review_text: This is a very special experience, if the weather cooperates.  The team at TAT was great at finding a time to reschedule us so that we could make it happen. It could not have been a better experience. The views, the knowledge shared, the glacier landing!!!  I was blessed to be able to have this experience!

A once in a lifetime experience for sure. Landing on a glacier way away from any civilization was mind-blowing. The only sounds were the ones I made walking on the snow/ice. We flew with Paul. Had no idea who he was until after, when I googled the outfit. Weather prevented us from flying the north side of Denali. I had not noticed. The company refunded us for that portion of the flight without us asking or even knowing. High level of integrity, all I can say. Lovely experience. Will recommend to anyone that travels near you!

I’ve been living in Alaska for two years and this takes the cake for one of the coolest experiences I’ve had so far. The Talkeetna Air team was incredibly accommodating and professional assisting my cousin who is a paraplegic load the aircraft. Our pilot Tim was so skilled and was a great guide. We had a fantastic time and I would recommend to anyone visiting Alaska.

one of the best things we have ever done.  Amazing views and landing on the mountin was a plus

signed up for the summit tour but they called 2 hours before and said they did not meet quota so we were put on the Grand Denali Tour w/ Glacier Landing. It was the most fantastic tour imaginable. Absolutely incredible. Pilot was excellent narrator.

Amazing! I took tons of videos and photos. We went all in with the Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing, and it worth the extra money. I am not sure how many flight tours I will do in my life, paying the extra to maximize the experience was worth it to me. 

I took dramamine for the flight and still got motion sickness but not too bad, so if you are prone to motion sickness I would for sure take something. 

I dressed a little too warm for the flight (leggings, t-shirt, long sleeve, long jacket and beanie) but took the jacket and beanie off during the flight. It was actually warm on the glacier because the sun was out but the pilot told us it can get cold quick if a cloud blocks the sun so I was grateful I dressed warm, as you can always layer down. You are also only on the glacier for 15-20 minutes. 

If you are doing the glacier landing, I highly recommend wearing the boots they give you for over your shoes as the snow can be pretty deep on the glacier- some people that just wore their waterproof shoes ended up with snow inside their shoes and had wet feet for the flight back. 

Such an epic experience! We took my parents, who are in their early 70s and my mother is terrified of flying - she did great - she was pretty scared during the flight but now it's all she talks about, is so proud of herself, and is open to doing a flight tour again in the future. 

Our pilot Luke made us all feel comfortable - definitely in good hands! Everyone we encountered that worked there were kind and professional - highly recommend.

review_title: Best activity of our Alaska trip
review_text: Highlight of the trip! Stunning views, smooth ride. Splurge for the glacier landing if you can, it’s incredible. Also just because it’s a little cloudy on the ground doesn’t mean you won’t have pretty skies in the mountains.

review_title: Surreal views and glacier landing was a  bonus!
review_text: Lucked out with the weather.  Andy the pilot did a smooth take-off/landing both on ground and on the glacier.  The views were fantastic, especially of Mt. Denali - we got to view it from the North and South.  The glacier landing was the icing on the cake!

review_title: On top of the world, once-in-a-lifetime experience
review_text:
Incredible experience! There's nothing else that can compare to seeing this landscape from the air. Truly awe inspiring. If you only do one thing when you visit Alaska- do this!! 

Everyone gets a window seat, which I think is great, and our pilot Daniel explained a lot of interesting things about the geography, climbing history, and what we were seeing. He also did turns specifically to make sure that both sides of the plane had good views of things. All seats are good views! He also offered to take pictures for people once we landed at base camp. Everyone has a headset so it's easy to hear why the pilot is saying, and the cabin is heated (though it can still be chilly).

The flights and views are weather dependent, but the staff does its best to keep people informed of the weather conditions and their top priority is to keep everyone safe (Of course, they can't control the weather and sometimes have to cancel flights, but safety is #1). The weather can be tricky but the pilots and rest of the team are experienced. We had some clouds in the area and the pilot explained some of how he was deciding where to fly and why based on that. 

There is a souvenir shop with sweatshirts and hats and stickers, and fantastic new restrooms with a water bottle station. Probably the best bathrooms in town!

It was a bit of a drive to get here from Anchorage (where we were staying) but it was worth it!  Seeing the glaciers that have been there for millions of years and to even land on one and take it all in is amazing!  Our pilot was very good at pointing out what we were looking at and even takes photos of you with your phone when you land on the glacier!  Although we booked the Denali experience, we were not able to go around it as the clouds were very thick, so we landed on a different glacier.  And while this was a big disappointment, the company gave everyone a partial refund because of this and it was put in before we even got back to the airfield!!!!    Great company...

The flight around Denali and the glacier landing were the highlight of our Alaska vacation.  The pilot gave great explanations about what we were seeing, and made a point of turning the plane so that passengers on both sides could have great views.  This up close look and immersive experience really helped us appreciate the majesty of Denali and its sorrowing mountains.

We booked months prior to our trip to Alaska. I called to make the reservations, and they couldn't have been nicer! The day of our flight was finally here and we were excited. When we arrived for check in, they were extremely honest, that the weather was deteriorating, and they could not fly the flight we had booked. They offered an alternate flight for a reduced rate but were very honest of what we would or would not be able to see. They gave us a choice of a full refund or this alternate flight. We chose a refund, which they processed immediately. Their care of customers is unmatched! Kudos!

This tour takes you on a small plane over Alaskan wilderness and out to the glaciers and mountain ranges, culminating with a circuit of Denali itself.  It was one of the highlights of my trip to Alaska.  Seeing the mountains and glaciers this way is simply indescribable; you have to take the tour to understand how amazing it is.

I have never paid for my family to enjoy flight seeing, but thought this might be worth it. It was breathtaking. The 1 1/2 hour trip with glacier landing was SO worth it!   We were blessed with clear weather too!

This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience!  The Grand Tour was a lengthy and  
close up look at multiple majestic peaks and glaciers.  I cannot speak highly enough of the trip.  The pilot and crew were very capable and professional.

We did the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing and it was by far the highlight of our trip!  Everyone who worked there was great and seemed truly happy to be doing what they were doing.  The flight was flawless, the weather perfect and the views of Denali, Hunter and Foraker were spectacular.  This was possibly the most amazing thing I've done!  We highly recommend flightseeing with Talkeetna Air Taxi!

I was in Alaska for 11 days and while I saw many amazing things, this Flightseeing was definitely at the top of my favorites. The narration was excellent, the flight itself was comfortable and the views were just out of this world. Would highly recommend this company and this particular tour--well worth it!

Incredible once in a lifetime experience. Stunning views and highly professional, we felt very comfortable with our experienced and chilled out pilot. Would recommend this to anyone visiting Talkeetna

Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) runs a smooth operation from the moment you enter their office door to the time you exit the plane when the tour ends.  Their staff are fantastic. Our pilot, Dan, was very professional, safe, and a great tour guide.  He was full of fascinating information about Denali and its surroundings.  The tour was worth every penny.

Dr Matthew A Johnson
Centralia WA

This turned into the trip of a lifetime for my wife and me. We had exellant weather through out the whole flight and were astonished to see Denali up close and personel. The pilot was terrific with all sorts of information on both the mountain and the surrounding area.  He made sure both sides of the plane saw all the great sights, but I was on the left side (copilot side) and thought a may have seen more then my wife. I'm also guessing they fly witht the weather, so this my not always be true. The glacier landing was fantastic with enough time to enjoy the massive bowl we landed in, (We were able to make snowballs with glacial snow).
Took way to many pictures but that is the way it goes. 
Hiughly recommend this trip when in the area,

Fabulous tour and flight! Dan, our pilot, was fantastic and pointed out highlights and provided lots of information the entire flight. Great experience - would definitely go again. Worth it to see Denali up close!

Great Experience from organization, pilot knowledge and glacier landing. Everything was safe, well organized and with great knowledge of the area. This was the highlight of our trip and I would recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
My adult daughter and I have done many trips and adventures, but as she said “This is the best special trip we’ve done “. My advice: Do it!

review_title: Aerial view of glacie and peaks
review_text:
We booked the Summit tour with glacie landing one day ahead. This was recommended by some posters, pending on weather condiction. The forecast was cloudy. for 6/16-19, with rain on 6/20. So we decided on 6/18. We looked into K2 and Seldon. But Air Taxi is the only one with our tour plan.

The flight was much smoother than expected. The view is spectacular. We saw vast forest, lakes, rivers, hills, rocks, cloud, trails, tents, climbers, glacies and peaks. Our pilot, Tim, is humours, experienced and knowledgable. 

The landing is also smooth. After climbing down we were immersed in ice, wind, mountains and glacies. Unexpectedly our last tour member lives in a cliff house on the landing site. She hijacked a ride home inside a national park at over 5,000 feet!

There are two minor issues. 
1. Gasoline smell in the airport. It disappeard during flight.
2. My earphone sound quality is not good. Also it is not easy to adjust. It could be improved if they have plug in for our own sound.

Overall it is a once-in-a-lifetime tour, with a price tag

Incredible trip. Incredible pilot! We zipped around mountain peaks and clouds. Mother Nature had plans for us that did not include a glacier landing or seeing Denali up close. We got a refund before we landed!! Would definitely do another trip with TAT.

review_title: Amazing flight over the snow capped mountains!
review_text: Incredible experience!  Well organized, everyone friendly.  The flight was amazing!  Such beauty!  We didn’t get to land on a glacier due to the weather, and they actually refunded us a portion of the trip. Definitely recommend doing this!
Amazing! We also did the glacier landing. Truly a once in a lifetime experience. Breathtaking views and great information from the pilot. We highly recommend this!

Booked this tour as I thought landing a plane on a glacier was just something I had to see for myself. The tour was fantastic. 8:30 AM flight out of Talkeetna directly to the Alaskan Mountain Range. The morning was partly cloudy with the sun shining through and Denali standing out in all her glory. The flight over the mountains and around Denali was thrilling with breathtaking views. Our pilot, a young man from New Zealand, was professional and knowledgable providing lots of information about the region. We saw Base Camp 2 at 11,000ft with a group of climbers camping. We also had 2 climbers on board who were going to be dropped at Base Camp to begin their summit attempt. Te landing at Bases Camp, 7,000 ft, was incredible. Walking on the glacier and around the camp was a dream come true. One of the high points of our 3 weeks in Alaska. The price is steep, but to us the trip was worth the stretch. I highly recommend this excursion and would venture to say to should not be missed.
This trip was incredible.  The views are amazing and our pilot, Liam, gave an informative narration throughout the trip.  Highly recommend.

What an experience. We took this flight seeing tour from Talkeetna. Our time was 8.30 AM and we reached as required, around 45 minutes before. We did some paper work and were given a briefing about plane and safety. We were also given some boots to wear on our shoes when we land on glacier on the snow. We were three plus a few other people, totally around 9 passenger and two crew. It was a bit scary when we started but the beautiful scenes made us forget our fear. we were soon soaring over the trees, rivers, mountains, clouds and a lot more. What a beautiful trip, it was just awesome. The views were unbelievable. We went around a lot of peaks including magnificent Denali. Then the climax of our trip—landing on a glacier. It was just too good to be true.  The pilot, a young chap from New Zealand landed very professionally. We got down on a fresh coat of snow. It was deep. We stayed there for around 20 minutes walking around and watching the scenery and taking pictures. Then it was time to take off again. Take off was also smooth and soon we’re up and circling the mountains again enjoying the ride and the views.  Soon it was time to return to base. Overall an awesome experience. 
Keep in mind this will be done if weather is clear. If not, then you get a full refund. We were lucky as last day it had snowed full day while our day was bright and sunny. This is an experience that is not to be missed.

Great trip
And fabulous way to see the mountains and glaciers. Highlight of our trip even the weather was beautiful!  Would do again

review_title: Grand Denali Flight Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text:
10/10 recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi! Seriously if you’re looking for a flight tour, this is the company to go through. We had an amazing time with breath taking views that made this trip absolutely magical. The mountains and landscapes were astonishing. So many glaciers, mountain peaks, ridgelines and of course Denali. Everyone at TAT was so friendly, professional, accommodating, knowledgeable and patient! Everyone in the office was great. Amanda was the one who got me and my group of 10 people booked and ready for our trip! I didn’t have a for sure amount of 10 people when I first called to schedule, but Amanda was patient and flexible with me until I could confirm my whole group. Her and another lady (I’m sorry I forgot your name) were so helpful with answering my multitude of questions and helping us to feel assured and ready for our trip. 
Our pilot Clay was excellent! He was cool, calm, fun and knowledgeable providing us with great information all throughout the trip. And most importantly he kept us safe! He checked on us throughout the flight making sure we were comfortable, updated us on when their might be some turbulence and was patient with our photo taking on the glacier and with our little kiddos we had with us. 
The office was clean, warming and had a true Alaskan feel to it. The plane ride was comfortable and even though I get nervous with turbulence (we had very little of it on our flight) I still felt very safe. I have 4 other friends that have used this company and they all have had the same positive, exhilarating and time of their life experience with this company. I will certainly be referring my friends and family here and if I get the second chance, I will be flying with them again. 

Thank you TAT crew!! 😎🙌🏼

This was a humbling experience. We ended up having to wait 3 days for the weather to clear to take this tour. The staff communicated well with us and let us know the day before that we would be able to go. So Weather is AK is always a risk, be patient and flexible it is worth it. The mountains and views were spectacular. Landing on the glacier at the foot of Denali was humbling and breathtaking.

We booked this tour independently after being unable to book a flightseeing excursion with the land/cruise trip by Celebrity Cruises. We easily found the small Talkeetna Airport. We walked to it from the small town of Takeenta in less than 10 mins. 
The entire was EXCELLENT! The pilot was very experienced (+20 yrs in Alaska), and we had an easy take-off and landing. He pointed out all of the amazing sights. The views were breathtaking! We were a party of four, including 2 elementary aged children. It was our first time in a small plane.  We would all highly recommend this tour and this company.

Absolutely breathtaking views and experience. The experience is something that has to be done. Just go! Book the flight- and you wont regret. The flight was smooth and unforgettable, and the pilot was a great guide and professional.

We debated cancelling this excursion as we had done so much flying already, but I am SO glad we didn't!  The first day we were not able to go as the weather wasn't clear, but they rescheduled us to the next day and it was perfect!  Wow, what a fabulous way to see Denali.  Gorgeous views the entire route.  Not a cloud in the sky.  We landed on the glacier and had the opportunity to get out and walk around and take some pics.  Wow, what an awesome experience!

Absolutely breathtaking views. The scale is just something that has to be seen to be believed. The flight was smooth and professionally run, and the pilot was a great guide. 100% would recommend again.

review_title: Denali Flight was an amazing closeup of massive peaks
review_text: This is a truly amazing bucket list experience. Up in a small 12 seater buzzing around the denali range like you are taking intro shots for a lord of the rings movie. The pilot said we got within about 500ft of some of the peaks but it felt like you could reach out and touch them at times. We also paid the extra to land on a feeder glacier for the Ruth Glacier flow and it was expensive but well worth it. Following the Glacier down on the way back was also an amazing and educational experience. We had a clear day for this trip which I am told is unusual, so we were very lucky.

I can’t even describe how amazing this was.  Pilot Alex was amazing and he made sure everyone got great views multiple times. This is a once in a  lifetime experience with the glacier landing being an absolute highlight.  Five stars isn’t nearly enough.   Loved it!!

review_title: Fantastic flight and landing experience in Denali
review_text: An absolutely amazing experience flying over Denali with a wonderful pilot who took us close the the points of interest and gave us tons of information about things we were seeing.  Getting off on the glacier and walking around to take pics was fantastic.  We loved his sense of humor as he we were leaving the glacier when he told us we were going on a toboggon ride .

review_title: Fly Denali & land on Ruth Glacier
review_text: This is the company to fly with around Denali & to land on Ruth Glacier. This flight exceeded all my expectations! My pilot, Nick was just lovely. Mad respect for landing on & taking off from a glacier!! Worth every penny.

A must-do in Talkeetna!! Although it was too cloudy for us to circle around Denali, we still got to take in some incredible views and enjoyed a glacier landing! Our pilot Liam was friendly and knowledgeable, and the whole team made the process go as smoothly as possible! You won’t regret signing up for any of their flightseeing experiences!

Our pilot was phenomenal. He told us what we were seeing and going to see ahead. He made certain the left and right side of the plane got to see the entire experience. We saw Denali in all her glory. She was out and it was breath taking. The pilot explained about not only Denali but all the other sites as we adventured there. Getting out on the glacier was such a thrill. I would recommend taking this trip.

review_title: Amazing Experience complete with a Glacier Landing!
review_text: This was a wonderful experience. Our private guide called ahead and we were told that the planes were doing the tour but landing on the glacier was not guaranteed for our particular day based on weather. Upon arrival to checkin we were greeted warmly, given our card, and send outside to wait. We were given glacier boots to cover our hiking shoes, in case we were able to disembark and walk on the glacier. Our pilot Tim, was EXCELLENT. He gave us our safety briefing and then did our flying tour, explaining everything, including flying us so close to the peaks, it was incredible. The pictures I took were amazing, it was great. He even played some great music while we flew. We were able to land on the glacier and that was also a great experience. We were traveling with my mom who uses a walker and she was able to climb in and out of the plane. I highly recommend this tour company, there is nothing I can share as constructive criticism, it was amazing.
Totally Breathtaking!!!  Favorite part was flying around and landing on a Glacier!  The pilot was awesome, shared history of the area and showed us more glaciers, lakes, etc!  Loved it.

Amazing flight! We took off from an early morning flight which was suggested to us as our flight the day before was canceled due to weather. The sky was clear as we took off. Beautiful scenery as we approached Denali. Once in the mountain range the pilot pointed out glacier areas and several of the big mountains. We were able to get a great view of Denali! Just breathtaking! We landed at base camp instead of the glacier due to changing weather. Great to see the other planes land bringing climbers who will head up to Denali. As we left base camp the weather was changing. I often fly commercial flights and I must say the pilot was one of the best I have flown with. Overall it was a very smooth flight and safe landings. This is a trip of a lifetime and a must do!

review_title: Grand adventure from runway to iceway!
review_text: A truly life-altering event! Alex provided unparalleled skill and hospitality as we explored the Alaska Range. My husband and I were blessed to be part of the tour and thankful that Alex was our pilot today!

Our family (kids 13, 10, 6) had an amazing experience on this tour. Our flight was smooth and our pilot/guide David/“Papa Romeo” was remarkably knowledgeable. We lucked out with weather and got  beyond the clouds in time to see Denali and its sister mountains in the sunlight. We also got to land on a glacier and take pictures, throw snowballs, and eat glacier snow. This tour was absolutely breathtaking.

Incredible experience. Made our AlaskaTrip !
Well worth the cost. Our pilot and plane were both amazing ! Would highly recommend to families.

review_title: A Must-Do for your Bucket List trip to Alaska
review_text: We had a great experience!  The weather put the trip in doubt, but Chris got us in the air with some great high altitude views of The Mountain. Very professional for them to refund the glacier landing fee - even before we got back to the airport.

Originally had scheduled Grand Denali with glacier landing however flight was cancelled due to poor weather. They were able to reschedule for the next day, just no glacier landing. Still very worth it to go on the plane. We were amazed at how close the pilot flies around the mountain. He was very informative and I was impressed at his flight skills! Amanda in the office was very friendly and helpful as well. Would definitely recommend this if in Talkeetna

review_title: EXCELLENT  flight with good narration/commentary from our pilot/guide.
review_text: Everything on this tour went well - from pre flight communications to booking to the actual flight. We had an EXCELLENT  flight with good narration/commentary from our pilot/guide. We lucked out with good weather and were able to see the top of Mt. Denali rising above the clouds. The glacier landing and experience was a big plus. For those who have not done an Alaska flight-seeing trip, I highly recommend it. The perspective from the air is a "must do" for your Alaska vacation.

review_title: See Mt Denali like never before
review_text: Incredible flight tour of Denali, some surrounding peaks, and glaciers. Andy was a terrific pilot and a great insight. Amanda was tremendously patient with my sheduling challenges! Highly recommend this experience! Every staff member was just spectacular to work with!

This was probably the NUMBER ONE FAVORITE vacation activity my husband and I have ever done. The rest of the trip almost paled in comparison. Liam, our pilot did such a great job. The views were indescribable and pictures do it no justice. The weather cooperated for us and the summit of Denali was clearly visible which we hear is rare. 
This place runs like clockwork. Even the bathrooms are top notch.
We highly recommend this company!

Worth every penny we spent going to Alaska. There are just no words for this experience. Flying between mountain peaks, stunning views, landing and taking off on a glacier with fresh snow. My group will be talking about this trip for years to come and it's worth coming all the way to Alaska for these 90 minutes. Major kudos to Liam - our pilot - who I firmly believe used the force the guide us on this adventure.

That was such an incredible experience!  Our excellent pilot, Alex,  flew us around the snow topped mountains surrounding Denali.  He would fly us in such a way that whether we were on the left or the right side of the plane, we could all see the same thing.  Then we landed on a 35 mile-long snow-topped glacier, got out of the plane and walked around.  It was a trip of a life time!
Excellent activity. It’s a sad sight to see glaciers receding but nevertheless, an amazing experience standing on 6000+ft of ice.

review_title: Best day of the Alaskan adventure!!!
review_text: Must do excursion when traveling to Denali.  The views are awesome and our pilot Clay did a fabulous job on the trip.  If you book the flight seeing trip you MUST include the glacier landing, you won’t regret it.

This was a spectacular and unique experience!  The flight and clear view of Denali and the surrounding peaks was beyond awe inspiring. The pilot was informative and skilled. Landing on the glacier was a riot ( and NOT scary).

The ground crew was very responsive and helpful. The flight was expensive but the experience priceless. We were speechless. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi for making our introduction to the grand mountain of Denali so fun and memorable.

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! We thoroughly enjoyed Tim as our pilot and gave us a smooth pleasurable flight. We landed at Base Camp on Mt McKinley, got to walk around & take lots of pictures! It was amazing and well worth the money! I recommend you do it😍 Ask for Tim he was Great!!

review_title: Phenomenal experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi
review_text: After another flightseeing tour company had to cancel at the last minute due to a sick pilot, Talkeetna Air Taxi came to the rescue. Their staff answered all our questions and got us scheduled onto one of their flights with minimal effort on our part. Pilot Clay did a fantastic job, making us feel safe and well-informed at all times. The flight itself was incomparable and the glacier landing is an absolute must-do!

Definitely a splurge, but so worth it. I recommend adding the glacier landing, it was incredible! The pilot was professional and engaging the whole time. I don't love flying and have never been in a small plane before, but felt mostly comfortable the whole time. Everyone on staff was professional and courteous. I highly recommend this company! They are closer to Denali than other companies by the national park, so you spend more time flying in the mountains instead of flat land, which is a plus. Amazing tour and unforgettable views. If you're on the fence, do it!

We did a Denali explorer flight seeing tour with glacier landing on July 5.  I had originally had this excursion booked for three weeks prior to this date, but I came down with covid and couldn't go on the cruise. We moved the cruise to a later date and I called Talkeetna Air Taxi to tell them and to ask if I could switch the excursion to the new date on my cruise and they were so helpful and understanding and made the change with no problem. I really appreciate how flexible and accommodating they were in this uncertain travel time that we are living in with Covid. When we arrived in Talkeetna we were asked to wait in front of a store on Main Street until we were picked up by one of their shuttle vans and brought to their office at the airfield. Once there we checked in, got our boot covers and waited for our flight time. We could see the plane that we were going to go up in and they were doing a last minute cleaning to it. Wiping down the windows to make sure everyone had a perfect view for pictures, which I thought was a nice touch. Finally our group was called to head to our plane where we met our pilot (I can’t remember his name, but he was from New Zealand and he was fantastic!). He went over the necessary safety information and then asked if anyone wanted to sit in the cockpit seat and of course I volunteered. That was the best decision, I got such amazing photos from up there which were unobstructed by the wings of the plane. We had a surprisingly clear day, we had even seen the mountain in her entirety from the ground so the pilot said we would have exceptional views once up at the mountain and boy was he right. There’s nothing that can compare to seeing the enormity and majesty of the range and that mountain up close. The pilot flew all around and switched directions so that both sides of the plane could get views of everything. He kept up a nice steady commentary of what we were seeing and interesting facts. Then it was time to land on the glacier. Our pilot picked Ruth Glacier to land because he said he liked the views from there better and I have to agree after seeing some of the other glacier landing sites that other pilots were using he was right. We were on the glacier for about 20 minutes to take photos, have a snowball fight, and just appreciate the beauty around us. He took photos of each family group with the plane, the mountain etc. I’m usually really picky about my photos and end up deleting most of them but I was pleasantly surprised with how perfect the photos he took were! We loaded back up in the plane and headed back to the airport. The whole ride was smooth with very little turbulence. Everyone that we met at Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly and helpful. They are extremely professional and most importantly safe. Their equipment is maintained nicely. I can’t recommend this company enough.

We did the Grand Denali flight seeing experience with the Glacier Landing, and it was truly amazing! Liam was a great pilot and took care of us from start to finish. The views were unbelievable, and the memories made will last a lifetime! Do not miss this experience! Thank you, TAT!

Incredible!!  Our pilot & tour guide, Alex, provided a once-in-a-lifetime trip.  Safety & points of interest #1 from Alex.  He made sure to fly the plane in all directions so everyone enjoyed the views & see Denali herself!  And, he was kind to take our photo after he landed us on Ruth's Glacier.  🙏  Thank you TAT & Alex for a seriously wonderful adventure!!!

review_title: The experience to do while in Denali
review_text: This was an amazing flight, our pilot Andy did a great job. Highly recommend, something you will remember for the rest of your life

An incredible, unforgettable experience!  Clay, our pilot, was the best.  He kept us at ease the whole trip and shared some great stories and information about the  Park and the Mountain.  The views of Denali and all the other majestic mountains were simply amazing, and the glacier landing was spectacular.  Customer service was professional and the team who work there are friendly, helpful and top notch all the way.  This is a must do if you visit Talkeetna!  Loved it so much I bought a t-shirt:)

It was almost a last minute decision to get on this tour as I was somewhat concerned about safety and motion sickness. None was an issue! Our pilot, Tim, made us feel super comfortable and flight barely differed from those commercial jet flights - smooth and confident. Totally enjoyed the experience. We got very lucky with the weather and had stunning views of the mountains and rivers. Definitely worth every penny!

Realized that we didn't need to have snow boots - they give you "wrap-ons" to step on the mushy ice as the glacier is melting under the sun now. It also wasn't cold.

Driving could take a bit longer because of the road works, so add about 30 minutes to allow ample time before getting on the plane.

Truly a life memory. Didn't realize I had a bucket list till I did this and realized this is what belongs on a bucket list. The reservations were easy and although we almost missed the flight due to travel delays (leave a lot of time to get to Talkeetna, road can be under construction). We got right on the plane an took off. While I don't like to fly , this was one of the best flights I have ever taken. Super pilot and weather did cooperate. 
We flew around Denali and did the glacier landing. Just amazing sights, and the beauty of the glacier and all that snow and mountains is breathtaking.

What an incredible experience! Our pilot, Melissa, was absolutely wonderful! She pointed out the best parts and made turns with the plane to make sure everyone saw the best views. Definitely a once in a lifetime experience!

AN ABSOLUTE MUST DO! We did the 2 hr Grand Denali Flight with the Glacier Landing in June 22. It could not have been more awe-inspiring!  I was hesitant to book at first because I tend to get motion sickness and it was a long flight. So glad I did. It was truly amazing. This was our second trip to Denali National Park but we had only done the park service bus tour previously. It was great, but no comparison to this one!  The vistas from the air are unbelievable!  Melissa, our pilot, was super skilled and provided great  narration, pointing out mountains and glaciers and providing interesting facts in a natural cadence. The flight and glacier landing were smooth and the weather was great. Words cannot describe the grandeur and magic viewed on this flight!  AN ABSOLUTE MUST DO!  Don’t hesitate. The ground staff was friendly and efficient. We were picked up from, and returned to,  our hotel. Special waterproof grip booties were provided. We only needed light jackets. It can be challenging for seniors to climb into the plane, but well worth it. As was the price. STUNNING views of the Alaska range, Denali, glaciers, and land around Talkeetna. Don’t miss it! First class service and unimaginable views!

Five Star Ride @talkeetnaair We had a great experience, perfect star to finish. Thanks to all staff doing possible this spectacular trip especially to our pilot Melissa She’s very professional and friendly; take off and landing were incredible smooth.
Absolutely recommended!!!

review_title: Could not have been better. Well worth it.
review_text:
Could not have been more professional.  The plane, an otter, accommodated about 9 people and was in immaculate condition.  The pilot was highly experienced and was an excellent guide.  The view of the mountains was breathtaking and landing on the Ruth Glasier was surreal.  Although the trip was pricey, you could justify it within the context of maintenance, care, and higher fuel costs.
Well worth it.

We recently took the Grand Denali flight and glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi and couldn’t have been more pleased. From the check in to check out, the entire staff was great. We especially enjoyed our pilot, Melissa. She was very conscious of our safety, describing the sites, making sure passengers on both sides of the plane got to see the beautiful views and finally taking great photos/videos of our group during our glacier landing. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi if you’re in the area.
This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska. Experience was great, staff was great, pilot was great. We did the Grand Denali flight with glacier landing. Unforgettable experience!

review_title: Stunning views!  Friendly staff - great time.
review_text:
This flight is a must-do!  We booked the Grand Denali with the glacier stop.  The views were stunning; once in a lifetime experience.  I highly recommend adding this to your itinerary - you won't be disappointed.

The crew, Andy and Liam, were knowledgeable and friendly.  It was easy to tell they enjoyed their jobs.   The office staff were very friendly and helpful.

We had a great time and wouldn't hesitate to book again; it doesn't get old.
I highly recommend the experience and Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Amazing!!!  Paul, our pilot, dropped some knowledge about rock climbing spots (my daughter loves climbing) as we flew threw the park as well as some other interesting facts. It was the best thing we did on our Alaskan trip. We even landed on a glacier at the base on Denali mountain. It was cold as hell but so worth it.

review_title: Flight around Denali and landing on glacier was AWESOME!
review_text: Leah our pilot did a fantastic job.  The flight to and around Denali was one of the best things we have ever done on a vacation.  The landing on the glacier and ability to get out and walk around such an incredible place was spectacular.  It was EXPENSIVE, but I have to say, well worth the money.
All around, a very professional and safe service. We had to come down a bit early due to the weather, but It was certainly a hell of a tour!

I can not say enough about this amazing experience. I felt completely safe the pilot was so competent and pleasant. She told us so much about the mountain, glaciers and the area itself. The views were breathtaking, I can not believe that I had this experience. It was absolutely incredible. If you ever have an opportunity to take this flight I can not recommend it enough, You will not regret it

review_title: Denali from a team of experts.
review_text: These guys killed it. What an experience. If you have an interest in seeing Denali, these guys take you on a trip of a lifetime. Not for the faint of heart as the dips and banks make for great viewing but it is not a commercial airline program. Covid rules apply.
Simply Amazing glacier landing. Once in a lifetime adventure that is a must do if you are visiting Alaska. Highly trained pilots take you on an adventure of a lifetime.
The Voyager flight around Denali was amazing, coupled with the glacier landing was a highlight for all of us.  A once in the lifetime experience and photo with the family.

review_title: A Must on your Alaska Adventure!
review_text:
We did the Grand Denali tour with Glacier landing and it was an amazing experience. Perfect length flight to see Denali and more of the Alaska range from above. Pilot and staff were very friendly, helpful, and had great communication. 

We are professional photographers and got some pretty awesome images and video. Hands down the best tour/experience in our 10day trip around Alaska. Worth the money 100%. 

Good covid protocols for those who are worried about mask usage etc…

Highly recommend!
Our flight ended up being canceled because of weather, but the company worked with us to get us on a flight the next day. It turned out to be a great day and it was such an incredible experience!

This trip exceeded our expectations. While I’d like to summit Denali, those days are long behind me. This gave us a nice, up close and very safe perspective of the park and her beautiful peaks. The glacier landing was magnificent. Our pilot Andy, a seasoned pilot, gave a nice glacial geography lesson too. All part of a wonderful experience that I highly recommend.

this was by far the most amazing adventure of our Alaska trip.  Our pilot was personalble and well experienced and she went out of her way to ensure the everyone on the plane got the same experience looking at the great views of Denali.  The weather was perfect and our glacier landing and take off was spot on. this was something you can explain in words but have to experience for yourself.  It was worth every penny.

We took the Grand Denali Flight Seeing Tour with Glacier Landing. The tour provides awe-inspiring looks of the Denali mountain range and the glaciers. Thoroughly enjoyed the tour and took some great pics.

Highly recommend It.

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna
review_text: Talkeetna Air Taxi was great! Our pilot, Andrew, was extremely informative and very friendly. We would definitely book this tour again.
Excellent adventure with my family,  great memories made.   Nice smooth ride on the airplane. Made the trip worthwhile
This was our favorite adventure of our visit to Alaska. Our pilot Leah was fantastic. The glacier landing and views of Denali were outstanding! Highly recommended!

I simply cannot say enough about this flightseeing tour.  It was exhilarating to fly between these mountains and glaciers, with breathtaking views.  And on our trip, DENALI was visible with all her glory!  Our pilot, Andy, was a wealth of knowledge and instilled confidence.  The ride was flawless.  We had briefly considered a different, shorter trip - thank goodness we did not try to save a few dollars - THIS is where you spend the money because THIS is the experience you want when you visit Alaska.  Landing on the glacier was a huge thril.  I cannot recommend this more highly - if you visit Alaska take this company and this flightseeing tour and (weather permitting) you will not regret it.

review_title: Landing on the glacier is an absolute WOW!
review_text:
I took the Grand Denali flight with a glacier landing. This was not guaranteed since weather was a bit cloudy.
During the flight we went close to some peaks and Alex the pilot provided detailed information on each and every peak, valley and glacier.
But the best part was, hands down, the part when we started manouvering into the landing and then out of the blue we touched the ground!
Then we got a decent amount of time to wander around and explore this untouched land.
Absolutely fantastic 😍

review_title: Flight and Glacier landing WORTH EVERY PENNY!
review_text:
Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing---

I have traveled up through Talkeetna on to Denali National Park numerous times over the last 10 years.   I had never, up until this trip, taken advantage of the Talkeetna Air Taxi service; and all I can say about that is "Shame on me!".   
First, know that I have tried to take the flight out of Denali in the past.   While I was not successful because of the weather, this trip I was advised that while the company out of the park is a great company, the flight into would potentially be better.  The flight out saved 6 hours of bus time, and weather permitting saw some cool sights, but the flight in, with glacier landing would amaze.   They were 100% right.   Second, know that I was thinking of saving some money and not doing the glacier landing.  I called Talkeetna Air and spoke with one of their employees.  That employee did not pressure sell me at all.  She explained what people like about the flight options, those with and without glacier landings, she gave me an honest account of the time in the air (15 minutes into the park, the a lot of time flying around the summit, then a landing if chosen, than a nice flight out) for a total time much longer than the flight out of the park (mind you).  She also explained what she thinks of landing on the glacier.  Explaining to me that while I have been to Alaska and hiked and seen glaciers, being on one in the Denali range in the mountains would amaze me with the vast openness and quite.  Again, she didn't try to sell me, she simply tried to explain pros and cons.  In the end, there weren't many cons other than a bit more money---and let's be honest, if you are forking out the money for the flight, you might as well not be cheap like I was going to be.  We settled on the flight and landing and it was worth EVERY PENNY!  I kid you not.  Everything about the flight was amazing.  Our pilot-- She was amazing.  There was a time when she said--ok, we are going to fly into the face of the mountain now to give you an idea of how big it is--but don't worry, we are at least a mile from the face.  It seemed like we were right next to it!!   She warned us when it might get a bit bumpy, and why, and then we were prepared and could still experience the sights that the bumpy air allowed us to see.  And the glacier landing was amazing.   To land in snow in a mountain and take off in snow on a mountain is a modern feat.  These planes they use are amazing.  And the pilots the best!  So there is that all by itself.  But to step  out and see it and listen and just exist was the best.  Every person on that flight was blown away.  Every person on that flight had a smile from ear to ear.   I am not going to lie to you--- we had perfect weather on August 21st---some of the best they had seen in a couple of weeks.  We saw Denali in all her beauty.  In fact, we saw her driving in to Talkeetna, on the flight and the next day on the bus tour (which I have done 4 times and it never gets old).  So we were blessed!  But Talkeetna air does not shy away from being honest with you about the weather.  They will not go up in the weather is bad.  And if the clouds are in but weather ok to fly, they will be open about that tour.  And they go out of their way to rebook you if necessary.  In fact, later that week while in Seward on a whale/glacier tour with Alaska Saltwater Lodge & Tours (who I highly recommend as well) we met a mother and daughter that tried to fly the day before us.  They could not because of weather.  And Talkeetna worked with them and their very busy trip (already planned) to accommodate another flight.    With that, what I recommend is you book your travel days (if going by car mind you) to Denali park a couple of days apart.  Plan the flight on the way up there.  If it doesn't work out, try to plan a reschedule for your day out of the area if going back towards Anchorage.   

Bottom line-- I will absolutely do this experience again.  I will absolutely use Talkeenta Air Taxi.   I will absolutely do the flight and glacier landing.   And I will absolutely love it.   

Oh, and one other thing.  I had my mom and dad with me.  Both in the mid 70s.  Mom a bit leery of small planes and nervous.   She did fine.  In fact, she did better than fine.  She was not once scared nor flight sick nor anything but amazed.  It was one of the highlights of her trip and it set the stage for more adventures.   

Thank you Talkeetna Air!
Great experience. Weather was changing and pooled made decision on safety. Nice explanation of where we were and local attractions like ideriod trail.

We had a flight arranged for a day that was going to rain so I called to see if they would switch our day and time and we were able to do it. Very accommodating and friendly people! We also landed on a glacier which was amazing. The pilot gave us a lot of information about Denali and the surrounding mountains - not only beautiful scenery but learned some new things. Highly recommend!!
The pilot was informative, engaging and made sure we saw Denali from many angles. Amazing! Go for it

The whole experience, from the lady on the deck with uncanny ability to guess shoe sizes (for glacier boots) to the landing back in Talkeetna, was awesome.  The day was clear and special care was taken to insure that all passengers got great views.  The glacier landing was pretty cool.

The weather was amazing and so was our pilot.  This trip was number one on my list of all of our tours in Alaska.  We highly recommend it.  Felt comfortable and safe with a pilot that has YEARS of experience under his belt and he was very familiar with all of the sites.  Will do again!

Just do it!  This is the most amazing tour you may ever do.  Picture-perfect day to see the valley, Denali mountain range and the 3rd-highest peak in the world!  The views were amazing but landing on the glacier was unbelievable.  Our pilot Khris was tremendous and we can’t say enough about this tour.  Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We were fortunate to have a perfectly clear day on our second attempt for a flight around Denali with glacier landing. (my husband had tried 8 times before with no success due to weather).  Talkeetna Air was very helpful with being flexible so that we could reschedule on a good weather day.  Everything was better than anticipated from easy checkin to the actual flight.  Our pilot Melissa was delightful,  the perfect pilot as well as tour guide and we were very comfortable with her expertise and the plane, including her taking pictures for us on the glacier landing.  Experience of a lifetime and well worth every penny.  Would absolutely recommend if you’re lucky enough to get good weather.

review_title: A must do if you can!
review_text: This was an add to our AK trip about a week ahead of time.  We are happy with our decision!  The staff, from check-in, to the lady on the deck getting our boots, to our pilot were all so nice and welcoming.   It was truly an experience and an amazing view. Landing on the glacier provided a great experience on our AK trip!

Make sure you bring a movie camera or a camera period, or you will miss some of the most spectacular views in your life time . If you think the cost is too much think again you will never see anything like it and it something you will treasure your whole life .Our  pilot was great ,landing was smooth , and taking off from a glacier was incredible.
Our trip also included the Glacier Landing.  We enjoyed our trip with Alex!  One of the highlights of our two weeks in Alaska.
Great experience, it highly exceeded my expectations. I definitely recommend it! It was breathteaking since the takeoff

Booked 4 on the Grand Denali flight. The weather was great, and the views were unbelievable. Our pilot, Sean, did a great job of making sure everyone got a good view and told us lots of interesting information throughout the flight.

We really enjoyed landing on the glacier, getting out to look around, and dreaming of staying at the Mountain House.

Through expensive, this is one of the coolest things we've ever done , and I would recommend it to anyone. We used a 25% off coupon from the Northern Lights coupon book.

We had never done a small plane tour before and were a little hesitant to spend the money for 6 of us to go, but I am so happy we did. Everything about the tour and company was top notch. Our pilot was very skilled and knowledgeable. We ended up having a perfect day and had some awe-inspiring views. The glacier landing is a must!

Flying around Denali seeing the beautiful mountain and the Glaciers up close and then landing on the Glacier and walking around in this indescribable beautiful place.
The company personnel were really friendly and helpful the pilot was very good and informative.

I had never been in a small plane and was nervous but Lee Ann’s piloting was smooth as silk from takeoff to landing. The weather before takeoff was uncertain with Denali shrouded in clouds above 10,000 feet but we went anyway and were rewarded with a break that showed us the whole mountain in all its glory. Thank you for an unforgettable experience and for the partial refund for shortening the trip due to the weather.

If you ever travel to Alaska, I would put this on the top of the list of things to do while you are there.  It was by far the most amazing thing my wife and I have ever done on vacation.  The pilot was great.  We stayed on the glacier nearly twice as long as the brochure suggests.  The plane ride was super smooth for a smaller plane.  All the pictures in the world can't portray the beauty you will see.

We had a great experience flying around the mountains and landing on snow clad slope. One of the best part of our Alaska trip. Our pilot Alex was super cool and provided great commentary all through the flight giving great insights on the mountain range,  and the surrounding landscape. I took plenty of great pictures, videos from the plan and on the glacier of the other planes landing. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. We were a group of two families of four and got accommodated on the same plane.
The facility was great with clean restrooms and a neat gift shop.

Most unbelievable experience of our AK trip! Inclement weather made peak views and a glacier landing questionable and we were given the option to cancel with a full refund or roll the dice. So glad we rolled the dice! Our pilot was awesome and the views were unreal!

Wow!!! This was an AMAZING adventure for our whole family!  It was our daughter’s 16th birthday trip and what a fantastic way to see Denali. Everything about the flight was even better than we had hoped.  Our pilot, Leanne, was so kind and friendly and told us so many cool things about Alaska and the beautiful scenery and mountain exploration. She made the whole tour fun and exciting! The glacier landing was epic!  We all loved every minute of our time. Then on the flight back our daughter got to sit up front as “co-pilot”!  We couldn’t have asked for a better adventure for our family.  Would recommend this tour to anyone. Better than 5 stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️+
Landing at Base Camp. Great view of Denali. LeeAnn was a very informative and competent pilot. Felt very safe. Smooth flight.

This was one of the best flying experiences I’ve had in my life. I fly aircraft down south but this was still shocking how incredible the view was. Our pilot Leighan was one of the best pilots I’ve flown with. Great company and staff, can’t thank them enough!

I really wanted to give a better review because the view was incredible. I was surprised we were offered a full refund because of cloud cover but they convinced us that we would see the mountains once we broke through. Indeed the scenery was outstanding and the pilot did a great job of making sure all passengers could see the mountain. However we were the first to arrive and the last to be placed on a plane. In addition to the usual 30-45 wait we stood in the cold for another hour. They changed our placement three times including once that when they did not inform us. My feet were cold prior to departure and only got worse on the flight which was freezing. The pilot admitted he was too hot so did not put the heat on. This company could communicate better and actually care about the customer and not just the money.

My 14 year old son and I just took the Grand Denali Tour with Talkeena Air Taxi, it was perhaps the most profoundly beautiful experience of our lives. Brought tears to our eyes. Can’t wait to come back.

I signed up for the longest flight but the weather didn't cooperated.  Denali decided to invite a warm front that generated a lot of clouds and rough air.  However, the pilot did what he could to make the flight and give us the best experience he could, under the circumstances.
As a result, the company responded with a sizable refund so I felt I received the best value I could.  The people were extremely friendly and accommodating.

We absolutely loved our flight with our pilot LeeAnn. I was nervous about flying in a small plane, but she was so experienced, confident, and knowledgeable. Her narration was perfect. The glacier landing was phenomenal and we got to hang out for about 10 min to take in the experience. Our pilot did everything she could to get us the best views of the mountain as possible and helped each side of the plane get a good view. We are so happy we decided to book this activity. A final note, we had to make last minute changes to our booking because one in our party fell ill the morning of the event, and the company went above and beyond to help us out. Highly recommend! Do it!

We also were able to land on Pika Glacier. The weather at the start was iffy, but it cleared enough to have great views of the Denali range and to land on the glacier. Our Pilot, Chris, is quite skilled and was able to avoid most of the rough air. He was knowledgeable and personable. The only thing I would change was the unnecessarily long lead time between check in and flight. We did not need to be there as early as they said we did, but oh well, the experience was so great I almost forgot about that.

review_title: Far and away our best event in Alaska
review_text: We were in Alaska, in three different cities over 9 days.  We did multiple events each day but this flight was far and away the best part of our trip.  Two hours in the plane....flying around the peaks in Denali and then landing on a Glacier.  Our photos even from our cell phones were breathtaking. Andy, our pilot, was fantastic about explaining what we were seeing and making sure that both of sides of the plane got good views of everything.  I would HIGHLY recommend!!

We have a family of 4 adults and we did the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing.  It was definitely worth it.  Mark was our pilot was narrated the tour and landed us on the glacier.  The views were spectacular of Denali and all the ridges and glaciers.  We had cabin pressure and had to keep swallowing to relieve the pressure.  The left side of the plane seemed to have better views of Denali.   The people in the office were great to meet and friendly.  Definitely take their advice and wear sunglasses and a jacket.

review_title: Awesome flight through and around Denali
review_text: Landing on the Ruth Glacier was one of the most amazing experiences. Surrounded by all the peaks in the middle of Denali is almost mystical!

This was truly an unbelievable experience.  We were very lucky...the weather was clear blue skies...not a cloud over Denali..and the glacier landing spectacular!  Even our pilot said it was amazing for him too.  We flew around and through the peaks for two hours.  The time flew by.  If you can do this tour you will not be disappointed!  the company is great too...helpful, explained what to expect and the glacier boots really helped on the icy snow.

It was the highlight of our Alaska adventure!  Our pics and videos will never show what we’ve seen but the 4 of us will never forget!  Glacier landing was so cool as well. We threw snowballs and made a snowman and took too many selfies.

Wow, what a great trip. Tim, our pilot was fantastic!  Landing a plane on a glacier is hard to imagine until you’ve experienced it.  Make sure to do this trip if you have the opportunity, it’s worth every penny.

What an amazing day touring Denali and landing on the glacier!  Truly amazing and beautiful and expertly experienced with our pilot LeAnn. This is an absolute must to really feel the majesticness of this range which also includes Foraier and Hunter Peaks.

I booked the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna.

Unfortunately the weather was not perfect, the tour was cancelled, but another tour was offered - Southside Explorer. We took it. It was excellent. We saw a lot of glacier. I can only imagine that Grand could offer a lot more...

I agree that it is better safe than sorry but I feel I still need to delete one star from that.  If they offer me a FREE hat, that would be a different story.

The office staffs and pilots are all very professional. A plus.

When scheduling air tours in Alaska, you really have to give yourself some slack. You cannot control the ever changing weather. But that only works in theory. Summer season is so busy in Alaska. Tours are all booked up in advance. Your next opening is probably next year 8-(

The weather is always a risk on these type of tours but ours turned out to be great for seeing Denali.  I appreciated how the staff kept my family informed of weather concerns.  We were not able to do the summit tour and the difference was refunded to my credit card before the flight returned.  The pilot did an excellent job of describing what we were seeing.  The glacier landing was amazing and well worth the cost.  This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Alaska and we would do this tour again if we ever get back there.

Everything was so organized - we arrived, checked in, and were ready for the flight 10min after arriving. The pilot was VERY experienced and did an amazing job of showing all the best of Denali - allowing both sides of the plane lots of opportunities for pictures. We were extremely lucky to have perfect weather...I'll give Talkeetna Air Taxi credit for that since every part of the adventure was absolutely perfect! I've flown in a helicopter around the Matterhorn so I feel qualified to say this - seeing Denali close-up in a plane is the most amazing mountain travel adventure you can ever have. If you're visiting Alaska, it's a must do, and Talkeetna Air Taxi is the only company I'd trust to take me up!
Excellent trip!  You will have a great time!  An exhilarating experience with great pilots.  The glacier landing is well worth it.

My husband and I booked the grand Denali tour. We were lucky, the weather was good. And we got very good views, total ride time was 2 hrs. And we were on the glacier for about 20 minutes. I would say it’s worth the amount, it’s a good memory for us.

review_title: Awesome!!! Highlight of my trip! Must do! Chance of a lifetime.
review_text: Karo the office ticket lady was so nice and helpful. Then our  shuttle driver over to our plane there was the nicest young man telling us about our flight. To our pilot Tim who was super nice and a great pilot. Everyone was so nice and that made the experience so pleasant. As for the sights and the flight. It was AWESOME! Highlight of my trip by far. Breathtaking views of the mountains and glaciers. I can’t express how great of a company and flight this was. I highly highly recommended this to everyone. Spend the money!!! It’s a chance if a lifetime and worth every penny.

Assuming the cost is not an issue this is very well worth it.  Extremely smooth flight and landings.  Landing on the Glacier standing look around at the mountains towering above is incredible.  Sitting at a restaurant an hour later it all seemed just a dream. 
Great pilot.
Spectacular, breathtaking, once in a lifetime experience. (Unless you decide to do it again cause it’s so good). Pilot was amazing and made the whole experience very comfortable.
Our pilot and flight were flawless.  The scenery was of course, spectacular!  The service was worth our money and time.  The glacier landing was smooth and an adventure we won't soon forget.

Absolutely incredible. We had a clear day and I couldn't have been more impressed with the pilot, the flight, and how everything was handled. This is a MUST DO excursion as it'll blow your mind at every turn.

review_title: A unique experience not to be missed.
review_text:
The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi did a great job!  In addition to being a great pilot, she also was an excellent 'tour guide' and really taught us a lot about what we were flying around.

The folks on the ground took great care of us and had everything extremely organized.  It was quite interesting watching them flex their plans throughout the day as weather conditions in Denali changed.

Getting to land on & walk around the glacier was quite an experience - got some of our best pictures the entire trip from there!

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience that far exceeded expectations.
review_text: Went on the Grand Denali Tour yesterday. Beautiful day to fly and it was FANTASTIC!  Our pilot Chris was great. Skilled, personable, informative, and generally a really friendly guide. I cannot stress enough how much you need to go on this trip. And Talkeetna Air Travel was professional from beginning to end. Would give 100 stars if it was an option.

review_title: Grand Denali and Ruth Glacier landing
review_text: I can't say enough about this experience. We took the Grand Denali tour AND landed on Ruth glacier on June 15th with (I think Chris). The day was sunny and gorgeous. The tour was informative and exciting...I'd call it the experience of a lifetime, and I've had a few. Highly recommend TAT.

A must do activity for any visitor or local! Our pilot is such an inspiration for my daughters and was exceptional in her leadership for our group for the entire trip. We highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi!

Imagine our surprise when we checked in to find out we were going to be landing at Denali Base Camp! WOW.  What a special Glacier Landing we had at Kahiltna.  Then, we did a second glacier landing at Pica to perform an expedition pickup.  Our pilot Andy was fabulous, providing a detail explanation of the different peaks and glaciers.  A must for visitors to Alaska.  Our family and friends who visited had the experience of a lifetime.

Imagine our surprise when we checked in to find out we were going to be landing at Denali Base Camp! WOW.  What a special Glacier Landing we had at Kahiltna.  Then, we did a second glacier landing at Pica to perform an expedition pickup.  Our pilot Andy was fabulous, providing a detail explanation of the different peaks and glaciers.  A must for visitors to Alaska.  Our family and friends who visited had the experience of a lifetime.

Words can't describe it and pictures don't do it justice. Exploring Denali is not a casual undertaking and unless you do a flight seeing tour, you won't really be able to see the mountain close up (and you do want to see it up close)! I was initially turned off by the price but it was absolutely worth every penny! Talkeetna Air does a fantastic job and their refund policy related to weather gave me peace of mind that the experience would be nothing but spectacular.

Awe inspiring non-stop views! Alex provided a thorough, low-key narrative of the sights seen from each side of the plane, with both sides getting ample time to see them. A skilled pilot, our glacier landing was soft and beautiful . Definitely the highlight of our Alaska trip.

review_title: Life changing. That’s it... just life changing.
review_text: Life changing expedience with Talkeetna air taxi! The very coolest thing I’ve ever done! My husband and I were a little wary about paying this much for one experience, but we were more than impressed, and couldn’t even fathom what we saw. It was a little like being in National Geographic movies, and we definitely don’t regret spending the money! Shanny and Amanda took care of us when we were booking, and were so easy to work with when we needed to reschedule! Such a fantastic company!! Clay was our pilot, and did a wonderful job. He was informative, and fun to listen to!

This activity was the highlight of our Alaskan trip! Our original date was pushed back due to weather so they worked with us to choose a different day. The day we actually went up couldn’t have been more perfect. The glacier landing is a must!!! It’s breathtaking up there and when else in your life can you say you stood on a glacier?? Highly recommend this but be sure you have some flexibility in your schedule in case the weather isn’t isn’t cooperating.

Don’t fret about cost, weather or being scared of flying, heights or 1000’ deep crevasses. Do this flight tour. You will be talking about it for the rest of your life. The team at TAT is friendly, informative and great. The planes are super cool, safe and easy to fly in. The sights are once in a lifetime for most folks. How many people do you know have flown down glacier valleys, through granite canyons with sheer rock faces as deep as the Grand Canyon, flew up close in personal with one of the biggest mountains on the planet and landed in a glacial valley surrounded by 14,000 foot plus peaks!? Seriously, just book the tour and do it. Thanks me later.

review_title: Grand Denali Glacier Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text: The tour was fantastic. LeAnn was our pilot and she was amazing.  The highlight of our trip. Will definitely book another flight on our next trip.
Our pilot Will was very knowledgeable as well as being a great helicopter pilot and good company. It was amazing. Highlight of our visit to Alaska!

Flying close to the mountain peaks and glaciers was incredible. The experience exceeded expectations and has been the highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska. Andy, our pilot was super safe, skilled and knowledgeable. The plane was a classic 1957 DeHaviland Otter in excellent condition. Glacier landing was a bonus. Would recommend to anyone considering an experience that is both thrilling and humbling, A must for amateur geologist types, nature lovers, thrill seekers, and those seeking to better understand, appreciate, and connect with our planet, We were impressed with their efficiency and professionalism- evident from booking and preflight instructions, in flight communication. safety and attention to detail. Nice job guys, reallly nice job. We’ll be back!

Had a great flight over Denali “The great one!”  Four seater plane, was a little nervous at first, but no worries, pilot was amazing! He brought us over the peak and in between the many other peaks! Amazing flight!  Recommend this awesome experience!

The plane was comfortable and the views and the photography opportunities were amazing.
Booked a glacier landing. They cancelled it for reasons we don't understand. Very disappointing

review_title: Worth every penny! This was an extraordinary experience!
review_text: We flew up to Denali, and landed on a glacier. Luckily, we had a beautiful sunny day, and Denali was out of her clouds to see. The only real way to see Alaska is to fly over her. I now know why people pull up stakes at home, and head to Alaska to live. It just feels like freedom. Every safety precaution was taken to make this a safe flight, and we checked with locals to see which service to use. Everyone told us that Talkeetna Air was the best.

What an AMAZING, once in a lifetime experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating — we came on a whim and were up in the air in 30 minutes (they took an early excursion for us).

I was a bit terrified, but the ride was smooth and perfect.

Paul was a fantastic pilot, incredibly knowledgable of flying, mountaineering, the route, Alaska and much more. He gave great insights into the spots and answered every question (I asked a lot).

5 star experience, wholeheartedly recommend.

Took this tour in 2016 and had a great time.  Decided to go again in 2019 without the glacier landing, but got upgraded to fit into flight plans.

In 2016, it was absolutely clear throughout the flight.  In 2019, there were numerous clouds, but they were broken enough so that we could spiral down to the glacier landing. 

The two flights were quite different and, each in its own way, quite wonderful.

I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Après 3 jours d'attente (à cause du mauvais temps) , on a finalement pu partir pour le Grand Tour, malheureusement sans atterrir car il n'y a pas assez de neige pour l'instant. 
Des vues absolument à couper le souffle!! Un MUST si on est dans le coin!!!

Professional, organized and very communicative. This tour operator is #1 is customer service. We were fortunate to land on the glacier due to weather improving over the last few weeks. Our pilot was top notch and in tune with us the entire trip. Highly recommend this group and experience.

I've flown numerous airplanes (and jumped most of them as well) and have to say, that flying with Paul was a great and pleasant experience. These guys know the business and they are doing amazing job showing us beauties of Denali including the base camp landing on a glacier. Thumbs up!

review_title: Grand Denali flightseeing tour - absolutely Grand!
review_text: Fabulous excursion. Michael our pilot was excellent , the flight was seamless. If you don’t do anything else while visiting in Alaska, take this air tour of Denali!  One of the top 10 things I’ve done in my whole life while on vacation.

My first time to Alaska and I wanted to see Denali. Heard from other family this was the place to go and see Denali. Even though there was smoke from the fire. Our pilot Alex did a fabulous job flying us around Denali. Glad our family chose this, we wanted to land on the Glacier, but the company was safe due to no new snow, so conditions were not good to land. The view was amazing. I highly recommend and would go again in a heartbeat.👍

review_title: Fantastic Views - Denali up close and perssonal
review_text:
We took the Grand Denali tour with a Glacier Landing.    The plane held 9 passengers.   8 passengers each had a window seat, and the 9th passenger sat in the copilot seat.   Our pilot, LeAnn, did a fantastic job.   She would make turns to make sure each side of the plane got the great views and pictures.  Because of the size of the mountains, it looked like the plane was way to close to them, but LeAnn assured us that she was always at least a mile from them.   She pointed out places and told us what was going on (like before we turned).   She was in constant communication with the pilots on other tours checking in with the weather conditions,

The views were awe experiencing.  Make sure you bring a memory card with space for a lot of pictures!  The Glacier Landing was impressive.  We landed at Base Camp, which is the first camp that mountaineers use to climb Denali.   It is in the middle of the 3 highest mountains.   

We were lucky that the weather was great to allow us to fly around Denali and do the Glacier Landing (they provide pull over boots and sunglasses for the Glacier).   Be aware, that like most things with flying, mother nature controls where the plan can go.  Realize that the flight you reserved may be changed.  FOr example, you may not be able to fly all around Denali or do the Glacier Landing (they stopped doing Glacier Landings after ours).  If your trip is changed, the office will alter your charges, appropriately.  

One thing to note, if you are in an Otter with 9 passengers, I recommend that you do not jump for the copilot seat.   Unless you are really tall, the Otter flies in a nose up configuration, so it is actually harder to see things.   

It was a great trip.  I would highly recommend it.

Flying around the tallest mountain in North America was an awesome experience. Flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi made it that much better. We met Michael at the airplane and he introduced us to our plane for the day. Flying with Michael was a peaceful a serene experience. From the moment we took off he was casually sharing history of the Talkeetna area and various details of the rivers and valley as we approached the mountain range. Once we got to Denali Michael's knowledge really came to light. It was almost as if he met every climber thorough the climbing history of Denali. Landing on the mountain was one of the top experiences of my life.

review_title: A Trip for All Bucket Lists
review_text:
To fly through the Alaska Range at Denali is a lifetime experience. It left us and all 9 of our fellow passengers in awe, then breathless over our flawless glacier landing, half hour stopover and take off. Our pilot Alex was superb in taking us though mountain passes carved thousands of years ago by glaciers that continue to amaze, and he narrated the trip thoroughly and continuously with historical and geographic facts. 

It is a trip you will never forget and a photographer’s dream come true. The lighting on the 6 PM grand Denali flight was awesome.

Susan & Charlie Murray

We were in Alaska for 12 days and our flightseeing trip was definitely one of the best things we did. It was on recommendation from alaska.org that I did the trip from Talkeetna instead of Denali, and I would recommend this trip to anyone as you get to see so much of the Alaskan Range. We were fortunate enough to land on the glacier at the base camp for climbing Denali. The pilot and all of the staff were great.

We had an awesome flight with Leanne - such a smooth flight and take off and landing and our trip around Denali was simply breathtaking! No bad seats on Leanne’s plane as she ensured everyone had a good view from all seats. So glad we did this and Mother Nature gave us an awe inspiring and simply amazing display! I booked this trip thinking it wouldn’t be much but how wrong I was!! Thank you Leanne, your flying and narration were fantastic! Mum and I had the best time!!!

Stunning views of all the geography in and around Denali, with great commentary by our pilot, Clay! Highly recommend the glacier landing if it's in your budget! A definite highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska, and the only way to guarantee a sighting of the mountain!

Not cheap, but if you can afford it do it. And opt for the glacier landing. It really is a once in a lifetime sort of experience, and the views from that small plane are unmatched. The opportunity to literally stand on a glacier in the shadow of Denali is something that few people get. It is difficult to adequately describe what you can see but the title really says it all - just awe inspiring. And don't be too concerned if the weather in Talkeetna is less than ideal. We had rain and thunder but after it blew through a bit we were able to launch and the flight was spectacular.

Die Organisation rund um den Flug sowie die Sicherheit jedes Einzelnen war hervorragend. 
Der Pilot war super nett und verlieh dem Ganzen seinen Charme. 
Aufgrund der Witterung wurde die Gletscher Landung spontan gecancelt - das Geld wurde am nächsten Tag schon zurück gebucht. 

Immer wieder gerne und einmalige Eindrücke über Alaska. Das gehört auf jeden Fall dazu, wenn man den 49ten US-Bundesstaat besucht 🙃.

review_title: Excellent Trip with Superb Pilot / Guide
review_text: We had a great flight and saw glaciers and Denali. It was cloudy, so the pilot (whose name escapes me) talked with other pilots to find the best viewing angles; thanks to his flying all over, we were able to see Denali out of the clouds from both sides. The pilot doubled as a tour guide, giving us all sorts of interesting information as we flew. The glacier landing was fantastic; it was the high point of our two week visit to Alaska! Highly recommended

Based on reviews, we booked the Grand Denali with Glacier landing! OMG, everything about the experience was AMAZING!  We boarded an Otter plane on a crystal clear day, glacier boots on, with  a delightful group of additional passengers.  The views from the first airborne minute to the final landing were incredible....felt completely Safe ON BOARD IN THE HANDS OF OUR AWESOME PILOT!  Thanks TAT for an experience of a life time!

review_title: Amazing!!!!  One of the best things ever!!!
