review_text: What an experience.  Flying around the tallest peak in North America and then landing on a glacier beside it? Does life get any better? Mike our pilot was smooth and a great educator on al of the sight as well.  He was also very patient with our questions and friendly!

I’ve been on my fair share of flightseeing tours, but wow this was just breathtaking and the two hours went by so fast! The glacier landing alone was worth it and we’ll remember it forever, but the flight scenery was just stunning too. And Paul was so great to fly with - super knowledgeable, easy going and friendly. 

I actually would just say don’t look at pictures so you don’t spoil it and just book any of the glacier landing flights - you will be so happy you did!!

review_title:
The epitome of service! Couldn’t be any better!  ONLY BOOK WITH THEM!!!

KELLI M.  (Butler, PA)
review_text:
Amanda was 20 steps above and beyond on service!! Pilot (nick?) was 20 stars if i  could rate him above 10!

 I would NEVER BOOK WITH ANYONE BUT THEM !

 I had the opportunity to watch how they handled many customers, both difficult and easy....they were not only professional but also patient and understanding and empathetic with each individuals situation and schedule.  There are not many top-notch places left in this day and age...this is one!  And what a rare find!!! 

THANK YOU AMANDA!!!!!

This was hands down the highlight of our trip and a must do for anyone visiting Denali. This is the best way to see the national park and easily one of the most exciting experiences I’ve ever been on. The glacier landing is a must!

review_title: Totally Amazing and worth every cent!
review_text: This was a spur of the moment side trip and was worth every cent. Mt Denali was view able but due to the wildfires, very hazy. We stopped in their office--no high pressure sales. The customer service rep explained the options. The views from the plane are indescribable,Nick our pilot was amazing! Smooth flight and landing, gets you up close with mountains,he was very knowledgeable about the scenes below. You have not seen Denali at all unless you see it from the air--words can not describe!

This was our 3rd visit to Alaska, but it was unlike any other. It is hard to describe the amazing views from above Denali...I would highly recommend this flight!!  Views that you won't get from the Park floor!!

We did the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a couple of weeks ago. The staff here are very professional and attentive. Our pilot was Michael and we had a fabulous trip and were lucky to have had beautiful weather for a smooth and memorable glacier landing. This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. Not to be missed!
Absolutely stunning, we were lucky to have a relatively clear sunny day and the scenery was breathtaking.

Leann gave us a memorable trip around Denali complete with a glacier landing in Don Sheldon Amphitheater.  Sunny, warm, awe inspiring trip!  Tasted some glacier ice.

The entire staff was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and helpful!  It is  a great team.  The entire experience was top notch!
Thank you for a memorable morning at the foot of Denali

review_title: Absolute MUST on your visit to Alaska list!!
review_text:
Alex piloted the plane and did a fantastic job pointing out and naming all the places we could see below. (we all had headphones and could hear the commentary very well)  We saw tents set up at base camp and those snow-capped peaks were amazing.The flight was smooth, including take-off and landing, and the view was amazing no matter where you sat. Best part was the actual landing on the glacier and having a chance to get out and play in all the snow and breathe that fresh, fresh air! Thanks Alex!
The road to Talkeetna is really well paved the whole way - I rode my motorcycle from Anchorage with no difficulty at all. Totally worth taking time to do this flightseeing "trip of a lifetime!"

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with glacier landning
review_text:
Booked using Northern Lights Discount coupon for family of 4 (25% off). Worth every penny. Office staff very helpful. Flew on 10 Sept 2018, first deprture 8:30am. Pilot: Michael from California. Superbly skilled and professional pilot, sunny and clear weather, pitch perfect take offs and landings. Michael provided much commentary of history, geography and geology throughout. this was definitely the Highlight of our Alaska trip! Doesn't matter where you sit on the plane, you'll get equally good views of Mt Denali if the weather is good.
Remember to collect your 7 day National Park Access Pass which you can use in Denali National Park.
Don't forget to tip the pilot :)

Wow, what a great flight. We did the 2 hr round the mountain and land on the glacier trip, and as soon as you get into those snow capped mountains, it’s magical. This was a friendly, knowledgeable and reassuring group of people, so just DO IT. If you are obsessed with Denali, sit on the right side, but I was on the left and was happy to be awed by all of the other mountains around. And we did a 360 anyway so I did get a good view. Be good and give your pilot a tip at the end—it’s worth it.

review_title: It adds Exponentially to your Alaska Visit
review_text: I did the same flight 11 years ago with the Dehaviland Beaver but on this trip my wife was with me along with 6 other passengers.  Our pilot was good and filled us in with a lot of what we were seeing and some of the geography as well.  Our plane was the larger Dehaviland Otter which handled well under his hand.  It was a clear day and we did circle Mt. Denali and land on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot pointed our Don Sheldon's "Chalet" and pointed out that for a fee we could spend the weekend there (I don't know if this was said in jest or not).  This was experience that most people don't get to enjoy but maybe several times in their life. We saw glacier crevasses, stress bends, and the gentle turns that glaciers make as they meander to lower altitudes.  Before we took off from Ruth Glacier 5 other tour planes joined us on Ruth Glacier so it was a great day for flying.  Taking off on the downward glacier slope is always an experience.

Our pilot Kris made us comfortable in the DHC-3 for an amazing flight that ultimately climbed to 20,000 feet.  We flew close to the buttresses of Denali, Wickersham Wall and through Denali Pass.  The view was incredible.  Without doubt the experience was the highlight of our Alaska trip.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and returned to Talkeetna after seeing so many peaks and glacier features that we will remain amazed for a long time!

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip - No Words for This Experience.
review_text: This experience was the highlight of our trip.  The views are so breathtaking that you feel that you're flying through a movie scene.  The glacier landing is something not to be missed.  Our pilot, Danielle, gave fantastic narrative throughout the flight, and when our group expressed interest in the controls she took the time after the flight to explain how the controls worked and talk more about flying.  It is clearly something she is passionate about and it shows in her work.  The entire staff was absolutely amazing!!!  Do not miss this experience when visiting Denali.

review_title: Spectacular Views of Denali Range with Glacier Landing
review_text: Our pilot had 15 years of experience flying here and inspired confidence.  She had climbed Denali and summited 15 times!  Her narration was interesting.  Our flight was smooth and comfortable.  We had a bright, warm, sunny, clear day.  Landing on a glacier and tromping around in the snow beneath the Denali range was a thrill.  All 6 of us were so grateful to have experienced this flightseeing.  It was awesome and memorable!

review_title: Flight around Denali with glacier landing kids ages 4-16
review_text: It was beautiful.  The kids really enjoyed themselves.  Little ones were entertained for the 2 hours and enjoyed playing in the snow on the glacier.

If you go to Denali, this is one of those things you have to do.  Hiking is not so much of a big deal at this park compared to other parks.  I believe Flightseeing and the bus ride offered by NPS are the two must things to do at Denali.

review_title: Crystal clear flight around Mt Denali
review_text: We took the flight around Mt Denali and landed on the glacier.  We have a crystal-clear day which was beyond description for the beauty.  Our pilot was Alex and he was great.  Wonderful experience.

We were in Alaska for two weeks and I think this was my favorite. The weather that day was fabulous so that really helped. Definitely worth the cost and the glacier landing was very cool. Once in a lifetime do not miss.

This was truly the flight of a lifetime. The staff was friendly & helpful. Andy was our pilot and he gave us the Grand Tour. We felt safe, he gave warning if there were going to be "bumps", changed course a bit if needed for a smooth ride with the best views. This was a glacier landing flight & so glad we did...amazing! Andy was knowledgeable and encouraged questions about area history, mountains, climbers, etc. You will not be disappointed!

We loved our flight seeing trip! The flight over and around Denali was breath taking. We were lucky as the weather was perfect with excellent visibility.  The landing on the glacier was a very special experience we will remember for ever.

My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was awesome! I booked short notice for the 4th of July holiday and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Big kudos to Heidi for being so helpful and friendly during the check-in process. She made it a breeze and did so with a smile! The predeparture preparation was straightforward and efficient and the folks on the ground were awesome. Leighan was our pilot. She was knowledgeable, courteous, and friendly and her comments during the flight made it easy to track our location. Plus, her piloting skills were top notch both on and off the ice! 

This experience was nothing short of amazing. Landing on Ruth Glacier and seeing Denali in all her glory is indescribable. Our group was lucky enough to see the summit, which I hear is not always the norm. It was such a lovely day that many folks were wearing t-shirts on the glacier! 

If you do one thing while in Talkeetna, it should be seeing Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was one of the best travel experiences I’ve ever had.

My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was awesome! I booked short notice for the 4th of July holiday and the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Big kudos to Heidi for being so helpful and friendly during the check-in process. She made it a breeze and did so with a smile! The predeparture preparation was straightforward and efficient and the folks on the ground were awesome. Leighan was our pilot. She was knowledgeable, courteous, and friendly and her comments during the flight made it easy to track our location. Plus, her piloting skills were top notch both on and off the ice! 

This experience was nothing short of amazing. Landing on Ruth Glacier and seeing Denali in all her glory is indescribable. Our group was lucky enough to see the summit, which I hear is not always the norm. It was such a lovely day that many folks were wearing t-shirts on the glacier! 

If you do one thing while in Talkeetna, it should be seeing Denali with Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was one of the best travel experiences I’ve ever had.

We had no intention of going flightseeing while in Talkeetna, as we already had a glacier landing scheduled elsewhere for another day. However, the skies were crystal clear & the perfect view of Denali had us scrambling for a flight. Luckily, we were able to get a flight within 2 hours with Talkeetna Air Taxi & even received 10% off for a family booking & another 30% off for kids under age 11. Our pilot, Matt, took our family up in a '61 DeHavilland Beaver. The scenery was spectacular - glaciers, rugged mountain peaks, massive granite walls, Denali...and the flight was expertly narrated by our pilot. Our headsets & mouthpieces allowed us to ask questions & converse during the flight as well. This was quite expensive for the whole family to do, but soaring amongst the jagged, snowy, granite peaks was an amazing experience.

Nach langer Wartezeit ergab sich ein günstiges Wetterfenster für eine Tour zum Denali - es sollte eines der atemberaubendsten Naturerlebnisse in Alaska werden! Das Flugzeug war erstaunlich groß, der Pilot sehr erfahren und freundlich, außerdem spielte das Wetter mit, so dass es am Ende eine phantastische Tour war. Klare Empfehlung!

review_title: A must do when in Talkeetna
review_text: This flight was one of the most amazing experiences in my life.  Dave, our pilot, was very informative, friendly and did an excellent job.  The glacier landing was great and seeing Denali from 21000 feet is something I will never forget.

I cannot say enough how this is one thing a person should put on their bucket list! Amy in the office was so nice and knowledgeable, she truly enjoys her job. They provided us with boot covers and off we went, Mike the pilot was amazing. He answered questions when we landed and narrated through the entire flight. This company can give you a truly memorable experience!

review_title: WOOHOO!  Get to Alaska anyway possible for this trip!
review_text: I tend to only review wonderful experiences, my apology.  But this was one of those "once-in-a-lifetime" experiences that exceeds description.  And Talkeetna Air Taxi exceeded all expectations.  Clean airplanes and facility, helpful and pleasant staff, and excellent pilot.  I just wish I could do this again tomorrow.  It would be with these same folks.

review_title: The best thing I have done in Alaska
review_text:
The family and I took the Denali flight which landed on the glacier near the pilots house on the mountain. Stunning views of course and we got lucky with a beautiful sunny day. 

The rule of thumb is 1/3 get to see the mountain so try to schedule around the weather. The mountain is roughly 20,000ft above the town of Talkeetna, AK. 

Definately do the landing it is worth the extra charge. My 70 year old mother with limited mobility was able to get out and walk about a little too.

Matt U was the most accommodating person as we prepped for our trip into Denali. We stayed three nights at kantishna roadhouse (which was lovely) but we might just stay at the KAT lodge next time given the friendliness of everyone there. Sean was our Pilot and made us comfortable right away. His knowledge of the mountain was incredible. We had to fly out early so we hung out with Matt U in the lodge as well as the owner’s dog named lucky. We were the lucky ones. There’s also a guy who looks like Jon Snow at TAT so you might as well go just for that reason. Lastly, if flying from talkeetna, bring them a few slabs of spinach bread as a treat—-they will be thrilled. Oh—and check out Matt U’s  art studio while you are there; amazing one of a kind pieces.

We did the Grand Denali tour with a glacier landing on a cold, rainy Sunday morning. Getting to the airport is easy, checking in was quick, and the prep fort he trip was simple. I believe Andy was our pilot. He was calm, clear, and made sure everyone in my party was comfortable (including my 30 year old sister and was white as a ghost because she doesn't like flying). The plane felt safe, and the actual flying part was smooth and relaxing. After the first 10 mins over the flat lands before the park, we went into a cloudy mountain range. But, the second we got past the first row of mountain, it was breathtaking. He may not want me saying this, but my father actually cried during the flight because of the beauty. Words cannot do this justice. After flying around the range, we landed on a glacier (very smooth and easy landing and take-off). That experience of being on, taking a bathroom break on, and eating of the glacier was surreal. I would say it is a must if you're doing this tour. We then took off and flew back to Talkeetna with no issues at all.

This was out first day in Alaska out of 14 total days. And while everything in Alaska was amazing, nothing beat this (and that sentiment includes my sister who is fearful of flying). There is no way I would send someone to Alaska without forcing them to do this tour. If you do not do this, you are missing out on a truly once of a lifetime experience (unless you are one of the pilots, who get to do this amazing thing every single day).

We chose this company to do a flightseeing tour of Denali with glacier 
landing. They were very professsional, prompt in their responses when arranging the tour. I had no doubts as to the competence of our pilot. Plane was small and views were wonderful. I was disappointed at the overall blasé attitude of the pilot. I realize that these pilots probably do this four times a day and I am grateful for the technical expertise, but for us it was a “once in a lifetime trip” . It would have been awesome to have a briefing of what we were going to see in and in what order right before we took off. Since this experience was very foreign to us, a 3D ground model so we could orient and have perspective would have been perfect. Also, a  more animated clear narration while in the air would also have been good.  At the end of it all I was left with the impression that this company knows their stuff and is technically very good, but they did not show any level of enthusiasm for what they do. I would not use them again if another reliable option is available
The flight had beautiful views of the Alaskan mountains including Denali.  It really helped us to understand how massive the area is and how small we are in the grand skeem of things.

Abbiamo riservato il tour grand Denali il giorno precedente. Quando ci siamo recati al check in ci hanno comunicato che avremmo fatto il giro leggermente più corto in quanto per ragioni di sicurezza e visibilità non valeva la pena vedere il lato nord. Abbiamo apprezzato molto L’onestà! Il nostro pilota Mike è stato bravissimo, abbiamo avuto L fortuna di vedere la vetta del monte Denali e di atterrare sul ghiacciaio! Sicuramente é un’esperienza da vivere se si passa da talkeetna!

review_title: Bet Way to See Denali and a Glacier
review_text:
We took the 11am flight around Denali and land on a glacier. I can’t imagine a better way to see the mountain and get a sense for how big it is!  

We had 5 total in our plane (including the pilot). The pilot did an excellent job describing the landscape and giving us a sense for the vast expanse we were flying over. 

We rose to about 12,000 feet on a party cloudy day. We saw incredible views the entire way, including the peak of Denali. We were also able to see one of the base camps of the mountain climbers who were about halfway to the top. 

As amazing as seeing Denali up close, landing on the glacier made the trip for us. After a smooth landing, we walked on untouched snow which sat on top of about 2,000 feet of ice. Because of how high the mountains are (granite walls rising 5,000 feet) I found it almost impossible to put anything into perspectives that my mind can comprehend. When we listened quietly, we could hear small landslides occurring on the granite shelves. 

We had some issues with our schedule and the folks at Talkeetna were extremely accommodating. Overall the service and experience were excellent from beginning to end!

Quick tips: we went on a warm day (70 degrees Fahrenheit) and were glad to have a decent jacket in the plane and on the glacier. Also we wore hiking boots and didn’t need to borrow the shoe covers. Sitting up front in the plane is terrific, but the curvature of the plane glass will limit some of the photo opportunities (at least straight on). You can still take photos through the side windows while sitting up front.

review_title: The only way to truly experience Denali!
review_text: Alex was a great pilot/guide!  We did the tour with a glacier landing.  You don't want to miss landing on the glacier.  This company offered more bang for the buck and it did not disappoint.  We weren't sure we were going to be able to do this tour so we ended up having to schedule at the last minute and they were able to accommodate us.  The ladies in the office informed us due to the weather we may not be able to see all the sides of Denali and told us if we weren't able to they would refund that part of the trip.  Fortunately, the weather worked with us rather than against us and we got to do the whole tour. As a pilot, I can tell you the aircraft was well maintained and Alex was professional and proficient.

review_title: Our Most Enjoyable Activity in Alaska
review_text: We had a beautiful sunny day to see Denali. The sky was clear and the flight was amazing. You could almost touch the mountains. They flew up 60 climbers that day and over 100 climbers were up there to climb Denali. The pics we made were great. We landed on the Glacier and it had over 80 ft of snow there. This Mississippi girl acted like a kid and loved every minute of this adventure. I would highly recommend this excursion. Tip - If you are riding bus to Mt McKinley Lodge, get off at Talkeetna to save time. We called on the road, booked the flight and got off. There are other buses that go back to the lodge every 30 minutes.

There really ought to be a six-star rating for some experiences and this was one of them. TAT was so accommodating you'd think we were old friends. Do they act this way with everyone? I'll bet they do. Vikki and Amanda in the office and pilot Dave were all amazing. We were so disappointed in not getting to see the Great One the first day we drove to Talkeetna. Vikki explained to us just how much we would be able to see and offered to re-schedule us the next day if we wanted to make the effort and return. We did and she did. It was a beautiful day and turned out to be a staggeringly memorable one, enhanced by TAT's professionalism. If a 20,320-foot mountain can be framed in a proper perspective, Dave did it with his narration and flight skill. Bottom line--this isn't cheap but you've got to do it. Yes, really. Pawn your least favorite kid, if you have to but DO IT and do it with TAT.

review_title: Good time on land and in the air
review_text: The plane ride was beautiful and the staff was so kind and welcoming. I specifically want to shout out Gavin who was very accommodating towards my family and went above and beyond to make sure they had a great experience. Thanks Gavin!

Lucky for me, the day was absolutely gorgeous.
It is so cool to see all these lakes from above. You wouldn't even know they were there from below. Totally enjoyed this excursion! The pilot was very nice, took us over some of her favorite places and told a bit about the different sites. 
The crew were really helpful too. My cruise ship was anchored far away from town and I would have no way to get a shuttle after our return. They had a driver take me to our cruise ship tender location, rather than back to town. That's great service.
Booked through Alaska Shore Tours - great experience

We took the "MistyFjords Flightseeing"on July 12,2024.  Thought it has been a while, we are still upset of the way we were taken care of for this tour.  Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word before the plane took off and either a thank you for us when we left.  He only had a few words during the flight and did not try to  make it a fun experience for us by letting us know of the areas we were flying over.  This  poor personality pilot should not be in that type of work to  deal with people on vacation.

review_title: Do not trust these people!!! What a disappointment!!
review_text: During my trip to Alaska, the most important thing to me was to take a tour on a float plane. I booked this the last day of our cruise, which was in Ketchikan Alaska. On our way into the port, I watched excitedly as one float plane after another left and flew in front of our balcony. I couldn't wait and told several friends and family members how excited I was to take this flight  that was scheduled for 4 PM. I got to the meeting place 15 minutes early when I received a phone call that the flight was canceled. When I inquired why it was canceled there was a pause and then the woman on the other end of the line told me there was a mechanical issue that they thought would be fixed in time for the flight, but they couldn't fix it. I found out shortly after from a person in the business that they called to try and help fill the plane that a mechanical wasn't the case at all. The plane wasn't full so they canceled it. On top of a HUGE disappointment. I was even more disappointed that they flat out lied to me. Had they been honest I might have even paid for the empty seats for this experience, but they never even gave me the chance. I called their number back and it went right to voicemail. I left 2 messages asking if perhaps they knew another pilot that could take me on a flight  but of course never heard back from them.  It's obvious  they care much more about how much money is in their pocket than they do about customer service or even honesty. I would never trust these people. They lost a lot more money by not even offering to let me pay for the empty seats and more importantly, lost respect, which is the one and only thing people in business have. What a total disappointment.

This tour was so unique. We went with pilot Max, who was a great pilot. The staff took precautions in getting us up in the air. There was quite a bit of wind at our originally scheduled time, so they called to ask if we could reschedule to later in the day when the wind has died down, which we could. The views were breathtaking from the air. This was a unique experience & I'm so glad we did it! I would recommend it to a friend.
Thank you!

myself and 3 friends boarded the plane, strapped in and got the safety instructions. when the pilot went to start the plane there was mechanical failure. we were told 15-30 minutes and they could take us up. 45 minutes later the pilot said almost done, staff inside were letting us know we could go up in a few. a group of 6 people then walked in and the staff said we can no longer take you. the whole plane, other than the 4 of us were willing to go up for 1/2 the time with no refund of dollar adjustment wanted. the staff refused to let us go when 5 minutes earlier they were willing to send us up for the whole hour. they refunded our money and sent us on our way, ruining a whole day of excursions for us and the chance to see the Fjords.
I would not recommend this company to anyone.

review_title: 100% effort given by company and they WILL get you to your cruise ship in time 🙂
review_text:
Taquan Air created a highlight of our whole cruise.  My in-laws said "we didn't like it, we LOVED it!"  Booking was simple. Had a few questions so I called and were very helpful and professional.   The pilot was so friendly, talkative, and knowledgeable about the area.  The flight lasted the whole hour advertised and we flew over so much breathtaking scenery - my in-laws favorite was the high up mountain lakes.  The shuttle bus that took us back to our cruise ship was awesome..... our ship was at the end of the line of ships in Port that day and a decent walk from the pickup point but Taquan Air dropped us off right in front of our cruise ship.  We had been a bit stressed about it because we only had about a half hour from the end of the tour time until all aboard for our ship but, all stress was taken away when they said they could drop us right in front of our ship at the end. We were back on the ship well before our deadline time.
Thank you all so much and we will find you for another flight next time we're there!

We booked this tour through Disney Cruise. We were transported from our ship to the sea planes by shuttle, just a short ride. We were loaded in the plane by size for balance. My son was in the co-pilot seat. Can't take very good pictures in this seat, though. The plane is hard to get in for us big people, but we managed. Everyone is friendly and the pilot informative of what we were seeing. We were provided headphones for communication. The flight was fun but a little bumpy. This is a unique experience we will not forget. I would recommend taking a bottle of water with you. The hour long tour was just the right amount of time. The tight quarters makes it hard to see out other windows.

On 7/25/2023 we took the Misty Fjords flight seeing tour.   There were a total of 8 passengers on a well maintained DHC-3.  

The best I can say is that Taquan Air completely mailed it in.  For the price it should have been significantly better.  Buyer beware and spend your valuable money on other activities. 

The total cost for all 8 was close to $3,000 for which we got a seaplane flight that fell well short of how it was hyped by the cruise line or on Taiwan Air’s site.  

We expected that there would be narration by the pilot pointing out landmarks and notable features.  The pilot didn’t utter a single word after boarding.  Instead there was a cheesy pre-recorded narration that was spotty and difficult to understand.  Passengers shouldn’t ask, “ are we at the Misty Fjords”.  

The pilot, although clearly proficient, was going through the motions and was clearly disinterested in anything except for talking to his fellow pilots in the radio. 

This was the only regrettable experience of the 2-week Alaskan experience. Don’t do it!!!

The take off and landing from the water was different and the sites were ok. BUT, no pilot narration… in fact he didn’t speak after takeoff once. There was a bogus recorded voice that intermittently cam I’ve the headphones to point out a couple things about a few areas. TOTAL RIP-OFF.  We should have asked for a refund. There were four of us. 1500+ for a quick hour tour of some ok mountains. Research before paying.

The views were fabulous. The pilot did a great job of personalizing locations with explanations of his own experiences at different spots. He also answered questions clearly and succinctly. Takeoff and landing were each well done.
We had a great trip. The fjords are beautiful! The trip was exactly 60 minutes. The scenery is amazing! Highly recommend Taquan air!

We went in October fully knowing the weather is not great this time of year, we were blessed with sunshine and had an amazing time. Felt safe at all times and the 1 hour flight was very informative. Definitely a must!

review_title: Great Tour, meeting location a trek
review_text: Very professional & accommodating staff. The only down side was the meeting place was downtown & my ship docked at the NCL terminal which was a 20 minute shuttle & 10 minute walk away. They did drop me and a couple others off at the NCL dock after the flight so that was good. Our flight did not land in the middle of it, as some reviewers have noted. The pilot told me this is an extra cost & they try to avoid doing it due to the dangers involved. My pro tip: sit in the co-pilot’s seat, it has the best view.

The views were absolutely gorgeous!  So glad I got to do this.  Only regret is that while we landed on the water, we didn't actually get to step foot on land as the description suggested.  Great otherwise. Thanks

Wow what a ride! Not only do we get to see the beautiful waterfalls and waterfalls and pools of water among the mountains and the snow, we landed on a tiny Little Rock formation where the pilot let us get out and take pictures. The views were amazing and  the tour was so fun! Talk about photo opportunities!

Super fun plane ride today with pilot Chuck. He’s been flying this route for over 25 years. He provided local commentary to enhance the company audio and music. We felt very safe. Wonderful scenery and our touch down in the middle of a fjord lake was just so great. We do recommend.

We had a great trip out on the floatplane. We had to reschedule due to cloudy weather. I appreciate that they really wanted us to be safe and have an enjoyable experience.  Our pilot was great and was able to give us informational commentary on the trip. We flew over amazing landscapes and mountains and landed on the water near Misty Fjord. We were able to get out there and take pictures of the amazing scenery.

So good this tour deserves 10 stars!  This was one of the best tours we have ever done.  We felt safe and secure.  Michelle shared lots of information about the area and history.  This is a must do tour!

I have always wanted to take a float plane and experience a takeoff and landing on the water.  I asked Chuck our pilot where the best seat was and he said beside him, so i got to experience this from the co-pilots seat!  The weather was beautiful and it was truly an experience i will always remember, and that is what vacations are all about.  this is definitely something i would do again!  Thank you Chuck for the wonderful day flying!

We did a 7 day cruise down the coast of Alaska which was breathtaking throughout, but this was one of the highlights.  Cruising over the mountains, you look down at beautiful lakes and fjords, and see glaciers in the distance.  The fact that you take off and land on water in a wonderful old plane just enhances it further.  When the pilot let me sit in the co-pilots seat for the flight back, I was in heaven!

Nice, gentle flight above the misty fjords with lakes and waterfalls and mist making it magical.  Our pilot performed a smooth landing on the fjord and we were able to get out and stand on the pontoons to take pictures.  Lovely day!

We booked this tour through our cruise ship at the last minute and we re all so glad we did.  We were nervous about being on a small plane, but the pilot was reassuring and we did something we will probably never get a chance to do again.  Thrilling!  It was worth the money.

Amazing tour over Misty Fjords. You get a bird’s eye view (literally!) of the fjords. The plane takes you close enough where you can make out some details from ground below. We had a sunny, clear day which helped. Well worth it!

My husband is a pilot and we love flying no matter the type or size of the airplane. This was our first floatplane flight ever and it totally exceeded our expectations. We were with four other passengers and were comfortable and secure. Our pilot was a retired air line pilot so anyone who worries about the experience of the pilot-relax, he had thousands of hours of flight time. We took off and flew right past our cruise ship and then headed for Misty Fjords National Monument. Our pilot had a perfect balance of commentary and quiet, accompanied by a great playlist for our time aloft. The scenery was beautiful-rugged mountains, pristine lakes, lush forests, and waterfalls. We flew past an eagle soaring-amazing! We landed on a lake in the middle of the mountains, stood out on the pontoons for a bit, reboarded and then took-off again. Our flight was about an hour and we would have been happy to stay up longer! We look forward to returning to Ketchikan and doing this again and maybe staying in a cabin for a week or so!! Thank you Taquan Air!

Our family was on the Holland America cruise ship.  We BOOKED For All 6 of us!  Larry was our pilot.  He was awesome! Very knowledgeable and a PRO.  We had a great time and he landed like a PRO.  We would highly recommend this trip and Larry gets 5 Stars!   Thanks for a great float plane experience.  I was nervous at first but felt very comfortable and at ease as we flew around and took lots of pictures.

our flight was canceled due to the weather. We certainly understand the safety concern, the problem was that no one bothered to let us know. We based our whole day on that excursion and would have tried to do something else had we known.

Our pilot, Larry, was great. Of course very skilled, but also personable and knowledgeable. Scenery phenomenal, combined with recorded and live dialogue made flight memorable. Would highly recommend while in Ketchikan.

Perfect for the last stop on our cruise, the floatplane tour of remote Misty Fjords was a highlight for everyone in our family.  We'd been concerned because of recent accidents involving this company and cruise ship passengers, but we found our pilot to be safety conscious and trustworthy.  Views were spectacular and landing on pontoons on a pristine lake will be an unforgettable memory of Alaska.  Of note, we returned about an hour late from this tour because one group was late coming back, so we missed a pre-paid, non-refundable excursion.

We were lucky enough to be included on a scenic tour of the Misty Fjords national park. It was a memorable experience in typical Alaskan weather. Our pilot, Larry, was very informative and skilled. We landed at Punchbowl Lake and had our pictures taken on the float. The scenery was spectacular and overall a memorable experience.

Beautiful scenery.  This is especially nice if you haven’t been on a float plane before.  We fortunately got to get out on the fjord itself on the fjord.  However, had the float dock not been full, we have just landed at another dock, and not had quite the experience we did.

I went on this tour with my dad & we both loved it! Larry was an excellent pilot and really made sure we got the full experience. He told us a lot of cool facts about the Misty Fjords and about Ketchikan in general. The sights in the air were truly breathtaking & being able to dock in the water was amazing! Best tour ever!

I was as facinated by the float plane as the magnificient views in Misty Fjords NM.  Dave was an excellent pilot.  Smooth takeoffs and landings. The weather was clear.  The water in we flew over was glass smooth in places.  The cascades were so beautiful.  I was a facinated by the plane, a six seat Beaver.  The controls were simple.  Dave explained them.  We flew about 80-85 knots.  Dave was often talking with other pilots in the area.  I did not want the flight to end.  I could have flown for hours at the slow pace and beautiful scenery.  This was one of the best flights of my life.

review_title: Gorgeous views and a bear sighting!
review_text: Our family took this excursion during our cruise stop to Ketchikan and on the recommendation of family.  Jim was our pilot, and was friendly with had eight (I believe) years of float plane experience, including prior experience in South Florida. The weather was gorgeous, and Jim took us up with upbeat tunes in our ears!  The scenery was stunning, with beautiful water and mountain views.  We literally flew over the mountain tops into the Misty Fjords National monument where we finally came down for a water landing (our first)... As the plane lowered towards the water, our pilot pointed out a brown bear and her cub at the water's edge, a wonderful thrill to see! Once safely landed, we got to exit the plane onto a dock where we could enjoy the stunning views and clean mountain air all around us.  Then it was back into the plane for further commentary about the various formations and other landmarks below.  This is a lovely trip and the Fjords a lovely sight to see!
Definitely one of the highlights of our honeymoon! Larry was an awesome pilot. Really entertaining, and we felt very safe. The scenery was beyond spectacular.

Went with my family -- travelled with kids ages from 12-23.   Loved the tour.   Our favorite part was when we landed on the water.   We were able to get out of the plane -- standing outside the plane and experiencing the quiet and beauty of nature.   It was fantastic.   This was one of our favorite excursions of our Alaskan cruise.

review_title: What a great way to experience Misty Fjords...
review_text: Adam Weiland was my pilot on this fantantic scenic tour of the fjords....He is a skilled pilot and very informative, friendly and knowledgable.  It was a pleasure...be sure to ask for Adam...and tell him Victoria sent you...: )

A must do once in your lifetime. Really gives a perspective of the Fjords and the Alaskan Wilderness. Trip logistics were great and Taquan Air was very professional. My wife is afraid of flying in small planes but she really enjoyed it. Especially enjoyed getting out on the pontoons and smelling the fresh Alaskan air and looking out over the water. Pilot was excellent and it was fun flying in the Beaver. Takeoff and landing was very smooth. Narration was excellent and the plane was very well maintained. 
The only glitch was that our party had tall people and the seats behind the pilot had less visibility of the horizon due to the lower windows. We had to sit there due to weight balancing and safety. My wife's view in the 3rd row was much better. However, it was still an incredible experience.
Did the floatplane tour to Misty Fjords as a cruise shore excursion. It was wonderful! Felt very safe in the plane and the views were phenomenal!!

Of all the things we looked forward to on our Alaska trip, the floatplane tour was in the top 3, actually #1 on my husband's list.  Larry, our pilot, did not disappoint.  What a great personality. He engaged each passenger with easy banter and his narration was perfect.   Loved the music and of course, the magnificant scenery you can only see this way.  My husband has a few mobility issues and Larry went out of his way to help him in and out of the plane. Great pilot, great tour.  Everyone should do this!

Despite a fear of heights and, therefore, a degree of pre flight nervousness this was an experience I would not have missed for the world. A sunny, clear day, magnificent scenery and a great pilot in John.

review_title: Fly me to the Moon, Larry
review_text:
I can see that Larry has already been mentioned in previous reviews, but I have to add another because he’s quite simply a lovely man and excellent pilot.

I wasn’t the most confident flyer in my group but Larry’s approach was reassuring, kind and courteous. All in all a tip top gentlemen.

Oh the sights were pretty awesome too.

This was an excursion booked through Holland America Cruise Lines and our first time on a floatplane.  Our pilot Jim was filling in for one of the regular pilots due to the increased demand... and now we know why:  Jim's timely narration combined with an awesome music selection provided the perfect backdrop for this wonder of nature.  Everyone on the plane has a perfect window view for the scenery and a headset for the audio. The take offs and landings are some of the smoothest and coolest you will ever experience.  We went on a warm and sunny day, so no special clothing needed.  A floatplane adventure is simply a "must do" in this area and Taquan Air is amazing.

What a great experience flying on a clear day to Misty Fjord from Ketchikan. Booked through Holland America. It was so beautiful with stunning views (no wildlife in sight though). Highly reccomend this tour.

This is a floatplane tour and it was so incredible!  Our Pilot(tour guide) Larry was very informative and had a sense of humor. It was a beautiful day and we saw no mist to get in the way of the beautiful views. We were supposed to land at a dock in the fjord, but it was full, so  I thought we were at another dock when he landed the plane. But no way, we got out to stretch our legs on the floats! What a great way to spend the morning! He kidded around with one of the  fearful passengers, and interacted with another about plane stats all along. He told us alot about the natural aspects and the history of the area. It was an informative and viewable tour. Thanks Taquan Air!

review_title: Float Plane through the misty fjords
review_text:
What a super experience ! Our Pilot Larry Conrad, really made the trip exciting as he related all the history as flew through the fjords. Climbing up past snow-capped mountain tops, looking down into the valleys, simple amazing.
We landed on the water in a sort of lagoon, to get out, stand on the floats and take in the view and clean crisp air.

We booked tour months ago for our first Alaskan  Cruise.  Had been told seaplane tour was incredible and not to be missed.  We arrived dockside at meeting place. Had to wait 15 minutes past scheduled pick up. Then when bus didn't arrive, operator liasion asked us to sit down it would be another 10 minutes. Then they asked us to walk to to different cruise terminal as the bus was still on way and it would be easier for driver to pick us up there. Someone asked about what if couldn't walk that far. Said could make the driver come, but would take longer.  We got to the next cruise ship and bus wasn't there yet. When it arrived, the bus unloaded some passengers. Driver was talkative but not about Ketchikan or Alaska. He said we were lucky because he had left passengers at station to come get us. Laughed about it and said they'd have to wait.  Arrived at station to find out that one plane was taken to the hangar due to mechanical issues. Asked for six volunteers.  After rearranging dinners for some passengers, we were told they would go on 5:30 flight.  Okay, then we were told by Tiger that he needed two more volunteers because if weight limitations.  We volunteered as other remaining passengers were celebrating or had second tours.  We were told we would go at 3:30. After group was called for boarding, Tiger said it was the 4:00 departure. Why he lied inexplainable. When I asked him why he lied, he said that was "tour" time.  He said he couldn't control the planes and he couldn't control the FAA safety regulations.  Said if we had booked directly, he would be able to do something, but since we booked with cruise line, he couldn't compensate us for the wasted day.   Still waiting for the tour. Will post if we ever make it to the seaplane.

review_title: We had booked through TripAdvisor - then when we arrived we got an email with a time which was unworkable, then canceled
review_text:
It is true that it appears to be much more economical to book Shore excursions through TripAdvisor rather than though the cruise line - our booking for 2 people was several $00's cheaper directly rather than through Oceania.

However the time they gave us was too close to ship departure time to be safe particularly when Oceania advanced their departure time by one hour.... When we tried to reschedule earlier - we were told there was no availability earlier - and they offered to refund our money (which was all done very timely = Honorable!!) Later we heard on the grapevine that there had been a crash, and a Taquan Air floteplane had crashed into a mountain in bad visibility. On shore, there appeared to be still multiple floteplane trips leaving, but we had left it too late to reschedule. Understood the circumstances, and greatly relieved there were no fatalities - but this was a huge disappointment in our own plans as we probably will not be able to do such a trip again in this lifetime ....

We love to fly but this was beyond our wildest expectation.  Would highly recommend to anyone that is on the fence about going.  Taking off and landing from the water is truly an amazing and fun experience.  Our pilot (Evan) was lots of fun and very knowledgeable about the area.  Had great music and commentary but told us if you just wanted to experience it in silence we could turn our head phones off.  I only did that once just to watch in wonder for a minute then listened to wonderful tunes and great commentary.  Going over mountains, lakes, over the town, waving at the cruise ship as we flew so close we could see people on the deck then landing along boats, ships and other planes was an experience we'll never forget.  Thanks Evan for the ride of our lives!

review_title: Flying  in a float and landing on the Fjords great experience.
review_text:
flightseeing experience was awesome!  pilot was a great tour guide, lots of  back round information,  He is a native.
landing the plane on the Fjords was a bonus.   They really take care of you from ship, plane, Fjords and back to ship!!

We visited Ketchikan on our cruise trip and had a awesome flight with our pilot Eric who gave a lot of helpful information. 
Recommended to do !

The views were awesome and our pilot mike was very informative and it was overall a very enjoyable experience. We even got to stand on the feet of the plane while it was on the water. It was a highlight of our trip.

We recently visited Ketchikan and did a combined adventure with a Taquan Air floatplane and a catamaran ride called cruise & fly.  The plane ride was amazing.  Our pilot educated us about the floatplane and its history, and then he did everything he could to ensure we saw as much wildlife as possible.  The highlight of the flight was being able to see a small herd of mountain goats on the top of a mountain ridge.  We also saw mountain lakes and learned about the Misty Fjords during the flight.  The scenery you can see from this excursion is hard to describe because it is just stunning.  The floatplane trip was fun, especially for the first-time float plane riders in our plane.  Definitely worthwhile adventure in Ketchikan!

We did this excursion while in Ketchikan on a cruise on the Norwegian Pearl.  This excursion was a splurge for us, but it was the highlight of our cruise.  It was just our family (my aunt & uncle, and my husband, 9-year-old, and me) in the plane.  Our pilot was fantastic, allowing us to take in the views put providing some commentary about what we were seeing.  Enough commentary to be interesting, but not a steady stream, which allowed us to take in the beautiful scenery.  We landed in Misty Fjords National Park and stepped out onto the skids/floats to further experience the beauty of the region.  We loved every minute of this special trip and Taquan Air gave us an unforgettable experience.  We highly recommend this tour!

We took the float plane back to Ketchikan a few days ago after the boat trip to the Misty Fjords. Absolutely marvellous. Stunning scenery, a great pilot and comfortable return. 
Chuck, our driver was very helpful, took photos of us and made the trip really enjoyable. Highly recommend the float plane back.

My husband and I truly enjoyed this Alaskan shore excursion during our stop in Ketchikan.  We were whisked from the port to the air facility in a comfortable passenger van and eventually joined there by passengers from several other cruise ships.  After a brief safety video, we shared a 6-seat deHavilland Beaver seaplane with another family.   Headsets allowed us to hear both the informative pilot and music which perfectly accented the stunning Misty Fjords scenery.  To say the least, it was both a breaktaking and awe-inspiring experience.  The highlight was landing softly in a quiet fjord and enjoying the landscape and wildlife that surrounded us until time to return to ship.  We highly recommend this trip!

Everything from booking, transportation, safety, boarding, etc, went very smoothly.  This is a well run operation with great people, facilities, and planes.  You will see amazing fjords, snow capped mtns, lakes and glaciers.  Whales and other wildlife are a possibility.  Our pilot Brentwood gave us a great narration, a smooth flight to a perfect landing on Punchbowl lake.  We climbed out onto the floats and tried to absorb the sights and (lack of) sounds of the incredible landscape.

Don't have any hesitation about floatplanes.  This flight was smoother than most airline trips.  Our family of 11-74yo all loved it.
This was a great excursion / beautiful scenery. Landing in the lake was very cool.  Pilot was knowledgeable and gave a great tour.

I absolutely loved LOVED LOVED taking off from a lake, flying over snow covered mountains and landing in a tiny hidden lake in the wilderness! The views were spectacular!! SEE MY PIX. So there we were, silent... floating on a wilderness lake... then the pilot, Chuck says, "Anyone want to get out?" That memory will be seared in my mind forever!! What fun to literally step OUT of the plane and stand on a pontoon!! In the middle of the wilderness! Without any sounds whatsoever. 
"Chuck" the pilot played GREAT music on the flight. We all had headphones on. 
If you are going on a cruise and hesitant about a pontoon plane excursion... don't be!! Take off and landing was smooth as silk and goes down as probably the very top travel memory of all time! FIVE STAR! No, TEN STAR! (I've traveled all over Europe, done many cruises, river cruises, trains, etc. but doing this... was the best!!!)
Jim did a great job piloting and narrating our tour. Smooth flight and landing, just the right length of time. Bonus, Jim played an excellent soundtrack from the 70, like CCR and The Band!

If you’re not afraid of flying or small planes, then you MUST take this cruise excursion or tour while in Ketchikan. It takes the full two hours allotted- no time is wasted. You get there, watch the FAA video, get on the plane and fly over the area and then get driven back. Misty Fjords is spectacular and there simply can’t be a better way to see it. (Air is superior to sea level if you really want to see mountains. Taquan has this trip down to an efficient but friendly science. I only spent 8 hours in Ketchikan, but I’m very glad that I spent two of them with these folks. Worth every penny, in exchange for which I got a lifetime of memories.
Our pilot Mike was an excellent tour guide giving great detail behind the outstanding visual scenery.  The fjords are just unbelievably beautiful.
Jim was our guide for our tour this morning and we had a really great time! The views were amazing and the playlist was on point. Definitely something you should do while you're here!

A perfectly sunny day to go see the beautiful Misty Fjords with our pilot Jim. We had a great time on our day off, he was very informative and friendly. Best of all he cranked some sick tunes (CCR) and pulled out his little hula skirt girl, all fitting for the ride into the mountains. Thankful for a one of a kind experience, would do again.

review_title: Thanks for a great Alaska excursion.  Love this trip
review_text: Chuck was our pilot and was great for info and was a lot of fun.  The Misti Fiords were fantastic.  This is a must excursion for anyone going to Ketchikan.

Larry and Chuck were our pilots/tour guides on our Misty Fjords floatplane trip.  Both guys were friendly and made our experience even better.  The splurge for a flightseeing tour is worth it after taking in the scenery and landing in one of the lakes surrounded by the pristine quiet.  Our tour in May was a little early for wildlife spotting, but the geological formations of this area are truly awesome.  A great way to see wilder Alaska.

I booked a tour to Misty Fjords. We were greeted by friendly staff and smiles all around. The process was easy and organized. We watched a simple video on plane safety then walked outside to meet our Pilot. We were paired with Jake who split us based on weight and seated us quickly and we took to the sky. I was in the co-pilot seat and Jake made us all feel comfortable with an awesome music selection. He told us about sights below but respectfully left space for quiet reflection. Every moment of this flight was beautiful and we will be flying with Taquan Air the next chance we have. When in Ketchikan, don't pass this up and go with Jake. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Very organized excursion, got there quick via coach bus, safety video, then off for what has become my #1 excursion of my life! Chuck was our pilot and he is so knowledgeable of the area and a great pilot! We saw lakes, waterfalls, white topped mountains and even landed in a lake! Got out on the pontoon to stretch and smell the clean crisp air. Beautiful day in Ketchikan! If you only do one thing it must be this float plane ride!

We had a great flight on our recent cruise stop in Ketchikan. Luckily, we had perfect weather and it was a smooth flight highlighted by a landing at Nooya lake to stretch our legs and a great landing back in the harbor with lots of traffic around us. Beautiful views throughout!

We had a great experience on this tour of the Misty Fjords National Monument FloatPlane on May 20, 2018.  This was the first time we had flown in a floatplane and the experience was amazing.  We had excellent flying weather and was able to see many beautiful sites.  I would highly recommend this company as safety was their first priority and we felt very safe during this tour.  We even landed on the lake and was able to step out on the floats.  Love the entire experience!

Such an amazing experience with breathtaking views. Would definitely do again! From Sea takeoff to lake landing and takeoff the ride was incredibly smooth. We debated booking this or the flight and crab feed and are so happy we chose the linger flight to enjoy views otherwise missed.

review_title: Amazing Taquan Air trip to Misty Fjords
review_text: This was my favourite of all the excursions we did on our Alaskan cruise and we only booked it while on the ship because my friend liked the look of it. So very glad we did. The beauty of this place cannot be described - its vastness and silence, with nature laid out below and in beautiful action. The ice was just starting to melt in May so the waterfalls were still running, and we had a spectacular cloud-free sky. Glaciated valleys, forests and swamps - what an amazing landscape. I could have stayed in the plane for twice as long although the trip lasted over an hour in any case. At one point we landed in a fjord which was spectacular - I had never flown in a float plane before. The commentary was superb as well. All in all, what a superb way to feed your soul. Do not miss.

review_title: Thank you Larry. This was amazing. This was the highlight of my life. I wanted to do it again.
review_text: I never thought I could get up the courage to do this. When it was over I wanted to do it again. Larry was such a good pilot, I felt so safe and did something so spectacular I can't believe it. You can't imagine how exciting it was. I hope someday I get to do it again and Larry I will ask for you to be our pilot.  The entire excursion from beginning to end was wonderful.

O passeio de hidroaviao pelos fiordes é fantastico. É bem caro, mas se tiver condicoes nao ira se arrepender. Fomos em um dia de ceu azul e da para ver muita coisa. Tem muitas montanhas, lagos, cachoeiras. O passeio inclui um pouso em um lago remoto. Bem legal.

Exciting adventure is what you seek? This is the one to book folks!  While on a cruise to Alaska in September, my husband and I chose the Taquan Air Misty Fjords Floatplane Tour.  Not a second of regret or fear as Chuck Perkins exudes calm confidence, exhibits expertise, and is a magnificent tour narrator.  The Misty Fjords are not to be missed--simply beautiful with so many different appeals--lakes on mountaintops, of course mist floating among the mountains, nanny goats and oh the reflections of the mountains in the lake that we landed on to climb out onto the pontoons for simply amazing views.  The music on the headphones matched perfectly to the essence of the flight.  My husband appreciated the placement of the Top Gun theme upon lake takeoff.  The pre-flight short video, Chuck's review of safety features, and magnificent untouched scenery made for a day we shall cherish--and the rainbow  was a bonus.

review_title: Great overview of the entire island
review_text:
This is a fantastic way to see much of Kauai in a 1 hour flight. The pilot, who grew up on the island and is a native Hawaiian, was very knowledgeable and interesting.

There was a lower cloud deck so we couldn't get over to Waimea Canyon, but instead saw the entire Napoli coast. So even if mother nature doesn't allow a regular flight plan, they do their best to provide good alternatives.

The weather was cloudy and overcast so our tour was cancelled which was upsetting but completely understandable. What was unacceptable was the fact that we weren't called with this information prior to arriving at the airport 20 minutes prior to our check in time. The supervisor who I finally got to talk to on the phone was beyond rude and uncaring when I asked why we weren't notified and that we'd wasted time and money to get to the airport. Based on her attitude alone, I'd never recommend this tour to anyone.

We weren't sure what to expect, but the flight was amazing. From Jill's fun welcome and orientation, to our skilled  pilot, Kenaka, everything was great. The plane was cozy and we all had great views. Our pilot pointed out many things and answered any questions we had. We saw almost all of the island including the canyons, mountains, beaches, NaPali coast, and the cities and towns. 
It was a great trip from takeoff to landing.
Great flight around the island.  Experienced pilot.  Smooth takeoff and landing and avoided clouds.  Safer than the helicopters.  Recommended.

review_title: Amazing views - got to see the whole island!
review_text: Really enjoyed this trip! You can see the entire island of Kauai - Was able to see many waterfalls - the top resorts and of course all of the coastline and the amazing mountain ranges along the Napali coast! Our pilot was very friendly and professional. We all had headphones where Hawaiian music was piped through - the commentary was just enough to be informative and not too much to be annoying!

review_title: Due to the failure of TripAdviser, the trip did not happen.
review_text:
Flight booked and no response.
However, $290 was debited. 
The tour operator had not received any information from TripAdviser. 
This trip was the most important to us. 
Thanks TripAdvisor for nothing!
Kamaka was 10/10 pilot. We had a wonderful tour over Kauai! Great experience with whale sightings and photo ops. Easy instructions and fun flight.

The check-in lady/safety advice giver/filming and photographing advice giver/plane icer/snack giver/tarmac photographer,Jill was so friendly that she put us at ease immediately. Marcus our pilot told us so many facts about who owned the land we were flying over and which movies had been shot there. He also circled a whale in the water so we could all appreciate it. Just a magical trip over truely spectacular scenery.

This was an amazing experience, worth every dime. This was our first time in a small airplane. Our pilot, Marcus, provided a calm that set us at ease. 
Marcus’ commentary throughout the flight was enlightening and appreciated.

He made sure that he flew by or around areas of particular interest so that passengers on both sides of the small plane could get the very best views.  There are no bad seats on this flight!  Everyone had a big window and a quality headset that provided clear two-way communications.  It was much quieter than a helicopter ride and apparently uses only half the fuel of a helicopter flight of similar duration.  We were so amazed by what we saw that we said "WOW!" over and over again and took soooo many photos!  After the flight we bought the video that Marcus made of our flight using footage from the cameras underneath the wings of the plane.  We are so glad we did.  The quality of the video is excellent and includes the narration that we heard on our flight.  We cannot say enough good things about Marcus and this excellent sightseeing flight! review_title: Not to be missed experience on Kauai!
review_text:
WOW! Just WOW! Our flight with Wings Over Kauai is one of the activities I was most looking forward to on our trip, and it totally delivered! It was truly the most magical and breathtaking experience of my life.

I know there are many options for seeing Kauai by air, including both helicopters and small airplanes, but let me convince you that Wings Over Kauai is the way to go.

1) The tour lasts about 1 hour and allows you to see more of the island that the helicopters, which usually skip the south shore on their flights.
2) There are no middle seats! This guarantees that everyone on the plane will get a window seat, and if the plane isn't at full capacity (our plane was max 6 passengers), then everyone is seated on the right which is the best view on the tour.
3) The cost is about half the cost of the helicopters. Let me repeat that, it costs about half of what the helicopters charge!
4) They have GoPro cameras attached to each wing and one inside the plane which record the flight. You can purchase an edited video of your actual flight which is 100% worth it IMO!
5) Our pilot was Marcus and he was absolutely fantastic! He is a birder, like my sister, and before our flight he even wrote down tips on where to see birds on the island. He did an incredible job narrating throughout our flight, and the flight itself was incredibly smooth and comfortable. Marcus truly went above and beyond and made our experience even better than I could have imagined.
6) If you are prone to motion sickness, often times the small planes can provide a smoother flight with less rapid changes in motion than helicopters.
7) I actually prefer that the plane flies a bit higher and provides a better panorama and wider shots than helicopters that fly closer to the terrain. If you have a camera with a good zoom lens, you can still get really nice close up shots!
8) Did I mention it's about half the price of the helicopters?

This plane ride was absolutely amazing and our pilot was awesome! He was so helpful and knowledgeable about pointing out the different landmark like waterfalls, caves, cities, and the Napali Coast was so incredible. This was a once in a lifetime experience and the plane flew so calmly without any bumps and turbulence. My two grandkids went with us and they were mesmerized looking out the windows the entire time. Thanks you Wings over Kauai for making this experience so very special and memorable!

review_title: Great Value; Great Service, Great Tour
review_text: My wife and I appreciated this flight around Kauai.  But, we have to commend the customer care we were shown by the whole staff at Wings over Kauai.  The day we were scheduled to fly, the island was clouded in; they gave us the option of a refund or rebooking.  We gladly rebooked with them for the next day; and instead of the larger group flight we had booked, the provided deluxe two passenger flight piloted by the owner.  We were able to see the parts of the island we wanted to see, but for safety reasons we did not go into the cloudy interior.   We flew at a leisurely pace--slower than a helicopter; this allowed us to see everything close up--allowing time for photos, and getting lots of information from the pilot. He not only explained the islands geography and current history but also pointed out the spots where a number of movies had been made--including Pirates of the Caribbean, Jurrassic Park, and Gilligan's Island.  At half the cost of a helicopter ride and with customer satisfaction and customer safety as their first priorities, we highly recommend this often overlooked option for seeing Kauai from the air.

The check in and out teams were phenomenal as well. It was nice to know what to expect.

Mahalo! Highly recommended.

We had a nice sunny day for our flight.  We scheduled a 9:30 a.m. flight.  We were greeted by Ellen, who checked us in and gave us a safety briefing.  Captain Bruce, the pilot, has extensive knowledge of things agricultural, which he shared in his explanation of vegetation and geology.  Points of interest were described and brought to our attention.  This was a great wrap up to our two weeks on Kauai, having visited most of the island from north to south, including Hanalei area, Kapaa, Waimea Canyon.  We have also taken helicopter flights in the past.  Fixed wing viewing is a different experience.  You see the island in overview and have a longer time to view the scenery as the plane seems to travel more slowly.    If you can, sit on the right hand side (starboard) of the aircraft for best views.  Wear dark clothing to avoid reflections from windows in your photos.  We felt very comfortable taking this flight, as safety and our comfort were emphasized. Would would repeat this tour.

review_title: Great island tour on Kauai with Wings over Kauai
review_text: Went on Wings Over Kauai airplane tour of kauai today.  Just myself and my wife so it was very private.   A must do since there's no other way to see most of the island.   Our pilot was very thorough and with minimal clouds we were able to see everything.   The airplane tour is half the price of the helicopter tours snd we were in the air longer.  Glad we chose this tour.    Recommend doing it early in your stay on the island because it will help you plan hiking and beach trips

review_title: GREAT bird's eye view of Kauai!
review_text:
We came in early November after Kauai reopened due to COVID.

We had a reservation for a 10:30 a.m. flight, but the winds were too strong. They called us and suggested that we push it back a few days, when the weather is better. I appreciate that they had our safety in mind.

We came back and did the 9:00 a.m. Cessna flight for 2 people on Saturday, Nov. 14th. Ellen in front was super nice and checked us in. Marcus was our pilot and he was super friendly and knowledgeable.

The flight was super smooth and very enjoyable. They play different music on an iPad that matches each part of the island. Marcus gave us great narration over each part of the island.

We saw lots of waterfall and the NaPali Coast was spectacular!

This was much cheaper than taking a helicopter flight and we were very happy with it!
From booking to the tour to landing Ellen and our pilot Parker were great! Very informative, safe and fun. For our family of four it was an affordable option to see island of Kaua'i.

Ellen fetched me from the designated pick up point for cruise ship passengers and brought me to the airport.  After details were explained we took off for our one-hour flight over Kauai.  Marcus was our pilot. His cool voice describing the landmarks with traditional Hawaiian music playing on the background will minimize any anxiety flying on a small plane. I felt relaxed during the whole flight.  The plane had an intercom system wherein passengers and pilot could talk to one another.

I went on a land tour of the coffee plantation and the Waimea canyon the day before.  Hence, I had a comparison of the sights to be seen.   Even if it was a bit cloudy on our morning flight, this is the best option for seeing Kauai. What I saw of the Waimea canyon park was only a fraction of the area on the lookout point.  On the air tour, you get to enjoy the whole canyon and its surrounding mountains.  This flight enables you to see the Na Pali coast, the most beautiful scenery of the Hawaiian Islands. The cathedral like spires were truly stunning.  We next flew over a tall dormant volcano with thick forest cover. Seeing numerous waterfalls was a bonus. 

Thank you for an unforgettable experience Ellen and Markus.

review_title: WINGS OVER KAUAI IS A "MUST DO"
review_text: Our entire experience with WINGS OVER KAUAI was amazing.  The people are receptive and easy to work with and the flight - well - there ARE NO WORDS!!!! Kauai is beautiful from land and sea but to  view the Island at her most breathtaking is to fly. I have flown over the Grand Canyon, hot air balloons over the Valley of the Kings in Egypt and the Bagan temples in Myanmar and many, many other airborne adventures and WNGS OVER KAUAI is at the top of my "must do" list for anyone coming to wonderful Kauai.  BIG MAHALO to ELLEN & CAPT. PARKER !!!

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island.
review_text: The whole crew was super friendly and the flight was wonderful. I highly recommend this a a must do. The views and the narration of the flight were unbeatable. Thanks for a great adventure.

Wow, what a gift we were given through Wings Over Kauai. Starting with the friendliness of Ellen, onto the no safety care by Val and onto the great competency of Parker in the air, we were in great hands. The beauty and majesty of Kauai can only be experienced by the close views from the air. We knew we’d have some spectacular sights but hadn’t expected the valleys, waterfalls, and coastline to give us such stunning memories. We are humbled by the beauty of this island and thankful for the professionalism of these great folks. Everyone needs to experience a birds eye view of Kauai and Wings Over Kauai is the smart move to find your own memories.

Highlight of our trip, the pilot was very interactive putting the plane in a 360 so we could watch the Whales and explaining iconic views, land formations and cultural background of the Na"pali coastline. It was very helpful that everyone had headsets provided to interact with Pilot and other 3 people on board.   Highly recommend

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: My hubby and I did the private tour and Parker was our pilot. This tour is awesome and Parker is the absolute best! Not only is he knowledgeable about the area, he’s friendly and very professional. We had a blast!! I highly recommend taking this tour (the private tour is just a little more if it’s just the two of you) and hopefully you’ll be fortunate enough to have Parker fly you around. Thanks again Parker!! You rock!!
I highly recommend this tour! Our pilot was Marcus and he was amazing! He made us feel safe and gave us an excellent tour of the island. The views are unbeatable! We even saw whales!

This is a fantastic trip and Marcus is a wonderful pilot/guide.  You see parts of Kauai that you would never see other than from the air.  We were surprised at how quiet it was once your headphones were on and Marcus had a great playlist that enhanced the entire trip.  We commented on how relaxing this was.  We would definitely do this again!

review_title: Amazing experience! Could not recommend enough!
review_text: My 70 year old mom, myself, and my 5 year old daughter all went on this tour today (February 2020) and we had the most amazing experience ever. The flight was so smooth, the views were beyond outstanding. We saw whales in the ocean and everything that the beautiful land of Kauai has to offer. We all felt so safe and had the best time. 10 out of 10. Don’t think about it. Just book it.

We took the air tour aboard the Air Van with out pilot, Marcus. What an outstanding trip this was! We took off at about 9:30am, and the weather was perfect. Seeing Kauai from the air is really the only was to experience the majesty of this island in one fell swoop. Marcus is an excellent pilot, and is very adept at spotting things you will want to see...such as humpback whales just off the coast. We circled over several whales, including a couple that had calves in tow. Flying along the Na Pali coast, and through Waimea Canyon will take your breath away. It is quite easy to think you have been transported to Jurassic Park! The folks at Wings Over Kauai were superb, and gave us an experience we will never forget. This tour was worth every penny, and I encourage you to fly with them.

review_title: A must do and a do over
review_text: Just off the plane with my wife and had the most amazing time.  Windy day but never felt any of it under the professional hands of Parker.  He was very knowledgeable of the sights below us and always kept us where we could see the landmarks.  My wife was a bit worried of motion sickness but never had any concerns.  It was so peaceful on our private tour and it definitely will be a do over with Wings Over Kauai.

Just a great ride....and at about $100-$150 less than a helicopter tour, and with a better safety record.  We flew in a small 4-seat Cessna, just the pilot, my wife and me and saw areas like the Napali Coast that you can't get to without a boat of some sort of aircraft.  Highly recommended!

review_title: Not gonna lie, I was nervous...
review_text: I was absolutely nervous to fly in a tiny plane, but our pilot Marcus was AMAZING! He absolutely put us at ease and showed us some incredible sights and breathtaking views. The ENTIRE experience was unforgettable and I loved every single minute of it!

The checkin process was strained and tedious. The lady in charge of our checking in seemed to almost resent us being there. I was concerned!!! When we met our pilot, Marcus, I relaxed. He was outgoing and personable. He handled the controls and flying expertly and pointed out numerous things we would have missed. He swung around for another look at a whale he spotted so we could all see. The flight was dreaded by one of our group due to a previous bad experience but he was smiling throughout this one and we all enjoyed ourselves!! The takeoff and landing were both smooth and not at all scary. Would highly recommend. Would definitely do this again on any return trip.

Unsere Tour war einfach traumhaft und absolut empfehlenswert! Unser Captain Bruce war wirklich erfahren, witzig und hat tolle, interessante Sachen über Kauai erzählt! Wir waren wirklich sehr begeistert.

This tour is a super value, half the cost of a helicopter tour and substantially the same views. The flight is smooth and comfortable, safely conducted by Captain Bruce. The views are spectacular, especially the Na Pali coast and traverse over the mountains back toward Lihue. Kauai is the prettiest place on the planet.

My wife and I had never flown in a single engine light plane, but we felt extremely comfortable with Bruce.  He is an excellent pilot and great narrator of the magnificent island of Kauai.  This experience is not to be missed!  Thank you to Bruce and his wife who made sure we found the airport and didn’t miss our flight.

Before I discuss the actual tour, a bit about Wings Over Kauai... Due to no problem of theirs, I screwed up the booking of this tour about four times. I was constantly confused of the dates and times we were available. I was a real headache, I'm sure. I spoke with a Wings Over Kauai employee (Mary?) several times, and she put up with my constant mistakes like a pro. By the time I'd finally got things settled, I was already convinced this organization was excellent.

Now to the trip... Kauai weather is fickle and we had a morning flight. The staff showed us a map of the winds and live videos to completely prepare us for risks of partial visibility or turbulence. They offered to rebook us for a different time or day if we had any problems. We chose to go ahead with the flight.

Our pilot (Mark?) was funny and happy to take a minor detour when he saw whales breaching off the Na Pali coast. The views are absolutely outstanding, and due to our altitude and flghtplan, we were able to see more than we would have in a helicopter tour. We experienced turbulence (which we were warned about), but Mark was amazing at the helm.

Would definitely do again! We recommend doing this as early into your trip as possible to get a scenic overview (no pun intended) of Kauai!

review_title: Great way to start your visit and get to know beautiful Kauai
review_text: Everything about our flight was spectacular. Marcus is not only an excellent pilot, he shares information that is helpful in making your activities more informed. We highly recommend that you also purchase the dvd of your flight that is done very professionally to share with those you love and to revisit your experience. Gina was very kind and helpful in the office. Our flight was at 1 pm and it wasn’t the perfect time for photography of the Napali coast due to sun glare. A bit of Photoshopping” helped remedy. We saw some beautiful double rainbows. You can’t get as close to the falls as a helicopter would, but the lesser cost is something to consider.

review_title: Best way to see the island
