review_text: Amazing view and smooth flight! Really get close to the pristine canyons and forests that are not accessible by foot from a bird eye view!
Awesome! Bruce was great and knew a lot about the island. Same views as the helicopter for half the price and not scary.

Amazing views and wonderful experience!
Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and the sea life!  Would recommend highly!  The day was a bit rainy but did not take away from the trip!

review_title: Best part of our 2 week Hawaii tour for all 4 islands
review_text:
We were in Hawaii for 2 weeks splitting our time between 4 islands - Oahu, Big Island, Kauai and Maui. We took many tours including scenic flights and boats but this tour stands out as the best one overall. We took this on New years day this year and it is very memorable for many reasons. 

1. Scenery is breahtaking and you get to see upclose
2. Very thoughtful touches to tour - right from well planned route, superior customer service at check-in and in flight. We got a Hawaiian music CD and a nice follow-up email with our pic they took in start free of charge, that was a nice tough. 
3. Our Pilot Markus was awesome and made us feel tour was safe and pleasant. He took time to go through all nice landmarks, didn't miss a single spot, turned around the coast too, gave plenty of time for pics, and also lot of good information about Kauai as well. Take off and landing was very smooth. 
4. We didn't plan well in advance and luckily managed to get seats on this flight. Since weather was awesome during the day, we consider ourselves lucky that day. 
We felt there was no better way to start the new year ! this was a memorable trip for us and Kauai Deluxe Sightseeing Flight made it all happen for us. 

THANKS SO MUCH! Highly recommended.

Hands down one of my favorite experiences on my trip to Kauai! Had an absolutely lovely time flying with our pilot Bruce! He's lived on the island for about 25? years and is extremely knowledgeable about its history and landscape. Feel free to ask him questions! We definitely got a history lesson on our trip :) 

I had the added experience of being his co-pilot on this flight so that was just the cherry on top for this experience!! 

I would definitely recommend this tour for anyone looking for an aerial view of the island but doesn't want to spend all that extra money for a helicopter tour. This one is worth it :)

review_title: Great experience of Kauai Island flight sightseeing
review_text: My family had a great experience of sightseeing of Kauai island from sky. Captain Marcus was an experienced pilot who drove the plane very smoothly and safely. Also he explained the History and scenery of the island and was very patient with all of our questions. Additionally, The staff provided safety information and refreshments. Overall, the sightseeing trip was worth it and is a must if you are visiting Kauai.
Simply the best way to see the natural beauty of this island. Captain Marcus was an excellent pilot and host and the whole excursion was smooth, safe and enjoyable. An experience too good to miss.

Took the airvan tour with Marcus and it was the best decision ever! Kauai is absolutely gorgeous and we can’t traverse all the vistas on road making the air tour a must! Marcus was amazing with his calm voice explaining everything about the plane, route and Kauai’s history and tour details. The company overall gave me warm and genuine vibes which I loved. Even the check process was great.

A great excursion to see all of Kauai. Waterfalls, the dramatic Na'pali coast, the Waimea canyon and all the different beaches and coastal towns. Marcus narrated the entire tour and provided so much interesting information about the island. It was very enjoyable and I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting the island.

Que dire. Les paysages sont magnifiques, incroyables. La Napali Coast est vraiment à voir, des dizaines de chutes d’eau plus belles les unes que les autres, une forêt luxuriante et vierge.
Merci Bruce pour ce vol qui restera dans nos mémoires !

What an experience!  Cameron was able to show us the beauty of the island and we could tell he loves what he does and where he does it.  Everyone was amazing.  We highly recommend this tour and do the private small plane.  Incredible and well worth it.

We had an amazing flight around Kauai with Bruce. This was our favorite active we did in Kauai. Unfortunately we didnt have the best weather, but Bruce navigated us around the island and gave us an amazing veiws.  We got so close to the mountains. They give you such a cute gift after your flight. I definitely recomend this family company.

My family of six took a flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai and had Marcus as our pilot.  It was the highlight of the vacation for everyone.  Placement on the plane is determined by weight but everyone has a window seat.  Customer service was great from beginning to end.  Seeing Kauai from the air is a must do, there is really nothing else like it!

Marcus was a great pilot, spotted dolphins, and gave us a super explanation of islands history and topography.  Taking another friend in January.  Have done helicopters before.  Liked the smoothness and price.

I booked a tour with this company. I Never heard anything back from them. I called them after 16 hours only to be told my 930 spot had been given up because no one checked the TripAdvisor site at the office. Only spot available was 230pm, which we could do because our ship leaves port. The lady on the phone was rude, refused to giver name. Avoid this company!!!!

We booked the combo tour with wings and the Blue Dolphin Charters. The pilot was super honest with us regarding some weather that forced us to stick mainly to the coast instead of flying through the valley to get to Na Pali. We were offered to cancel, reschedule or take the adjusted flight plan. We chose to accept the new flight and boy am I glad we did. The pilot made sure to point out interesting points on the flight. While we were near Na Pali we circled above some giant manta rays and circled above a shark along the north shore. I would recommend this company to anyone and if you enjoy snorkeling/boats take the combo too. It was a great time!

review_title: Awesome way to view many of the waterfalls of Kauai!
review_text:
Marcus was a fantastic pilot and tour guide on this excursion! Kauai has so much beauty with the "cathedrals" along the NaPali coast as well as waterfalls and aspects of the rain forest that cannot be seen other than from the air. Marcus was knowledgeable and the flight was quite smooth, including takeoff and landing. 

We chose to do this tour on our first morning in Kauai, which worked out well to help inform the rest of our trip and exploration of the island. We decided to even purchase the recording of our trip to share with family and friends afterward.

review_title: Amazing views and great value for money!
review_text: This plane ride was definitely the highlight of our trip, gorgeous views, knowledgable and helpful staff. The scenery we were able to see on the plane was surreal and seemed okay for motion sickness prone passengers. Informative narration and never felt unsafe in the plane.
Amazing views. Pilot and ground staff were excellent. Felt safe, pilot gave excellent narration during tour.

review_title: Start your vacation with Wings Over Kauai
review_text: Bruce alone was worth the price of admission.  Great pilot, great tour guide, and fantastic individual.  The views from his comfortable plane were amazing.  It definitely set the tone for our vacation.  We will definitely book with Wings Over Kauai when we return.  And as an added bonus I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat, which was a personal highlight.

I do not have enough words to describe all the beauty and nature we saw on this flight. We were greeted with a friendly, Aloha and given the ground rules for the flight. Bruce our pilot was amazing! He is very knowledgeable about the island and a very skilled pilot. If you are wondering do we do the helicopter or plane? Choose the plane Boss! My husband was so excited to be seated be next to the Bruce the pilot. I got some amazing pictures of all the stunning landscapes ! Mahalo! Wings over Kaui! 
Thank you Gina and Bruce for your amazing hospitality!
The Hopes!
Until we meet again!

We decided to try Wings Over Kauai instead of a helicopter tour, because it cost less and it was just the two of us plus the pilot. Due to turbulent air, we weren’t able to fly over Waimea Canyon, but we saw the entire north and east coasts, including Hanalei Bay and the Na Pali coast. 
Pilot Cameron pointed out lots of natural landmarks, as well as small beaches and places to walk/hike. He shared interesting history and geology of the island. He was very knowledgeable. 
It was great having a *private* tour of Kauai. We even flew (somewhere) OVER the rainbow! <see photo>
There were a few rough spots and unexpected rain, but we never felt sick or scared. The tour was definitely a highlight of our trip!!

Note to Val in the office – I went to Dr. Ringler (in KS) today and told him of our visit. He was surprised, to say the least. Small world!

review_title: Best way to see the Napali coast
review_text: This was an amazing experience. Flying over Kauai in a small plane was great. These guys really do an amazing job. The narration was excellent, it's a smooth flight and the visual experience is a must do on the island. By far my best experience on the island. Congrats to the team.

review_title: Would give more stars if I could.
review_text: This island is amazing and our tour was incredible.  Marcus gave us a great flight and narrative.  I think this is the best excursion we have ever taken. Everyone had a window seat on the right which was optimal for viewing.  The weather was perfect. Takeoff and landing great.  They picked us up near the cruise ship and delivered us back, exhilarated,  after.

review_title: Best way to see the island!
review_text:
We did an Airvan tour with Bruce, the founder, as our pilot. He was incredibly knowledgeable (hes a Ph.D. in addition to being a pilot), funny and accommodating to our party of five, several of whom were non-native English speakers. Bruce took us on a circular tour of the island describing various rock formations, plantations, waterfalls and other points of interest. He kept up the witty banter, asked us questions about us lives, and described the general functioning of the airplane and process by which it flies. As you'd expect, he flew smoothly, avoided low clouds and strove to make the flight as comfortable as possible for those on the plane sensitive to bumps. 

In addition to the tour itself, which was amazing, Bruce described the aircraft to us and he let me assist with the pre-flight checklist, which I found to be awesome. If you're an aviation nerd, definitely ask to be in the co-pilot seat. 

At the conclusion of the tour, Val came over and provided us with a CD of Bruce's favorite Hawaiian music. What was cool was the photo on the cover of the CD -- it was our family picture taken prior to our flight. A really neat and personal touch and something that we really cherish from our trip. We now drive around at home with Bruce's favorite Hawaiian music playing in the car and we think of the amazing time we had in Kauai. 

Many thanks Bruce, Val and Wings Over Kauai team!

We did the flight around the island with wings over kauai and we could not have imagined a more amazing experience. The view from up above completely changes your perception of the beautiful island and they try to show you as much of it as possible. Me and my family were seated on the right side of the plane, where you have the best view (as the tour is a clockwise circle so you always face inwards) and the windows were super clear which granted the possibility for a fantastic view and pictures. Our pilot Marcus did an amazing job at constantly providing interesting information about the sights we passed on the tour.

We we're scheduled to fly on October 16th, 9am but were a bit unlucky with the weather.

But the team was prepared and rescheduled us for 12:30. Bruce our pilot changed up the route to avoid the bad weather and gave us a great tour of the island.

Although I'm not a big fan of small aircraft I always felt save and the flight wasn't that rough. 

We can recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see this beautiful island from above and get some good inspirations on where to go.

We were debating on doing this or the helicopter tour, and chose this one. We had a great experience and the pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. We lucked out and only had one other couple with us, so it wasn't a tight fit. The views were amazing! 
It didn't feel rushed at all, and after the flight we both said that this was probably better than the helicopter since we got a bigger view from a little further away while still feeling pretty close.
Capt Bruce was an amazing guide. The sights were breathtaking. And you get keepsake at the end!! Couldn’t have had a better experience.

Wir haben uns den top-bewerteteten Rundflug auch gegönnt und waren begeistert. Natürlich ist die Begeisterung schon hauptsächlich der wunderschönen Insel geschuldet. Die Ausblicke sind unglaublich. Unser Pilot hat alles sehr schön erklärt und war super freundlich. Viel Spaß :)
Captain Bruce was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. The flight and the views were amazing. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

review_title: Amazing way to see the Napali coast
review_text: Wow, breathtaking. 2 words to summerized our experience. Taking a small plane, max of 6 people was quite the experience. The flight last between 65 -75 minutes but crazy cool. The ride was very smooth . Our pilot was Marcus, he was great in narrating our flight. We did purchase the video, at $50 , it's a great souvenir because the videos it's the tour we did we the narration that Marcus did, so very personnalized. A must in Kauai, thank you Marcus.

review_title: Best way to see Kauai's beauty!
review_text:
Full disclosure- I suffer from motion sickness fairly easily.  I've tried boat rides on calm waters, which end badly for me, so I knew touring the Na Pali coast via raft or helicopter were not options.  After extensive researching, I finally decided to try Wings Over Kauai.  They advertised their Airvan plane as like riding a bus.  This would probably be the best/only option for seeing a glimpse Kauai's awesome landscape.

Booking the trip was very easy.  The price per couple was totally reasonable.  Checking in for the flight was also easy.  Val checked us in and took us into the back room where she went over the safety briefing and let us know what to expect on the tour.  Marcus, our pilot, as also in the office checking the weather conditions.  

After our final weigh in- we went to the tarmac where Val took a couple pictures of the groups in front of the plane.  We donned our life jacket pouches and head sets and waited for take off.

Our pilot, Marcus, was amazing.  Super friendly and knowledgeable about the island. He also was a great DJ, queuing up music appropriate for what we were seeing (Jurassic Park Theme when flying over the Jurassic Park waterfall).  The views are breathtaking.  Our Airvan plane had huge windows so nothing was ever obstructed.  The entire flight was a little over an hour and did a tour of pretty much the entire island.  

Unfortunately I did end up getting sick towards the end of the tour, though it was entirely my fault.  The plane ride itself was smooth, except for the small bump here and there.  Val warned us motion sickness sufferers to not take too many pictures out of the window.  I did not follow this advice- the beauty was too tempting!  Thankfully on board they supply a small cooler filled with ginger candies and water. I would definitely still do this tour over again and will have no problem recommending this activity for other Kauai visitors!

Wij kunnen alleen maar WAUW zeggen!! Wat een prachtig eiland en wat een geweldige rondvlucht over het eiland. Letterlijk alles kunnen zien en wat super dat onze piloot overal wat bij kon vertellen. Het was niet strak blauw, maar volgens mij is dat niet eens mogelijk op dit eiland maar dat maakte het zeker niet minder mooi. Ongelooflijk is dit eiland! Zelfs met regen en bewolking. Wat ons wel weer prachtige regenbogen heeft gegeven! Zo fel en groot!!! Absolute aanrader om een rondje boven Kauai te vliegen!!!
Captain Bruce was very friendly and knowledgeable.  Saw great views of the island at a fraction of the cost of the helicopter tours.

review_title: The way to see the island
review_text: Awesome island and this was the way to see it. A little bit of turbulence but our very experienced pilot moved out of it fast. I don’t usually get air sick only sea sick, but I would advise using motion sickness tablets, I would use next time. We saw so many sights that we did not explore the island anymore just went swimming for the rest of the day. Can definitely recommend.

review_title: Sensational way to spend an hour
review_text: This was a lovely relaxing informative flight.  The scenery is stunning, the pilot so polite & calm & full of information.  This was worth every cent & we would highly recommend it.

Very nice welcome and briefing by Val and Capt. Cameron.
Capt. Cameron is a very experienced pilot and we always felt safe. He explained to us even small details about the island (when asked about it), selected a very interesting route and always knew about the other traffic (helicopters). 
It was a private sightseeing flight for us two in this Cessna 172, not comparable to sitting in a crowded helicopter.
Finally we have seen the whole island from a bird's perspective.
After landing we got a DVD with the music which was played during flight including a picture from us in front of the plane for free!

Nothing like taking a private flight around the island to get a birds eye view of the sights. My wife and I booked the private Cessna tour and we loved it. Cameron, our pilot, was great. My wife isn’t the best flier and was worried about being in a small four person plane. He put her at ease right away and as a pilot myself, he was an excellent one. He knows the island and is full of information to point out while seeing the island. We would definitely do it again. Everyone was professional and accommodating for the whole process.

My wife and I both agree that this was the highlight of our trip to Hawaii. Captain Marcus was a great pilot and showed us the many wonders of the island of Kauai. He was very engaging and informative. The views of the Na Pali Coast were exceptional and awe inspiring. I would recommend this flight to anyone. If we ever go back to Kauai, this would be one of the first things we would do again.

Definitely take the flight to take a look at Na Pali coast. The views are breathtaking. While I know that there is helicopter tour as well which is popular since it takes you way down and right above the waterfalls and canyon but I would say that these beauties are better if you see from a distance. It would be great to see it up close but I think the better view would be from a height which is what this tour experience offers!
Excellent tour. Mr. Bruce was our pilot and he was very informative and engaging. We also ended up getting personal gifts at the end of the tour. Definitely worth the price.

review_title: Heaps cheaper then helicopter - Amazing Beautiful Scenery
review_text: Captain Marcus at the controls provided us with an experience we will never forget.  The scenery from the air was incredibly beautiful. The flight was for 65mins and priced a lot better than the helicopter flight which was for shorter duration.  Only 4 people on our flight and we all had an incredible window view. We covered areas which were inaccessable by land and the waterfalls were beautiful.  A thoroughly wonderful experience which we were so glad we did - one of the best things we did on our holiday!

review_title: Super exciting, felt very safe, well run Family business
review_text: Well worth it. The family preferred Fixed-wing aircraft v/s Helicopter. All four of us got large Window on the Right Side of the Plane. Flight Trek covers the whole Island. Pre, during & post-flight checkup, setup was good. Gives you the confidence of well-run outfit. It is definitely a better & safer value compared to the Helicopter ride.

Der Rundflug über Kauai mit „Wings over Kauai“ bestätigt alle Erwartungen! Es war super! Unser Pilot Marcus war sehr nett, hat alle Gegenden und Sehenswürdigkeiten erklärt und den Flug erlebnisreich gestaltet. Wir hatten alle (5 Passagiere) einen tollen und einzigartigen Blick auf den Canyon, die Napali Küste, die Wasserfälle und mehr! Danke! Das war TOP.

Sherry and I took the air tour today.  Captain Marcus was at the controls.  We have seen this island on the ground from “tip to tip”, have been on many sunset cruises up the NaPali Coast.  We’ve also taken a helicopter tour of this island.  This tour was by far the best way to see the island!  The ground crew was fantastic and the captain was very informative and handled the plane marvelously.  Highly recommend this tour!

I truly have to say this was one of my favorite vacation activities that my wife and I have ever done on a vacation. Kauai is a beautiful treasure and seeing it from the air is the best way to get the total experience. The staff was awesome - Val was very friendly and thorough in preparing us for flight and Captain Marcus made the ride truly enjoyable. His narration of the island and his great piloting skills made for a memorable time. We chose this plane tour over the many helicopter tours in the area since we would be guaranteed a window seat - no middle seats on the plane.  Getting a middle seat on a helicopter which would totally ruin the experience. The flight was smooth and safe. Great experience - highly recommend.

My boyfriend and I did this tour over Kauai. Our pilot Cameron was fantastic. The ride was enjoyable, a great way to see the island and fun! Cameron gave us information as we rode, answered our questions and provided local recommendations. Val was also extremely helpful and the office called us right away to book the trip. It is an amazing way to see Kauai with a helpful staff!

A great way to see the beauty of Kauai, and all different sides of the island. Both ground staff and our pilot Marcus were very friendly and made the entire trip easy for us as a family with young girl. We are family of 4, and we had the luxury of having entire airplane all by ourselves (the airplane seats 6 at most). Everybody gets a big window seat! Even though it does not go as low as helicopter, it gives much broader view and in depth look of the island, and it covers bigger portion of the island from the air. The excursion was very smooth (I probably had the best landing experience over years of flight experience), and great for family with young kids. Would definitely recommend them to anybody!
Wenn ihr auf Kauai seid, dann gönnt euch dieses besondere Erlebnis. Der Blick auf die Insel ist einfach fantastisch und Captain Bruce ein erfahrener und sympatischer Pilot.

This is a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai.  The staff on the ground were very helpful and friendly.  The pilot was both skillful and knowledgeable.  Doing this excursion by plane instead of helicopter was less expensive.  I would highly recommend trying this company.

I really wanted to tour Kauai by air but I get motion sick. I took a non-drowsy Bonine and was a little nervous at take off but did fine. I felt completely safe in the hands of our expert pilot, Captain Bruce. He was very knowledgeable and we learned a lot about the island. He was super nice to my teenagers. This tour was way cheaper than the helicopters and everyone got a window seat. I don't feel like I missed out by not being able to land or swoop close to the water falls. Instead, I feel lucky that I was able to take in so much beauty in safety and comfort. I'm attaching a photo so you can see. I recommend this tour!

We loved everything about this experience! No other company gets you up in the air for an entire hour, and in that time we saw basically the entire island. One of us is a nervous flyer, and the small plane was very smooth and Bruce did a fantastic job piloting. He knew all kinds of fun stuff about Kauai, but it felt like a fun conversation and not a history lesson because of his sense of humor. We really loved this experience and would recommend it to anyone!

This was the best part of my trip to Kauai. Loved seeing the sites from the air. Considered taking a helicopter ride but this was significantly cheaper and just as much fun. Bruce the pilot and owner was fun to listen to, he knows what to point out and gives stories about it.

review_title: Great for a first day on the island!
review_text: Bruce is a fantastic, kind, and knowledgeable tour guide. Highly recommend. This was a spectacular way to get a feel for the island and places we’d like to visit (we did the tour on our first full day here). We saw the same areas as the helicopter tours, but the trip much less expensive.

This is my fourth time on Kauai -- I only wish I'd done this on the first trip!  It was a fabulous introduction to the island for my 20-year-old son: Kauai's geography and geology, agricultural history (Capt. Bruce was an agronomist by training), movie venues, spectacular vistas, and general layout.  Although I'd been all around the island at sea level -- and driven up to Koke'e to see the spectacular vistas, hiked part of the Napali Coast, etc., this one-hour tour put the island together perfectly.  Definitely the thinking (wo)man's view of the island.  Also quite affordable, much care towards safety and passenger well-being, and good fun.  

My son said he had been worried about going up in a small plane, but quickly realized just how resilient it was.  Then, at dinner, we were chatting to a small group that had done the equivalent tour on a helicopter -- only, one member couldn't bring herself to ride in a chopper, whereupon they wished they'd realized this was an option.  So glad we did it.

review_title: Excellent flight, amazing views, expert pilot
review_text: Couldn't have been better, we loved flying with Bruce and enjoyed how knowledgeable and kind he was.

We loved our tour! You 100% have to book!! I did the morning tour with my boyfriend and there was one other couple. The max I think is 6 in the plane. Really there are no words for the scenic Na Pali coast. Highly recommend!! Ask the pilot made the smoothest landing ever!!

review_title: Great trip!  My wife was very apprehensive and it was very smooth and an awesome view!
review_text: This was an incredible way to see the island.  There is no way to see everything by land or boat, so this accomplished seeing things we could not have seen all in one tour.  My wife was worried because she had gotten sick on a helicopter tour previously, but she had absolutely no problems on this and the pilot was awesome and very informative.  Would highly recommend this instead of a helicopter tour.  This was much smoother than a helicopter tour and based on our previous experience on another island, we saw just as much as you would have on a helicopter

we did our flight with Marcus, he is very friendly,knowledgeable and experienced pilot.
The flight was smooth, he showed us awesome views. This is the best way to see whole island in 1 hour.
Fantastic flight, the best islands tour, smooth flight knowledge pilot  small private plane great views

We had a really great experience flying over Kauai the captain was very informative and told was all the important facts about the island the flight was very thorough and long and beautiful views highly recommend this tour

review_title: Toller Rundflug! Ideale Alternative zum Heli-Flug
review_text: Wir (Familie, Kinder 9 und 15) haben den Rundflug sehr genossen. Kostet ca. halb so viel wie der Heli-Flug, ist viel komfortabler und bietet beste Ausblicke. Wir waren allein an Bord und wurden von Captain Marcus bestens betreut und mit Infos versorgt. Jederzeit wieder.

Originally when I was looking to book an air tour, I was unable to find a company that would take small children. I have a 2 1/2 year old who travels well and who I prefer to bring along with me whenever possible. Fortunately, Wings Over Kauai was referenced on a TripAdvisor forum, and when I followed up to confirm that they take small children, I was assured that they have lots of experience with kids, provide a booster cushion to help kids see out the windows, and provide a kid-size headset! 

Val, the office manager, and Cameron, the pilot, were both incredibly professional and friendly with us. They made us feel welcome and at ease, and got us settled onto the Cessna with no hiccups. The flight was amazing! Totally worth doing, and a definite highlight of our trip. My 2 1/2 year old enjoyed wearing her headset and looking out of her window for about half the flight, and then had a nap for the rest of the flight. 

I would recommend Wings over Kauai for any group. The Cessna is amazing because you get the plane to yourself if you only have a couple and maybe a child. I’m sure the larger plane is great for bigger groups, but I didn’t experience it. Hands down, take this tour!

Initially I considered booking a helicopter tour of the island, but after reading some reviews of heli vs plane tours it seemed like plane was the way to go. Less possibility of motion sickness and better overall aerial views. 

We were not disappointed. The approximately one hour tour was full of amazing views and vistas, combined with informative tidbits from our captain/pilot Marcus. 

Definitely recommend!

review_title: Small plane sightseeing flight was excellent
review_text: Plan ahead to assure you can book a flight! We cruised easily over the island with breathtaking views and waterfalls by the handful in multiple locations! Our pilot was friendly and answered questions as well as pointing out the historical sites and well known areas. He also took care to find places we would not be able to see on the ground. Overall, we enjoyed our trip and the team!

It was a wonderful time. Napali Coast, Garden of the Gods, I was so happy to see it in front of my eyes.
It was so good to see the whole of Kauai. The pilot was nice for everything!! And we could see the rainbow on the tour and it was a perfect time.
If I come back to Kauai, I will also take an wingsoverkauai tour!!

Wir haben diesen Rundflug vor 6 Jahren schon einmal gemacht.

Wir können diese Tour mit Wings over Kauai nur empfehlen.
Es ist deutlich familiärer und angenehmer wie die Rundflüge in den Hubschraubern, jeder hat garantiert einen Fensterplatz und sieht alles perfekt.

Das Paradies von oben zu sehen macht hier am meisten Spaß.

Beim nächsten Besuch auf Kauai kommen wir sicher wieder.

Top!

review_title: Amazing experience, half the cost of a helicopter and none of the motion sickness
review_text:
One of us had been on a helicopter before and it was a sickening experience (literally) so we had ruled that out though we wanted to see Na Pali. Saw one of these planes and called them right away. They didn’t have any times available before our leave date but arranged a special trip just for us at no extra cost. A family run business, they were so flexible, and great at making my kids feel safe and special. The kids loved it!

And I got a ton of amazing photos, including the free family pic they provided.
What an amazing experience! Highly, highly recommend booking if you’re in Kauai. Bruce was so knowledgeable and funny and made the journey so entertaining. The views were spectacular!!

This is a family business and they make you feel like part of the family. They pick us up on time. They cover everything we needed to know before the flight. Captain Marcus gave great narration and made sure we saw everything and fun doing it. The whole experience was just outstanding. My grand children said this was the best thing they did in Hawaii and I agree.

I enjoyed our tour over Kauai.  The family run business took care of us.  Unpredictable weather on Kauai caused us to reschedule and we were able to get in the next day.  The flight was smooth and you could hear well with nice noise canceling headsets.

We initially booked this activity because we didn’t want to pay the expensive helicopter prices but this ended up being more than we could have every hoped for! They were extremely personal and professional and our 70 minute tour was stunning and informative. We really enjoyed the entire flight experience and we highly recommend it to anyone going to Kauai!

review_title: The most epic way to see the island.
review_text: Absolutely the best way possible to see the island. Captain Camron was an amazing tour guide,he had info on everything we were able to see. But the perfect amount not overwhelming. The flight was smooth as glass. Just absolutely left my wife and i in aw. The crew was extremely accommodating. We will 100% be back and fly with them again. Thanks guys And Aloha!!!

This was a beautiful, memorable experience.  Our pilot, Cameron, was very informative, knowledgeable, and took us to see some awesome sights of the island.  He circled back a few times, because we couldn’t quite see the waterfalls ( they were under us) or we wanted to get a better look.  There is no better way to see the whole island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and especially the NaPali coast than from the air.
Best experience while on the island!  Unforgettable!  Mahalo Cameron!

Bruce and his wife run a very professional & safe sightseeing flight business. The flight was relaxing  with SPECTACULAR views of the Na Pali coast and so many waterfalls!  Bruce is so knowledgeable about the Island and provided lots of fun facts. It was a wonderful way to view the Island and a great way to start our vacation with a sky view of Kauai's beauty.

review_title: Perfect way to see the island
review_text:
The visit and activity was perfect in every way.  The ride was comfortable and much Superior to a helicopter ride plus it was more economical
We were celebrating our 50th anniversary and couldn't have wish for a more perfect experience I would highly recommend this  to anyone interested in a pleasurable and rewarding and educational trip
This is the absolute best way to get a complete picture of how overwhelming and spectacular Kauai is. We would do it all over again!

Bruce was a fantastic pilot/guide. He was very knowledgeable about the area and made us all feel safe while he flew us around the island. The flight itself introduced my family to the many gorgeous but hard to get to places in the island. We will definitely be flying with Bruce again during our future visits to the island.

We wanted to see Kauai from the air but my mom was nervous about taking a helicopter as she can get motion sickness, so we decided to take a flight with Wings Over Kauai.

This was the best decision we made on our trip - the view was absolutely incredible (the Na Pali coast from the air had us speechless), our captain was so informed about everything we were seeing and answered all of our questions, and we felt so safe the entire time.  The flight was very smooth, and my mom really enjoyed it despite her nerves and was so glad we had booked it.

From a logistics perspective, we were picked up from our cruise ship dock exactly when they said we would be, and the trip to the airport was short and easy.  We then had a safety presentation and went up in the air! Very efficient operation. If you are on the fence, book it!! You won't regret it.

review_title: A great way to see Kauai!
review_text: We did this one-hour (ish) flight on our second day in Kauai. It was very well received by our 6 person extended family group (oldest 65, youngest 9). We went with Captain Marcus. He was great, giving an overview of Hawaiian history and geography and also was able to answer our questions about other activities such as snorkeling and hiking. We took up his advice to try a trail near where we were staying in Hanalei. Marcus has a mellow vibe and was good with young and old. He is a very experienced pilot and we all felt comfortable in his plane, the Air Van 1. Several of our family get motion sickness and there was a touch of it but it would have been worse in a helicopter so if you have that problem you should consider the airplane tour instead.

review_title: Better late than never! I did this 5.5 years ago and LOVED IT!
review_text:
It's Alyssa Jacey, the singer/songwriter you hosted on the private helicopter tour! I have been MEANING to review this and my only excuse is that I went on tour! I've opened for Bruno Mars, PEPPER, Andy Grammer, Lisa Loeb, Tavana and about 20 others! Anyway, enough about me. THIS TRIP WAS OUTSTANDING! I loved every second. It was so gorgeous, I felt very safe, they had a clean, comfortable heli...it was all wonderful. Not to mention their staff! LOVED them. So sweet, genuine...there was a lovely girl there at the time that hand drew me a map of the island...just to have! Anyway, I'll be coming back my next time to the island! I'll be on my 3rd tour in a year next month (June 7-19) to HNL. Visit Alyssa Jacey dot com for show details, maybe you can come to one of the nine?? 

To all considering Wings Over Kauai...stop hesitating and do it! You'll love it!

Sincerely,
~Alyssa Jacey

This was by far the best activity we had on our 10 day trip to Oahu and Kauai.  You cannot digest the amount of beauty we saw in just a little over an hour.
Pros:1- amazing staff, starting from Val, the nice lady who welcomed us to Markus our amazing pilot who not only pointed out to us all the interesting sights of Kauai but also answered all our questions 2- The plane is very comfortable and airy. 3- wide windows allowing for excellent viewing. 4- The plane tours the whole island, the helicopters only show you some of the island and don't get high enough.

The cons: I wish we had a video of our flight

We are a group of 6 ladies from all over who met in Hawaii yo celebrate 2 of our 50th birthdays.
We included Kauai on our itinerary to see the Na Pali trail only to discover it has been closed for over a year.
We looked into options to see it from the sea or air and founds these guys and are so glad we did. The price point was great cheaper than a helicopter and not so noisy.
Bruce was a lovely fella so calm and caring about those on our party who were motion sick.

Can’t recommend highly enough.

My daughter and I have just returned from a trip to Kauai. Since we both arrived in the dark and departed also late at night we didn't see any of the island as we arrived. We took this tour in combination with a catamaran tour. Everything about the adventure was excellent and worth the expense. All staff on both tours are knowledgeable and personable- you will love these tours.

Our ages ranged from 3 to 59 and we all enjoyed it! Kauai has magnificent scenery and this was an amazing way to see it and far less noisy than a helicopter! Captain Bruce was as knowledgeable as his website says and is an excellent pilot. He was engaging, humourous and our photos came out really well. Thank you, Wings over Kauai!

Had a first class trip with Marcus. Great pilot. Seems young for a pilot but he knew his stuff. Smooth flight, great views made tons of pictures. Would recommend this flight for everyone who wants to see the island from the air.

This was one of the most amazing things we have ever done! We saw the entire island, Wailua Ricer, Waimea Canyon, Na’pali coast (this had to be the highlight, it was spectacular) Our pilot Bruce was fab, very personable and told us so much about the island and spots which you may recognise from films. Val at the front desk was great too. 100% recommend this trip!!!

This  tour is extremely well-established, well managed and as informative as you will get.  Not only great sightseeing,  but super-informative about the island's history, flora and fauna.  Well worth it.

The Wings Over Kauai staff was so helpful from the start. Our first reservation was for the private air tour for 2 on a Cessna. That trip was cancelled so they rebooked us for the air van with 2 other guests on the next morning. It was a lucky change. The weather was perfectly clear. Best part of our flight besides the indescribable awesome beauty of the views, was our pilot Marcus. He was very knowledgeable about all aspects of the island. The flight was calm and smooth.
Marcus took time to spot whales and flew us over a mother whale with her calf and and an escort. Amazing! I highly recommend this company due to the excellent service from the staff. We will be back for a flight the next time!
Took the family on this flight tour back in December 2018. Great views, informative in-flight narrative,  friendly and competent pilot. We all enjoyed the activity.

review_title: Start your Kauai trip with flying with Wings
review_text: Chose this over helicopter tour.  Loved it. The pilot, Douglas was very nice. If you can, start with this flight when you are in Kauai so that you get the whole picture of the island before you explore places in the island.
This was a great experience, beautiful view and Marcus was so informative and pleasant. Could not ask for a better time. Val and he entire staff was so helpful and friendly. Its  a must do!!!

We had a fantastic experience with Wings over Kauai. Bruce is an excellent pilot and gave us a wonderful tour in the Cessna on a cloudy day. We were able to see all the main sights on the island and felt completely safe the whole time. At half the price of a helicopter tour, we enthusiastically recommend Wings over Kauai for those that want a pleasant and low-key experience to see this beautiful island. Bruce also gave us great recommendations of things to do on the island. Overall a wonderful experience!

My partner booked this flight tour as he originally wanted a flight with an instructor (he’s a qualified pilot) but these were fully booked. This turned out to work in our favour as it meant that he got to see so much more without having to concentrate on flying.
Our pilot was Bruce and he was an excellent tour guide in the four-seater Cessna. He was funny and warm and pointed out loads of interesting sights, including a shoal of fish in a bay, and various movie locations. When I mentioned that I liked Jurassic Park he made a point of showing us filming locations and even played the soundtrack at one point, which made us laugh. He’s also a very interesting person, and we enjoyed chatting with him throughout our flight.
I was worried that I would maybe get travel sick on the flight as I sometimes do when my partner’s flying but I was absolutely fine, thanks to flying in the morning when it was cooler. Snacks and drinks were provided but neither of us had any as we were so engrossed in the tour.
We were lucky with perfect blue skies and calm conditions and I actually felt like staying on the plane and doing the tour all over again, it was that good!
This really was a highlight of our trip, and we’d highly recommend it.

This company is very professional and we appreciated the fact that the day our flight was scheduled, the weather was not cooperating.  Knowing that I am a little afraid of bumps in the sky, they recommended we re-book and I am so glad we did.  Marcus was our pilot and gave us an amazing experience.  The flight was a smooth as glass and we even got to see a whale and her baby.  The scenery was beautiful.  Not sure if you can see the close ups of some of the canyons, but I would highly recommend this to anyone!

review_title: Nice Trips by Wings Over Kauai
review_text:
At last week of December 2018, we visited Kauai. We planned to view Kauai from sky during our trip. So, we booked “Wings Over Kauai” air plane trip. One of the purpose to select air trip is to view Na Pali coast of Kauai easily, which can be reached by two days trekking or by availing boat. We select Wings Over Kauai air plane trip instead of helicopter. Because, as far my idea goes, helicopter fly closely to the objects like hills and waterfalls. But, in this manner over all view will not available. Another important reason was in helicopter trip window seat is not guaranteed. Almost 50% of passenger will not get window seat. In my idea view will be much restricted if window seat is not available. But, air plane which is used by Wings Over Kauai is a six seaters plane and every seat have a big window.
We booked our trip on December 27, 2018. They prefer that customer should arrive half an hour before start time of flight. Though we were arrived in time other group of our flight became late due to traffic jam on road. But, the company wait for those tourist until they arrived, delaying departure of the flight (Though flight can be departed without those customers, and there was no chance of any loss of the company). It indicates they also care for their customers and not only the money.
Pilot of that flight was Mr. Bruce who was a very nice person and guided us very nicely throughout our tour. Weather was clear and our views from the aircraft was excellent. Mr. Bruce inform us continuously about the location over where the air crafts were flying. We enjoyed that tour very much. We noticed one thing that views are better from the windows other side of pilot seat. Due to orientation of the route followed by the air plane. Though sometimes Mr. Bruce rotate the air plane such that everyone could get the best views. Time of the flight was about one hour. We enjoyed our tour very much. If we plan to visit Kauai, we will avail this tour again.

review_title: Best way to see this beautiful island
review_text: Seeing all of the beauty Kauai has to offer is a challenge unless you go by air. After researching helicopters vs planes & then the best tour companies, we chose Wings over Kauai & are so glad we did. What an experience! Nick was a fantastic pilot & guide. This is a much less expensive alternative to taking a copter ride & our group felt it was just as good. We saw the Jurassic Park waterfall & (for those more experienced readers who can remember the show) the Fantasy Island waterfall (interject your de plane, de plane jokes here) among many other beautiful sites. If you want to see all the amazing views this island has to offer without breaking the bank to do it, book with these guys.

I scheduled this tour for my two adult boys during a visit to Kauai while on the NCL cruise.  My husband and I had visited the island previously and done a helicopter tour.  I wanted them to have the chance to see the highlights of the island, but was put off by the high cost of the cruise helicopter tour excursions.  I was reading TripAdvisor reviews to look at other options when I saw this flight.  Having past experience in small planes, it made sense to me that this might be a better and more enjoyable way to see the beauty of Kauai from the air.  And then I was pleasantly pleased to find out the cost is about half of the cost of a helicopter tour.  Both kids said this experience was the highlight of our whole vacation and the video/pictures they took are amazing.  One texted me "One of the coolest things I've ever done in my life" and he's traveled Europe.  They said the crew and staff were great -- friendly and informative.  And they felt completely safe while fllying.  A great choice for anyone wanting an air tour in Kauai.  Also, if coming in on a cruise, they pick up for free from a shop just a 10 minute walk from the pier.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text:
If you splurge on one thing in your trip to Kauai, it should be on this. The very best parts of the island are not accessible by road, and flying is the only way to see it. 
We flew with Captain Bruce on a Sunday afternoon. We were lucky to have gorgeous weather during the flight, but Bruce's commentary and knowledge raised the experience to another level. He kept us entertained and informed with various facts about the island, and his background score (of the Jurassic Park theme) when flying over parts of the island used for filming will give you goosebumps, its just like you're in the movie!
Overall, I would highly recommend Wings over Kauai, they are a small family run business, highly professional and provide a great, personalized experience. Plus they are much cheaper than the equivalent helicopter ride, with you seeing the same scenery!

Der Flug über Kauai hält, was die Werbung verspricht. Persönliche Tour in der Cessna mit nur 2 Personen. Tolle Aussicht auf Canyon und Napali Coast. Der Flug war ruhig ohne grosses Schaukeln und man ist ähnlich nach dran, wie im Helikopter, zahlt aber die Hälfte. Zum Schluss gibt es noch ein Überraschungsgeschenk. Wings over Kauai ist ein kleines Familienunternehmen mit langjähriger Erfahrung! Man spricht sogar etwas Deutsch.

Our family of 5 took the 1 hour island tour today with Doug and had a great experience.  The ride was smooth, Doug was an excellent pilot (take off and landing was not bumpy at all) and he had interesting facts and stories to share. I was hesitant to book a helicopter as I had felt sick after the last time, so we booked a flight instead. Despite my slight fear of flying in small planes and motion sickness tendencies, this trip exceeded expectations. I highly recommend this trip- you can’t see the whole island any other way.

review_title: Best way to check the Scenic island of Kauai
review_text: Got lucky to be the copilot for our flight. The ride was smooth and the weather was perfect without much clouds. Great value for a 60 minute plus flight tour of the Kauai island. Great service and a very experienced Pilot. Highly recommend it!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Air Van Tour
review_text:
It is wonderful trip to view beautiful island. 
Thank you for the pilot and staff. I think it is better than helicopter ride.

review_title: Cessna flght with Bruce over Kauai
review_text: The only way to truly appreciate the beauty of nature and the island's landscape is to see it from the above. My private plane ride with Bruce was an amazing experience as he knows how to highlight the most beautiful island's places. The hour long ride felt like 10 minutes as Bruce keeps you entertained with stories, guided explanations and a mock co-pilot engaging. Makes me want to re-watch the Jurassic Park, Pirates of the Caribbean and many other movies as this ride took me over the landscape's featured in those movies. Great overall experience.
I don't like helicopters and was happy to see this as a great option to view the beautiful island of Kauai! Helpful staff and very competent pilot! Would definitely recommend!

review_title: Great experience and views to be awed over.
review_text: Booked this company based on TripAdvisor reviews and was very happy with our decision.  Great customer service.  Our initial booking day proved to be very grey and dismal, lots of clouds, they offered to reschedule us to another day!  We gladly accepted.  Our check in and pilot, Captain Doug were great, personable people.   Flight was spectacular and narrated by Captain over headsets we all wore during the flight. Captain Doug's narrative of the Island was wonderful, very knowledgeable. Our pilot was highly experienced, comfortable flight and great landing. Would highly recommend this company if you are on the Island, worthy of the price.  The island is even more beautiful from the sky...verdant green!

We flew with Bruce on October 24, 2018. It was our first full day in Kauai. A must do. My husband cannot fly in helicopters so we decided to go on this flight in a Cessna. My husband had no problems what so ever with motion sickness. Just my husband, myself and the pilot. The scenery was amazing. Bruce was informative and entertaining. A very special way to see this beautiful Island.

Highlight of our trip! Decided to do this activity in Kauai over Maui as there is so much that can’t be seen by foot in Kauai. Since there were 4 of us, we all got to sit on the right side (when seated) for the best views as we traveled clockwise around the island. Still can’t get over the beautiful scenery and would recommend everyone to do this activity (and it’s more affordable than the helicopter tours). We really enjoyed the experience given by our captain, Marcus.

review_title: Nice views, easy to work with
review_text: We took the plane ride on 11/12/18 and enjoyed it.  Their confirmation email made it easy to find them, checking in was a breeze nd then we were off to it.  Doug was a very good and experienced pilot, very friendly.  The views are to die for.  I have not done any other planes/helicopters to know how close you get to the waterfalls and such.  Seems like we were quite a ways away but still great views.

We visited all four Hawaiian islands via a cruise ship but this flight with Marcus was the highlight of our trip.  We debated on the helicopter version but so glad we decided on this option.  The prices were better and we felt like we were able to see just as much.  The views were amazing and the entire staff was so wonderful to work with.  They made you feel very welcome and put everyone at ease.  Marcus was a wonderful tour guide up in the air describing everything we saw on land.  The scenery was incredible and will be a memory we will take with us forever.  My husband by chance got to sit in the copilot's seat and he was in heaven.  Seating placement is based on the weight of each passenger (no worries for you females because they don't disclose your weight when you hop on the scales) so he just happened to be the lucky winner of that seat.  Would highly recommend this adventure because both me and my husband thought this was the best thing we did while we were in Hawaii.

review_title: This is how you should see Kauai
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! We took the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and were treated like family. Capt. Bruce (he’s also Dr. Bruce, a retired research scientist!) and Val were very professional and took good care of us. We were unsure of this morning’s trip as the weather forecast was not looking good. Rain and clouds were about to roll in when we got to the airport. Val greeted us cheerfully, checked us in and went through the safety briefing with us thoroughly. I immediately knew that they took safety seriously. We then waited as we were early for our scheduled departure. It started to rain shortly thereafter and Bruce then called us into the office and showed us the big rain clouds over the Lihue & Hanalei area on the computer. He was very honest and told us that we will likely not have clear views over some areas. So he gave us a choice to reschedule, a refund or to go ahead with the tour (assuring us it was safe to do so). What an honest and professional business! We decided to go ahead and was prepared for a less than stellar experience. Boy, were we wrong! While it was cloudy, the sights were still wonderful as Bruce expertly navigated through the clouds and showed us the spectacular Na Pali Coast and the breathtaking Waimea Canyon. We had to turn around at Hanalei due to the storm clouds (again safety first!) while some other operators decided to go through the area. I knew this as I could hear all the chatter over the radio. A couple others did turn around and followed Bruce’s lead. He must be well respected by the flying community! We made it back to Lihue airport safely with full of wonderful memories. Thank you Bruce for your wonderful sense of humor and knowledge about the island. I enjoyed being your “co-pilot”!

review_title: A Different Place From the Air
review_text: We loved our air tour of the island with Wings Over Kauai.  We'd seen Waimea Canyon from the ground the day before; it was so nice to see it from the air.  We also saw our hotel, the biggest coffee plantation in Hawaii, the Na Pali coast, and the beautiful azure Pacific.  The views were absolutely amazing; a different perspective than anything you'll see from the ground.  Doug (our pilot) did a great job pointing out highlights.  We will definitely recommend this tour to any friends who visit Kauai.

Amazing experience, Marcus, our pilot, and Val were great. For those who are scared to fly on a small plane, It's better than a jumbo plane, take off and landing very, very smooth.
The scenery is breathtaking. Na Pali coast is a must must see when visiting Kauai, and the only way to understand the scale of this natural wonder is to see it from the air.
Guys, Thanks for the one-hour unforgettable experience.

We booked this tour after our catamaran trip was cancelled due to rough seas (we are here late October), and I am an extremely nervous flyer.  Let me tell you, firstly, the service was excellent.  The staff really cared that I was nervous and took every opportunity to make me comfortable, I so appreciated that.  As soon as we took off however - I had forgotten my nerves.  Holy wow.... Kaua'i, what a treasure.  Marcus was our guide, he was very knowledgeable and made us feel at home and comfortable straight away.  For those wanting to take images of Na Pali- I recommend you book the private tour - either on the cessna, or book out the entire air-van.  I can imagine if I was seated on the opposite side of the air-van, I wouldn't have had the unforgettable experience I had - we were lucky that the others booked in our tour did not show, and we had the air-van to ourselves.  From the beginning of the flight to the end, the scenery was like another world.  From lush green, untouched growth and waterfalls to the stunning Waimea Canyon, to the 5000ft vertical peaks of Na Pali and inner Kaua'i landscape beyond, it is truly a life changing experience to see.   When we landed, I wanted to get back in and do it again, and to top it all off, our amazing pilot played music from Skyrim when we entered the Na Pali area - LIFE MADE!  Don't hesitate, just book in!!!

review_title: Best Plane Tour on the island !
review_text:
We LOVED our tour over Kauai ! We were there during our honeymoon last weekend and had a blast ! Our captain's name was Doug and he was AWESOME !! Very professional, very fun and outgoing and gave us great information about the island and everything that we were seeing while up in the air ! I highly recommend this company, this was pretty much the highlight of our trip. Thanks Gina and Captain Doug. 
P.s. Doug thanks for making me the Co-Pilot of the flight, best seat in the house 😁
From Celeste & Emil

review_title: Das Beste, dass wir auf Hawaii gemacht haben
review_text: Wir sind am Morgen um 9:30h geflogen. Sicht war perfekt mit blauem Himmel. Haben der Eindruck je früher desto besser ? Es war vom Anfang bis Ende perfekt. Sehr sympathischer und warmherziger Check-in durch Gina. Super Flugzeug, komfortabel und im besten Zustand.. Wunderschöner Flug über Kaui ( die gewählte Route ist perfekt) mit sehr interessante Kommentare durch Captain Doug. Kaui ist einfach ein Paradies . Der Ausmass dieser unberühmten Natur kann nur von Oben wahrgenommen werden. Wir fanden diesen Flug mit diesem Flugzeug besser als unser Flug mit Helikopter über Big Island vielleicht weil man höher fliegt

Nach einer sehr freundlichen Einführung von Val nahm uns Marcus in Empfang und erklärte uns während des Fluges alle wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Er sparte auch micht mit Zusatzinformationen und beantwortete alle unsere Fragen. 
Der Flug dauerte nahezu eine Stunde und es war einfach, gute Fotos zu machen, da jeder einen Fensterplatz hatte. 
Ausserdem war der Preis unschlagbar und im Internet auch von Anfang an fair mit allen Kosten und Steuern angegeben (ganz im Gegensatz zu IslandHelicopters, deren Internet-Preis Von 145USD auf 187USD im Office wg Fuel-Zuschlag, Taxes and fees stieg)
Zum Abschluss bekamen wir noch eine CD mit der Musik, die wir während des Fluges gehört hatten.
Ein rundherum gelungenes Event. Wir fühlten uns gut aufgehoben und können Wings ofver Kaua’i uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

review_title: Great tour for a great price!
review_text: We were very happy with our Wings Over Kauai Sightseeing flight! The staff were all super friendly and helpful and we even met the owner, who gave us a nice list of recommendations on the island. The scenery on this island is incredible, and our plane tour gave us a good view of pretty much everywhere! Our pilot, Captain Doug, was great! And the price for this tour is pretty unbeatable! Way cheaper than a helicopter tour, and a longer flight too. You can't get as close to the waterfalls as in a helicopter, but it is much easier to get nice photos from a plane than from the glare-y, curved windows on a helicopter. If you are on Kauai and want an amazing birds-eye view of the island, please check out this company!!

Excitement to see the raw natural scenery that Hawaii offers. Was surprised at what you could see from the skies. Little cloudy over Jurrasic falls. Enjoyed with friends. Id highly recommend taking to the heavens to see Kauai when the sunshine lights up a rainbow. The pilot made us very welcome. Jan 2015 was when our exploration of the 4 islands began. Loved each island and what they have to offer.

We’ve never seen Hawaii until we saw it from the air.  The pilot was amazing.  The staff friendly and accommodating.  The ride was so smooth, I didn’t have any motion sickness that I normally experience.

Such a cool experience!  You see the whole island, check out sites from various movies and learn about the history of Kauai.  Captain Doug was awesome.  Motion sickness is possible, but they have water, ginger snacks and other helpful aids ready to go.  The flight was at least an hour, so definitely worth the price tag.  Such a neat way to take in the island.  Definitely book ahead of time!

review_title: A great tour and a great company
review_text: We are so happy we took this tour! The person who checked us in, Val, was super friendly and smiling. Our pilot Marcus was also very nice and flew us over the entire island with great confidence and skill. When we flew over the Na Pali coast the view was so breathtaking I almost teared up! The entire experience was wonderful. This is so much better than a helicopter ride, the windows are bigger, everyone has a view and there is much less noise. We recommend this company 100% and would certainly take the tour again if we come back to Kauai. Mahalo!

What an amazing way to see the island. Our captain Marcus did an awesome job of giving us the detailed history of Kauai as well as hitting us with loads of factoids about each and every crevice. Get to see the island from a whole different perspective. Also had various island and movie music playing through headsets during the hour long tour. Amazing views of na’pali coast, Waimea canyon, Waimea falls, coffee fields etc. the airbus was great with its bubbled windows for pictures, they even had ginger treats, cold towels and drinks on flight for those who get motion sick. Couldn’t imagine coming to Kauai and not doing this.  For those who do get motion sick - can be a little bumpy at times, but also make it really energizing and exhilarating.

Thank you for a very memorable and awesome flight. We booked this for our 25 th wedding anniversary and we were not dissapointed. Booking on line went well, they kept us up to date on the booking and pre flight info was thorough. Our pilot did a fantastic job, steady flight, plenty of time to see all the sights and the commentary was very informative. We had a great time thank you

What a wonderful experience.  Circumnavigating the beautiful island of Kauai from the air.  Our pilot Marcus was capable and confident and provided an insightful commentary during the 65 minute flight.  He was ably supported by the ground crew, Val and Bruce.  A most enjoyable experience and well worth doing.

First thing we did on our first day in Kauia was to ride this small seater plane. Pilot was excellent, felt very safe and secure with him. Extremely smooth ride (only encounter turbulence once and he handled it like a pro). Best way to view this magnificent island is by air. You get a larger glimpse of the beauty. Helicopters get closer but not necessarily capture the whole perspective (not to mention the risk of dizziness with their swinging movements.) Plane trip felt relaxed and mesmerizing. The Napali coast line and the numerous waterfalls to observe on this trip were spectacular. The cost was very economical considering the once in a lifetime views and the memories that you will forever keep with you. Front desk staff friendly and the flight left on time. We had the plane all to ourselves so we got special attention. Go ahead and book this tour now... you will be you did.. if you don't.. you will regret this once in a lifetime opportunity

There is no better way to see Kauai than from the air! This was my first trip to this island but this tour was one that was highly recommended and our group of 3 was not dissapointed! The staff and our pilot were very professional and knowledgeable about all the sights to be seen and the history of the island.

We thoroughly enjoyed our airplane tour of Kauai. We flew in a Cessna, 2 seater plane. There was an amazing view of the mountains, valleys, waterfalls, beaches, and the Napali coastline. We took a lot of wonderful photos. Wings Over Kauai was a great company to work with. They were very caring and helpful. I would highly recommend them for an aerial view of Kauai.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the island
review_text:
Plane vs. Helicopter seems to be a matter of thrill vs. camera shots. In the plane, it seems you can get better camera shots because you are further away from everything, but we saw helicopters underneath us who could go quite close to the waterfalls and craters, etc. I imagine it would be awesome to experience but even more difficult to capture. If money were no issue, I might opt for the helicopter but I have no regrets on our plane experience. 
My friend and I booked the slightly larger plane because we wanted the bubble windows for better visibility. Unfortunately because there were not four of us, they called us to switch to the private jet, which I was a bit bummed about due to less window visibility (which they at least admitted) even though they didn't charge extra. Regardless, views were nicer on the side than I was worried we'd get (if you're short, it is hard to see out the front even as co-pilot). Doug was super calm and very friendly, which helps if you get altitude sickness (so do their ginger candies and water). Getting there 30min early seemed unnecessary since they didn't see us til 10 min before, yet again were very friendly. Overall would highly recommend seeing Kauai by air, whatever way it is that best works for you and your schedule/budget.

review_title: Private Cessna is the only way to fly!
review_text:
We decided to splurge during our visit to Kauai and booked a private flight on Wings Over Kauai's Cessna 172.  It was a bit more expensive than the group flight on the Caravan, but so worth it.  Imagine having your own private chauffeured hour to fly around the island!
 
We were warmly welcomed to the flightline by Val.  She took our information and gave us a quick rundown of what to expect during our flight.  She also discreetly weighed us 
to ensure the weight and balance is set up properly for the flight.

We met Captain Bruce and after introductions were made all around, we all walked out to the plane.  So much nicer than boarding a commercial flight.  Yeah, the plane was smaller but no one was fighting you for overhead bin space! As an #AvGeek (read "plane nerd!") I called shotgun and my wife was nice enough to indulge me.  Bruce also teaches flying, so he took the time to explain flight dynamics and how the airplane respond to different inputs.  We both worked the pre-flight takeoff list and after waiting for a Hawaiian Airlines 717 to land and vacate the runway, we were off.

It was a beautiful day for flying.  Puffy white clouds dotted the sky and visibility was forever.  Mt. Waiʻaleʻale was almost totally visible, which is vary rare!  Bruce kept up a running commentary was we overflew Poipu Beach, the Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, then across Hanalei Bay and back down towards Lihue.  When we were halfway through our flight, my wife commenced the drink service with bottles and cans from the cooler under the back seat!

We were thrilled with our choice of Wings Over Kauai.  We highly recommend the private Cessna flight for a group of 2 or 3 people.  Even if you take the group flight on the Caravan, seeing the island from the air is a fantastic trip and should be considered a "Must Do!" during your visit to the Kauai.
Couldn't have asked for anything better from this company. Friendly staff, the pilot had lots of information for us, was a genuine nice guy. Great tour!

What a great day of sightseeing. Everyone was great to us, and o my what a great day to fly with Marcus. Explained in detail every site we flew over. We had our 2 grandkids with us for their first time on the island. We also purchased the in flight video of our flight. Would highly recommend them for any of your future flights over this island.

review_title: Simply fantastic -  Affordable and high quality
review_text:
We chose to fly as a private tour. 

Gina and Captain Bruce took great care of us. 

Gina make checking in for the flight easy and Bruce, (pilot) put us at ease explaining everything we had questions about and ensuring we were comfortable.

The flight itself was exciting and generally smooth. The views were priceless of course and taking this particular option, meant we both had an uninterrupted view. Bruce's local knowledge added to the tour also.

Bottom line would I recommend this option to see Kauai?

A clear yes. 

Bang for buck (price) is unbeatable.
The ability and ease to take photos, especially for the person sitting in the back seat is excellent. (no competition for window seats as you are guaranteed one).
Time is the air is generous.

This was a fantastic way to get an appreciation of the Island.

Many thanks Gina & Bruce for a fantastic experience.

Jack

We had booked this trip as the highlight of our Kauai stay and were not disappointed.  The pilot Marcus was polite and very informative.   We mostly gazed at the beautiful island, completely awestruck. The journey was a good hour long and so we really felt we had our money's worth.

Flying over Kauai is the only way to get a true picture of how stunning the island is from every viewpoint. We had a great flight and Captain Marcus answered our questions and showed us the highlights. Also, funny enough, he's from southern Minnesota and we were visting from the Twin Cities in Minnesota. Small world. I'd recommend a tour - it was a wonderful experience at a reasonable price.

Once again Wings Over Kauai was the BEST ever---anywhere!  Captain Doug has this tour mastered in the Cessna for 2. This was a repeat tour for us (toured with Capt. Bruce 6 years ago) and the first thing we booked when we knew we were returning to Kauai.  This time we saw the Na'Pali Coast 3 times---but by air was the best!  The whole island is so so beautiful and peaceful!   Val and Doug are super additions to the Wings family (O'hana!)  Mahalo for a funtastic adventure--again!

Der Rundflug war ein Geschenk von meinen Kumpels zu meinem Geburtstag. Was soll ich sagen außer WOW!!! Für alle die mal in Kauai sind und das nötige Kleingeld haben kann ich nur raten das auch zu machen. Bruce und seine Crew sind super nett und Bruce hat sehr viel Fachwissen über Kauai. Es war ein unvergesslicher Flug den ich jederzeit wieder machen würde. Ich vermisse Hawaii und seine schönen Ecken.

Danke Bruce für diesen unvergesslichen Trip!
This was a great experience and fantastic way to view the island! Friendly folks greet you and make the flight fun. I would highly recommend!

review_title: Best part of my 15 day Hawaii cruise on Princess
review_text:
My son wants to be a pilot and just happen to mention this to lady who took my reservation over the phone 2 months prior us to going there. They gave me an option to cancel as the weather was not great but we decided to go since we spent time getting there. They allowed my son to go in any fly side by side with the pilot which my was awesome! The weather wound  up clearing up and this was the best part of my Hawaii trip. I have bad feet and can't to any excursions that require hiking or difficulty.   This made my entire Hawaii trip great, would highly recommend for everyone!
.

I have done many of these type tours and this was one of the best.
the pilot was great . the plane ride was smooth and there was great seating.
The sites were amazing and i would highly recommend this company

It's something you should never miss in Kauai. Seeing all the island from the sky is something absolutely unforgettable. And while you have such a nature miracle in front of you, Doug explains you everything, and kindly answers all your questions. For me, that I grew up with jurassic Park, that I felt in love with diving many years ago, all this was absolutely the most wonderful thing I have ever seen. Thank you SO MUCH Doug and Ellen for your kindness - also with my little daughter-, for let our dream come true. If you come to Tuscany contact us!!!

review_title: Don’t miss this!  Worth every penny!
review_text:
You just can’t imagine the beauty of the island till you see it like this, a totally different perspective.
Well worth the money!
Very professional and friendly service.

I’m a large lady and did not have to pay extra that I would have had to, if I took a helicopter.

It’s not fun to get weighed but it was a very discrete process.

There is a surprise at the end, but don’t want to spoil it for you!

Go, you won’t be sorry!

This was in my top two favorite things that my family of four did while we were in Kauai (and we managed to do a LOT.) Every single thing about this tour, from check in to departure, was just great. Val checked us in, and she was friendly, efficient, and funny. Our pilot, Marcus, was perfect. He made us feel welcome and safe and did a great job narrating our trip and answering our many questions. He even provided a soundtrack during the flight which added so much. As I said, we really packed it all in on this vacation and viewed the island by boat, air, and trails. The aerial vantage point is a fantastic way to visualize the (almost) entire island, and it really complimented our other adventures on Kauai. Seriously, just do this tour. It is money well spent.

This is a fantastic way to see Kauai and especially the Napali Coast and the waterfalls.  Our family of six loved this airplane ride.  This is definitely the highlight of our trip!  And Val and Captain Marcus were fabulous and so friendly. The special gift at the end of the air tour was a nice touch.  The kids and my parents all enjoyed this air tour!  Definitely a great way to spend our vacation time.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Amazing Impressions from the Landscape, great pilot and much background information
review_text:
Martina and I spend a few days on Kauai. We choose a flight by a small plane, because we wanted a private experience. Long story in short: It was fantastic. We had great views of the entire island. Bruce, our captain introduced us very dedicated.

Mahalo, Bruce!!!

We would recommend this experience to everyone especially our best friends.
We appriciated it.

Good Luck to all of U at "Wings over Kauai" and thank you again for your hospitality.
Josef

My wife and I booked the flight around Kauai with Wings over Kauai. Everything from start to finish was fantastic. Val checked us in and gave us the low down on what to expect. Our pilot Bruce was so friendly and accommodating on the flight. My wife sat in the co-pilot seat and got to help with the pre-flight check. The ride was smooth and spectacular. Bruce filled us in on all kinds of local landmarks and history during the flight. We couldn't have been more pleased. I highly recommend, you won't be disappointed.

Four of us took this sightseeing flight in April 2018. Ellen, Bruce and Doug (our pilot) were all so nice. Our flight over Kauai was awesome! The sights, falls, and canyons left us amazed! Doug was very informative and professional. We highly recommend this excursion.

This is an absolute MUST!  You get to see everything, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, coffee fields, all the middle of the island, mountain tops, coasts, Napali Coast (ABSOLUTELY STUNNING)!  DO NOT LEAVE KAUAI WITHOUT SEEING NAPALI COAST!  We didn't have the 7 hour super cruise planned, but after we saw Napali Coast with WINGS OVER KAUAI, we knew it was a must as well!

review_title: Best flight tour of the island!
review_text:
This is the best way to see Kauai, with a birds eye view of it's magnificent cliffs and waterfalls, and breathtaking coastline! Ellen and captain Bruce were so warm and friendly, and went above and beyond to take such good care of us. They gave us a safety briefing before we stepped on board and took some pics in front of the plane. 
Bruce is an amazing pilot, and has a lot of knowledge about the island and some great commentary. The aircraft was roomier than I imagined, and although we encountered some rough weather in some parts, Bruce managed to keep the ride as smooth as possible. The windows are large and every seat is a window seat. The landing was the BEST I've ever experienced, I didn't even realize we had touched down.
In short, we got some spectacular views of the island at half the price of helicopter tours, and this is a must do if you want to experience the true beauty of Kauai!
The staff was outstanding with incredible service! The pilot did an awesome job giving us a tour of the island! The views were incredibly breath taking!

Amazing tour,better than our helicopter tour as everyone gets a window seat. Marcus was wonderful as our pilot and was very knowledgeable regarding the beautiful surroundings. 
Front office lady was very welcoming,  made it easy to book, locate the place, describe where we were going and provided us a free picture with soundtrack of our trip without even asking. One of our favorite things we did on our trip, would highly recommend.

Just returned from a spectacular flight around Kauai. It was a bit cloudy in spots but that's to be expected in the wettest place in the world.

The entire experience was flawless. Everyone we dealt with was very nice. Doug was obviously an experienced pilot who was very comfortable in a small plane (must be all that Canadian flying he did :)) He provided great commentary and local knowledge. 

We debated between a helicopter and the plane. The helicopter would have been three times the cost. The plane was definitely the way to go if cost is at all a factor in your decision. 

We loved the flight and thanks. Remember to say hi to Doug's pup.
We would book it again. Excellente tour and learn a lot about the island. In the end there was a video with its own photo.

review_title: Amazing Experience from start to finish!
review_text: I have done the helicopter tours a couple times but I was on Kauai with my wife on this trip and she has a bit of a weak stomach so we chose the plane experience instead. Granted you cannot hover next to a waterfall but this experience is still worth it and it's more affordable.
