This pilot Marcus was an outstanding guide and we had a beautiful clear day to fly around the island of Kauai.  It was an amazing flight and experience for the senses.  I challenge anyone to look out the window and not see a waterfall.  I would strongly recommend the airplane tours for families and couples with small children who can appreciate the views.  Unforgettable!

review_title: Great Way to See Kauai from the Air
review_text:
Prior to arriving in Kauai, my wife and I decided to take an aerial tour of Kauai. After researching various companies, both fixed wing and helicopter, we decided to fly with Wings Over Kauai, and this tour was absolutely spectacular!
After checking in with Val, and going over the safety instructions, we were introduced to our pilot Marcus. He is thoroughly professional, but his professionalism is balanced out with a friendly and warm personality.
Once we were in the air, he conversed with us throughout the entire tour, and pointed out landmarks along the way. This is a great way to see the Island from up above, and it is a beauty to behold!
My wife and I highly recommend Marcus, and Wings Over Kauai!
Great experience. Easy to book. They picked us up (last minute) from our cruise ship so we did not have to rent a car. Pilot very friendly and knowledgeable.

My wife and I took the Cessna flight for 2 back in February and it was simply amazing.  We were scheduled on a day that it was pouring down rain and there were lots of clouds but we showed up anyways spoke to Bruce the owner who was super nice and immediately gave us the option for a refund or to try and reschedule the next day.  Bruce said they didn't want to take anyone up when all they would see is clouds which we appreciated and the fact that they offered the refund and not automatically rescheduling which could potentially interfere with other planned activities.  My wife and I chose to reschedule the next day.  Our pilot that day was Doug and he was very friendly and knowledgeable about the island.  The flight was awesome and I probably took about 300 pictures in an hour long flight.  If we were to go back to Kauai we'd probably take the tour again!

My wife and I booked in for the private tour of the island and loved every minute of it. Our Pilot, Bruce, was incredibly knowledgeable of the island, a lot of fun, sharing funny anecdotes and an excellent pilot in somewhat tricky conditions. Words can't describe how good the views were from up there. The customer service was excellent. Bruce even gave us a list of things to see & do as well as some of his favourite places to eat on the island. Can not thank Bruce enough for a truly memorable experience.

review_title: Warm welcome and great views; a family-friendly flight
review_text: We took a flight in Cessna as a small family (2 adults, 2 small kids - 0 and 5 years old) and can only recommend this option for families. Doug was a great pilot and had very good recommendations about other things to do while staying on Kaua'i.

Wings Over Kauai sightseeing flight was an excellent way of seeing Kauai.  Doug's narration and tour was very professional and enjoyable.  I was concerned before the flight since I have a tendency to have motion sickness.  Doug was aware of this and did a great job in keeping the plane at an even keel.  I would definitely recommend this excursion.

Three couples booked in advance, woke up to overcast skies but was reassured once we got to the airport  that our pilot wouldn’t take us unless it was clear skies for our optimum vision. We were in the 6 passenger plane with each one of us having our own window so no problem seeing out. 
 Marcus was our pilot, very knowledgeable about the island and it’s landmarks/activities. He made us very comfortable from the very start. Flight was smooth from start to finish and the sights were unbelievable! All in our group can’t say enough good things about this tour. An absolute MUST. Kauai is truly the most beautiful island and to experience it from this vantage point  for such a good price, is something everyone should do. 
We paid the $50 for the video montage they put together which we haven’t received as of yet ( 2 weeks later ) They are suppose to email to me. I can’t wait to see what it captured. Saves you from taking pictures so you can enjoy the moment. 
Highly recommend. Thank you Marcus for an incredible ride

review_title: Four of us, had an awesome flight
review_text: The four of us really enjoyed the flight around Kauai in the Air Van. Compared to some of the other small planes that I have flown in this plane gives a good amount of room and comfort for the passengers. Every on had a window seat! Marcus did a very good job with the tour, answering questions, and sharing his experiences.

review_title: Best way to see the island!
review_text: My wife and I were scheduled for a morning fight which needed to be cancelled because of some bad weather but Bruce and his team worked with us and moved some things around so that we could go the following day. We took the smaller Cessna 172 flight and enjoyed every minute of it. The flight let’s you see all around the island and gives a very different perspective. Highly recommend! Also, it’s around half the cost of the helicopter tours so it won’t break the bank!

review_title: One of the greatest excursions I've ever done!!
review_text:
One of the greatest excursions I've ever done and probably will ever do! We were visiting Kauai for a few days after Maui, and booked the sightseeing flight tour with Wings Over Kauai as our first stop after we arrived at the airport. I highly recommend planning this as the first thing you do on Kauai, because you get a birds eye view of the entire island before you start exploring it by land. It was truly fascinating to see how diverse the different regions of the island are; lush forests/waterfalls, beautiful coastline beaches & mountainous cliffs. 

This is a family run business and they went above and beyond to take such good care of us. Mary and Captain Bruce were some of the kindest people we've ever met, truly care about their customer's experience, and made it clear why they love the island so much. They were extremely knowledgeable about Kauai, both local recommendations and about its rich history. 

I was initially a little anxious about flying in a small plane, but felt extremely safe and comfortable with Captain Bruce and the smooth ride from take off to landing. He even gave us clearer views of humpback whales from the air than we got from our whale-watching tour by boat days later. He also pointed out a bunch of different movie set locations and flew low enough for exceptional views of the Waimea Canyon! 

My boyfriend is a Jurassic Park fanatic, so watching him in awe of the Jurassic Park waterfall, as the Cap'n played the Jurassic Park theme song in our headsets, was priceless. Extremely worth the price and I'd highly recommend over a helicopter tour, especially for anyone a little anxious about flying.

Travel is my passion and I can safely say this is an excursion on the top of my list and a MUST DO experience. Thanks Wings Over Kauai! We can't wait to come back some day!

This company is great! Great customer service checking us in and getting us weighed in for the flight. The pilot really knew his stuff as he flew us around the island of Kauai and up and over the mountains. He pointed out all of the sights from waterfalls, farms, and plantations, up to blow holes, whales, and parks we would want to drive to. Do this early in your stay and you will know where you want to spend more time at later in your vacation.

review_title: This is the way to see Kauai!
review_text: We debated between the helicopter or the plane. (In fair disclosure, my hubby is a private pilot so we look for specific things that the average person might not think about). We were a bit leary about the helicopter rides because the reviews said there were some crazy experiences with weather (some are flying while others are not, etc). One big disadvantage was that we heard over and over that sometimes you were in the middle and didn't get a good seat or view and also that if all the seats weren't full, they didn't go out. So after looking at all the options, we decided to go with a plane. We called several companies and decided on Wings over Kauai. We were not disappointed. Doug was our pilot. He had a calm demeanor, he was friendly and had lots of experience, not just in Hawaii, but Alaska (one of the most difficult places to fly) and other places. Doug told us all about the island of Kauai while we flew over it and all around it. It was a great day to fly, calm winds and mostly sunny skies. We enjoyed the trip very much and would recommend it to anyone visiting Kauai.

We had scheduled a flight seeing tour in January, the weather looked iffy, but we were told we had to come to the airport as only the pilot could decide if the flight was cancelled.  This the 4 of us in our party did, and were told that the flight conditions were poor, the only thing we would be able to see would be beaches instead of the most scenic area, so the flight was cancelled.  We rescheduled for two days later.  That day it was rainy and windy all day.  We called and were told we had to come to the airport or we would be charged for the tour. When we arrived at the airport, the office was closed and nobody was in sight.  We phoned and the person who answered apologized, saying that someone was supposed to talk with us, and that in retrospect, they should have cancelled the tour.  We wasted most of a day waiting for the 2:30 flight and were very disappointed with the way this company does business.

review_title: We'd do it again in a heartbeat!
review_text: My wife and I took the Cessna flight with Doug as our pilot on Feb 10.  We had originally booked for the previous Monday, but due to terrible weather, Bruce and Ellen dissuaded us.  The day could not have been better...sunny and just a little wind for the 2:00 flight.  The scenery that you see from the air is simply STUNNING!  Because of the rough winter sea, you can only see the Napali Coast from the air.  There are lots of choices for flights, but after all our research, this was the best choice.  It was a nice, calm flight with nice Hawaiian music and sights pointed out all along the way.  (I now know where Puff lived!  LOL)  Everyone at "Wings" is wonderful, polite and care about your flight.  Perfect right up to the very soft landing and the nice touch parting gift!  Thanks to Ellen, Bruce, Katy and, especially Doug!!  Mahalo nui!!

We flew with Doug in the Cessna and it was fantastic.  The views were amazing and there wasn't a single minute of waiting to see something great...it was all great. Doug is a very experience pilot and the flight, take off, and landing were smooth.

review_title: Safe & Competent Operator; Stunning & Unforgettable Scenery
review_text: Kauai really can only be appreciated in its entirety from the air.  Ellen's "Wings Over Kauai" accomplishes the mission with safety, competence, and a keen appreciation for the customer's/passenger's perspective. Every aspect of the operation is run in a timely, efficient, and safe manner. The scenic highlights, running narrative, and even the background audio music, makes for a memorable ride. As a career aviator myself I was looking for subtle signs of safety and regulatory compliance and found the operation completely satisfactory.  Cheaper than a helicopter tour, but just as thorough - fully recommended.

The view was spectacular. Marcus, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and caring. We finally got to take the trip on the third try, the other two cancelled because of weather.  We weren’t able to cover all that was included in the flight because of weather conditions but we still got to see awesome waterfalls and scenery,  

The customer service for this company far exceeded our expectations. We were offered a full refund or reschedule for another day.  Due to the weather conditions we weren’t able to do the whole trip and they offered a partial refund. Excellent and very fair.

Une experience superbe ! un très bon accueil aussi ! Nous étions dans le "Air Van 1" avec Doug notre pilote. Le vol a duré 65 minutes, nous avions un casque avec de la musique hawaiienne. Les paysages sont vraiment magnifiques, l'avion ne bouge pas trop pour ceux qui appréhendent :) 
Le meilleur moment pour nous était lorsque nous survolions les falaises de Jurassic Park avec la musique du film !! quelle émotion ! au top
A la fin, nous avons eu un CD des musiques hawaiiennes avec notre photo en couverture devant l'avion, super souvenir !

My wife and I had a fantastic flight with Bruce this afternoon over Kauai! Bruce is an excellent pilot and knows the island very well. He provided excellent commentary as we made our flight over and around the island, seeing many beautiful waterfalls, some of which can only be seen from the air. I highly recommend that you spend an hour in Bruce’s Cessna!

On a 28 day cruise to Hawaii, Tahiti, Bora Bora, Pago Pago, and Moorea. We booked this tour with others from our Cruise Critic roll call. We were picked up by the operators and informed that due to extreme winds we wouldn't be able to do the entire tour as it wasn't safe to go over Waimea Canyon. We were offered the choice of taking the tour anyway or receiving a full refund. We all (4 of us) decided to go ahead with the flight and were very happy we did.

Absolutely beautiful and stunning scenery and we even ended up with a rainbow below us.

Bad weather prevented us from going to certain areas and Bruce offered a full refund if we didn't want to go.....very fair and honest businessman. We decided to go, and we are SOOOOOO happy we did. Bruce is a super safe pilot and took us to see so much. He is personable and accomodating. The flight was smooth and we were able to have an amazing flight even with the weather issues.  We would DEFiNITELY do this again with Wings Over Kauai and recommend it very highly.

I can't say enough good things about the experience and the people at Wings over Kauai.
Efficient from sending us an email reminder about our reservation a day in advance and with the details about the time and pick up location.
Ellen picked us up in a mini-van, just around the corner from the cruise port and took us to the airport, where Katie briefed us on the flight plan and, just in case, gave us ginger candy in the event of air sickness (never happened). The friendliness and the courtesy were incredible.
My wife and I flew on the smaller Cessna with Doug as our pilot, who was terrific. Clear descriptions, smooth flying and he answered all our questions.
After landing, we were given the choice of returning directly to our ship or be dropped off at the shopping center to spend some more time in town. At the end of the flight, we were presented with a CD with our picture on it and the plane on the background; unexpected!
Great experience and more private and cost effective than the helicopter ride.
Highly recommended

Had a wonderful flight with Doug. Most of the helicopter tours were outside my price range, so I chose this instead, and am glad I did -  it was a wonderful end to my trip and an excellent value! Great views of all the highlights of the island (including a few quick detours for whale spotting!), and friendly staff. Doug was personable and knowledgeable, and I felt completely safe throughout the experience. Highly recommended.

review_title: The only way to see Kauai!!
review_text: A flight with Wings over Hawaii is a must for any visit to the island. Bruce, our pilot, was very friendly, knowledgable, and an outstanding instructor pilot. You can fly in the larger six place airplane or take an instructional flight in the 172.  I got to fly while he handled the radios and pointed out sites around the island.  It was a much better, cheaper and safer experience then the multiple helicopter tours you could do. A definite must!

review_title: Superb sights and instruction over Kauai
review_text: As a low time, out of practice private pilot, I signed up for an hour instruction with Wings Over Kauai and took my son along as a passenger.  It was glorious:  excellent views, careful and thoughtful instruction, and great ambience over all.  I strongly recommend this approach to seeing the island from the air (whether as instruction or just a sightseeing flight).  Would be great for all ages.

I sent my parents on this sightseeing flight to celebrate their 50th wedding anniversary. My mother tends to get motion sick, so I choose this trip over a helicopter, as I had read it was more smooth. My parents loved it! No motion sickness, the views were amazing and they loved all of the information they received from Captain Doug.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai with Captain Bruce
review_text:
Our flight was back in November but we are just getting around to writing a review now.
First off I want to thank for Wings Over Kauai team for such an awesome experience. I am a private pilot in Canada and we were lucky enough to fly with Captain Bruce. He offered some awesome pointers and the tour was top notch. Bruce also gave us recommendations on what to do while we were on the island. We almost did all of them and they were all amazing. 
Hopefully we can come back and fly with you again soon!

This was my 3rd flight with Wings Over Kauai. As Always, the flight was wonderful. You can read my previous reviews which reflect the same as this one. EXCELLENT tour and personnel. 
This year I took my girlfriend and she had a wonderful time. From the Front Desk, the pilot and finally meeting Ellen, the tour and time there was GREAT. I don't like wasting my time nor my money and I promise you that you will LOVE this tour. This IS the BEST tour on the island. Best Wishes in 2018 to Bruce, Ellen and all the WOK  family.

What an amazing experience! My family, including an adult son who is a private pilot,
took this flight. From the time we met Bruce, the owner, until we completed the flight with Doug, we were blown away. We flew on a gorgeous, clear day and were able to see everything including clear views of Waimea Canyon. Doug was very knowledgeable, accommodating and made us feel safe at all times. What a way to begin our vacation! Do not miss this once in a lifetime experience!

After hearing about our daughter's plans to be married on 
Shipwreck Beach the next day, Bruce and Doug volunteered to take and forward aerial photos of the wedding as they passed over the beach. Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate and my daughter was married in a local church! What a thoughtful and generous gesture by Doug and Bruce!

My wife and I took the tour in the small 4 seater plane and flew over most of the Island.  The views are quit amazing.  Unfortunately there was some heavy cloud cover in some of the valleys.  The pilot has little control of the weather and Kauai gets a tremendous amount of rain each year.  I would do it again.

Have you ever wanted to fly a plane?   How about fly a plane over a tropical island?   Then this is your chance to have a once in a lifetime experience with Bruce calmly guiding you through the magic of flight.    The cost of doing this is incredibly low compared to other air tours and totally worth it.   What an amazing way to see the island!  I can't wait to do this again!

My wife and I visited Kauai for our 40th anniversary.  Prior to going one of my friends had shared with me that he had flown with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai while visiting Kauai. During his visit he took several flights with Bruce and raved about the experience.   As a long time pilot I wanted to have the opportunity to fly in Kauai.  We arrived about 30 minutes prior to the flight and had a chance to chat with the staff who were great.  The flight was wonderful- Bruce is a super experienced flight instructor and guide.  We had a blast and would highly recommend Wings over Kauai to all that visit Kauai!

Our flight was with Bruce, who was brilliant, Very friendly and reassuring (I was a bit afraid of flying but it was fine). Took us around the island on a very enjoyable flight - the views were amazing and Bruce was very experienced.
The flight was amazing!  The views were phenomenal and the pilot was very experienced. He put us at ease and we saw the entire island from the air. A great experience!

I had never been to Kauai before, but my mom had. We were doing a mother/daughter trip and our special TREAT to ourselves was an aerial tour of the island. Bruce gave us a personal tour in his Cessna...and it was amazing. The views, the commentary, ...he even had music! We chose them because of the great price, but the value was unbelievable too. They took a photo of us too....great experience, highly recommend them!

The flight was for 2 passengers in a Cessna 172 and lasted a little over an hour.
The tour goes around the island of Kauai in a clockwise direction and gives you an excellent aerial view of everything on the island; including remote areas that you really can't see or visit from the ground.
Thoroughly enjoyable and highly recommended.

review_title: Hightlight of my 10 days on Kauai!!!!
review_text: so we had bad ether the first two times we were booked, but the third tike was a charm!   Amazing aerial tour of the entire island!   great service, great pilot! So clear and calm.  I just had to buy the video:-)

review_title: A Wonderful Way to See Kauai
review_text: My husband and I chose this tour while in port and had a wonderful time!  The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the island and was an excellent pilot as well. The entire staff couldn’t have been nicer or more accommodating, including picking us up and returning us to our cruise ship, at no additional charge over the rate charged for the flight itself. The driver wouldn’t even accept a tip!  I would strongly encourage anyone who wants to see the inaccessible parts of this beautiful island to take this tour. You won’t be disappointed!

review_title: Our 2nd time with Wings Over Kauai! But not our last!
review_text:
As you can tell, we were so thrilled and excited to be able to book our second flight with WOK!  Once we booked the cruise, the very first tour that I booked (20 months in advance) was Wings Over Kauai!  
I took on the task of coordinating this excursion for our Cruise Critic Roll Call group.  When all was said and done we had booked their Van 8 and Cessna tours full for the entire day!  That was 5 flights for the Cessna and the Van 8.  Everyone that took the flight was thrilled and excited that we had the opportunity to book such a great tour on our 28 Day Hawaii, American Samoa & Fr. Polynesian Islands Cruise.  
Working with Ellen and Bruce was as easy as falling off a log, as they are truly professionals and provide a wonderful tour.  In your wildest imagination of what to expect you will come up short.  It is everything that you would expect and so much more that I can honestly say that on our next cruise to Hawaii, (yes there will be another) we expect to book the WOK Flight again.  Could you ask for a stronger recommendation?
Just Mike

Our expectations were exceeded for sure! We had an amazing time flying with Bruce. He made the entire experience so personal and truly a day we will never forget. This was the highlight of our vacation for all of us. We thought we had seen most of the island already, but we were wrong. The entire hour was breathtaking, especially the Napali coast. This tour is a MUST do!!!!

My husband and I celebrated our 25th wedding anniversary and our present was to do this plane ride.  The hubby was so excited but I was apprehensive, nervous and frightened!!!  I have never been on a small plane.   The staff was amazing in answering all my questions and calming my nerves.  This ended up being the most spectacular, amazing and breathtaking way to see Kauai. Our pilot Marcus was great at flying the plane and narrating the beauty of the island.  This was worth the money and I would recommend to do this when you visit Kauai.
Where do we even start ! Not only are the views beautiful but the team is the kindest group of people you will meet! It’s everything you could ask for ! Def a must do !

I've not been up in a light plane before, so this was a new experience for me. The pilot, Doug, was just what you'd hope a pilot would be; careful, considerate, professional and proficient.
This has to be the best way to see Kauai. Even though blustery winds changed the usual flight path for us we saw all that we wanted to see. We'd also be given the option of a refund due to the changed route.
If you have the time and the money I can't recommend this company and this pilot highly enough.

I went with a somewhat nervous 90+ year-old, who is not a fan of planes, let alone small planes, and she loved it! As did I!  The views are spectacular, something you can only see by air, and this is so much less expensive than (and calmer than) a helicopter flight.  Tell nervous flyers there is nothing to be worried about!  Totally worth it!

Surprised my husband with an instructional flight on our honeymoon. <3 
Captain Bruce did an AWESOME job - husband loved getting to help fly the plane and I enjoyed the beautiful sights from the back seat.
Very warm and professional service and an EXCELLENT way to see the island! 
Mahalo Captain Bruce!

I booked the private 2 person flight around the island for my wife's birthday present during our recent visit to Kauai and it was absolutely perfect.  Bruce was an excellent pilot, was extremely friendly and had just the right amount of interesting island information to pass along during our flight.  We saw so many amazing sights and the hour went by very quickly due to all of the incredible views.  

I can't recommend Wings Over Kauai enough.  Just a wonderful time!

review_title: Better than Kauai from a helicopter!
review_text: Marcus was our plane pilot, and he was magnificient as he smoothly guided us over almost all of the most beautiful island in the United States.  Even after seeing Alaska, Central and South America and some of Europe, nothing compares to the splendor of this magical island of Kauai. Marcus made a couple of passes of some of the main attractions  (including Jurassic Park and Fantasy Island sites) to ensure we could take great photos.  He spotted an early whale siting and circled us around them.  While helicopters can get you closer to some waterfalls, the plane is far better for getting to see the seas, mountains, and valleys, and to see countless waterfalls throughout the island.  The plane is quieter, smoother, and gets to much more of the island than the choppers.  In addition, Marcus was friendly and provided us with a wealth of information.  We wouldn't hesitate to take the same trip again, especially 9:30 am to avoid some of the cloud cover.  Wow!

We came to Kauai for our honeymoon and booked some experiences that we thought would be super memorable. We were not let down after riding with Wings over Kauai!  Ellen and Doug were both wonderful, kind people. The flight was smooth, stunning and unforgettable. Doug is super knowledgable and you can tell how much he cares about Kauai and its topography, plant life and culture. The views were breath taking. Nothing beats a birds eye view! Thanks so much for an epic adventure.

Found these guys through a YouTube video I saw. I am a private pilot, and Wings Over Kauai offer an opportunity for pilots to actually fly a Cessna 172 over Kauai! One of their instructor/guides flies with you and handles the radios, shows you where to go, gives a great tour of the island from a locals perspective, and talks you through some of the unique aspects of flying in Kauai. My wife was able to come as well as a passenger and she thoroughly enjoyed the experience as well!

These folks offer a personal touch from start to finish, and it is truly a unique experience! Helicopter tours are great, but this was an opportunity I’ll never forget! I now have flight time in Kauai in my log book!

Thank you Bruce for the fantastic experience in the plane! And thank you ladies in the office for all you did to help us get ready! We will never forget this experience!

Even if you’re not a pilot, I would highly recommend using them for a regular tour as well. They are fantastic!

A great full hour with a knowledgeable pilot which showed us the great beauty, ruggedness and special Magic of the island.  Would love to fly with this outfit whenever we come back to Kauai.  Terrific family-run operation.

What a great experience from beginning to end.  We were 3 couples (2 went in the Airvan & 1 in the Cessna.)  We took off within minutes of each other and spent the next hour flying over spectacular scenery; our pilots, Marcus and Doug, shared a lot of interesting history & information about the island while soothing Hawaiian music played in the background.  The flights were smooth and the planes are clean and comfortable.  Everyone we dealt with was professional and very accommodating.  This definitely was one of the highlights of our 2 week Hawaiian vacation.  Highly recommended.

We flew with Capt Marcus and had a great time! Everyone was so very nice, explained all safety instructions and even gave us water and ginger ale for flight. I was a little worried about getting air sick but had no problem. By air is the ONLY way to see Kauai, the views of Waimea and the Napali coast are absolutely incredible. After the flight they sent us photos they took of us prior to the flight. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai, dont hesitate to book this fabulous trip!

We booked an island tour with Wings Over Kauai, after having seen the island by helicopter on a previous vacation. We both agreed that the airplane trip was much smoother and proved to be a great way to view areas of the island that can only be seen from the air. Our pilot, Marcus, was fantastic and his narration during the flight was extremely informative. I was invited to sit in the co-pilot's seat during the flight, which added to my excitement, and this experience was definitely the highlight of our visit to Kauai. Thanks also to Bruce and Ellen, the extremely friendly owners of Wings Over Kauai, who we met before our amazing flight with Marcus. A very professional team!

review_title: Best part of our Cruise Trip
review_text: We are so glad that we took this flight with Wings Over Kauai.  By air is the only way to see the whole island and the Na Pali Coast and by plane is the most affordable.  This was truly the best part of our 7 day Hawaiian cruise.

On our recent Pride of America cruise, we moored at Kauai overnight.  We are Australians, and our travelling friend had privately booked a trip with Wings Over Kauai.  It was a fantastic trip, and our pilot, Marcus, was a delight.  He provided a very knowledgeable commentary throughout the flight; wonderful Hawaiian background music throughout the trip, and stirring music as we approached the Na Pali Coast.  To see the Na Pali Coast and Kauai parks and countryside by small plane was an amazing experience.  We have flown by helicopter in Maui on other trips, and this small plane trip  was just as exciting, with great visibility. We are all in our sixties and felt very safe with Marcus. We would highly recommend this trip.

fully agree with others  excellent tour. My wife just couldn't get into the idea of helos so I talked her gently into Wings Over Kauai skyvan.  We lucked out w/ just us 2 passengers and she thoroughly enjoyed the flight.  We saw helos down in the depths of valleys etc but the sedate flight gave us a wonderful overview of the entire island, including all the helo whoopdidoo sights, just from higher up, slower and way less $$. 4 thumbs up from us.

We booked the Air Van for a 1pm flight for 5. Prior to booking, we were torn about whether to pay more for a helicopter tour instead, and did a lot of research. In the end, while I'm sure a helicopter ride would be wonderful, the Air Van was almost half the price (we booked online directly and it 550 off 5 people plus tax which came to a little under 590 - GREAT DEAL!) and everyone in our party had a fantastic time...the scenery is just unbelievable! We also had the whole plane to ourselves and everyone had a window seat, which was amazing.

Check in/safety instructions, and weigh in were smooth. They allow some time to let you take pics by the plane and with the pilot before and after he flight. I took some motion sickness pills but they also had some cool neck towels and ginger ale in the cooler in case anyone felt queasy -they do recommend you look ahead out the window to help relieve any motion sickness.

They also ask if you want a video from the attached GoPro on the wings. You get it sent online and it also includes the actual conversations in the plane from your flight. Forget the price, but believe the video cost was around $40.

We also received a free CD with soundtrack from the flight with a picture of our group in front of the plane.

Overall, it was an amazing experience and would not hesitate to go again or recommend others. Great value!!!!

review_title: Incredible View of the Beautiful Garden Isle
review_text: You really cannot get the sense of the enormous beauty of this island unless you see it from above and we could not have been more pleased with our experience with Wings Over Kauai!  We had a few on board who were prone to motion sickness and a few who were not fond of heights generally, so not the easiest group they've ever had to manage, I'm sure!  Doug, our pilot, was extremely sensitive to our concerns and even had a cooler packed with cold cloths, ginger candies, drinks, etc. to help us through.  The flight was breathtaking and absolutely worth the price pre-flight jitters. We were vacillating between fixed wing vs helicopter and were VERY happy we chose fixed wing for all the sensitivities I mentioned above.  I could not recommend Wings Over Kauai more highly, both for their skill and their courtesy.  Truly one of the most memorable experiences of our first trip to Hawaii!

We really enjoyed our tour! Staff were very friendly and our pilot, Doug, provided us with a safe, interesting and enjoyable flight. We would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai. Great price, fantastic service and an experience we will cherish forever. One of the highlights of our holiday. Thank you so much for a wonderful time. Becky and Tom (U.K.).

review_title: Great tour, staff and overview of the island!
review_text: My wife and I booked w/ Wings largely based upon the amazing reviews on TripAdvisor; we were not let down! Bruce, Ellen and their staff were courteous, knowledgable and provided exceptional personalized service. Unfortunately, we also had our tour canceled due to the Lycoming AD, but were able to reschedule a private flight with Bruce in the Cessna...for no additional cost. (I think they may have added several flights to compensate for the down aircraft.) I understand how this could be upsetting to some, but Wings’ concern and flexibility to refund and/or reschedule clearly demonstrated why they are the best option to see the Garden Isle!

I'm pretty sure all the plane tours take you to about the same places and we saw Waimea Canyon including the valley of the kings, the Napali coast, Wailua Falls and all of the south shore which were all beautiful.  But, the pilot and the staff really were the ones that made the trip great.  Our 7 year old son gets motion sickness and they did ask if anyone was motion sensitive so in the cooler they send up in the plane were 2 cool wet towels, some ginger candy and cold water for everyone else.  He did get ill (but luckily did not need the bag) and the pilot asked about him as we were kind of quiet.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly and they play soothing Hawaiin music during the flight which was also a nice touch.  Happy we did the flight even with a not so happy child!

I booked an August 18th flight for my family of 4 on December 10th (8+ months in advance) to coincide with a stop of our cruise ship.  I call the day before to confirm details and I'm told the plane won't be available due to unscheduled maintenance.  I was told that they sent me an email the day before (gee thanks but I don't check my email every day when on vacation - how about trying to call my cell).  I was also told the plane was flying today (on the 17th) but had to have the maintenance done on the 18th; really?  You couldn't do the maintenance early or late in the day or cancel a local guy or someone who would be on island longer than a day instead of the guy who flew 14 hours and took a cruise ship to get to the island and booked 8 months in advance?  Due to learning so late, I wound up hanging out on a local beach; not a disaster but not the trip highlight I had planned.  Given I didn't get the "official" cancelation email until 20 minutes after my phone call, I can't help feel that I was really bumped due to a double booking or a similar situation as the story just didn't ring true to me.

Really really loved this - definitely a highlight of our Hawaiian honeymoon! We had toyed with a helicopter tour but booked this as it was a lot cheaper, and because we were worried about being squashed in with other people in a helicopter. We are so glad we did. In a small private plane you get to see everything. I sat in the front as I get travel sick and my husband sat at the back. Doug was our pilot and he was excellent. He was very knowledgable, a lovely friendly man, told us lots about the scenery we were looking at, and did the most amazingly smooth landing! This is a really friendly company - Bruce met us at checkin and we really enjoyed chatting to him too and he let us look through his book on Kaui movie sights as well as giving us some island recommendations (it was our first day!). The tour itself was breath-taking... we saw the whole island and I got some incredible photos. Honestly indescribable. We even saw the famous Jurassic Falls (worth noting we saw from further away than a helicopter would have). I get travel sick really easily and this flight was no exception, even though it wasn't very bumpy, but if you sit in the front it is much better - take some water with you and do it anyway - it is so worth it! Many thanks Bruce and Doug for an experience of a lifetime - we will never forget it!

review_title: So glad we started our visit with Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: My friend and I scheduled our flight several months in advance online, with no problem whatsoever.  We arrived early for the flight, were greeted and checked in and weighed and then we waited briefly before our pilot, Doug, met us.  He was wonderfully good-natured, and was obviously at ease flying the Cessna jet we were in.  He pointed out all kinds of interesting sites, with history included, and answered every question we had with respect.  He obviously knew Kauai quite well, and imparted this information easily.  We loved every minute of our flight, and would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai with its current staff.  The lady who handled our orientation in the office was absolutely delightful, providing cold water and ginger candy and a flower blossom to us (water and candy was accessible in the plane as well) before the flight, and shared some fruit from a market/store with us when the flight had returned.  We purchased the recording of our flight, which we should receive via email in a few days, for $50, and we may share it with whomever we wish, if we wish.  My friend and I are a bit embarrassed-we did not realize at the time that the flight was being recorded, and are wondering how "dumb" we sound, but we look forward to having the recording to view again as a reminder of the beautiful island of Kauai and the pilot and staff of Wings Over Kauai.  I highly recommend this adventure, especially if you are new to the island and would like a great "overview", especially when you first arrive.

We did a helicopter tour the last time we visited Kauai.  Since there is so much to see from the air, I wanted to do an aerial tour again.  After reading the great views for Wings Over Kauai, I decided to give the small plane tour a try.  Not sure I'll ever do another helicopter tour again, if there is a small plane option.

We opted for the Cessna, and it was just me, my wife and the pilot.  Bruce was our pilot and he was fantastic!  Great commentary along the way, and his experience flying this tour showed as he charted a perfect path around the island.

The flight seemed so much smoother than the helicopters.  And my original concerns about just flying past sights without the ability to hover were unfounded.

Not sure if it is always the case, but when they say 65 minute tour they mean it.  Pretty sure we were in the air for the full 65 minutes, though it went by way too fast.  No discounting for taxi time, etc. or rounding an hour down to 50 minutes.  

At the end of the flight they provided us with a list of Bruce's favorites.  Wish we had that at the beginning of our visit as his recommendations were spot-on.

This is the way to see Kauai from the air!

After some browsing, my sister and I decided to purchase the combo of flight with Wings and Blue Dolphin boat cruise to see the Na Pali Coast. We took the Air Van with Marcus. He was informative, friendly, and a great pilot. The ride was comfortable  and the landing was the smoothest I've ever had in an aircraft. The flight is 65 minutes (most helicopters are under an hour). The flight hit most of the island: Na Pali coastline, Waimea Canyon, the valleys in the central part of the island, north shore area, etc. We planned on doing the flight at the beginning of our stay, but due to availability we went on our last day, which was really cool because we got to see all the stops we made in the week from a different perspective. Wings made the whole experience pleasant and fun, and I was really impressed with the flight for what we paid. I've heard the gripe that helicopters can get closer to the waterfalls and deeper in the valleys, but I personally thought our view was wonderful and wouldn't have asked for more from the experience.

We booked this tour on-line during our cruise ship vacation. Smoothly picked up at the Anchor Mall Shopping Center by van and driven to the airport. Everyone was very nice as we had a safety review of the airplane and the plan for the flight. We met our pilot "Mitch". Plane holds 6 passengers, everyone has a window seat which is one of the reasons we decided to go airplane vs. helicopter (also more economical and you cover more area in a plane). Nice smooth flight, a perfect way to see and appreciate the beauty of Kauai. Received a photo and a CD of Hawaiian songs from Wings Over Kauai at the end of the flight.

This was a incredible airplane ride. Pilot Doug did an excellent job narrating our flight as we gawked at the most beautiful scenery around Kauai. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai over a more expensive helicopter tour. You see waterfalls only seen from the air. Go early in the morning before clouds build in.

I had heard that flight lessons were a much more personalized and better tour of the island than the helicopter tours and for half or less than half the cost, so I took the advice and boy am I happy I did. Bruce was a fantastic teacher and said he would only be available for flight tours a limited time after I went (7/13/17). We heard all about local spots to visit and Bruce even had a printed out version of all the things to visit on Kauai if you wanted to be a local for a day or more. The views and stories were fantastic and the team at Wings Over Kauai were phenomenal. A great time was had by all and I would recommend this to anyone. Especially the flight school. Even if you don't plan on continuing your training as a pilot, to fly a plane over Kauai is such an amazing experience. Mahaolo 💙

We booked our trip on a friend's recommendation from several years ago and we booked day of flight. Their website was easy to maneuver and directions to location was simple. We arrived earlier than the recommended half hour before but we were accommodated and checked in accordingly. Sabrina went through  pre-flight valuable information. She was warm and welcoming as was Eileen and Bruce, the pilot of our Cessna. The hour plus flight in the Cessna was an upclose and personal way to explore the island.  My husband was nervous about motion sickness so when we read about the boat tours and helicopter tours we realized that both of those options would not be a great fit for him. He sat in the front  of the plane and had no side effects. whatsoever.  Bruce recommended that he look out while I took pictures from the seat behind. The Na pali coast from a bird's eye view is a must!  The price of this tour is conservative on the wallet compared to the pricey helicopter tours available.

Bruce our pilot is very experienced. Over 13,000 flight hours and 7000+ Times for this 65 minute air tour.
Very safety conscious. We caught a post card day with perfect weather. Highlights were Waimea canyon, Napali coast (fantastic), and Hanalei bay. Bruce does a good narrative during the trip. Ask about the Robinson family.
One aside about our aircraft, the Cessna 172, Bruce stated that from an altitude of 6000' the plane can glide for 10 miles without power. Reassuring. The Cessna 172 is great for a couple. Thanks Bruce for a memorable Kauai experience. We would recommend. Considerably less expensive than the helicopter.
Cheers,

From reading the previous reviews I can tell that our wonderful experience was not unique and everyone has enjoyed this Cessna tour of the island as much as we did.  Everything was perfect and couldn't have been better!  Thanks to Ellen and Captain Bruce for an outstanding experience.  From making the reservations to meeting our ride at the shopping mall near the port, the flight itself and the friendly manner in which we were treated....all was done very well.  Those things are always important to me as I plan our adventures. 
And as great as that all worked out....the views from the plane and the narration that Bruce provided still has me shaking my head in amazement.  We saw things that most people won't and the photos that we took can't even do it justice.  Parts of it just didn't even look real.  It was such a great perspective and so utterly beautiful.
There was never a moment that I didn't feel safe which I was afraid of in such a small plane. It was truly an experience of a lifetime.
Thanks to Bruce and Ellen!

I have a slightly different perspective - I flew with both Bruce and Marcus as part of my ongoing training as a private pilot. They were both fantastic instructors AND fantastic tour guides. I also flew 3 times over three weeks, and during the last 2 flights I also brought my girls (one at a time - only one passenger at a time in the Cessna 172. A bunch of folks can fly in the Airvans). My girls had a GREAT time and I got to be the "pilot" even though I was the student.
Maybe the other tours have great guides, but I have a hard time believing they are better guides than Bruce and Marcus. Bruce has lived on the Island for nearly 30 years, and knows the geology, history, ecology - the best beaches and most importantly, the flying!
Both Marcus and Bruce provided great instruction on situational awareness, the winds aloft and terrain effects, and how to keep passengers calm and enjoying the flight. If you are not an aviator, let me say this - these guys are safety minded, vigilant, experienced, and exercise great flight discipline. I learned a TON flying with them.
THE TOUR: beyond beautiful! On every one of my 3 flights we saw new things, from barking sands, to the Na Pali, to the interior of the island, to the biggest resorts. My girls had an amazing time. I recommend doing this early on in your time on the island, as it gave me a mental map of how varied the terrain was, and quickly formed a list of things to see and do. I can also say that you could even do it twice or more, as a passenger, and get new things every time. 
If you are an experienced pilot, or just learning like me, you have to do this! If you already have your PPL, fly right seat, as the flights rotate around the island from south east to northwest (na pali) and you will see much more. I stayed in left seat as I wanted to be consistent with the controls for the time being. Having the freedom to fly on vacation was something new to me, and I plan on doing it in norway, out in Colorado, Florida, etc. It will be hard to top the beauty of this trip - one of the best things I've ever done on vacation. Bruce, Ellen, and Marcus run a great experience. 5/5!

Our pilot Bruce was engaging with all 5 family members and it made us all very comfortable and feel safe.Its  gorgeous and gave us some idea of the places we would eventually go later in the week.;Bruce even gave us a nice soundtrack he played on the plane on disc for my bday with a photo of the family.My daughter hade motion sickness , so he ran over before we left and gave her a soothing cold towel to take.Beverages and ginger available on the flight. Check in wi9th Ellen went smooth and pleaasant. I do not know how different the helicopter is from the plane, but I felt the plane was a great choice.

review_title: Great bird's eye view of the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Marcus and Wings Over Kauai.  The flight was so enjoyable on a clear day and the narration by Marcus was very informative.  It is the perfect way to see the beautiful island of Kauai.  I would highly recommend this trip to anyone who would like to see otherwise inaccessible parts of this beautiful place.

My wife and I recently did the Cessna tour with Captain Doug.  This was an incredible air tour.  The check in was very easy to find with a nice introduction to our tour showing highlights of where we would be flying on a topographical map.  The plane was very comfortable for the 2 of us even though I am pushing 300 lbs.  My wife sat in copilot seat and I was in the back seat and there was plenty of room.  A cooler was provided with cold water and mints and ginger chews in the event of motion sickness they have everything covered.  Fortunately we did not require any of these amenities as the flight was very smooth.  The flight was a little over an hour and was amazing for every second of that time.  There are so many amazing views around every corner of Kauai that are not accessible on the ground, there is absolutely no other way to see some sights other than the air.  After our trip we both agreed that this was the highlight of our vacation hands down, cannot recommend enough.  The NaPali coast from the air is absolutely amazing.  The flight is low and slow and very smooth, giving plenty of time to take in all vistas.  Being that this is a private flight for 2 the trip is entirely yours.  Captain had nice information about sights and locales and was just a pleasure to chat with throughout the flight.

Less expensive than a helicopter tour, we'd highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and its pilot Bruce   Tour the island in a six-person airplane and learn loads from Bruce, who knows much about the island's history, people and geography.  He was personable, the sights were stunning and, at the end of the flight, he gave us two thoughtful gifts, in addition to the flight and his narration--a music CD of his favorite local music (complete with our family's photo on the cover!) and a list of his island favorites--from food to activities to beaches--as well as a map that locates each of those favorites.

My husband wanted to get more fixed wing hours, so we called Wings and was setup with CFI Bruce. He was awesome!!! So engaging and so very nice. He helped my husband with any flight questions and made sure to point out things to me about the island. We had an awesome time with Bruce and the entire team at Wings. We highly recommend this company to fly with.

review_title: Best thing we did on the 3 week vacation!!!
review_text: We did this as part of our honeymoon and it was absolutely brilliant. We did a 9am flight with Bruce, his lovely wife checked us in and told us what we would see on the flight and the route. Bruce then took us up, and it was amazing. Bruce was brilliant, talking to us for the whole flight, was very knowledgeable and was a great tour guide. We got to see so much of the island we wouldn't have otherwise seen, absolutely brilliant company, brilliant tour and lovely people. The best thing we did all holiday, cannot recommend enough, thank you for such a wonderful experience!

You can't beat the views you get for this price!  Kauai is beautiful, from the hiking trails to the small towns.  But the scenery from a Wings Over Kauai airplane - AMAZING!  Not to mention, very reasonably priced!
We went on the 11am tour.  It was a beautiful sunny day (no rain yet) and the wind wasn't too bad.  
They start out on the east side of the island (the airport), and we made our way south towards Poipu before veering north to see Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast. Before looping our way from the North Shore back down.  It takes slightly over an hour and the pilot Josh is an excellent guide.  Very friendly and knowledgeable between the history and the "movie sights".

Now, if you get the slightly motion sickness let the lady know when you check in.  I can get nauseous easily (see my review from HoloHolo Charters), so they put me in the front by the pilot.  I was told this was the best place for me; to try and keep my head and view on the right side of the plane and to give the camera to my husband.  Taking pictures and looking thru the viewfinder tends to make more sicker.  Oh and take dramemine, sea patches, whatever works for you.  I took the pills and although I was somewhat nauseous thru the flight, it wasn't near as bad as it could have been.

One of the highlights of our trip to Kauai. From initial booking to landing, Bruce and his team were absolutely wonderful. Bruce was our instructor for the flight lesson and was extremely knowledgeable, personable, funny and just cool!

The views of the island were indescribably beautiful and we learned a lot about the island.

If you want to experience a true gem of an activity and support a family-run business, please, please go see Bruce, Ellen and the team at Wings Over Kauai!

We booked a plane tour but encountered less-than-ideal weather the day we were booked. Marcus suggested we do a different day to maximize our adventure, then worked carefully to fit the rescheduled flight into our itinerary. Man, was it worth it! Marcus was our pilot and was a wealth of knowledge about the island. He had many interesting stories and patiently and expertly answered our many questions. I don't think I ever heard the words "I don't know" as our family peppered him with inquiries throughout the flight. Great choice; would absolutely do it again!

From Amy who picked us up near the port, to Val who checked us in.  Both lovely and very professional.  But a special mention to our pilot Marcus, thank you for the awesome and unforgettable flight.  The views were amazing and breathtaking.  They record everything with GoPros attached everywhere on the plane and the audio of your flight which if you want you can buy.  We thoroughly enjoyed everything about this flight, this company, and we definitely would not hesitate to recommend you see this beautiful island with Wings over Kauai Air Tour.

My wife and I were looking for some sort of air tour on Kauai and looked at all the helicopter tours first and then finally settled on Wings over Kauai. It was a whole hour of breathtaking views of the whole island. Not just the falls and Nepali Coast but everything. Captain Marcus was our pilot and he did a fantastic and amazing job. The hour passes by quick before you know it it's over. They record your entire flight with GoPros and the audio from your flight which you can purchase. It is well worth it because the quality is just like taking the flight and reliving all the memories all over again. I would highly recommend this tour. The interactions with everyone in the company we had was the absolute best. Thank you!!!

review_title: Very professional company - beware any air tour if you're prone to motion sickness
review_text:
This company is outstanding and very professional, and I felt safe despite some initial concerns about safety in a small plane. 

We took this tour as a shortcut to dragging our hike averse toddlers to Waimea Canyon and because I was dying to see more of the Napali Coast. All in all, I'm glad we did it. But I did get very nauseous. I knew I was somewhat sensitive to motion sickness because I'm consistently nauseous on windy roads, but I'm pretty good on commercial flights so didn't expect to feel as sick as I did. The pilot noticed immediately and was great about taking measures to help, but I was super happy when the flight ended and, as a result, came away thinking this wasn't a must do. Many of the views you get you have seen if you've looked at pictures of Kauai. Personally, I can't say seeing it in person was much more awe inspiring for me. But my opinion is admittedly directly affected by my sickness, which of course was not the fault of the company. We had an excellent pilot.

There were a lot of helicopters buzzing in and out below. I think that experience would be amazing and more exciting than a plane tour, but I'll never do it now that I know how sick I can easily get. And I'm happy with the experience I had with Wings over Kauai.

review_title: The Best Way to Experience Kauai
review_text:
We had an awesome, unforgettable flight with Marcus. Marcus and the other people in the office were very professional. Our flight was great, and it was a bonus to get a photo of ourselves. Our own photos didn't come out so well, due to reflection, so you might want to consider the video or go-pro options offered. 

If I go back to Kauai, I will probably do this tour again. It was THAT GOOD.

We flew with Marcus today and throughly enjoyed the experience. 
It was fantastic trip and he made it a fun, informative and personalised tour.
We did the 1pm flight and we're initially concerned about clouds but the higher peaks of Kauai are usually shrouded in clouds anyway. 
All in all we throughly recommend this as an excellent way to see the Waimea canyon and the Na Pali coast in a short space of time. 
Also, everyone is guaranteed a window seat which is a big advantage over a helicopter and a lot cheaper too!

review_title: No luck getting into the air, but Wings is still the best!
review_text:
My husband and I were rained or otherwise "bad-weathered" out of every adventure we planned on Kauai.  Couldn't hike Kalalau due to the river crossing being flooded. 
Couldn't kayak or sail the coast due to 24 ft swells.  Never got to fly in the Cessna with Doug due to high winds the first day, and low cloud cover and/or rain the other three times we tried. Luckily, we had booked our flight through Wings over Kauai, and originally booked it for our first full day on the island, which ended up giving us the most shots on goal in terms of chances to reschedule and hopefully get up there.  Each time we arrived, Doug walked us through the weather, visibility, turbulence, and gave us the choice of getting up there with the limited visibility/bumpy ride or reschedule.  We rescheduled three times, and while it never worked out, we still appreciated the customer service and flexible policies of Wings.  Our last chance was the AM before our flight off island, and when it became clear the weather still wasn't going to cooperate, we were promptly issued a refund.  One thing both my husband and I noticed was that every time we went to the terminal to try to get into the air, the helicopter tours were still going out.  So, my guess is they have a limited refund policy and therefore people opt to take the flight even if you don't see anything and/or it's potentially dangerous.  Doug and the rest of Wings were incredibly helpful, friendly, and clearly interested in making sure everyone gets the best and safest experience flying over Kauai.  I can't wait to go back to Kauai again to accomplish all the adventures we were denied our first time out, and we will definitely be re-booking our tour with Wings over Kauai!  We've already passed on their info to three other people we know are heading to Kauai in the next few months.  It's so rare to encounter such amazing customer service in this day and age.  We can honestly say Wings was a highlight of our time in Kauai even though we didn't even get to fly!

With a young family we found our options for aerial tours was limited as most helicopter tours would not take a child under 2 years.  While we didn't take our young child on the tour in the end, the search for a aerial tour led us to Wings over Kauai. (incidently, they did indicate they could take a child under 2 yrs)  We took the private flight in the smaller plane and enjoyed the flight and knowledgeable  commentary of our pilot.  The only negative of the flight if you are a photo buff  was maybe the plane is not ideal if you wanted high quality photos through the  windows which are not ideal for photography.. but we dont see the world enough with our own eyes these days anyway! Good excuse to just enjoy the view and company instead of looking through a digital screen which we all tend to be guilty of more and more these days.

My husband and I just returned home from a 10 day stay in Hawaii, and our air tour with pilot Doug was the highlight of our entire trip! We booked the 3 person Cessna tour, and it was fabulous!! The weather was less than ideal, but Doug was able to show us a coastal view of the entire island. As we took off I became a little anxious about the flight, but Doug was so experienced and provided a very comfortable tour. The calming Hawaiian background music was a nice touch. Doug was very knowledgeable about the entire island and shared much about the sites we were able to see.  He really welcomed us to the island and gave great advice and offered recommendations for our stay. If you plan an air tour while in kauai, books with "wings over Kauai" and ask for pilot Doug!

My wife and I got a private tour from Doug in the small Cessna. He did a great job narrating as we flew across the island. 

The whole process was very relaxed, from checkin to the (smooth) landing. Our pilot even adjusted course based on how we were feeling, and what the weather was like to give us the best custom flight possible. 

The views were great- even sitting in the back seat I could see everything. Highly recommend this over a helicopter where you run the risk of getting stuck in the middle. 

Friendliest pilot in the world, and the whole experience was incredible!

Had a 4PM flight.  Light on the sea cliffs was very good and the view at 2200 Ft was probably better than lower down in a chopper.  Was cheaper with longer duration than the many choppers competing for customers.

I took a 70 minute flight instructional Kauai Air Tour with Wings Over Kauai, with my wife in the rear seat as the photographer. I do hold a Private Pilot's License and was able to fly the Cessna 172 for the entire tour over almost the entire island of Kauai. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and gave me several pointers on improving my flying skills. The small plane tour will not get you into the canyons or valleys like a helicopter tour will, but if you are looking for a tour in a small plane, this is the operator to choose.

We were drawn to Wings Over Kauai because it is a family-owned business. Everything from making reservations with Ellen to being flown by Bruce was perfect. Ellen is warm, friendly, and most helpful. When the day came to fly, the winds were iffy, so she kept us apprised all morning as to our status. Luckily, the wind died down and we were off to see some of the most spectacular sights on the islands.
My husband and I were joined by two young ladies on a six-seater plane. We were awed by the Na Pali coast, something you can't see any other way except by boat, which isn't an option in winter with the heavier seas. Bruce pointed out all the landmarks, including celebrity homes. He did a great narration with historical information and included all of us in the discussion. It was a smooth and relaxing flight.
When we landed, we were presented with a CD of Hawaiian music with our picture, taken pre-flight, on the front of the CD case. Also, Bruce gave us a list of his favorite restaurants and spots on Kauai.   
This was a trip to remember!

What a great experience!  Not only is the island incredibly beautiful and unique from above but Wings Over Kauai really go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and safe.  Our pilot told us interesting facts about the island during the flight and Mary packed us a cooler full of cold beverages and towels.  I love that it is a small family ran company that makes you feel right at home from the beginning.  I would highly recommend this amazing experience!

Wings Over Kauai gets 5 stars in my 4P categories. 

We began planning our excursions for this vacation several months ago and decided to use independent third party operators in lieu of the expensive ones offered through the cruise line.  For Kauai nothing was booked in advance - not usually a good decision considering all the good tours on the ship were sold out.  

Professionalism:  Upon arriving in Kauai on 4/15, I decided to call Wings Over Kauai to see if they have any cancellations.  Using the local number, I did not reach them on the first try and figured I was out of luck.  Immediately after hanging up, I received a call from Ellen, she was very friendly and said they had some openings to accommodate one passenger and I booked a flight on their 8 seater for 11am.  I received email confirmation within minutes ... outstanding customer service and I was a happy camper.

Performance:  I read many of the Trip Advisor comments and let me tell you they do what is advertised, and more!  Ellen picked me up at precisely the right time and shuttled me from the ABC Store to the air terminal.  Her daughter Mary took care of the reservation paperwork along wth weigh-in to make sure they balance out the seating.  Mary said Marcus was our pilot and he would be arriving shortly, and sure enough, he was just landing from a previous flight.  Mary and Marcus escorted the 4 of us to the plane, photos were taken by Mary as a souvenir and she said she'd email them after the flight. I felt like the lucky one with the co-pilot seat (Marcus probably didn't feel as lucky)...guess they needed to put me up there for proper weight distribution.  Views were absolutely incredible -- from take off to landing, and it was great to fly over the harbor and see the cruise ship at the pier.  Marcus' narration of the landmarks, simply outstanding and his piloting skills phenomenal!  Very little turbulence, partly cloudy skies and a very smooth flight allowed for some spectacular photograph.  The beautiful island music playing through the headsets was a great touch!

Pride:  Upon landing we were greeted by Mary and she helped Marcus with getting us off the plane.  Bottled water or ginger ale was offered and it sure was appreciated.  Marcus asked us to come inside because he had a parting gift for us.  Each of us was presented a CD with the Hawaiian music played on our flight and a color picture that was taken at the beginning of the flight as the jewel case cover.  It was no charge!  A simple gesture that goes a long way in my book, and the kind of thing that will bring me back to them the next time I visit Kauai.

Price:  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai should you want to take advantage of the spectacular Pali Coast scenery not viewable by land.  Their price is cheaper than several others I checked out, so please call the (808) local number to discuss your adventure of a lifetime.

I have taken many, many excursions through various cruise lines and bar none, this was the best ever in my opinion.  Many thanks to Ellen, Mary and Marcus - and Mary, thank you for bringing me all the way back to the terminal.

review_title: Fantastic way to see Kauai - great service!
review_text:
My wife and I were visiting overnight on the Pride of America cruise, and decided to book the flights based on other very positive Trip Advisor reviews. The views on the flight were spectacular and it was a great way to see the Na Pali coastline and the Grand Canyon of the Pacific! The flight was very smooth and the commentary from our Captain Marcus was great. Highly recommended and arguably better than the more expensive helicopter flights. I particularly enjoyed riding up the front in the co-pilot seat! We were very impressed with the service from the entire team, particularly Ellen on the ground and Marcus. Thank you once again.

Mahalo,

Rob & Silvia - Adelaide Australia

We took the family (ages 2, 5, 8, and two adults) on an afternoon flight, and loved the whole experience. We enjoyed our flight, and the pricing was GREAT. I'm into photography, and got great shots, and the pilot was informational, knowledgeable, and helpful. We'd definitely do this again over a helicopter ride.

We booked our tour for March 17th by calling them directly.  They were very helpful on the phone and gave us a great price.  As we exited the Pride of America cruise ship we walked the 2 blocks to the ABC store (or there is a free shuttle) where we were shuttled by an employee to the airport.  Our pilot, Marcus, was very informative and showed us all parts of the island.  The waterfalls were amazing, the canyons, the shoreline, the Na Pali coastline were easily viewed out the large windows.  Photos I took on my iPhone 6 turned out great!!  The flight was smooth and comfortable.  I highly recommend this excursion to see all the island, most beautifully seen by the air.  I preferred the small plane vs helicopter which we did in Hilo.  Much cheaper and great views.   Top notch and professional. Thank you for a great adventure. 

Mike and Colleen

We booked a private flight, one person in front next to the captain and one behind. Doug explained a lot about the island and it's nature and history. We had clear weather conditions, could see lots of beautiful country sides. We also watched a group of 8 whales, that where kindly spotted by our captain flying an extra round to get a better view. Totally awesome!

My husband and I decided to take a plane tour (as opposed to the many helicopter tours) and I'm so glad we did. This was a great way to see the whole island and the views were awesome. We flew with Captain Marcus and we felt extremely safe the whole time. I loved that we had headsets to be able to talk with everyone during the flight. Unfortunately, my husband got pretty motion sick (he was in the front passenger/co-pilot seat) but Marcus had cold drinks and cool damp towels in the plane for situations like these which helped a great deal. Before we left for our tour we talked with Mary (super sweet!) and Bruce and we absolutely loved them both. They were so personal and had so many great recommendations to offer. Bruce even provided us with a packet of information about his favorite things on the island (sites, trails, restaurants, beaches, etc.) as well as a map with the corresponding locations marked... this was AMAZING and so helpful. I can't say enough about how great everyone was. 

Another thing,... Mary, Bruce, and Marcus remembered our names throughout all of our interactions which really stood out to me. They called us by name any time they were talking with us and it was just a really great little touch :)

review_title: Logged an hour of dual, in paradise.
review_text:
I had the luxury of flying with my teenage son and Bruce this morning. There is NO better way to see the island than from a small plane. Our flight was smooth, well narrated, and the sights are absolutely amazing. Each person we interacted with was professional and fun.

If you are in Kauai, flying with this company specifically, would be a must do!

This company is first rate. We toured with them a couple of years ago. The pilot, Marcus, was extraordinary and extremely courteous. My young son had a giant hot chocolate right before the flight (not a great idea on my part). Anyway, the poor kid threw up on the flight, but the pilot was so professional and understanding. I wont forget that kindness. He and his assistant were so wonderful when we landed. They wouldn't even let us help clean up. The tour was excellent and took our breathe away. The island is so beautiful. We also learned quite a bit of history. I recommend this tour highly. Very memorable images of the island. They also sell a video of your flight. I recommend that too!

review_title: Family run, super professional, breathtaking tour.
review_text: We immensely enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai tour. The owner Bruce Coulombe greeted us by name and his daughter Mary was equally friendly running the tour. The take off and landing were incredibly smooth. All passengers had a right sided window seat to enjoy the view.  All charter flights run clockwise around the island with views to your right. Captain Marcus was fantastic, an expert pilot, calm, very knowledgeable narrator. He is also an expert whale spotter and circled around for us to get a great look, very impressive to see groups of whales from above! The Waimea Canyon and Na Pali Coast views were heartbreakingly beautiful. My photos came out great. What a perfect way to see this beautiful island. I couldn't imagine a company doing a better job than Wings Over Kauai, it was a real pleasure.

We took this plane tour of the island and Captain Marcus was great!  He pointed out all the sights below and was very knowledgeable about the island and history.  Very smooth flight and a great way to see the geography of the island.

My husband and I, our two kids (age 8 and 10), and my parents did the airplane tour of Kauai. The woman who checked us in and the pilot were both very friendly. We enjoyed our flight. My daughter felt a little airsick but they had a cooler stocked with ginger ale,. mints, ginger candies, and cold towels which was very helpful. Thank you!

review_title: Amazing tour, cruise and flight lesson too!
review_text: I am a student pilot with abouit 24 hours under the belt. I booked a tour/flight lesson with Capt. Bruce and was also able to bring my wife along in the Cessna 172. The tour aspect was wonderful and the views of the entire island were spectacular. I also enjoyed being able to fly the entire trip and appreciated Bruce's split between tour navigator and flight instructor. It was the best activity I've ever done on a vacation. Don't miss this tour and if you are a pilot or a student pilot, consider the trip in the 172 and you too can be the PIC! Aloha and Mahalo

I passed PPL last year and have been looking forward to coming to Kauai and fly.  Bruce and Wings over Kauai were great.  Bruce did radio work and let me do all the flying with some minor suggestions here and there.  It was an awesome experience and Bruce gave me some useful tips and instruction.  I highly recommend this. Awesome scenery and my wife flew in back seat and got great pictures. I can't wait to get the GoPro video of the flight

We thoroughly enjoyed our Wings Over Kauai flight.  The check-in process was smooth and the staff friendly.  The pilot, Doug, was personable and knowledgeable and, despite some clouds, found ways to show us key sites across Kauai.  Since fog and rain had prevented us from seeing Waimea Canyon the day before, we were especially pleased to see both the canyon as well as the Napali coast.

Flew with Bruce from the left seat.  Great orientation to a C-172.  Nice tour.  Having done the helicopters, it's a better value to do it with Wings over Kauai.  Got some flight time in my log book on Kauai!  My wife enjoyed the experience.

My husband and I recently flew in the Cessna with Bruce on day 2 of our vacation.  We took the afternoon flight and had amazing lighting on the Na Pali coast for photos.  Bruce was engaging, with plenty of interesting facts about Kaua'i delivered with a great sense of humor.  I would recommend doing this early during your stay, as you'll probably want to visit some of the spots viewed above by car/hike as well.  We liked the Cessna since we wanted a private flight, but know that the Airbus will give you better shots with the bubble windows (allowing you to aim your camera down).  Also, only the Airbus has a mounted camera, so you cannot purchase the video of your own tour if you choose the Cessna.  

They have a great website with online booking available, but Ellen will get back to you right away if you have other questions.  Definitely recommend!

As an aeronautical geek this trip ticked all the boxes for me! Captain Marcus was both a great pilot and tour guide giving us lots of info as we flew around the island and it was fabulous to see views that are inaccessible by any other means.  He did his best to find us some whales but, apart from a very fleeting glance, we were unlucky - but lovely that he tried so hard.  

The whole experience from my initial email exchanges on was seamless.  Having drinks, sweets and cool towels available on the flight was a lovely touch.  As were the photos emailed to us after the flight and the CD of music played during the trip that we were given when we got back to Lihue.

Would I recommend Wings Over Kauai?  Most definitely!!

We hopped on this flight on our first full day on Kauai and it is the only way to do it! You get a great view of the whole island and Marcus, our pilot, was phenomenal. Do yourself a favor and book this tour.

We debated between the fixed wing and a helicopter tour. We are so glad we went with Wings Over Kauai. There were just 4 of us on the flight and it was beautiful. The pilot Marcus was informative and interesting. He flew over all parts of the island pointing out everything, did a few 360 views so everyone could see from all angles, we even saw  some whales. We would definitely recommend them to anyone trying to decide what to do in Kauai.

review_title: GREAT way to see the island
review_text: We rented out the airbus for our tour and had a fantastic experience overall.  The staff was incredibly friendly from initial phone call through to the end of the flight, particularly our super-experienced and knowledgeable pilot Marcus (a fellow Midwesterner!) and our coordinator Val.  We learned a lot about the island, got to see whales breach up close (Marcus flew close to them whenever we saw them), and the scenery was just breath-taking.  We were waffling on whether or not to take an air tour since we had hiked/driven to see a lot of the island already, and are SO glad we did--it was the highlight of the trip!  Had family that paid 5x more to take a helicopter tour, and I'm not convinced via their stories or pictures that they had a better experience.  This is an activity that is WELL worth the $$ and time and I strongly recommend this company!  Thank you Marcus, Val, and Wings over Kauai!

What a treat!  According to Bruce, our pilot, the day was an 8 out of 10 (and he's never given any day a 10 )so we lucked out on a terriffic day. Gotta thank the Universe for that part.
