Headsets made it so great to share info and what we were seeing.  The flight was smooth, and well, just what the doctor ordered.  It was really quiet as well, which I'm not sure the helicopters are.  And after we landed we were each handed a CD with Hawaiian music and on the front covers were photos of ourselves that were taken prior to take off.  Surprising touch and much appreciated.All in all just perfect

We shared a planeride with 2 others and Marcus (the pilot). The check-in is easy (at the commuter terminal) and very Kauai-like - completely laidback and you are told about the route you will be taking. The flight is about an hour and good value. The plane is small but you have a guaranteed window seat. A word of advice that came to us: don't spend all your time fretting about pictures as you want to be looking out as much as possible. Our pilot had a gentle, easy going manner and it came across in his commentary. It never felt like we were one of many he has done; it was genuine, interesting and through the headphones, felt authentic.
We wondered about when in our trip, to do this tour. We did it at the end and it tied things together nicely especially flying through Waimea to the overlooks, then dipping down to Na'pali and Hanalei. It was meaningful to see where we had driven and been. There are many highlights but the south coast beaches and the water clarity were exceptional. We had some vog that lessened the visibility higher up and then encountered some clouds over the highest mountains over the really wet parts of the island. Highly recommended and good value

We booked the flight over Kauai for my husband, myself and my mother (79 years)
This was a wonderful experience. The island is very pretty with waterfalls, mountains, beaches & the Na Pali coast. The flight lasts about 50 mins and covers a large part of the island including Waimea Canyon. We listened to music and a commentary from our pilot as we flew which added to the experience. He also pointed out specific locations from movies including Jurassic Park.

As we flew along the coast he was great at spotting whales and we even watched a breaching whale for a few minutes.

I cannot compare to the helicopter flight as we have not done this on Kauai but I found the fixed wing flight to be affordable and very enjoyable.
I loved this flight. It was very relaxing, the scenery simply stunning, staff very relaxed and friendly and knowledgeable. We had great weather luckily and felt the flight was great value

My two sisters and I planned a lovely, activity filled Christmas in Kauai. We picked this company for our air tour because of the great reviews. Although the flight was nice (Marcus was our pilot) I must comment on the reception and behavior we encountered from Bruce and Abi. We arrived early to an empty lobby area, well over the 30 minutes you are instructed to arrive. We could see out the back windows to the tarmac and noticed that one of the company's planes had just landed. It was the smaller 4-seater plane; a couple had since arrived and told us they had a two o'clock flight. They ended up leaving without taking their flight tour after a conversation with Bruce. We knew another couple was with us which meant that we would be in the larger 6-seater plane at 2:30. I watched a lady (whom I now know as Abi) placing blocks under the wheels of the plane and the pilot climb out of the plane then I moved away from the window further into the lobby to talk to one of my sisters. As we stood talking, the pilot (whom I now know as Bruce) came in through the door and saw us standing there. The expression on his face was not only off-putting, his actions were the same. He didn't speak or say hello at all, just paused scowled and kept walking. In fact, his demeanor was such that both my sister and I looked at each other in askance. As African-Americans we are the both of us very aware, observant and sensitive to our surroundings and peoples' energy. I was glad that he was NOT our pilot. Later as Abi was explaining emergency in-flight procedures to us, correction, to my two sisters; it was as if I didn't exist. She didn't bother to look at me or include me in that conversation. I am 6 feet tall but I was standing directly behind them in a little huddle. It was incredibly rude and disrespectful of her to treat me in such a manner and I let her know. Later there was an issue of seating arrangements in the plane which I think could have been handled differently. I have extremely long legs and was put in a middle seat when the back row seat by the door had no middle seat in front of it. I had to stretch my left leg out across the aisle of the plane to even fit there. I have flown in many small airplanes before. My ex-husband was a private pilot and flight instructor so I am aware and understand how weight and balance works. I will say that Marcus was polite, professional and his landing was one of the softess I've ever experienced. he would do well to brush up on his knowledge of the pine tree was on the island...We're going back to Kauai again but we will not be giving these people our business. I did not feel at all welcome or like they wanted or appreciated our business, unfortunate but true....

We visited in early December and while the weather was not ideal we did manage to fit in a flight. We waited until the last day when the weather seemed like it might cooperate. No problem booking the flights online and we had excellent customer service when checking in. Bruce flew the two of us in the cessna. Visibility was low and we did have to reroute and not see the canyon but he still managed to take us out to Napali which is what we were most interested to see. Bruce was knowledgeable but still very easy going. You didn't feel like you were in a classroom. 
I tend to get motion sickness in cars but didn't have any issues with the plane even though their were some bumps and dips. They are very good about sharing tips with you to limit any discomfort. They even had little bottles of water and some essential oils in a cooler in the back that you can use. All in all, fun experience!

My wife and I definitely like to relax on vacation and aren't always up for tours and activities. After reading the great reviews we decided to book the Wings Over Kauai flight. We were a little nervous because we had never been in a small plane before, but as soon as we checked in and got set up in he plane with our pilot, all of that went out the door! Everything was great from start to finish. The whole process is really fun and exciting, and the views of the island from the air are insane. The pilot was great, and the tour guiding was informative and interesting. When we got to the Napali Coast, he noticed some humpback whales playing and he made a couple of loops around so we could see them. It was incredible! All in all it's definitely worth the time and price. We loved it.

review_title: Highly recommended sightseeing flight over Kauai
review_text: We do highly recommend this sightseeing flight over the island of Kauai. Bruce, the pilot, is highly skilled, very personable and experienced in his trade. We booked with Ellen, his wife, and the communication was great from the very beginning. We felt well taken care of before we even arrived on the island. It is a small, family-run company, and they go out of their way to show you a good time. We were there on a very windy day, and felt completely safe at all times. Bruce is very accommodating and responsive to the needs of his passengers. We had beautiful views of Kauai and saw the beautiful Napali Coast line which can only be seen like this from the air. Also, the price for the flight is highly competitive. Bruce is very klowledgeable about the island and his narration was very informative. All in all we highly recommend this tour. Do yourselves a favour, when you are in Kauai, and take a tour with this company. If we ever go back to Kauai, we would take this tour a second time, as we enjoyed it so much! Thank you, Ellen & Bruce for a very memorable experience.

review_title: Fantastic way to see the Island and a visiting pilot's dream flight!
review_text: A highlight of my time on Kauai! Whenever I travel, I like to explore new places from the air by grabbing a local flight instructor and plane and flying around. Wings Over Kauai was really easy to schedule a flight and get to. Upon arrival the staff and pilot were both very friendly. There was some rain on and off and the staff was happy to reschedule if we wanted. Our schedule was tight so we opted to do a modified flight. The pilot worked with us to put together a safe trip that worked around the weather and was still amazing. My wife--who does not always enjoy small plane rides--loved this trip and captured some fantastic photos. If not a pilot, small plane is a great way to sight see and more affordable than helicopters.

As I a student pilot, took the opportunity to take both a tour and instructional flight in one go around the island for me and my partner. 
Was great weather for it, got to be  see the garden island, and Bruce was great tour guide, pilot and instructor. 
Great value for money for a tour flight. 

Recommend it as both a tour flight, and also a student pilot on holiday.

user_location: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States
review_title: A brilliant way to see the Kauai
review_text:
While we were on vacation in Kauai we wanted to see as much of the island as possible and, as I’m a pilot, looked for an opportunity to fly and sight-see from a fixed wing aircraft. Helicopters are ok but they can be a bit of a nuisance for people on the ground. Plus Bruce’s Cessna 172 is a much less expensive way to do this.  We arranged (before we left home in North Carolina) to take an island tour via dual flight instruction from Bruce Coulombe of Wings Over Kauai. We met Bruce’s colleague at Lihue airport and she did a short briefing and the weight and balance. Bruce then showed us around the aircraft and we climbed aboard. After a thoroughly professional preflight and engine start/run up we were ready to go. My wife was in the back and I had the right seat – for a better view of the island. We were cleared for take off from runway 3 and immediately after lift-off could see the beautiful island spread out below, and as it happened the resort where we were staying.  We flew along the coast and Bruce – who has lived on the island for a long time, initially while working as a scientist for a big agriculture company and then for the next few thousand hours of flying around Kauai – pointed out the places we were flying over. Basically for the next 50 minutes this included all of the island highlights, and Bruce’s comments and background information made this a data-rich tour. When we were approaching Lihue airport, we had to do a 360 because of departing traffic, and then were cleared to land on runway 3. 
This was a brilliant way for us to see the island, as well as for me to get 1.1 hours unforgettable instruction for the logbook. The helicopter tours may be ok for passengers, but believe us, Bruce’s tour will stay with you – a pilot – as one of the best flights ever, and especially if you get the dvd of the flight for an accurate record with all the details. And with money you save flying with Bruce rather than doing a helicopter tour, you could have dinner for the next 3 nights at the Bamboo Grill and Sushi overlooking the bay at Lihue. What a great day!
Aloha and mahalo Bruce.

Thank you Abi and Captain Bruce for the amazing experience! We had a blast! Kauai is definitely one of the most beautiful places on Earth and it was such a pleasure to see it all from up above. Thank you for the great and smooth flight! Really made our day!
Super friendly pilot and staff. We had a lovely time with Bruce. The flight was very smooth. our pilot told us a lot about Kauai. Definitely recommend it!

Doug,
Thank you for blessing us during two big occasions we celebrated while in Hawaii--anniversary and birthday. We had a great time and we appreciate your flawless piloting skills and for "steering" us in the right direction to capture the most breathtaking photos. "I can't breathe!"  
This is a must do while in Kauai. Excellent customer service--Mary!! Mary, Thank you for waiting for us and being reflexible with flight time! Thanks again for the memories

What a treat this flight was!  Our pilot Marcus made all of us feel safe as he handled the plane expertly. He gave us a tour of the island and noted points of interest along the way.  It was fun having the earphones and microphones so we could talk easily in the plane.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel right at home as soon as we got there.  I would go back to Wings over Hawaii anytime!!!

Ok so I'm visiting from the Uk and want to see as much as possible so. Flight it is now I've done helicopter trips sometimes a bit too quick so this was to be a flight in a small aircraft 8 seats only and if your picked your up front ( no you don't have to fly it ;-) ) 

We were picked up from the port as we arrived via Princess cruise around the Hawaii islands and taken to the airfield where we were weight as to be safe and a safety briefing before been taken out to our aircraft.

You may have seen this type of aircraft before as its used mainly in the Australian outback for short take off and landings think ( flying doctors) 

We greeted by our pilot a lovely youngish man about 30 ?? With quite a lot of experience who gave us a running commentary as to the island and very useful information.
The trip lasted about 1 hr and was breathtaking and worth every dollar.

Many thanks for the Emailed photos of our trip and the music CD I'm writing this while it plays so.

Mahalo  a hui hou 

Best wishes Kevin&Debbie Saddler

Bruce and Ellen, owners of the business, make sure you have a memorable experience.  On the morning we had originally scheduled, it was raining on the south and north ends of the route.  They gave us the option of rescheduling for better viewing, which we appreciated - thus the recommendation to schedule your flight early in your trip.  They have two planes.  We chose the Cessna, which had space just for the two of us and the pilot.  We went around the island, down the east side which included the locations for several movies, around the south, up near the Jurassic Park waterfalls which is on private property, up Waimea Canyon, then the Na Pali Coast on the east side.  I thought the Na Pali Coast would be the highlight, but actually enjoyed the final turn through the interior of the island best.  Up the Hanalei Valley and through the Volcano Crater than created this island - simply stunning.  So much of this beautiful island is inaccessible that seeing it by air is not only the preferable, but only way to see it.  There are numerous helicopter and plane companies that do this tour.  We chose a plane because my husband gets motion sickness and planes tend to be less bumpy.  We chose this company because of its reviews.  We were not disappointed.

review_title: Absolutely breathtaking! Weather was amazing for us!
review_text: The flight was on a perfect day, with slight breeze, clouds at 2600' and it was smooth sailing at 2500'! What a beautiful flight with amazing scenes! A must do on Kauai!

This was an incredible way to see the parts of Kauai only accessible by air. Our party of four had the plane to ourselves and it was a terrific flight. The weather was perfectly clear, which we were told was uncommon, making the scenery that much prettier!  Our pilot, Marcus, was so knowledgeable about the island. I have done the same trip by helicopter but this was far more enjoyable. Do yourself a favor and book this trip!

Our flight over the island was AMAZING!!!  Are family of 6 had a great time including our 4 year old.  We saw so much in the hour plane ride.  We loved the beaches, mountains and especially the crater and waterfalls.  It was WELL WORTH every penny spent!!!

Wings over Kauai is family owned and operated including the precious 4 legged family members☺️ They go the extra mile to make sure it is a fabulous experience!  I met two of the pilots and had Bruce as pilot for ours.   He was very knowledgeable about the island and very attentive to each and every passenger that was on the flight!  I Highly recommend Wings over Kauai if you are seeking an experience of a lifetime. The sweet gift from the pilot to all the ladies is precious!  Can't wait to get our personal Video of our actual flight😃

We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai over helicopter tours.  We had the most wonderful birds eye view of the island in extremely relaxed and stable flight condition.  We were a family of 4 and had the plane to ourselves.  The plane was spacious and comfortable.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight. Kauai is a beautiful place, and Wings gave us the opportunity to see parts of the island that cannot be seen any other way. Marcus was friendly, knowledgeable, careful, and we had a great time.

review_title: Pilot your own Kauai Flight and tour the Island of Kauai in Control
review_text: Sandy & I signed up for the flight with Bruce Coulombe, owner of "Wings Over Kauai". Bruce has over 7,000 flights touring Kauai since 1994. This is a Family owned and operated flight tour business. I elected to be in the right seat with Bruce in the left seat for better viewing while I flew the C-172S. The weather was beautiful and with Bruce's expert advice I navigated and flew while sightseeing. Sandy took excellent photos from the rear seat behind me. It was a great flight with Bruce handling the radios for ATC and Tour position reports. I own a '70 V35B Bonanza and Bruce was excellent with his power setting suggestions, airspeed and altitude directions all the way to a right seat landing. This is an excellent experience for any pilot from a high time retired Airline pilot, like myself to a novice thinking about taking up flying. Well Done. Thanks Bruce, Ellen, Carter and Mary, a true Family operation! Marty Noonan

We had the great pleasure of flying over Kauai with Captain Bruce.  He is funny and knowlegable about the island. The views from the plane were incredible.  It was serene and beautiful, flying over such amazing landscapes!  We saw waterfalls that were stunning.  We really took time reviewing different companies that offered sightseeing flights and picked this one and are so glad we did!

We wanted to see the Napali coast before leaving the island. After comparing boats, helicopters and planes, we came to the conclusion that this family business was the best option and we were right ! Views of the island were breathtaking ! And you can enjoy it in a private way (only two people and the pilot) for an entire hour. You can also easily take pictures as you have a window anyway. Our Captain, Bruce Coulombe was very friendly and entertained us during the whole flight ! In the end, you get a picture of you in front of the plane and a selection of Bruce's favorite Hawaiian songs. And all of this for a reasonable price!

Booked this flight as a surprise for my husband's birthday, and he said it was the height of his Hawaiian cruise!  If you are on a cruise ship, they will pick you up just outside the port gate and drive you to the airport for the flight and return you to the port. You will not see the Napali coast or Waimea canyon from this vantage on any land tour.  Our pilot (Bruce) was simply the best, most experienced aviator and island guide to be found.  This is a class act operation from start to finish. Book this flight!  You will not be sorry.

review_title: Great option for an aerial overview-Affordable and Great Service
review_text:
We were looking at Helicopter tours, but I read so many great reviews for Wings Over Kauai, that I preferred the plane. My husband wanted to do a doors off helicopter but there were weight limits and the potential of being crammed in a middle seat. I didn't want to pay a lot and be stuck in the middle. My husband, friend, and I decided to try this option. 

We did the airvan tour. Booking and check-in were smooth. There was plenty of parking near the office. The plane also had plenty of room. We went with one other nice couple. Customer service was excellent. The flights were pretty full but they squeezed us in for a 4:00 p.m. flight and it was perfect. The sun was out and the lighting was great for pictures. Bruce personalized the tour and gave us a good background of the island too. They also had drinks in the plane if anyone wanted them.
After the flight, they gave us a CD with music and our pictures in front of the plane at no extra charge, which was a nice gesture.

I also think you got more minutes in the air with the plane and less rocky motion so if anyone is subject to motion sickness, this would be a smoother ride and nice way to see the island.
In sum, we highly recommend this as it is a great value for an aerial tour and excellent customer service.

Writing this review on behalf of my parents. We sent them there for 40 year anniversary this past Spring. I researched scenic flights for hours and this company shined through all the rest. Reviews were spectacular and the price was much cheaper than helicopter rides. My dad gets motion sickness but had no trouble at all on this private chartered flight. The owner actually took them around the island and he was extremely informative and polite. My parents had a blast. When I called from the mainland, they were so accommodating and helpful. They did not have any other clients flying on the day that we wanted but did a flight just for my parents. Don't cheat yourself out of this very special treat, it's once in a lifetime folks! Book it and you won't think twice or regret for one second!

A wonderful personalized flight experience that introduces the island of Kaua'i from a different perspective. We got the small 4-seater Cessna which is nice having the plane only for ourselves and the pilot Bruce (great entertainer).
Mahalo

After the check in they take you to the plane and take some pictures before you hop in. Then you can enjoy flight over the whole island and the pilot answers all your questions. Really cool experience. After like 70 min you land back at the Lihue airport and as a thank you they give you a cd with Hawaiian music and picture of you they took before you got on the plane, on the cover. It's a really sweet surprise. I highly recommend this company!

Spectacular views, great pilot, very professional operation. As mentioned by others, you get a great view from any seat in the Airvan. Flight was smooth and the pilot provided and interesting commentary. Great trip !!

I did a lot of research before booking, and found that many people recommended this over a helicopter flight. We decided on the Air Van flight as it has the bigger windows. It's a six-seater plane, and my husband got to sit in the co-pilot seat, which was cool!

On the day of our trip, the weather was cloudy and uncertain (Hurricane Lester was close to the islands at that point, bringing unusual conditions with it).  Because of this, the pilot was forced to take a different route than usual, but we still saw fabulous sights, including the Na Pali coast, and rainbows on the ocean. Tip: if you think there's even a chance you'll get motion sickness, take Dramamine or similar before the trip! It'll be worth it if the weather is a little 'off'.

Our pilot Marcus was superb, giving us a safe ride and plenty of interesting information.  Thanks as well to Val, Bruce & Ellen, who were all great.  This was a wonderful experience, so glad we did it.

We had a really amazing time on this flight!!!  From the moment we checked in until we walked out the door after the flight we felt welcomed and taken care of.  The flight was truly stunning and it was smooth and easy to focus on the sights around us rather than our safety.  There was some cloud cover at the top of the mountains (to be expected this time of year - Oct.) but the sun was shinning and we had a clear view of everything else.  The waterfalls were lovely. The beaches were beautiful. We had great views from the seats we were sitting in (both of us were on the right hand side) Our pilot was very professional and informative. We couldn't have been more pleased with the experience and would absolutely recommend it to ANYONE visiting Kauai.

This was an awesome tour. After deep research efforts I decided to do an airplane tour vs. a helicopter tour. Our pilot was Marcus and he was awesome. The plane holds 8 people max. and our total party size was 4 people only for this flight. The take-off was smooth and so was the landing. The aerial views from above are awesome. Wings over Kauai is a first class operation. You really get the best bang for your buck with Wings over Kauai.

We took the 2 person private flight with our pilot, Bruce, also the owner.  It was fairly windy, but the flight was smooth, very little turbulence.  The views are outstanding, we liked it much better than the helicopter tour.  You get to see a panoramic view from the plane whereas the helicopter tours get you in closer, but you can't appreciate the landscape as a whole.  Bruce did a great job of pointing out places of interest and some must do's.  You'll also get a copy of his top 10 things to do and a special gift to the end.  The flight itself is approx. 65 minutes from take off to touch down, you see almost all of the island and certainly the areas you can't access by foot.  Well worth every penny.  What are you waiting for?  Book it!  You will love it!

From reserving online, through e-mail communication before and after our adventure, the experience was seamless and incredible.  Our pilot, Marcus, was very knowledgeable and friendly, smooth flight with amazing views of all areas of Kauai.  Highly recommend Wings Over Kauai for those that want to see the areas of the island one cannot reach, as well as won't be traveling to see.

review_title: A Must For Your Kauai Visit!
review_text: I was originally looking into helicopter tours but was worried about my wife getting motion sickness and the costs are pretty expensive.  When I found Wings Over Kauai on a TripAdvisor search and saw the other positive reviews it seemed like the perfect solution for our visit.  I booked the private 2-person Cessna tour and it was half of what a helicopter tour that wasn't even private was going to cost.  Our experience with booking, confirmation, directions and everything leading up to the flight was flawless.  On the day of our flight we met with Bruce who owns the company and was also our pilot and went through a thorough pre-flight briefing and were on our way.  Bruce shared his vast knowledge of the island as we flew by all the spectacular sights which added a nice touch to the tour.  We started out at 3:30 in hopes that the weather would be a little clearer (always a gamble on any day) and the sun would be better for some pictures along the Waimea Canyon and Na Pali Coast.  We lucked out and the scenery was amazing.  While you aren't right up on things like you might be in a helicopter I found that the views were still excellent and met my expectations.  Although the configuration of an airplane isn't the optimum for taking professional photos (and really only a doors off helicopter is optimal), my wife and I managed to get many great shots.  Wings Over Kauai also provides the option to purchase a high def go-pro video of your flight which is a nice touch as well that you could also grab still images from.  Overall our experience was excellent and I would highly recommend Bruce and Wings Over Kauai as an alternative to high priced and crowded heli-tours.

review_title: Friendly atmosphere & breathtaking views over Kauai!
review_text: Definitely worth it! We loved our flight over Kauai with Captain Bruce. We had an amazing time & we liked it so much better than our helicopter tour in Hilo (Big Island). The captain did a great job and his daughter took great care of us. They even made a picture of us & the cessna airplane and sent it as an e-mail immediately after our flight. There were also drinks available on board and some ginger candy for the stomach. The views were unbelievable, this flight is the best and only way to see all of the island. Thank you so much for this adventure!

The staff at the company is amazing.  Very kind people and highly professional.  The price of the flight is very reasonable, given the level of service and the length of the flight.  Basically you get to see the entire island from the sky.  The views are incredible and the flight provides an excellent perspective of what this beautiful island has to offer.

This afternoon, we undertook one of the greatest experiences, a must see when visiting Kauai.
We were recommended to try the 'Wings over Kauai' Air Tours. and they didnt let us down.
This a Family business that operates out of Lihu'e Airport, they basically cover the entire island flying nice and low, and close to all the attractions, our pilot Marcus and Bruce were a font of information, giving us details of every area and the history behind the amazing scenery.
Caitlin on the ground gave us all the rundown before the flight, we were a little scared the weather was going to dampen the experience, but as if specially arrange it cleared, giving us several photo opportunaties with rainbows.

We will be back and doing this again.

We booked the air and sea combo tour with Blue Dolphin Charters and Wings over Kauai -- both were a great value. Unfortunately, the morning we were supposed to take our flight it was cancelled due to conditions. However, Bruce and his team were very accommodating about the short amount of time we had on the island and were able to reschedule for us. We ended up rebooking for the day we also had our boat tour -- not the best idea since you're driving from one part of the island to the other, but still doable.  We caught Bruce's last flight of the day at 4PM and were lucky to have the whole flight to ourselves. Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and we were able to see incredible views. Part of the perks of doing the plane over the helicopter would definitely be the pricing  -- it's almost half as much. Though a helicopter is better able to get you down into those tighter areas, such as Waimea Canyon, we still had plenty of great views and picture ops. They were also quite alright with me using my gopro to record a chunk of the flight. Bruce provided complimentary drinks while we were up in the air and a nice, added bonus -- they took our picture in front of the plane and printed the pic out on the jacket of a DVD highlighting the views we saw during the flight (at no extra cost). It's a nice little touch to have a pic of us before our flight and a little highlight video. Thanks, Bruce and your team. Would definitely recommend!

review_title: Awesome way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: Bruce Coulombe was not only an excellent flight instructor, but a very knowledgeable tour guide as well.  The staff was very friendly and the airplane was great.  Highly recommend to visiting pilots!!

Captain Bruce, as well as his wife and daughter who help run the business) were absolute professionals, knowledgable and enthusiastic. I was anticipating feeling claustrophobic (especially while pregnant) and was anxious about the flight, and they could not have been more reassuring. The views were exceptional and unlike anything my husband and I had ever seen before- I can't imagine going to Kauai without going on this tour. Bruce pointed out all of the island's highlights, was full of information, and was able to answer all of our questions. They took lots of pictures for us and gave us a free CD at the end with our picture on the cover. Could not give them a higher recommendation!!

A true highlight of Kauai. The pictures I took from the plane were amazing. The flight is smooth and easy. The landing was soft and comfortable. The pilot has 22+ years of experience flying Kauai so he was able to tell us so much we didn't know about. We added to our itinerary many things after learning all the hidden gems.
Such an incredible experience! The only way to see Kauai, gorgeous views! Carter welcomed us & made us feel at ease. Bruce was a wonderful pilot, smooth flight, unforgettable time! Mahalo.
A flying tour over Kauai is an absolute must and Bruce is a fantastic pilot and tour guide.  The flight was very smooth and the scenery is breathtaking.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai.

This was our favorite experience in Kauai. The staff is friendly and professional, and our pilot shared with us his vast knowledge of the island. The views were incredible and we saw Kauai in a way that we never would have been able to had we not taken this flight. I highly recommend this company!

Bruce and Caitlin were great.  We were able to see views of the island that were incredible.  Bruce told us what we were seeing, answered our questions, and made the flight really enjoyable.  It was the highlight of our trip.

We did the Grad Deluxe Tour with Wings Over Kauai in August, 2016 and it was fantastic.

Bruce and all of the staff at Wings Over Kauai were extremely welcoming, professional and knowledgeable.

The flight included sights such as Waimea Canyon, The Na Pali Coast and several waterfalls. The visibility from the plane was fantastic- every passenger had un-obstructed views of all of the sights. I don't think you can appreciate the sheer beauty of the Na Pali Coast from the ground- this was a perfect way to see it.

The tour was great value for money and we had a good amount of time in the air. The DVD and free pre-flight photos which were emailed to us after the tour were also a nice touch.

Booking via the website was quick and easy and Wings Over Kauai even emailed us directions of how to get the Hangar from our hotel.

A fantastic tour- highly recommended.

My family of four enjoyed our flight with Bruce during our stay in Kauai earlier this month.  We did the tour on the day we landed on Kauai & had beautiful weather.  We flew all around the island & enjoyed the gorgeous views.  Doing it early in the trip, gave us a good idea of the sights on the island.

review_title: An awesome way to see the island!
review_text: This was one of the coolest things I have ever done and I would highly recommend it to anyone wanting to see the island from the air. Bruce was outstanding and made the flight both exciting and educational. It was a perfect day and we saw everything you could possibly see! Activities like this are what memories are made of! We will always remember and recommend this trip by Wings Over Kauai! One thing that was really interesting about this was that we did it early in our vacation and then did a Napali raft trip later in the week. It enabled us to get two really different perspectives on the stellar beauty of Kauai! Thanks so much for a great trip and some great memories!!!! Best vacation EVER!

Mary and Bruce did a FANTASTIC job. They were super nice, informative and they spent quality time with our family. The views were amazing, the overall flight pretty smooth (the whole family was a bit concerned with motion sickness) but we did not experience any problem. We would recommend this experience to anyone who is looking to visit Kauai.

From booking to landing everything was great.  Easy to book online.  Very welcoming when we arrived.  The flight was smooth and beautiful.  Bruce answered all our questions via Bose headphones.  It was a great way to see the island.  Highly recommended!!

We had a really nice flight over Kauai, thanks to the expert pilot.  Many sights were seen, and we don't think that we missed anything.  The staff were exceptional, we had a weather problem with our first flight time, so, for safety reasons, we couldn't go.  The staff arranged a different flight, and promised that if we had to leave before the weather permitted our flight, we would be fully refunded.  Fortunately the next opportunity was clear enough for a very enjoyable flight !

There is no better way to see Kauai than from above because so much of the island is virtually inaccessible. So my wife and I opted for the small plane vs. the helicopter. Since the airport is 3 miles from the ship, they will pick up and drop off. Our pilot, Marcus, was both an experienced pilot and a very personable young man. He explained everything that we were seeing during our 1 hour flight. Everywhere we looked there were waterfalls, perhaps numbering in the hundreds if not a thousand. Many probably have never seen people. Good people, smooth flight, can't miss.

We debated the helicopter tour or the small plane offered by Wings Over Kauai, and opted for the plane.  For us, it was the perfect decision.  We didn't necessarily want all the ups and downs the choppers take, and enjoyed the steady and amazing flight our pilot Marcus provided.  The plane is the type they use in the Outback and can land anywhere if needed.  Marcus was a true pro and knew everything there was to know about the island.  Mary, from the office, was very helpful, as was everyone in this operation.  You're going to hear about the amazing vistas from all the reviews--I wanted to be sure to commend Wings Over Kauai for the outstanding tour, great service, and true Aloha spirit.  Highly recommend.

This was a fantastic way to see spectacular views of Kauai which most are unacceptable.  If you are keeping excursion cost low I would highly recommend this over snorkeling, kayaking or hiking tours.  This was by far the highlight of our Maui/Kauai vacation. I'm so happy my husband and I booked this tour as it will forever be an unforgettable experience.

Note: if you have a weak stomach like my husband take a Dramamine or nausea patch/bracelet. 

I personally thought this was a smooth flight and my husband did as well but now knows how sensitive his stomach really is. He still thought this was a fantastic experience.
Beautiful sights, about an hour long tour. Small group flight of up to six people.  Got to see the canyon, coast, lots of beaches and waterfalls.

Caitlin was very responsive to our questions, Robert the pilot was great to fly with, smooth pilot and informative about his life and the views we were seeing. He made the 1 hour plus flight fly by, pun intended. We are really looking forward to the BlueRay disc of the flight.
My partner and I did the private flight with Bruce as pilot. Couldn't rate this any higher! Had such a fabulous time and the service was stellar. Look no further and book your flight!!

Our flight was three couples on Monday June 27, 2016.  Our pilot was Marcus who is very personable, an excellent pilot and a knowledgeable tour guide.  We felt the airplane flight was much preferable to our previous helicopter trip.  It was more relaxed and much less of a thrill ride.  Our views from the plane were excellent.  The views of Wiamea Canyon, the Napali  Coast and the trip up the Hanalei valley were outstanding.  The reservation process was easy on-line and the cost was reasonable.  We would certainly choose Wings Over Kauai for a repeat flight.

After researching extensively which air tour to do of Kauai, we booked with Ellen from wings over Kauai. We booked the Cessna plane for my husband, myself and my daughter.
Ellen was so helpful and included my young daughter free of charge. 

Captain Bruce was so friendly and the flight was very informative and not to mention very scenic.
You could tell he genuinely loved his job, and it was such a pleasure flying with him.

I highly recommend using Wings over Kauai! Don't waste your money on a helicopter tour, when you can get a more personalised and private tour with Captain Bruce!

My wife and I booked this excursion after hearing it was a must-do. We were not disappointed. Originally we were leaning towards a helicopter tour but this tour was a lot cheaper and we enjoyed every minute of it. The staff was extremely friendly and Captain Marcus was knowledgeable (and extremely experienced) and we had a great trip. It was a great way to start our honeymoon as we got a feel for the island and were able to plan what we wanted to do with the rest of our week. The flight lasted about an hour and a half and you can buy a video of your flight or take your own. We were even given a CD of the music that played during the flight (the pilot was also the DJ) with a picture of the two of us on the front. It was a trip we will never forget!

review_title: Phenominal Views / Personable Friendly Pilot and Staff
review_text: Our family of 2 couples booked the charter flight and each of us had a window seat.  The preliminary information was very informative by Caitlin - loved the new 3D map of Kauai on the wall.  The flight was on time and Bruce (our pilot) was friendly, full of information and included each of us in conversation!!!  My then Fiancé, (now Husband) is typically afraid of heights, however, he said for some reason, the flight really didn't bother him.  Bruce was even able to capture an aerial view of our wedding location that over looked the ocean and personally sent the photograph to us.  We humbly appreciate the personal touch and are very thankful to have booked our island flight with Wings Over Kauai.

As a private pilot, I enjoy flying while on vacation.  It is a great way to see the sights and you get to log the time.  However, it is not trivial to get checked out, learn all of the local procedures and fit this all in when traveling with the family.  Wings over Kauai made this all very easy.  I took an instructional flight with one of their flight instructors.  I got to do all the flying, they took care of the preflight, coms, and navigation.  It was all VFR, and a great loop to hit all the sights.  The route was incredible and the pictures do not do it justice.  You don't have to be a pilot of fly with Wings over Kauai, but just an added bonus to an incredible tour.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text:
After rescheduling a few times due to windy conditions which was recommended by the team we finally got up in the air and were not disappointed. The napali coast and waimea canyon were  awesome to see. Bruce our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and friendly throughout the flight and really made you feel at ease. 
Half the price than most helicopter tours but with better service. They are number 1 on trip advisor for a reason. Thanks again Ellen and Bruce we will be recommending your tours to family and friends. Dan and Emily

I cannot say enough about how great our flight was. Bruce and Caitlin were very friendly and were very genuine about making sure we had a great flight.  My family of 4 were the only ones on the tour. They had water and Sprite on the plane. The views of the coastline were just breathtaking. Our 7 and 9 year olds enjoyed it as well.  A cool addition was that they had go-pros on the wings so you can purchase an edited video of your tour. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an air tour of the island!

We booked online long ago.
The time of the flight and the plane had been change at the last minute. They send us an email3hours before , but when you are travelling you are not on Internet all the time...
We paid 280$ for 2 and they are still expecting a tip!
The views and the tour were fantastic thought

review_title: Glad we flew with Wings Over Kauai Air Tour!
review_text:
It was our fist time visiting Kauai, and seeing Na'Pali coast was a big deal for us. But my daughter was just too little for a hike or any boat tours... Then, lucky us - we found Wings Over! Ta-dah! We booked a Cessna which we fitted comfortably and was perfect.
Smooth flight and great guide by Bruce. Like other reviewers said, not just a Na'Pali coast, but it's really a great way to see Kauai for its whole island from the sky. Wish the weather was a little more sunny, but overall we enjoyed it very much! Highly recommended!

review_title: Smooth Ride Over Beautiful Kauai Island
review_text: We had booked the Airvan for a private charter. The debate of helicopter vs airplane was a big deal with the five of us. What I really liked about the airplane is that the whole family can fly at the same time and able to talk with one another. The other concern I had if my stomach can handle the helicopter's maneuvers. There were a helicopter every 10 min. over our heads when we were at every beach and hikes, kind of sad. There were five in our group and four sat on the right side. I got to sit in the back next to my daughter-in-law, kind of in the middle. I stretched to see and Marcus turned for me to see specific areas of the Napili Coast. Prior to the flight, the young lady at the office kept bringing up that they might not fly due to the weather. I understand the conflict of not flying that day but the lady asked over and over about when the next dates for us, I was getting angry after a while because my hubby was wheeling and dealing with dates and times. I wanted to wait until Marcus came back from the flight to see how it goes first. Marcus passed out a couple of DVDs to the previous group while they were thanking him. He walks by and says he is ready to fly us around, the office lady frowned and questioning him with whispers. We got our photo taken, then climb in the plane, and put on headphones. There is music playing during the whole trip as well as the pilot talking with us. Reflection on the windows were a big concern, wear dark clothes. Lots of photo opportunities, got to see all the waterfalls to the ocean line too. We booked for 2:30, perfect time in May. A discount was offered with the DVD when we landed, we purchased but not opened yet. Most of our group was nervous about plane fears but they were fine. The ride was smooth with the small part of landing.

review_title: A 'MUST DO' in Kauai!! Do not miss this!!!
review_text: Our trip over Kauai was breathtakingly beautiful! We were very lucky as we had a very clear day and had a wonderful view all around - amazing Na'Pali coast, too many waterfalls to count, Waimea canyon and more - it was definitely one of our trips greatest highlights! Our pilot Marcus was knowledgeable and shared many interest facts about the island - what a great guy too! Due to overcast weather when we had originally booked, we opted to change our flight dates - really, you could not find better customer service anywhere - what a lovely group of people that work at Wings over Kauai - stand out day, stand out people, we will never forget our trip over Kauai and the next time we will book to go again - cannot recommend this enough!!

We debated and debated on whether or not to take an air tour and then whether or not it should be by plane or helicopter.  The reviews (and the price) of Wings over Kauai won out.  Great decision!

We booked an afternoon flight in the Air Van.  Most of the seats were on the coveted right side of the plane (all tours fly clockwise around the island).  Even the person in the middle back seat had a great view of all aspects of the tour. Marcus, our pilot, did a great job.  He started by recounting his experience as a pilot and instructor, immediately putting everyone on board at ease with his experience and skill. 

Marcus did a nice job narrating the flight and providing historical information. Music was played throughout the flight providing a nice background.  We got a kick out of the theme from Jurassic Park playing as we flew over "Jurassic Falls".

I am sure that the tour was longer than the advertised 65 minutes.  We circled the entire island and really felt we received our money's worth.  We highly recommend the professionalism and friendliness of Wings over Kauai.

review_title: Excellent Experience All the Way Around!
review_text: Val and Marcus were extremely personable and the air tour itself was awesome..  Marcus provided a very interesting narrative during the flight and seemed to be an extremely competent pilot.  I'd recommend this service to anyone travelling to Kauai, it's a can't miss for sure!

review_title: Family operation,  with safe, knowledgeable staff.
review_text:
My wife and I had a wonderful flight with Wings over Kauai.  Our flight around Kauai was the highlight of our trip. The weather had been cloudy and for a 4 pm flight we still saw tons of Waterfalls. Na Pali Coast and the North Shore is not to be missed.
We highly recommend Wings over Kauai!

This is only Air Service on the island that provides a couples tour of the island by air. We booked the Cesena and Bruce, the owner, took on a customized flight to allow us to see the parts of the island available (due to clouds), they also gave us the option of booking later in the week if we wanted. We still saw the NaPai coast line and what seemed like hundreds of waterfalls (only possible by air).  We picked Wings Over Kauai because it is safer, and the very personalized approach. My wife even got to do the pre-flight checklist with Bruce. We enjoyed the personal attention from the team (Bruce and his wife). This is so much better than the approach at the other places where every helicopter or plane only flys when the flight is full. Great start to our vacation on Kaui.

We opted for this small plane tour rather than a helicopter, partly because it was much more economical, and also because we didn't want to get stuck in a helicopter seat with a lousy view, which can happen.  We weren't disappointed. Bruce took us all around the island, offering interesting tidbits of history and trivia, and the views were fantastic. My husband had a little flying experience and got to help with the take off and fly a little bit too, which thrilled him.  We even got a short video included as a memento of the flight. We've never done the copter tour, so I can't compare, but I can't imagine that it would have been any better, just different, and much more expensive.

review_title: Awesome value, take your own GoPro!
review_text:
This was such a good experience! Marcus (I think his name was) was a cool guy, super smooth flight with amazing views. My wife, 2 year old son and I went in the air bus with another couple. They gave our son a nice little blue bear to calm his crying before getting on board which was super nice. Very quick to get off the runway and fairly loud, I used my hands to cup my boys ears as he wouldn't wear his earmuffs. Once we were in the air he fell asleep 20 minutes into the 60 minute round island trip. The pilot was great.
The only time I nearly died was from drowning when my wife fed me a can of coke, my hands weren't free and she never stopped pouring. I also strapped my GoPro to the wing for $25, easily worth it.
Plus my boy got to keep the bear.
Awesome value 🛩🛩🛩

We chose Wings Over Kauai as my boyfriend had never been on a small plane, and it was MUCH cheaper than the helicopter tours (our tour was $300). This company had the best customer service ever! On our scheduled day, we arrived early and Mary got us checked in, weighed, etc. The wind was really picking up and it looked like a big rainstorm was moving in. Mary checked with Marcus (the pilot) to see how conditions were elsewhere on the island. Marcus replied that conditions were not very good for sightseeing and getting worse. He and Mary suggested that we should cancel for the day and try again the next morning, in the hopes of a much better trip. Note: we had booked an afternoon trip but Marcus and Mary said that morning trips are usually a better bet for good weather and visibility. We got booked onto a tour the next morning with no problem and at no charge.
Meanwhile, we asked Mary for recommendations on what to do since it looked like a thunderstorm was moving in. She suggested going to the west or south side of the island which she said was usually sunny. Since we had a Jeep, she recommended we go to Polihale Beach. This turned out to be breathtaking, and we were so glad she recommended it!
The next morning we went on our tour. There were two other people with us, and we all had window seats. Also provided in the plane were waters, cool wet towels, ginger candies, and ginger ale for motion sickness. My boyfriend got motion sick, and the pilot and other passengers were most helpful in helping me get him the towels, ginger, etc. to feel better.
Marcus was an excellent guide, and had personal stories about some of the sights we saw, as well as general information, which helped make the flight tour that much better.
We had our picture taken with the plane before flight, and when we returned, we got a CD with our picture and some of the music that was played during the flight. Unlike some other companies, there was no charge for this great souvenir.
We thought the plane tour was better than doing a helicopter tour as we were able to fly higher and get better views and pictures of sights such as the Na Pali coast. We saw helicopters that were flying lower and closer to the cliffs, but we preferred to have our views of the entire cliff from top to bottom, instead of just a small portion of the cliffs.
This was our favorite thing we did on Kauai, this is a must-do!

My friend Austin and I took the Cessna tour with Bruce and could not have been more delighted.  Bruce, our pilot, is a highly experienced commercial pilot and flight instructor, not to mention a tremendously friendly and talented tour guide.   Everyone was cheerful and made us feel welcome.   The scenery was absolutely breathtaking and the flight in the Cessna 172 was smooth and comfortable.   I could not recommend Wings Over Kauai any more highly!

We were tossing up whether to do a helicopter tour or a flight tour around the Island and settled on the flight.  We were to go the day before which was cloudy and rainy and Val (the office manager) called and suggested we delay a day - which we accepted - for both the views and for safety.  The weather turned out to be beautiful - blue skies in the east and south which turned cloudy on the west and over the mountains.  The views and colors of the water, coastline, and mountains were spectacular.  It was just Margaret and myself on the tour on the Cessna with our pilot Bruce. Bruce is a retired geneticist with a PhD from Virginia and has been flying for over 30 years including over 10 years on Kauai. Margaret took the pics from the back while i just took it all in from the front.  Take it - its well worth it.

My husband  and I booked a flight with Wings Over Kauai for our first trip to the island in April 2016.  What a great decision it turned out to be!!!  At check in, Caitlin was fantastic. She took our photo outside the plane and had it ready for us with a CD of the songs we heard on the tour when we returned. She even put together a little cooler with cold rags and ginger candies in case I needed it, which I thought was above and beyond. Bruce was a great pilot and conversationalist.    We saw so many beautiful sights.  I bought the video at the end and have watched it a few times or will just have it on in the background while I cook or clean. :)  Thank you all so much for the wonderful experience.  I am a bit claustrophobic and not the biggest thrill seeker there is. We watched some helicopter tours getting very close to the rocks and things in the canyons one day and were SO glad we chose to do the airplane tour with you instead.   I highly recommend this company. Bruce knows what he's doing and it is worth EVERY penny!!

This was our first tour on Kaua'i and it couldn't have been better. Bruce, the founder of the company, gave my wife and I a fantastic tour, including history, agriculture tidbits and interesting facts about various things. The weather was good our particular flight and turbulence was very minimal.

Later in the week we did a helicopter tour as well and they actually compliment each other nicely. The plane was more comfortable and much quieter than our doors off chopper. Bruce uses high quality headsets and we heard every word he said, unlike the chopper that we missed probably 25% of the dialogue.

The plane stays above most attractions whereas the chopper dips in and out of them. Both are very enjoyable and sort of serve different purposes. I was able to Video the flight too, which will serve as a nice reminder of the trip. They also sell even better videos if you like.

The cost is roughly half of a helicopter, which makes it by far the better value. I highly recommend this tour.

My wife and I did a 9am Cessna trip for two last week and it was without a doubt the highlight of our trip to Kauai. My wife was a bit nervous before the flight but as soon as we took off all of that disappeared. Instead of nerves she spent the hour-long flight in awe of the beauty of Kauai -- even getting tears in her eyes at the sight of the Napali Coast. Marcus was both an awesome pilot and tour guide, and being in a plane enabled us to see sights of the island's interior that simply otherwise would not have been possible. Even with less than ideal weather, particularly with clouds around Hanalei, it was still a great experience and the rainy weather contributed to more dramatic waterfalls in the island's interior. Lastly, the cost of the flight is an outstanding value, being only a bit more than a boat tour of the Napali Coast we had done the previous day and almost half the cost of some helicopter tours we had looked at. I will be recommending this experience to everyone I know who visits Kauai!

review_title: Wonderful pilot, spectacular views of Kauai
review_text: Our party of 6 went on the 4pm flight with Marcus, our pilot. Kate-lynn was very friendly and she made the check in fun and informative. The aircraft is spacious and very comfortable. The noise-cancelling headsets with microphones were perfect, allowing us to ask the pilot questions and talk to each other. The flight was smooth and the views were spectacular. Marcus pointed out so many features of the landscape and his commentary was very interesting. We saw the Napoli coast 3 different ways on this holiday, by foot on a hike, by water from a zodiac and by air, during this flight. The views from this flight are unforgettable and were the best by far. We will do this again when we return to Kauai!

review_title: Amazing Experience, do not miss out!!
review_text: My husband and I took the Cessna tour for two with Bruce and it was the highlight of our visit to Kauai! We took a helicopter tour when we visited the Big Island four years ago which was a little rough, so we opted to try a plane and are so glad we did! Bruce was a wonderful pilot and tour guide and we loved the family atmosphere that Bruce and his family created. We saw amazing scenery throughout our hour long flight and definitely felt like we got the better end of the deal there! If you're debating between a helicopter tour and Wings over Kauai, choose the plane, you won't regret it!!

As a visiting pilot from the mainland my wife and I did an instruction/tour with the owner in the C172. Great flight, great company and all PIC time. I would recommend them to any pilot wanting a supervised flight around Kauai or for their group flights. 

Wonderful family business. Don't forget to pet the beautiful pup at the office!

We did the Cessna Tour for two today. From the moment we checked in with Caitlyn until we touched back down at the airport and our flight with Captain Bruce was over, we felt like the most important clients of the day. Flight conditions were great, the early morning clouds were gone by the time we took to the air at 9am and the sights were wonderful. I have also done a helicopter tour of Kauai, and have to say that the personal attention and roughly 50% cost savings are well worth the minor inconvenience of maybe catching a wing in a picture or two. I also think that the option of buying a video of your particular flight for $50 is a good deal.

It was a wonderful airplane tour over the beautiful island of Kauai. The guide/pilot was a good host. The flight was fairly smooth overall. It provides an interesting perspective of the island and of whales in the ocean as well. Definitely worth doing for the price of admission being so much cheaper than the helicopter tours.

Captain Marcus was absolutely amazing. The views were spectacular,the plane felt very safe, Marcus was incredibly knowledgeable about the island and from the beginning to the end this experience was both perfect and unforgettable. We really appreciated the fact that we all had a window at the right so we saw everything including surealist rainbows and the fact that we could hear music plus explanations very clearly in our headset all trip long. Did not feel anything at the landing because it was so smooth. Only 200% positive things to say about this company. Oh and they also let us reschedule our flight for no fees because on the day it was initially planned it was raining and visibilty would not have been interesting.

An hour long flight in a Gipsland GA-8 Air Van giving us great views as we flew over all the main sights - Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coastline, Hanalie Bay.  Absolutely stunning scenery and with interesting commentary from the pilot.

review_title: Wonderful trip with Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: My husband and I as well as two friends were recently in Kauai for two days on a cruise.  We booked a flight for the four of us in order to get to see the parts of the island that aren't accessible by car.  From beginning to end, our trip was enjoyable.  Val picked us up for the short trip to the airport and also explained to us what to expect on our flight as well as the safety requirements.  She was knowledgable and very enjoyable to speak with.   Marcus was our pilot.   He was great, both in giving us a nice smooth flight and in explaining all the sites around us.  The scenery was beautiful!  We all thoroughly enjoyed the flight and would highly recommend this company.

review_title: Aerial tour worth your time and money!
review_text:
This is our first visit to Kauai.  My wife and I decided to take this aerial tour (two of us with Bruce as the pilot/tour guide) instead of helicopter tour for two reasons.  First, we have the Cessna 172 to ourselves, and it gives me the opportunity to fly the plane (I am a certificated commercial pilot) and learn about mountain flying from Bruce.  Second, it is considerably less expensive than a helicopter ride (and sharing the ride with several others) of the same duration (70 minutes).

The aerial tour goes through all the scenic spots, some of which are simply unreachable by car.  The majestic views of the mountains (especially the Waimea canyon) and the waterfalls are best appreciated from the air.  Bruce spent 7000 flight hours (out of his 13,000) flying around these islands.  No wonder he is so knowledgeable about Kauai.  He has this calm demeanor that would put non-flyers at ease.  I would fly with Bruce any day.  He is a first-rate pilot and tour guide.  We will no doubt drop by Wings Over Kauai and check in with Bruce the next time we come through Kauai!

I am a very anxious flyer but wanted to see the Na Pali coast badly so I booked a private tour in the Cessna.  Bruce was our pilot and he was excellent at giving the tour and making me feel at ease.  I get very bad motion sickness and have a phobia of planes but I would do this again in a heartbeat.  Despite stronger than average winds the day of our flight, it was the smoothest flight (and landing)I have ever experienced thanks to Bruce flying a slightly altered route for us.

review_title: Highly recommend the instructional flight if your interested in flying at all
review_text: My first time in a light plane and Bruce did a great job with both the first time instruction as well as a tour of the island. You don't need any previous flying knowledge, and if you are interested in just having some fun steering an airplane I highly recommend booking an instructional flight. The views were great, and it was so cool flying into a tower controlled airport.

My wife and I were in Hawaii and decided to fly over the Napali coast while in Kauai on April 2nd. After researching our options we settled on  Wings Over Kauai Air Tours. It turned out to be the highlight of our entire trip. Josh was our pilot and he was not only a skillful, well-qualified pilot, but so knowledgeable on what everything was that we were seeing and telling us stories of what movies were filmed in different locations. We flew to the south toward Poipu then turned to the north and flew across Kauai toward Waimea Canyon. Josh described all the sights below. After passing Waimea we came across to the ocean at the top of the Napali coast and flew all along in amazement of the beauty that was passing below. We were all seated on the right side of the plane so it made viewing everything so easy. It was a very clear sunny day and words cannot describe the beauty of the coastline. The hour-long flight went by so quickly and we didn't want it to end. Everyone at Wings Over Kauai were so friendly whether making a reservation, getting our preflight orientation,  talking to the pilot, etc. We even met their dog who hangs out there. First class operation from the ground to the air. We highly recommend using them to see Kauai.

Awesome adventure! Family run business they were warm, welcoming & very knowledgable. If your looking @ options for flight tours hands down this is the one you want!! We did a private tour & Josh was our pilot he knows the island! Ellen & Caitlin were wonderful @ getting us set up & ready for take off. Thank ya'll very much for everything!!

My husband is an experienced pilot with over 5000 hours. I thought he would not like being able to fly the plane on his own as another pilot from the tour must go with you.As it turned out he loved it! The tour guide pilot manned the radio while my husband flew the plane. It helped because the tour pilot knew where to go and pointed out the sites as we flew over. It was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. When and if we come back, we will be sure to do this again. 
    Since we have been back I have heard my husband talk about the trip with his pilot/students and I can tell he really enjoyed the flight

I did a lot of shopping around before I booked with Wings Over Kauai, and I am so glad I booked with them! I really thought that the small place (we did the private 2 person Cessna flight) was the way to go over a crowded helicopter for double the price. The owner was our pilot and his daughter checked us in and got us ready...they were both nice as could be and very eay to deal with when deciding whether or not to go due to sketchy weather. We took his advice and went as scheduled and did not regret it. It is hard to find a day without some kind of weather (wind or some rain) in the winter, but he avoided the areas with low clouds and we saw everything that we wanted to see. We purchased the video for $50 and LOVE IT. They piece it together in house and we picked it up a couple fo days after the flight instead of having to pay $5 for shipping. It is over an hour of perfect footage from the wing and even some bits inside the plane--what a memory. You will not regret booking with this awesome family!

Being a lifelong pilot, adding a new state with a landing & takeoff as PIC (Pilot-In-Command) is a big deal to me.
So when the wife and I decided to vacation in HI and specifically Kauai, I started researching the possibility of renting an aircraft to fly around the island.That is when I discovered Wings Over Kauai & owner Bruce Coulombe.
It turned out to be a great choice and when we finally got to fly (had to re-schedule due to very high winds on the original day we planned to fly) all went smoothly. Bruce handled the radio and acted as our guide while I did the piloting on our circumnavigation of the island in his Cessna 172.
In all we flew just over an hour, saw some breathtaking scenery and added the 35th state (and the hardest one to get) to my logbook.
If you're a pilot, go to Kauai and don't take the opportunity to fly around the island with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai well......your truly missing out on an experience of a lifetime.
Can't wait to see the movies from the Go-Pros attached to the airplane during our flight !!

It was such a great experience dealing with the Wings over Kauai team from the initial contact to the flight 6 months later. Bruce and his son Carter made the day of flight a memorable one, and as a pilot I appreciate their focus on safety and creating a memorable experience. 
This is a must do on Kauai. Forget the helicopters. Save some $ and call Wing Over Kauai. You will never forget the incredible experience in their well qualified hands.
We'll be back next year for a month, and I will be calling Bruce to  get some lessons on hi wind mountain flying  and another tour around the beautiful island of Kauai. Great job everyone!

review_title: You must take the Wings over Kauai sight seeing trip it's the best!
review_text:
Wings over Kauai are the friendliest and most professional company you can book your trip with. I emailed various companies which provide this service and Ellen was the first to respond back, she answered all my questions via email, so helpful friendly, and because of her personal touch I decided to book with Wings, I am so glad I did. I had a wonderful flight. Carter checked me in and Captain Marcus was our pilot, he was so knowledgable about the island and a great pilot, I felt quite safe, seeing the helicopters buzzing in out and about during the trip I am glad I went fixed wing! Wings do a DVD of your flight let them take the pictures and compile a DVD format of your choice, there is so much to see and the scenery is stunning, you will miss so much being behind your own lens! I would highly recommend wings and they deserve 5* plus. Thank you to everyone at 'Wings over  Kauai' for a great morning and for looking after me so well. 
You can even book with Wings and fly yourself over the island, check that option out, even if you haven't flown before! I wish I had done that!

FYI - and Nothing to do with wings! but If you are a solo traveller and/or not driving then the taxi fares to get out to this side of Lihue airport from Koloa are something to factor in $50 each way or thereabouts with tip! But it's worth every penny to see the island from a different perspective!

review_title: Bruce and his team are really great
review_text: We chose our flight with wings over kauai in the cessna because it promised to be a private experience for us as a couple - with great views for both of us (which with other offers was not guaranteed - neither in planes nor in helis). It indeed turned our to be the highlight of our visit, providing us with views that especially on Kauai are only accessible by air. Bruce's expertise and experience as a pilot allowed us to enjoy even the windy weather during the flight. He showed and explained to us all the places of interest and gave us worthwhile recommendations for our further journey and stay on Kauai. We certainly got great value for the price we paid. Our picture, taken in front of the plane was included and the video of the flight was 40$ (no pressure). We recommend Bruce and Wings over Kauai 100 %.

Bruce, the pilot, was very fun and nice! He told us so much about the Island and could answer every question we had. 
He also gives good advises how to be comfortable in the plane in case you are air sick.
It was absolutely fantastic, especially for this price! I paid 130 Dollar and did my flight at 1 pm. 
Would do it again!!
It's worth ist!

Simply no one could charge a price that is equal to the experience with these folks.  From the beginning of registering online and then my calling, "Wings Over Kauai," it has been so much more beneficial than I could have imagined. Ellen was full of spontaneous energy, responding with all kinds of additional help, photos and ideas beyond our flight booking!. At the check in desk is a really interesting and interested woman, Val and I am glad that she shared some of her personal story with the Island and her job, responding to our interests.  Bruce, the pilot is one of those exceptional, rare birds, who possesses so much life talent.  His flight skills are superb, narration is keyed to the folks in the plane, not a canned speech. We were so fortunate the time and date of our flight to have spectacular rare views of nature's phenomena and our pilot was thrilled too. If you are interested in people too, his story of the family journey to this endeavor is truly inspiring.

This was a great flight.  It was slightly windy and bumpy that day but helicopters had the same issues.  We decided to do this flight instead of helicopters so everyone could have a window seat.  The price was better and the views were great.  I would highly recommend you do this sometime while you are on Kauai.  We purchased the video of our flight and it includes the entire flight including music and commentary.  You can re-live it over and over.

PLEASE PLEASE Schedule a flight with Bruce and his team the first day you are on Kauai!
His air tour and commentary are the perfect introduction to the Garden Island and you will spend the rest of your vacation thanking yourself (and Bruce) for the experience.
Lastly, be sure to buy the Blue Ray DVD of your flight!

Not much to add to the already awesome reviews.  The Wings over Kauai Air Tours was totally worth it.  We had a 3 year old and even though she took up a seat, they didn't charge us, which is way nice.  Do buy the video of the flight, we took some good pictures in the plane, but totally worth it to have the hour long video.  Totally wonderful!

review_title: It was the right way to start the week!!!
review_text: Caitlin and Captain Bruce made the entire Kauai vacation an awesome experience. We had great flight mates! Captain Bruce is very personable and engaging. He punctuated our clear and calm morning flight with humor, history, personal stories and a whale sighing. This flight experience was truly a value for dollar. Once we landed, they provided us with a personalized gift to remember the incredible event. Thank you Wings Over Kauai.    Mahalo A Hui Hou

review_title: Spectacular Views Delivered by this Family-Run Business
review_text: Wings Over Kauai was one of the first tours we booked when planning for our stay on Kauai January 29, 2015. The cost was more than we usually spend for an excursion but we found out it was worth it. We walked a short distance from where our ship (Pride of America) was anchored to meet up with Mary from WOK. She drove us to the Lihue Airport where we met her brother, Carter. Carter made us feel at ease as we went through the registration process. He then took us out to meet the little Cessna that would take us to see spectacular sights, many untouched by man. We climbed into the plane after a quick photo shoot and were then introduced to our pilot, Bruce (Mary and Carter's dad). For the next 70 minutes, Bruce did an excellent job sharing his beautiful island with us. We flew over the Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coastline and viewed many waterfalls, including the one from Jurassic Park. Our only complaint was that the flight ended too soon. As we exited the plane, Bruce handed us a very special gift (it's a secret, you'll have to take the tour to find out). We were lucky to have a clear, calm day for our flight so the use of motion medication was not necessary but WOK was prepared with ginger chews just in case. We were so pleased with this tour and thank each member of the WOK team for sharing their talents with us.

We had a great flight with Wings over Kauai.  Weather was fantastic, not a cloud in the sky.   Everyone is so friendly, and very personable.   Bruce the pilot gives you a narrative of the island as you fly by all the points of interest.   I found this to be a better value than a helicopter ride, and in my view felt safer.   You were not as close to the points, but I think this gave you a better panoramic view of the island.   This was definitely the best excursion we have been on.   If you do this trip, do it early in your stay, and you can plan the things that looked interesting from the flight.

My husband and I booked a tour with Wings Over Kauai during our honeymoon in the Cessna and it was way over our expectations! 
First, Bruce (the pilot) welcomed us and introduced himself, then his son, Carter, made the check-in and showed us the route.
Carter took a picture of us with the Cessna and the flight could begin!
Bruce truly loves his job and commented the flight with a lot of very interesting information about the island. We flew over the waimea canyon, the breathtaking Na Pali Coast, the best beaches like Poipu, Tunnels and Anini, the most amazing waterfalls and towns like Princeville. We even saw a whale !
And after this wonderfull time Carter surprised us with some gifts ! 
Wings over Kauai is a family business, every members' job is to offer you the best moment ever ! So don't hesitate, book with them, you won't be disappointed !
And to immortalize this amazing moment we bought the video for only 50$ !

review_title: Amazing views, great experience, reasonably priced.

review_text:

review_title: Very Best Way To See Kauai
review_text: Great service and a very friendly and knowledgable staff.   As a licensed pilot, I did an instructional flight in the company's Cessna 172S.  The plane was well maintained and provided the sky-hawk's usual stable and comfortable flight. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai, and will fly with them again on our next visit.

review_text:

of the island in a single-engine airplane
