review_title: Warm & Personal Way to see The Gorgeous Island of Kauai
review_text:
My husband and I decided to take a tour with Wings Over Kauai after reading their great reviews. We are happy to report back all the good reviews were true. Bruce and his team were warm and inviting. My husband has had a private pilots license for over 20 years, I have never been up in a small plane. Bruce made me feel right at home and any nerves I had were quickly abolished by both Bruce's warmth and humor as well as the views and his smooth steady flying. This was an exceptional way to see the full breath of this island, one where in so much of its most dramatic beauty is locked away by mountain terrain and best experienced from above. This first timer was thrilled and my husband was in flying heaven. The price
Of a plane tour is considerably lower then a helicopter tour, and the duo flight (just the two of us with one very knowledgable pilot)  was very personal and very informative. We'd do it again in a heartbeat, and couldn't recommend this experience more.

As I have my pilots license we did the instructional flight which meant I was able to fly the airplane while Marcus gave directions and a great commentary of the sights. It is an awesome place to fly and this was a highlight of our trip to the island. Next time we visit we will go for a fly again.

As a pilot with a student certificate, I wanted to take the controls myself and Wings over Kauai was the obvious choice. We booked an instructional flight in the 172 with Bruce, the owner of the company. Now, for all certified pilots out there: you will not be able to rent a plane by yourself in Kauai and neither should you. The tour traffic (especially helicopters) is busy, constant and organized. It is important to check in on the advisory frequency for position updates and if you don't know the informal landmarks, you'll be spending your flight trying to figure out which valley a chopper is going to pop out out of next. Additionally, you have to deal with mountain/ocean flying, comply with noise abatement rules and the Pacific Missile Range restricted area. Let Bruce handle the radio and big picture navigation so you can enjoy the flying and scenery. 

Since my flight was pre-checkride, Bruce threw in a few exam questions here and there, gave me general directions, offered some helpful tips that you can only get from an 11,000 hour pilot, and otherwise let me pick my path between the clouds. He pointed out landmarks and places of interest, and supplied some tour-guide type narration. 

We had a good weather day (there are always some clouds in Kauai) and the view was spectacular. We followed the established clockwise direction around the island which is flown by all tour aircraft. We saw whales, the steep cliffs of the Na'pali Coast, craters, beaches, reefs etc. 

The main difference to a helicopter tour (which we did the same day) is that helicopters can get into spaces the plane cannot. The two are different experiences. With the helo rides you're part of a group and get herded like cattle through the safety video and the tour. With the plane, you miss out on those tight canyons and close-up waterfalls, but you have your own plane and can pick your route. Plus, it's a lot cheaper AND YOU GET TO FLY YOURSELF. If you load the plane with 3 people the price is about $100 per person/hour. Compare that to $260/person on the choppy for the 55 min ride. Plus, if you're stuck in the back middle seats on the helo, your visibility is quite restricted. On the Cessna the windows might be smaller, but at least everyone has their own. 

Anyway, we returned to Lihue Airport, I made a nice-enough landing, and taxied back to the ramp in front of two Hawaiian Airlines Boeings. If you're a pilot, you know what I'm talking about. 

All in all, Wings over Kauai is a down-to-earth, family-run small business, and not a multi-island, slick and smooth helo operation. No memorabilia shop, t-shirts and upsells. They have GoPros mounted on the plane for those who like that sort of thing, but they don't push their video as much as the other outfits. Wings over Kauai is a more than viable alternative to the helicopter rides, especially if you don't want to spend $750 for a family of three. They also have a Cessna Caravan for larger groups (or mixed groups).

Long time we were not sure eigher to do the heli or a fixed wing flight. Because of the  excellent reviews we chose wings over kauai and it was the best thing we could do! Ellen and Bruce welcomed us warmly. Everything was well organised. As we were only 4 passengers they made sure that everybody could sit on the right side as most is seen from this side. Our pilot Josh was amazing not only as a pilot but also as a guide as he told us a lot of interesting things about Kauai. This island from above is even more marvellous as it is already by land. This flight was definitly a highlight of our Hawaii-honeymoon! Thanks so much you guys for this great experience!

review_title: The best way to see the beauty of the Garden Island!
review_text: Pilot Bruce was a fabulous and jovial companion for our flight tour. The flight was smooth and filled with interesting and notable secrets of the island. He shares fun facts about famous people who reside there and movies that have been filmed on the island. The views from the plane are breath taking and I cannot imagine being able to really witness the beauty of the island without doing it via air. The tour is considerably less expensive than the helicopter tours and it's nice to support a small local business of only 4 folks. Definitely recommend this to anyone looking to enhance their vacation!

It was a perfect day for our flight tour - no wind, no cloud, crystal clear sky. Our pilot was Bruce - the boss of this small company, a very friendly and professional guy who also gave us a lot of great suggestions about food/ beach/trail on Kauai. Me and my boyfriend took the private couple flight with the smaller plane, which is a great choice as we were the only two passenger on the flight and we could ask Bruce whatever we want. Very amazing view on Kauai island - numerous waterfalls, red land and canyon, pretty coast line of Na Pali... Would highly recommend this tour to anyone, it's twice cheaper than a helicopter tour and can see literally everything on Kauai, just in a bigger distance than helicopter tour.

We took our 3 kids (8, 10 and 12) for a flight over Kauai.  It was amazing. We had the choice of rescheduling due to high winds and it was very easy to do and were able to get a good time that worked while we were on the island.  I do suggest if you are staying more than a few days on the island that you book your flight early so you have the option to reschedule due to weather.  My son loved the headphones and microphone so he talked almost the entire flight and Josh our pilot answered all his questions even the ones that were not related to anything we were seeing.  Josh was very informed, friendly and professional.  We all had a wonderful time.

review_title: Best way to see Kauai quickly
review_text:
We visited Kauai while cruising on the Pride of America, which provided a limited amount of time to see the island.  Fortunately for us, we researched flights and decided on Wings Over Kauai due to it being a family-owned business with excellent reviews.  Our decision was rewarded greatly, they are wonderful folks to work with and everything was as smooth as could be.

I was very surprised to have Bruce himself pick us up at the ABC store, he is a very nice man and shared a lot about how he started WOK as a "hobby" after retiring.  Check-in with Val was a breeze and soon Josh had us flying high above island, seeing all of the key sights during our one hour flight.  We saw more than could have ever been done with a bus tour, and the insights that Josh provided really made the trip special.  My wife was a bit apprehensive as she is not a fan of small planes, but she loved it and said she was more comfortable than on a larger plan.  

This flight was one of the highlights of our 11 day trip and should not be missed.

Best experience of our trip. Josh was a great pilot and tour guide. Worth every penny.
Anyone that comes to Kauai and doesn't take this flight is missing out. Josh stayed out of the turbulence and gave us a smooth and enjoyable ride.

review_title: The highlight of my Hawaiian holiday
review_text: This is a must do for anyone visiting the island of Kauai.  The scenery and views that you get from taking this small plane is spectacular.  My friend and I were travelling on the Pride of America cruise ship and we arranged to do this flight as it was a lot cheaper than the helicopter flights and excursions offered by the ship.  I'm so glad we did as everything was so professional from start to finish.  When we arrived at the airfield we were shown our flight path on a map.  We boarded the flight, adjusted our headsets and the music from Hawaii 5 0 started playing as we raced down the runway.  The whole event was spectacular with magnificent views only seen from the plane as there was no access by road to some of the landscapes we flew over.  We mentioned we hoped to see some whales and our very experienced pilotJosh managed to spot 3 whales in the water just off the coast.  What struck me most was that from the plane you could see the whole scale of the island whereas the helicopters flew so close to the canyon I can't help feeling you wouldn't be able to grasp the grandeur and scale of the canyon and surrounds.  Josh was very informative about the history of the island and its many characteristics.  The Napoli coastline, the canyons, the waterfalls etc it was all such a wonderful experience I would love to do it again but the next best thing is being able to buy the dvd which is edited to show the flight without any glare or reflection that my camera picked up. If you take this flight you'll also be able to meet Millie the sweetest, friendliest dog who sometimes likes to ride shotgun in the plane.

We really had a great time with Wings Over Kauai.  We were in the area for a day and a half on the Pride Of America cruise ship.  I decided to schedule our flight for 930am the second day.  The first day we arrived it was pretty cloudy and rainy, so I was bummed that the weather was going to stay the same and we wouldn't see much.  Thankfully the second day it was totally clear and nice!  Even the top of Waialeale was clear!

The day of our trip we were picked up promptly near the cruise ship as arraigned.  We went over the basics- safety, weigh-in, and some pictures next to the plane.  Our pilot was Josh (a former American Airlines pilot), and he got us buckled in to our assigned seats.  I was in the copilot seat, and my wife was behind me.  Once in the air, Josh told us lots of facts about what we were seeing while music played.  The Na Pali coast was beautiful and we had great viewing weather.  I did get a bit of haze in my pictures, which looked worse on the camera's LCD than the final picture (I used a telephoto lens with a polarizing filter).  Before we knew it, it was time to land.  I really enjoyed getting to listen to air traffic control the whole time also.

Once back at the airport, they gave everyone a free gift (I won't ruin the surprise).  They also offered to sell us a DVD of the full flight, filmed by GoPros mounted under the wings and inside the cabin.  The price was very reasonable, and it arrived by the time we got home.  It was a great keepsake to have, and the views were so much better than what I captured on my camera.  They offered to drop us off back at the cruise ship or the mall, and gave my wife a flower for her hair.  Everyone we met was extremely nice and we really enjoyed the flight.

One note, if you have even the slightest problem with motion sickness, take a dramamine pill before you fly.  We were lucky to have a pretty smooth flight, but small slow planes like this are more prone to thermals and winds than large jets.  We experienced a few quick stomach-drops, that felt kind of a like a roller coaster hill.  My wife did feel a little airsick, but the dramamine stopped her from throwing up.  They do have a cooler on board with sprite and ginger chews, but better safe than sorry.

Don't hesitate to get a great view of Kauai, book a flight!

I am a return client with Wings Over Kauai. I took this air tour in December 2013 and again this December 2015. In my opinion, this is better than taking an open door helicopter tour. I did the open door helicopter air tour and this air tour both in 2013. I returned to do this one. It is the BEST deal on Kauai. 
The owners, Bruce and Ellen, were so nice and took excellent care of me with my reservation and flight. Be assured that you will have the time of your life on this air tour. Call ahead because they are in high demand, and their is a reason for it- Great Service and Price. Best Wishes and Thanks to you Ellen and Bruce

We live on the island and have been on the helicopter tour a few times and decided to try the fixed wing flight. We thoroughly enjoyed the flight. We would now recommend this over the helicopter. We really liked the service, and the flight. Thanks so much for the tour. First rate all the way!

review_title: Great Flight - friendly service - excellent value
review_text:
We very much enjoyed the flight with the air van of Wings over Kauai. We have long thought to take a helicopter flight instead, but after this experience we would always recommend to take the plane. It is slow enough so that you enjoy all sights long enough from every seat. And the flight with Wings over Kauai is more the 1 hour, so considering the speed of the aircraft it takes you to more of the Island than helicopters can, and all for half the money!
Crew and Pilot were very nice and professional. Together with the background Information provided by the Pilot and "on the spot" Music we can really recommend it!

review_title: Private Pilot - Do your own flight around the island
review_text:
As private pilot, I was able to rent a Cessna with one of the CFI instructors from the company, and do my own tour around the island, taking my family for the nice personal flight tour. 

Wings over Kauai office is located at the airport and you will depart and land at the same airport used by all airplanes that land on the island. The flight around the island, including flying over all local attractions will take up to 1 hour to complete. Because of the water (ASL to 3,500 feet AGL), you will experience clouds below, above and around you. The flight includes mountain flying as well as flying over the water, so get ready to polish your private pilot flying skills.

review_title: Classy outfit at an affordable price
review_text:
This was an unparalleled aerial experience of Kauai in a 6-passenger plane ... and we each got a window seat because "Wings Over Kauai" didn't fill the others on purpose. My wife, usually uncomfortable in helicopters, was enjoyed the 65 min small plane ride. 

They picked us up from our Cruise ship (Pride of America) in Kauai on a crystal clear Nov. day and drove us to the airstrip for safety brief and the flight. The main difference from a helicopter ride was we didn't come very close to the cliffs, yet got a spectacular aerial view of beautiful Kauai. Our young, handsome and personable pilot delighted my wife, and completed our 5 star experience. We recommend this highly to enjoy the picturesque Kauai because you can never experience this from land, and it did not break our bank either.

review_title: Don't miss this when in Kauai!
review_text: We LOVED this Amazing and affordable flight around the island. There are genuine, great folks running the company that truly care for your experience and don't just see you as another tourist. Very informative, professional, friendly and saftey-minded pilot.  It would be a shame to miss this, we are so glad we did it early to get a panorama of the whole island.

review_title: First time on Air tour and it was awesome!!
review_text: Josh our Pilot is knowledgeable and very friendly.  we changed our date once because of weather and staff on the phone was also friendly. on the day of flight,  it was clear sky on major part of island. my wife had aloha time on the flight but apart form that experience was nice!!

The crew were amazing, the flight outstanding.... I can not say enough about this crew/ company... Don't leave the island with out taking this flight!!!! 

They also pick you right up at the pier and return you...bonus!!! 
Thank you Josh, Bruse and Angel 

Paula and John Lawrence from NB Canada

review_title: This is a must for pilots
review_text: As I could not find a plane to just rent, I reverted to a flight instructor. While it is anyway a good idea to get a bit of introduction at a new place you fly, this was a particularly good choice. Bruce combined his hints for over water and windy mountain flying with wonderful tourist guide capabilities. Also reception and other services were first class.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text:
We were a couple visiting Kauai for just 1 day as part of a cruise from Los Angeles to Tahiti on Crown Princess and decided to book Wings Over Kauai well in advance. The flight came highly recommended and we thought the price of $125 per person was very good value for such a tour. Ellen, one of the company's owners was in contact with me via e-mail from the start and answered my many questions about the flight promptly. 
On the day of the flight we made our way to the meeting point close to the ship (the ABC store at Anchor Cove Mall) where we were transported to the airfield by a friendly lady in a van (sorry, I forget her name). We were briefed about the flight in advance and then Bruce, Ellen's husband, took us and another couple up in his plane. We wore a headset, so could ask questions and Bruce communicated with us as the flight progressed and gave us info about the island. The flight was fantastic and lasted around 1 hr 10 mins and we got to see all of Kauai and places that are inaccessible by vehicles. 
I would not hesitate to recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone, as it's a very reliable and safe company to enjoy a short flight over this picturesque island.

This was a huge highlight of our trip to Kauai. We booked online and  we met Bruce who made us feel very welcome.  Mary checked us in and we enjoyed her friendly manner and helpfulness. Josh our pilot, was awesome. We felt very comfortable with him and he was very informative and a very experienced pilot. We loved every part of the trip and we were amazed at the incredible scenery. Just do it, well worth it. Thank you guys for our wonderful flight. Looking forward to showing our family and friends in Australia  the Dvd that you recorded for us. Sue, Brenton, Taylah and Josh. 😁

What an excellent tour!!  Our pilot, Josh, was knowledgeable and professional, giving us plenty of information about the island. We considered a helicopter flight, but had concerns about motion sickness and the price.  All our expectations were exceeded.
Thanks again Val and Josh, for a great way to end our time on Kauai.

We had an amazing time with Wings Over Kauai.  Our flight the afternoon before was cancelled because the winds were too strong.  We had the plane to ourselves the following afternoon because the other couple did not show up.  The pilot, Marcus, was great.  He explained and commented on everything we saw and more.  I took tons of photos!  One thing, if you are prone to motion sickness,  take some pills.  The wind was strong and so it was quite bumpy.  Fortunately they had drink and a cold towel so it helped my husband. I was fine.  A fantastic experience!  Highly recommended!

We booked this trip kind of last minute (the day before) after doing a little research into the best ways to view the Na'Pali Coast. We were trying to decide if we should fly with Wings Over Kauai or take a boat tour. Since it was November, and the waves had been pretty choppy, we decided not to take a several hour boat tour and booked a private morning flight with Wings. 
We were contacted by Wings the night before the trip, saying that the private tour had to be cancelled but that they could re-book us for a late afternoon flight with two other people. We re-booked the flight and were given a partial refund for the inconvenience (which was very nice of them). 
The afternoon flight was absolutely amazing!! The Wings Over Kauai staff were all very friendly and experienced. Our pilot, Josh, was very calm, confident, and he told us so many interesting facts about places on the island that we were flying over. The weather was beautiful and we saw everything that we wanted to see, including the Na'Pali Coast. The flight had a few bumps flying through a couple of light rain showers, but we never felt unsafe. It was such a great experience that I wish we could have been able to do one more lap around the island!!

review_title: Highlight of our visit to Kaua'i
review_text:
I found Wings Over Kaua'i through a Tripadvisor thread debating heli tours vs fixed wing. I am prone to motion sickness, plus we were treating my in-laws, so four tickets would be a little pricy. I was glad to see the good reviews of the plane tours and thought it would be easier on my stomach and wallet. I booked through their website just a few days before our tour. 

We took the early morning flight at 9am and it was a good thing because it was calm and clear but rainy later in the day. Everyone from Ellen picking us up, to Bruce and Angel taking care our prep, to Josh as pilot- just wonderfully nice and friendly people. Josh did the best job of keeping the flight as smooth as possible. The crew even  sent along a small cooler with ginger chews and sprite in case of motion sickness, something I really appreciated. The narration, music, and of course the views made this an absolutely wonderful experience. I recommend them highly.

What a great way to see Kauai.  The experience was amazing.  What makes this  flight so special is that you really come away with seeing all of the Island.  I call it a geographical tour.  As the helicopter tours get you very close to the mountains, Wings Over Kauai gets you close enough.  You also fly around Black Mountain and along the Poipu Coast--The helicopter tours head from the Lihue Airport across the island to the canyon--no Poipu.    Instead of seeing a flight through your camera lens you can order a CD of your personalized tour for a minimal cost--all this and it still doesn't cost as much as a helicopter tour.  The pilots give a great commentary on what you are looking at and are happy to answer questions.  This tour really puts the Island of Kauai in perspective.

review_title: Great way to view the Island
review_text: We had already done a great photo tour but had heard about this air tour from some friends who took it a few years ago.  Since I tend to have a little motion sickness I did not want to take the bumpier helicopter tour.  This was very smooth...and our pilot, Marcus, was very proficient in his piloting skills and we encountered only a few seconds of bumpiness.  The view was awesome.  Each participant wears a headset with a microphone to communicate with each other.  There was pleasant and very appropriate music during the flight as well.  We got some beautiful pictures and you really get a better perspective of the island and its distinct parts (beaches, mountains, waterfalls, etc.)  And don't let a few clouds deter your interest...the weather looked very sketchy at best but turned out to be great once we got up in the air (11:00 tour). I also saved a few bucks by calling directly to book.  It's well worth your time and money - highly recommend it!  And PS, they gave us a special gift - a DVD of the island (not our tour which you CAN purchase for an additional $35) but all in all a great unexpected keepsake including our picture in front of the plane as the cover of the disk.)

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Recommended Air Tour
review_text:
We flew with Josh in late September, and were very happy that we chose Wings Over Kauai over a helicopter tour.   There's good reason why there's over 1800 excellent ratings for this company.  

We are in our early 50s and had concern about the helicopter tours, with the movement of the copter as well as potential motion sickness.  We chose the Wings Over Kauai tour with the 6 passenger Air Van, although they do have a 2 passenger Cessna.  We're posting a picture of us viewing the scenery out the window, and you can see that the window has plenty of viewing area.  Review their website, wingsoverkauai.com, as it contains all the information necessary to make the choice of the tour right for you.

Angel was working their front desk and was a really pleasant young man who went over the paperwork prior to the flight.  There is a restroom across from their check-in counter that you can use prior to the flight.  Josh was our pilot and he was outstanding.  Knowing that he does tours day in and day out, and it's bound to be tiring at times, he still made us feel as though this was his exclusive tour for us.

We saw Bruce dropping off individuals from the cruise ship for the tour following us, and he, too, had wonderful aloha considering all the people that cross his path on a daily basis.

We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

I had set up Wings Over Kauai several months prior to our trip to Kauai because I didn't want to miss out.  This was the most fantastic tour.  Josh was the pilot and he was awesome.  The entire flight was fantastic.  Josh made us feel like family and we learned so much from this tour. The weather was perfect and we able to see everything with clear skys.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!!!!

Like many, I read TA a lot but don't often feel the need to post. Flew in their smaller plane, the Cessna 172, recently on the standard around-the-island tour. Excellent narration and as most everyone else has already said, wonderful scenery. All I have to add is that I was impressed at this operator's excellent attention to safety details. The aircraft was clean, well equipped and obviously well maintained. Pilot knew his stuff. No worries at all. Having retired after 40+ years flying for a major airline, I think I'm qualified to say "great job". Nice landing, too, 
The three Gopros on the aircraft are recording all flight and, yes, it is very well worth it to order the optional DVD or Blu-ray [or online download] to show your friends and family back home how great Kauai looks from above. No stock footage. It's all recorded on your flight.

We debated fixed wing or helicopter ride over Kauai and decided on the fixed wing ride.  We had very good weather as there was very little cloud cover at the top of the mountains so we good views everywhere.  Josh did a good job narrating the flight.  I enjoyed listening in on radio communications during the flight.

Our flight on Wings Over Kauai was spectacular.  I can well see why this is TripAdvisor's top rated activity.  Markus our pilot, was super with great knowledge of the island features.  He was very engaging and entertaining and provided us with first hand experience for some of the activities we wanted to do..  The flight was smooth with indescribable views of the island from the air.  This is a beautiful island to visit and having an "over view" of the island gave us an opportunity to orient ourselves to where we wanted to go and what areas we definitely wanted to see. 

I cannot explain in words the beauty of the Hawaiian Islands and especially Kauai other than to say experience it for yourself.  When you do come to Kauai make sure you take this flight as it will provide you with the most spectacularly visual experience you have ever had.  I have been on Helicopter tours before and the fixed wing adventure provided by Wings Over Kauai, blows them away.

review_title: Fantastic tour!!  A must for Kauai!
review_text: We went in their small plane for the tour over Kauai, there were six of us including the pilot.  They picked us up at the ABC store, just up the street from the pier, where our ship docked.  If you don't want to take the ten minute walk you can jump on the free shuttle that takes you to the little mall where the ABC store located.  When I read all the previous comments about Wings Over Kauai we decided to go with them, and we're very happy we did!!  For $125.00 US we got a whole hour in the air.  If they keep that up they will continue to be busy and recommended by people like myself.  I've already told many people to go with them.  They were nice enough to offer us free water and pop during our flight, that was great!  The best part of the tour, is seeing Kauai, it's beautiful!!  For anyone sitting on the passenger side of the plane, you will see better.  If your on the pilots side, you will see everything but not as well and throughly as the others, but the pilot does try his best.  I think it's due to the time it takes to fly the plane around so everyone can see as well.  I would still recommend it anyways.  If price doesn't matter and you want a shorter ride then you can take a helicopter ride, which flies lower and takes you closer to the mountains.  Make sure to bring your camera!!  Go to the washroom and get in the plane!!  They do have good walk up steps to the plane, so even if you have some disabilities you shouldn't have a problem.  If you leave yourself three hours from getting to the mall, filling out the paperwork, getting weighed, get on the plane and the flight back, you should be good.  Ellen picked us up and was,so nice.  We met her husband and our pilot, Josh, along with Ellen's daughter, and they were all so nice and friendly.  Josh was an excellent,pilot, constantly talking to us all during the flight and answering any questions we had.  Can't lose taking this tour, especially as its the only way to see the canyon and the Na Pali coast without hiking and a boat, which would take days.  Kauai is so beautiful and you appreciate it more from the air.

Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff. 

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing. 

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.

We would highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone wanting to see Kauai from the air. Easy to book, the guys are enthusiastic and a delight to fly with. Our pilot Josh was very knowledgable about the island and the perfect tour guide. We are a family with two under-tens and the 60 minute flight time was no problem for them. Anyone looking for an aerial view of this amazing island should look no further than these guys.

This was probably one of the most incredible experiences of our lives, but definitely a honeymoon highlight. Weather was clear so we were able to see the top of the highest mountain and had phenomenal views of Waimea canyon and Hanalei valley. There were four of us on our flight and we all had window seats. We managed to film most of the trip, just a couple of challenges with sun glare (we flew at 1 pm on a very sunny day). I had taken a motion sickness medication as a precaution and didn't experience any problems but also don't think I would have anyway based on how smooth the flight was. Very skilled and knowledgeable pilot!

Time constraints prevented us from seeing Weimea Canyon and other wonders from the ground, but this trip allowed us to feel like we still experienced Kauai.  Just wish we had done this first, as it would have helped us prioritize the rest of our stay particularly as to beaches. 

The Wings Over Kauai team made us feel comfortable from the start, and our pilot Josh maintained that Aloha vibe throughout the flight.  My wife wasn't entirely comfortable with the idea of a helicopter ride, but an airplane flight was more than acceptable as an alternative.  Excellent views, humorous and informative narration, and a smooth ride.  A highlight of our trip to Kauai.

review_title: Sheri and Gary wings over Kauai
review_text: This was the most amazing hour of my life.. What a wonderful tour company all the way from pickup by Ellen to the incredible flight by Captain Josh and his unbelievable expertise on the island of Kauai.. If you are looking for a true Hawaiian experience this is the tour company for you!!!  Mahalo from Sheri and Gary

review_title: Fantastic way to see the island!
review_text: We debated whether to see the Na Pali coastline from a boat or the air.  After many tripadvisor reviews, we decided to go by air and opted for a plane over a helicopter (again, based on review comments).  We think we made a great decision.  The ocean was pretty rough while we were there, which might have made a sea journey by catamaran less fun and probably would have eliminated the snorkel option those tours offer.  Besides, we got a great view of the coastline from the air and saw parts of the rest of the island that we would never have seen otherwise.  Val prepped us for our flight at the Wings over Kauai office and her pleasant demeanor put everyone at ease.  Captain Josh was a great pilot, maneuvering us in and out of canyons and over the ocean without a bump.  There really is no better way to get a sense of how much diversity and beauty there is on this island w/o seeing it from the air.  We have a number of vacation videos that go unwatched, but I'm sure we'll be watching the flight video from this trip several times.  Thank you Val and Josh (and Millie, the nicest dog you ever met)!  We had a great time and it was the highlight of our stay on  Kauai!

We were a party of 5 and took the private air van tour over Kauai on October 12th. It was an absolute pleasure with Captain Bruce and his daughter Mary was very lovely with check in and making sure we were comfortable.  
The flight was seamless and smooth and Captain Bruce had a wealth of knowledge over the island. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai because it was a great experience to see the the true beauty of the entire island by air.

y 2 friends and I took this tour on Sunday,  October 11th but our experience with this company began on the Friday evening before when I called after hours and was pleasantly surprised to be talking to a real live person! I expected to leave a message on an answering machine as I had done with every other tour company I had called before calling Wings Over Kauai but not only did a very pleasant lady answer the phone and all my questions but I was able to book our tour with her as well. I could tell this was truly a family business because I could hear children playing in the background! 😊 On the day of our tour we were greeted with a big welcoming smile from another young lady named Mary, who was Bruce's daughter. Bruce is the owner of the company and he was our pilot! Bruce was so warm and friendly that we immediately felt right at home in his plane. He was so knowledgeable about the island and he had such a great sense of humor that he kept us intrigued and laughing throughout the entire flight! In case you're wondering, yes we saw the Jurassic Park sites too but way too soon our 70 minutes were up and we returned to the airport but we were each agreed that we will definitely be taking the tour again when we return to Kauai and recommending it to all our friends. Oh, I forgot to mention that our tour time slot did not fill up and yet, Bruce did not attempt to reschedule or cancel our tour,  so we had a private tour and the price did not increase! Great guy, great company, definitely book you Aerial Tour with Wings Over Kauai!!!

Our party of two couples booked this trip about 2 1/2 months before cruising around the Hawaiian Islands on NCL's Pride of America. Everything - having questions answered, booking ease ,being transported to and from the airport, meeting friendly owners, and having a very capable, knowledgeable pilot was first class. We had a private flight with just the four of us and the pilot. I had taken a helicopter ride over the island about.30 years ago and believe this equals, if not excels, that experience. Since the plane can go higher,you get more panoramic views of beautiful Kauai. We were fortunate to have a beautiful, sunny day for our 2:30 PM flight.

We thoroughly enjoyed our Wings Over Kaua'i tour during our honeymoon.  Bruce was knowledgeable, informative, fun, and an experienced and safe pilot.   It was a very smooth flight with beautiful views.  Highly recommend!

Bruce and Mary did a great job of making you feel welcome. Bruce made an effort to get to know us before take off, and did an excellent job engaging the passengers during the flight and describing view. There were even beverages provided on the flight! I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai to see this island by air.

Took this trip on the advice of a local aviation pro who knows the company.

Couldn't have been more pleased....from check in through the flight everything was smooth and easy.  Covered the entire island without rushing.  You truly see things that you're never going to see any other way.

The plane (Air Van) was perfect because there are no middle seats and everyone gets a window which really adds to the experience.  The pilot (Josh) struck the right balance between being informative (and answering questions) and letting us just take in the vistas.

Difference between this and a helo ride (besides price) is that Wings over Kauai puts you in a 'bigger picture' and adds a greater degree of context as to where you are and how the island fits together.

Just can't say enough good things about this outfit

This was my first time to Kauai, and I fell in love with this beautiful island with this first flight! My husband and I visited Kauai via cruise ship. Knowing we only had a limited time we wanted to see as much as we could. Wow we got much more than we expected. We got to see the all the island with the most breath taking views. And thanks to Marcus our pilot, we got to to hear the rich history and variety that the island has to offer. We actually went to one of the waterfalls we saw from air first thing when we got back to land. We would of never known about it with out him. I can't wait to go back and see all the hikes and beaches he pointed out. He was so friendly and I have to say it was the smoothest plane ride I have ever been. If you can only do one thing in Kauai- do this!!!!

review_title: The best company to fly with over Kauai
review_text:
This was by far the most memorable and beautiful way to see Kauai.  Wings over Kauai is a great company to choose.  They only put people on the side of the plane with a view, rather than packing the plane to get the most money.  Our pilot was an American Airlines pilot which made the experience feel safer!  They also postponed out flight when the weather was too cloudy for a good view.  Other companies were taking off, more concerned with making money rather than giving their customers a great experience.

 The experience was breathtaking.  We would not hesitate to fly with them again and it's on our bucket list for our next trip to Kauai.

We also bought the DVD from our flight which was beautiful.
Rick Ellen and Jenna from CT

I have to admit, I was a bit nervous to ride in this itty bitty plane.  But I was pleasantly surprised.  Our pilot (Bruce), was phenomenal pilot.  Having never been in such a tiny plane, I did not know what to expect and I was amazed that the take off and landing were so smooth.  You wear headphones and everyone can have conversations during the flight.  Bruce did a great job explaining all the different parts of the island, from the trees, waterfalls, movies filmed on the island, great beach spots and hiking trails.  Once you're up in the air, the  views are unbelievable.  Kauai is such a beautiful island, and to experience it from this plane makes you appreciate the island in its entirety.  We went as a family and my son brought his 2 month old baby.  The plane engine purrrred her to sleep.  It was a great experience.
Same as all the other reviewers - this was a great flight from a great team. Highly recommended. This is a can't-miss tour.

My husband and I had an amazing air tour with Marcus and Wings Over Kauai!  We took the private Cessna tour.  Marcus was very knowledgeable and made the flight even more enjoyable than we expected!  You have to see Kauai from the air to truly experience the beauty of the island and I highly recommend using Wings over Kauai!

Bruce and Wings Over Kauai is Exceptional! For our honeymooon, I decided to book Wings Over Kauai with the cruise add on with Blue Dolphin. We scheduled it for the first full day of our visit as recommended on the site. I called to reserve and Bruce was extremely helpful in answering all my questions regarding what to expect, the difference between helicopter and airplane and he answered questions about the cruise.  When we arrived for the ride, we were greeted by his daughter and she took us to get weighed (don't worry she won't tell you what it says unless you want to know) then gave the women a  kukui lei and a flower for behind the ear.  Then she went over the sites we would be seeing on a map of Kauai and went over the safety information.  After, we were greeted by our pilot and owner, Bruce.  He got a picture of us in front of the plane, got us strapped in and we started pre-check.  Bruce was very energetic and engaging by involving us in the pre-check and all the pre-flight items.  Once we were off, the views were spectacular! The windows were large and I got over 600 beautiful aerial and close up pictures. I didn't have any issues with glare (I was worried) and he even paused a little longer to get shots if asked via the headset.  Upon landing, he informed us that he has a compiled list of his favorite things to do on Kauai.  This list included hidden spots to visit, parks, restaurants and more.   In addition, as we de-boarded the plane, his daughter greeted us with the list of Bruce's Favorites and our own copy of a DVD of a flight (not ours, but another one his son made), but our picture was on the front! How cool is that?!?!  

I highly recommend this company, as they truly show Mahalo to everyone. They will go above and beyond to make your visit memorable. You will not regret anything, but only be earning to go again.

Wings over Kauai Air Tours proivde an amazing, very friendly and professional service. The view was stunning. We highly recommend choosing Wings over Kauai Air Tours if you are considering to explore Hawaii by air. 
Thank you for the great flight.

Here's why I gave them a 5 star even though we didn't fly with them. I booked a flight with their smaller Cessna plane so my wife and I would have a better experience seeing the island. Well, thunderstorms were in the area so we rescheduled a later in the day flight with a call ahead. The weather stayed sour so I re booked our flight. Two days later the weather was still bad at 9am flight time so they held a slot open for us for a 2pm flight. We stopped back at 2pm and I talked with the owner, Bruce about our options. Radar still showed rain over parts of the island with a lot of lower cloud cover. After looking at the next days forecast which seemed much improved we rescheduled again for the  next day at 3:30pm. The day we were flying out of Kauai to go back home. 
The next days weather was 100% better. We arrived at Wings over Kauai at three for check-in. After the Cessna came back in we chatted with the pilot, Marcus and the owners wife. He informed us that there was a very minor mechanical problem with the plane and he couldn't take us up. He wasn't able to get a mechanic in to do a repair that day. Marcus and the owners wife went into the office.I figured a refund was coming. While talking with my wife,they came out and went over to Air Adventures who are in the same building. Air Adventures came over and offered to take us up, but not until 4:30.Their pilot was already doing the last trip of the day.Great I said. Thank you Bruce for running a top notch company that puts safety and customers First. For your employees to set up a trip with Air Adventures and not just refunding our money. Going above and beyond to see us get in the air to see the island. I cannot thank you enough and I wouldn't hesitate a second to book a trip with your company. Ma halo!

Although we had to re-schedule our original reservation because of constant rainfall after having driven an hour to the destination, we were accommodated with a different date and time that fit our schedule after we moved around some other excursions in our itinerary.  This was the best attraction during this trip to Kauai.  The views and sights were absolutely amazing!  The staff were quite friendly and knowledgeable.  The pilot wonderfully described everything we saw while he adeptly flew the plane.  The plane is small and cozy, they sat four of us all comfortably on the right side so we would all be ensured a great view to take great pictures.  They provided small bottles of water during the flight.  The free gift of a highlights DVD and photos of us in front of the plane are a super added bonus!

Took our second tour with Wings Over Kauai in December 2014 and couldn't be happier! The second trip was just as great as the first, and the price was definitely economic for our family of many kids. Our pilot was so informative and kindly answered my eight year old's many questions to the best of his knowledge. We purchased the blue-ray disc of our flight and have enjoyed watching it a few times. What a great experience for our whole family.

We completed a lot of research into which flight we would do over Kauai as a family of 4. Wings over Kauai always came up with the best recommendations with safety and service, which is why we chose them. On arrival to our hotel, I was glad to hear our concierge also recommending them to other travellers! 
We had our deluxe tour booked, but the weather wasn't so great. Bruce and Angel were communicating with us to reschedule an appropriate time which would also improve our chances of beautiful views. We weren't disappointed. We took our tour with Josh as our pilot and he was amazing, friendly and extremely knowledgable on the island. He was so kind and tolerant of our children who asked a lot of amusing questions along the way! 
The service at WOK was excellent and Mary had already emailed us photos by the end of the day. We would recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone wanting a friendly, safe and personable service!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai
review_text: After reading the reviews on Trip Advisor decided to book with Wings over Kauai. I must say what an excellent decision. Bruce and Ellen provide a superb personal and very professional service, would highly recommend.   We donned headsets so everyone could communicate, all four of us and Bruce, he pointed out the attractions while he talked with us.   The tour was one hour and it was so interesting, he time went by quickly.   You also receive a ten minute video of a flight for free, if you wish to purchase the full video of your flight it is $35.00 plus $5.00 for shipping, the video beat us home.    We would definitely fly with them again on a even longer flight.

We were a party of 6 most of which hadn't flown in a small plane before. Despite all the rain around the flight was really smooth and we had great views. Josh the pilot was very informative and made sure he pointed out things on both sides of the plane calling us all by name to look at certain points. At some of the feature locations he flew a circle around so everyone got a good view. We had already driven the Waimea Canyon and done a boat trip around the Napali Coast so it was great to then see the whole island from the air. Being in the plane gave you a great view of everything and some good photos. I would highly recommend this trip.

The Wings Over  Kaua'i flight was the highlight of our trip to the Island.  We saw  the island from land and sea as well, but the air experience was by far the most beautiful and breathtaking. We couldn't snap photos fast enough.  Thank you Josh and Angel for this wonderful experience!

This flight was amazing from the greeting at the airport to the DVD of the flight. Dad and Daughter greeted us and we were soon on the plane. It was roomy, cool and a nice ride...unlike the helicopters. The price is about a third of the copters for two to three times more flight time. Gorgeous smooth ride. All captured on a DVD which is worth the small price. Go Pros on each wing! A definite must with a great family business. Kauai from the air is not to be missed.
Captain Bruce was great. The flight was awesome. Helicopters might be fun but this ride will save you $$$ and you will get great pic's!! Well worth the flight.

This was the highlight of our trip to Hawaii!  It's hard to describe the beauty we experienced!  We had a 4:00 flight with a forecast not looking good for the windward side of the island.  Our captain, Bruce, was still more than willing to take us up and adjust the flight plan if needed.  As luck would have it, the bad weather held off and the island was breathtaking!  I've never seen so many beautiful bright rainbows which made the flight over the Napali Coast even more incredible.  Our captain was very knowledgeable about the island!  I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Kauai!!

Been on lots of tours and flights all over the world, but this was my favorite.  Super friendly and very considerate.  Made sure everyone was comfortable.  Bruce, our pilot, was knowledgeable and gave us a fantastically smooth flight.  It was so smooth I felt like I WAS FLYING not riding in a plane.  Great views from the plane.  A "not to be missed" experience when visiting Kauai.

We had a simply fantastic 'us only' air van flight with Captain Bruce. From the friendly welcome (including Kaiya), to the information Bruce dispensed, and the numerous personal touches (which I won't mention as it will spoil the surprises), this was a very special experience. They aren't the biggest company and have stiff competition against the helicopters:  but the difference is that they really care about what they do and it shows. We found ourselves looking out for the plane from different parts of the island and reminiscing about the flight - and I don't think you can get better than that as a recommendation. Mahalo

review_title: Brilliant!  Must do in Kauai. Kids loved it.
review_text:
We decided to book a plane ride over a helicopter as the helicopters are a bit rote, they rush in and out of the sights and are expensive. Plane flights do not go as deep into the canyons, but they are longer and in our opinion more enjoyable as everyone gets a better view (in helicopters you can find yourself in the middle in the back with other guests getting the good view.)

In researching our flight, Wings over Kauai provided great information via email and over the phone so we booked with them a few weeks before travelling to Kauai.  The day prior our flight, we received a confirmation email with detailed instructions. On arrival at the airport the greeting was friendly, safety was clearly important and everything was explained clearly. Prior to take off the took a group photo which we received via email after the flight. 

The flight with Josh was brilliant. We had the 6 seater to ourselves (2 adults & two kids) so everyone could sit not he right side of the plane which has the best views. You wear headsets with microphones so you can hear the pilots excellent explanation and you can talk to the others in the plane.  They Gopro the whole  flight inside and outside and for $50 you can buy the high res video (it is ready 3 days after the flight. Can't wait to see it.)

All I can say is you MUST see the Napali coastline either from the air or boat. We chose the air and did not regret it.

All in all a brilliant experience and Wings over Kauai was more than excellent. Highly recommended.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai!!
review_text:
Bruce and Val were extremely welcoming and friendly upon our arrival and excited for our flight with them!  They were very personable and made us feel like family.  The flight itself was one of the best experiences I have had and a must do while in Kauai!  We saw all parts of the island, spectacular views and shared laughs with Bruce throughout the ride.  I would 100% recommend this to anyone visiting or living in Kauai! Thank you Bruce and Val for memories that will last a lifetime! MAHALO!!!

-Jen and Kat

The trip was great. Josh and Val were terrific. Josh, our pilot patiently answered all our questions during the flight, pointed out interesting sights and facts. The view from above was heavenly, so beautiful ! Great way to see Kauai. After the trip, you might want to get the video link. The video was terrific. Josh, thanks for such a wonderful experience.

We chose to fly with Wings over Kauai because their rates were very competitive (especially compared to the helicopter tour with the Pride of America!). I was greeted with a kukui nut lei (one per couple) and we were offered ginger candy and peppermints to help with motion sickness. Our pilot had great knowledge of the island and a perfect soundtrack to accompany the sites we were seeing out our windows. There was a cooler with cold drinks and towels as there was limited air circulation in the plane itself. I did get a little motion sick because I was taking too many pictures - there's a lot to see! The flight was a good length for me (1 hourish). I will say that helicopters seem to be able to get closer to the sites than planes, but other than that, highly recommended. When we got back, they gave us a pre-recorded DVD of some of the best sites from the Go-Pros all over the plane with a cover that featured a picture of us before the flight and the opportunity to purchase a DVD of our specific flight - we did purchase the DVD which was mailed to us about a week later - it's excellent quality.

We have been on many helicopter and small plane fights in different areas of the world and this one tops the bill. Really friendly emails before and the staff are all delightful. All smiling happy and pleased to be looking after you. A great flight, not rushed, a great commentary from our pilot who was very interactive. I would take this over any of the numerous helicopter tours any day.

review_title: Awesome Air Tour of Kauai - especially if value keeping your lunch down
review_text:
So this was my 3rd time to Hawaii, 2nd with my family.  I vividly remember my first time, which was my honeymoon, because that's when I had my first helicopter ride in Hawaii.  I spent a small fortune on a "champagne" tour and ended up losing my lunch because helicopters can be very disorienting in tight spaces like waterfalls and canyons.

So this time I took a different strategy and booked a 60 minute flight with Wings Over Kauai.  And I must say the experience was very enjoyable and didn't bother my stomach in the least.

Bruce, the Pilot, was very friendly and personable.  He is also one of the owners of the company and turned his flying hobby into a 2nd career after leaving the agricultural field where he had a PhD.

We were a family of four and everyone had a clear window seat.  We toured the entire island, including the Waimea canyon, Napali coast, and saw a half dozen great waterfalls, including the one from Fantasy Island.  Sitting in the front for takeoff and landing was also pretty cool.

One thing I did not do was read the FAQ on the site about best times to fly.  One suggestion was that afternoon flights gave you better lighting on the Napali coast and the canyon for photography.  And while I agree that might have reduced the glare from the cockpit somewhat for photos, overall our 930am flight was fine and the weather was beautiful and my photos turned out fine. Bruce had a lot of good tips.

After the flight Bruce also provided us with some tips on his favorite things to do / places to eat which were very good.

Thanks again to Bruce and his assistant Angel for a truly great experience.  I definitely felt less queazy and safer in a plane than I did in a helicopter.

Had an AWESOME time on this tour. 4 people on our plane plus the pilot.  So much to see- the 60 minutes plus we were up in the air flew by (ha!) and our pilot John was just great all around. Funny, personable, informative, the works. Val helps us book and get settled in etc she was great too. Can't believe how easy they made this whole experience.  Truly memorable and well worth every penny we spent (125/person). They also have a go-pro hooked up to the plane so you can purchase your flight with all the chat/narration going in. We purchased that video too- it varied in cost from 35-50 depending on the format you get it in. Overall, 10/10 would recommend. Seriously. I don't recommend stuff too much but this is too good to pass up guys.

review_title: Felt Like We Were In A Movie!
review_text:
Just an hour or so after arriving on Kauai, we took the air tour around the island. Wow! What a ride this was. Josh, our pilot and was extremely pleasant and knowledgeable about the island. Of all of our traveling experiences, this one is one of the very best! We flew over the clear, blue water of the ocean and could see golden sand beaches for miles as well as coral reefs. Over the interior we could see down into the depths of Waimea Canyon & waterfalls in every direction. We felt like we were in a movie! 
The price was only $125 per person but was worth every penny. Also, you can purchase a DVD of your actual tour with audio. You can relive your flight for years to come. It was only $35, so I highly recommend buying it. 
Thanks, Josh & Mary for such a great experience!

My husband and I took this trip today and loved it. For those of you contemplating a helicopter tour, don't waste your money! Choose Wings Over Kauai and then go actually hike/drive/explore the places in person that you see on your flight.

We booked wings over kauai after reading reviews on tripadvisor and also for their price. It was one of the most economical options available. Also kids under 3 travel free! We were very satisfied with the tour, our pilot Josh was very courteous as well as knowledgeable and was able to provide a good account of the many attractions in the island that we flew over. We also loved the fact that it was small airplane and not a helicopter, which meant less noise during takeoff, landing and in flight. With two young kids, the less noisy option proved to be a blessing. I would highly recommend it.

Worth every penny! It was breathtaking and the pilot was so knowledgeable.  Everyone who works there is so friendly and it was easy to get to.  The flight was great and not too bumpy even though it was windy. Great company, I would pay to go again!

Flight 11 July 2015 - Didn't tell my 3 kids (ages 28, 22 and 18) we were going on this until we got to the airport and were checking in.  I highly recommend the element of surprise for this age group.   Had an absolutely fantastic trip with Josh who not only new how to fly a plane but engaged us all in exacting facts about trees, waterfalls, swimming bays and movie locations.  My kids absolutely loved seeing movie spots from Jurassic World.   

We were very disappointed about two days later when we got a call stating that all the video feed from the inside Go-Pros had been lost but I realized I had not even known that we would have the option of this so we compromised and we moved on.  

Tonight we watched out edited version of Go-Pros from the external cameras combined with an audio soundtrack and captions and while it would have been nice to have us in it, it is a very memorable caption of our flight and we are very delighted with how it all worked out.

Things happen, so be it.   The true test is how a company responds.   Wings Over Kauai exceeded customer service in this area and took our wonderful memories, captured them, and provided us with a video that will always reminded us of what a great flight it was because of the video.

review_title: Spectacular Way to See the Island!
review_text: We booked a trip with Wings Over Kauai very last minute after deciding we really wanted to see the island from the sky. We were able to do a same day flight for cheaper than any of the helicopter tours. We did the Grand Deluxe Tour and basically got to see the entire island. We were fortunate enough that the sky was fairly clear and we could see all the way to the top of the Mount Waialeale which we were told happens about 3 times a year so that was a truly amazing experience with several 2000-3000ft waterfalls. The staff was really great. Mary greeted us and gave me a Kukui Nut Lei and fresh flower. Captain Josh took us out and he was really engaged and fun. At the end you get a souvenir video with your photo on the cover that they take before your flight. Overall, it was a great experience and I would recommend Wings Over to Kauai to others looking to see the island's breathtaking beauty from the sky.

review_title: Fantastic experience that you and your family need to experience!
review_text: Myself, my wife and our sons (7 and 2 years old) just had the most wonderful experience today with Bruce and the Wings Over Kauai group!  First class all the way and definitely will do this again and recommend this company to anyone and everyone!  Beautiful flight...great tour guidance and flying by Bruce...and the price was very affordable.  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone!!! This is something we will all remember forever!!!

The scenery is truly breathtaking, but what sets this experience apart was the "aloha spirit" and genuine sense of hospitality. Souvenir photo and highlights video and more were unexpected treats. Great narration and chats during flight, with added ambiance of soundtrack. Ordered the full digital video without hesitation, and if/when we return to Kauai, would do this tour again. Kauai is even more beautiful in person than in the pictures. Cannot recommend enough! Thanks to Mary and Captain Josh!

review_title: Amazing way to see the beauty of Kauai!
review_text: Our family of four (with teens ages 15 and 17) flew with Bruce and were assisted by Angel.  The morning forecast didn't look overly promising at first but after a brief wait we were ready to go.  We were greeted warmly by Bruce and Angel gave us the safety briefing. Before we knew it we were up and away!   We started our trip clockwise around the island and Bruce adjusted the flight plan to dodge the spotty clouds and rain.  The view from the air of the coastline, beaches, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coast and other sites is one that needs to be experienced!!  It was amazing.  Thank you Bruce and Angel!!

I flew with Wings Over Kauai in July 2015. As a recently minted private pilot, I was excited to get a chance to fly on Kauai. Making a reservation was very easy, and Captain Bruce was a pleasure to fly with. He provided excellent instruction for flying in the local area as well as tips to improve my flying. He was also a wealth of knowledge about the island in general and did a fantastic job of playing tour guide. We also flew with two passengers, both of whom had a fantastic time enjoying the incredible views. I would certainly recommend them to visiting pilots as well as those interested in sightseeing flights.

review_title: Great flight to see all of Kuaui! (Considering motion sickness pills)
review_text: Everyone that greeted us there was very friendly. Our pilot (Josh?) was very knowledgeable of the land history and movies that had taken place there. Although we had very clear sky during the flight, there were sudden small sharp drops in altitude here and there. I normally don't get motion sickness in these type of planes, but did feel a little sick at the end of this flight. Taking a motion sickness pill is highly recommended as a precaution.

Great tour.  Captain Josh is knowledgeable and made a great 'mixed tap' soundtrack to go with the flight.  Take the tour, change your perspective and find a beach to visit from the air.
Things to know:
There is a lot more of the island to know than what you can see from your car.
It's a little like a roller coaster up there.  A Dramamine pill might take the edge off.
The kids thought the flight headset and intercom were way more exciting than the view.
A small airplane does not have much leg room.
They are going to weigh you before you get on the plane..to "distribute the load".
Flying in a small plane is fun.

Bruce and his team are outstanding in their friendliness and service.  The flight was extremely enjoyable, smooth and really was a highlight of our trip to Kauai.  The trip gave us beautiful views of all the sites on the island and really left us with a great sense of the why Kauai is so special.  The ride provided great photo opportunities although the beauty is so mesmerizing that I sometimes forgot to snap the shots!  Thanks Bruce and the WOK team for a very memorable day!

review_title: Worth the time and money if your time in Kauai is limited (cruise)
review_text:
If on a cruise - book on your own.  This is a family-owned operation with only two airplanes - Dr. Bruce Coulombe, young retired research scientist, head of the family.  My wife searched Kauai flights after we booked a cruise from Tahiti to Los Angeles with stops at four Hawaiian islands.  The cruise excursions are costly.  Our time on Kauai was limited.  Wings Over Kauai had the best price offer, and were friendly when the reservations were made (about three months in advance).  Bruce met my wife and me at the cruise port and drove us to the airport.  Since more people booked for the same hour, instead of flying in the larger six passenger aircraft, we volunteered to be flown in the Cessna Skyhawk - just the pilot, my wife and myself.  The pilot was well versed on what we to see below. Bruce returned us to our ship. 

A retired judicial professional couple who were with us on the cruise and lived on Kauai told us that the fixed wing aircraft were much safer than helicopter flights.  They told us that far more helicopter accidents (fatal) occur than happens with fixed wing aircraft.   Helicopters do fly closer to the canyons and water falls.  Might be the reason they crash more often. 

Worth the time and money spent.

review_title: Birds eye view of Kauai in an hour!
review_text: We had a private tour and Bruce was our captain - with a doctorate turned his passion of flying into a profession. During the flight he explained quite lot about the Island with tons of humor. It's a family run business and they run it professionally. Great value for money!

My husband and I took the morning small cessna  (3 seat) flight tour of Kauai.  We were by ourselves and had a great flight around the island. We were both really impressed with the pilot's knowledge of the island, including history and geology. After the flight, we were given a memory dvd. The owners were so warm and welcoming and had several suggestions of other places to see and eat at during our visit. I definitely recommend this tour for the quality and personal touch. Thank you again for a wonderful tour!

review_title: amazing view of a beautiful island
review_text: Josh was terrific. The music he has cued up to play during the flight adds immeasurably. He knows the place, and clearly loves it. Showed us all sorts of sites. How to choose between this an a  helicopter? I don't know, though everyone having a window was nice.  Between this and a boat trip - I have to say BOTH!

review_title: Fantastic tour, a must do in Kauai
review_text: We had a brilliant time on our Cessna tour, we're still talking about it in awe. From the moment we arrived and received the warmest welcome and smoothest check-in with the lovely Mary, we were taken on an amazing flight around this stunning island by our wonderful captain Marcus who pointed out everything to us with great explanations, details and anecdotes. The flight was really smooth and enjoyable, the cessna tour was fantastic, we always felt in great hands and safe, we got to see everything and were able to take so many photographs. We both came out thrilled, it is an exhilarating experience and we highly recommend Wings over Kauai Air tours, Mahalo =)

Bruce and his family were wonderful.  We had our 2 year old with us and other tours told us that by FAA regulations we had to pay full price for her.  Wings Over Kauai didn't even charge us.  They took a great family photo of us in front of the plane (we actually used it on our holiday card) and gave us a video of the flight which was awesome.  They accommodated us the same afternoon we called because we were only there for a few short days.  I recommend wings over kauai to everyone we know who is going to kauai.  Thank you Bruce and family for making our vacation!

My niece had taken a helicopter tour of Kauai and impressed on me that it was the only way to see the beauty of the island. My family and I decided to go with Wings over Kauai mainly because it was cheaper. It was a very smooth flight with Capt. Bruce and the sights were just breathtaking. I would do it again with Wings over Kauai. Everyone was so warm and friendly; service is top notch.

We did Wings Over Kauai on our first day on the island.  Bruce was an excellent pilot and shared lots of interesting information about Kauai.  The clouds passing over allowing the Na Pali Coast to come into view is a moment I will always remember!  I often suffer from motion sickness (as on similar flights in Alaska), but on this occasion it was minimal.  We were very happy with the 11 am time slot and the photographs we took.  We received a lovely souvenir at the end.  All in all, I feel the cost was very reasonable for my family of five and the experience was well worth the money!

Just take off on Wings Over Kauai with Captain Bruce and his crew for the memory of a lifetime ! Hats off to Capt. Bruce for a great tour of his paradise island and all the insider tips and explanations. We did the 4 pm air van tour and were only 4 passengers so all were able to sit on the right side and had marvellous views that day.  If I am ever in Kauai  again I would surely do this flight again with them. I would like to add that despite it being a business they go out of their way and add a personal touch which makes this a spectacular experience to take home and cherish.

We are glad that we decided for Wings Over Kauai. I had the pleasure of being on the copilot seat, thank you captain Bruce. It was a memory of a lifetime. During our flight of about 65 minutes we had exceptionally excellent weather conditions which allowed us to see all parts of the island in sunshine. Right from check in till we got of the plane everything was handled in a very competent and friendly way. Captain Bruce surprised us with a Christmas carol which he sung in German and another German rhyme. His know-how of the island and his explanations during the flight made it all the more interesting and special. After the flight he gave us his tips of what to do and where to go and what not to miss on Kauai. 
Thanks for adding the personal touch which made the flight so unforgettable for each one of the passengers on board.

review_title: An Air Tour experience that should not be missed we had last week
review_text: What a memorable experience, flying over Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. The owners Bruce and has daughter were both professional and very friendly. They will make you feel comfortable and a provide fun experience in small aircraft. Bruce's knowledge of the island (he was the pilot on our flight) and personable, humorous manner, created an entertaining and fascinating experience. We have done the helicopter tour of the Island few years ago and this was about half the price. You also will typically not risk the air sickness many get on a helicopter. My wife and I both felt it was a highlight of the trip and we were left with a memorable gift by Bruce.
Excellent flight!  A must do while on kaui!   Bruce our pilot was excellent! The fight showed our family all the sights of the island that are not accessible by car or foot.

based on t.a. reviews, we decided to take a flight with wings over kauai and we're so glad we did.  josh, ellen, val and the team took great care of us and all the logistics were handled smoothly and efficiently.  the flight itself over the island was fantastic and surprisingly smooth, with josh providing wonderful commentary with a good dose of humor.

i'd recommend wings over kauai for any visitor to this wonderful island.  they really take pride in providing excellent customer experience and the value for your money can't be beat.

What a memorable experience, flying over Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. The owners Bruce and Ellen were both professional and very friendly which made me feel relaxed and confident for the flight. This would make a big difference for people who haven't flown in small aircraft much. Bruce's knowledge of the island (he was the pilot on our flight) and personable, humorous manner, created an entertaining and fascinating experience. An incredible deal for the price, which, by the way, is half what you'd spend on a helicopter flight.

review_title: Highlight of Our Time in Kauai
review_text: This was one of the most memorable parts of our honeymoon. We spent an hour flying over Kauai and learning what everything was and seeing many sites we would not have been able to access any other way besides by air (there are many parts of Kauai that are inaccessible by car). The pilot was knowledgeable, friendly, fun and provided us free professional photos and a disc of the key highlights of Kauai after the flight. As far as I'm concerned, this is a must-do when your in Kauai.

review_title: Best thing we did on our trip of the Hawaiian Islands
review_text: We took a week long cruise of the Hawaiian Islands and did a different number of attractions.  This beat everything else hands down!  The flight was smooth, the day was clear, and Josh was a great pilot.  We are a family of four, and one member was a little hesitant to fly in a small plane.  However, he loved it!  This is one attraction I would highly recommend to anyone spending time on Kauai... I'd do it again in a heartbeat! Great way to end the trip of the islands.

This was an excellent way to see the island of Kauai.  The flight, overall, was relatively smooth. Captain Bruce was a wonderful narrator and engaged each passenger by name. I have taken a helicopter tour of the island in the past but I personally enjoyed this type of tour better. 
Everything was handled smoothly before the flight, thank you Mary, and I received an email with our group picture shortly after the tour. 
I recommend it highly.

Captain Josh's knowledge and humour added to the spectacular scenery over Kauai. He even managed to part the clouds for us to view the wettest place on the planet - Mt. Waialeale. Awesome stuff because that is a rare event. My husband and I took the 2-passenger Cessna option in the early afternoon. The flight was surprisingly smooth. We purchased the video and were very pleased with the quality - no window reflections! This joy flight was close to the best we have done anywhere in the world, We've done quite a few. The ground crew, Mary and Ellen were very welcoming and friendly and obviously enjoyed their job of wanting their customers to have a enjoyable experience.

Enjoyed our tour over Kauai with wings over Kauai, had a nice flight and the price paid was extremely fair. However after we landed one of our group seated behind the pilot complained she didn't get to see much, Ellen confessed they normally don't sit anybody there because of the limited view. So we got pretty bummed after this, especially after being charged for all six. Again service was AWESOME and we had a GREAT time but thought it devious for her to admit they don't charge for the seat AFTER we flew and were charged for it. I tried to contact her after she dropped us of at the cruise terminal but  to no avail, she didn't answer our calls. If this hadn't happened they would have 5 circles!

I'm a 300+ hour visiting pilot, and had contacted Wings over Kauai to see if I could fly left seat in their C172 - they got back to me and said sure, and so this week off we went, with Bruce in the right seat, me in the left, and my wife in the back. 

The C172 he flies is in excellent condition; fuel injected, steam gauges, well maintained. I particularly liked that Bruce didn't mind me doing my own preflight or questioning him on the oil level and fuel before engine start. I really respect that. 

As an instructor, Bruce is fantastic. He has input if you want it, or he'll just let you get on and fly. He's obviously a solid pilot (as he should be, at 10,000+ hours). and knows the local landscape and procedures well.

We flew around the island, safely, and enjoyably. He's got decent ANR headsets, his folks are awesome, and I can't imagine a better experience. 

All in all, if you are a visiting pilot, you would be CRAZY to miss this experience. Much safer than a helicopter (not to mention cheaper), run by folks who really are focused on safety AND fun, good flight instruction (I was on the stick the whole flight). I can't say enough good things. Mahalo, Bruce!

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: We recently enjoyed our flight over Kauai provided by a most wonderful and family run, Wings Over Kauai.  Captain Bruce, our pilot, made the flight so enjoyable and very personable.
