From the time of booking to completion of tour this company provided outstanding personalized service. We were made to feel "special" prior to viewing the most incredible sights of the island. The 'grand canyon of the pacific' provided a tapestry of color and texture experienced with the same sense of awe as with the grand canyon of USA. but this canyon provided more beauty. Our pilot supplied a great deal of information about the island including the Napali coast. Josh was very well informed and addressed all individual questions with the knowledge and skill of a professional guide.We recommend purchasing the optional DVD of your individual flight recording commentry and also cabin views together with the views you individually experienced. 
We toured in March took our cameras and now have some wonderful photos, from the Australian manufactured plane, together with a wonderful DVD.
In summary this company is very close to providing perfection in their total product assisted by the very competent and approachable staff. We recommend Wings over Kauai for anyone wishing to see this incredible island.

We had booked for a flight earlier in the week and when we turned up they said that with cloud cover we'd miss 1/3 of what they normally can see so they gave us a full refund and we booked for another morning.  Today we were luckier and despite it raining at our hotel and us thinking the flight would be cancelled, we were thrilled to find that it was on and our visibility was great.  

The team that work for the company are all so friendly and helpful.  Given all the different options of companies that you can go up in the air with, we think we definitely made the right choice.  You have Bose earphones so you can hear the pilot and hear/speak to each other.  They had very cleverly timed the background music to movie themes of the sites we were seeing, such as Jurrasic Park, Indiana Jones, the Descendents etc.  I started to not feel too good, as I do suffer from travel sickness (even when I drove the car up to Waimea Canyon I started to feel sick, so I am a lightweight) but they had ginger candy onboard and that helped, plus they had a micro cloth that had been soaked in water and then frozen and that really helped.  

I have done a helicopter ride before and was terrified, but I felt much safer in the plane and would recommend for those who know they don't like helicopters. 

Definitely worth every penny...or cent I should say in US.

This review is for the Grand Deluxe tour with Kauai by Air. The tour covers most of the standard spots in Kauai including Jurassic Falls, Napali, Waimea Canyon, etc. 

Experience (5/5) - The experience was amazing at every customer touch-point. Our initial conversation during the data gathering and reservation was candid, honest and direct without any high-pressure sales. This is followed by the first in-person conversation where they Bruce and Ellen warmly invited us into their office to collect additional information and address other flying logistics, rather than dealing with the customer at the counter. They are also well prepared with some interesting reading materials while the customers wait for the plane logistics to work out. The actual flying experience is amazing as well. Bruce is a very good pilot and guide who immerses you in the overall flying experience. He's extremely knowledgeable and beyond pointing the standard spots he understands Kauai's vegetation very well (he used to be an agro-scientist before). Finally, at exit they awarded us with a CD that had one of their tours on a bright & sunny day.

Pricing (5/5) - Fly by Kauai has one price, that is honored any way you contact them. This makes shopping far more easier. While doing our research, we came across groups that would change the price depending on the discount coupon/magazine you're holding.

Ethics (5/5) - I felt it was important to highlight this category because I've read nightmare experiences across some other reviews across their competition in Helicopter and Air. The case in point is where the second group did not show up due to a scheduling error. Bruce came by to tell us that they will need to change planes because the # of passengers had reduced. Unfortunately, their smaller plane did not have enough fuel and since it would take more time to refuel the plane they took us flying in the original larger plane, at the expense of their profit. A lesser group would have delayed the trip or made us wait longer till the smaller plane was refueled.

One other aspect I want to highlight is for people that get motion sick easily. I am one of those who feels nausea after an hour long boat ride. Given that, an Airplane ride is a safer choice rather than a helicopter ride as they tend to change altitude much more rapidly. So for all of you who get motion sick easily, I would recommend that you go for a plane tour. Note that this does not guarantee that you will not get motion sick, but it reduces the possibility.

Perfection, as we all know, is tough to come by in any endeavor. But Wings over Kauai came as close as we've been in a long while when we took their tour on March 16th. Right from first contact and in every respect, this company performed brilliantly. Ellen answered my emails (and dumb questions) quickly, handled our reservation with great efficiency, picked us up at the ABC store right on time and delivered us back to our ship. Dori in the office was a delight to deal with and Millie the mascot greeted us with joy. The flight was everything we expected and more, including empathetic handling of my restricted mobility and fascinating commentary by pilot Josh.

We've taken literally hundreds of tours and excursions over many years of travel and can honestly say we've never taken a better one than this. Why anyone would choose to pay double or more for a helicopter tour when this one is so good is beyond me. Yes, I sound like a fan because the people running Wings made me one. If you or anyone you know is heading for Kauai, do yourself a favor and reserve with these people. They are the very best.

Had a fantastic flight lesson and views of the island with Bruce, our pilot.  Bruce was a great instructor, very calm and instructive, yet very safe.  We had a great flight and super experience with awesome views.  Thanks, Bruce!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Kauai!
review_text: This was an excellent way to see the whole island. Loved the scenery and commentary provided.  Josh (our pilot) was very knowledgable on all parts of the Island and answered all our questions. Our morning flight went for over an hour with views of the canyon, many waterfalls, Na Pali Coast and whales :-) The Wings crew were very friendly. Would highly recommend this flight.

review_title: See Kauai and learn how to fly!
review_text: What a bargain. See Kauai by air which is amazing AND get some quality and fantastic aviation aeronautical education too. What a combination! If you ever want to learn more about flight instruction as well as Kauai Bruce is a great flight instructor!

review_title: Breathtaking scenery accompanied by a wonderfully welcoming and personable staff!
review_text:
My boyfriend, John, and I were greeted by Sophia at the ABC store right by our cruise ship. She kindly drove us to the airport, checked us right in and prepared us for our flight! We were introduced to our pilot, Bruce, who was just as sweet as could be. We booked the 9:30am flight on the Cessna because we don't mind small planes and it was nice to enjoy the ride with just us two and Bruce! Before we boarded the plane Sophia snapped our photo in front of it and we expected them to offer the photo to us for an extra fee but It was emailed to us no charge immediately! 
  Bruce talked us through the take off and I got to help him go down the flight checklist as I was in the copilot seat, which was very cool I thought. The sky was clear for our flight and we were able to see EVERYTHING! Bruce was extremely knowledgeable about the different places on the island as well as the history and types of trees/plants. The three of us communicated theough the headsets throughout the flight so we were able to ask questions and hear comments from Bruce about the island. He knew where all the good waterfalls were and the best beaches to fly over. I could go on and on about our flight but, as you can tell by now, we truly enjoyed every aspect of our experience with Wings Over Kauai and we plan to spread the word as best we can! The island is only about 20% accessible by foot/car and the rest can only be seen aerially (if I remember correctly) so you MUST plan to book a flight and I HIGHLY RECOMMEND you do it through this company. Thank you, thank you, thank you to Ellen, Bruce and crew!!!!

review_title: Fantastic Way to See the Island
review_text:
My friends and I had been excited to check out the Napali Coast, but we knew we did not have the money for a helicopter tour.  We were talking to the concierge at our resort asking about boat tours whenshe told us about Wings over Kauai.  She explained that it would be about the same price as a boat tour and we would be able to see so much more of the island and Napali.     She was right.  It was just fantastic.   All 5 of us were impressed and glad we did it.

Breathtaking views and definitely not to be missed.

One minor warning-  I would have sworn that I don't get motion sick, but I found my stomach doing flip-flops.  The flight was pretty smooth but I think the back of the plane gets a few more bumps.   In spite of queasy stomach,  I loved the trip and could not stop taking pictures (even though I knew that just starring at the horizon would be better for my stomach than breaking up my line of vision with a camera lens).    Just an FYI.

review_title: Wonderful start to vacation on Kauai!
review_text:
We booked our flight with Wings Over Kauai for our first morning on the island.  I'm glad we arrived early enough to be able to chat with Ellen a bit.  She is a wealth of information about the variety of ecosystems on Kauai, all of which we were about to see from the air!  Our pilot, Josh, was a great tour guide, giving us all kinds of information about the history, geography and culture of Kauai.  I struggle with motion sickness (in spite of aids to keep it under control).  Josh's steady and calm demeanor definitely helped, and I was amazed with the photos I managed to get as Josh pointed out features.  This introduction to Kauai was a great start to our exploration of the island!  We are very happy that we choose Wings Over Kauai!  Thanks Ellen and Josh!!
Connie and Jan, BC, Canada

Our last day in Kauai we booked a flight with Wings Over Kauai - I can't believe we waited until the last day, but so glad we didn't miss out.  It was my wife and I and our 3 year old son (he flew for free being young and that was the main selling point). Our pilot Josh was super nice and narrated the flight and we were able to hold a conversation and ask questions through the headsets.  Everything we tried to drive, hike or swim on land just unfolded in front of us and even more of the island appeared, this is a must do for sure.    
One of the best parts was how they made us feel like VIPs and just super friendly.  We were given a DVD at the end of the flight of all the highlights (previously recorded and edited of course) but best of all they had gopro cameras mounted to the outside of the plane and we were able to get a DVD of that footage of our actual flight with our conversations and narration, so cool!

review_title: Nice flight in Cessna with Wings over Kauai
review_text: My brother and I booked a flight on the small Cessna plane with Bruce of Wings over Kauai. The flight was about an hour long and showed us the Na Pali Coast, North Shore beaches, Wailua Falls, Waimea Canyon, the Hanalei Valley, and other gorgeous scenery. We were the only two passengers, which was fun, and I'd never been in such a small plane before. (I get motion sickness on some trains and buses, but did fine on this flight.) Bruce is very reassuring since he's made something like 5,000 flights around the island of Kauai. He flew us over two humpback whales and then right over our hotel so that we could practically see our room. He shared some information about where various movies were filmed on the island, a few kinds of trees and plants, and where a few celebrities live on the North Shore. It was a fun way to see the island, and I'm glad we went.

review_title: A great way to see the island
review_text:
My wife and I decided to so a scenic flight while on our honeymoon on Kauai. We are so glad we chose Wings Over Kauai. It was easy to make a reservation then we just turned up on the day and were given a few instructions and off we went. I was lucky enough to get to sit up the front with Josh the pilot, but all the seats offer great views and plenty of amazing photo opportunities. Josh provides lots of interesting facts about the places you can see. My personal favourite was when he pointed out the Jurassic Park waterfall and subtly put the Jurassic Park theme on the stereo! The flight covers the entire island and the views are simply breathtaking.

One word of warning: my wife was quite motion sick so you may want to take something before going if you are that way inclined. 

Overall, an absolute must-do if you are on Kauai!

We had taken a helicopter flight around Kauai in the past.  We decided to try it in a "fixed wing" aircraft.  This was a good choice.  We really like the airplane over the helicopter.  It is quieter and easier to understand what the pilot is talking about.  We went on a windy day and was worried that it might be "bumpy".  Our pilot did a great job of keeping the plane as smooth as possible on such a windy day.  The customer service from this company is the best on the island.  They made us feel at home from the very fist phone call to make a reservation.  If you only do one thing on Kauai, I would recommend this flight.

We're not overly adventuresome and don't fly in small planes so we were nervous, however our fears quickly subsided.  Ellen and Josh the pilot made us feel VERY comfortable.  Josh is a professional airline pilot and flew great and communicated with us throughout the flight.  The views were spectacular.  Definitely glad we did it.  There were 6 of us plush Josh.  Do it early in your stay so you have an idea of where you'd like to visit in the island.  At the end they gave us a special treat.  Definitely a fantastic way to see the island!!!  And Ellen is a very friendly and knowlegable person.  I highly recommend using Wings over Kauai!!

There were 4 of us on the flight plus the pilot. The flight was about an hour and we saw beautiful waterfalls, coastline, movie sites and gorgeous scenes of the Canyon. The pilot was very friendly and informative and even took us over to see a whale which appeared below us. I would highly recommend this company!

review_title: You have to check this out
review_text: WOW was this a blast seeing Kauai from the air this  is a must for everyone. Wings over Kauai made us feel like we were family. Everyone well all 3 of them talked to us and explained the flight path they were taking us on and what to expect to see. Then Bruce our pilot showed us everything that we needed to know about are flight in the Cessna And how to make it the most enjoyable, He had me help him with the preflight checklist and explained everything about what he was doing And then we're off. Bruce kept us very well informed of everything you seen from 4000 feet the air And make sure he made this  about the most memorable event on the island. When we come back to Kawai eat we're definitely going to take another flight  with them

I don't like to fly in small planes or helicopters (fear of heights!) - but this was awesome! Bruce gave us a special glimpse of the beautiful Kauai, and his information and comments during the flight gave was wonderful - the flight was smooth and easy, as far as seeing the island, this is the only way to go!  If you're aprehensive about flying, you have to try this-you won't be disappointed!
One of our best experiences on Kauai-this is a must for everyone!

Our flight over Kauai with Josh as our pilot was the highlight of our visit to Kauai. There were 4 of us so we had a private tour.   When Ellen picked us up her relaxed, friendly attitude immediately put us at ease.  The whole experience from the greeting necklace, the flower for our hair and the photo and then the actual flight was terrific.  Josh was so relaxed, even though it was quite a windy day, that it was obvious that he was an accomplished pilot and we were in good hands.  We were fortunate that it had rained quite a bit previously so there were many many waterfalls.  The "Grand Canyon of the Pacific" was truly beautiful as was the Napali Coast.  Josh circled around trying to include some whale watching but our whale friends were shy that day!   We were able to communicate with Josh and the headsets (Bose) were wonderfully clear.  We were able to listen to Josh but I must admit we were all too busy looking at the scenery and the many beautiful rainbows to do much talking ourselves!  Thank goodness we decided to go with Wings Over Kauai for an experience of a lifetime.

We communicated via email with Ellen concerning our reservations. She provided detailed information promptly to our queries. Our 60-minute trip was set to depart on a Thursday afternoon, but was moved back on our request due to the weather several times. Josh was our wonderful pilot. All 4 of us had window seats with a large bubble window that hardly had any reflections. Large headphones with 2-way communication with the pilot and others in the plane. Views were fantastic, of course.  Overall, a great flight!

This tour was the favorite of all the things we enjoyed during our vacation to the islands. Bruce and staff were friendly and welcoming, quickly making us feel at ease. Our pilot Josh, previously a commercial airlines pilot, was interesting and informative as he pointed out highlights of the tour. The flight was smooth and comfortable and afforded us an excellent overview of Kauai. Although there were low clouds and light rain at times, the views were still spectacular.  The time just flew by ( no oun intended), and we hated to see it come to an end! From start to finish, this was a fabulous experience. Highly recommend!!!!!

We arrived to check in and Sherry gave us an orientation to our flight and aircraft safety.  She then introduced us to our pilot Paul.  They both helped us get comfortable on the airplane with seat belts, head phones and showed us the cooler of drinks.  We quickly took off and Paul pointed out highlights of our tour throughout the flight.  We circled (most all) of the perimeter of the island including the Waimea Canyon, the Nepali Coast and the Hannalei Valley.  Most of the flight was just offshore with views of the beaches.  Spectacular!  We took a helicopter ride several years ago around (generally) the same flightpath.  It was great, but it was loud and a bit manic.  This flight was calm, quiet and cost about half the price of a helicopter ride!  Sherry and Paul took great care of us and I highly recommend Flight over Kauai to you.

Well what can I say WOW. Only found this site by chance when I was looking for something to do in Kauai as we had been here before.
Made contact with Ellen by email and had a response by return from this very friendly lady who couldn't be more helpful, gave me all the info I needed without asking.
Booked with her to have the flight when our cruise ship docked, was met by our driver spot on time when they said.
When I saw the plane I thought "my car is bigger than that".
Our driver (pilot) Bruce brilliant puts you at ease and once up in the air the scenery was breath taking and informed all the way as to where we were and what to look out for.
At the end of the flight we were given a DVD which is great and the memories will last forever.

The same sort of thing booked via the cruise company but half the time was double the price so have a look at this for your next visit to the island.

The people who run this are a credit to the travel industry and would recommend them to everyone.

What a fantastic ride! It starts with the warmest Aloha welcome, followed by a safety briefing. You board and take in parts of the island that can not be reached on the ground. Josh's knowledge of the island was surpassed only by that his piloting skills. He caught sight of a whale breaching and playing and maneuvered the plane such we all were able to see it, but take all of the pictures we wanted as well. Highly recommend the flight.

review_title: Amazing flight with a great company!
review_text:
We recently did the "Wings Over Kauai" flight and had a great time with some amazing views. If going to this island you owe it to yourself to see the beauty of this place that can only be seen by air. I have done helicopter tours before, and wanted to try a fixed wing flight to compare. Besides the fact that fixed wing tours are more affordable, they also have a better safety record. You might not get into some of the nooks and crannies as a Heli, but maybe thats part of what makes it safer. 

As I found out the Air Van did not bother me for motion sickness at all. I did experiance some motion sickness in past helicopter tours, not enough to get sick, but enough to be glad to be back on the ground.  

Anyway our flight in the Airvan was smooth, and our pilot Paul was really good and very informative. Everybody (4 of us passengers) had a good seat on the right side of the plane for a clockwise tour of Kauai. We saw lots of Humpbacks as we flew along the south coast and the beauty of the mountains was spectaular. Flying over Waimea Canyon and seeing the Napali coast was simply breathtaking. Also because this was our first trip to Kauai it was great to get the "lay of the land" on just our second day, and get a feel for where things are. 

All in all Wings Over Kauai was an excellent company to go with and I can certainly see why they have such wonderful reviews. We highly recommend them.

My family and I have been coming to the Hawaiian Islands for years, and this is about the 6th time to Kauai.  We have done ALL of the activites on the island (ATV, Fishing, Zipline, boat cruises and even helicopter tours) but this is the best one out there!  I booked with Ellen over phone/email about a week before we arrived after noticing all the positive tripadvisor reviews.  We did the tour in the smaller Cessna 172 (perfect for 2-3 people) so everyone gets awesome views.  Capt. Bruce even let me take the plane off and control for most of the flight!  We saw whales and the Capt. was very happy to make a couple turns in the air to get some better views for all.  Very easy to find and nicest people ever!  They even give you a little personalized gift that any other place on the island tries to nickle/dime you for at the end of the experience.  Would give 10 stars if I could and HIGHLY recommend this anyone wanting to see Kauai from a different perspective!

We went with wings over kauai on january 21st. We had a wonderful time and the scenery was just wonderful. I highly recommend this flight very good company and the price is perfect. We saw the napali coast, the canyon, in fact the whole island.Great staff, very proffesional. Thank you so much!!!

review_title: Value and Service Sets Them Apart
review_text:
I could write a long list of reasons why to take an aerial tour of Kauai.  If you get lucky with a good day of weather, you're not going to be disappointed.  I'm sure the helicopter tours are great as well, but what sets Wings of Kauai apart for me is the value and service.

The tour is cheaper than the helicopters, and while the helicopters may be able to get lower and in the canyon a little more, I don't see how the views are that much better.

The service from Wings of Kauai is amazing and honestly it would be nice if every business did things like this.  The owner Bruce greeted us at first, went over safety with us, and gave my 3 year old daughter a little stuffed toy gift which made her comfortable from the start.  Our pilot Josh was enthusiastic the entire time and his commentary along the way was great.  They gave us a video of the flight (not our actual flight) which is great if the weather doesn't allow you to see everything like you hoped for.  This was not an extra cost.  Emailed us pictures they took of us outside the plane before take-off.  Overall you feel extremely well taken care of the entire time, they make sure you have everything you need and enjoy the ride.

You should definitely do an aerial tour in Kauai if you can, and you won't beat the value and service at Wings Over Kauai.  If you get lucky with the weather, it's an amazing view.

My wife and I stayed on Kauai for 8 nights, and did many interesting things, but the flight with Wings Over Kauai was definitely the highlight of our trip.  Our pilot Josh was enthusiastic, enjoyable and did a great job taking us to very remote spots over Kauai.  I would highly recommend taking a trip with Wings Over Kauai, as it is great value for the money spent.

Thanks again Josh

Ward and Karen, Calgary

review_title: A highlight of your vacation that will provide fabulous photo memories!
review_text:
We looked into doing a helicopter ride over Kauai, but while doing internet research, I came across 'Wings Over Kauai'. The reviews and the price seemed favorable and since we'd previously experienced a helicopter ride (on the Big Island), we decided to give the small plane a whirl. We were not disappointed!

We booked the flight a few weeks prior to our visit to Kauai in December 2012. 'Wings Over Kauai' has a convenient check-in desk at Lihue Airport where you check in with the friendly staff, go over some brief paperwork and then wait a short while in the small airport lounge where there are toilets available. 

Josh, our pilot introduced himself and was bursting with friendly 'Aloha' spirit and confidence! We boarded the plane, where we got a complimentary bottle of water. We took off and as the runway disappeared behind us, the adventure began!

While in the plane, you wear headphones with a mic attached, through which you can hear the pilot's running commentary about what you're seeing. You can also ask questions and make comments that everyone in the plane can hear.

Have your long camera lenses ready for the stunning views as you see miles of coastline, blue waters, waterfalls, coffee groves, fancy resorts, celebrity houses, an Indian temple, the cruise port, the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon and possibly even whales.

It's a thrilling approximately 60 minute ride that will leave you on a high for a few days and provide you with some fabulous photo memories.

You are given a complimentary previously filmed short DVD as a keepsake of the trip and they e-mail you a digital photo of yourself next to the plane. 

For $125 per person, it beat the price of the much more expensive helicopter rides and yet still provided one of the absolute highlights of our vacation. We recommend it! 

NOTE: Complimentary parking available in front of the check-in terminal. 
It's recommended you book the flight early in your vacation in case it has to be postponed due to weather conditions. We were lucky to have a beautiful clear day!

Bruce the owner and pilot is a great guy.  Very safety focused and really takes care of you during the whole trip.  Typically his flights are much smoother than a helicopter and relaxing.  Bruce has lived on the island a long time and is a great historian and really gives you the low down on the island.  My kids loved it.

We just returned from our trip to Hawaii and we are still talking about the wonderful flight we had with Josh at Wings Over Kawaii. Ellen  helped us with the arrangements and even picked us up and drove us to the airport. The flight was truly wonderful, great value, and very informative. We even received a video of the flight to take home as well as pics in our in box!! The service and friendliness of all were super and it was likely the best value we had  for our tourist dollars. It is a must -do!!

Our experience could not have been any better: great people, perfect weather, a smooth flight and the most amazing views of Kauaii from the air. I was able to take amazing pictures (bring your zoom lens!) and we will recommend Wings over Kauaii to anybody that visits this amazing island.

review_title: From the air; a great way to see Kauai!
review_text:
We were met by friendly helpful staff and checked in for the flight. Millie the dog and our pilot Josh came up to greet us, both very personable. We filled out the prerequisite forms on an iPad and were given a safety brief on their aircraft.

We loaded up, each passenger was given noise canceling headsets which make small aircraft flight much more comfortable. While Josh wasn't talking to ATC he was talking to us and asking questions of each passenger, stealthily determining if anyone's anxiety might need to be addressed. 

We took off over the beach and made a right turn down the east coast, with island music playing softly in the background and Josh giving interesting tidbits of knowledge as we go. Josh thanked me for my occasional habitual traffic calls on the intercom while my wife suggested I sit quietly because he had it under control. She was right of course, and as a fellow pilot I appreciate how well Josh did have everything under control. 

About an hour of spectacular scenery including whales, cliffs, waterfalls, beaches, coffee plantations, movie sites, and tropical beauty. It was great!

review_title: Great flight lesson/tour combo with free seat for your partner
review_text: Take the little Cessna, ask Bruce for the right seat, have your partner sit in the back (very comfortable and windows on both sides), and do a mixture of a tour, sightseeing and flying yourself.  Bruce is incredibly knowledgable about the flora, fauna and topology of the island and this made for a great commentary.  Despite arriving 30 mins late we were made to feel very relaxed, and despite having originally booked a 90 minute flight, due to the late arrival it was reduced to 60 mins with no charge and it was still plenty of time to see all the sights. Having taken a couple trial flying lessons before I was also keen to have the opportunity to take the controls.  Bruce was excellent, putting me at my ease and allowing me to take off and land and fly some of the round the island circuit (at least using the yoke). Great fun, good experience, lovely touches including the free photo emailed to us, flower and necklace for my wife and and all round friendly experience. Highly recommended, at $220 for two people, also great value regardless of if you want to take the controls or not. Also, I suspect, much safer that the helicopter tours.

review_title: Great Experience for a Private Pilot
review_text: Rented their C-172 for a scenic trip around the island and the luxury of logging some time in the beautiful skies above Kauai.  Bruce was a great co-pilot & instructor... Graciously working the radios and making position calls for the duration of the flight. He also gave some great instructional tips unique for island flying and took the controls so that I could snap a few pics.  The whole experience was spectacular.  Whether you're a licensed pilot itching to fly around or an aspiring pilot looking for great instruction in a very unique environment - this is worth it!

review_title: Wings over Kauai - personal tour in Cessna
review_text:
I was looking for something different to do while visiting Kauai'i for a meeting, so I looked about and ended up booking a tour via their website.  Ellen got back to me not long after to confirm details.  Very easy booking process, very friendly.  Being a flight sim geek when i found out they could do a personal cessna flight with 'stick' time I had to jump at that chance!  So I booked a personal flight in their Cessna (turned into an introductory flying lesson) which was excellent - so much so I bought a trainee pilot log book and booked another flight/lesson later that week!!  The typical tours are in their larger Air-caravan with other people - i poked my head in it in the hangar while it was being maintained, looks like everyone gets a great view in comfort.  (my second flight was at the end of day so ended at the hangar - so looks like they maintain their aircraft frequently.  Interestingly Bruce asked me if it was ok if we taxied to the hangar - nice touch incase I was in a hurry),  On both days while waiting for the Cessna, I saw people come off the Air-van and heard them all raving about how much they loved it etc.

The cessna is great for a personal/couples flight, and based on what i paid for a personal 1.1 hour flight/lesson in the Cessna, it was very reasonable indeed compared to a shared helicopter tour (i paid a bit over $200 for each personal flight/lesson of 1.1 hrs all the way round the island which is amazing value for what is effectively instructor time, hire of cessna and fuel - and I could have brought a guest along with me for no extra cost....).  Granted a heli tour will get you a bit closer to the sights, but if you are looking for a very nice way to view all the sights of the island without the hairiness you will get from a helicopter tour, fly with this company.  Even if you are zoned on a helicopter flight, take a tour with Bruce as well as you will get at least an hour to see the entire island (empty your camera's memory card!) at a leisurely pace with interesting commentary as well.  

It is clear Bruce and Ellen love what they do, and Bruce was a very good tour guide with a background in agriculture on island prior to starting this company.  Bruce was also a very good instructor - clear instructions, subtle assistance (or clear assitance where needed) and very informative incase anyone is looking to log some hours or just give it a try - cant think of anywhere better to do your first lessons, it is a stunnning island and the cessna seemed to be in very good condition.  I am now begging my wife to allow me to continue lessons back home....

Very highly recommended.

Flying with Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience.  The reservation process was easy and they were very flexible in order to accommodate our schedule. When we arrived everyone was extremely friendly and the checkin process was a breeze. Bruce informed us there was some haze and checked the weather to see if the next few days would offer better viewing.  Since there was some rain in the forecast we decided to go that day, and we were happy we did. We took the smaller Cessna plane.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot - it was an extremely smooth flight and Bruce was a great guide.  And the sights were awesome.  This is a great alternative for people who are nervous about helicopters (like me) or who have weight limits and cannot take a helicopter.

I went up with Bruce in the 172 and had a marvelous time. I am an instrument rated private pilot and had some fun flying the plane as well as seeing the gorgeous island from above. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and I appreciated picking up some new tips. He was also great as a tour guide and taking control while I snapped pictures. The staff was welcoming and efficient. I will definitely visit them again.

review_title: There's no other way to see the island!
review_text: This is the only way to see the entire island of Kauai. So much of this beautiful island is only viewable by air, and Wings Over Kauai is the best value on the island. Not only can you take a tour, but you can get an instructional flight and fly a Cessna 172! If your going to Kauai, this is a must.

If you want to do an island tour, Wings Over Kauai is the way to go!  
My hubby and I were looking to do a helicopter tour, but too much $.  Looked into Wings and the price was right!  We called to make our reservation the night before and were booked first thing at 9:30 in the morning.  Not sure if this is always the case or if we just got lucky!
Captain Bruce was wonderful, funny and knowledgeable about the island.  We flew in the four passenger Cessna, but it was just me and my hubby so we had our own private flight!
Highly recommend going with Wings Over Kauai, they are professional, courteous and make you feel right at home as family!

We chose Wings over Kauai based on their reviews on Tripadvisor, great ratings and reasonably priced. It was a good decision.
We booked the first flight in the morning @ 9:30 as per their recommendation, Josh was our pilot.  He was an excellent pilot and had very good knowledge of the island.  We saw couple of whales during our tour. It was amazing to see the island from the air. Breathtaking!!! 
A must  do tour in Kauai.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is Professional with Top Operators
review_text: I chose Wings Over Kauai for Flight instruction and a tour of the island with Captain Bruce.  The first thing I noticed was Bruce's professionalism and smooth flying of the Cessna.  He really does keep the passenger's comfort and enjoyment in mind at all times and knows the island very well.  I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone that asks.  No better value on Kauai.  You will be treated right!

We chose Wings Over Kauai for our air tour of the island because of the reviews of previous customers and let me tell you, we're glad we did! It was a fantastic trip. Bruce took my husband and myself up in the Cessna this morning, it was everything and more than what we expected. He shared his knowledge about the island with us and showed us just about everything there was to see from the air. The weather was pretty bad at our scheduled take off time so he asked us if we could wait another hour, thinking that it would provide a better view and he was right. The Na Pali Coast was socked in the clouds and raining but he did his best to make the trip worthwhile for us. We even saw Humpback whales breaching beneath us. What beautiful sights, knowledge and a fantastic smooth flight. You'll never know what there is to see without getting up in the air. It was half the cost of the helicopters, longer in air time, they gave us a CD with photos and music of the tour area, great bargain. Thanks for a great time Bruce and company!

review_title: A great time by the four of us...
review_text: Josh took us up for our tour of Kauai on Thursday January 10, 2013.  We weren't sure about the weather when we started, but the staff reassured us that the weather was great for flying and we're glad we decided to do the flight!  Josh was very knowledgeable about the history of the island and we loved the music in sync with the sights.  We were able to get into remote parts of the island and got some good photos.  We would highly recommend "Wings" to everyone.

We were in Kauai the first weeks of January and I really wanted to tour the island by air. I had read that this was the best way to see the whole island since most of the island is inaccessible by foot/car/etc. Wings over Kauai was a great choice. It was a great price for this activity (half the price of a helicopter ride) and was really amazing. It was a little windy the day off but we were still able to take off and the beginning was very smooth. I was surprised by how smooth the take off and landing were. I did get a little motion sick in the middle of the flight, but the pilot Josh was really great and directed me towards a cold compress kept in a cooler on the plane. This helped a lot and I was still able to enjoy every minute. We did see helicopters that appeared to be flying closer to the cliffs and in the canyon, but we still had great views and I don't regret taking a fixed winged plane vs a helicopter. It was easy to find the location and there is parking for guests. I would 100% recommend anyone to book a flight with Wings over Kauai!

Months before going to Kauai my wife and I booked a Sightseeing Adventure with Wings Over Kauai.  From that moment on Bruce, Ellen and the others seemed like family.  So personable, pleasant and helpful.  When we arrived for our flight Bruce suggested we reschedule for later in the week due to wind and visibility; what a great suggestion.  Our flight around the island was beautiful and Bruce provided a lot of information and history.  After the flight we were given a DVD with a picture of us standing in front of the plane on the cover.  It was fun to watch the video the other night; great journey and great memories.  Thanks Bruce, Ellen and WOK Staff!

review_title: Great service. Beautiful tour. Got sick.
review_text:
My family of four adults, and one baby, flew with Wings over Kauai in November.  Awesome customer service. Above and beyond. The tour itself was beautiful. So amazing!  Only downside was not their fault. My mother and I got extremely air sick. If you are susceptible to motion sickness I would suggest something else. Sorry.  Again, not their fault. They gave us water, an ice pack etc. But we were sick 10 min. Into the flight. And that makes an hour long flight seem very long! Ugh.

My dad and husband loved it. All in all great tour for the price. Just think I will stay on the ground next time...

We had an excellent experience from planning through the flight.  Everyone was great. Bruce shared geographical and nature tips.  Very knowlegable regarding the island's plants and terrain.  As a pilot out of practice it was a great chance to get in the air again.  Strongly recommend Bruce and his team!  They even provided a DVD - personalized with footage from the Island.

Not only did I see whales from the air and fantastic scenery all around the island, but I picked up some valuable tips from Bruce for flying over mountains, avoiding birds, managing the aircraft in turbulent conditions, enhancing my visual scan and staying vigilant. A Canadian commercial pilot, I had fun and learned new skills too - not to mention some of the history of the island. This was a great flight with a first rate instructor and a very well-maintained aircraft.

Took my wife and 2 year old daughter.  We had a hard time deciding between a helicopter or airplaine tour of the island.  I was also a little hesitant about doing a tour of the island from the air to begin with.  This was absolutely worth it, and my wife and I have no regrets.  The staff was super friendly and helpul.  The pilot Josh was also very friendlyand very knowledgable about the sites you get to see during the flight.  They were very accomodating with our 2 year old and gave her a free toy which she loved.  The flight was just over an hour and the views were absolutely stunning.  If we are able to visit the island again in the future we will definately do this again with this company.  I highly recommend this you won't regret it.

My husband and I chose Wings over Kauai based on their excellent TripAdvisor reviews and terrific price in comparison to a helicopter tour -- we were not disappointed! Not that we've done the flight, we can honestly say these reviews are true to the experience you get with Bruce and Ellen and their team. We flew with Bruce on a gorgeous December morning and loved every minute of it - just as others noted though, we too wished it would have lasted longer! The hour goes by so quickly and you are left wanting to circle and circle again -- it is THAT beautiful! We had contemplated choosing Maui as the island to see by air and decided at the last minute to stick with Kauai since we'd heard it is the best island to see by air because of its beauty and its inaccessibilty by car -- again, SO TRUE! If you are worried because you're scared of heights or bumps, don't be! I was concerned (I'm not even comfortable with turbulence on commercial flights) and was surprised to find the ride to be smooth and felt completely safe -- not normal for me. I would highly recommend booking this as a phenomenal part of your trip that you'll always remember -- it brings the island to life like you'll never believe! Thanks, Wings!

We loved Wings Over Kauai.  We were looking for a lower-priced option than a helicopter ride to get a nice look at the Na Pali coast and Kauai, and this was a great decision.  Very friendly, kind people, and our pilot, Josh, was wonderful.  I don't really like flying, but I never once felt nervous on our flight and thought the sights were spectacular.  Lovely!

After reading the reviews on TripAdvisor I decided to purchase a morning flight on December 26th for my mom, sister and I as a Christmas gift. We met Sherry and our pilot was Josh, they were both great and made us feel like family. Josh remembered our names and everything about us during the flight which was very impressive. The flight was great and it was our highlight of our two week trip to Oahu and Kauai. When we visit Kauai again we will fly again with Wings over Kauai!

We were a party of 4 and Josh was our very informative pilot for this tour.  It was a beautiful day for seeing all the sights by air.  We knew that the only way to see the North shore during the winter was by air and it was beautiful.  Great views of the Waimea canyon, south shore and everything in between.  Ironically, I am a flight attendant and I was the only one who felt a bit quesy half way through the flight since I was not used to all the bumps of a small aircraft. 
I highly recommend this tour and hope for clear weather!

Bruce and his crew gave us a wonderful morning's flight over beautiful Kauai - one that will be long remembered.  Great people! and great value for money.  We saw much more in an hour than even a day's driving could achieve.  I was also very impressed with Wings Over Kauai's professionalism, commitment to their customer and high standards of operation and safety.  Highly recommended, should be on everyone's must-do list for Kauai.

As a flight intructor myself ,Bruce was kind enough to offer me either the right or left seat (right seat better views) in the Cessna 172. At the last minute I decided to fly from the left seat and Bruce immediately understood and shifted positions. 
The flight was extremely easy, especially when Bruce would do the radio call and keep me out of noise sensitive areas and restricted airspace. Bruce is so knowlegedable about the island. My wife Dawn is the photographer and was able to get many great shots, and views  that we would never have been possible from a helo or drive tour.
As a final recommendation to those pilots out there who are considering a flying tour of Kauai. Bring along Bruce, he will let you fly as much as you want, and has the personality and demanor that all flight instructors strive for, but rarely achieve. He also does great radio so all you have to do is fly and look out the window.

It was a great flight and we all had a super time.

Jim MacKay
CFI / ATP

My sister and I chose to fly with Wings Over Kauai as a end of trip treat - we are SO happy that we chose to do so! The trip was worth every penny we spent. From the kindness of e staff, the leis and flowers you are given when you check in, the enthusiasm of the pilot (Paul was sweet, a great pilot, and very knowledgeable of the island), and the DVD of a similar flight (with our photo on the cover of the DVD!!), we were so impressed. The flight was smooth and comfortable. And of course, the incredible scenery of this beautiful island is stunning! Thank you Wings Over Kauai!!

Everything about the experience with Wings Over Kauai was great.  The communication, and flexibility, booking our flight was fabulous.  Once we arrived at their location the customer service couldn't have been better.  They described the flight plan and asked if we had any concerns or questions about the tour.  Once in the air Bruce was a pro and we all envied his job.  He gave us lots of great information about Kauai and the history of the island.  I fly often so I found the small plane provided a very comfortable ride.  We can't thank the team at Wings Over Kauai enough for the amazing service they provide.

We had a helicopter tour in mind, but after researching on Trip Advisor, it was sounding like a flight with Wings Over Kauai was the way to go. I wouldn't even consider looking any further- you won't regret booking with this company! Great value, great experience, and a company that you feel good about supporting.  It was a highlight of our honeymoon- we just got home tonight and despite being up at 4 am, I'm already taking the time to spread the word about how great Bruce and the team were so that's saying something!

I booked the smaller plane. My husband was a bit nervous when we got outside and he saw how small it was, he was nervous that it would be a rougher ride, but he ended up loving it! 

Here's what we loved:
Half the price of a helicopter tour.
Much less fuel consumption than a helicopter (aka more environmentally friendly!)
A knowledgeable, capable and friendly pilot - Bruce, though we've only heard great things about Josh too.
A free ride from the Anchor Cove mall -which was a quick walk or free shuttle from the cruise ship.
Friendly staff (Jennifer and Sophia were great!).
No hidden costs.
Great communication- we inquired and booked online and Ellen emailed and happily answered all of my questions.

Really no downside. Not one complaint or concern.

Plan for 2 hours from pick up to return time.

There is no way to see the beauty of Kauai from the ground, we would do this trip again and again. Mahalo to the Wings Over Kauai team for such a special and personal experience.

~ Lance and Jessika, Mission BC

review_title: Fantastic way to see Kauai, knowledgable pilot, great value!
review_text:
My girlfriend and I were on a cruise and decided to take a flight tour of Kauai the morning we arrived in port late November.  We called a couple helicopter tour companies that were full for the day and they recommended an airplane tour with Wings Over Kauai.  I'm a private fixed wing pilot so that was perfect for us, and it's also much more affordable than a helicopter tour.
I love the fact that they are a small family run business and Ellen came to pick us up free of charge from the cruise ship.  Checkin was simple, quick, and it was great talking with Ellen.

Josh, a former American Airlines pilot, flew us and another couple around the entire island on a glorious clear day with only a small portion of the mountain peak covered by the ever present cloud that makes this the wettest place in the US(or planet, I can't remember).  The flight lasted about an hour and was an incredible value, especially considering you can't get to most of the places we were able to see from the air, what a beautiful island!  

Josh is incredibly knowledgable about Kauai and the Hawaiian islands, in addition to being a terrific pilot.  All of the seats in their Gippsland G8 AirVan have active noise cancelling headsets, which made talking to each other and listening to Josh really easy(not the case in many small aircraft).  Although a fixed wing airplane can't fly quite as close to some of the canyons as the helicopters, everyone gets a window seat(many helicopters are 3-4 across).

Ellen took a beautiful photo of us next to the plane, emailed it too us, and gave us a DVD with a short video montage from previous flights set to music.  Overall a fantastic experience! 

FYI, although we didn't do it, if you're a pilot and want hands on flying they can do a lesson in their Cessna 172.

The crew at Wings over Kauai (ground staff and the pilot) were so friendly and really invested in making sure we had a great time. They gave me a beautiful lei, took pictures before the flight and gave us a DVD of the tour. The tour itself was wonderful and the pilot gave us so much background info. about the island as we flew over it. 

I have a toddler and they were particularly attentive to her needs. This is what I call great customer service on top of a great service!! 

I will go back and would recommend anybody considering a flight option to pick Wings over Kauai.

review_title: A Must-Do for the Full Picture of Kauai
review_text:
Kauai is such a beautiful island and you need to see if from the air to experience all the island has to offer.   This is a great experience.  You'll see the entire island and will hear lots of interesting information while you tour from above in the comfort of the airbus.  Josh was a wonderful pilot and tour guide.  The entire flight is an opportunity to take fabulous photos.  We thoroughly enjoyed the experience.   The small touches make you feel very welcome - bottled water if you get thirsty and a blanket if you need it, a complimentary kukui nut lei and a DVD gift of a Wings Over Kauai tour comes with the price - very nice.  

For those who might experience motion sickness, Wing Over Kauai is actually the best choice for an air tour.  Much more comfortable and stable than a helicopter.  And if budget is an issue, Wings Over Kauai is a great value - you see more of the island at a more reasonable price.   

A "Must Do"

You really need to see Kauai by air to truly appreciate what a gem it is.  Wings Over Kauai makes this possible without breaking the bank.   We enjoyed our flight in the G8 Airvan in early November. There were three of us plus Josh the pilot so we all had a prime window seat on the right of the plane with space to spare.  Check in was easy, you have headsets to listen to pilot chatter plus you can talk between pilot and others in the cabin.  There is nice music playing in the background to give you that aloha feeling.

If you do have motion sickness definitely take something or use a PSI Band. Poor hubby gets seasick but never had problem in air before but I guess a small plane is similar to a boat...  Unfortunately we had not thought about it beforehand but he made it though a little worse for wear.  

We were surprised by the Kukui nut lei and DVD with images/music after the flight.  Really a nice touch.  This is a small family run business and you can tell they are passionate about what they do.

we flight with Wings Over Kauai because friends told us about it. It was simply great! Everybody was so friendly, even though we made first a mistake of the date. We felt very safe at the flight and we get a lot of informations. Everything was very personal, we felt like friends.

Took the flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai today. What a wonderful experience. The business was both very friendly and very professoonal from the very first contact. Bruce was our pilot and he did a great job showing us Kauai from the air. The flight was very beautiful and we felt very safe. Highly recommend them.

What a amazing flight, thank you so much!! Bruce was wonderful, he was first of all a lot of fun to have as our pilot, but he didn't talk to much so we could enjoy the scenery, but mentioned all of the important info that we'd want to learn and know about. Lets just say this....there is a reason why this has a 5 rating for most of the people.....I would highly recommend, thank you for such an enjoyable flight!!!!

i had booked the flight tour based on review, for our anniversary. i was glad that i did. every seat is a window seat with only 4 passengers per flight. they also took our complimetary pics with the plane and mailed it to us. also got a dvd with some of the sights we saw.
pros
you get to see the best sights of the island
have an experienced pilot that knows alot about the island
see parts of the island that are not reachable otherwise.
its much cheaper than all other providers i could find.

cons
u may have to share the plane with another couple.

review_title: By far one of the best trips EVER
review_text: Having done a flight over the grand canyon and being a little disappointed, I was a bit aprehensive - no need - one of the highlights of our holiday (we did it during a day trip to Kauai from Oahu. Fab fab fab - these are genuinely LOVELY people and it was the best money we have spent on a trip EVER - anyone who goes to Kauai MUST do this trip - we have already told all our family and friends about it and would do it again in a heatbeat!

I am going to write a big review as Wings over Kauai deserves it.

Background:
This is a must for any trip to Kauai. Choices are either a chopper or an air tour. The air tour is by far the most bang for your buck. For air tour we were on smaller Cesna so we were the only ones with our pilot - Josh, this is a great option for privacy and you get personal attention from the Pilot - I got to be the co-pilot :-). You can also choose a big 6 seater Airvan, which has larger windows but more passengers with you. 
Tip: Sit on the right side of the plane.

Service:
Ellen was super courteous and made sure we had all the information about choices that we had. The lady at the reception (can't remember her name) was good too and did all the formalities. This process takes ~10minutes. 
Tip: Try to book at least 4 days in advance.
Our pilot - Josh was brilliant and made sure this was a perfect way to say "Mahalo!!" to Kauai. He is extremely courteous and knowledgeable about the island. He made sure that we had every opportunity to photographs amazing vistas - he did double rounds over some waterfalls. The good thing about Cesna is that you get undivided attention of the pilot. 
Many thanks to Josh.
They take your photos (and email them to you) before boarding on the plane and do a great job of tucking you nicely. I was the co-pilot, so i had an opportunity to see all the controls apart from enjoying the views. You get noise cancelling headphone so that you can communicate with each other and the pilot. They also give you a free pre-made DVD (not of your actual flight). It is a 5 minute DVD with music encapsulating the tour.
Tip: The photography buff should sit on the back seat as there is a bar blocking good photography over the front seat side windows.

Flight:
Our flight was around ~65 minutes. The flight started from Lihue commuter's airport terminal. The path started from the south-east corner of the island through Poipu beach, port Allen - into the center of the island Waimea canyon with all the waterfalls - into the north-west corner Napali coast and all amazing vistas - onto north-east side and finally back to the airport. The views are simply breath taking and no review can do justice for this experience. So you have to experience it yourself.

Bottom Line:
I would give A+ to Wings over Kauai for the price ($125/person) and the over all flight experience. You can choose a chopper ride that will cost you 2X ($250/person), the only plus on the chopper ride is that they can land you on some waterfalls which are otherwise inaccessible and can fly little close to the mountains. To me i wanted to get the big picture so flying close to mountains would make sense. However, both options are good.   

Thank you WINGS OVER KAUAI for making this a memorable trip.

My husband and I have spent 3 glorious weeks on the Hawaiian Islands - exploring, surfing, hiking, eating way too much food but we both agree that this was by far our best adventure!!!  We opted for the flight as oppose to a helicopter for 2 reasons - cost and the reviews and hey they were completely spot on!!!  The service that Ellen & Bruce, "Wings" provides has a family feel and full of the Aloha Spirit, we really can't thank them enough for a wonderful experience that we'll always treasure.  Josh our pilot was such a genuinely lovely guy and made me feel very comfortable and allayed my fears of the flight - the views are breath- taking and we were able to see the entire island cloud- free and if we missed something Josh would circle again.  During the flight you may come across some of the helicopter tours and what I realized is they go really close to the sights, deep into the valleys and so close to the cliffs but I wonder if being that close they lose the grandeur and sheer glorious-ness of the views.  We were completely blown- away, humbled even being surrounded by such beauty so if your worry is will I see everything - trust me you will and more.  Thank you Wings for everything and more!!

review_title: Spectacular, Friendly, Adaptive and Personal Experience,  The best part of our visit to Kawai!
review_text:
Jane and I had a wonderful experience with Wings Over Kauai, from the point of view of a visiting pilot and an amateur photographer. Before we flew, Bruce clarified the traffic patterns unique to the Island. We then did 1. familiarization / training session and  2. a photography session, both over 1 hour long. We did not want the flights to end.

Bruce kindly let me (the pilot) fly out of the left seat and guided me around the island traffic pattern, while we flew around the coast, the canyon and the mountains. Bruce pointed out interesting landmarks and locations where famous movies have been shot. We chatted about various issues related to mountain flying, strategies for monitoring traffic and bird avoidance. 

In the second flight Bruce kindly let us open the right window to get clear photo shots, free of reflections and distortions. He positioned the aircraft at an appropriate distance, and considered the direction of light for good shot opportunities. It is clear that he understands the needs of a photographer. He encouraged me to take control from the right seat (with which I did not have much experience) and all worked out well. 

Bruce is an excellent pilot and an excellent instructor and quickly finds the level at which his student functions, communicates and encourages at an appropriate level. Ellen runs the office professionally and in a personally attuned way. All aspects of the experience have been pleasant. We look forward to more flying with Wings Over Kauai in the future and highly recommend the experience as safe, educational and adaptive to individual likes, needs and skill levels (pilots).

Michael Krelina, M.D., Jane Barlow, M.D.
Canada

review_title: go for it - you won't regret it!
review_text:
Before coming to kauai - we were tempted to take a heli ride but after reading multiple reviews & recommendations we finally chose to book an airplane tour. Among those 2 available on Kauai
we decided for "Wings over Kauai" and while waiting for our plane ride at the general aviation terminal
(which by the way is much more comfortable incl. restrooms etc than the bare heli gateways)
we could notice the difference to their next door competitor loading their aircraft to capacity
while wings places only 4 passengers comfortably on their state of the art air van.  All 
tour participants enjoy a right hand side window seat with unobstructed views of the island. 
Captain Josh was an excellent
pilot and tour guide pointing out the most interesting spots and stories on and about the island.
We enjoyed excellent flight conditions with miracolous views over countless beaches, Waimea
Canyon and of course the Napali Cliffs.  
Booking this tour is not difficult either. Just call Ellen the managing co-owner at the back office.
She'll book you on a flight which will suit your needs perfectly.
At the terminal before the flight Ellen will receive you very warmly and address all you concerns if needed.
Top notch service at a very reasonable price.   
Go for it!
Mahalo from Gina & Gerhard, visiting from Austria

We had a fabulous experience both with Cpt Josh in the air and with Ellen on the ground. Our check in and orientation was efficient, and our experience in the air was unforgettable. Not only did we see the highlights othe tours include (Na Pali coast, waimea canyon, and a multitude of waterfalls), but Cpt Josh shared information about the local folliage, pertinent history of the island, and of the sights. Also, they provided a video (free of charge), not of our specific flight but of a similar flight - a very nice touch.

review_title: Great Customer Service, but Motion Sickness
review_text:
Because of these high reviews, we booked with Wings of Kauai Tours.  We wanted so much to enjoy the airplane tour just as all these reviewers have been boosting about.  Maybe it was just our unlucky day where it was too windy, not sure really.  However, our group total was 5 and all 5 of us experienced major motion sickness (some vomiting) due to so much turbulence on our tour at 11AM.  It surprised our group because we were not prone to motion sickness in the past.  Our pilot Bruce did give us suggestions on how to reduce motion sickness and it helped some.  

We don't blame the staff since they have no control over mother nature.  In fact, their customer service is excellent, so professional and friendly.  Our suggestions are to call the day of the tour to check weather conditions and to take ginger before/during the flight.

review_title: No anxiety, no motion sickness and awesome flight!
review_text:
I'm not going to repeat everything that the other reviewers have already mentioned but will say that I agree with all of them. 

Things I will add are: 1) I am a little anxious in small planes and am prone to motion sickness. The take off and landing were amazingly smooth. We were lucky to have a mild day so almost zero turbulence. Bruce gave me some tips on how to keep my motion sickness at bay and checked on me during the flight. 2) Tanya, Ellen and Bruce exude a homeyness that makes you feel at ease. They are so friendly and their service is personal. Just extraordinarily nice people. 3) Felt like a was in good hands with Bruce at the helm. Very peaceful and informative flight. 4) Post flight, Tanya handed us a dvd at no charge. This stunned me! FREE?? I imagine other companies are doing the same thing, but charging you for the dvd. When I got back to my condo and logged onto my computer there was a thank you note from Ellen and electronic files of photos they took of us in front of the plane. Stunned again! So sweet. That is genuine hospitality that will make you come back for in the future and tell all your friends about.

I booked this flight for my husband's birthday and it was a great gift. He loved it and I think he'll remember it as one of my better presents! It was so affordable and such a great value. I could still take my husband out for a nice birthday dinner, whereas if I went on a helicopter ride, it would have been 2x the price. Plus it just felt safer.

If you come to Kauai, you should really consider Wings Over Kauai. They love what they do and it shows. You won't be sorry.

I loved the personalized tour we received. The flight was smooth and gentle-it is what flying is supposed to be like.  We could see everything so clearly and Bruce narrated so we felt like we really knew what Kauai was.  Don't miss this!

We took the Wings Over Kauai flight in September whilst on the Golden Princess cruise to Hawaii.  We were looking for something different to celebrate our 48th wedding anniversary and came across Wings Over Kauai whilst trawling the internet.  Thank goodness we did.  
Thank you to all at Wings Over Kauai, especially Sherry in the office and Josh our pilot who was very caring and a good guide.  We were made to feel very special and we will remember it always.
The best complement we can give is to recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone. 
Christine and Tony - Burnham on Sea, Somerset

Everything about this trip was terrific.  We pre-booked a few months ahead, the arrangements were easy.  We met the driver at a local shopping center and had a wonderful trip for a bit more than an hour.  The flight was so quiet and peaceful with a great explaination of the area while flying.  Definitely one of the greatest tours while in Hawaii.  We also were given a nice DVD upon the finish of the trip.  Thanks "Wings Over Kauai" for a super time in Kauai.

One of the best values on the island.  Bruce and Ellen are terrific people and making your flight the best ever is obviously their goal.  Bruce is a great pilot and with his agriculture background he was a wealth of information about island farming and has an abundance of knowledge about the island history. Little touches, like the photo they provide, involving you in pre-flight check and  the necklace presented on arrival, made this a special tour.  The island is truly a Garden Isle and the views seen during flight are ones you would never see otherwise.  This was actually the last thing we did before leaving the island and we saw the parts we were unable to see by car.  We had a truly memorable experience and one we would probably do again.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for making our trip to Kauii complete.

From the time I booked this flight online this was the best experience. We were picked up near our cruise ship. Taken to Lihue airport to start our filight.The ground staff are friendly and make you feel welcome.Our pilot Josh was the best.We felt safe and in capable hands the whole flight.His narration of our flight was informed and interesting.Sights we saw were amazing. This flight was great value. We experienced much more expensive helicopter flights on the nearby islands but this was the best for both value and sightseeing.We couldn't give a higher recommendation.

This was one of our first activities on the island and gave us a great overview as to where we wanted to go. Staff was very good to deal with; they were all down-to-earth, welcoming and friendly people. Weather was good for a decent trip, albeit the wife got motion sickness. Very appreciative that Wings Over Kauai were able to get our trip started off nicely!

PROS

Comprehensive - see the whole island in under an hour. Bruce was very informative and skilled to maneuver the plane to avoid excess turbulence

"The little extras" - it was a pleasant experience to receive the extra little touches they offered. They gave us a DVD as well as a nice kukui necklace for the misses.

Excellent Staff - the company knows how to run a business and treat their customers well. We felt important, appreciated and most importantly safe. Arriving early, Ellen advised to take some pictures at a nearby bay. 

CONS

Possible motion sickness - my wife got ill during the flight, so keep this in mind or take any precautions beforehand.

Wished it was longer! - we saw pretty much the whole island, but though my wife wanted it to end sooner, I wished it was longer.

Don't expect great detailed shots - I was big on being a camera-wielding tourist, so I think I may have had expected a bit much. Don't expect too many close ups. Not a deal breaker though, the tour was fantastic

Our tour today was really wonderfull, best weather, best plane and best pilot! Our family enjoyed the flight very much. We saw everything and more... We would like to encourage everybody to do the same. Thanks again Josh, Ellen and Bruce.

review_title: Spectular, imformative and incrediably family friendly.
review_text:
We had such a great time on our recent flight with Wings Over Kauai that I just had to post this short review.

My husband and I took our 20 month old on his first small plane today and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Ellen, Bruce and our pilot Josh were incredibly friendly, welcoming and informative. The plane set up was fantastic with every passenger getting a window set....and I just loved Ellen's genuine concern that the windows were not clean enough so she fixed them up herself before take off. I can't begin to explain how truly magical the flight is. Every turn and every corner had a new spectacular view. We tossed up getting a plane or helicopter and are so happy with our decision. Not only is it great value for money but I actually think the views are just as good if not better....giving us a broader view if the coast and canyon.

SO if you are considering a flight in Kauai I couldn't recommend this more highly...enjoy!!

review_title: My Favorite Activity While Visiting On A Cruise!
review_text: We had only one day in Kauai while visiting the islands on a cruise.  I had read these reviews and so booked the flight for our group of 4.  I am so glad I did!  They could not be friendlier, the flight was amazing and was truly the greatest way to get a good overview of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Our pilot, Josh, was personable and really just great to fly with.  They are cheaper than the helicopter tours and frankly, I think I prefer this whole experience.  I can't wait to visit Kauai again, and I would happily fly with WOK again.  THANKS for such a great and memorable experience!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Saved the Day
review_text: The hotel booked a flight for my Husband and I through another plane carrier.  We arrived at 11 for our 11:30 departure to find out they had engine troubles at 8 that morning and couldn't fly until later that afternoon.  They did not bother to call and let us know so we drove an hour to get there to find this out.  We wanted to fly just not waste the whole day to do it.  We went to Wings Over Kauai and they made room for us.  Bruce brought out the small Plane just for us, they were $10 cheaper and we had an amazing experience.  He knew so much about the island and the things to look at.  They gave us a free CD of the Experience and a picture of us with the plane.  It was a fantastic experience and they saved the day!!  Thank you Bruce great operation!

Today we went on a Wings Over Kauai tour.  It was definitely one of the highlights of our stay on the island!  Sophia checked us in and made us feel comfortable and welcomed.  After a quick picture in front of the plane, we boarded and were shown how to use the headset that would allow us to talk with one another throughout the flight.  Josh, the pilot, was wonderful.  He gave us a lot of interesting information about the history and current events of Kauai.  He took us over the coast, Waiemea Canyon, the Napali Cliffs, and many waterfalls.  Being quite fearful of flying, I was surprised at how much I thoroughly LOVED this trip!  We highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Kauai, both for the excellent views and the great customer service!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is a Lifetime Experience
review_text: If you come to Kauai, please make the most of your trip by taking an aerial plane tour with Wings Over Kauai. You'll find all sorts of offers for all sorts of helicopter and plane tours, but book with Wings. Josh, the pilot, and the rest of the staff are warm and friendly and very professional. Everything from the first email inquiry to getting secured on the plane was managed perfectly. I enjoyed Josh's descriptions of the geological formations and Kauaian history as we fly over the island. The beauty of the island just can't be described - and can't be viewed in any other way. It was relaxing and awe inspiring at the same time. We even saw a whale shark while flying over the ocean. After we landed and got off the plane, Josh gave us a DVD of the flight with our photo on the cover. That's the kind of attention to detail and friendliness that sets Wings Over Kauai above the others. I highly recommend them!

We wanted to do something special for our anniversary and decided to fly over Kauai.  We were on a cruise ship and were very limited in the time available to us.  Ellen picked us up close to the cruise ship terminal and explained the tour to us.  When we arrived at the airport the plane we were going to fly on had to have an adjustment and if we waited we would not have been able to get back to our ship in time.  Bruce made arrangements for my husband and I to fly in a Cessna for the tour and also gave us a DVD with some scenes from a fliht over Kauai and sent us a photo with the plane. Our pilot was very informative and you could tell he really love the island.  He explained history, a little about the geography and showed us were many films were shot.  It was an incredible tour and I am so glad that I was able to make the flight.  It was one of the highlights of our trip.

We had a great flight over Kauai taking in the spectacular scenery. I rang in the morning and was able to get a flight in the afternoon which was great. Their website is really easy to use and they were really helpful over the phone and when we went to check in. The pilot, Josh, was really friendly and pointed out all the points of interest.
I would highly recommend the flight to anyone going to Kauai and definitely fly with Wings Over Kauai.

I am a student pilot and my wife and I went up for a lesson in Bruce's Cessna 172. What an amazing experience!  Bruce is very knowledgable, both on many aspects of the island's natural and cultural history as well flight instructions!  His calm demeanor is very helpful with the flying instructions yet he kept my wife engaged in the tour. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai.
Mario and Dona.

review_title: One of the best parts of our honeymoon
review_text: My husband and I took a flight with Captain Josh at Wings Over Kauai, and it was an amazing experience.  We debated about whether to do a helicopter tour or this tour, and we are so glad we went with Wings Over Kauai.  The views were incredible, and we got a ton of great photos from the very large windows.  I really appreciated that they only booked one other couple on our flight, even though the plane could hold six passengers, in order to make the flight more comfortable and to allow everyone to see the views from the right side of the plane.  I had emailed Ellen before our trip with some questions, and she was extremely helpful.  Captain Josh was excellent, providing informative commentary without being cheesy.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and would not hesitate to take another flight with them when we come back to Kauai.

As a family with three young children (all under 6) and another on the way, many of the exciting things to do in Kauai were not practical so we decided to take a plane tour. To be honest I was a little concerned that our kids would be a little scared, but they loved the adventure of wearing headphones and walking on the tarmac. The plane ride was smooth, and touch downs and take offs where much less jarring then the US Air flights we came and left on. Our pilot Josh, was excellent, he was good with the kids, showed us all the interesting things on the island, and as a result of some of the points of interest he recommended we explored some things we might not have otherwise done.  Not only did we get a wonderful flight, they gave us a beautiful DVD and even e-mailed us photos all before we were out of the parking lot, without the up sale. I know there are other operators on the island but if you want a truly personal and intimate experience this is the group for you.

Ellen and Bruce do a wonderful job tailoring the flight to fit your interests. My wife and I chose to take a Flight Instruction hour with Bruce which allowed myself the ability to fly and see the beautiful Island of Hawaii! Absolutely amazing experience. We also found it to be three times less expensive compared to the helicopter rides. Truly a must do if you hope to see the entire island during your stay in Kauai! Thank you for the cd of pictures, that was an extra special touch we really appreciated.

This was our second flight with Wings over Kauai and when we come back will do it again.  It's the best way to see the island and Ellen, Bruce and Josh make it such an enjoyable experience as well.  Highly recommend!

This was a great alternative to the helicopters which we weren't crazy about using. The two of us were celebrating our 35th anniversary and booked a flight on the smaller of their two planes (a cessna).
