It was a FANTASTIC  excursion, especially for those people like us who don't want to be packed into a noisy vibrating helicopter with a bunch of other people.  My husband and I ended up with a private tour at a much lower price than what the helicopters were charging.  Amazing!  From where we took off, we could see the helicopters loading and taking off non-stop and ours seemed to be a much more relaxed and peaceful trip.  We were in the air for abt 1 hr 15 mins. and even though we couldn't hover or go as slowly or fly as low as the copters, we were still "blown away" by the trip.  Both Ellen (one of the owners) who did a great job with the registration and the details, and Josh (our pilot) were terrific. He was personable, knowledgeable and made sure we were comfortable.  It was a great overview of the beautiful island of Kauai and a great idea to do early in your trip as you can see from the air many of the places that you will want to visit. When we landed I found myself crying- not sure if it was because I was sad the trip was over, or was just overcome by the whole experience.  We will always have special memories of this trip.

From the minute we arrived at the terminal and were greeted by Sherry and Capt. Bruce it was a wonderful experience. We felt that we came to see our good, old friends whom we haven’t seen for a long time. The check in took only a few minutes and we were ready to board the plane.  Bruce is an expert pilot who has flown over 5,000 flights over Kauai so you may feel extremely safe, relax and enjoy the flight.  The flight experience was out of this world; with the cost being very reasonable we recommend everyone visiting Kauai to take a flight. In addition to being an expert pilot Capt. Bruce has a vast knowledge of the island history, flora, fauna, etc., which he shared with us during the flight.  We highly recommend taking a flight with the “Wings over Kauai”!!!

Chamil and Tatiana, Colorado, USA

Do not miss this flight. Very friendly and super professional team at Wings Over Kauai. Incredible scenery and majestic views from the plane. Josh the pilot inspired confidence and was a great guide, very personable. Also a great value.

We flew with Capt Josh on the 5th of oct and couldn't have had a more wonderful experience!! Ellen and Josh treated us like family as soon as we walked up, even though we were late!!! Having said that, they didn't short change us on the time we were up in the air.  We were up for a solid hour and had a great flight.  Josh really knows the island and was able to take us to all the highlight spots and a few extra!! We had an over cast day so our pics didn't come out as sharp but that has nothing to do with the tour.  I thought that the excellent reviews might be overrated, but was pleasantly surprised that WoK REALLY lives up to the 5 star ratings!! We went with our 7 and 9 yr olds and they made it so fun for all of us.  Definitely take this tour for guaranteed views of Kauai.  Plus, its less than half the cost of helicopter!! Thanks all at Wings, even Millie!!! :)

This was definitely one of the highlights of our week in Kauai.  I have taken a helicopter tour in Kauai before and while it is definitely what you want to do if you have the extra cash and don't get motion sickness, this is an excellent (and significantly cheaper) alternative.  Ellen and Captain Josh could not have been more friendly during both the booking process and the flight itself.  We lucked out with amazing weather and the ride was incredibly smooth.  It will definitely be one of the best hours you spend in Kauai and I could not recommend Wings Over Kauai more strongly.  There is a reason they are ranked #1!

review_title: Awesome tour and definitely felt safe!
review_text:
I've never taken a small plane tour before so I didn't know what to expect, but it was a fantastic way to see the island and it wasn't scary at all!  I popped a Dramamine an hour before the flight, but I probably would have been fine without it since pur pilot, Bruce, flew and landed the plane super smoothly--all while giving us lots of trivia and facts about Kauai!  There were 4 passengers on the plane and we all had great views out our windows!!

I really enjoyed the experience, especially the unexpected ginger chews, kukui nut lei, and photographs they gave us! :)  And the $120 price point was much cheaper than the price point the helicopter tours were charging.

review_title: very nice flight - with some caveats
review_text:
I wanted to do the helicopter tour, but knowing that my wife couldn't handle it (motion sickness) and wasn't up to it, we decided to take the plane tour .. its a good alternative, although perhaps less thrilling. the flight felt safe and we all had nice window seats (2 other pax) .. the pilot was a new guy who had just started working for the owner .. he may not have been 100% familiar with Kauai (I think he mentioned he had just moved there) however he was friendly and informative enough. 

Towards the end, we did hit some bad weather and my wife felt nauseated but overall it was a great experience! (try to sit on the RHS.. for best views of Na Pali )

We booked with Wings Over Kauai while visiting on the Pride of America. Our flight was on 9/27/2012 and we had Cap't Josh. It was beyond amazing!!! We walked over to the ABC store- a very short walk from the ship- and Bruce picked us up. Sophia and Ciera got us all checked in and ready for our flight. And Ellen gave us a ride back to the Marriott by the ship when we were done, so we met all the staff and everybody was so nice and helpful! The flight itself was just stunning. Kauai was our favorite of the islands and this tour was our favorite tour by far! We all had mics so we could talk with Josh and ask questions and he did a great job of pointing things out and answering our questions. I would definitely do this tour again if I'm ever lucky enough to be back in Kauai!! Mahola, Stan and Mary- Texas

We took a flight with Bruce (the owner) on 10-2-12.
I am a licensed pilot and can tell you Bruce is extremely professional and we were very comfortable with his skills and local knowledge.
I have taken many helicopter tours of this beautiful island and I can tell you Wings over Kauai beats them all.
The aircraft is very comfortable, much less vibration and quieter than any helicopter I ever flew on.   The views from the wide, clean windows were spectacular.
I recommend this tour without hesitation.
10 thumbs up.

My husband and I, and our 6 year old daughter took a wonderful plane ride with Bruce, our very knowledgable and hospitable pilot. We flew in the Cessna which seats the pilot, co-pilot, and two passengers (my husband was the co-pilot).The island was gorgeous from the air, so I would highly recommend a tour by air. If you can afford the helicopter tour I would recommend that, but for those on a budget (like us) I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. I received a beautiful necklace at check-in, a free DVD at the end of the flight, and had wonderful photos of my family emailed to us within an hour of our flight. Excellent customer service, fun trip, and great free gifts to remember the trip.

My husband and I booked this tour separately while on the cruise ship "Pride of America."  Ellen responded quickly to each email.  We were met at the ABC store right outside the pier and driven at no additional cost to the airport.  This particular day four of us flew with Josh in the larger plane.  Two additional people flew with Bruce in the smaller plane.  The larger plane could have accomodated all of us.  However, Ellen and the staff wanted everyone to have the best possible seats to view everything.  Josh did an awesome job narrating everything we saw.  It really helped that we had driven the coast the day before in a rental car, so we had a better idea of what we were seeing.  In addition, Josh made a couple of extra passes, so we were able to get a closer shot with our cameras.  I was amazed at how smooth the flight was, particularly the take-off and landing.  When we landed, we were ready to pay and do it again.  When we returned to the cruise ship, we met several other people who flew with Wings Over Kauai.  Everyone agreed this was the best tour we could have possibly done.  We always try to book privately and not through the cruiseline.  It helps the independent small business owner.  This company goes above and beyond when it comes to customer service.  We will definitely do this tour again when we return to Kauai.  If you cruise on Norwegian's Pride of America, rent a car the first day in port and drive the island. (We started driving at 8:30 a.m. and returned the car at 8:00 p.m. and saw the entire island.) Fly with Wings Over Kauai on the second day, since day two is a shorter length of time.  Thanks Ellen, Bruce, and Josh for making this adventure the best anyone could hope for.

We went with Josh for an afternoon tour. From the moment we arrived the staff was extremely friendly and helpful.  The Lady ( sorry forgot her name) at reception was super helpful and outgoing. We were greeted with flowers and a kukui nut lei. They were kind enough to give my 15 month old daughter a little stuffed bear :) The flight was very smooth, and Josh was very informative and friendly. You can see many stops on the island not accessible by car. Upon our return the staff provided us with a video and a photo taken of our family pre flight. I don't think you will find better value for your money on Kauai, even if they doubled their prices. This is a great sight seeing adventure for anyone interested in seeing Kauai from the air.

I am a very bad flier.  Very nervous, can't handle turbulence, etc. So when my husband asked if I wanted to go on a flight on a very small plane through Wings Over Kauai I wasn't exactly sold...

Having now done it (and survived!!) all I can say is, wow.  This is such an amazing experience and I'm so happy we chose Wings Over Kauai.  

Booking a flight was easy and Ellen responded quickly to all of our emails.  She also sent perfect directions so we arrived at the terminal and parked with no issues.

When we arrived Ellen prepped us for the flight by giving us some tips and asking if we have issues with motion sickness (I do), then she gave me a beautiful kukui nut lei and took a picture of us in front of the plane.

She helped me get situated in the front of the plane and gave me peppermint and ginger chews to help with motion sickness. They also have small bottles of water on the plane.

Bruce was our pilot and he was amazing. He's very calm and knows absolutely everything about Kauai so kept up a soothing commentary throughout the flight. I had a bit of a death grip on my chair every time we hit a bump in the air but as Bruce was so calm and in control it really helped me enjoy the flight much more than I thought possible.  Takeoff and landing were very smooth and we were lucky to have a pretty smooth flight. The views are stunning and you get to see parts of the island you'd never easily be able to access otherwise, this is a must do on Kauai!

A warm and personable staff - and friendly, experienced pilot, Josh - made for a very memorable experience. The flight was smooth and beautiful and we got some pretty amazing photos of the NaPali coast, waterfalls, the majestic mountains, Waimea Canyon, Hanalei Bay...
Mahalo, Wings Over Kauai!

First of all, Kauai is an awesome place. Above all, it's the people that make it even more awesome. Ellen and Bruce are among those people. 

The tour takes a little over an hour. You park directly at the private terminal. If you are prone to motion sickness then it is advisable to take care of it before you begin the tour. Don't forget to bring the camera because the views from above are gorgeous. In retrospect, I think that it should have been the first thing that we should have done because Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and not averse to a lot of questions. In fact he welcomes them and keeps checking in on you throughout the flight. By the end of the tour, you are able to plan your itinerary and know about the spots to hit according to your time on the island. 

When you check in, Ellen is a great host and very personable. She followed up with us with a couple of photos through email and even gave us separate DVDs of the beautiful video shot by their son who is an aspiring cinematographer in Hollywood. My only suggestion would be to upgrade it to HD video. 

Great people, great tour, great island. Thanks Ellen and Bruce. Don't do air or water, do both, especially, for Na Pali. I am still not done with Kauai.

review_title: The best flight charters in Kauai!
review_text: Having seen the positive reviews from fellow travelers on Trip Advisor, we decided to take an aerial trip of Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. Thanks to Ellen and Bruce for making this experience great. Our flight in charge was Capt Josh, who is also a full time pilot with American Airlines. He gave us a great aerial trip of Kauai and shared lot of facts of Kauai that we would not have known otherwise. I must say that we were impressed by quality of the customer service received, personal attention, and got good value for money. Front desk person, Sofia, was polite and handled our requests very well since we were traveling with a 6 month old and they treated us well.

Everything about this trip was enjoyable, from friendly check in to breathtaking flight. Went with my wife and 2 boys (age 8 and 6) and we all loved it. The views are spectacular and Capt. Bruce was informative and professional. We HIGHLY recommend taking this excursion!

We had a perfect time with the folks at Wings over Kauai. Our pilot for the day was Josh, who made it a memorable ride with his little insights, friendly interactions and a perfect flight. The guys are extremely friendly, make it very personal and don't pack the flight to keep it that way. One memorable ride, will definitely recommend!

Booked the trip ahead of time based on everyone reviews. It definately did not disappoint. Josh was fabulous and they really took care of us. They ask if anyone gets motion sickness or queasy and if you do they ensure that the little cooler on the plane has water, a cold compress and ginger chews. Unfortunately our teenage daughter got sick, nothing to do with the flight since it was smooth. Josh and the staff were so nice to her when they found out, she sufffers in silence this one. They were reasonable priced for a family of four, we didn't have to worry about getting window seats since everyone did and we were the only ones on the plane. Husband and son loved that we had to line up on the tarmack like the regular commercial planes, for them that was part of the thrill. Josh was super knowledgeable and pleasant. Would not hesitate to go back on them again and would highly recommend them to anyone who wanted a flight.

The staff at Wings over Kauai are very nice and friendly. It is a pleasant experience from making the reservation to check in to the tour itself.  We have four passengers on a six-passenger plane and we all seat on the right-side window seats with great view during the flight.   The lady gets a flower, each group gets a photo taken with the plane, then after flight we get a DVD which contains a short version of the flight.   

It is a great way to see Na Pali coast and many waterfalls.  Add it to your Kauai must-do list.

review_title: Outstanding value compared to helicopter tours, especially for passengers in the 250+ weight class
review_text:
Our goals were simple: find an air tour of the Napili coast of Kauai for a party of five that included a Samoan sized gentleman (well north of the 250 lbs. weight class but well loved), preferably a private charter, that was stable enough to allow all to see from the right side windows.

WHat a relief to find Wings over Kauai. They were perfect.  From the moment we met Josh, we knew we were in capable hands.  For $500 we booked a private tour of the entire island where the only weight restriction was an 1,100 pound total passenger load. No extra charges for empty seats for the larger passenger as demanded by the helicopter operators.

All in,  we paid less than half the cost demanded by the helicopter tours and know we enjoyed a smooth private flight with more than enough excitement for all.

My husband and I traveled to Kauai for our 25th anniversary and scheduled a couple of things based on reviews that I read on Tripadvisor.  Everything positive we read about Wings Over Kauai was absolutely true.  From the beginning stages of booking online they were very personable in their communication.  When we arrived we were greeted with enthusiasm.  The ladies get a lovely necklace and flower as a welcome gift.  The plane was very comfortable and they included a small cooler with drinks, wet towels in case you got a little queasy and mints to help as well. Bruce was so informative and you can tell he loves what he does.  The views were absolutely breathtaking.  When we landed we were given a very nice DVD of the sights we had seen with our picture on the cover.  It was a super day.  As my husband and I waited for our flight another group from a different tour company returned from a flight and they were very quiet and no real interaction with each other...when the group from Wings Over Kauai returned you would have thought they were all old friends.  The laughter and ease with this group and the crew spoke volumes and told me right away that we had chosen well.  Thank you to Ellen, Bruce and Kathy for a wonderful wonderful day!!

I've had in the past many experiences with other companies but this was is faaar on the top pf my list:
Few things that place them in top of my experience:
- easy to book, flexible and friendly
- Ellen and Josh (the pilot) make us feel like in familly, extraordinary people, I wish all business in the world be like this one...than no more recession :-)
-flight was smooth, lots of info from Josh, really unforgatable experience, if you'll go in Kauai this is a must, only 10% of the island can be seen from the road.
-pricewise is better than other competitors, flight time is longer than with other companies and Cessna 172 is best you can get in this airplane class. 
Thanks you guys and big kiss to Millie (Josh's dog, a pure beauty, so cute)

Julie and Daniel

From making reservations to the flight itself, nothing but compliments!  Customer service was excellent and what a great experience. We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.  We have flown on a float plane before and that was so cramped.  This plane was very comfortable and they didn't try to squeeze people in.  The views were unbelievable.  Ellen and crew are AWESOME!

My husband and I immensely enjoyed our entire experience with Wings Over Kauai!  It was a pleasure from start to finish.  Ellen was so welcoming when we checked in and Bruce was an excellent pilot and tour guide.  He is knowledgeable about Kauai and provides great commentary during the flight.  I was able to take lots of great photos and loved seeing Kauai from the sky.  I highly recommend choosing Wings Over Kauai if you are considering a sightseeing flight.

We were on Kauai during our honeymoon and decided to take an airplane tour over the island, as we knew that the northern part of it is very beautiful but not accessible by car or on foot. We googled out Wings over Kauai and chose them, as they had the best prices on the island. Elaine was so kind to pick us up at the hotel and to give us a ride to the runaway free of charge, as we did'n have a car. Bruce was our pilot for the tour and made the flight very interesting. He is a very knowledgeable man. He used to be a scientist researching genetically modified organisms. After he retired he became a pilot. The flight was very smooth and the landing was very soft. Elaine and Bruce gave us a photograph, a DVD and some other small souvenirs. Elaine gave us another free ride to the airport where we rented a car and continued our exploration of this beautiful island.
Thank you Bruce and Elaine.

My husband and I went on this tour during our honeymoon in Kauai and we weren't disappointed.  The pilot and other employees couldn't be friendlier and more accommodating.  There were only 3 passengers on our flight and Captain Josh was able to answer all of our questions while in the air.  My husband and I debated whether a helicopter tour or plane tour would be better and we believe the plane tour was a better value for the money.  The planes can't go into the valleys nor go as close to the mountains as the helicopters but the plane flew slower (great for photos) and was substantially cheaper.  I'd do this tour early so that you get a good overview of the island and with the money you save on a helicopter tour go on the Na Pali Experience boat tour!

review_title: You have to see Kauai by air.
review_text: Had a wonderful time flying with Wings Over Kauai.  The pilot was great and the plane is designed to give you some great views.  We went on a day when Lihue was very overcast, but Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali Coast were bright and sunny.  We were provided with drinks and snacks for the flight.  I prefer to tour the island by plane because you cover more ground and it's quite a bit cheaper.
Bruce was a wonderful host for an island tour.  He was very knowledgeable and was funny and great to fly with.  I would highly recommend taking this once in a lifetime flight!

Wings Over Kauai was Highlight of our trip. My Wife and my 2 daughters visited beautiful Kauai from July 20th to July 27th and we were planning to see the island from air as heard 80% of the island can be seen by road which is true. Initially we were thinking that air flight for 4 of us will not fit our budget, then found Wings over Kauai and found reasonable price. Booked over phone and were not asked for any advance which keep you flexible but wanted to do anyway. Our experience from start to end was 5 Star. The views from top were excellent and the service from Ellen,Bruce,Mary and our captain Josh was very personal. Ellen also recommended some safe place to visit with family. I will highly recommend if you are planning to take a areal view. We also had a excellent weather for our 11:00 AM flight.
Also boat trip which we did not do will also be good as you can have the closeness with beauty.

We lucked out because the weather on the day of our flight was amazing.  Totally clear.  The family who runs the business couldn't have been nicer.  Nice little touches before, during and after the flight.  There were 5 of us so we had our own plane and that was sweet.  Very knowledgable tour guide and pilot.  My husband loved being the co-pilot.  Highly recommend.

We flew out on a Monday afternoon.  

We showed up without a reservation, and were able to book a tour for just two hours later.  One thing I can smell from a mile away is fake "niceness".  That is, when people are being nice because they want your money.  These people were genuine.  They wouldn't take our money until flight time, even though I offered to pay early.  They wanted to know, and remembered our names.  Everyone was positive and friendly.  You got the feeling that they liked their jobs, and wanted you to have a good time.  

The pilot lived on the island and was also an airline pilot.  He wasn't just some "guy" with a license, he knew what he was doing, was highly skilled, and friendly.  He had a genuine knowledge of the island, and enthusiasm for living there.  The flight was smooth, we saw the entire island, and had a great experience.  The free DVD with our picture on the front was a nice touch.  The ability to talk to the pilot throughout the flight with the headsets was also great.  Highly recommended.  

My only criticism: I filled out an online form the night before, but they hadn't checked their email by 11am.  So we had to make a second effort to make a reservation by visiting them at the airport personally.  They should have checked their mail and called us before we left in the morning.  A minor quibble for an otherwise excellent experience.

I would fly with them again in a second, and recommend that others do the same.

We took a tour yesterday with Josh. He was very friendly and professional.   Ellen innthe office and the lady she was training were so nice!  The flight was very comfortable with very few bumps. Take off and landing were a breeze.  The weather cooperated well and the sights were as gorgeous as expected.   I feel very strongly the price is an excellent value but I must admit that I was a little jealous when I saw how much closer the helicopters fly.  Maybe I'll use the money we saved to do another adventure ;-)

Mahalo Josh, Ellen and Bruce

We thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Wings over Kauai and consider it one of the highlights of our whole tour. Thank you Sophia for making us feel so welcome and thank you Josh for a phantastic flight with amazing views and lots of interesting information.
We can only highly recommend this amazing experience.
Mahalo Wolfgang, Monika, Helene and Hannah

review_title: Wings Over Kauai vs. Helicopter Tour (ALL DAY LONG!!!)
review_text:
My wife and I recently visited Kauai for our 20th wedding anniversary and wanted to do something memorable on this beautiful island.  After reading the reviews on tripadvisor we decided to sign up for the Wings Over Kauai tour and were NOT disappointed.  Not only was this tour about half the price of a helicopter tour but we saw all of the same parts of the islands including the waterfalls, farmland, valleys and beautiful beaches and coast lines.  

This is a top notch, professional and friendly organization in every way possible! 

We had the opportunity to go with Bruce as our pilot (the owner) in the two passenger plane.  Our tour was amazing!  Bruce is extremely personable, knowledgeable and genuinely interested in his customers.  He shared his personal and professional experiences and even had my wife help him out with the pre-flight check, really cool!

This is a 6 star tour and 7 star service out of 5!  Overall I would go back to Kauai in a heartbeat, we had a fabulous week overall and found that everywhere we went people were nice and the island is amazing.  That said, our experience with Bruce, Mary and Ellen at Wings Over Kauai was over the top!  I will definitely do it next time we are on Kauai!

Bruce and Team, Mahalo for a top highlight of our week on your island!  

Dave & Cindy (from CA but not Hollywood!)  :o)

The service provided by the Wings Over Kauai tours was very well done.  Ellen was very hospitable while waiting for our scheduled flight.  Capt. Josh has a very clear passion for aviation and an extensive local knowledge of the things we were seeing.  Flight was very smooth and comfortable.  I would highly recommend this service to others.

My wife and I made our first trip to Kauai last week, and one of our first excursions was an aerial tour of the island with Wings Over Kauai.  We booked this tour over a helicopter for several reasons: 1) reviews on tripadvisor and others were outstanding, 2) VALUE (half price vs helicopter), 3) safety comparison, and 4) my wife can get motion sick from time to time.  We had a great tour by the Captain, Bruce, who was informative, witty and amiable.  The flight went without a hitch and presented a great and affordable way to see the island.  Cathy greeted us at the gate and was a pleasure, as well.  WOK is a tremendous way to begin or end a trip, as it gives you a completely different perspective of the island, and really lets you feel the scale of geological features.  I do see the appeal of a helicopter ride (gets closer to the action), but you really can't beat the value and service of WOK; I'd recommend them to anyone.  Thanks, guys!

review_title: The only way to see Kauai
review_text:
I researched and researched.  I called two helicopter companies and was not impressed.  Seemed that they just wanted to take my reservation and move on.  Not much help at all.  I came upon Wings via this website.  Half the price and a bit longer flight experience.  The Caravan is a nice 6 to 7 seven seater.  Bruce knows his stuff and the flight was enjoyable, smooth and beautiful.  I would do this again in a heartbeat.  If you want an extraordinary value for your dollar, then this is the ONLY choice you can make.  Call the number and his wife, Ellen, will take care of everything including a follow-up reconfirmation.......most likely, while you are on the Island.

We did a day trip from HNL to Kauai.  Took the 8 am Hawaiian Air flight to Lihue, rented a car and drove north through Princeville.  Had lunch, drove to the 4 pm flight and returned to HNL on the 7:30 pm HA flight.  An easy daytrip and very do-able.

This is the way to see Kauai! Like other reviewers we choose this one over the expensive helicopter flights. I can't imagine how this experience would have been better on a Helicopter. This was one of the top two things we did in Kauai. The owners and staff were very nice. They made a point to provide us water in a small ice chest during the flight and took pictures of us and emailed them to us that same day, plus gave us  CD when we finished  the flight.

review_title: Amazing option for private pilots too!
review_text: I'm a visiting private pilot and was trying to rent a plane. Found out about Wings Over Kauai and scheduled an instruction flight with Bruce, who acted not only as an instructor, but as a phenomenal tour guide with excellent customer service skills. I got to take off, fly in the air and land their Cessna and enjoy the amazing views and history of the island. From the flight booking, through the warm and attentive welcome and flight, I only have wonderful things to say about Mary, Bruce and the whole team! Bruce is a very experienced and gracious instructor. An amazing experience which I plan to repeat on every visit to Kauai! Thanks.

I have longed to see Hawaii from the air, but the cost has always been a factor.  We were a group of five, so we got a great rate and the plane to ourselves.  I am a bit of a worrier, but I never felt nervous or concerned at any time.  Sophia and Mary welcomed us, answered all of our questions, and took care of the pre-flight business with a friendly, easy manner.  Captain Josh was our pilot, and he took care to remember our fifth passenger on the left side of the plane and turn to allow him to see the sights.
The reservation process was easy, and Ellen was fast with her responses.  I would recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone wanting an aerial tour of the island.

We were very happy with WOK - the service was awesome! Customer service was exceptional from the necklace given to me at the beginning of the flight to the DVD show given to us at the end. We also received a great photo in our email that was taken of us in front of the plane before takeoff. The ride was comfortable and the views were amazing. Definitely choose to fly with them the next time you're here!

As an American living in Japan, flight training is difficult to get because it's expensive...and in Japanese. As such, both of my two training flights (so far) were done on vacation, first in Guam, then here at Wings Over Kaua'i. I have to say, Wings Over Kaua'i was at least 10 times better-- no exaggeration. The instructor worked with me and my specific needs-- NOT another island tour, but actual flight training. We went over to Port Allen, an uncontrolled field just SW of Lihu'e and practiced 2 touch-and-go's, went over the sea and practiced climbs, descents, stalls, and steep turns (my personal favorite). When we got back to the office, the people there were friendly and just as excited as I was -- you can tell they love their jobs. They even gave us a complimentary CD of our flight! Additionally, the CFI there was very helpful when I asked him about the right way to approach my training, and I ended up buying the FAA-authored Airplane Flying Handbook for just $20 -- only $2 over what the retail price was. All in all, an amazing experience...I'm looking forward to this Tuesday!

We had booked the 11am flight but on waking on the appointed morning to low cloud and drizzle rolling in from the sea, we assumed there would be no flying done that day. But as quickly as the clouds had descended, the sun broke through and we found ourselves at the Wings over Kauai offices discussing the "flight plan" and safety briefing with owner Bruce, pilot Joshua and staff Sophia and Cathy. Due to the earlier unpromising weather, it turned out my wife and I were the only customers for the flight that morning so it was that we took to the air in the 4 seat Cessna. Just the two of us and Josh. And so the magic begins! Kauai from the air is absolutely spectacular. All flying, including by helicopters, is done clockwise so our route took us along the eastern shoreline, across the Waimea canyon and along the stunning Napali coast for a full 60 minutes in the air with expert and interesting commentary from Josh in between keeping in radio contact with the many helicopters whizzing around. In short, this is a must do tour for everyone visiting Kauai. Everything from the initial booking with Ellen to the final landing and personal friendly attention from everyone at "Wings" was faultless. Excellent value for money and even includes a personalised DVD of the trip in case your own shots aren't up to professional standards! Highly recommended.

review_title: Great alternative to the $$$$ Helicopter flights.
review_text: I took my family on the Wings over Kauai flight and it was a great experience and was about HALF the cost of a helicopter tour. Customer service and followup was excellent as you might expect from a well run family business. Bruce is a great pilot and guide, he made sure everyone was comfortable and had a great amount of knowledge about the island and landmarks we were seeing. Don't let the high cost of the helicopter tours stop you from seeing some amazing sights that you can only see from the air! Fly Wings over Kauai!

review_title: Experiance Of A Lifetime - Unforgetable - A Must Do
review_text: If this was an Olympic Event, It would be Gold medals all round for “Wings Over Kauai”, starting from our initial contact with Ellen via email to the actual pick up, pre flight preparation, flight then drop off back at the Cruise Ship everything was superb. This was our 1st flight over the island and we flew with Bruce in the Cessna, weather and vision for sightseeing and photography was superb and Bruce`s knowledge of the island and his commentary was excellent, he kept both my wife and I enthralled for the full 65min flight (even got a song out of Bruce while flying over the “Waimea Canyon”). This without doubt was the high point of this our 3rd trip to Hawaii but our 1st to beautiful Kauai. It has been very hard to pinpoint what we liked the most on the flight as it all was awesome and we have superb photo`s, DVD and unforgettable memories of this experience. This is definitely a must do tour and so easy to organise yourself online.

These guys earned their 5 stars from the time of booking to the moment we returned to our car.

It was good to deal with a family run business and they certainly lived up to the high expectations that we had built up from all the TripAdvisor reviews.

The booking process with Ellen was efficient and really friendly.  We're from the UK, with an 11 hour time difference, so everything was organised on line and by email.  Responses came back by return, and provided all the information we needed.  We booked our flight and were not even asked for a deposit.  Ellen's response when we offered a payment was "we are just using the honor system to hold reservations and it seems to be working really well".  A nice touch.

Our weather in Kauai was great but with some seriously strong winds and we were a little nervous about going up in a small 4 seater Cessner.  Upon arrival at their office they assured us it would be ok, although they did warn us that there would be a few bumps!  Before completing the paperwork and taking our money they suggested we speak with the passengers who were coming back from the previous flight.  They offered to cancel the booking or re-arrange it for another day if we were concerned. There was no pressure on us whatsoever to fly, which we really appreciated.  We eventually decided to go for it and are so glad we did.

Carter (Ellen and Bruce's son) looked after us while we were waiting, and was great.  He then introduced us to Bruce, our pilot.  Bruce's style is incredibly calming and he gave an excellent commentary on the landscape, history, flora and fauna, whilst chatting with us throughout the flight.  He is not a typical tour guide, he is genuinely knowledgeable and interesting and clearly loves the island. The flight was amazing and we saw virtually everything.  Kauai is absolutely stunning from the air. 

After an extremely smooth landing, we went back into the office and were presented with a "home made" but good quality DVD of a typical flight, personalised with our photos, which had been taken as we boarded the plane.  The photos were later emailed to us.

Having flown over Maui in a Blue Hawaiian helicopter a few years ago and been stuck in the middle seat, with limited visibility, I loved the fact that "Wings" only use the right hand seats of their aircraft to give everyone the best view.  Also, the safety record of tour helicopters in Hawaii is not great and following the sad Blue Hawaiian crash on Kauai at the end of 2011, we felt a lot safer opting for a fixed wing plane.  

A plane can't get into the valleys in quite the same way as a helicopter, but I remember from the previous flight that we spent a lot of time hovering and circling around so that everyone could get a view.  With the fixed wing flight, it felt that we were getting a much better overview of the whole island, and at only 1,500 feet, the scenery still felt very close.  It was just as good, if not better, than a helicopter.

We chose to fly with Wings primarily because of the safety issues and the seating arrangements.  It was not really a cost based decision but, at about half the price of a helicopter flight, we thought it was amazing value for money.

Finally, having landed and been given our DVD, we walked back to our car and as we were getting in, Bruce made the effort to come over to offer directions and suggestions for the rest of the day.

We loved the personal and genuinely friendly service of Wings over Kauai and their professionalism throughout and recommend them one hundred percent.
We had an amazing flight over Kauai. Thanks to Ellen and Bruce and their lovely organization.

Wings Over Kauai does a fantastic tour of the island at a very reasonable price. I originally contacted them via e-mail and got an immediate response from Ellen. She reserved spots for my wife and me, without any required advance payment, and gave clear directions how to find the place. When we arrived, she and Allison checked us in. Our pilot, Josh, did a great job flying us around the island and pointing out the sights. We even got a pretty good look at Wai'ale'ale, the perpetually rainy peak in the center of the island, thanks to a break in the clouds and relatively light winds. After the flight, we got a DVD of a flight over the island (not ours but one like it), and Ellen e-mailed photos that they took before the flight. They are a terrific group and they do a great job. This is a great option for seeing some spectacular scenery.

We were very excited to be taking this flight over Kauai after reading many positive reviews.  We were on the Pride of America cruise ship and only in Kauai for a day and a half, so it was perfect to get an overall experience of the island in just 1hr.  I can't express how easy it was to book by just emailing Ellen directly she was so prompt in replying. This was also so much cheaper than a helicopter tour.  If you are on the cruise ship they pick you up not too far from the port near the ABC store (which you can hop on the free shuttle to or just walk about 5min).  All the staff are so friendly and Sophia is just lovely, she even gave my 2yr old daughter a little toy puppy and she just loved it! (it's the small things that count).  Joshua was our pilot and made us feel very comfortable, he was so knowledgeable and gives you a good commentary on all the sights, the highlight was the beautiful Napali coast, it was just awesome!.  We flew on their smaller aircraft and it was fantastic, definitely a must do tour.

My wife and i decided that an aerial tour of Kauai was a must, but since she is 7 months pregnant we had to be picky. We heard the helicopter was out so we looked into the plane tours. This place was awesome from the first phone call. They said not only could my wife fly, but if the winds were too bad the day of our tour for her motion sickness they would let us reschedule. Fortunately, we ended up with a great day. Mary greeted us when we got there and made us feel special right away. It was the kind of friendliness you could only get with a mom and pop business. Josh was our pilot and he was terrific. Super friendly, and made sure my wife was comfortable the entire flight. He let us know when it was going to get bumpy and when it would get better. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone!

Visited in June 2012, Bruce was a great guide. The day we were supposed to go up I realized I had left my camera back at the room in Princeville. They allowed me to reschedule for the next day, very flexible. The veiws were incredible and considering the price compared to a helicopter ride, it's a no brainer. My 17 yr old was charged the kids rate (bonus!) Every seat was a window seat. They take a picture of your group before the flight. I usually don't even try to look good so I am not tempted to buy an expensive photo later on. Wish I would have this time because they used it as the cover of our DVD of this flight (not our actual flight) that was included at no extra charge. What a nice surprise. Also received leis made out of some kind of seed or nut (won't shrivel up like the flower ones). I would easily recommend this company to anyone. Great way to get a different perspective of the Napali Coast.

When we came to Kauai, I expected an aerial tour would be out of reach for us.  When we looked into it, I was surprised how affordable it was.  The staff at our Inn recommended Wings, saying that it was much more enjoyable than a helicopter tour.  That the price was lower was definitely nice too!  They were very helpful accommodating us to get a tour that meshed nicely with our schedule.  They were incredibly friendly throughout the process, and the flight was amazing.  Ellen was very hospitable, and Josh did a great job flying us.  The island's beauty is remarkable.  Josh did a great job letting the island show itself off, offering helpful facts about the things we were seeing.  And he did this all while providing a very smooth, well-planned flight.  I know some of the people on our tour were a nervous about flying on a small plane, but he had a flawless flight like a real pro.  I've already been recommending this tour to my friends on the mainland! Mahalo!

review_title: A great Family Experience in Kauai
review_text: We just came back from our family trip in Kauai, We wanted to see the beautiful Island. My husband found this tour place, the price was great considering that there is 6 of us in the family. The price was great after. The flight was amazing! Since the minute we got there to register Ellen was very nice and helpful, Also our tour capt Josh came out to greet us, I actually told him I was really nervous and by his response he made me feel better and trust that the ride will be an enjoyable one and after seen the island I forgot I was nervous. We all enjoy it very much. The view it's amazing well worth it. I recommend Wings Over Kauai Tours, they are the best!

We wanted to see Kauai from the air (doesn't everyone?) - liked the reviews about both value and safety. Also thought it would be a unique opportunity to log some flight instruction. Bruce is a wonderful instructor - even if you have never been at the controls, he can lead you through take off,  landing and a memorable tour. Give Wings over Kauai a try - you won't regret the choice.

Had a great flight with Wings Over Kauai. I really liked the personal touches that Bruce and Ellen added.  When I arrived a was given a shell necklace and flower to wear behind my ear.  They both took the time to get to know my boyfriend and I.  We were given bottled water during the flight.  Bruce often referred to us by name and genuinely seemed interested in learning more about us.  Bruce also shared many things about what was going on in his life as well and how he came to live in Kauai.  It was like we were flying with friends.  After the flight we were given a dvd that had our picture on the cover.  We were on a small aircraft with just my boyfriend and I and Bruce.
Great time!
Wonderful flight! Great family run business! Very professional and willing to work with my schedule! Nothing negative about my experience

The flight was really delightful....Bruce was considerate, competent, and knowledgeable, and Mary was warm and friendly. The service is quite personal, and they make a point of remembering your name and making you very comfortable.    I absolutely recommend WOK.....not to be missed!

We really wanted to see Kauai from the air but were horrified at the prices for the helicopter tours...then we stumbled upon an ad for Wings Over Kauai. Checked them out on tripadvisor as we always do for everything we book and were astonished at all the excellent reviews...and they were all right. The whole experience was excellent! We ended up taking the small Cessna (just my husband and I) and really enjoyed the personal experience. Amazing views, great commentary from pilot Bruce and a smooth flight. Would recommend this tour in a heart beat.

'Wings Over Kauai Tours' were recommended by friends, and we were not disappointed. From the punctual pick up in Nawiliwili, to the informative flight around the island, to being dropped off at the cruise terminal was conducted in an obliging, friendly and professional manner. The seating in the aircraft afforded good views through domed windows that enabled good photos to be taken of the incredible terrain below. Bruce and Ellen provide an excellent service at a very reasonable cost.

I purchased this flight as a surprise for my mother for Mother's Day. We were in Kauai for 1 day on  a 14 day Hawaiian cruise from LA. I must admit I was a little apprehensive at first as I'm a white knuckle flier at the best of times. Ellen and Bruce are 2 of the most wonderful people that you will ever meet. They both reassured me that there is nothing to it. I'm so glad I decided to do it cause it was the highlight of the cruise. The relaxing Hawaiian music Bruce played just added to the experience. Both of us just raved about the flight to everyone for weeks after. I can't wait to return and do it all over again.

review_title: Best Value to See Kauai By Air
review_text:
My huband, daughter, brother, and sister-in-law toured with WOK on June 10.  The pre-flight check in was very informative - given by Bruce and Ellen's daughter, Mary.  And Bruce was just fantastic as the pilot and guide.  We've been to Kauai numerous times, but had not toured the island by air.  This really gave us the perspective we had been missing.  So much of the island isn't accessible by anything other than air and as such, we were able to see so many sights we had previously missed. 

As others have noted, Bruce manuevered the plane to allow all to get pictures of Na Pali and the waterfalls.  The scenery is just breathtaking!  Helicopter tours may get you closer, but in my opinion, it just isn't worth the significant increase in cost.  WOK is one of the best values we have found for exploring Kauai and highly recommend this company and its tour.

My wife and I flew with Bruce this morning. Fantastic experience and a great way to see parts of the island you can't see any other way. Bruce and his team were superb. We really enjoyed the flight and the views of this incredible island. Mahalo Bruce!

On every trip to Hawai'i we debate the helicopter tour but ultimately decide against it.  However, since touring Kauai from the air is a "must", we went with Wings Over Kauai last week and have not regretted it for an instant!   The company is run by a friendly and helpful family who made us feel very welcome.  Josh is an excellent pilot who made us feel comfortable throughout the entire flight.  Recommend booking the flight for early in your trip to get a good island overview.

My daughter and I took the flight a week ago - we enjoyed the journey and highly recommend the adventure.  It was very relaxing and a great way to see the island.  The cost was reasonable! Thank you, Bruce, for a great flight and to Ellen for her words that encouraged us to check it out!!!

I cannot think of a better way to see this most beautiful of the Hawaiian islands.  We felt very comfortable with our pilot, Josh, and the family who run the business are warm, appreciative and accommodating.  The plane itself is comfortable and we were able to communicate with each other very well while in flight.  The DVD given to us after the flight has been a nice reminder of our experience and something we can share with others as well.

review_title: So friendly, so much to see, a great experience
review_text:
Wow, what a great flight we had on May 29th 2012. The people at Wings Over Kauai are the friendliest people you will meet, and they run a fabulous operation.

Josh was great with our 11yo who never stopped asking questions for the whole flight.

We will definitely do this again next time we are in kauai.

What an incredible way to see all of the island, especially the waterfalls, the Napali Coast, and the North Shore. We were staying in Poipu and could pick out our condo from the air, as well as see all the way we had walked a couple days before from the Hyatt to Gillens Beach. Tunnels Beach and its reef as well as Waimea Canyon also stood out as aerial viewing treats.

All 4 passengers were on the right side of the plane, so everyone could see everything, and all had unobstructed viewing out the large windows. We had a lovely day, and Josh our pilot was first rate. We got a free DVD at the end, with our picture on it in front of the plane. Just one word of caution to those who get motion sickness. I don't, and thought the flight was pretty smooth, but my husband had taken 2 Bonine and even so was a little queasy by the end of the one hour flight.

review_title: A first class operation for sure!
review_text: We were picked up at the ABC store and taken to the airport. Upon arrival at the airport I was given a beautiful wooden lei to wear. I was very ill with a virus at the time but didn't want to cancel because I wanted my husband to see the Island. We had a marvelous flight on a beautiful day. We were given a video of the flight and am I thankful as I can't recall the trip at all due to the illness. It was great to get home and be able to see what I don't recall seeing. Our thanks to all of you at Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: The BEST part of our trip was this tour!
review_text:
Do yourselves a favour and book a flight with the Wings Over Kauai crew today! It was hands-down the best thing that we did on our 14 day Hawaiian adventure. From the second we arrived in the morning, to the second we got off the flight, we were treated like royalty. Bruce greeted us with such warmth that we knew we were in capable hands from the onset.
The flight itself was truly a sight to behold. The majesty of the island is literally at your feet. It was absolutely breathtaking. Bruce was also incredibly knowledgeable and answered every question that we could think of. He is the consummate host! 

If you are looking for a magical, affordable, first-class experience then this flight is for you! There is simply no better way to see the island than this!

We took our flight while the cruise ship we were on was in port.  Ellen provided transportation to the airport and back to the ship at no extra charge.  The views were spectacular and Bruce was great at sharing his knowledge of Kauai while piloting the plane.  The entire staff was personable. I recommend taking the Grand Deluxe Tour if you visit Kauai.

review_title: Saved the best for the last day
review_text: Our plane didn't leave until 9:30P.M., so we decided to do something really fun on our last full day in Kauai. Boy, was it ever fun!  I really liked that everyone had a window seat and we all were able to see so well. The views were so beautiful, it was breath taking. Josh, our pilot explained all the maneuvers and what to look for as we passed over so many beautiful sites we would never had seen if we hadn't taken the flight. I would definitely recommend this trip and will take it again if we get the chance to come back to Kauai!

First trip to any of the Island's, Kauai was beautiful. The staff at Wings over Kauai were wonderful. Our pilot, Bruce, provided awesome views and was an entertaining host. We were provided with a free CD of our flight. I took my Nephew for his 12th birthday. Highly recommend this, also, very reasonably priced

We had an excellent experience with Wings over Kauai.  Bruce and Sophie were super friendly and accommodating.  They went above and beyond to make sure we felt welcomed and attended to.

The flight itself was phenomenal.  All of the "Kauai highlight" areas were hit and Bruce did a great job talking about each one.  He was also good at engaging each of us in conversation throughout the flight, which made for a more personalized experience.

If you are looking for a fun way to see the gorgeous island of Kauai for literally half the cost of a helicopter tour, make sure you check out Wings over Kauai!

Mahalo!

One afternoon we took a scenic flight around the island with Wings Over Kauai. This is a great way to see waterfalls that are not accessible by car. We had an excellent pilot. At the end of the flight, they gave is a DVD with some of the sights we experienced during the flight.

Wings over Kauai Tour was excellent and the staff was incredible.  I was 6 months pregnant and they made sure I was very comfortable and didn't get "sick" on the flight.  They were very professional and friendly in every regard.  The tour was awesome and the pilot was very knowledgeable of the island.  It definitely was the highlight of our trip to Kauai and we'd do it again.  It is also the best "bang for your buck" to see the island from up above.  Fantastic!!!

review_title: Fun Viewing Kauai from the air
review_text:
We enjoyed our air tour of Kauai flying Wings Over Kauai in their six seater fixed-wing aircraft.  Wings Over guarantees a window seat on the right side of the plane for every customer.  This is crucial to getting a great view of the island from the air and getting your money's worth.  

Bruce Coulombe, the owner/pilot, is a retired scientist and very knowledgeable.  We thoroughly enjoyed his commentary and insights as we flew.  Bruce is a veteran pilot with more than 5,000 flights over Kauai.

One drawback of the fixed wing aircraft is that it cannot get up close to many of the waterfalls and ridges that a helicopter can.  For us, this was for the best because one of our party members tends to get motion sickness.  Bruce and Ellen also made sure that the person with the tendency for motion sickness got to sit in the co-pilot seat to minimize the effects of the motion of the plane.

Ellen, Bruce and Joshua are a great team and make their customers feel welcome and relaxed.  I had come to Kauai specifically to see the Na Pali coast by air (since i could no longer hike it).  The fixed wing plane was good value and Bruce was a fount of information.  The fixed winged plane does not go into the canyons but looking at helicopters that did, I was glad that the plane did not do that -  a sudden gust of wind could be extremely dangerous.
Kauai is beautiful from the air and with so many contrasts it is a delight to see.  We had seen the Waimea Canyon from the road the previous day and the plane view gave a wonderfully different perspective.  Flying over Princeville and the northern coast was also lovely and gave us an idea of whether we wanted to visit there or not.  If you are a golfer then there are some very interesting and beautiful golf courses.
Be ready with your camera and dont lean it against the window - it damages the windows.  The opportunities for photographs are quick so you really need to be prepared.  Video of the trip would be great.  Bruce's son has produced a CD with photographs taken of customers before the trip and highlights of what is seen on a typical trip.  A great souvenir.  They also present the women passengers with a Kuki nut lei.  
Bruce was an agronomist and is able to tell you all about the crops and flora of the island.  The forest of abiza trees from Africa are beautiful - hopefully they are not an invasive pest.
We were lucky enough to see some waterfalls as there had been a lot of rain recently.  The extinct volcano in the middle of the island has the highest record of rainfall in comparison with other parts of Kauai so there were quite a few waterfalls on he northern side.
Ellen provides air sickness ginger candy for those with queezy stomachs and cold drinks in the form of cola and water.  Bruce goes through all the safety checks before take off including the use of life jackets.
The plane we flew had been made in Gippsland (Australia) and took six passengers as well as the pilot.  It was comfortable.  Note that the seating of passengers take place according to weight so you may not get the seat you had hoped for.  However all seats have good views and Bruce will point out places and things of interest if you advise him before hand of your particular interests.
The fixed plane cost is roughly half the cost of a helicopter flight.  It is good value indeed.
The waiting area looks over the helicopter landing area and you can sit in the open air and watch the helicopters taking off.
This was an event to remember and we will certainly be talking about for a long time to come.

Booking online was a breeze and Ellen, the pilot's wife, even arranged for my BF to have the co-pilot seat because we were doing the tour in his birthday.  The family-run nature of this business makes it very warm and hospitable.  On the day of our flight, we were greeted and welcomed with smiles, chatted briefly with Ellen about what we would be viewing from the air, and then met Bruce, the pilot.  Bruce was a wonderful pilot and guide, sharing all of his knowledge of the island.  He engaged everyone on board by name, made sure we were all comfortable and having a good time.  The views were spectacular, but the service is what makes Wings Over Kauai such a good choice.  You're going to see beauty all over Kauai - it's the people who make or break an experience.  Definitely recommend doing a flight with this company....you will thoroughly enjoy it!

We had our flight with Wings Over Kauai earlier today, and I just wanted to add my voice to the many here in favour of this tour. I must confess that I have no frame of reference for comparison, this is the first super friendly, genuine, and truly amazing air tour I have been on over an Island Paradise, but I still feel confident in saying if you are planning a trip to Kauai it HAS to contain this tour. I can't see how there is a better way to see the island and find out anything you want to know about it along the way. 

From initial contact with Ellen and initial greeting on the day, through to the registration and pre-flight with Sofia and the flight itself with Bruce, the whole experience is great. They are such lovely people and really love what they do. The only thing that overshadows how good they are and how at ease they put you and how comfortable and quiet the plane is, is the beauty of the island and the breathtaking sights you get to enjoy during the flight.

review_title: Trust the reviews... it is AWESOME!
review_text:
We used WOK after reading all the reviews from tripadvisor and we couldn't have been more pleased. This is a fantastic experience and the staff were all wonderful. From the organising to the flight everything went perfectly.

This is a must and was a highlight for everyone including my Dad who has seen the world and it takes a fair bit to impress him. The flight is stunning and really completes a trip to Kauai. Worth every cent!

Bruce was extremely informative and a wonderful pilot - a pilot with a Ph.D makes for a great flight! Not much more to be said that hasn't already been said however if you suffer from motion sickness I would recommend taking something beforehand (mainly due to the fact it is a light plane - not to any fault of the pilot).

They even gave us a lift to the airport after! A wonderful family run business that really delivers!

user_location: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States
review_text:
Thanks to a huge Recommendation from my neighbor, they for sure said you have to do an air tour by WOK. This was by far the highlight of our trip, the views are incredible, and even though Mother Nature didn't cooperate over the Waimea Canyon, Capt Paul found some other parts of the Island that were just as good.

You will be amazed at the number of Water Falls that are visible, these are not just 50 feet waterfalls, I am talking several hundred feet, with several of them at a time. It was amazing and the pictures are incredible. The flight was great, the airvan is nimble and can be turned around in seconds. 

The folks at WOK are the nicest on the island, and the price is half of what you spend on a Copter ride. I can't wait to come back in the future and do it again, this is a class "A" Business.

Wanted a flying tour of Kauai, and based on Tripadvisor, picked Wings Over Kauai.  Filled out WOK form online, and got to Lihue to find an email that my chosen tour was booked, and a choice of other times the next day.  Quick confirmation from WOK on my second choice date, no requirement for a credit card confirmation ("on the honor system") good directions to their location. Actual check-in very nice, with parking right there. Very nice plane, with really clean, clear windows. Fabulous tour over spectacular scenery, very nice narration by owner, who doesn't seem at all jaded, despite doing this 5000 times. Lots of personal touches, and the fact that every passenger had their own Bose noise-cancelling headset with a microphone made asking questions very easy. On return from the 60+ min flight, everyone got a souvenir DVD with highlights, and their picture by the plane on the cover. Highly recommended, half the price of a helicopter, and much easier on the environment. I had hiked the Kalalau trail the day before, and didn't much care for the constant helicopter noise. Never heard the plane.

We loved Bruce's tour and the wonderful, safe flight over the island - giving the best view ofnthe NaPali coast- we took a great boat tour too, but the flight was the best and showed us the whole island. Great value.  Carter did a great job with the video and pictures as well.  Terrific family run operation.Thank you for everything!

To echo all of the other very positive reviews, we had a great experience flying with Wings Over Kauai.  The friendliness and helpfulness of all of the staff (family) at Wings was truly notable, from online booking to check in, to the flight itself. 

Bruce, our pilot, is so very knowledgeable about Kauai; the information he shared with us regarding the island was fantastic.  We had been to Kauai a few times and decided to try a flight to see the whole of the island.  We are so glad that we did!  

We cannot say enough about our flight--we so thoroughly enjoyed it. It was a highlight of our trip to Kauai.  Highly recommended!!

A really, really first class experience, starting with booking all the way through the flight.  I booked online after doing my due diligence with TripAdvisor :-).  I have an anxious flyer (son, age 10) and felt that a helicopter might be too much for him.  I was assured by Ellen that he would have a great time in the plane and he did!  Carter welcomed us and made us feel at home (thanks for the flower and kukui lei, that's my new Facebook photo!).  Bruce took pains to be sure that my son understood everything going on during the flight and let my husband "co-pilot."  Bruce pointed out many sights - we saw so much, including whales!  Mahalo, Bruce, Carter and Ellen for a wonderful flight!

We had a great flight and i have to say the whole operation is top shelf.
I can not wait to take another flight with Bruce and wings over Kauai.
It was amazing topography throughout the flight.

review_title: Wings over Kauai, Excellent way to see the Island
review_text: We had a great flight today with Bruce and Wings over Kauai. The one hour aerial tour of the island let us see all of the sights you read about on Kauai. Bruce has lived on Kauai for quite awhile and was able to share with us a lot of local history and information about the island. The aircraft used by Wings over Kauai is well suited to this type of flying and was very comfortable. Being in the aviation business, I appreciate seeing an aircraft and business being operated in a professional manner, Bruce and Carter did not disappoint. I would recommend this experience for everyone.

I exhaustively researched our trip to Oahu & Kauai and was looking for the best experiences at reasonable cost. We had 10 days to do both islands.  Best use of time and money mattered.  Travel literature leaned heavily towards the helicopter tour and in researching them, I came upon WOK through TA.  We took the chance (and savings) and went for it.  Reviews found here on TA were key in this decision and we have NO REGRETS.

From the first momenet of booking, every aspect of the experience was friendly, easy, honest, professional, informative, safe and inviting. Others  have said it all here and I echo them. We were treated as if we and our vacation mattered! From email with Ellen to check-in with Carter and flying with Bruce, every detail was perfect. It was a relaxing time. No "herd" experience. Not a bad seat in the plane. Our safety and comfort were paramount to WOK. The quality individual headphones & microphones really made for a quiet flight so we were able to hear Bruce's informative pointers, ask questions and ensure everyone's comfort.  The personal photo, free flight tour CD upon landing, free snacks on the plane and the followup email afterwards were nice touches.  WOK obviously loves providing the public a fun, economical, safe adventure.  We had a great time and do not feel like we missed anything by foregoing the chopper tour.  The substantial savings were well spent elsewhere.

Thanks to all at this small family run business. We had a great time and there was no hassle or unpleasant surprises.  First Class service and a great value!

Visitors cannot grasp the full beauty of Kaua'i without an aerial tour. If your budget, health, and stomach are not obstacles, go with the helicopter tour. If you are nervous about flying in a small plane or are prone to motion sickness Wings Over Kauai is a perfect choice. Ellen and Bruce own this small business and understand that people need reassurance for air travel in a plane that seems so small and fragile. You can trust that Bruce will not fly if conditions are not right and he will get you off and back safe and sound. Ellen provides ginger candies that really help with queasiness. 
Our preference was  to take the helicopter flight but our budget is limited and we found this tour the best choice. The competitor was doing a brisk business, but I know ours was a superior trip because of the accurate description of everything we saw by Bruce who is  very knowledgeable. Because we chose the airplane trip instead of the helicopter, we were able to afford a boat cruise with Holo-holo that gave us an up close  vantage of the Naal Pali coast. In addition, we rented a car and drove around to see all the views from ground level. 
One of the other reviewers noted a delay in starting due to flooding the engine on take off. This happened at the start of our flight, too--and it was nerve wracking. However, Bruce is calm and reassuring so we didn't feel uneasy about possible problems while in flight.
I had a seat to the left and missed many sights but had a beautifull view of the ocean and saw a whale during the flight.

review_title: this was a highlight of our trip!!!!!
review_text: What a great experience!! This outfit was very professional and helpful. We booked a  morning flight from our cruise ship. They arranged for our transportation to and from the airport. The flight itself was magnificent! If we were to return to Kauai we would definitely do this again.

Sophia welcomed us as we arrived with a warm smile. She was pleasant, informative and prepared us for the flight. We had our picture taken by Carter in front of plane and met our pilot Bruce shortly thereafter. Bruce put everyone at ease from the get go and gave us details about himself, the plane and the tour. THe hour went by too quickly and we were awed by the beauty of the island seen from a different view/perspective. Bruce added anecdotes and trivia along the way. All in all, a wonderful experience. I would HIGHLY recommend this tour to everyone. At the end...we were impressed and surprised with a gift- a DVD of tour with our picture on it. WOW!  Class act from beginning to end!

review_title: Ellen trully made our vacation that much better
review_text: We called Ellen super last minute and she was able to accommodate my wife and I on a flight. We truly recommend heir service, it is personal and friendly and lacks nothing in professionalism , a hard task to achieve. give them a Call, you wont be disappointed .

My husband and I took a Wings over Kauai tour in early March 2012.  Bruce and his crew went above and beyond to provide us with an excellent tour- from welcoming us at the door on a first name basis, providing us with reading materials while we waited for the pilot to ready the plane, to opening the door for us as we landed asking us how our flight was.  The plane was able to hold 8 passengers, we only had 3 passengers, my husband and myself and one other.  While many other companies might consider rescheduling or canceling with so few passengers in order to maximize their profit, it appeared Wings over Kauai was interested in providing an exceptional tour and customer experience- big or small profit.  I would recommend this tour to anyone who is considering an air tour in Kauai!

THANK YOU to Ellen, Carter, Sophie and Joel for a truly amazing experience.  The service from my first email was warm and friendly.  The flight itself was spectacular - a gorgeous sunny day after some heavy rains so the waterfalls were really flowing.  I caught myself with an ear to ear grin several times.

I have already recommended Wings Over Kauai to a friend - they are phenomenal.

review_title: Not as good when it's Bruce's day off
review_text: My husband and I visited Kauai in February 2012 with out toddler son and my parents. While there, my parents wanted to do something adventurous and saw Wings Over Kauai was the top attraction on TripAdvisor. My father called to see if any time was available during our last few days on the island and he was able to book a time for himself and my mother to go the next day. They went on the tour and came back to our hotel and just raved about the experience! They had a blast and thought that Capt. Bruce was wonderful and everyone there was so nice. They had such a good time that, even though I was scared to fly in a small plane, talked my husband and I into calling to see if there was any other times available for us to go. There was an opening two days later they were able to fit us in and while excited to go, I was very nervous too. Our flight time arrived and my parents dropped us off at the airport. I was still very nervous about the flight. Carter greeted us and checked us in, he was very nice. The flight before ours arrived back and my father quickly noticed it was not Bruce flying. Carter mentioned it was Bruce's day off. We were sad we didn't get to meet Bruce, whom my parents just raved about, but figured it would still be great. After checking in, we watched out the window as the pilot messed around with the plane hood up. It was not comforting to see that. Then we were taken out to the plane and seated. We met the substitute pilot (and now I can't even recall his name because I was too nervous) and got settled in the plane. The pilot then tried to start the plane and it wouldn't start. Now, I know nothing about planes so as a clueless passenger when a plane won't start, it is a little nerve-wracking. The pilot would try to start it and then we would have to wait about 5 mins and then he would try again. This went on for about 5 times and it finally started on what he said was his final try. I was about ready to demand to get off the plane when it started. And I noticed my parents and son looking out the window in concern as well when were weren't moving. Then I questioned the reliability of the plane for our flight and was basically laughed at by the pilot and another passenger. The flight itself was just OK. The pilot talked a bit about the sights below but really didn't have a conversation with us like my parents (and all the other TripAdvisor reviewers) said Bruce did. He knew I was clearly nervous but did nothing to make sure we felt relaxed. The views were beautiful and it was a nice time but I don't think it was even close to the same experience my parents had. The pilot was friendly but just didn't make it amazing like others mention when they talk about going with Bruce. I would recommend this tour to others but  would say to make sure Bruce isn't off the day they go. I completely understand that he needs a day off, just like everyone else, but they may need to teach the substitute pilot to offer a similar experience to the one Bruce gives. It was just night and day differences between two different tours in two days. I am still giving this a Very Good rating because I know how good it was for my parents and do think it was worth doing.

Ellen, Carter, and Shane were great through the entire process and provided a truly memorable experience.  Kauai had some rough weather and Ellen did a great job of being flexible to allow us to reschedule our flight to when the weather cooperated (helicopters usually will fly in any conditions even if the view is limited and the flight rough).  The plane flight was smooth (in strong winds) and provided a great view of all the key island sights including the Na Pali coast.  I was pleasantly surprised how slow we flew which really helped with enjoying the view and taking pictures.  I would strongly recommend WOK.

JK60

review_title: Best Way to see KAUAI's Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon
review_text: In Feb/Mar 2012, we spent 2 weeks in Hawaii, including 1 week in Waikiki and 1 week on the Pride of America.  We had decided that the best way to see Kauai would be by air, since most of the island is inaccessible by road.  And we didn't want to spend 4 hours on a bus in order to see Waimea Canyon for 20 minutes.  What a great choice we made to fly with "Wings Over Kauai" instead of the ship-sponsored Helicopter flights.  It turned out to be the highlight of our cruise. We were 3 couples.   We hadn't flown before on a small plane.  This is a small family-run company operating out of the Kauai airport.  Our pilot was Bruce Coulombe; the office matters are taken care of by wife Ellen and son Carter.  What a treat they were to deal with.  The plane is maintained by the airport mechanics.  They were very relaxed, friendly, informative, and helpful.  We booked the whole airplane.  The plane is much quieter than the helicopter and MUCH cheaper.  The views were fantastic.  We've got photos to last a lifetime !!!
Bruce and Ellen were wonderful!  Went out with Bruce and the flight was so smooth!  We were able to see the entire island!  Excellent tour guide by air.

We were in port with the Pride of America and had our flight scheduled for the last day we were there.  We woke to very cloudy skies which worried us about our flight.  While we were waiting for Wings to pick us up Ellen called and said that they were checking the weather report to see if it was going to be safe to fly...a few minutes later Ellen and Carter showed up to take us to the plane - they explained that it was our choice if we wanted to go up or not but that it was safe flying conditions.  There were us and another couple - we decided to go and at the last minute they decided not to so we had the plane to ourselves.  Our pilot Shane was awesome...made us feel completely at ease and showed us a wonderful time...we saw all kinds of things while we were up.

If you plan on being in Kauai I would HIGHLY recommend taking this flight.

My girlfriend and I took the trip this week, we flew up with Bruce.  I have to echo other comments on WOK that it is a family business and that really gives you a better feeling when dealing with them.  They're super friendly, they give you cute free stuff both before and after the trip (I don't want to tell you what for the spoiler alert factor).  The trip itself was a little over an hour but frankly I didnt look at my watch once, it was just so enjoyable.  I sat in the co-pilot seat and helped Bruce go through the check list with air traffic control, and he took great care to remember everyones names and where we were from so as to ask questions during the flight.  We went all over the major highlights, everybody has a window seat and I think the plane sat 8-9 people so it could never be packed at the best of times.  Everyone has a radio headset so you can hear and talk to each other, plus hear Bruce chatting with ATC.  It was fun, educational, interesting, honestly, it was just really great and it's about half the price of the helicopter tours and not to sound cheap but, why would you pay more when you can go with WOK.

As two retired couples, we looked forward to our scenic flight over the island of Kauai as part of our Hawaii vacation aboard the NCL cruise ship "Pride of America" - and we were very happy with the entire experience. We were picked up near the pier by our friendly host Bruce and taken to the airport to register with another friendly staff member - Sophia. Although our foursome turned into a threesome due to an illness, we had the plane to ourselves  - with Paul, our pilot, showing us the sights of this beautiful island throughout the 65 minute ride. From the southern beaches to the coffee plantations to the gorgeous Waimea Canyon to the breathtakingly impressive Na Pali coast to the numerous waterfalls of the Hanalei Valley, our trip was an amazing experience. Upon returning, we received an unexpected gift - a DVD containing a video recap of our flight itinerary. We were then personally driven back to the ship by our gracious hostess Ellen. It was a truly wonderful morning!  I heartily recommend "Wings Over Kauai" as a great way to see the sights of the island at a very reasonable price.
