Bruce has an interesting perspective of the island with his background in agrology (branch of soil science dealing with the production of crops). 

A Big thanks to Bruce, Maren and Ellen!

My husband and I had a terrific time.  Bruce seemed to know everything about the island and showed us all the most beautiful places.  The flight itself was wonderful as well.  Bruce and Ellen are the best and we'd recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who is vacationing here!

review_title: Great way to start your vacation on Kauai
review_text: Seeing Kauai from the air is a great way to start your vacation and Wings Over Kauai is a fun, safe, and (relatively) inexpensive way to do it. Like many reviewers, I was somewhat apprehensive about flying in a small plane, but Bruce's calm demeanor, relaxed yet professional approach, and piloting skills quickly put those fears to rest. The hour-long flight provided plenty of photo opportunities and Bruce provided just the right amount of commentary. There are a couple of other nice touches that also add to the experience and value.

Like many others, we decided on our flight with Wings over kauai based on previous reviews.  I'm not crazy about flying in small aircraft (or large ones for that matter), but the flight was awsome and I highly recommend it.  Bruce and Ellen were out of town on the day of our flight, but Maren and Shane took excellent care of us.   We are telling our friends, "If you go to Kauai - book a flight with' Wings over Kauai' !"

Recently took a Wings Over Kauai flight and it was one of the highlights of our vacation on the Garden Island. Maren, at the Front Desk,  and Shane, our pilot, were simply the best! Maren kept calling  to update us on the weather and tried valiantly to accomodate us over several days to get the best flying conditions for our tour. She was so nice when we met her in person. Shane was very informative and flew over the most beautiful parts of the island. Maren gave my wife a kukui nut lei before our flight. There were soft drinks on board and mints to prevent air sickness. Maren also took photos of us with our plane before our flight and had them ready along with a CD of the highlights of Kauai when we returned. 

My wife tends to get air sick but had no problems on our flight. This tour was half the cost of the helicopter tours and we highly recommned it unequivocably.

I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, and read off the pre flight check list, an honor I will not forget. Nothing I did the other six days I was in Kauai, topped the experience of a guide tour by air in the front seat of an airplane. This tour let's you take pictures of waterfalls you would not otherwise see, and Capt Bruce's narration and phraseology of the islands history,events and unique qualities is amazing, with some humor and jest added. 
I'll stop here, so "You" can have your own surprises and discovery on the tour.
Cliff (PALI) Anderson

review_title: Great way to see the most beautiful Hawaiian island.
review_text:
We booked this tour over the Internet and Ellen picked us up as planned.  We took the free shuttle from the dock to the ABC Store.  The kids fell asleep half way through the flight but my wife and I enjoyed the breath-taking views of waterfalls, beaches, mountains and valleys, etc.  Bruce shared a great deal of information and history throughout the flight.  One highlight for me was sitting in the cockpit and helping Bruce with the pre-flight check list!

I definitely recommend this tour.

As veterans of Kauai travel, Wings Over Kauai ranks very high on our list for personal touch, competitive at 1/2 the price of the competition; you feel like you are flying with old friends who've welcomed you home!  Your flight is a wealth of information on island plantlife, history, folklore and a great way to learn.....flying high!
This was our anniversary and wouldn't have spent it any other way!!
We give Wings Over Kauai as perfect 10

The Beck's

Flying with Wings over Kauai was definitely the highlight of our week-long family vacation in Kauai.  As our family was too large to accommodate on one trip, we chartered one flight and purchased some individual tickets on the next flight.  Everything was professional and prompt - from our initial inquiry to checking in for/boarding the flight itself.  Maren and Captain Bruce were great with our kids and were quite patient in answering their (and our) numerous questions.  Maren was especially attentive with our 3 year-old daughter, who loved the pink headphones.  My father-in-law enjoyed his informal role as "copilot" in reading off the preflight checklist.  The plane felt very safe and comfortable and the views were spectacular.  In my opinion, it was much better having the panoramic view from the plane window than the close-up that we would have had in a helicopter (plus we saw lots of close-ups the next day during our boat trip to the Na Pali coast).   Our photos and videos of the 1 hour trip turned out very well.  Overall, most highly recommended.  Wings over Kauai set a very high standard and it will be difficult to find a comparable experience on our next vacation.

I went on this adventure with my girlfriend a little over a week and a half ago.  We both kind of have the jitters about flying, especially with this being the first time in a small plane for both of us.  Captain Bruce and his crew, Ellen and Maren who were awesome at getting us situated, made the flight very easy and comfortable.  We learned a little about flying from Captain Bruce who is also a flight instructor which was a very cool part of this adventure.  The flight was about an hour and we circled the whole island while Captain Bruce, who I think is a genius, pointed out all kinds of land marks and told us facts and neat things about the area.  The views of the Na'Pali Coast and the Waimea Canyon are spectacular.  One of the best things about this tour was when he showed us where they shot different clips from shows like Fantasy Island, Jurassic Park, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Six Days Seven Nights, and he even would help us so that we could get a nice photos.   I got a really good shot of The Fantasy Island Falls from the opening scene when Tattoo was yelling "The plane, the plane."  You see a lot of stuff that you normally would not see because you can not get to it by car.   Hands down, this was one of the best things we did our whole trip.  I would highly recommend it to anyone, especially if you can't afford the helicopter ride.  I am so happy we did this.  Thanks again Captain Bruce, Ellen, and Maren for this incredible adventure!

Mahalo,
Rob

I have extreme tendancy to motion sickness, so after hearing about helicopter tours from my friends, I was afraid I would have to pass on seeing Kauai from the air. Then I read these reviews in Trip Advisor. There is a reason Wings Over Kauai is the number 1 attraction listed.
  The pace is friendly and relaxing. The flight is awe inspiring and informative, and the experience is a great way to start your time on Kauai, not to mention much less expensive than the helicopter tours.
  You don't get as up close and personal as the helicopters do, but I was fine with that. The special windows on Captain Bruce's plane were great -- all of our pictures turned out perfectly. The service by Maren and Ellen before we even got off the ground made this a special memory of Kauai. Don't hesitiate to book Wings Over Kauai for your aerial tour.

Wings Over Kauai was the best tour we took during our week long stay in Kauai.  Ellen and Capt Bruce were the best tour guides to the island.  There is so much that you can only see by air on Kauai and Capt Bruce made the tour around the island very interesting.  We chose the Wings Over Kauai air tour over the island instead of a helicopter because of my two daughters, who are 11 and 14.  The ride was so smooth and they did not get airsick! Plus, they are much cheaper than a helicopter tour and they offered a discount for my children.  With four people booked on the flight, Ellen gave us the entire plane and we were all able to sit on one side of the airplane for the best view of the island,  We are still talking about the flight and the fantastic views that we saw.  I flew in the Air Force for 23 years and Capt Bruce is one of the best pilots I have seen.  I definitely recommend this tour!

review_title: Excellent Way To Fly Over Kauai
review_text: We took this air tour as part of our recent visit to Kauai.  Wings Over Kauai uses a fixed-wing aircraft, which we preferred over a helicopter.  Captain Bruce was the best host, explaining in great detail the various sites we flew over, giving many personal touches along the way.  A great flight tour with very competent and friendly folks. This tour was so excellent, we plan on taking it again when we visit Kauai

My wife and I went on the Wings over Kauai flight on a recent vacation and we absolutely loved it.   Helpful directions from Ellen made it easy to find the location and check in was informative but relaxed and made us both very comfortable with the flight ahead. 

The flight itself was a great experience and the aircraft windows were kept spotlessly clean which allows for perfect photo taking.  Bruce (the pilot) arranged everyone on the right hand side of the aircraft and orientates the flight so that all the best sights are on this side which made for a clear viewing experience.  

Sights were breathtaking and the narration by the pilot was spot on.  

Price was right and the customer service was perfect.  DVD of the flight with a photo of us boarding the plane was a nice touch at no additional cost.

Bring your camera, other than that I had shorts, t-shirt and flip-flops on and I has fine.  Cold sodas are on the plane.

Likes: Views, narration, customer service.

Dislikes: I only wish the flight could have been longer than the 60/70 minutes as I didn't want it to end.

This is one absolute highlight of our trip.  Ellen Colombe met us at the ABC store in the Anchor Cove Mall (walking 10 min. from the cruise ship; shuttle available) then drove us to the airport where we were guided through the safety procedures then boarded our 6 seater plane.  Bruce Colombe expertly flew us around the perimeter of the island of Kauai also flying inland over famous waterfalls, through Waimea Canyon and basically to show us all of the sites.  During the 65 min. together he pointed out where the rich and famous are as well as describing life on Kauai, meanwhile checking we were all safe and comfortable.  The DVD they gave us at the end, captured the key highlights of our flight and will be a great momento when our minds forget!  This is one fantastic trip!

Bruce & Maren are wonderful. My dad & I felt right at home. The flight was the best we have had on Kauai. We have been on a helicopter & bi plane but this was the best. It was so enjoyable that we hope to fly again tomorrow with Bruce. My dad is a pilot from Idaho & he got to be the co-pilot.

review_title: Great for families, better than helicopter
review_text:
We flew with owner and pilot Bruce of "Wings over Kauai", after he was recommended to us by our B&B the day before. It was fantastic, to say the least! Highly recommendable, especially for families of 3-6 who can have the plane to themselves (we went with my in-laws and our baby girl).
Guaranteed window seats also. I won't go into describing the views, they were truly amazing and hard to described with words.

Bruce and his wife Ellen have lived on the island for long and know it really well, they both have PhDs in agriculture and so we got to hear  a lot of interesting stuff on the vegetation and history about Kauai. They are friendly and relaxed and run the small family show as a 'retirement' hobby, so its far from the expensive, highly commercialized and high-throughput tourist ripoffs you are likely to get with the helicopter operators. 

We got a proper safety briefing before the flight, and could not have felt more comfortable before and during the flight. Free soda's and ginger chews were available against flight sickness, but we didn't need them. 
Excellent in-flight communication system with Bose noise cancellation headsets, our 9-moth old daughter got soft baby earplugs and earmuffs on top, and slept straight through the 65 minute flight. 
   
Discounts available or Hawaii residents or if you bring in a coupon.

Bruce, Ellen, and Maren provided a great experience while we were in Kauai. For half the price of a helicopter we saw the Napali coast, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls and more in our hour flight. Bruce, our pilot and owner of the company, narrated us through the flight. It was a smooth flight with unobstructed views. Bose headsets made for a nice narration during tour. This is a great way to see areas of Kauai that you would never get to see otherwise. Other added touches are that there are only 4 people on the tour and everyone is seated on the same side so everybody sees the same thing. The women receive a lei and sodas and 
water are available for everyone  during the flight and a free video of what you saw on the flight with a picture of you and the pilot in front of the plane. You still need to take pictures but the video is an overview of what you would normal see on each flight. I highly recommend this tour. Thanks Bruce, Ellen, and Maren
Don't miss it.  Wonderful experience -- the flight and the personalities of those involved:  Ellen, Bruce, and Maren.  Would do it again in a heartbeat.

My family of four and two friends we were traveling with had the very enjoyable experience of taking an airvan flight with Wings Over Kauai on Sunday April 3.  The weather was perfect (though Elaine offered to switch the date if we had to - glad it was not required), the check in experience was fun and the flight was wonderful.  Bruce is an excellent pilot/tour guide and we are very happy we did this tour early in our trip!  Thanks again for a lovely experience.

After five days returning home (Melbourne) we watched the photos and we decided that flying over Kauai was definitedly the highlight of our trip. Bruce (the pilot), was so cool, calm and collected that made us feel very comfortable. His knowledge of the island was very impressive. We came away from the flight relaxed and well informed. We would definitely recommend to anyone to fly with Wings over Kauai. To all staff, keep up your great services and mahalo!
Leo and Maria Wings - Melbourne (AUS)

After reading all the wonderful reviews about Wings Over Kauai we decided to try it out on our recent trip to Hawaii.  By far it was the best part of our trip.  We choose to do a private tour on the Cessna.  My husband was nervous about flying in such a small plane but Bruce was awesome.  He made us feel at ease during the flight and he was very informative.  The views of the Napali Coast were breathtaking and we flew through the middle of a rainbow.  The best perk about choosing Wings over Kauai is the price is about half of a helicopter ride.

This was, buy far, the highlight of our trip to Kawai. We got to see unbelievable scenery from a perfect vantage point at a very reasonable price. My girlfriend and I booked a flight with Wings Over Kauai on short notice and Bruce and Ellen were very accommodating. I am a private pilot, with not a lot of experience, and Bruce let me fly the airplane around the island while he provided both an interesting narrative on the sights for both me and my girlfriend and helpful tips on my flying. I have flown many different airplanes during my pilot training and their Cessna was clean and well maintained which made us feel very safe. My girlfriend was a little apprehensive about flying in a small airplane in the mountains, but both of us thought this was the most memorable experience of our visit to Kauai and would highly recommend it to anyone.

review_title: The BEST memory from our Hawaiian cruise!
review_text: We had one day in Kauai on our Princess cruise, and I crossed my fingers that the weather would be good for flying.  We booked our Wings Over Kauai flight before leaving for the cruise, based on the Trip Advisor comments.  We managed to get in our flight before clouds and rainy weather caused the rest of the afternoon's flights to be canceled.  We had a spectacular flight, and even saw a water spout on the ocean!    Bruce and Ellen and the staff were wonderful!  Ellen picked us up at the shopping center, so we didn't have to make our own way to the airport.

Wings Over Kauai was a great way to see the island.  I had originally booked this trip early in our stay and it's a good thing I did as the weather for the day of our flight was supposed to be bad...and it did rain, so it would not have been a good day for this tour.  However, I got a call from WOK and we were able to reschedule for our last day on Kauai.  We had an absolutely perfect day for this flight.  The skies were blue and clear.  We were able to see everything, inlcuding Mt. Wai'ele'ele, the wettest spot on earth.  Ellen, Bruce, and Maren were wonderful and really did treat us like family (I thought people were exaggerating on other reviews, but they weren't).  My advice would be to book this tour before you get to Kauai and early in your stay.  You WILL see many sights that you can't see by car, and we were even able to see whales from the air...and one of the humbacks breaching.

review_title: Wonderful experience!  Everyone should do this!
review_text: My husband is a private pilot, so he was able to sit in the left seat with the instructor in the right seat.  It was a wonderful experience for my husband as he has not been  pilot in command for 12 years.  Our flight took us all around the island while the instructor pointed out sights (including Julia Roberts home!).  This tour is open to everyone, not just pilots.  In the plane was a cooler filled with beverages for our flight which lasted a little more than an hour.  At the end of the flight we were given a CD of a typical flight, but the beginning did show us, and our picture was on the cover of the CD case.  Also, pictures were taken before the flight, and emailed to us.  This by far was the highlight of our trip.  This is a top notch group.  They will make you feel like family!

review_title: This is a MUST DO when you visit Kauai. Skip the pricey helecopter tour
review_text: When I told my freinds and family that we took a privately chartered flight around and over the island they responded "wow"! I loved how Bruce made my husband and I feel like we were part of the crew. He had me read off the pre-flight check list as we were lining up on the runway, waiting for the towers o.k. for take off. Ask Bruce anything about flying a cessna, (he's a flight instructor), and about the island. Thanks for the personal touches...flowers and beaded lei. We'll definately do this again on our next trip to Kauai. Shawn and Mary of Saint Charles IL.

review_title: A "Must Take" Aerial Tour when in Kauai !!
review_text:
This aerial tour was a top highlight of our trip to Hawaii.  As several other reviewers have stated, we were treated more like family than customers.  Our plot, Bruce Coulombe, combined his agricultural background with his extensive flying experience to give us a wonderful and informative tour of the island.  He made sure to check on the well-being of all his passengers (we were a party of 4) prior to, during, and following the flight.  His pre-flight briefing was comprehensive, and he has a quiet and comforting style in explaining all the flight procedures, and asking (frequently) if we had any concerns or questions.  His knowledge of the geography and natural history of the island is considerable, as well as his updating on movie locations and stars who have visited the island.  We had an excellent flight, with good weather, and even saw some Humpback Whales in addition to the regular island sights! 

As a pilot myself, I was impressed both with Bruce's airmanship throughout the flight, his great rapport with his passengers, and with one of the smoothest landings I have ever experienced !!

I have no hesitation to give this experience "two thumbs up" and recommend it as a "must do activity" on Kauai.

Geoff Gartshore
Ontario Canada

As a pilot, I was hoping to find an option to fly myself around the island and experience all the beauty that Kauai has to offer.  Bruce and Wings over Kauai provided that opportunity.  From the moment my wife and I arrived, we realized that the entire Wings over Kauai staff were there to provide a memorable experience.  We arrived for a dual flight yet were met with a lei greeting and full debrief of the circle island route.

I then met Bruce who is the owner/flight instructor who suggested that I fly the plane and he handle all the radio communications, which worked out perfect given all the local reporting points which are utilized.  From the moment we took off until we landed Bruce not only provided guidance to the flight but more importantly pointed out sights all along the route of flight along with the history of the island and those locations.  It was perfect.  He suggested great angles for pictires which my wife clicked constantly in the back seat.

All in all a fantastic experience and even an added kick for a pilot.  A little over an hour in the air.  To finish our expierence, we were presented with a personalized picture and video tour of the island.  Bruce also wrote up an entry for my logbook seeing I left it on the mainland.  The entire staff were so accomodating and made the experience personalized, a great touch.

Can't wait to return and would definitely connect with Bruce and team for another flight.

Aloha.

review_title: What a great tour of Kauai...
review_text:
Maren made us feel very comfortable while we were being prepped for the flight.  The flight was fantastic with Bruce making us feel right at home.  Dr. Bruce is a very patient and accomplished pilot and very knowledgeable about the Island (and a lot of other things also like Island agricultural issues).  The plane was very comfortable and smooth - I'm glad we didn't take a helicopter.  

This flight took us to view areas of the Island that cannot be reached by car and the scenery was breathtaking, especially the spires and the Bali Hi.  We even got to see some whales - from the air you can see how big they are in such pristine waters.

Loved the trip and would recommend it to anyone interested in personalized service at a very reasonable price.

Thanks and Aloha Bruce and Maren, and thanks for the great pictures!

Hubby and I flew w/Bruce and another couple on Valentine's Day.  Hubby is a pilot and I had asked if he could fly the right seat w/Bruce and they accomodated, hubby was thrilled.

Bruce is a very skilled and knowledgeable pilot.  The other couple w/us had never flown in a small plane and were a little worried at the start, but you couldn't have asked for a smoother flight than we received (they had water, pop, ginger, mints on the plane, along w/the aloha bag for "just in case").

Taking off from Lihue, we headed south and around the west side of the island, I'd asked Bruce to point out several things to us, which he graciously did (we all had seats on the right of the plane, fuel is carried on the left to balance things out).  Flying over the Napali Coast was quite impressive, actually, flying over the entire island was impressive w/all the different colors and textures.  I was able to get quite a few really great shots of the island through the windows.  Bruce gave lots of local info as we passed over various locations.

I don't remember the office lady's name (she was very nice), but she took pictures of us prior to our flight, in front of the plane, gave us a DVD w/a flight tour on it and sent us our pictures in an e-mail that afternoon, very nice touches.

Very well worth every penny of the price.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai a Memorable Experience from Above and on the Ground
review_text: What a pleasure it was flying with Wings over Kauai.  From our phone call to arrange the flight to us saying good -bye to Ellen and Bruce. It was a truly memorable experience.  Ellen was so kind on the phone, she spent time answering our questions in a friendly manner.  Also, when we arrived she explained what would take place, what we would see and did it with a smile.  Some places you go just rush you along and treat you more like an object than a person.  We felt nothing but sincere concern that we have a pleasurable adventure with their company.  They really cared. Bruce was professional, knowledgeable, and courtesy.  He wanted to share his love of Kauai with you.  By showing and telling you of it's wonders, beauty, and lushness which in some areas can only be viewed from above. The deluxe Bose headphones have you in constant contact with Bruce and fellow passengers. The ride is smooth. Bruce and Ellen made sure we were comfortable and safe.  We thank them dearly for giving us a truly unforgettable memory.  Not only from above but also on the ground.  You can't beat Wings Over Kauai especially compared to the cost of helicopter rides.Wings Over Kauai is afforable, safe, comfortable, and will satisfy your senses. Wings Over Kauai exceeded our expectations.  Please do yourself a favor and fly with Wings Over Kauai you will not be disappointed.

review_title: Do not pass up this opprotunity!!
review_text: Before we came to Kauai, my husband and I did a lot of research on the helicopter and light plane tours.  It became obvious, by reading the reviews in TripAdvisor, that THE tour to take was WINGS OVER KAUAI.  Everyone was so right.  We were both a little apprehensive when it comes to flying in small planes, and when the competitor landed minutes before we took off and the passengers said their flight was rough (one was even sick the entire flight) that did not help.  But with Bruce as the pilot, we had absolutely no problems what so ever, a very smooth flight (a testament to his 26 years of flying experience).  The scenery is gorgeous and Bruce made sure he pointed out all of the scenic wonders of Kauai, and gave us a little history lesson as well.  Bruce made sure that he gave us the best positioning for pictures that he could.  Bruce and his staff made sure everything was done right and that we were comfortable and enjoying the ride.  If you are ever in Kauai, make sure to take a flight with WINGS OVER KAUAI.  Absolutely THE BEST!

review_title: Awesome, exhilarating, informative. What a ride!
review_text:
The day was gorgeous, the pilot engaging, the views incredible.  We had a wonderful experience with Bruce our safety conscious and knowledgeable pilot.  His assistant, Maren, was one of the most pleasant individuals we've ever met.

Everything was low key, relaxing and FUN!  From our welcome lei to the CD of our flight, it was PERFECT!    Wings...sings!!!

My husband talked me into taking this tour because I am afraid of small airplanes.  Boy, am I glad.  Wasn't scary in the least.  I thoroughly enjoyed this flight.   We got to see the whole island.  So beautiful!  Especially loved seeing the Na Pali coast.   This company is run by husband and wife team and they do a great job.  Ellen is so nice and makes everything just right for you before the flight.  Bruce(the pilot) is exceptionally knowledgeable about island history and really wants you to enjoy your flight.  You can't go wrong flying with Wings Over Kauai..

Feb 02, 2011.  We had our flight booked through Expedia from our hotel.  Being a pilot myself, my wife and I were looking for a fun flight around the island where I could do the actual flying under the guidance of  a local pilot.  Wings over Kauai provided just that.
We were greeted by very friendly and professional people who checked us in and flight briefed us.  Bruce, our CFI did all the radio work and navigation while I was able to do the flying. He is also a great tour guide as he pointed out places of interest and gave a brief history of the site.  I highly recommend Wings of Kauai to any pilot who wants to log some time and have an interesting tour over the island.
MAHALO to Ellen and Bruce.

Knowing my love of flying my wife got me the 1 hour instructional flight over Kauai for my birthday. This was the perfect birthday present, combining an opportunity to fly with the beautiful scenery of Kauai. Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience. Ellen helped my wife set up the appointment and even sent her a special certificate that she could present me prior to the flight. When we arrived, Marin was warm, friendly and helpful in preparing us for the flight as we waited for pilot Bruce to bring the 4 seater around. Once in the aircraft Bruce was very thorough in instructing me how to taxi and generally operate the aircraft. He even got my wife involved, having her go through the pre-departure check list. (She thought she was only along for the ride.) Bruce was very helpful and helped me taxi, takeoff, and let me fly a good portion of the flight. When we got to Na Pali he took the controls allowing me to fully enjoy the scenery. Bruce was as good a tour guide as he was a flight instructor pointing out the unique terrain, sites and nature of the island.

I can not say enough good things about Bruce and Wings Over Kauai. I would highly recommend them for either a tour or an instructional flight.

review_title: Fantastic Trip Around the Island of Kauai!
review_text: A big Mahalo to Bruce and Ellen for the great flying experience while we were in Kauai!  Bruce's knowledge of the island, in addition to, his superb flying skills made this an experience to remember!  I look forward to returning to Kauai for another flight!

We were very inpressed by the personal service we received from Ellen, Maron and Bruce.  The price was so reasonable......half what we would have paid for a helicopter ride with the risk of being squeezed into the middle of the back seat on a 6-passenger copter.  Bruce was truly a gentleman and made sure we were very comfortable.  We were lucky to have had a beautiful, clear afternoon for our wonderful flight.  The scenery was spectacular....the very best way to see Kauai!  We could continue to sing their praises, but would only be repeating what the other reviewers have said.  If you're planning to visit Kauai be sure to include a flight with Wings Over Kauai.  You will be glad that you did!  Thanks Bruce and Ellen.  And thanks, too, for the DVD.  Your son has done a very nice job on that video.

Take a camera with a good telephoto lens.  
Bruce and his staff did an excellent job on the briefing and the flight commentary was great.  The weather was beautiful and the trip very smooth and quiet.  
I think it was the best value on the island for the many things that we did during our time there.

review_title: Absolute BEST tour flight we've ever taken...and, at a very reasonable cost vs. the helicopter tours.
review_text: Bruce and Ellen went the extra mile to ensure our flight was safe, enjoyable and memorable.  And, WOW...the scenery was gorgeous.  A "must do" on Kauai.

We flew with wings over Kauai in early January... their email responses are really pleasant and quick.. we had to re schedule for the next day due to the weather and it was easy and quick.

Marin was the best ,our greeting to wings over Kauai was exceptional and warm she even had to move a car to accomadate ours in the parking lot.  When you first see Bruce pass by he is not very talkative, and you wonder how he will be ,but as soon as you are in the air he is informative, interesting and warm.
The service is the best!!! You cannot hover over the water falls but see them from a distance but for  much less than a helicopter  the flight it is terrific.

I was planning to book a helicopter tour for our trip and did a lot of research.  Every company seemed the same in terms of price, types of tours and receiving mixed reviews.  I didn't want to spend $500+ for a tour for 2 that had bad reviews!  When I saw that Wings Over Kauai was the #1 activity on Kauai I had to check it out.  

Ellen and Bruce were very friendly and offered A+ customer service.  We booked the flight for the first day we would be in Kauai.  It was cloudy that morning so they recommended that we go the next day.  No hassles; no trying to cram as many tours into one day as possible- just offering the best possible service and experience to their customers.  I would recommend booking the tour early in your trip in case you need to reschedule due to weather and also to get an overview of the island so you can decide which parts you want to go and explore further.  

The other factors that sold me on the airplane tour instead of the helicopter is that everyone gets a seat on the right side of the plane.  All of the views are on the right, so it would be a waste of money to be on the left.  And the same tour as a helicopter for half the price- why wouldn't you choose Wings Over Kauai??

Our flight with Wings over Kauai earlier this month was definitely a highlight of our trip. Ellen was very friendly and helpful, rescheduling our flight so that we would have the best possible weather: an amazingly clear day in which we could even see the top of Mt. Waialeale.Bruce is a great pilot who is very knowledgeable about the island and clearly loves what he does.

For half the price of a helicopter, we saw many amazing sights only visible by air including two full sillouettes of whales in the crystal clear waters below. (admittedly, helicopters are able to fly closer to some of the sights but having flown one on an earlier trip, I don't believe they can provide the panorama needed to see the whales like we did here).

Overall, we highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and can't wait to fly with them again on a future visit.

When planning our trip to Kauai, we had decided against doing an air tour. We'd only looked at helicopters and we refused to spend the money. We couldn't justify $500 for a 50 minute tour. We saw an ad for Wings Over Kauai in a magazine and called. My husband spoke to Ellen, and she was able to get us on a flight the same day! And their price? Almost half of what we'd been quoted from the various helicopter companies. 

When we arrived at the airport, we were warmly greeted by name, and treated like family from the beginning. Wings Over Kauai is a family owned business and it shows throughout the entire experience. When you walk into the airport, you become family as well. 

The plane holds 6 people, but they rarely take that many up. We went up with just one other couple and the pilot, and once airborne, we all had a window seat on the right hand side -- something the helicopters can't give you. The plane is supplied with noise-canceling headsets and intercoms, and a cooler of water, soda, and even ginger candies for easily upset stomachs. 

Once we were in the air, Bruce was a wealth of knowledge. He worked in agriculture (and even has a Ph.D), and is a long time island resident. He knew the history and the natural wonders of the island well and gave great explanations of the island flora. 

We saw all of the sites, from the waterfalls to the Waimea Canyon to the breathtaking Napali Coast.  We enjoyed every second, and Bruce's landing was the smoothest I've ever experienced. This is the one tour you can't miss on Kauai, and they even send you the photos they take afterwards via email -- free of charge.

review_title: Excellent, informative flight and 1/2 price of a heli.
review_text:
We had a great flight with WOKT. We strongly considered doing a heli (have done this before in aother localtions). But, after reading all the positive reviews we decided to try WOKT as it was 1/2 price. We were not dissapointed! This is a family run operation. Bruce is very educated and knowledgeable and gave a very informative tour of the island. (Plus, he is a flight instructor so, that makes you feel more safe.) Ellen and everyone that we met was very nice.  

Our flight was amazing. We saw many whales and entire pod of dolphins. Bruce had lots of insight and we felt like we had an A+ tour and learned a lot. The plane is small with no middle seat which is nice.  You can get awesome photos!
We had a great flight with Bruce and this was definitely a highlight of our honeymoon. Ellen and Bruce are a pleasure to deal with and run a great business. Thanks again!

Bruce and Ellen made us feel so comfortable and they were super friendly! They took the time to get to know us! Bruce let my husband be the co pilot!  The scenery was beautiful we got to see whales, birds, and rainbows! Bruce is very knowledgeable about the plants and native history landmarks! This was definitely the best part of our trip! we will definitley go again!! They made us feel like we were good friends!! Ellen gave us free pictures and a Dvd of our flight!
The Allan Family!

We stopped by Bruce's operation on the last day of our Hawaiian honeymoon before taking a flight back to the mainland. He was helpful, professional and made us feel at home in the cockpit. He also was very tolerant of my husband's fear of flying and put him at ease. This is the best way to see all of Kauai and I will definitely go again next time I am there.

The personnel were very friendly and helpful - they rescheduled our flight twice because of bad weather.  The tour itself was informative, and it is a good way to see the island, especially areas that are not accessible.

We received this tour as a gift from our children and took our Wings Over Kauai flight yesterday.  This tour is perfect in every way!  Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly,  knowledgeable and professional.  We flew over Kauai for over an hour - it was a smooth ride from take off to landing!   If you are considering whether to take a plane or helicopter tour of the island...please choose Wings Over Kauai:  Captain Bruce is an excellent and knowledgeable pilot and his plane is comfortable and quiet.   We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!

My husband and I came to Kauai, Hawaii for our honeymoon.  I was in charge of coming up with activities and I booked a tour with Wings Over Kauai to see the island by air.  The views were breathtaking.  Bruce was awesome- very personable, so knowledgeable, and has a 100% safety record!. His take off, flight, and landing were soo smooth; I didn't get sick, and I'm typically prone to motion sickness.  My husband loved it so much, he was really debating on doing the same tour AGAIN that week!  The tour was a full 70 minutes and was definitely worth it.

review_title: Smooth and Mellow and Breathtaking all at once.
review_text: We had the pleasure of a 4PM private flight with Wings Over Kauai yesterday.  My wife was concerned about being in a small plane and being scared and airsick.  The staff assured her she would be fine and the owner and our pilot, ,Bruce, was so nice and warm and kind that Vicky was delighted from takeoff until landing.  I took over 200 pictures and took Bruce's advise and just pointed and shot without using the viewfinder so I could enjoy the sights first hand.  It was smooth flying all the way and Bruce was informative and entertaining and obviously loved sharing his island with us.  The headsets worked perfectly and we were all chatting away and Bruce encouraged questions and interaction.   Some of my pictures were nice but the DVD that we were given after the flight really showed the highlights perfectly.  It was a nice surprise that was included.

This well organized, hospitable and intimate adventure was an absolute pleasure and should not be missed regardless of the length of your stay in Kaua'i.  From the very start we appreciated Ellen's personable approach on the phone while booking the flight session, right up to the week of the experience itself when she extended us generous flexibility in rescheduling our flight in the face of Kaua'i's unpredictable rainy season.  

The morning of the flight, we were greeted with the same enthusiasm by Maren at the terminal.  We very likely had a unique flight experience in that it was led by Bruce but competently piloted by Shane as well, and therefore provided us with not just the breathtaking aerial perspectives of "The Garden Isle of Discovery" (Kaua'i) but also the excitement of aviation from an airman's standpoint.  Bruce gave a very expert commentary - including tour advice - on the many wonders of the island, above all Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast and Hanalei Bay along the North Shore.  We were even treated to a custom "fly-by" of a new religious structure recently built in the Wailua region of the island just because of its cultural significance to the individuals in our group.

I am indeed more impressed with Wings Over Kauai than I expected, and I hope that anyone visiting Kaua'i will give it an even chance when weighing their options to see the island by air.

This was our first ever flight tour, and we felt like we were in good hands the whole way with Bruce in control. He is an outstanding pilot and tour guide. The most unique aspect was Bruce's perspective on the flora, due to his extensive background in Agronomy. Ellen was a wonderful host, and gave us great suggestions for must see/do activities on the island. This was the highlight of our trip to Kauai.

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Bruce.  He was very knowledgeable and insightful while at the same time, not dominating the tour with fill in comments or useless facts.  He made the tour very personable.  It literally was like our own private overview of Kauai.  We would definitely recommend their services and will use them again when we visit.  Bruce, Ellen, and Maren were very courteous, friendly, and helpful throughout the whole process of booking, confirming, and preparing us for our flight.  You can't go wrong using Wings Over Kauai Tours!

It was my first trip to Kauai and this was certainly one of the many highlights of my trip. 

I found Wings Over Kauai on this site, and after my experience, I think they deserve all the positive accolades. 

My whole experience with Wings Over Kauai was positive. 

Booking - I procrastinated, and didn't book the tour until the day before. I was sitting at the Honolulu airport waiting for my connecting flight to Kauai. I sent in a request, and by the time I landed in Kauai, Maren has already confirmed my reservation for the next day. 

Pre-flying + Flying - I didn't get to meet Ellen, but Maren and Bruce are super nice and very friendly. They are great guides, very knowledgeable. They definitely want to make sure you have a memorable experience, not just with the tour itself, but also with your trip to Kauai. You are not flying with too many people (I think they said 4 people max). Everyone gets a seat with a good view! The tour was one of the first things I did on my trip, and because I didn't do much preparation, the tour definitely helped orient me and helped me plan out the places I should check out.

Post-flying - It was great to receive a personal follow-up email (not a standardized one) from Maren with photos. 

Cost - I didn't do much price comparison, but it was definitely on the lower side. 

Everyone who is going to Kauai should definitely set aside time to take a helicopter/plane tour, and I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. :-)

Take this tour!  We did and we loved it.  Smoother and quieter than the helicopters and about half the price.  The views were wonderful and Bruce, Ellen, and the staff couldn't have been more helpful or accomodating, even to the point of re-scheduling our flight as per our request to find better viewing weather during our stay.
Bruce, the pilot, is also a PHD in agronomy and plants, and he knows his stuff both aeronautically and scientifically.
Take the flight early in your stay so you can see the island in an overview and can then plan your activities to suit what you've seen from the air.  Much nof the scenery can't be seen other than from the air.
The highlight of our trip!

This was an amazing way to see the island.  The whole experience was picture perfect.  From Bruce, who is an articulate and knowledgeable person, to his wife who helps with the administration side of it.  The flying experience was also very educational, and Bruce involved us in some of the flight procedures.  The views of the island from the plane are breathtaking and stunning.  There is really no way to put into words how picturesque this island is from above. 

We loved it.  HIGHLY recommend this.

My wife and I flew with " Wings over Kauai " the day before Thanksgiving and absolutely loved it. This was a birthday present for my wife from our kids knowing full well that my wife was very frightened with small planes and helicopters. This was a surprise flight that she found out about once we arrived that morning. Bruce and crew put my wife at ease with the tour and once in the air she loved it. Everything was perfect with this experience and totally recommend " Wings over Kauai"   Worth every penny

review_title: Best Way To See Kauai By Air
review_text: I took the Wings over Kauai flight tour on 11/26/2010.  The tour is by fixed-wing aircraft rather than helicopters like most of the other tour operators.  The tour started with a friendly greeting by the staff and then we were introduced to Bruce, our pilot.  We were given a safety briefing and we took off from Lihue Airport (the main airport on the island).  We had a beautiful tour of the entire island by air with Bruce giving the narration.  No tape recorded narration here.  Bruce knew all the great sights and the right angles for viewing them.  We were as close to the sights as the helicopters, but without the distraction of the noise and vibration.  The plane is more ecologically friendly than the copters too.  We even circled some sights only viewable by air so we could photograph them from all angles.  Bruce carefully avoided the noise sensitive areas without missing any sights.  In conclusion, if you want a relaxing tour of some of the most beautiful mountains, canyons, coastlines and waterfalls on earth, try Wings over Kauai.

I booked this flight for my husband and I after reading all of the positive reviews on Tripadvisor - we were well advised!!!!!  Bruce, the owner and pilot, was absolutely wonderful.  An island resident, his narrative while we were in flight, his knowledge of the sights, his interesting anecdotes about local history, made the flight thoroughly enjoyable.  We had a clear day, and were able to see the N'apali Coast, Wailei canyon, the south and north shore beaches and interesting sites, interior waterfalls - you name it, Bruce made sure we saw it.  Forget the helicopter rides, they cost a fortune.  For just about half the price of a helicopter tour, you get a personalized (there are only 4 people at a time taken up) tour, and a much better experience than the helicopter (IMHO).  If you're heading to Kauai, a flight with Wings Over Kauai should be first on your "to do" list - not to be missed!

review_title: This was seeing Kauai as I've never seen it before
review_text:
Our flight with Bruce provided a level of personal attention that I have never experienced on an island excursion.

My partner and I had brought my parents to Kauai to celebrate their 50th anniversary. Our original plans had been to view the Na Pali coast from a catamaran snorkel cruise, but the high surf during our visit canceled that. Even though Jay and I had been to Kauai on 3 previous visits, we'd never seen it from the air. So I took a chance and booked a personalized flight with Bruce for our last full day on the island.

We were particularly interested in seeing from the air some specific parts of the island - particularly, the areas that we had not been able to see from the ground/sea, the place where we were staying, and the area where my parents had renewed their wedding vows. Bruce set us up with a flight that accommodated all of our wishes. He even circled around at one point so that we could get better pictures of one of the sites we'd missed. What made this flight even more special was the fact that Bruce was able to expertly describe so much of the bio-diversity of what we were seeing - even identifying plants that we had seen on the ground and pointing them out as we flew over them along the way.

In the end, this 70 minute flight allowed us to see so much more than the snorkel cruise would have and it even cost less. We shot so many pictures that it I'm still going through them and continuing to be surprised at what we saw. With the high-quality headsets on the plane, we were all able to talk to each other and everyone had the same view of what we were seeing since we were all on the right side of the plane.

If I had it do over again, the only thing I'd do differently is that I'd take this flight at the beginning of my trip so that we could visit some of the places that we saw from above but which I would not have otherwise known even existed.

Thanks Bruce.

I found Wings over Kauai to be the highlight of our vacation in Hawaii. Bruce and his wife were very nice people who truly cared that we had a good safe time. I had the privilege of seating in the co-pilot seat and Bruce was very meticulous about safety matters. After the pre-flight check list was completed we went for a one hour tour of the island that was filled with remarkable sights to see.  I would highly recommend this excursion which is very reasonably priced. At the end of the tour we received a compact disk with an impressive video of the island as well as photos of my wife and I prior to our flight.

review_title: Simply spectacular -- our best tour ever
review_text:
From our first contact with Wings Over Kauai, through to their “thank you” email and photos, everything was simply first class.
Friendly, personalized and professional are the three adjectives that best describe their service.
Captain Bruce, as well as being a considerate pilot (comfortable, smooth flight) is a wealth of information about the island.
The flight was spectacular and we enjoyed aerial views of inaccessible terrain as well as features (Wailua Falls, for example) we had seen on our road trips.
We had a rewarding and memorable experience and thoroughly recommend the team to all visitors who wish to see Kauai from the air. Thank you Bruce, Ellen and Maren.

My wife and I were in Kauai for our 20th anniversary and as a former pilot I wanted to see the island from the air. I researched all the helicopter tour companies and some sounded interesting, however we decided to try Wings Over Kauai as they appeared to offer a more personal touch, we were not disappointed! Ellen and Bruce were so welcoming and unhurried they put us at ease immediately. I had asked for the tour in the 4 seater Cessna172 instead of the 6 seater Airvan, as I used to fly the Cessna. Bruce (who pilots either aircraft for the tour) took us up and showed us Kauai as I'm sure we would never have seen it in a helicopter. He took the time to explain every detail of the flight with a running and often humorous commentary on all we were seeing, and took the time to answer any and all questions we had. It was a fantastic tour and one we will always remember with much fondness. 
I'm sure some of the heli tours can be exciting, if you don't mind paying twice the price, and perhaps give you an adrenalin rush, but they want you in and out quickly to maximize their profit and will never take the time that Wings Over Kauai did to make the flight personal  and something special you will always cherish. Thanks Bruce!!

review_title: If you only pay for one tour in Kauai, this is it!
review_text: Bruce, Ellen and Maron (sorry hon if I spelled it wrong) were absolutely wonderful! My fiancee and I were in Kauai for only 4 days and planned only to lounge at the beaches every day. But at the last minute, we decided to book a flight tour. We came across Wings in a tour mag and called Ellen right before she closed the office. She was able to get us a morning tour the very next day.. and even better, the price was much cheaper than helis, and we got more air time than helis too. I'm in my 6th month of pregnancy so was a bit worried about having to ride in a tiny little 4-seater plane but she assured me it would be completely safe. Next morning we drove out and met Maron - she is a doll! She talked us thru the logistics before we got to meet Ellen and Bruce who were the sweetest couple. When we finally saw the plane.... boy was I scared. Its a tiny tiny plane. But! the takeoff, landing and the entire ride was sooo smooth. Better than flying 747s. Bruce has 20+ yrs experience flying so you really are in safe hands. The sites from the sky are amazing - you cannot see this stuff from land or water so this is the only way to go. Well worth every penny for the ride itself, but for the experience and meeting such great people, I would've paid much more!!! Give Ellen a call, you won't regret it ... and tell them Heather & Andy said Alohhhhha!

Took the tour earlier this month with Bruce.  Great experience and definitely worth the money.  Our flight was with one other couple-(they only took four of us so that we could all sit on the side of the airplane with the best views).  The weather was a little cloudy, so they gave us the option of rescheduling, which was nice.  We went anyway and it was great.  The staff was excellent.  As a pilot myself, I was very impressed with Bruce and his attention to detail.  He is very knowledgeable and gives a great deal of info. during the flight (but not too much so that you can't enjoy it).  I think it's the only activity we did in Hawaii where we didn't have to prepay.  They actually take you on your word, which is rare these days.  I would recommend this over a helicopter tour any day of the week!  I

We really enjoyed the comfort and visibility for everyone in our flight, and we are each 6'2"!. Ellen runs operations, and she picked us up and dropped us off at a very convenient location. They run like clockwork. Bruce is an extremely capable, knowledgable and safe pilot. His narration is intelligent and interesting, not chatty.

We have recently returned from our honeymoon on the beautiful Garden Island of Kauai, and we were able to experience the abundant beauty of the island thanks to the courteous, personal and professional service of Wings Over Kauai, run by Bruce and Ellen Coulombe.
From the warm welcome, the personal attention to detail and the inclusion in the pre-flight checks; to the special touch of seating everyone on the right-hand-side of the aircraft (for best, unobstructed views) to the quick and personal turn-around of a personalized CD, this was one of the highlights of our honeymoon. We have no reservations about recommending Wings Over Kauai to anyone - this will be an experience that will give you a fantastic tour of an island that is 80% inaccessible by most means.
There was nothing we could suggest to improve our experience. It was simply fantastic.
Mahalo, Captain Bruce and Ellen! You were great :)

review_title: Good value for must do aerial views of Kauai
review_text: For an aerial view of Kauai (almost compulsory for a visit to this stunning island) there is a basic choice to be made between helicopter and fixed wing.  We chose the plane to get a guaranteed window seat and more room to move. WoK has lots of great reviews and we would agree with these – very friendly and welcoming approach and the flight is smooth and well presented by the pilot, Bruce.  They do advertise 65-70 minutes in the air though – we got 55mins and didn’t go over Hanalei Bay on the north shore – which surprised me as it is such a jewel of that area. Still, we felt it was very good value compared to the helicopters.

If you are going to Kauai and planning on air tour then do not miss this .Ellen picked us up at airport , she waited as our flight got delayed. Bruce made sure we get comfirtable  and explained pre-flight checklist procedure . You get to see beautiful island of Kauai and he gives in-depth detail explaination of your questions and  what you are seeing . 
    Surprise gift and photos without any extra cost and this tour will cost you less compared to helicopter tour . we took helicopter tour on another island , this aeroplane is more comfirtable if you are prone to motion sickness . Bruce/Ellen are very good as hosts and Bruce as very good pilot and tour guide .
 Highly Recommended !!

review_title: Awesome way to see the island!
review_text:
We had friends recommend Wings Over Kauai to us as they had just returned from Kauai.  We thought it was a great way to see the island as I am scared of heights and not sure about getting into a helicopter.  The small plane was a great alternative and slightly cheaper.  We are so happy to have met Ellen and Bruce.  They take pride in their business and it shows in the way they treat their customers from the booking to the actual flight and capped off by a photo emailed directly to you without any additional charge.  

Helping Bruce with the pre-flight checklist was lots of fun.  He explained all the instruments and the workings of the small plane.  His knowledge of the island was amazing.  Seeing the Na Pali coast and Waimea Canyon from above made for excellent photos.  We later hiked and visited Na Pali by boat.  By air was the best perspective.

We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai from anyone visiting the island.  You will not be disappointed.

We were already booked on a helicopter tour when I read about Wings Over Kauai.  We decided to bag the helicopter and go for the small plane instead, in part to save money, but mostly because one of us was too afraid of the helicopter, but was willing to try the plane.  We are so glad we made the change.  

Dealing with Ellen couldn't have been more pleasant.  She made suggestions about our flight time, and even sent us a weather forecast to help us pick the best day.  Of course, we can't say enough about Bruce.  He quickly determined that one of us was nervous about the flight and made an effort to engage her so she'd relax.  

The views from the plane were breathtaking, and Bruce's knowledge of the island and it's vegetation is vast.  He is a skilled pilot as well as a warm and engaging host.  

Do not hesitate to take this flight.  You will be so glad you did.  As with so many other reviewers, it truly was the highlight of our trip.

As a licensed & avid flyer (pilot), I set my expectations high for the trip over Kauai, and to be completely honest, the experience was simply heavenly. I'm so grateful we took the flight with Bruce, who is a kind, thorough, and thoughtful guide and flight instructor.

If you are looking for the "Highlight of your Trip" ....I strongly recommend taking a flight in the Cessna 172 (for couples), you will never forget it, and you will be so happy you did it.

Our flight with Wings over Kauai last week was a highlight of our vacation. The hundreds of positive reviews here on Trip Advisor don't lie: this is an excellent way to see all the beauty of Kauai.

I'm a bit of a nervous flyer and often have motion sickness. The Wings Over Kauai staff calmed my fears and helped us prepare for a great flight. The flight (we were in the larger plane, but it was just my husband & I) was very smooth taking off and landing. The staff let me know there might be some slight bumps as we moved from the Waimea Canyon area to the coast, but even that section was really smooth. They had a cooler with drinks and cold cloths to calm down motion sickness, but we didn't need either.

Captain Bruce was incredibly well-informed about Kauai: geography, history, geology, agriculture, movies, celebrities, beaches, hotels... you name it, he knows about it, and offers great explanations of what you're seeing and answers any questions you have. Unlike a few other people I interacted with on the trip, Wings Over Kauai's staff always gave accurate and appropriate answers. Bruce was also friendly. Some of it was certainly the same lines he gives every tour, but he was very open to answering our questions, and always called us by name (a nice touch).

Could you see the same things in a helicopter? Yes, I think you could. But, Wings Over Kauai offers a similar tour, at about half the cost, and without nearly as much motion-sickness potential. (All my friends who had visited Kauai told horror stories of being sick on helicopters; none of that with Wings Over Kauai). And, though they do weigh you (it's done discreetly) the weight limit isn't nearly as much of a concern as on a helicopter.

I can see why Wings Over Kauai receives such positive reviews! With so many parts of Kauai only visible from the air, you want to take a tour, and Wings Over Kauai is a most excellent way to do that.

review_title: Marvel at the wonders of the "Garden of Eden" from the sky
review_text:
Smoothly and comfortably soaring fixed-wing over the garden isle in a not to be missed experience. The price does not burn a hole in the pocket. Bruce pilots the plane expertly and knows the terrain like the back of his hand, offering deep insights. He even showed us the Hindu temple under construction and the adjacent monastery on Kaholalele Road - a great place to explore.  
The lady at the desk on 6th Oct 2010 afternoon was very friendly and informative and had a 'personal touch'. The lady guests got kukui nut leis. A DVD of the flight is also a welcome gift.

review_title: Best choice for flightseeing in Hawaii
review_text:
Bruce and Ellen are wonderful.  The plane is roomy and comfortable and the cost of flying a fixed wing tour is one heck of a bargain compared to helicopter tours.  

Bruce is a highly experienced pilot (I know because I am a commercial pilot also) and his love of the islands is very evident.  

Do yourself a favor and book this trip if you don't book another flight while you are visiting the islands!

While preparing for a 28 day cruise covering both Alaska and Hawaii, we found Wings Over Kauai on Trip Advisor.  We only had funds available for one BIG shore excursion, so we studied all of our options and decided to go with Wings rather than some other tour.  It was a great decision on our part.  It is hard to read one great review after another and then still have all of your built-up expectations met, but they did it.  Ellen was very prompt in answering all e-mails and even suggesting other things we could do on our visit to Kauai.  We were met at the pick-up site right on time.  The flight was beautiful and Bruce did a wonderful job in keeping each of us (4)  at ease in our first small plane flight.  As a seasoned traveler to many parts of the world, both my wife and I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.  As we returned to our ship, holding our CD gift with our picture on it, my wife said, "That is one of the best things we have ever done".  I agree.

review_title: My husband recently took a flight lesson...
review_text: My husband recently took a flight lesson with Bruce and I was able to join them for the flight around the island. We followed the normal tour flight path and were able to see the entire island. Bruce, Ellen and Maren were so kind, so friendly and helpful. Talk about the true meaning of aloha! Bruce knows a lot about the island, especially the agriculture. He shared a lot of interesting information during our flight. I disagree with the review that said a fixed-wing tour is not a good as a helicopter tour. I have done both on Kauai and I think the two experiences are more similar than different.

review_title: The Private Airvan Tour for the 4 of us was Awesome!
review_text: My husband and I enjoyed out Helicopter rides in 1998...but I remember getting a bit queasy on those rides. Either Bruce or the Airvan are awesome...maybe both...but this flight couldn't have been smoother. No queasiness in 2010! Bruce and Ellen are conducting a 5 star business. Don't miss taking an air tour with Wings Over Kauai during your visit! FYI...its more bang for your buck than a helicopter tour...and you see much more of the island. Aloha!

review_title: Excellent trip, great service, fantastic people!
review_text: In searching for a Kauai flight, I came across Wings Over Kauai Tours. The reviews and their commitment to service won me over and I am very glad I chose to fly with them.  Both Gy and Ellen make you feel very welcome and they are genuinely interested in each passenger.  You feel like you have known them for years!  The weather turned out to be excellent, the trip was smooth, Gy was very informative about all that we saw and we got great views of all the beauty the island has to offer.  It was an excellent experience from beginning to end.

review_title: Wings over Kauai- Top of the list!
review_text: The service that Bruce and Ellen provide is like nothing I've ever experienced.  They welcome you with smiles, handshakes, introductions, flowers, and a Kakui Nut necklace.  The flight briefing is exceptional, as is the flight itself.  Bruce is well versed in the narration of the island botanies, and amply gives the names and history of areas that you are flying over.   Arial views of the Napali Coast, Waimea Canyon and the coastline are breathtaking...a real photo opportunity, and a view that you will never see from land.  Bruce is a real pro, and an excellent pilot.  You will leave "Wings over Kauai" with many "Mahalos", a DVD that their son made, and picturesque memories.  A must do!  This is the most economical flight on the island.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is a fantastic excursion!
review_text:
My husband and I decided to book a tour with Wings Over Kauai after reading all the positive reviews on Trip Advisor about this service.  We were not disappointed!  After all the activities we did on our honeymoon this flight tour remains my husband's favorite part of the trip.

Upon showing up to the Lihue Airport for check-in, we were greeted by friendly faces. Ellen (the pilot's wife) gave me a very nice lei and Hawaiian flower for my hair to welcome us.  We then went over safety information, were given tips on how to avoid motion sickness in the small craft, and also tips on how to take great pictures in flight.  

Before getting into the plane we had our picture taken with the aircraft that Ellen then emailed us before we were even done with our tour!  We met with Bruce, the pilot, to discuss weather conditions and where our tour would be going and then we hopped in the plane.

For someone who has never been in such a small aircraft I was a little nervous about flying but this uneasiness quickly disappeared when we took off without jolt or bump.  Once in the air we were treated to a great narrative by Bruce who has his PhD in agriculture and has lived on the island for over 15 years.  We saw the beautiful southern beaches, flew over Waimea Canyon, continued around to the Na'pali Coast, and around Hanalei Bay before returning to the airport.  We were also lucky enough to see many waterfalls deep in the mountains and get great pictures of Wailua Falls with the sun shining right on it.

Overall, a great experience with a skilled pilot.  The excellent and friendly customer service (complete with free DVD with your picture on the cover) was great bonus.  The price of the flight was well worth it and we both highly recommend you join Bruce on his next flight with Wings of Kauai!

We have been to wings over kauai up recently, the flight was quite fun, scenery amazing and the Bruce was very helpfull with explaining anything of what was arround, also he circled quite a few times when we wanted to take extra pictures of the spot.
We did it as a trio and had much fun.

Would recommend them for anyone!
Thanks Wings over Kauai for an amazing adventure!

After reading many of the reviews of Wings Over Kauai, we took a tour during our trip to Kauai in August. An excellent decision. It was indeed a chance to fly over more or less the entire island and see everything. The weather was perfect and Bruce provided an informative narrative. The whole ride was very smooth and visibility from the larger aircraft was good for all, resulting in a delightful hour or more of sightseeing (and education). The cost of the trip was good too, around half a helicopter flight and a bargain. 

By the way, we had booked well in advance and were pleased to see that Ellen and Bruce had assessed the weather conditions on "our" day, recommending a small change in time to give us the best conditions. We enjoyed our trip to the maximum -- highly recommended, a very professional company.

We had a flight over Big Island, which was so good, that we decided to do it again by plane over Kauai.
And we were not deceived ! Bruce showed us the love he has for HIS island, he was so patient with the kids, he made them read all the check-ups before take off, and they just loved to be part of it. For those of you who hesitate between plane and helicopter, choode the plane ! It is more safe, almost half the price of the copter, and it is much easyer to get a good view of the nature below. And if you missed it, Bruce will make a special loop to show again the right spot.
Thanks again Bruce and Ellen, also for your personalized CD with pics.
Daniel (from far away Israel)

This was the best excursion that we have ever taken!  The flight was smooth, the pilot and his wife and assistant were superb and friendly, the sites were gorgeous and it was an all round wonderful experience!  My husband, sister and I arranged for our Wings over Kauai trip after reading the great reviews here on Trip Advisor and we were so happy and amazed with our experience!  We are still pinching ourselves-did we really just do this?  Treat yourselves to Wings over Kauai!  You will not be disappointed!

review_title: Wings over Kauai- Don't miss this tour!
review_text:
What a wonderful tour!  We were on our honeymoon and looking at the Helicopter tours but the price was over $200. pp and could not justify the cost of $400+. So we decided to book "Wings over Kauai" @ $120 pp. They have everyone sit on the one side of the plane so no one has a bad seat. The views where incredible and should not be missed! Don't believe me: Check out my pictures! Ellen and Bruce where wonderful hosts and made you feel welcome. They took a picture of us and gave us a DVD with the picture on the front of a prerecorded flight (included on the price).
Don't miss this tour!

I'm so glad I stumbled upon Wings Over Kauai during my internet search for things to do while on vacation in Aug 2010.  Not only did I enjoy the flight but Capt Bruce and Ellen were such wonderful people to deal with and meet.  I can't stop talking about them and Wings to people who have been asking me what to do when they go to Kauai.

review_title: Impeccable service and what a view from the air
review_text:
We chose WOK over helicopter tours because (1) the reviews here (2) able to request a private flight for my family of 4 on GA-8 Airvan (3) everyone get window seat (4) the significant cost saving. Our objectives were met 100%.

Based on the reviews here, we decided to go on WOK as early as we could. However, it was cloudy on our first morning in Kauai. Since this was our first trip to Kauai, I didn’t know whether that was weather as usual (since it often rains in Kauai) or just a cloudy day. We arrived at the airport on time. Ellen’s first reaction was “you didn’t get my message”. Guess what, Ellen had called to suggest flying on other time. The cloud cleared up in the afternoon. I called again to check with Ellen. Ellen suggested if we went on the afternoon flight, we won’t get the flight for my own and the children would need to sit on the left side of the plane since she had rearranged other morning flight passengers to afternoon already. To make the long story short, Ellen keeps customer’s best interest in mind. That’s something very commendable.

We finally got on the flight on our last day. It was a beautiful day with blue sky. Kauai is as advertised as beautiful from the sky. You truly need to take a flight to see the mountain, valley, waterfalls and coastline. Since we had been to a few places already in Kauai, able to recognize places like Wailua Fall in the air was fun. 

We all felt dizzy to different degree in the flight. The flight was smooth so it’s more due to our physical condition than anything else. Another thing, my video and pictures captured quite a bit of cockpit reflection. If you plan to take a lot of pictures and videos, beware of the reflection or don’t sit on the right co-pilot seat. The complementary DVD with our photo on the cover made up some from the glare. A follow up email is also a nice touch. WOK does not need to do any of these, but they do!

Overall, it is a wonderful experience and I will suggest taking this flight to anyone else.

review_title: Would do it again in a heartbeat.
review_text: Could not have been more impressed with this tour.  My wife and I were on our honeymoon in Kauai and they found a way to truly make the experience memorable.  Bruce and Ellen seemed genuinely excited to have us as guests for their company.  Bruce is a retired research scientist and can tell you more than any other tour guide we had on the island about some of the science behind Kauai, yet make it interesting and witty at the same time.  Bruce truly makes you feel comfortable throughout the entire flight, and having a three seat Cessna for a private tour is quite the exquisite way to see the island.  At the end of the tour they present you with a complimentary DVD of the flight they do complete with a picture they take just prior to the flight of you with the plane.  Could not have been a more personable couple and they obviously really love what they do.  We would definitely do this flight again and would recommend it to everyone we know who is going to Kauai.

Just to start off, my wife and I picked all of our excursions, hotels, and restaurants for our honeymoon off of TripAdvisor (and Yelp) and were not steered wrong once.  Wings Over Kauai is a prime example.  Ellen and Bruce provided a memorable experience with a beautiful flight over this gorgeous island. There were two other couples on the plane in addition to us, but Bruce (the pilot) made sure to give everyone personalized attention and service. Bruce is extremely focused on safety (they've been doing this for over 20 years I believe) and is a very knowledgeable and interesting tour guide in addition to being a pilot. The aircraft was new and comfortable, with some minor bumps but nothing major. My wife tends to get air/car/seasick, so the fact that she was completely fine on this trip is a testament to the aircraft and the pilot.  While we didn't get as close to some of the waterfalls and sights as a helicopter would have, we still got to see everything for a fraction of the price. We must have seen about 50 waterfalls because it had just rained earlier in the day, and we had some beautiful views over the Waimea Canyon.  I had the Jurassic Park song playing in my head the whole time.  As a little extra bonus, we were given a DVD (with our picture on the cover) at the end of the flight and received an email with our pictures from Ellen just the other day. A+ company and service, would highly recommend.

I spent alot of time reviewing different ways to see Kauai by air and Im glad I went with Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen make you feel right at home.  The flight itself is fantastic - amazing views and alot of Island knowledge from Bruce.  I highly recommend Wings of Kauai!

review_title: Breathtaking Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: We recently went to Kauai for much needed R&R.  As we have never been privileged to visit this beautiful island before, we decided to take an air tour of the island to "scope out" the areas we wanted to visit by land.  We were not disappointed!!  After contemplating multiple helicopter tours, we chose to go the fixed wing route based on previous reviews.  Wings over Kauai was the perfect decision.  Bruce and Ellen were gracious, lending their highly knowledgeable, personalized touch, making our experience unforgettable.  I have to admit, I'm a little nervous of small planes, however, their years of experience both on and off the ground (and impeccable flight record), made for an exceptionally amazing flight!  I can't believe I ever hesitated, even for a second!  Their attention to the little details made the experience that much more incredible- the lei and fragrant flowers, personalized CD of the flight experience, soda, water, and ginger candy.   I would definitely book another air tour with Wings over Kauai.  Kauai is a hold-your-breath beautiful island and is appreciated so much more when experiencing it in it's untouched raw beauty- only accessible by air.

Ellen and Bruce are the nicest people I met in Kauai. They were so adorable both over the phone and in person. The flight then was amazing. I was a little worried at the beginning but Bruce was very reassuring and kept talking to us through the headset. He gives a thorough account of all that goes/went on on the island. He also gives you the so called "movie tour" so that you don't have to do it or pay extra for it. I guy that was on the plane with us had flown helicopters before and said that flying in a plane with an experienced and friendly pilot like Bruce was a lot better. Not only it is a lot more personal but it is also longer, less noisy, and half the price of a helicopter tour. I'd do this again a million times.

My wife and I just returned from a Hawaiian Cruise aboard the NCl Pride of America.  We chose to do our own excursions rather than go with the on-board overpriced choices.  One of our best selections was Wings Over Kauai Tours.  Ellen was so kind and helpful about picking us up and then delivering us back after the tour.  Bruce, the pilot was also great and really made my nervous wife much more comfortable about flying.  She almost chickened out the morning of the flight.  She was so glad she didn't because as soon as we were in the air all of her fears went away and we both really enjoyed the ride and the views were spectacular.  We had already done a helicopter tour on the island of Hilo and it was okay but this plane ride was more comfortable and everyone had a great view out of the large windows.  I am enthusiastically giving them another 5 star review and recommending them to everyone!!  Thanks again Ellen and Bruce for a great flight!!

review_title: Very good experience - shame we didn't get the private flight.
review_text: I echo the general positive comments about the Wings Over Kauai tour itself. Very informative and efficient friendly service, with great sight seeing and narration by the pilot, Bruce. We had booked the private flight option but unfortunately on the date of our flight we were told that the smaller Cessna aircraft that they do the private flights in was being serviced. We had booked  the private flight option in this plane several months in advance, so we feel we should say that we were naturally disappointed with this news. However, they did try to contact us a couple of days before the flight but we did not get the message. It was still a lovely flight in the bigger airvan, with another couple along for the ride as well. I have to say that it was definitely a great way to see the island at a good price and with a friendly company. Little extras like the lei and the DVD were very nice!

For our 25th wedding anniversary, we really wanted to book a helicopter tour of Kauai.
