Steve and Lori from Tom Barefoot Tours TomBarefoot.com highly recommended booking a fixed wing flight on a Cessna from Wings Over Kauai. We're glad we took their advice. We flew with Wings Over Kaui on Thursday, July 15, 2010.

It's a true "mom and pop" operation run by Ellen and Bruce Coulombe. Both are very friendly, warm and accommodating. Ellen picked us up in town (we were on the NCL cruise ship Pride of America) and drove us to the airport. Flight check in was very smooth. She answered all our questions, even giving my wife a welcome gift and taking our photos in front of the Cessna.

My wife Maria was a bit hesitant to fly in a small 4 seat airplane. She told Bruce our pilot that she might feel queasy. Bruce put both of at ease with his wonderful suggestions for avoiding motion sickness. He also had on hand some ginger candies which his lovely wife Ellen told us were very effective in settling any upset stomachs.

Maria sat up in front, while I had the back all to myself. One great advantage of a fixed wing airplane is that you're guaranteed a window seat! Maria helped Bruce with the pre flight checklist. 

This is a great way to see the island since you can't see it by car. Bruce pointed out all the must see sights and giving us his personal anecdotes as well. Bruce has a great sense of humour, a wealth of information and knowledge of Kauai, (he has a PhD in agronomy) and a masterful way of telling great stories.
 
It went by way too fast! This was a real personal tour. We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai for their unbeatable prices, longer flight time, and pickup and return if you're on a cruise or without a car.

review_title: Bruce you were the best and provided a truly memorable experience.
review_text:
My wife and I had a wonderful trip with Wings Over Kauai on Aug 13 during our honeymoon. Bruce, the pilot and owner, provided a first class tour with narration second to none. He involved all in the plane in the discussion and provided expert insight about Kauai, and its flora, that no one else could match.

Earlier in our trip we took a helicopter ride while on Maui and enjoyed that too. But after reading all the positive reviews in Tripadvisor about Wings Over Kauai, we thought a plane ride would be worth a try. Boy was it ever! I felt the plane was superior to the helicopter in that we had more time to look at the individual sights, but it was Bruce and his knowledge, wit, and care for his clients that made the trip a true experience.

I got to sit in the co-pilot's seat and go over the pre-flight check off list. As an engineer, that was really cool and Bruce explained some of the controls that I didn't fully understand.

It's the little touches that make Wings Over Kauai so exceptional. My wife received a shell lei and a flower from Bruce's home garden upon arrival. At the conclusion of the trip a CD of Kauai was waiting for us and it had a picture of the two of us on the CD cover.

If you are looking for an attraction in Kauai that will leave you very pleased, visit Bruce and company at Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: On top of the world (or heaven)
review_text:
For starters, I really must compliment Capt (and Dr) Bruce and his daughter Ellen for making my family and I feel comfortable and at home before our flight.  That really helps when you’re stepping on a small plane.

Seeing Kauai from above is one of those things that you need to do even if you've been to the island before.  In fact, I wish I took this trip first so that I could really appreciate Kauai before I saw it by land and sea.  

The flight itself is very cool and fairly calm given the mountains and breezes above.  We were able to take excellent videos and photos during the flight without any issues at all.  Also, we only had the three of us on the plane (plus Capt Bruce), so it’s like you’re getting your own personal tour. 

Finally, you really do get to see many nice things that you normally wouldn't see without flying and I would recommend you take advantage of this opportunity if you can.  

Aloha!

Book this flight right away....very personable company with an aim to please....smooth ride...great points of interest thanks to our pilot Bruce!...This is probably our best memory of our Kauai vacation. My wife received a lei before boarding and we received a DVD (previously recorded footage) with a personalized DVD cover (very nice touch!) Highly recommended!

I had researched things to do in Kauai on Tripadvisor and everyone was raving about Wings Over Kaua'i. I didn't initially think that it would be something i would want to do, but when i got to Kaua'i I realized that most of the island is unaccessible (there is a road that runs 3/4 of the circumference of the island, and a road that runs into Waimea canyon, and the rest of the island is forests and mountains with little or no access)...I really wanted to see the Na Pali coastline, and i knew i wouldn't get to unless I took a flight. It was really a wonderful experience, and well worth the money. Ellen was very helpful and accommodating, working with me to find the right time slot in my busy schedule.  The views were awesome, and Brian, my pilot, was lovely, very professional and informed. The take off and landing were smooth as could be. I got some brilliant photos! Thanks to you Wings over Kaua'i!! ;o)

review_title: Wonderful flight with a top notch company
review_text:
Ellen and Bruce, the owners of Wings over Kauai are two of the nicest people that you’ll ever meet.  The reservation process with Ellen was smooth and enjoyable and she is very personable.

We had received a phone call from Ellen yesterday letting us know that they had an unexpected inspection of their larger plane (GA-8 Airvan) scheduled for today so we wouldn’t all be able to fly together on our scheduled sightseeing flight.  She had offered us the option to take two separate flights on their smaller aircraft (Cessna 172) or to take their competitor Air Venture (she had even talked to Air Venture about available flight times with them).  We decided to stick with Wings over Kauai and were glad we did.   

We decided that my step son and I would take the first flight at 11 am and that my wife and step daughter would take the later flight at 12:30 pm.  Ellen picked us up at the ABC store near the ship (it’s about a 10 minute walk or a free shuttle ride) and we headed to the airport where we weighed in and waited until Bruce was ready.  I sat up front with Bruce and my step son sat in the back.  The Cessna was definitely small and was by far the smallest aircraft that I’ve ever been in, and I was a bit nervous at first.  Bruce’s calm manner and professionalism quickly put me at ease though.  We both had on headphones so we could hear Bruce’s narration and converse with him.  As we taxied out, he had me read off his preflight check list which was fun.   He is very methodical and safety conscious so I felt like we were in very good hands.  Soon we were cleared for takeoff and  it didn’t take long for us to be airborne.  We flew over Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, the waterfall from Fantasy Island, and even saw the summit of Mount Waialeale which Bruce said was rare (it’s one of the rainiest spots on earth with an average of 426 inches of rain per year).  We saw numerous mountains, waterfalls, beaches, and beautiful coastline on our flight and Bruce is a veritable encyclopedia of knowledge.  I haven’t done any helicopter flights but couldn’t imagine it being any better than this, and at a much cheaper price than a helicopter too.  We flew over the Pride of America on our way back to the airport and all too soon were coming in for a smooth, smooth landing.   

My wife and step daughter were waiting at the airport for their flight so Ellen took a picture of all four of us in front of the plane.  That picture ended up on the cover of the free dvd that they gave us (which features footage from what we saw on the flight but not from our specific flight).   Ellen drove us back to the ABC store (she offered to take us to the ship but we wanted to buy a few t-shirts) and bid us a fond farewell.  Later, when my wife returned, her and my step daughter raved about their flight and we all compared notes.  What a wonderful experience.

review_title: Aloha Spirit ! Fantastic Wings over Kauai !!
review_text:
This  was  our  second trip with Wings over Kauai , having  flown on their Cessna 172 with Bruce  last year, we  enjoyed it  so much ,that we  decided to fly again with them and  try their new Airvan. We were lucky with the weather , it  was simply amazing  to be  able  to see this beautiful island  again  on the  confort of the Airvan with the noise  reduction headphones, that also allowed us to communicate freely during the entire flight. I can only recommend everyone to have the thrill of their vacation flying  with Wings over Kauai instead of  going  on one of the many helicopter tours available . Bruce  and their  family  are outstanding , mahalo for another  unforgettable flight , wish you guys blue skies until we meet again !!! 
Pedro & Ulla from Denmark.

review_title: A truly amazing way to see Kauai! An exceptional value offered by GREAT people!
review_text:
We recently visited Kauai and our first stop was with Bruce, Ellen and Mary. I first contacted them by email and set up our tour. Ellen was so pleasant via email and immediately put any fears I had to rest (I am pregnant and was worried about the flight).  

We were greeted like family when we arrived and recieved a lei in traditional Hawaiian style. We flew in the 4 seater as it was just my husband and I. He got to be the co-pilot while I was the photographer.

Bruce was informative and provided us a GREAT tour of the island. I did end up a bit sick (I am blaming it on being pregnant and looking out my camera lens most of the time and not the window) and Bruce was so great about making me feel better. 

The DVD that they put together for you is another bonus!

It really is one the best values on the island! I can't say enough great things about the Wings Over Kauai people. We will certainly fly with them on our next visit!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai "Wings Over Kauai"!
review_text: Our son took us to Kauai for vacation and when he checked out the ratings on Trip Advisor for an aerial tour we took note of the highly recommended and great reviews for Wings Over Kauai. This was a great decision as there were 5 in our group, so I booked the AirVan which can carry 6 people instead of the Cessna so that we could all ride together.   One of the members of our group was a bit  apprehensive to take the tour with us, but she did anyway and survived the wonderful trip without losing it.   Upon arrival at WOK, Bruce graciously greeted us and shortly there after Ellen warmly welcomed us, too.   She presented me with a Kukui Nut necklace and a small flower, too.  They were so hospitable and treated us like family which made our Katie feel so much better about joining us on the tour.  We took the tour at 12:30 pm and had beautiful weather for our flight.  Bruce assisted us with taking our picture in front of the Air Van before our takeoff.   We had bottled drinks available and some ginger candy to assist us with flight sickness if we needed it.  Then he helped us strap in and showed us how to use the headsets.  They allowed us to converse with him and ask questions during the flight which was really neat.  Bruce was our pilot and our son, Jeff was his co-pilot and had the job of assisting Bruce with the pre-flight checklist as we made our way down the run way.  We chartered the whole plane for our group of 5 and paid a total of $520 including tax since it was less expensive that paying the $130 per person + tax for the flight.   What a deal!  Our view of the Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali Coast, Wailua Falls and many other breathtaking sights was just awesome.   I took about 150 pictures and the majority of them came out great!  We highly recommend using Wings Over Kauai for your aerial view of the island.   Mahalo,  Ellen and Bruce for a wonderful adventure!

review_title: One of the best ways to see the Garden Island
review_text: Thanks Ellen for arranging a lovely flight.  We enjoyed having Capt Bruce as our pilot.  He has a very calm and comforting voice for anyone who is not used to flying in a small prop-plane.  Plus, my wife got a kick out of being his co-pilot.  Added to the lovely scenery of Kauai was Capt Bruce's expert knowledge of the ecosystem.  The only advice....don't miss the beauty of the island by looking through the lens of your camera.

My sister bought us tickets for Wings Over Kauai for our honeymoon and I am so glad she did! My husband and I had the best time. Ellen greets you and is extremely friendly and she gives the ladies a lei and a flower. Bruce, her husband, is also so friendly and makes everyone feel very comfortable going for a ride in his plane. He had another passenger go through a checklist before he took off and it was interesting to see what pilots have to do before takeoff. He was very personable and knowledgeable of the island. He even made a special fly over a temple for the other couple on board. I asked him may questions throughout the flight and he was happy to answer them. We saw the island from the most spectacular view. I would do this everytime I go to kauai and would recommend it to anyone. thank you Bruce and Ellen!!!

review_title: Best deal and a great flight!
review_text:
Great, long flight.  Very friendly and accommodating staff.  They made us feel very special.
Complimentary drinks, video, photo and lei.
What more could you ask for?
Well worth the price!

review_title: Really great experience, incredible views of the island
review_text: Wow!  We loved Bruce, the pilot, and his family.  His wife, Ellen, and daughter were all a part of the operation.  They were very easygoing, and accommodating when the date of our flight didn't have great weather.  We rescheduled for the following day, on Bruce's advice, which was the right choice.  As we floated off into the sky, Bruce narrated the trip to us in a lovely, soothing voice to soft Hawaiian music in the background, and if we were nervous, all of our fears went away.  It is hard to believe there can be so much beauty on one island, and I feel like we got to see most of it from our plane window.  What we weren't expecting, however, is to get so motion sick.  It really took me and my daughter by surprise.  It was such a smooth and relaxing ride that I never would have expected to feel so badly.  Bruce had bottled waters, which helped the two of us, along with peppermints and ginger candy.  It didn't ruin the experience at all, but we were not prepared, since we don't normally get motion sick.  We still highly recommend this adventure.

My husband and I enjoyed our honeymoon in Kauai this April and really arrived with out any plans at all. We knew what we wanted to do, but had no idea where to do it when we got there. After hearing about helicopter flights and how they herd people like cattle into them; we opted for the private flight by Bruce and Ellen's Wings over Kauai. And boy were we happy.  We had a personal flight over the island and Bruce shared with us all that he knows about the island, allowed us to take pictures through an open window! Swooped in over the canyons and really let us be a part of the flight.  Ellen greeted us with a lei made of nuts and gave us a DVD of our tour! 

We are so sorry we took so long to post here, our life took a crazy turn when we arrived back home after our trip to Kauai and we didnt get a chance. Thank you for such a wonderful flight. We are coming back to see you guys next year!!!

Don't do a helicopter ride if Wings over Kauai is available...you will miss out on the charm of an inflight chauffer!

This is  not just a review of the Wings Over Kauai marvelous circle island flight, but also  about the aloha of their family, Bruce, Ellen and daughter Mary.

Reservations were easy, happy and fun, when I talked with Ellen, to reserve two seats for us.  We talked story, and just had a ball.  Ellen is so full of life and aloha, and infectious happy laughter makes a person feel like you are talking to a long time friend.

On the day we were sheduled, Ellen calls and reminds us of the flight, and says everything is a " go".   She also says that she will not be there, but her daughter Mary will be running the office.

Kidding around, I say "  Well , just how am I going to give you an aloha hug ? "  Ellen replys "  Give the hug to my daughter, and she can pass it on ! "  How cool is that. I love this island and the people.

We are excited about flying in their brand new G-8  Aerovan.  That puppy has room for 6, but generally they  just fly four.   Huge windows for photo opportunities, and plenty of leg room.  Seats run along each side seperated by an isle in the center.

Each passenger has a headseat and mic, and Bruce , the owner, and pilot, visits and talks with each individual, calling them by their first names.   The naration of the flight is excellent, as Bruce has years and years of experience flying the tour in his Cessna 172, plus he has many, many years as a resident on Kauai.  Knows his stuff.

Prior to departure we weigh in and sign in....Mary escorts us out to the G-8, to the ladder leading into the main cabin.  She will take pre boarding photos with your camera , as well as hers.

Also the ladies all receive a kukui nut lei...which I placed over Erica's shoulders and gave her the traditional kiss.    The fun had already begun and we were still on the ground.

Take off was smooth, and I rode up in the right seat, ( co-pilot seat ) next to Bruce.  Not sure if it makes any difference, but I was a professional pilot for nearly 40 years.  No stick time in the G-8, but it was great fun helping read off the check list, and feeling a bit like part of the aircrew.

Take off was smooth and we gently banked to the right, and began our climb out for the Circle Island Tour.   The passengers in the back had their cameras ready.

Bruce flys slow and at an altitude that is superb for photos as we were treated to marvelous panoramic views of the garden island.   Seems like we fly about the same routes as the helo companies,  with thoughtful attention to noise abatement in certain areas.  

Roughly, we cruised past Kalapaki Beach, and  Nawiliwili Harbor.  On our right the cameras clicked with shots of Kipu Kai,  Maha'ulepu, The Hyatt and Poipu. Turning inland we crossed over the coffee fields of Kalaheo,  and then to some of the canyons in the Hanapepe Valley.

Wonderful vistas of Waimea Canyon opened up, and then flew over the ridge and waimea canyon road,  and the deep valleys that lead to the Napali Coast.  Soon we were cruising along the Napali Coast . Banking inland about Hanalei, the interior beauty, lush valleys, water falls and rivers were marvelous.   More natural tresures passed beneath us, as we circled Wialua Falls.....

That is just part of the flying experience, you will be seeing much more, and even though we live on Kauai,  learned all kinds of new information about the island.  

Flight time is nearly up, and we fly  very near our condo, at Banyon Harbor, which is on the approach to runway 3.   

We have a cross wind, and Bruce landed so sofly that I could not feel the wheel touch down. Maybe jus a slight kiss as he rolled it on.   I kidded him  "  You had better call the tower and confirm that we are on the ground ! "    Bruce just smiled.

Now remember when Mary took photos of both couples prior to departure.  Well, we taxi up to the Commuter Terminal and shut down.  Mary brings out the steps for easy exiting of the aircraft.  

Everyone is happy and smiling,   Mary presents us with WOK's  professional DVD of the  route of flight.  Back ground  music is by IZ.  And, on the front of the DVD plastic holder is the picture of each individual couple.  Yep,  Erica and I are pictured just below the WINGS OVER KAUAI  name on the top.   

Will just finish by saying that the G-8,  is a product of Australia, and flown as a tour aircraft down under.  It can  haul the weight.  Which, is great for those who weigh more than the max limit to fly a helo tour without purchasing an extra seat, or a percentage of an extra seat.

No extra charge. There is plenty of leg and shoulder  room, and I belive the cost is about $  249.00 for two people.  That is pretty reasonable and about  half the cost of some of the helo tours give or take a few bucks.   Not bad !

We looked out our DVD this morning,  now this is professionally done. It is not a dvd of our particular flight, and is outstanding.  Perfect for showing friends and family upon returning to your home base.  And it is also included.  No extra charge.

The Wings Over Kauai cirdle island tour,  was most outstanding. Bruce, Ellen and Mary were wonderful, and make each individual passenger feel like they are the only people that exist on the planet.  Lots of individual customer service and aloha.

Denny and Erica
Lihue, Hawaii

review_title: Excellent flight instruction while getting awesome flightseeing
review_text: I am a pilot, and my wife and I were interested in flying while on Kauai.  I found Wings Over Kauai and met Bruce Coulombe, the pilot/instructor.  I was impressed by Bruce and his operation.  Bruce is very professional but friendly, the two qualities you want in a pilot.  My wife and I were impressed by his thoroughness as he prepared us for the flight.  I have my own plane and over 800 hours, but Bruce gave me advice and instruction that made me a better pilot.  But the great thing about the flight was that he not only gave good flight instruction,, but also gave us a great tour of Kauai at the same time.  Bruce would point out things to see, and then would give great explanations about the features as my wife shot lots of great photos from the backseat.  With the high-wing Cessna, the photo opportunities seemed endless.  The canyon, the coast and the volcano were spectacular on the day of our flight.  The flight seemed to take 10 minutes, but when we landed, we had been flying for 75 minutes.   Bruce was very hospitable and gave us nice gifts to help us remember our trip, as if we would ever forget it.  We will definitely fly with Bruce again on our next trip to Kauai.

review_title: Kauai is even more beautiful from the air
review_text: First time to see Kauai from the air and we so enjoyed the breathtaking views of this beautiful island. Carter (Bruce's son), & Thomas (friend) got us all checked in & prepared for our flight. Also took pictures of our family.  So very nice! Then we were off on our flight with Bruce, our outstanding pilot and so very knowledgeable about the island. He made us feel so comfortable. I got some outstanding pictures. Thanks Bruce and we hope to fly again with you someday!

review_title: Money well spent on the best flight of our trip
review_text: Bruce, the pilot, gave a wonderful explanation of the sites but did not over talk.  Due to the slow speed of the plane we were able to have ample time for viewing the scenery and taking awesome photos. With much af Kauai's beauty inaccessible by other means the flight gave us the opportunity to see the hidden treasures of Kauai. My wife and I took the flight on the last day of our stay and agree that it was the highlight of our trip. It gave us a whole new perspective of Kauai and another view of Kauai's incredible beauty.

review_title: Best way to start your Kauai stay in Paradise
review_text:
Wings over Kauai is personal and friendly and first class!  From the Email correspondence, to the check-in and welcome before the flight, you feel in good hands, and with a Air Tour company that cares about your needs and your expectations.  Bruce expains everything as you taxi out to the runway, with your Bose comfortable headsets with mics, you are part of the flight!
As you fly around the Island, your questions are answered about almost anything you see or can think of, The view from inside is fabulous, take as many pictues as you like, you will see everything you came here for!  When you gently touch down and taxi back to there office, they have a keepsake DVD with your picture in front of the plane, so you have a movie of the highlights of Kauia to share. We loved our tour, thanks so much.and low cost too!

review_title: Wings over Kauai is the best!
review_text: My wife and I just got home from our hawaiian cruise and I have to say that the best part of our trip was our flight with bruce and ellen.  Their flight is half the price of the chopper rides and they are so friendly.  They go out of their way to make sure you are comfortable and enjoying yourself.  You really get a personal experience with them.  Ellen picked us up at the abc store near the pier in her car and drove us to the airport.  My wife gets motion-sick and they even offered her ginger, and let her ride in the front seat so that she wouldnt get sick.  I learned so much about Kauai on our flight.  Bruce does a great job of narrating the trip and even explains a little bit about how the plane works.   I got some great pictures on our flight, and I will submit them on their website in the near future.  If you are going to fly over one of the hawaiian islands, fly over kauai, and do it through wings over kauai.

review_title: Highlight Of Any Stay In Kauai
review_text: The highlight of our stay on the beautiful island of Kauai. Helen and Bruce are lovely, friendly people and Bruce (the pilot) will ease the nerves of anyone not sure about flying in such a small plane. He cleverly involves everyone in the actual flying procedures, short of taking control of course. Some advantages of a fixed-wing flight over helicopters are the price, quieter and you don't have to share the flight with anyone else - if there are 2 of you, the plane is all yours. Bruce will also reschedule if the weather is not good. The views cannot be any better in a helicopter, they were superb, particularly over the otherwise inaccessible parts of the island. I can thoroughly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

My wife and I flew with Bruce in June of 2010 and had a great time.  His wife and son were very helpfu.  Bruce did a great job telling us about what we were seeing.  We went on a 75 minute flight and saw everything we wanted.  It was somewhat overcast but we were still happy with our photos and the experience. The flight was smooth and I would recommend it to those on the fence.  The price is a little steep but compared to helicopters, it is a no brainer.

Bruce & Ellen Coulombe made this a great experience for our family, and we are so glad we chose to fly with them. Bruce has such a passion for flying and makes the whole trip worth it just to fly with him. We were able to get great pictures and video of the island along with commentary from Bruce. When we got off the plane they gave us their own DVD of the island flight. We want to thank you for the memories you helped our family to create while on vacation last week.

review_title: Don't leave Kauai without flying with Bruce
review_text: The flight and view of Kauai was wonderful.  Our pilot, Bruce, gave lots of interesting information along with the most spectacular views of the island.  He clearly loves what he does and makes you feel right at home on his plane.  Everyone is assured a window seat with the best view.  I only wish comercial flights could be so smooth and easy.  The price makes it very affordable for a family versus other flight opportunites on the island.

review_title: Best idea we had in Kauai
review_text: my girlfriend an i had plans to do a helicopter excursion but found it a bit pricey.  after flipping through one of the tourist guides we found Wings Over Kauai was more reasonably priced.  though skeptical because you often get what you pay for, we went through with making the reservation. securing the reservation was easy and the staff was friendly.  the size of the plane, a 4 seater,  was intimidating but it made for a very intimate and personal flight.  I found the pilot/tour-guide to be very personable and incredibly knowledgeable of the island.  although it's probably not protocol, we only paid for an hour tour but the pilot extended the tour by another half hour at no cost allowing us to enjoy the beautiful scenery all the longer.  I rate this at 5 star.  well worth the money for an unforgettable experience.  i have and will recommend to all my friends. Mahalo!

Bruce, Ellen, and Thomas were all very friendly and helpful.  Bruce did his best to avoid bumpy air the day we flew, but alas, my travel companion still got a little queezy (she used wrist bands, but no other medication, for motion sickness).  The views were gorgeous; I just wish we'd been able to fly over Waimea Canyon instead of near it (didn't see much of it), but the bumpy air prevented our doing so.

Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island, which made the flight educational.  I would also have liked him to give more of a running narrative of the names of the areas, beaches, towns, etc. that we were flying over along the way to provide a better orientation to the island. We took the flight on the first day of our stay; it would be helpful to know the names of the places we saw so we could find them to explore from the ground later.

All in all, flying with WOK is a great value and I'd recommend it to anyone.

Well organized flight with an excellent overview of Kauai. The pilot gave good snippets of information about all the highlights and also personalized the tour to give an aerial view of a temple we were planning to visit.

review_title: The best day for many years / the best event I've ever had
review_text:
My girlfriend made me a surprise - booked flight with WOK. The company is owned by Bruce and Ellen C. - very friendly and nice people. No any pre-paid for booking, just book, come and FLY! Bruce took us over Kauai and showed everything from the different angle. We had seen most of areas before, but flying over it was worth it! I even dod not make a picture - it cannot tell even a part of that beautifil views. During the flight Bruce told us many interesting things about the island, about the aviation, he's just very interesting and attentive interlocutor.
But all this is nothing. In about 30 minutes, Bruce let me steer his Cessna, and autopilot was turned off (I checked:)) 5-10 minutes of flight - that was the most beautiful thing during this and many others vacatins i had...
I am writing this right after the flight, and one idea is going around my mind - I think i shoulg go to fly tomorrow again..

That's not advertising, guys...if you're just tourist - you will like the view. If you are mad about  flight - that's main thing for you

I visited Wings over Kauai back in February, I was Refered there by a local after my current flight plans had got canceled. I would have to say that it was the best thing that could have happened. Ellen and Bruce were very welcoming and friendly, they helped me decide how to customize my flight the way I wanted it and then Bruce and I went up for a flight lesson. I kinda got the tour and lesson all in one it was truly one of the best expeirences in my life. thank you both. if your looking for a great sight seeing tour or looking for  flight lessons on one of the most beautiful places on earth. Wings over Kauai is the number one spot to go.

This was a wonderful experience and worth every penny.  Bruce and Ellen are so gracious and friendly.  The entire experience was personalized for my wife and me and they made sure we felt comfortable during the flight.  Bruce is a great pilot and knows a lot about the Kauai island and is able to sure interesting information throughout the flight.  Before the we took off, Bruce gave a flight "checklist" to my wife to call out (rudder check, fuel tank full, etc).  It was fun, made us feel safe, and is a great example of how Bruce and Ellen went above and beyond to make the experience unforgetable.

While on a cruise through the Hawaii Islands, I was looking for an alternative to heliocopter  flights over Kauai and happened upon Wings Over Kauai. And was I ever lucky that I did. Bruce & Ellen are extremely gracious and helpful. Ellen even drove to where I was on another land excursion to pick me up since  timing of the flight was crucial to my getting back to the ship on time.
