There are a lot of places on Kauai that cannot be accessed by automobile or even 4 wheel drive vehicles and Wings Over Kauai is the way to see these locations. I would suggest  it to everyone.

the owners were absolutely fan-fun-tastic!!! MUCH SAFER then copters and much MORE info -hx. ENVIRONMENTAL - and fun entertaining facts , the views were awesome!! VERY PERSONNAL !!! LOVED their dog in the office and the personal touches on board...drinks, etc... Can't wait to fly again!!! the picures and dvd of flight made it even more special

review_title: Amazing, breathtaking views of Kauai not to be missed!
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed every moment of our tour from the minute we met Ellen to the final aloha to both Capt Bruce and Ellen as we left Wings-words cannot express the elation we felt seeing the beautiful island from the air with the expertise of Bruce's narration during our flight. We did this early during our week on Kauai and found it was a wonderful introduction to the many island sights which we later visited in person. The views of the Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast were absolutely marvelous from the air and not to be missed by anyone visiting the island. We would highly recommend this flight to anyone visiting Kauai-a tour we would rate 6 stars out of 5!!!

My husband and I flew with  Bruce this afternoon over what has to be one of the most diverse islands in the world! The trip was unbelievably awesome and will be a lifetime memory to treasure. Bruce and his wife, Ellen were a pleasure to work with. When we arrived, Ellen presented a beautiful lei to  me. Our 70 minute flight was amazing. We saw everything we wanted to see and more. Bruce was a wonderful tour guide as well as pilot (with a perfect safety record!!!--loved that!) and pointed out every detail as we soared over the lush landscape. It was amazing! When we landed,  Ellen presented us with a DVD of the trip with our picture on it. We have already watched it and were amazed again at the beauty we had just seen. Having seen the poor quality  of  one done by a local helicopter company  after my brother's trip, we were amazed at the professionalism of this DVD. The bonus was that it was not as expensive as a helicopter tour and was at least as good and quite possibly even better!!  We highly recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone thinking about flying over this gorgeous island! You won't be disappointed! Thanks again to Bruce and Ellen for a lifetime memory!!! If I could give it more than 5 stars, I would give it 10!!

review_title: You HAVE to see the whole Island, the best and affordable way is this!
review_text: These guys are a hidden gem on Kauai! Bruce and Ellen have a smaller operation than the competition and add a personal touch to your flight. Ellen gave my wife a flower for her hair, and a stuffed animal for my little girl. They also have the exact same plane as the other guys (7 seater I think), though you won't see it in any of the advertisements (that I saw). They also have a 4 seater as well. We flew the entire island for half as much it would've cost to go in a helicopter. Ellen took a picture of the family before our departure and emailed it to us and gave us a DVD of a flight around the island so you can share the highlights with your friends and family later! During the flight Bruce had everyone pitch in to be a part of the crew-checklists and what-not. Bruce has a PHD in agronomics, and knows tons about the plants in Hawaii. We even swung out a little wider than usual to see a whale Bruce spotted. (It was March)  If you want to see ALL of Kauai, go see these guys!

This was our first tour on a small aircraft and it was awesome. Bruce and Ellen were so friendly and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The flight itself was incredible. The plane ride was smooth and with the great headsets provided by Bruce there was no distracting noises. Bruce really does a great job in explaing about the islands agriculture and history. It really was an intimate feel with my wife and I being the only people on board. We were free to talk about personal experiences or even joke around with Bruce. I have already recommended this trip to two couples heading to Kauai this summer. This is a must do and I would definately fly with Bruce and Ellen again.  Mike and Pauline

review_title: Why would you want to take a helicopter???
review_text:
It appears that the key choice in chosing an air tour is to go by helicopter or by airplane.  The hotels always seem to recommend the helicopter tour, but why?  Could it be that they just recommend the most expensive option?  Take the airplane!  It's half the cost, and you see the same places.

Captain Bruce of Wings of Kauai has been flying for years, and his skill sets proved it to me.  As a commercial pilot myself, I notice things that most people don't.  I VALUE SAFETY ABOVE ALL ELSE.  Case in point.  There was another aircraft within sight that decided to fly up a canyon, one where the clouds were very low.  As I sat in the seat, I wondered if our captain was going to follow him.  My concern was that the clouds were too low to remain legally VFR (visual flight reference), a standard that tour planes must adhere to for safety sake because no IFR (Instrument Flight Rules) plan had been filed.  Flying into or too close to those clouds can spell trouble, after all, where are the sides of the canyon if you can't see them?  Draw your own conclusions.

Captain Bruce made a consciencous decision to take a different route, and we saw the same sights.  Later I asked him why he took that route, and he replied, "Safety comes first, and I did not want to risk my passengers".  There is a saying in aviation: There are old pilots and there are bold pilots, but there are no old, bold pilots.  I appreciated his decision and concern for safety rather than take a risk just we could see the same sight from a different perspective.

There are two rows of seats in the aircraft.  He only books the seats on the right hand side of the aircraft so everyone gets a window seat.  Great for visuals and great for photos.  Would you get that treatment in a crowded helicopter?  

We actually flew through a double rainbow that totally engulfed the aircraft.  I've never seen anything like it.  I totally encircled the aircraft.  It was above us, beside us and below us.  I've never experienced anything like it before.

In any case, I give Wings over Kauai a five star rating.  Great people.  Great trip.  Great memories. Great photos.

review_title: Best Photo’s and Video to share with friends and family, Mahalo!
review_text: You don’t need to be a private pilot to enjoy a Wings Over Kauai tour, but I am and it was wonderful.  My wife loves to take pictures and I wanted to get some left seat time so we booked a flight around Kauai with Bruce and Ellen.  The highlight of our trip, Bruce is a great CFI and Island guide, and Ellen presented us with a great video that we have shared with friends and family upon our return to Michigan.  Mahalo for a memorable adventure on Kauai.  Dave and Ruth, (03/26/2010)

After booking a helicopter flight through my NCL cruiseline which was cancelled on the day because of engine trouble,  

We were referred to Wings Over Kauai by a local tourist information service in Nawiliwili, Kauai.  The cost of the flight was half the price and the service was much more personal and the staff very friendly and professional.  

The views of the Waimea Canyon and coastline were breathtaking.  The flight took us to coastal areas the helicopters don't normally go to which were amazingly beautiful.  I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai ...you will not be disappointed!  Enjoy you flight!

review_title: Absolutely the best - Great service and views
review_text: We experienced an awesome flight with Wings Over Kauai, a small family business, on February 24, 2010.  Customer service provided by Bruce and Ellen is second to none.  Ellen does an outstanding job of handling all the arrangements prior to the flight.  Bruce is an excellent pilot, who made us feel very safe and comfortable during the tour.  His comprehensive knowledge of Kauai made this a very informative and interesting tour.  Bruce pointed out some whales and seeing them from the air was a whole another view of these magnificent creatures.   We took this tour early in our visit to Kauai and this was a good decision.  It gave an excellent aerial perspective of the island together with background information prior to visiting the various scenic sites by car.  Finally, we had taken a helicopter tour on Maui the previous year.  Wings Over Kauai was superior in all respects but it especially eliminated the crowding inside the helicopter.   The complimentary DVD received at the end of the tour is such a nice touch and contains wonderful photography.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai and the personable and friendly services.

review_title: Thanks for the great memories Bruce & Ellen!
review_text: What an awesome flight.  My wife, two kids and I spend a wonderful Sunday morning encircling the island of Kauai with probably one of the most knowledgeable and professional individuals on the island of Kauai.  A retired agronomist, Bruce the pilot provided us with information about the botany of the island that no one else could have.  I can see why people time and again have ranked the attraction as one of the number one activities to add to your itinerary while staying in Kauai.  Thanks for the free DVD, the family and I will remember this trip for a very long time while we are back in Wisconsin.  Dan, Julie, Kolton & Kiara Krolow.

I, like many people, went back and forth debating on whether to book a helicopter tour or a tour with Wings Over Kauai. I'm a big fan of personalized service and not having the feeling of being herded in and out (who does enjoy that??) by companies more interested in your dollar than the quality of service which they provide....so after reading lots of reviews on TA I went with Wings Over Kauai. I know Kauai runs on "island time" but communication with Ellen was always prompt, informative, and helpful. When we finally made it to our tour the weather was drizzling and, again, instead of taking off anyway we waited until the weather cleared so we would have ideal viewing conditions (FYI, during this time I watched numerous helicopters taking off). Bruce knew everything about the island and made everyone feel very safe during the flight. Sure, we did not get as close to some of the sights as the helicopters do but ohhhhh the sights you will see!!! I would not hesitate to recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone...their personalized service and fabulous flight make this tour worth every penny. Thank you guys so much!!! Keep up the great work :)

review_title: A wonderful experience on a beautiful island
review_text:
What a ride! Kauai has stunning scenery with lush green forests, dramatic dark cliffs, majectic red canyons and waterfalls everywhere. Most of the island is inaccessible by car, so to fully appreciate the landscape an aerial tour is the best way to enjoy the views. 

You may be tempted to take a helicopter tour, but an airplane provides a much smoother ride and on the brand new G8 Airvan you will have much more room than on any helicopter. Did I mention this tour costs half as much and has longer flying time? 

The ground staff provided us with very friendly and personal service, while pilot Bruce gave us a detailed briefing on the itinerary and a highly knowledgeable narration throughout the flight. 

Wings Over Kauai has been a highlight of our Hawaii journey!

review_title: Ten out of Ten for "Wings Ten"
review_text: We holidayed in Kauai last September and were undecided about a helicopter flight or plane flight to see the sights from the air. We opted for the plane flight given my partner and I could do a plane flight with just us two (and the pilot), thus being without a cabin full of strangers. It turned out to be an excellent choice!! From the second we arrived at the airport, Ellen greeted us and was fabulously friendly and helpful. Bruce, the pilot of "Wings Ten" was equally fabulous - Bruce was a knowledgeable and entertaining tour guide - pointing out all the Kauai sights from the air. It was an exceptionally enjoyable experience and definitely the highlight of our Hawaiian holiday. It was a bonus that it was also cheaper than a helicopter flight! I would without hesitation recommend Wings Over Kauai, and I urge you to consider them if you're thinking of a scenic flight over Kauai.

My flight with Wings Over Kauai was the first thing I did on Kauai, and what a great choice! Ellen and Bruce and all the other staff were sooo helpful! They stored our luggage, got us refreshments and even greeted us with fresh Hawaiian flowers and beaded leis. We were briefed on our flight and helped into the plane where there were refreshments and high-def headphones with speakers for all passengers (what a great idea! We heard everything during the flight). The pilot, Bruce, then took us around the island and pointed out landmarks of interest (including breaching humpback whales) and I have a ton of AMAZING pictures. Of all the activities during my trip to Hawaii, this was definitely at the top. The value for the money is unbelievable in relation to the treatment by the staff, the experience, the views, and even the picture CD we received after our flight (what a nice extra!). I will totally recommend this to anyone visiting Kauai--don't waste your time with these other charters when you can fly with Wings Over Kauai and get a true custom experience!

review_title: We felt safe and well take care of before, during, & after the flight.
review_text: My wife and I had the pleasure of taking a flight with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai on February 8, 2010.  That Monday was a gorgeous day with the sun shining and birds singing in the small terminal that Bruce and his staff were occupying.  Parking was easy and very close.  My wife saw Bruce's Cessna through the window and said this was a toy.  As Bruce and his staff introduced us to the plane, my wife relaxed and become more comfortable with the plane and Bruce put to rest any worries about whether this plane was flight worthy.  The Cessna took off without any strain and was smooth throughout the tour.  Bruce was excellent and knowledgable as to the narration while we flew and pointed out all the interesting sights along the way, especially the terrain, mountain ranges, vegetation, and ocean through our Bose Headphones which made communication a pleasure.  We took many pictures of this beautiful island by air during our flight and one of the Napali Coast Line is hanging on our bedroom wall, enlarged and beckoning us to return to this green and lush island.  Bruce made it all possible to see this pleasure island and one day we will return.  Wings Over Kauai is a first class operation and made our trip very personable as if it was Bruce's first trip.

We took a Cruise around Hawaii in October 09 and as an excursion on 30 October did a tour over Kauai with Wings Over Kauai.
I had been so impressed with the service I received before even stepping foot on the plane to come to Hawaii - months before we had had e-mail correspondence and received fast responses to every question and query.
On the morning of the flight, an employee was sent to pick us up from near where our Cruise ship was docked to take us to the airfield.  Ellen (and their cute dog!!) greeted us at the office, answered all our questions and even offered me some ginger root, remembering that I had told her before that i suffered from motion sickness.
As it turned out, I didn't need anything, as the flight was so smooth, and I was relaxed even more by the fact that Bruce told us we could open the window if either of us started to feel sick.
I can honestly say that we saw some of the most beautiful sights I have ever seen on that hour tour, and it was so useful to have Bruce's commentary so we actually knew what we were looking at!  
I would recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone visiting Kauai, even if just there for a couple of days (as we were!) - there was absolutely nothing that could have been improved!

The highlight of our trip to Kauai was the personal touch both on the ground by Ellen and in the air with Bruce.
 
The review of Safety items, the care with which the clients were boarded and the instructions both on the ground and in the air were well done.
We were made to feel special and every effort was being made to ensure that all the bases were covered and still enjoy the flight and the spectacular scenery.
 
I understand that there have been some complaints by home owners of aircraft overflights. Our flight was high and an effort was made to be unobtrusive. Perhaps if I owned a condo or home, I would find the noise of aircraft intrusive at times, but there is a place for organized aerial touring, done in a safe and efficient manner with consideration for the home owner.
We could not have seen or discovered in a week on the ground, all of the wonderful terrain features or animal life that we were were able to see in a one hour flight with personal narration and response to questions by Bruce.
 
Whether to go by airplane or helicopter was a difficult choice. I am a helicopter pilot with more than 19000 hours of helicopter flight time. I know the capabilities of the helicopter and they are awesome.
We chose to go by airplane because we wanted to have a less expensive choice. This was at the end of a 19 day vacation at the end of my second retirement. With the zoom capability of my movie camera, getting up close and personal was not a requirement. 
The airplane met or exceeded all of our requirements.
 
Our visit for my wife and I, to Kauai was wonderful.
Thank you Bruce and Ellen Coulombe.   
 
Bob and Sandy

Three of us took their 70 minute flight tour at the end of January and it was a great time.  I've taken small plane tours in other parts of the world and a helicopter tour on Maui and this flight was probably the best of them all.

We had perfect weather that day and had a turbulence-free flight with great view of the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, and the Waialeale Crater.

review_title: Great way to see the Garden Island from the air.
review_text: As a private pilot myself, I know a good pilot when I see them in action.  Wings Over Kauai is a small family run business where they love to show visitors a safe, smooth journey around the island.  Much less expensive than a helicopter flight, with very personal service and attention to every detail.  The pilot is not only good at what he loves doing most, flying airplanes, but is very knowledgeable about the island's history, both ancient and modern, and true expert in the island's diverse flora and fauna.  My wife always wants me to fly slow and steady turns, which is exactly the kind of turns she got during our flight with Wings; in other words, great for anyone worried about motion sickness.

My husband and I took 70 min Grand Delux tour last week.
Bruce was knowlegeable, and gave us good commentary (especially agricultural aspects).  The day we took the flight was clear day, so we could see beautiful views of Kauai.  We definitely recommend this tour.

This was a fantastic way to see Kauai. Bruce is a friendly and helpful pilot who really knows the island. We loved seeing all the places that can only be viewed by air, such as the canyons, tree covered peaks and waterfalls. The coastline is gorgeous on land, but even more beautiful from the air. The sunlight on NaPali was perfect for photos. We loved every minute of it. 
     Our daughter arranged this trip for us as a gift knowing we were coming here. She dealt with Ellen, both online and by telephone and said she was super friendly and helpful.
     We highly recommend this flight to anyone visiting the island.
Absolutely fantastic!  We've been to Kauai 3 times, done lots of activities, but our flight with Bruce was the best.  Don't miss it!

review_title: Great way to end our Kauai Vacation!!
review_text:
My wife and I would like to thank Bruce and Ellen for their great hospitality and service before, during and after our flight.  They were very accomodating to help us find the right time to tour the island.  The tour itself was magnificent with Bruce's superior knowledge of the details of the island right down to the names of each plant.  Awesome way to end our vacation to Kauai and meet some great people.  Thanks Ellen and Bruce!  

If you are looking for a great experience on Kauai, do this tour!

On the final day of our wonderful stay at 4 different islands (Oahu, Big Island, Maui and Kauai) we had a great flight with Bruce and Ellen's Wings over Kauai. We had great comfortable seats in the airplane with wonderful sights of Kauai. It was windy that day but Bruce made a nice and smooth flight. Bruce also explained a lot of the sights we were seeing. He was very knowledgeable about all kinds of things (history, agriculture, nature etc.). As a bonus we got a short video with airial shots from the island.
If we come back to Kauai we are certainly going for a rerun of our flight.
We can advise everybody to fly Wings over Kauai.
Dick and Gerda van Dam

review_title: 90% the helicopter experience, and 50% the price.
review_text: I'm a private pilot with some 1300 hours in a Cessna 172 and with a perhaps silly desire to log a landing in all 50 states. (I'm up to 37 as of yesterday.) Having already experienced a helicopter tour of Na Pali and Waimea Canyon, and having also (two years ago) kayaked Na Pali, all I really wanted was to fly once or twice around the airport and get a landing or two. That said, I decided instead to hire Bruce to give me one-hour flight training as I flew from the left seat as he guided me and my wife (in back seat) on their usual one hour tour. I'm so glad I did! Not only is Bruce a great narrator and knowledgable, but he is a confidence inspiring instructor, a smooth pilot, and the view from the Skyhawk, while not quite as up-close as what you'd get in a helicopter, is outstanding. Highly recommended. And the Bose noise-cancelling headsets work great, almost as well as my Zulu's.  :)

review_title: An excellent way to begin our Kauai vacation
review_text:
My wife and I booked Wings Over Kauai for our first day of vacation, January 10th. It was the best decision we made. Bruce, Ellen and the staff were tremendous and the flight was awe inspiring. Bruce's information on the island and its history during the flight was very informative and helped us with what we wanted to see and where to go as this was our first trip to Kauai. We would highly recommend booking a flight with Wings Over Kauai and we will do it again when we return.

OnVacation Blaine Minnesota

What a great experience – from the first call to schedule – to walking away from the airport after the flight. Bruce and Ellen were fantastic. I would truly recommend this aerial tour to everyone. What a great value and the personalized tour over Kauai could not have been better. We will do this again the next time we are in Kauai. Bruce is a great pilot and knows so much info about the island. You’ll be happy you did this tour and you will not be disappointed. Annette and Royce

My wife and I were in Kauai for her 30th birthday and went on the fun and scenic aerial tour of the island with pilot Bruce. It was such a memorable and happy experience from the beginning when I called and spoke directly with Ellen (Bruce's wife) to make our reservation.  She was very accommodating and even gave us additional advice on places to check out on the island based on our personal interests (beach, water, etc.).  Carter, their son, was really nice, friendly, and personable when we met him as he checked us in at the terminal and while we waited for Bruce to come back with the previous flight.  The weather on Monday was not the greatest, but Bruce did the best he could (with our ultimate safety in mind) to show us around so that we could see the waterfalls we had hoped to (and we did see them!).  I could keep going on on how wonderful "Wings Over Kauai" is, but then I'd just be rambling on about what everyone else has already said.  You'll have an excellent experience and won't be disappointed (plus, it's safer than a helicopter)!
The flight was just perfect. Bruce did a really good job. He knows a lot about the island and its flora and fauna. It was the most interesting and terrific part of our trip to Kaua'i.

review_title: Best Value on the Island by far
review_text:
We were pricing helicopters and it was a little much for us.  So for the half price and twice the time as a helicopter we got a flight with Bruce.  They don't have a single safety incident on record and there has been a major helicopter crash each of the last 5 years.  

Also, every seat has a view in the plane.  Bruce was very charming and also accomodated us when we wanted to fly by the lighthouse.  The Grand Tour is definitely worth the money.  

Highly Recommended!

review_title: You MUST do this flight if you have a change when in Kauai
review_text: Called on a whim, and so glad I did.  Bruce and Ellen are wonderfully nice people; no big sales pitch (they were ready to call in advance to report whether clouds would make it not worthwhile; luckily that didn't happen); and Bruce is knowledgeable about the island in an intimate way that is really charming.  The flight was spectacular!  Can't imagine any more exciting way to see the Island.  The little plane is not as noisy as a helicopter, and definitely not scary.  Views were incredible.  We saw whales, waterfalls, rainbows, and incredible coastline.  I agree with another reviewer that I wish i had time to do it again.  The couple's attention to detail and great service is a bonus but the flight is just absolutely tremendous.  Do it!

review_title: If I could only take one flight tour, this would be IT
review_text:
I have never been a fan of flying but this was the best light airplane flight that I have taken. Captain Bruce and Tor are very knowlegeable about the island and where to see the great views of this beautiful island. He knew that I was nervous sitting in the co pilot seat and saw to it that it was an easy flight. I have gone on a helicoptor tour before and going by plane is a lot nicer. Capt. Bruce makes it especially interesting by explaining a lot of different aspects of the island especially with his knowledge of biology and geology. What was especially cool was the DVD presented to us at the end of our tour with our picture. We only had one day on Kauai and the Capt gave us some really neat hip tips on where to go and what to do with our limited time......and he was right on the money. Seeing some of the places by car right after flying over them put a lot of things in perspective. If and when we go again we will be taking this flight again and hopefully spending a little more time on this beautiful laid back island. Thanks again Bruce and Tor.
Some friends in Louisiana.

After reading the reviews on trip advisor, we chose to go on a tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Everything promised from all the previous reviews proved true.  Excellent friendly service, personalized tour, comforting pilot, and amazing views of the island for a much better price then most tours.  I would actually pay higher than the going rate for this tour of the island because of Bruce (the pilot) being so knowledgable about the island.  It was fun being part of the pre-flight preparations as we went through the flight checklist and learned a bit about planes and airports.  Bruce was handed a tough deck with one of his passengers having a tendency for motion sickness and the other a  fear of flying.  He calmed us both and provided useful advice in avoiding motion sickness- we both enjoyed the flight with no problems at all.  We got amazing weather for our flight and it went by too fast.  The helicopters do get much lower than the plane, but as Bruce said, "If the engine fails in a plane, we can glide."  Not true for helicopters.  The higher altitude of the plane still provided for stunning views of beautiful Kauai.  I highly recommend this experience for anyone considering a tour of the islands.

We were orignally supposed to do a tour on Christmas Eve. Bruce came back from the flight before ours and said that the Napali Coast was covered by clouds.  He gave us the option to reschedule which we did for a flight a few days later.  The rescheduled flight was super! The weather was excellent and the commentary about the island was excellent. WE got some great photos!  It is a BEAUTIFUL island and Bruce & Ellen are really nice people.  You felt like you were with friends you had known for years. I highly recommend there flight!

We cannot say enough good things about this tour and this company! We booked a trip with Ellen and she was so friendly and helpful. The weather on the day of our flight was a little iffy so they rescheduled us at another time with no problem. They were so accommodating and it showed how much they appreciate their customers. The aerial tour itself was unbelievable. The island is so beautiful and this was an awesome way to spend our anniversary. Bruce was such a nice guy and he was fun to spend time with during our flight. This is an anniversary we will never forget all thanks to Wings Over Kauai. No one should miss this adventure on a trip to Kauai!

The other reviewers have said it all but I am still compelled: You will like Bruce and Ellen (and their family) and entirely trust Bruce's professionalism. They will treat you well. Bruce will keep up the interesting observations even if you don't comment, and is well versed in any subject matter you might bring up. We've done helicopter tours on two other islands and I prefered this by far. The viewing was just as good, and comfort just as high (with the Bose noise cancellation headphones.) The only thing I noticed was that the helicopters would take you down into a coastal canyon, but having seen these from the ocean and the ridges, the (intrusive) flight in would have added nothing. 

(And the reviewer who just mentioned the tip was right. The Coulombes are without any hucksterism that the tourist industry thrives on. You could tell that Bruce really, really, tried to make an effort by way of a joke, but at the same time the concept was plainly abhorrent to him - it made me smile to myself. In fact I felt strange giving a "tip" to a consummate professional so I snuck it in to Ellen later. Remember - they really treat you right at a great value.)

I called Wings Over Kauai to book a flight for my birthday, and I cannot say enough great things about this company.  I spoke with Ellen on the phone a couple of times and she was so sweet and helpful in booking our flight.  When we arrived, we were greeted by the pilot, Bruce, who wished me a happy birthday, chatted with us a bit, collected our payment, went through a short information and safety briefing, and then took us up on the flight of a lifetime!  

Capt. Bruce’s commentary during the flight, including information on the native vegetation and interesting facts about the amazing sights of Kauai (some which are only viewable by air) was fascinating!  We were able to open the window at times to get some great pictures without window glare (although, the windows were very clean and we didn’t use flash, so it really didn’t impair our photography anyway.)  But it was cool.  I can’t recommend this company highly enough!  Do it!

review_title: Wicked views and an excellent time
review_text:
Went for the deluxe tour with my wife in Dec 2009. What a great way to see the island. Bruce (pilot) really knows the place and explains everything you see and anything and everything I had questions about. Way better than listening to the canned narration on the heli tours (as our firneds have done). We really felt like part of the flying process (even though my wife had the co-plot seat and got to help Bruce out).
There were some clouds around the higher mountains, but really had no impact on our flight as we still had amazing views of the entire island (including the Napali coast and all the waterfalls throughout the island.). 
The entire process was great, from my wife chatting with Bruce's wife on the phone to hanging out before at the terminal, its a small operation and they really seem to care.

We decided to take this flight whilst calling at the island on a Princess Cruises tour of the Hawaian Islands. Whilst considering our shore excursions before leaving England we knew that we wanted to see Kauai from the air, but should we choose a Helicopter or a Plane? Princess wanted US$269 each for a 55 minute shared helicopter flight including ground transport; WoK charged us US$249 FOR THE TWO OF US  including 'trimmings' (see below) with exclusive use of the plane and ground transport. They also confirmed that if, for some reason, the ship could not dock we would not be charged. Always one for a bargain, I booked - but was it any good?

It was arranged that Ellen would meet us at a shopping centre close to the ship at 10.30am for our 11.00am flight for a private car transfer to the airport - but she was late!! I have never known anyone so apologetic about being 3 minutes late (try waiting for a local train in the UK Ellen, they don't even call it late in their performance statistics unless it is 5 minutes late and they don't even apologise if it is 13 minutes late). 

After our transfer to the airport during which Ellen told us all about Bruce and her backgrounds we carried out the paperwork (and weighing!) with Ellen whilst Bruce prepared the plane. My wife was presented with a flower for her hair and a nut lei to wear and we proceeded to the plane, having our photo taken alongside it.

My wife, having a slightly more petite build than me (!), was chosen as being the best person for the front seat with me having room to spread out in the back. She helped Bruce with his pre-flight checks and we were then away. The in-flight refreshments were not used by us - we were too interested in the scenery. 

We had been warned to wear a dark top (to prevent reflections in the windows) and as a result of this I did not need to open windows to take my numerous photographs.  

Was it a good decision to take a plane rather than a helicopter? As the saying goes 'you pays your money, you takes your choice'. Of necessity, the place operates at a higher level than the helicopter and cannot go deep into the valleys; however, for a lot of our flight I could see a helicopter operating beneath us. It appeared very close to the ground and I cannot believe that it could have provided as good a photo as some of those taken by me on my rather basic camera. Ours was also very much a personalised trip whereas a helicopter would have been shared, following a pre-determined route. 

We were able to fly over our ship to take pictures from the air and also more unusual sights such as the massive Costco and Car Park from the air.

As we returned to the airport it was an interesting experience to land on one runway at the same time as a 'proper' passenger plane was landing on the main runway. Like others, we were presented with a DVD with our own pictures on the front.

We were intending going on afterwards to the Kilohana Plantation which we thought was close-by but was actually a fair distance away. Ellen offered to take us as she was heading in that direction. She needn't have done this, however, it was typical of Ellen and Bruce. Their main concern was to ensure that we had a great day, which we did. 

If you book with WoK you will not be sorry. Enjoy the experience; we certainly did.

Highlight of my trip--Just beautiful, Bruce and Ellen are great and the flight was personal and so awesome. They are so nice. Kauai is an island where you must see it by air, and the helicoptors are overpriced and dangerous. Plus you will have to share with others. Remember to tip them to it did.t occur to me at first A++++++!

I'd been hoping to rent a single engine airplane during our recent trip to Kauai.  I'm a private pilot, and my wonderful wife was looking for a way to see the island while allowing me to indulge my flying passion.  We found Ellen and Captain Bruce searching on line, and are glad we did.  I logged the flight time as "pilot in command" with Bruce in the co-pilot seat, and my wife-family photographer  in the back seat.  

Bruce and Ellen's late model Cessna 172S is spacious and clean.  What I appreciated most was how stable the aircraft flys around the beautiful mountain palis.  And with it's high wing configuration, you get to see everything around and below you.  My wife took over 100 photos during our 70 minute adventure.  

After circling the island and flying over Wiama Canyon, we contacted the Lihue tower for a clearance to land.    The entire experience was excellent, providing an up close  view of areas otherwise inaccessible.   As a private pilot, it was a real thrill for me to land the aircraft on the same island runway that the large commercial jets, including the one we had flown in used.  Whether you're a pilot, or  you let Captain Bruce do all the flying for you, I'd recommend Wings Over Hawaii...for anyone wanting a safe, slow ride around the Garden Isle!

review_title: Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people.  So ... DO IT!
review_text:
This was our third trip to Hawaii, and second to Kauai. Last time here we took the helicopter tour & thought it was great. This time we decided to fly again, but wanted a better opportunity for photography. We reviewed all the brochures, but Wings Over Kauai was the only one that offered open-window capabilities. We're also very environmentally sensitive about any place we go (yes, we pick up other people's trash), and liked the idea that the plane used so much less fuel than a chopper. That settled it!  Pilot Bruce and his wife Ellen welcomed us warmly with a Plumeria flower for my hair and a Kukui nut lei. There was a cooler in the back with water and soda at no charge. My husband is the photographer in the family, so I opted for the back seat, although photo ops from that viewpoint were also possible through the open window. The Bose noise-cancelling headphones were fantastic, and we were able to talk to the pilot while in flight, asking questions all along the way. Bruce is so knowledgeable about the landscapes we were viewing, offering history, geography, geology, and agricultural tidbits that were both educational and entertaining. There was no problem with him turning the plane for certain photos, and we were lucky enough to get shots of Mt. Waialeale when it was not covered in clouds. At 5,148 feet, this mountain is the wettest spot on the planet, averaging rainfall of 460 inches per year. Waimea Canyon and the NaPali Coast were indescribably beautiful from a bird's-eye view.  Because the plane held only 4 persons (including pilot), my husband and I felt like it was our own private tour. It's windy and chilly, though, in the back seat once that window is opened, so be prepared by bringing a scarf for your head and a sweatshirt or jacket (we flew in December). The cost was very reasonable for the one-hour flight ~ and if we have one suggestion, it's that Bruce and Ellen should offer a longer tour. Before we took off, Ellen took our picture by the plane and surprised us when we landed with with a video disc with us on the cover. The video was produced by their son, Carter.  So it's truly a family business, and we were happy to support such a venture
.
Great day. Great weather. Great pictures. Great people.  So ... DO IT!   You won't be disappointed!

review_title: A time to plan the rest of your vacation!!
review_text:
I recommend this be your first stop when you hit the beautiful island of Kauai; Not only was it informative about the landscape of the island, but a great way to plan on where we would like to visit next and whats a waste of time.
My dad(44), sister(7), and I(16) took this tour of Kauai and just loved it.
The pilot was kind and made sure each person was comfortable and collected on what was a very bumpy ride for the day.(hard wind)
He had a lot to say and cracked a joke here and there.
There cooler was a very nice touch in case we got thirsty, I wouldn't recommend the Diets to be on the plane though, there worst for you then the regular soda is.
I got sick the entire flight but didn't say anything till I just couldn't take it anymore; I was about to blow!!!
The pilot sprung into action with his trust cold yellow towel he told me what to do and when to do it, before I knew it I was feeling better and back to enjoying the ride.

His cunning smarts about being a pilot led him to talk a few people out of flying for that day but not us, so if it seems he is trying to talk you out of flying, consider it first, then choose if you want a bumpy ride or a smooth sailor.

Thank you for the trip guys and hope you have a great holiday

-Arthur Patterson
Paso Robles High School Debate Coach
San Luis Obispo County Virtual Enterprise CEO

review_title: Breathtaking Flight over Kauai at Half the Price of a Helicopter
review_text: Bruce and Ellen do everything to make this a great experience from the welcome Kakui nut lei to the "in-flight service" cooler to the free video after the flight.  Bruce even put my flying nerves at ease by having me "help" him with his pre-flight checklist.  The flight was just over an hour for only $100.00 per person and was amazing!  We saw the canyon, the Napali coast and the waterfalls but Bruce did an excellent job of explaining the agriculture of the island, too.  What a wonderful way to get a bird's eye view of the entire island!  Loved the sound eliminating headphones which allowed us to communicate with Bruce and each other throughout the flight.

review_title: 1/2 the price...twice the flight of a helicopter!
review_text:
A most professional yet friendly operation!  felt totally at ease and loved every minute of our flight.....from Ellen's check in to Bruce's knowledgeable and excellent commentary... in flight water and sodas offered... we received a DVD of the trip with our picture not only on the cover ..but they also e-mailed the photo to us...  we took all the photos and movies we could accommodate in our 70 min flight... Bruce takes 2 (max of 3) passengers a flight .... had an answer for our every question.. 
High point of our Hawaiian trip!  be sure and do it if U R on Kau'ai  !!!
tell them Greg and Gemma sent U!
[--]

My husband and I totally agree with the other positive ratings that are given to Bruce with his Wings  over Kauai.  We had to deal with rain, clouds and WIND - but Bruce still was able to pull off an incredible flight for us, flying around clouds to give us the best views.  The wind was blowing us around a bit, and it was very comforting to know that Bruce was at the wheel.  He provided a very safe trip and was very concerned how we were feeling, quick to see to our comfort and to calm any fears.  We'll only fly with him when we are in Kauai!  Thank you Bruce.

We just recently flew with Wings over Kauai on the 9th of November '09.  We had such a great time and were treated very, very well!  Bruce is also a flight instructor and allowed my friend who has logged many, many hours as a pilot, fly the plane with Bruce as co-pilot!  My friend was so thrilled and we all loved the experience!!  I was able to take some great photos too, and you cannot beat the price.  They also have an excellent website and are very responsive to email - what more could you want?

review_title: It was an awesome tour and more than we expected!
review_text: The tour covered the main areas of the island.  The pilot was experienced and provided an excellent description of the sights.  The visibility from the aircraft was good and we took many pictures through the windows.  The aircraft was small but ideal for the two of us as we received a personal flight tour at less cost than many of the others.

review_title: Beauty of Kauai in the air !!
review_text: Just got back from an amazing trip ... Wings Over Kauai is our favorite adventure on the island.  We didn't have the opprotunity to meet Ellen but I am sure if she is as wonderful as Bruce we would feel as though she was part of our family from the start.   Bruce was great, explaining everything he was doing so we would understand.  The flight was smooth and the Beauty of God's work came alive in the air as we flew over several waterfalls, valleys and peaks of Kauai.   Thank you Bruce - we will tell everyone about you and Wings Over Kauai!!

Just want to complement Ellen and Bruce and staff for a wonderful experience.  Had a great flight and very knowledgeable and pertinent commentary from Bruce during the flight that brought out aspects of the Island that one would not read about.  They were able to rearrange some other customers schedules to be able to accommodate me as I only had Saturday Morning to fly (was on the Norwegian Cruise Lines , Pride of America which was leaving that afternoon) after poor weather cancelled our scheduled Friday Afternoon flight.  Can't thank them enough for that, otherwise I might not have been able to fly in Hawaii at all.

I might also mention that the noise level was very low as they have Top-End BOSE Noise cancelling headsets.  Not sure if a helicopter ride would be this quiet.
Thanks Again and if I ever return will be knocking on your door again..

Cheers

review_title: View paradise with professional yet personal guide
review_text: Visiting the Hawaiian Islands for the first time, my wife and I could not have made a better choice than with Wings Over Kauai to start off our visit. From the start with Ellen's personal touch through the flight with Captains Bruce at ease however skilled and knowledgeable presentation of Kauai's history, changes and landscape made the trip more than enjoyable, (the scenery alone was breathtaking) it was educational. To the end where we had to say good by, Wings Over Kauai was more than worth the price it was priceless for the both of us. If you enjoy smiling from start to finish along with an informative adventure, We highly recommend booking your aerial sight seeing tour with Wings Over Kauai. Oh, by the way, do not forget to bring your camera.

We were happy to take the advice from previous reviewers to take the one hour 'Pali Mist' flight with Bruce.  It was a great choice.  The two of us had a personalised  tour, which included pre-flight time with Ellen.  Definitely a highlight.    Karen, NZ

review_title: Make time for a flight tour with Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: My new husband and I were "honeymooning" on Kauai, and some of my co-workers did some research and found Wings Over Kauai.  They got us the Deluxe Flight Tour, and it ended up being one of our most favorite things we did our entire time in Hawaii (between both Kauai and the Big Island).  Bruce and Ellen were so easy to work with.  Ellen was accessible when we had questions before arriving, and Bruce is extraordinarily knowledgeable about everything you get to encounter along the way.  He has the ability to make you experience the beautiful island of Kauai in a way that most people will never be able to.  Not only to you get to see first hand what makes Kauai different from any of the other islands, you get to do so in a safe, comfortable environment.  Bruce and Ellen rise above any of the helicopter tours you can do...literally you are looking down on the helicopters that are a dime a dozen.  This type of tour is special and Wings Over Kauai recognizes that by making their tours different from any others.  How do they do this...you have to book your own flight tour to find out yourself!

review_title: You won't know Kauai until you fly with Bruce.
review_text: This is a fabulous way to see the entire island.  You are treated as family by Ellen and Bruce, and they do everything possible to make the flight an unforgettable experience.  The scenery is inconceivably beautiful and Bruce offers historical information as you fly.  This is a unique experience we plan to repeat the next time we are in Kauai.  Bring your best camera.

We were on vacation in September and decided to take a plane ride with Wings Over Kauai.  Ellen and Bruce were wonderful.  So much information about the island and the great views we were getting.  They both made us feel comfortable about the flight, and gave us tips on what to look for and take pictures of.  

We definately recommend them as something you must do while on the island.

Thanks again for a great experience.

review_title: Wings over Kauai, better than the helicopter ride!
review_text:
We had taken helicopter tours of other islands and found the airplane ride to be more scenic and pleasant.   The service provided by Bruce and Gy is outstanding and personalized.  The flight provides a slow and personalized tour of the island and the price is better than helicopter tours.

I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai as a great way to get a birds eye view of this beautiful island.

review_title: A total must do while in Kauai
review_text: After spending a lot of time researching the islands' various airplane and helicopter flights, we chose Wings over Kauai because it seemed like it was going to be a more personalized experience than the other options. (It was cheaper to be on our own flight-2 people plus pilot- than the other places were charging for groups of 6 people to fly).  For less than $150 a person, we got an hour flight, personalized tour and a husband and wife team willing to make your experience as enjoyable as possible- they even offered an ice chest with drinks for the trip, a lei, and what looks like a dvd with our picture on the cover (we havent had a chance to look at it yet). We were able to see all of Kauai's breathtaking views (and get the most beautiful pics) while the pilot/ tour guide, Bruce, answered all of our questions and offered interesting facts about the island's history.  This experience was more than we expected from beginning to end.  Bruce and Ellen were awesome hosts and very fun people.  We will most definately do this again the next time we are on the island.  Many of Kaui's tourist activities are over-rated and over-priced but this was not the case here and it was worth every penny!  Definately the highlight of our trip and we are still talking about it!!  Thanks again Bruce and Ellen- You Rock!!

review_title: Excellent experience, excellent value, wonderful people!
review_text:
I recently took my wife to Kauai for her 30th birthday, and read from reviews on this site that it would be a good idea to schedule a flight around the island early in the trip to get oriented with the island. Choices were helicopter or private plane. I saw a number of reviews stating their satisfaction with both, but noticed a definite lean towards Wings over Kauai for anyone looking for a personal touch. Well laid back friendly folks are part of our vision of Hawaii, and so we took the Wings Over Kauai plane tour with Bruce. 
We had a fabulous time. The plane was nice, comfortable and safe, the awesome headphones made noise a non-issue, everyone involved was very nice and welcoming. Then there was Bruce, who is the reason we will be doing this flight again in the future. He was the perfect tour pilot. Great sense of humor, respectful but not stuffy, knew EVERYTHING about the island, great pilot, basically everything you want in a tour pilot. 
I am sure you could be happy taking the helicopter tour, but our bottom line is that when we return to Hawaii, even though we have only done the Wings Over Kauai tour, that is the only aerial tour company we will fly with in the future. We have no reason to believe anyone else can beat the experience we had with Bruce.

Two of us took the tour on Oct 8 while our wives shopped.  I am sure that we had more fun with Wings Over Kauai than they had at WalMart and Hilo Hattie.

Originally, we had booked with a third party vendor and they apparently had a schedule conflict, so we were jettisoned to Wings Over Kauai.
From the moment we checked in to final landing, the husband and wife party of Ellen and Bruce were A OK . 

The weather was good and our pilot and guide (Bruce) was capable, informative and entertaining.  Never a momet of anticipation or fear during the flight.  We did see everything except the northeast corner of the island (that left out Kilauea, a couple of beaches and the condo where we stayed that can all be seen from land).   However it did leave plenty of time for miles of inaccesible rugged coastline, falls and great sights.

The position of the sun plays a major factor in viewing most of the Kauai sights.  We had an a.m. tour and I would bet we could take a p.m. tour next time and see the same things and it would appear completely different.  

The combination of the air team and a breathtaking scenic flight makes it evident why the ratings for this tour are so high.  If I could open a resturant on Kauai and be rated so high I would pack my bags tomorrow .

Our flight (10/7/09) with Wings Over Kauai was the highlight of our trip to Kauai.  What an experience!!  We took the longest flight (70 minutes) and it was breathtaking.  The views, the personal attention from Captain Bruce, and every aspect of the flight from takeoff to touch down were absolutely superb.  
Forget the helicopters...fly with "Wings"

We had an AMAZING time with our flight! Bruce was a wonderful guide! He was patient with those on our group that were scared/sick from the flight (nothing to do with his flying, all our personal issues) and the scenery was just breathtaking!! 

We went on our last day of our 7 day vacation there. We had seen most of the island at this point, but after the flight it was like was like we hadn't seen anything before the flight. It just totally changed my opinion about this beautiful paradise! I was able to get some amazing pictures that I can now enjoy until we are able to make it back there!! 

Definitely a MUST when visiting this island! :)

Our recent trip( Sept 24-Oct3) to Hawaii was highlighted  by a flight with Bruce of  Wings over Kauai.  He was both professional and knowledge in his dealings with us.  As a pilot myself, I felt very secure with Bruce.  Skip the shaking and noise of the helicopters, and enjoy  the flight with Wings over Kauai, its alot less in price.

review_title: If you only do one tour - This is it
review_text:
We booked online. Ellen emailed back a confirm within 24hrs (actually more like 2).  Tor from Wings picked us up right outside the cruise terminal and took us to the airport. He gave us so much info on what it is like to live in Hawaii in just the few short minutes of the drive to the airport.  Really a tour within a tour!   We signed our life away, stepped on the scale - really a formality.  Bruce arrived with the last couple he took up, and they were beaming.  Tor got us into the plane.  Let me tell you, if you have any mobility problems, or if you are a large person, you will be just fine.  The plane was easy to get into and we were well taken care of.   Probably due to decades as a pilot, Bruce's natural confidence set us at ease right away.  He told us what to expect as far as the way the plane moves ahead of time. 

It was neat feeling like part of the flight crew.  We were able to listen in on the chatter with the tower.  And although I did not expect it, both my husband and I felt afterward that there was something really special about taking our tour in an airplane.  It's an extra feeling to the tour that is hard to explain, but you will understand it once you go up.  Most of our pictures have a bit of the window or the wing in there. And for us, that is just so perfect.  We have a remembrance of the phenomenal beauty of Kauai and a reminder of that incredible nostalgic and peaceful feeling of slowly flying over pristine beauty. 

Bruce was great at pointing things out - an interactive tour. Really more like a personal conversation between Bruce who knows the Island, it's history, it's ecology and people -  and the people lucky enough to get a seat on his plane.  We just can't say enough about that - this is a personal tour. Not a prepackaged production.  This is one of the few things I'd gladly spend money on again if we are lucky enough to see Hawaii again.

Everything from the start of email inquiries about the flight, to the finish chatting after the flight is on a very personal level. No being herded through like cattle with these folks.  WOK is a small operation. Bruce is the owner/pilot, Ellen his wife takes care of reservations and they have Trey? a high school kid who helps out.
The flight was thrilling, entertaining, educational and gorgeous! My first time in a single engine plane – I think I’m addicted now.  The plane seats 4 including the pilot. I was up front, so many of my photos have the wing strut in them. It is not distracting from the view however.  Kauai is an amazing place from the ground, but from the air – WOW!  So much of the island is still undeveloped. 

Try to do this tour in your first few days on the island.  You never know how the weather will be, so you may need to be re-scheduled.  You don't want to miss this.
Highly recommend!!  We took the Grand Deluxe tour on 9/17/09 at 9:30 am - perfect weather.
Link to my photos:
picasaweb.google.com/3ChihuahuasMama/WOK#

We almost never take a chosen itinerary path on world travel "things to do" and "must see events". We usually wing it, and finding Wings Over Kauai was another notch in our belts in this department. This 70 minute flight adventure on board a Cessna 172 was incredible. Captain Bruce was personel and the sights of Kauai were beautiful and awesome. We considered the cost very reasonable. This flight truely made our trip complete - buzzing around in his aircraft and witnessing all of the islands wonderful sights.

Bruce and Ellen run a very professional business, Wings Over Kauai. We were greeted like old friends when we arrived for our tour and felt the same as we left.  Bruce, our pilot, is so knowledgable about the island and such a fantastic pilot, that we felt comfortable throughout the whole tour. At the end of the flight, Ellen presented us with a DVD showing the island from the air... and it had our picture on the cover....such a nice ending to a great tour!  A+ all the way:)

My wife and I were lucky to find this unforgettable venue as we were searching for things to do in Kauai last May.  Both Bruce and Ellen were very friendly.  The flight was smooth, the views were super from the well equipped Cessna C-172.  Bruce was full of information and he made everyone in his plane very comfortable.  We would never forget about this flight.  We would recommend W.O.K.T. to anyone who wants to see Kauai from the air.

One advice:  Be sure to arrive 30 minutes before the scheduled flight.

After reading many reviews and doing research on helicopters v. plane rides over Kauai, I was convinced that Wings Over Kauai was the best option from a cost and overall experience perspective, and I was right!  Bruce and Ellen make you feel comfortable right away and welcome you with a kikui necklace and fresh flower which is a nice touch :)  The flight itself was amazingly beautiful and Bruce was incredibly knowledgeable on the vegetation, history, and other interesting, fun facts about the Island.  I wasn't sure how my pictures would turn out but was pleasantly surprised as some of my best pictures of the trip came from our flight around the Na Pali Coast, the waterfalls, and Waimea Canyon.  I would absolutely recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone visiting the Island!

Ellen and Bruce run and outstanding tour operation, which is very affordable.  Customer service is excellent.  As I am an experienced and professionally trained pilot, I immediately noticed Bruce promotes saftey as of paramount importance and is an excellent commerciall pilot, all customers are in good hands. His knowledge of the island and convenyence on the tour is very good; as he has lived and flown on the island for many years.  The flight was excellent, the entire beautiful garden island was seen in about an hour. Bruce knows the island and the flying conditions like the back of his had, making the tour flight superb.

I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai without reservation, as the best overall air tour operation on the island.

review_title: The BEST way to shoot aerial photos of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I went back to Kauai this summer and flew Wings Over Kauai for the second time.  I am an avid landscape photographer, and an airplane provides a better platform than a helicopter for shooting sharp aerial landscape photos due to the vibration of a helicopter.   Wings Over Kauai is a top-notch operation.  Scheduling a flight is easy - just call and choose a time.  We chose a custom tour where you tell Bruce where you want to go, and that's where he flies.  We spent most of our time over the Na Pali coast.  Bruce flew back and forth at our direction, circled the coast 3 times, and even tipped the wings of the airplane when we signaled so we could be sure that the wings would not show up in our photos.  We had absolutely beautiful lighting the day we flew, and I snapped over 400 photos in 1.5 hours.  Overall, our Wings Over Kauai tour was the highlight of our trip.

After reading the review about Bruce and Ellen, I decided to book the deluxe tour during my recent trip to Kauai. On my previous trip, I booked a helicopter ride that was great albeit a bit impersonal, and was going to do the same this trip until I read about Wings Over Kauai!  What a trip!! I actually decided to make the ride an instructional one and was able to actually fly the plane!!! What a thrill.  Bruce shared his incredible base of knowledge about the island, agriculture, you name it. I think my IQ went up a few points during the ride! What an expected gift that Bruce shared his passion so freely.

Bruce loves what he does, loves to fly, loves the land, and loves to share his passion with others and all that comes through. I will remember this trip for the rest of my life, and as soon as I get back to Kauai, I will be booking again - for 2hrs this time!!

When I think of Bruce, I think of this quote by Howard Thurman

“Don’t ask what the world needs. Ask what makes you come alive, and go do it. Because what the world needs is people who have come alive.”

Mahalo and much aloha Bruce and Ellen.

We highly recommend the very personable experience we had with Wings Over Kauai.
Bruce and Ellen were very accomodating to us - allowing us to change flight day and time.  
Captain Bruce is a wealth of knowledge as he flies you over the island.
Our family really enjoyed it because they add so many personal touches.

Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

Toronto, Ontario

review_title: The BEST In-Flight Tour You'll Ever Take
review_text: We are SO glad we took time for Wings Over Kauai!  Don't leave Kauai without flying with them!!  We hiked the Kalalau Trail before the flight - what an AMAZING VIEW seeing what we hiked from the air!  Your Captain is extremely knowledgeable of the area & full of interesting stories & facts we never would have learned otherwise.  DONT WASTE YOUR TIME ON A HELICOPTER OR OTHER PLANE TOUR.  We are telling you - Wings Over Kauai is the ONLY way to go.  We can't wait to go back!!

My wife, her sister and I went to Kauai and flew with "Wings Over Kauai".  I'm not ever too impressed but Bruce gave us a fantastic flight and history and overall tour of the island in his plane.  We felt safe and never worried about a thing.  It was an awesome experience and very light on the pocket book.  I will do it again when we go back.

We had a wonderful experience flying with Wings Over Kauai.  We booked it to basically see the whole island from the air but as airplane enthusiasts we decided to go for the flight instruction option.  It was definitely the highlight of our whole trip to Kauai.  
What a fun time we had!!!  We went around the entire island and my husband got to actually fly the plane through most of the trip.  We had such a great time that we booked another day where we each got flying lessons.  It was an experience that we both will never forget and will always look back on fondly.  What a beautiful place to fly for the first time!

Wings Over Kauai was very professional, and if you choose to take a tour with them you will definitely get a wonderful experience without having to be with a larger group of folks you don't know.  Its designed to be more intimate and I believe you get more out of your tour of Kauai this way.  
All I know is that they are very professional and we had a fantastic time with Wings Over Kauai.

we had a fantastic flight with Wings Over Kauai. Bruce & Ellen are both genuinely lovely people who take the extra step to enhance the experience wherever they can. Bruce is a very knowledgable guide with interesting insights about the island, and he's funny! The flight was very smooth, and the views are of course amazing. Considering this costs a third of the price of a helicopter tour, it's amazing value!

My wife and I were in Kauai in July and we set up a flight with Wings Over Kauai based on comments here on Trip Advisor .  We didn't want to spend as much as a helicopter ride would cost, but we wanted to see Kauai from the air.  The filight was a teriffic way to see the island!  The customer service was wonderful, and Captian Bruce was a teriffic tour gide, giving us lots of great information as we flew around Kauai.  I would highly reccomend this service to anyone interested in seeing the majestic beauty of Kauai from the air.  Thanks Ellen and Bruce!

review_title: The Best Thing I Did in Hawaii
review_text:
I booked a sightseeing flight with Wing over Kauai a couple of days in advance. Ellen and Bruce provide very friendly service, and they were very flexible to accomodate things like my schedule and peculiarities of weather in Kauai.

I had the most beautiful flight around the entire island of Kauai with great narrations by Bruce. 

In addition, Bruce is a certified flight instructor. As a student pilot, I was able to fly the plane myself under his supervision and picked up a lot of invaluable "pearls" specifically operating a plane over terrain (mountains and canyons), open water, and in ever changing tropical weather.

My experience was great! Still sending pictures and telling stories to my friends. 

This is a MUST for anybody visiting Kauai!!!

See for you self: http://www.everytrail.com/view_trip.php?trip_id=301395

We had an excellent experience with Pilot Bruce and his wife, Ellen!  It was easy to book, reasonably priced, and our one-hour tour took us to all of the major sites in Kauai, including the Na'Pali Coast, the "wettest spot on Earth," the major waterfalls, and even Pierce Brosnan's house :)

I am terrified of flying, but Bruce made the experience pleasant and rewarding.  From start to finish, he kept a running narrative of what we were seeing, to make sure we didn't miss any whales, corn fields, waterfalls, mountain ranges, and beaches.  Our flight was smooth and calm, and Bruce quickly adjusted his flight path when my knuckles got white.  Bruce also encouraged us to take photos, and we did: about 100 clear, panoramic shots of Kauai, as you can only see it from the sky.

I strongly recommend Wings Over Kauai to everyone who visits Kauai!

This is the first review I have made the effort to write for a vacation experience, but this trip warrants it. Bruce and Ellen organize this very well, with every minute of the experience being fun, from the pre-flight checks to final landing. Bruce does a great commentary and is an excellent pilot. We felt very safe the whole time.
You will not be disappointed with this trip, and you could almost do two trips for the price of one helicopter ride. We will certainly go again next time we are in Kauai.

I had booked this way in advance after reading here about the excellent time folks have had and we were not disappointed. Both Ellen and Bruce are very friendly and made us feel very comfortable. The day of our original appointment it was quite cloudy and seemed to get worse and even though it was not windy or stormy Bruce very readily agreed to postpone the flight for another day. Another day turned out the very next day and when I saw the sun come out I immediately called Bruce and he was ready to take us up at the first available time slot. Went up with my wife and 18 month daughter who loved the idea of sitting in a small cessna. 

     The flight itself was very comfortable with Bruce being an excellent pilot. My wife who is generally quite scared of small commuter jets says she felt very comfortable within a couple of minutes of take off. Bruce's knowledge about the area is excellent and he can tell you a lot about the flora/vegetation of the region. He also sings for you every now and then. We are looking forward to doing this ride again next year. I would strongly recommend this for anyone over the helicopter rides.
Thanks Ellen and Bruce for a wonderful time.

review_title: Fantastic Flight !  It has  to be the best way to see Kauai from the air !!!
review_text:
Our  flight was one of the highlights of our  vacation in Kauai. 
It was a pleasure  to fly with Bruce and meet his wife Ellen , he is an excelent pilot  and an excelent  communicator . Aloha and mahalo for an unforgetable trip !!!

review_title: Great way to see the Island!
review_text:
We booked our trip online, and received a nice personal email from Ellen (Bruce, the pilot's wife) almost immediately.  I had explained to her that my husband was also a private pilot and was really looking forward to the tour and meeting Bruce.

We met with Ellen in the office; she is so friendly and personable.  Bruce was just coming in from another tour.  The little touches that they do before, during and after the trip are so fun and make the trip even more special.  I won't spoil it by sharing them with you!

I sat up front, as I am a bit more prone to motion sickness, but I felt fine during the trip.  Bruce is an excellent pilot.  He is so well versed on the Island and has a wealth of fun information to share with you during the flight.  Our pictures came out great.  

We are glad we chose Wings Over Kauai!  We highly recommend this family run, professional tour.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

review_title: Wonderful Experience! Not to be missed!
review_text: We took the best tour (grand deluxe?) last week -- Ellen was so helpful and welcoming, and Bruce (the pilot) was exactly what you'd want in a pilot: knowledgeable, competent, alert, wonderfully soothing voice, and kept us informed about what we were seeing from the interesting perspective of one who knows what's on and in the ground. This is a wonderful way to see sights you would miss regardless of how into hiking or boating you are as some of it just can't be accessed on the ground.  We could see a helicopter which also looked to be great fun, but if your stomach or your nerves or your wallet  won't permit all that swooping, I can't say enough great things about Wings Over Kauai. The highlight of our already fabulous trip!

This is a late review but we took a flight with WIngs over Kauai during our honeymoon in October 2008.  Bruce, the pilot, is very knowledgable about the island and the views are amazing.  A benefit of Wings over Kauai is that it is personalized service since only 3 people can fly with the pilot and there is not a body weight restriction as there is with the helicopter tours.  We are coming back to Kauai this October 2009 with our parents and plan to have them take a flight with Wings over Kauai.

On June 4th,2009 our family of three took the tour.  We loved the view over the Kauai and it was very comfortable.  Eleven years ago when we took a similar flight from Maui to Big Island I was sick to my stomach.  This time I did not feel sick at all.  Bruce and Ellen are very nice and Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island.  We enjoyed every minute of the tour and may go back next year.

My partner and I travelled to Kauai in June as part of a three island tour of Hawaii.  I'd booked the Wings over Kauai 'Grand Deluxe' tour over the Internet based on positive reviews and we were not disappointed.  The hospitality shown by Bruce and Ellen was fantastic and we felt more like family guests than customers.  The flight was perfect - even though it was a small aircraft it was perfectly smooth and the scenery.....   If you want to really see Kauai then it has to be by air and if you have to go by air then I'd recommend 'Wings'.  As a Scot, I also have to mention that the cost is far lower than the helicopter prices we saw.  And I must also mention Bruce's Bose noise-cancelling headphones - having suffered trying to hear other narratives in other places over the background engine noise these were fantastic.

review_title: Once In A Lifetime Experience... Unbelievable!
review_text:
My wife and I had the trip of a lifetime with Wings Over Kaua'i on our recent trip to the island. We went to three different islands over the span of 12 days and saw many different things, however, this was the unquestionable highlight of our trip.

The company is a true family affair with Bruce, Ellen and their children, and they made us immediately feel welcome and a part of their extended family.

Bruce is an exceptional pilot and perhaps an even better tour guide. His knowledge of the island -- traditions, culture, geography, etc. -- is made even better by his knowledge of the climate and agriculture that you see during the flight.

We boarded his plane at the Lihu'e airport and took off on a route that followed the Eastern Coast south. We then turned West near Poi'pu and saw many things along the shore. During that part, and the entire trip, Bruce mixed in good conversation with fun facts and information about the island. It was as much of a learning experience as it was a sightseeing tour for us.

He then turned the plane northwest so that we could see the views of Waimea Canyon and eventually the dramatic Napili Coast. Words and photos do not do justice when describing these areas. It is truly an awesome sight and something that is hard to fathom. However, seeing it from the air adds an incredible dimension that you can't tell from land.

Bruce then took us along the Northern Coast of the island and inland to see Wailua Falls and other waterfalls. Again, an awe-inspiring experience.

When we booked the flight, Ellen warned us that the day we were going up could be a bit bumpy because of the tradewinds, but other than a few minor air pockets, it did not bother us at all. The entire flight was very comfortable for both of us.

Bruce also gave us the opportunity to open the window and take photos through that. We were amazed at the photo quality with the window both open and closed.

Overall, you cannot go wrong with booking this flight. It is unquestionable one of the best things I have experienced in our life. The price was very reasonable, and the quality of the experience was second-to-none.

review_title: The absolutely best way to see the island from the air.
review_text: This is an aerial tour from a Cessna 172 4-seater airplane. Very stable, very safe and FAR less bumpy than a helicopter. The pilot also has a PhD so you'll get a narration that is more detailed and informative than the usual canned speech from a flying tour guide. As a bonus, he's a flight instructor so when he learned that I am also a pilot, he was very happy to let me fly "left seat" which was a thrill for me and freed him up to narrate for us. Also, this is a fraction of the price of a helicopter. I'd do it again in a heartbeat.

My wife and I took a Grand Deluxe Tour of the Island on Sunday, June 7th during our honeymoon. This flight added to the many favorable memories we have of Kaua'i. We were greeted by Ailana during check-in. My wife was surprised to have been given a flower and a lei. The flight tour is definitely very personal and interactive, both with the take-off run-down check and the awesome noise cancelling headphones to communicate with each other. Bruce is not only a very experienced pilot, he was also a PhD in Agronomy (i think) in his former life. This made the flight quite interesting since he could talk about the plants and climate with ease. We saw wonderful rainbows, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon (which we didn't get a chance to drive to when we were in Kaua'i), and the wondrous Na Pali Coast. The lighting during our afternoon flight was majestic and the lush green mountain ridges were heavenly to see. We also saw many of the beaches we toured and famous movie/TV backdrops were pointed out to us. This was definitely a flight to remember!

What a great time we had with Bruce+Ellen, my wife was a bit nervous about flying in a small plane but Bruce put her at ease and we had a great flight round the island. I would  recommend this trip to anyone

review_title: Awesome, even for a scardy cat
review_text: I was so afraid to fly!  So when my husband booked a flight on a teeny tiny plane, I was less than thrilled.  However, the staff was so sweet and patient and reassuring that the experience started out just fine.  They answered all my scardy cat questions before hand.  Once on the run way, it was very comforting to do the flight checklist.  The take off and landing was really smooth.  Though there was a little turbulance, around the West Side of the island, I found that I wasn't scared (well just a little bit:).  The beauty of the island and all of the information that we learned about the spots was well worth it.  We recommend that you book the flight for your first day there.  We did that, and really appreciated having the background knowledge of the places we saw from the sky once we were visiting the places on the ground.  It was an all wound wonderful experience!  The kind of experience you put on your top 20 list of  "cool things I did in life".

This is a once in a lifetime experience.  Kauai is a beautiful island.  Flying over this island in a Cessna 172 provides an awesome panoramic view of all the beautiful places.  Bruce (the pilot) is very knowledgeable and provides a verbal commentary throughout the entire flight.  There are so many waterfalls that counting the waterfalls is a real challenge.  Many of them are unreachable by land so flying over is the only way to see them and really appreciate them.  Bring a good camera along!

The entire staff at Wings Over Kauai is friendly and helpful.  They make this a truly special experience.  The spirit of Aloha is alive and well at Wings Over Kauai!

We just went on this flight today and the whole experience was amazing. It was our first year wedding anniversary and Ellen, Carter, and Bruce were extremely friendly and welcoming. The flight was not bumpy at all and I couldn't believe all the sites that Bruce showed us. We would definitely recommend this to anyone coming to Kauai.

This was a last minute activity my b/f and I decided to do on our last day in Kauai. Initially we thought all the helicopter tours were overpriced but being the brat that I am, I hunted down a cheaper option and found Wings Over Kauai as well as a $20 off coupon (per couple). So, it was just me, the b/f and Captain Bruce the pilot. While he didnt go really indepth about the sites, it was a peaceful tour, definitely beautiful and definitely personal.
