We got to know his staff pretty well in the short time we were there. They were all super friendly and super imformative and we were pleasantly surprised by the beverages offered on the flight and the ginger candy to calm our nervous tummies (except we weren't nervous, we just like free sweets). I have already recommended this tour to friends who are expecting to visit Hawaii (and I just got back last night.)

review_title: Absolutely fantastic start to our Kauai trip!
review_text:
We LOVED Captain Bruce and the entire staff at Wings Over Kauai!! They were so nice, and very knowledgeable. I was concerned about motion sickness, so I got hooked up with some ginger candies to help just in case...I also got a little Kukui nut necklace and a flower, and they took a couple of pictures of my husband and I before the flight. They really understand how exciting these things are for island newbies, and they totally embrace it!

As for Captain Bruce - he was great! He has a total love for what he does, and it shows big time! He points out everything, answers all your questions on the tour, and has little tidbits about just about everything! Flying with him was a total pleasure.

The flight was great - very safe and little turbulence. We saw some absolutely BEAUTIFUL sights and took some fantastic pictures. Captain Bruce opened up the windows a few times to let my husband take a few glare-free pictures of the highlights: Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, and Wailua Falls. We have some gorgeous pictures as a result! Again, they understand how much these tours mean to us tourists, and they totally go with it!

Seriously - consider this as an option to your WAY overpriced helicopter tours. For $100 a person, instead of $160-$350, we got a fantastic, personalized tour of this beautiful island. I also recommend starting your trip with this so that you can decide what you want to see up-close later. We will definitely fly with Wings Over Kauai again on our next trip.

Bob and I had a wonderful tour of the "Garden Island".  We were warmly greated by Ellen and Bruce, my flower and lei were an unexpected surprise, as was being included in the pre-flight checks.  The depth of Bruce's knowledge of the island was very appreciated.  We were able to see things in a totally new perspective from the air than from the ground.
We would recommend Wings over Kauai to everyone and anyone that is interested in taking an air tour.  (We did actually give out a couple of cards)

Bob and Teia Strong, Harrisburg, Pa

My husband and I flew with Wings over Kauai on June 5. We came in on the Pride of America cruise ship and took a free shuttle to the nearby strip mall and then Elaina from WOK picked us up and brought us to the airport. After we were done we were dropped off at the same place and went to the beach next door for the afternoon. Very easy! Both Elaina and Bruce, the pilot, were very friendly. My husband really enjoyed sitting next to Bruce and learning about the airplane. We picked WOK because it would only be the two of us in the plane so we would get a private tour and because of all of the good reviews on Trip Advisor. The flight was a great experience. The views from the air were amazing and all of the pictures we took turned out great even through the plane window. Bruce also let us open the window a few times to get some pictures as we flew over Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast. We felt very safe and Bruce made sure we were doing ok and were comfortable. After we were done they gave us a DVD of some of the views you see from the plane. The cover was a picture they took of us before the flight. It was a nice touch. We also appreciate Bruce taking time for us since his daughter was graduating high school that afternoon. We would definitely recommend Wings over Kauai!!

You have to do this!!! The reviews are "spot on". My wife and I just got back from a 2.5 week trip to Oahu and Kauai, and this has to be the highlight of our trip. It's hard to add to all the positive things others have already said. From the time we were greeted by Bruce's (the pilot) wife, son, and daughter to the end of the flight, it was a very positive experience. 

It was just Bruce, myself, and my wife in the plane. My wife rode shotgun and had a good time going through the checklist with Bruce as he explained a bit about all the gauges. That was interesting to both of us, as neither of us are pilots. 

Just to give you some background, I only fly when I have to, and I'm not at all a fan of small planes. In spite of that, I had no problems with the flight. Bruce kept it nice and smooth. He did a great job of keeping us engaged in conversation the entire flight, and as someone else noted, he will position the plane to give you clear views of the Na Pali Coast. He's a funny guy too (he entertained us with a short rendition of a couple of songs from the musical South Pacific! haha).  

We really can't say enough about this "mom and pop" operation. Don't waste your money on the chopper rides. Wings Over Kauai is MUCH more personal than any chopper ride and you'll see amazing scenery the whole time. And I believe a small plane is safer than a chopper (if a chopper rotor goes, that's it. If a plane's engine goes, you at least have a chance of gliding back down to the nearest clearing, or glide into the water). 

A BIG thanks to Bruce and his family for giving us the experience of a lifetime!!!

Andy and Stephanie

My wife and I had a very good time on this flight. The veiws were beautiful, the flight was smooth, Bruse is a very knowledgable guy and is a wonderful tour guide/ pilot.  Eleen was also very freindly and was even nice enough to drive us to our hotel.  Extremely nice couple and a very well run business. I would most definatly go back to them and recomend them to anyone.

The opportunity to fly a plane and see Kauai from the birds eye viewpoint is a rare treasure -- thank you Wings Over Kauai for the flight of a lifetime!  You made two pilots' dreams come true -- Scott and Ruth, Phoenix, Arizona

review_title: A highlight of our visit on Kauai.
review_text:
We really enjoyed our flight with Bruce, as well as, our visit with Ellen and Carter.  We couldn't have asked for anything more or to be treated with more personal attention.  We highly recommend this family operation to anyone wanting to get an overall view of this beautiful island.  It is much lower priced that a helicopter flight and with only 4 passengers on board you have a window seat for better visability.  Noise quietening headphones are a definitely plus allowing you to communicate with the pilot.
Stan and Patsy Alexander
Hamilton, Texas

review_title: Thrill of a lifetime-The Bob Ross of the Air
review_text: Since you are reading this review you most likely are in Kauai or contemplating a trip to Kauai, and you are wondering whether you should you take the plane or the helicopter. For our family the choice was clear: Wings over Kauai. Pilot Bruce at WOK was not only super professional but an amazing tour guide. I will not repeat what the other reviewers have already said but I will say that we had a great experience. At half the price of Helo rides we were able to see some great sights over the island. It was obvious that Bruce has a wealth of knowledge about the Island...from trees and vegetation to star homes......WOKT is the way to go. We loved our tour so much that we not only booked for the next day to go whale searching but we also invited my sister to go up on her own flight with Bruce. Bruce is an extreme professional (Agronomy PHD.) who is not only safety conscious but one of those rare souls that truly do what they love...He reminded me of mild mannered Bob Ross with his Afro painting back in the early eighties, except Bruce paints with flying.. The next time we are in the Kauai area..we just have to go and stop in and fly with Bruce...

Lovely family! Awesome flight just like giding over paradise. We have taken several helo flights over the island, dh wasnt too thrilled about this flight. He is and was very happy about the price, experience,photos. Total experience a TEN!!!!!!!!!!  Hi Ellen ,Bruce, Carter and daughter of Bruce and Ellen.

We made our second trip to the beautiful island of Kauai this spring.  And, one of the highlights of our trip was our tour of the island on Wings Over Kauai Tours.  The first time we were on the island, we took a helicoptor ride over the island.   And, it is both of our opinion the next time we visit the island we will choose Wings Over Kauai again.  You almost feel like you are floating in the air, and you really get the opportunity to view the terrain instead of just zipping by it in the helicoptor.  And, an added benefit was the information that the pilot and "tour guide" was able to give.  Bruce had excellent knowledge of the vegetation of the island which made it all the more interesting.  So, we would hightly recommend this to everyone. . .it would be our first choice regardless of the price. . .but with the price compared with the actual flight time . .this is the way to go
Sisters from Omaha, NE .

review_title: The Best Way  to See Kauai
review_text:
When you get to Kauai you will see all sorts of ads for helicopter rides. I'm sure they're nice, but they are expensive. Wings over Kauai is a ride in a small airplane for about half the price, and it is great, personalized tour for you and your family.  The tour takes about 70 minutes.  Be sure to bring your camera.  (The operator e-mail souvenir pictures and video of your family.)

The owner operator gives you a wonderful guided tour of what may be the most beautiful place in the world. There are scores of waterfalls; misty mountains, green, green valleys; remote, multi-blue beaches; surf and sand; in all a tropical mountain paradise.  There is no way you can see all of of Kauai without taking flight, and there is no better way to fly than in a small plane.

Helicoptors rides are cool in themselves, but for this you don't need the distraction of a thrill ride. The plane is simple, smooth and prefect for Kauai. Wings Over Kauai is a family buisness where you will ride with the owner, Bruce, meet his wife, and maybe even one of their kids. It's a warm safe feeling. Bruce is a easy going, knowlegable guide with a gentle sense of humor. He will show and tell everything about Kauai, where the movies were filmed, where the stars live, how agriculture works; he may even tell you the down side of the cost of living or the public schools. And he will show you the tail of Puff  the Magic Dragon in the town called Hanelei. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Hate Flying & Heights, But Loved This!
review_text:
I detest flying and heights, am a "safety nut", and add to all that, I'm cheap, which is why I was so reluctant to book an aerial tour of Kauai.  However, I just had to get my eyes on the aerial views I kept seeing pictures of so I took the plunge with Wings Over Kauai.  Reasons I chose them over a helicopter ride (and why it was the right choice!):
1.  Cheaper---this tour is literally half the cost of a copter ride.  The value is unbelievable.
2.  Personal---we would have been on the copter with 4 other people plus the pilot.  This tour is limited to 3 persons plus Bruce, the pilot, so my husband and I were able to go it alone and have a very tailored, personal experience.  Bruce was so knowledgeable about the island and sites he pointed out.  We asked lots of questions, and had a wonderful, personal experience. 
3.  Safety---I kept reading about recent helicopter crashes on aerial tours.  WOK has a perfect safety record.  I was shocked at how comfortable Bruce made me feel on the fight.  I felt completely safe.
4.  Stability---the small plane provides a more stable riding experience, and I am really susceptible to motion sickness.  Bruce helped me with some "tricks", and I didn't feel badly or get sick the entire flight.  I was truly amazed by this.  

If you are considering an aerial tour of Kauai (and you should---the views did not disappoint), you should choose WOK.  Bruce and Ellen are kind, helpful, considerate, and extremely accommodating.   

Thanks a million, Bruce and Ellen!

review_title: Absolutely the best thing we did on our whole vacation!
review_text: I was blown away by how spectacular this flight was! I am very nervous about small planes but Bruce is simply the best. The flight was so smooth and I actually felt very safe. His altitude is low and I think that makes it so much better. I wish I had done this sooner. Photos I got out the window were the best photos on our trip. This is a must for photographers.

This was our second viist to Kauai and we just had to return for another flight with Wings Over Kauai. We were travelling with our parents who had opted for a helicopter tour - big mistake for them! While we were waiting, my husband went for a spontaneous flight with Wings Over Kauai. Bruce and Ellen were gracious enough to accommodate us and we had a wonderful flight. Bruce always has something interesting and intelligent to share about the island and he's such an experienced and conscientious pilot that wants to give you his best personal attention. You can't be in better hands. My parents, meanwhile, returned from their harrowing helicopter ride that turned out to be crowded, noisy, and so bumpy that many passengers has to use their 'aloha bags' (i.e. motion sickness). They won't make that mistake again!

review_title: I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: We skipped the helicopter tours because of their cost and motion sickness problems.  Wings Over Kauai uses a small 4-seater plane that gives you fantastic views of the whole perimeter of  the island (Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, lush fields, etc)  and when the weather is good can get in close to the interior as well.  It avoids the swooping and sharp turns that the helicopters make.  And it wasn't a bit scary!  Ellen was very friendly, accomodating, and reassuring when we talked on the phone before the trip, even more so in person!  She even handed out ginger capsules which really seemed to work to prevent motion sickness, and she took our pictures before the flight.  Bruce the pilot was also friendly and calm, made us feel safe, and narrated the entire trip.  The flight was exciting and gorgeous!  And the price was right -- $100 per person for the 60-minute trip,and a discount for the 3rd passenger.   They're a lovely couple and the trip was fantastic!

I am a private pilot and had the pleasure to fly with Bruce from Wings over Kauaii.  Bruce has a very nice 172 and he was nice enough to let me sit in the left seat for our flight.  Bruce was an excellent guide of the Kauaii scenery and was extremely dilligent to ensure a safe and fun flight.  Bruce was great showing the sites and since I have a vineyard took me to a vineyard experiment in Kauaii and also was a wealth of knowledge on the rest of the agriculture in Kauaii.

As a private pilot, this was the best way to see Kauaii.  For those who want a window seat to the most beautiful island in the world, do yourself a favor and book a trip with Bruce and Ellen.  I would say this is an absolute must do when in Kauaii.

My wife Cindy and I traveled to Kauai in early March.  Since the Napali coastline is only accessible by air or sea, we planned to take a flight over the Island.
The first day we scheduled a flight turned out to be cloudy with very low visibiltiy; so, Bruce and Ellen were able to reschedule our trip.
The morning of the trip turned out bright and sunny.  Bruce prepared us for the trip with all the pre-flight info.  We took the 70 minute flight to be able to view everything.  Bruce did an excellent job of pointing out the numerous highlights.  The waterfalls are simply spectacular!!!  We saw the Waimea Canyon from the ground; however, the flight over the Canyon was awesome!
Then, we flew along and over the Napali Coastline which is simply magnificent.  All the while, Bruce is continuing to point out places and areas of interest.  Great Job Bruce!!
I highly recommend the flight and consider it an absolute must for any visitor to Kauai!
Again, thanks for the wonderful trip and experience!
Roger & Cindy Thompson
Council Bluffs, IA

As a pilot I look for every opportunity to fly in new and exotic places.  Having flown in Maui,  I looked forward to flying in Kauai, however there were no airplanes to rent on Kauai.  Bruce,  as it turns out is a CFI and was very gracious in allowing me to fly form the right seat.  He offered the left seat but since the plane took all left turns it was easier for me to see the sights from the right seat.  I took off from Lihue airport and climed out over Poipu and headed for the grand canyons of Wiamea.  Bruce allowed me to fly as much as I wanted and when I needed to take pictures he was there to take the controls.  Both Bruce and Ellen were superb hosts.  My group had an excellent flight wtih great nariation and insights of the island.  I had tken a helecopter flight years ago but the plane ride was for me more enjoyable.  Especially for me taking off and landing at Lihue airport.  I have and will continue to recommend their service to anyone wishing to see the beauitful island of Kauai with an exellent host and pilot.

Please, please do yourself a favor and book a ride with Captain Bruce on Wings Over Kauai Tours!  My new husband and I were recently in Kauai for our honeymoon and we knew that we wanted to see Kauai by air.  My husband tends to get seasick/airsick/carsick, so I knew I wanted a quiet, uncrowded experience for him.  We called on a Tuesday morning to inquire about possible reservations and were able to fly that afternoon!  

Here are the POSITIVES:
(1) You get to meet Captain Bruce's wife, Ellen, at the private terminal and learn all about the family (even the kids!).  Ladies are presented with a special lei and a flower (which smelled so delicious, I spent the rest of the week trying to track down in perfume form only to find out nobody makes it!).  We also met their son, Carter, who was really sweet to us, took photos of us before we got in the airplane and in the airplane, and provided our pre-flight entertainment.
(2) Captain Bruce: Bruce is REALLY nice and knowledgeable; he makes you feel incredibly welcomed and safe.  We laughed when he offered us "in flight" service before our flight by giving us each a mint and collecting our wrappers!  (They also provide drinks.)  My husband got to sit in front with Bruce and do the pre-flight checklist, which made us both feel like we understood the plane better and was really interesting!  
(3) You are the only ones on your flight!  We were so glad we booked with WOKT after we saw all the noisy helicopters buzz in and out across the way from the private plane terminal, dropping off and picking up hoards of people.  Also, other small planes had numerous people on them.  On the WOKT plane, only three passengers are allowed at a time, so everyone has a window seat and everyone knows each other.  
(4) The flight is not noisy and you get to talk to the pilot whenever you want.  There was nice background music in our ear sets, but we were more interested in talking to Bruce about the island.
(5) Flights are affordable and almost custom.  We found the WOKT pricing to be extremely reasonable and affordable, especially compared with our experience before with helicopters and other small plane tours.  Because Bruce took time to get to know us before and during our flight, he made sure to point out or spend extra time on sights that would be of interest to us.  I am a huge fan of the Harrison Ford movie "Six Days, Seven Nights," which was filmed on Kauai, and so is Bruce, so he took special care to point out movie locales for me and we quoted our favorite movie lines.  He also dipped in for a closer view of whales breeching and our hotel.

Negatives?  Absolutely none!  We talked about our flight the rest of the week and the photos we took were the best of our trip.  After we got home, there was a nice email for us from Ellen with a photo they took of us before our flight, a great reminder of an awesome time!  Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

My husband and I just did a flight with Wings Over Kauai today.  Bruce and his wife, Ellen, run an amazing business and we could not have been happier with our decision to choose to fly with them.

Originally we were planning on doing the traditional helicoptor tour of the Island, but after seeing how high the prices were, we just couldn't justify spending that much money with a baby on the way.  I then read about Wings Over Kauai on a Trip Advisor post.  The price was over HALF of what helicoptor tours charged, AND you had the entire Cesna plane to yourself.  A completly personalized, private tour!

From the moment we were checked in by Ellen and their son to the moment we were finished, we could not have been happier.  The customer service was outstanding, with then taking a special interest in my safety and possibility of nausea with my pregancy.  

Bruce was an amazing pilot and the flight on the little Cesna was incredibly smooth.  The views were outstanding and we saw more than you would get to see if you did a boat tour.  We felt so incredibly safe, and Bruce was a great tour guide!  

I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to ANYONE coming to the island.  Skip the over priced Helicoptor tour and take this tour instead.  It was well worth the money and you won't get a better look at the entire Island.

review_title: The best way to see Kauai is with Capt. Bruce & his family.
review_text:
This is the best way to see Kauai.  On a previous trip to Kauai I took a helicopter trip.  This blows that tour away.  Bruce's airplane is the way to see Kauai - every flight is a private flight so you get the entire airplane to yourself.  And it's cheaper too.  Especially if you are a bit on the heavy side, as Bruce and Ellen don't make you buy an extra seat as long as your entire group is under 580 pounds. 

Bruce and Ellen run an amazing little family operation out of Lihue airport. 

I called at 9am this morning because the weather looked great and my wife and I wanted to do some sort of aerial tour of Kauai during our visit.  Ellen answered the phone and was able to fit us in to the schedule at 11am.  We got there a little early and decided to take the slightly longer 70 minute flight tour that included more waterfalls. Totally worth it!

Capt. Bruce spotted some whales right after take off and so we went off shore a little bit and got some amazing aerial views of whales before heading back along the coast and through the mountains to see Kauai.

From welcoming us in the back office and going over the safety briefing to explaining the flight operations, we felt safe and in good hands the entire time.

The views area amazing from Bruce's Cessna airplane.  The windows are huge and clear and even though I'm an airplane geek I spent all my time staring out the windows at the awesome views.  Bruce knows his stuff and has lots of info about the island and plant life.

review_title: The most affordable must do in Kauai
review_text:
Simply the best tour money can buy! We really enjoyed our flight on Tuesday, March 3rd 2009! For anyone considering an air tour of Kauai you should do yourself a favor and call or e-mail Ellen about Wings Over Kauai - you will not be displeased!

We booked our tour based on the flawless feedback here on TripAdvisor. Our original schedule was to fly on Monday afternoon but that afternoon stormed and was way too windy for my wife and I. A quick phone call to Ellen and we rescheduled for the next morning and it was perfect!

The flight was a little bumpy as can be expected from any aircraft of this size (helicopter or plane) but it was worth it. The views were unforgettable. Bruce is a fountain of knowledge about the island and was so calm and polite to us. He shared with us details about what was planted (farmed) and what was natural - explaining the soil and why we were seeing the colors that we were. It was awesome! Better than watching Discovery or Science channels and so personal to what we wanted to know.

Do it. You'll love it!

Thank you, Ellen & Bruce!
-Brian & Garyann

Wings Over Kauai Tours was one of the highlights of our Kauai stay.  Bruce and Ellen were thoughtful and informative.  Their attention to details really shows.  The flight was spectacular.  When it was all over we felt we had friends we have known forever.  Thanks Bruce and Ellen for letting this old rusty pilot fly your beautiful plane and the Bose headsets were the icing on the cake.

Thanks again for making our stay more memorable.

Mike and Evelyn Parson
Portland Or

We took the Pali Mist tour with WOK today (Friday). Making the reservation was very easy. I called their # on Thursday morning and Ellen took our information (name, hotel, weight, when we would like the tour). We were concerned about the weather as it has been windy the whole week and my husband was prone to motion sickness. She said that the ride can get bumpy at times and most people were able to tolerate without getting sick. 

The morning of the flight, it was overcast and windy. On our way to the airport, it even rained a little. We were greeted by Ellen 30 min before the tour at the commuter terminal. She was very friendly and gave me a flower from her garden to put in my hair and a lei. She then got us ready in the plane (cooler with drinks, seat belt, window etc). Take-off was nice and smooth and we were on our way to some fantastic views. We hiked a few trials and saw some of the sights earlier during the week and it was really neat to see the same sights from air: the Na Pali coast (via Kalalau trail), the Hanalei bay (via Alaka'i Swamp trail), the Waipo'o falls (via canyon trail). The most amazing was we saw many sights that could only been seen by air. That made the trip really worthwhile. Bruce gave excellent narratives throughout the tour and pointed out the sights for photographs. Overall it was a wonderful trip. I would have given a five-star if the weather were more cooperative. We did not get sick but the flight was bumpy at times due to the wind. I would highly recommend the trip. After all, it was only $220 for two and we got the plane, the pilot, and the beautiful sights all to ourselves.

review_title: Highlight of our Visit to Paradise
review_text: We visited four islands over two weeks in mid-February.  It’s true: Hawaii is paradise.  On our first day, we took flight with Bruce over Kauai and it was the highlight of our entire trip.  Both Ellen and Bruce prepared us well for the flight and, once in the air, Bruce was the perfect pilot/host.  He explained precisely everything we saw, pointed out subtle things we might have missed, and made sure our money had been well spent.  Speaking of money, the price for the deluxe flight was significantly less than even the special rates now available for helicopter tours.  We both had window seats because the plane only seats four (including Bruce), and my window opened for perfect picture taking.  It would be difficult to imagine a better way of being introduced to paradise.

We arrived by cruise ship early on Feb 12th.  Ellen and I had been in  communication since I originally inquired about Bruce's Kauai flights since reading fellow "Trippers" reviews.
Both Ellen and Bruce made this both painless in connecting up with them but just a supremely pleasurable experience in all respects.
Bruce makes no bones about being ultra-safe and taking his time in checking everything out prior to taking anyone in the air. Just to keep me busy (I'm sure) he handed me his partially completed pre-flight check list for me to call out.  He explained things as we went through those final steps.  Then it was our time to take to the air.  The views experienced simply can not be put into words.  Photographs don't do justice to what the eyes absorb and fills one's spirit.
Bruce, explains points of interest through-out.  The noise-canceling headsets everyone is equipped with make for a wonderful experience.  Not having to deal with the drone of the engine throughout the flight is just one more of the many small details Ellen and Bruce thought through to make this nothing less than a top-notch experience.
Mom received a kukui lai upon the completion of the flight.  I felt left out :-(  I had it planned that both mom and I would be "lai'd" twice during our visit to the islands.  Sadly, due to circumstances caused by mother nature, our next stop (in Maui) was cut short and our luau was missed due having to return to ship before the afternoon was over.
One last note concerning Wings Over Kauai...
BIG thanks go out to Mary, Bruce & Ellen's progeny chauffeur.  She was tasked with returning us back to the pick-up point.  We inquired about eateries for afternoon lunch.  After picking our brains about our tastes (I tend to be a bit more willing to experiment than mom)  Mary recommended "Duke's Canoe Club" along with the sage advice of "you MUST try their HULA PIE" (she also warned that one slice would be enough for two)... Mary was wrong on that point.  One piece is enough for a small army.  LOL
Thanks again to Ellen, Bruce and Mary Columbe  
You made mom's "dream vacation" that much brighter and special.  
Many, MANY Mahalos

review_title: WINGS  OVER  KAUAI  --  Excellent   Airplane  Tour
review_text:
**   **  In late January - early February, 2009, my wife and I visited Hawaii (to see Kauai and Ohau --  plus an Hawaiian cruise) for a first time trip.    
**  **  We wanted to see / photograph the "Garden Island" -- but knew we had to get up into the air to  REALLY  see this island.
 ** **      We selected Wings Over Kauai as it is essentially a private charter for up to 3 people plus pilot --  with a reasonable cost ($100 for 1 hour -1 person).   Both of us had window seats !!
 **  **     Ellen & Bruce  (a married couple) made a very enjoyable & safe trip.  In the air, Bruce provided ample information about many topics. WOK has a very effective sound system to reduce  airpland engine noise and permit talking among passengers and pilot.  The trip produced many pictures taken by both of us.
  **  **    Actually we scheduled a one-hour airplane flight  --  and followed up with a second one-hour flight several days later.   
 **  **  During our two week vacation we saw and did many things - all where new to us.  The WOK flights certainly are extremely high on our list of wonderful experiences.  WOK is a first rate & safe operation.
 **   **    Would we take a third flight with WOK ?  YES !!!  We highly recommend WOK.   But probably a different month so photography conditions (light, clouds, etc) are different  --  for  us.
 **    **   Once you have seen Kauai from both the air and from the ground  --  --  you will understand why Kauai NEEDS to be seen from the air.  Steep mountains limit roads; much of the land probably has never been walked upon - - -  it is wilderness, waterfalls, abundant plants and trees, mountains, coast, and ocean waves.

        Gary    --      Arizona   --          February, 2009

I came to TripAdvisor looking for a Kauai helicopter tour recommendation and stumbled onto the superlative reviews for "Wings Over Kauai".  Changed our plans and REALLY glad we did.......the experience was the BEST ever and really was the highlight of our 25th anniversary trip to Kauai and the Big Island.

Here's why:

1.)  Bruce is an excellent pilot and the flight was extremely smooth.  Even though he gave tips to avoid motion sickness I felt nothing but glee and delight on being aboard and seeing the sights.......couldn't get enough.  The avoidance of symptoms was I'm sure in large part due to Bruce's flying abilities.  

2.)  Ellen and Bruce were VERY VERY accomodating in rescheduling our flight due to overcast and cloudy conditions which plagued us during the majority of our trip.  We were rescheduled from Tuesday to Wed to Thursday AM (right before we left Kauai) in order to allow the best viewing conditions possible.  I seriously doubt many copter tours would have done the same.  Ellen and Bruce knew how special our trip was to us and wanted us to have the same experience with our Kauai flight. As a result, we actually saw Waimea Canyon and several North shore beaches in bright sunshine vs. our road trips earlier in the week.  Saw the NaPali coast in all its glory and admired all the named and unamed waterfalls gracing this magnificent island.  

3.)  Ellen and Bruce are the friendliest folks ever.  They are wonderful proprietors of their family-run business and treat you like they would a friend or neighbor.  They even loaned us one of their guidebooks and gave us suggestions on the North shore when we mentioned we would be driving there.

I could go on and on but suffice it to say that taking a flight with "Wings Over Kauai" will be one of the  most enjoyable and memorable experiences ever  (ono ono).

Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!  :-)

-Sandra and Phil C.

review_title: Best trip ever ... just loved it... highly recommended
review_text:
The WOK experience was really great. AWESOME !! It was way better than I had expected. 
The flight was excellent. The hosts very hospitable and friendly. 
The flight was pretty stable unlike I had expected. I thought I'd be sick and feel queasy but did very well. The pilot Bruce he is excellent and fun to be with. 
All in all a great way to get a personalized tour of the famed Napali coast and Kauai without the huge price tag

review_title: Wings Over Kauai - A Cut Above
review_text: Knowing that my wife, Valerie, wouldn't consider a helicopter experience over the island, (neither would I) I researched WOK and talked her into the flight.  WOW!  We totally enjoyed the kindness and trust in Bruce and Ellen.  We were going to fly a day earlier, but the weather conditions weren't the best so they rescheduled us for the following day.  Val was the copilot and helped Bruce with the checklist.  After checking for birds, we were off.  At half the price of a chopper and so personalized, just the three of us, you couldn't ask for more.  Make sure Bruce demonstrates the Bose noise cancelling headset.  Incredible!This flight was the highlight of our week on Kauai.

Our entire experience from the initial phone call to our landing was extraordinary.  Ellen, thank you for making us feel like family over the phone and Bruce is just as fabulous.  It was the best vacation experience and value you could ask for.  Having previously experienced a vacation helicopter tour we weren't sure if this would afford the same experience.  It went above and beyond and was worth every penny. Not as expensive as helicopter tours and what a personal experience.  Ellen puts you at ease on the phone and on the ground and I can assure you Bruce does the same pre-takeoff and during the flight.  You know you are in good hands from start to finish.  Bruce's knowledge of what you are viewing is phenomenal.  He is a plethora of information and a seasoned pilot.  You cannot ask for a more personal experience.  If you are a nervous flyer, I can assure you that you will feel safe and comfortable with him.  And so much of Kauai you cannot view on foot or by car, this affords you the experience of a lifetime.   Thanks to Bruce and Ellen of Wings over Kauai for great memories made!

My husband and I took the one-hour tour with Wings Over Kauai on Jan. 22, 2009, and would recommend it to everyone. We did the helicopter tour 4 years ago and enjoyed it, but this tour is so much better. Bruce and Ellen make it special is why. Ellen checks in the guests and gives each lady a kukui nut lei. Once in the little Cessna, Bruce had my husband "help" him ready the plane for flight. The lift-off was so effortless and light, I didn't realize we had left the tarpac at first. Once airborne, I felt like a dragonfly zipping along in the air. Bruce was very friendly and knowledgeable about the island, pointing out lots of points of interest including the roofs of celebrities' homes. We felt we were out with a friend instead of someone we had just met. The motto of Wings Over Kauai is "Twice the fun for half the price," and that's absolutely true.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai is the Best for Kauai Flightseeing!
review_text: We loved our flight with Bruce!  He showed us so much of gorgeous Kauai, we learned a great deal about the island from him, we felt so welcomed by both Bruce and Ellen, and we appreciated having our own personal tour.  The price can't be beaten, and Bruce is an excellent pilot.  We'd highly recommend this tour.  You really haven't seen Kauai until you see it from the air!  This is a family owned business, you get lots of personal attention, and you won't be sorry you tried Wings Over Kauai.

The flight with Wings Over Kauai two weeks ago was fantastic! It was a windy day but Bruce did such a good job taking off and landing that my husband and I didn’t feel the turbulence. Despite the strong wind, Bruce kindly allowed my husband take open-window photos after getting my permission (hint: let the “photographer” be the co-pilot, and prepare for strong wind flow at the back seat during open-window shooting). Also thanks to the Bose noise-cancelling headsets, we were able to enjoy Bruce’s delightful narrative of Kauai: its legend, history, agriculture and more without the disturbance of the engine noise. The views were breathtaking! The Wings Over Kauai is the highlight of our Kauai trip. I give the highest recommendation.

review_title: where else would you get a custom charter for $100!!
review_text: what a brilliant trip!!excellent value so glad we did this instead of the helicopter!bruce and ellen were lovely so friendly and knowledgable.bruce had us totally relaxed for a superb smooth scenic flight i wouldnt hesitate in recommending them for your trip. where else would you get a custom charter for $100!!!

review_title: A must-do for all Kauai trips!
review_text:
My new husband and I were in Kauai for the second half of our honeymoon. My one thing that I had to do was go on an air-tour of the Island. Honestly what initially drew me to Wings Over Kauai was the price...most helicopter trips were almost $250 per person! I called up this co and Ellen was so sweet and helpful, the instant I talked to her I told my husband that I really felt comfortable & that we weren't going to regret going with them (being a tourist you never really know what you are paying for). When we arrived we felt so welcomed and at ease. I even got presents from them! The ride was amazing! Smooth, wonderful views, comfy seats, and we could all talk to eachother on our awesome headsets (Bruce did a good job on buying top of the line headsets!) 

Bruce was a great guide. He gave us tons of history & info we didn't know from the typical 'tourist' books we read, which made the flight even more enjoyable for us. We shared stories (and  tons of jokes) the whole way.

Another plus to consider...if you or another person in your party are afraid of flying, this is the plane to take! My husband is terribly afraid to fly (you practically have to knock him out to get him on a plane!) But Bruce handled the flight so smooth and was always checking to make sure my husband was ok and feeling alright. That little touch meant so much. 

In the end, I can't say enough about this company. They really made our vacation. I said that the price is what drew me in, but honestly after the service we got, I would have paid 3x the amount they charge to get such a wonderful experience again!!!   Mahalo Bruce & Ellen!

My husband and I chose Wings Over Kauai (WOK) because we wanted to see the island in a way that was affordable, economical and fun. When we discovered that flying with WOK was less than half the cost of going the helicopter route, our minds were made up.

WOK is run by a family of the nicest people on Kauai. Bruce, our pilot, was warm, friendly, funny and informative. His background in agronomics gives him keen insight into Kauai's flora and fauna. During the flight, we had on Bose noise-reduction headphones and got to listen to a wonderful selection of Hawaiian music that Bruce had compiled.

The flight itself was smooth and exhilarating. We saw four pods of humback whales as well as the entire island, including many famous spots such as the waterfall in Jurassic Park, the Waimea Canyon, the breathtaking Na Pali coastline and Mt. Waialeale.

We loved our flight and would definitely recommend flying with WOK to anyone interested seeing the island from above in a comfortable, relaxed and personal setting.

Tiffany & Ian Beliveau
January 2009

I have been to Hawaii approx 40-50 times and flying with Wings Over Kauai rates in my top 5 of fun things I have ever done in Hawaii.Flying with Bruce was a blast and dealing with Ellen was painless.When I called Ellen for information, you could tell she had the true "Aloha Spirit". When I informed her that I was a private pilot and asked if I could do the flying she said that would not be a problem, as Bruce is a FAA certified flight instructor. Bruce was extremely safety oriented and has a wealth of knowlege about Kauai. His aircraft is in great shape, has Bose noise cancelling headsets, and is a pleasure to fly.
 I have previously taken 3 helicopter tours on Kauai. Flying with Wings Over Kauai takes you basically everywhere the helicopters go at half the cost. I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. Thanks Bruce and Ellen, it was really fun.We will be back.
Al and Eric

WOW!!! What am amazing experience. It was such a treat meeting Bruce and Ellen. They were so kind, welcoming, and relaxing to be around. We could have spent all day with both of them. We were so fortunate to have a clear day that we could see for miles. The hills were so green and the waters were so blue. We will never forget our flight. It was a longer flight than helicopter and WAY cheaper. We recommend Wings Over Kauai to EVERYONE!!!

We took the Wings Over Kauai flight tour and it was a wonderful experience at about half the price of the helicopter tours.
The flight was as smooth as glass and the views were to die for!
The narrative during the flight was most informative and the hospitality of Bruce and Ellen could not have been better.
When overcast weather was an issue they rebooked our tour and we ended up with the beautiful sunset tour over Kauai.
A 40th anniversary trip to remember!
We can not wait to return the beautiful Hawaiian Islands, the paradise of Kauai and another island flight.
Mahalo Bruce and Ellen!
Marilyn & Jim
from Texas

If you can only do one thing in all Hawaii islands, then it is taking the flight tour over Kauai. The tour was our best experience in Kauai, and Ellen and Bruce are the most friendly and warm person we met in this island. It was a very personal and thoughtful service. Bruce gave me a fragrant flower and a nice Lei and explained everything about the flight very clearly. Ellen cleaned the windows specially for us so we could take clear pictures. The view was more than spectacular, beyond imagination. The flight was very safe and Bruce did an excellent landing, very very smooth. What's more, the price is half of the helicoptor tour!

review_title: Don't even consider flying with anyone else!!
review_text: Simply the very best in visibility from the aircraft, the very best in safety and comfort considerations, and the very best in Bruce's knowledge of the entire island, it's features, and character.  Even though the location of this business is shown to be in Kalaheo, rest assured, that the actual flights take off and depart at the Lihue airport -- turn left at the three flagpoles.  I've been on a number of Hawaii helicopter tours (Maui and Hawaii), and this flying experience with Bruce tops them all.  This family-run operation deserves your consideration, as this flying experience is not only safer than a helicopter, but offers a slower, less harried and more personal experience.  Try the extended 70-minute tour of the entire island and experience the flight of your life!  Return with a fatter wallet as compared to a helicopter or even other fixed-wing airplane tours.    This is the very best "bang for the buck" experience on all of Kauai.  Next time we're here, we'll do it again!

review_title: The best thing we did all week
review_text: I want to echo all the wonderful reviews this company is getting...they are all well deserved. Bruce and Ellen are great folks, and the tour was my all time favorite air tour, as well as the most talked-about part of our vacation. If you are in Kauai, you owe it to yourself to take this flight.

After living in the islands and visiting all the major ones, this was our most exciting time!  My wife Susan and myself were treated like family by Bruce and Ellen.  They are gracious and caring people who make your trip unforgettable.  Bruce is a wealth of knowledge regarding Kauai.  The flight was interactive and flew over the most amazing country I have ever seen.  It was the smoothest most satisfying flight we have ever experienced. We are coming back next year and I will look up Bruce and Ellen again.  Do not pass up the opportunity to fly with them.  It was incredible !!!

review_title: The best way to see Kauai from above
review_text: We had a wonderful experience seeing this spectacular island from the air with our pilot Bruce Coulombe.  Bruce and Ellen add a personal touch to their business and really care that you get the best possible experience.  The weather was iffy while we were there, and they were very helpful in re-scheduling us so we would get a flight in good weather - and we did.  We got some truly breathtaking views of the island, and especially the Napali Coast, of course.  Bruce's narration was interesting shows how much he knows about the island.  The pricing was very fair compared to competitors.  We highly recommend them and would fly with them again!

We've only been home one week and our memories of our 2 weeks in Kauai are fresh.  One of the fondest memories will be of the air tour we took with Bruce, pilot and owner of  "Wings Over Kauai."  He was a great narrator and so knowledgeable about the Napali coastline and Waimea Canyon and other areas on the tour.
   We felt safe with Bruce as our pilot and  we were very comfortable in his plane.   The Bose headset system made for a quiet ride and we were able to hear Bruce as he told us what we were seeing.
  He and his wife Ellen made us feel comfortable and like old friends coming for a flight. They were very attentive to detail and  they had several nice and unexpected surprises for their passengers.
  If and when we return we will certainly do take this flight again and highly recommend their business!

  Bill & Marsha Hastings
  Creswell, Oregon

We agree with previous reviewers that this is an absolutely wonderful tour!  We only had a few hours to spend on Kauai since we were there on a cruise ship, and I can't think of a better way we could have spent our time there.  I talked to Ellen on the phone before we went to Hawaii and she gave me alot of great ideas of  things to do before and after our tour.  She even picked us up near our ship and drove us to the tour and back again afterwards.  The flight was amazing!  It was smooth and the views were just beautiful, and Bruce's knowledge of agriculture and the island made the trip all the more interesting.  The price was very reasonable too.

We booked our trip as a result of the reviews on Trip Advisor. From the very first contact, Ellen Coulombe was friendly, informative and responsive. The web site, wingsoverkauai.com was also helpful and well designed.

The safety record was excellent. Bruce and Ellen briefed us fully and made us all feel like we were completely informed as we prepared for the flight. They got us involved in aspects of the safety checks prior to take-off. 

We headed along the coast toward Poipu followed by the Waimea Canyon. We were able to see the canyon beautifully. It was absolutely stunning. Next we headed to the Na Pali Coast. Unfortunately it was mostly obscured by some showers that sprung up. Bruce pointed out points of interest including movie sites and homes. He was able to fly us over Kilohana Crater and the Wailua Falls.

All in all we were so pleased with our trip and would highly recommend it as part of your stay on the Island. You will not be disappointed.

I decided to book a flightseeing tour with Wings over Kauai after reading the rave reviews on this site.  I must say that we can now add our recommendation to the long list of satisfied customers.
We were only in Kauai for one day as part of a Hawaii cruise, Ellen met us as arranged and gave us the option to cancel our flight as it was an overcast day, however as we had nothing else planned we decided to do the flight. Boy were we glad we did! 
We felt very safe with Bruce the pilot and once we were airborne we saw spectacular views of the Kauai coastline and waterfalls. Bruce gave a very informative commentary and pointed out various film locations along the way.
It was one of the highlights of our Hawaii cruise and at half the price of the helicopter tours, plus everyone gets a window seat, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Wings over Kauai to anyone looking for a special experience along with personal service that is so rare these days.

review_title: What a way to see the island!
review_text:
We took the 1 hour tour while on our honeymoon and greatly enjoyed every minute of it!  First, I was given a traditional lei and fresh flower for my hair and then we were even offered waters, soda & mints for the plane ride.  They are nothing but nice here!

Bruce even flew over the cottage we were staying at so we could see it from the air.  While on the flight the front passenger is even allowed to open the window for some great photo opportunities.  This was by far one of the highlights from our honeymoon.  I recommend Wings Over kauai to any and every body!

review_title: Your Kauai trip is not complete without Wings!
review_text: Our one-hour tour with bruce was the highlight of our visit to beautiful Kauai. The flight was very smooth, narrated with knowledge, humor, and personality, and the views were breathtaking. Don't jam yourself into a pricey helicopter ride...try Wings Over Kauai instead. Bruce and Ellen are just fabulous and the price is definitely right! We'd rate them as "super-excellent!" Phil & Vicki

We decided to fly with Wings Over Kauai as opposed to any of the helicopter tours. All three of us couldn't have been happier with our decision. Customer service was excellent and the flight was incredible. We had perfect weather and we ended up with some amazing photos, better than I could have expected.
We also loved the fact that our money was going to a small family business than a large impersonal corporation such as all those helicopter touring companies. Everything was very friendly and personal. You're not put together with strangers and the pilot makes you feel very comfortable. The pilot was very knowledgable and shared some very interesting facts with us.
It was simply perfect.

Beate

Although flying is not my favorite activity (it is one of my spouse's favorite activities), both of us  really enjoyed our flight over KAUAI with Bruce.  He honestly did "WOW" US with his knowledge of Kauai, the flora, the fauna and the physical attritudes of possibly the oldest and undoubedly the most beautiful of the Hawaiian Islands.  Ellen, his wife and partner, was very engaging and extremely helpful and courteous. Even though we had to reschedule our attempt at flying due to cloudy weather, Ellen accomodated us , even advising us of the weather as we traveled to the airport.  Some of our pictures, taken during the flight with Bruce were really fantastic; i.e., Bruce kept the plane masterfully under control.  By far the BEST ACTIVITY that we experienced during our 2 weeks on Kauai! Thanks guys for a wonderful 40th Anniversary adventure. F & R
Sept, 2008

We took the Grand Circle Istand flight yesterday in Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. It was the highlight of our vacation so far.  They use a single engine plane which seats four including the pilot.  We were a little apprehensive in the beginning when booked the tour but the owner- pilot, Bruce,   put us at ease from the very beginning.  He and his wife run a very professional operation and are pleasure to talk and deal with.  

Bruce treated us as if we his best customer ever in which I'm sure he does with all.  They where not in a rush to get us in and  out like most of the helicopters companies do.  Safety was foremost and they spent plenty of time preparing you for the flight.  The flight was spectacular from the smoothness of it to the scenery itself.  I don't think I've ever seen more beautiful scenery than Kauai from the air.  Bruce narrated during the whole flight.  No only did he demonstrate his vass knowledge of the island and it's eco-system, but he took the time to point perfect photo opportunities and even turned the plane to make sure you had an opportunity to capture the best shots.

During the flight, I was allowed to open the window to even get better shots.  The photos were undescribeable and will be great screensavers.

The best part of all is that the price of the tour is less than half of a comparable helicopter tour.  We have taken helicopter tours in Kauai before, but they were pale in comparison to Bruce's service.

I would highly recommend it to anyone who is considering a helicopter flight.  You'll be amazed by how much more you will see and by the expertise as well as professionalism demonstrated by Bruce and his wife.

Ron Brannon
Orland, Park, Illinois

review_title: a must to do on Kauai
review_text:
I wanted to make a present for my husband's birthday and I decided to book a flight with Wings Over Kauai.
It was a great idea and both my husband and I are enthusiastic about it.
Bruce and Ellen were very professional and explained us a lot of things; Bruce was wonderful, he gave us a lot of information and details during our flight which we enjoyed thoroughly.
The price is very competitive for a 60 minutes flight and I would recommend it to everyone, also to people who might be afraid of being sick on small planes (I am one of those and I hadn't any problem at all).
Wonderful experience.

Awesome, awesome experience!!

Flying over Kauai is the best way to take in the entire island. Only about 25% of the island is reachable by foot or car.

With 2 young kids (10 and 7) and my in-lwas who had not taken small plane or helicopter rides before we were debating between helicopter and air plane tour and we are glad we went with the airplane tour. And we are especially glad we chose "Wings Over Kauai".

While any air tour will allow one to see the beauty and scenery that nature has bestowed upon this Garden Island; what made our trip unforgettable was the great professionalism of Bruce, the pilot and co-owner of Wings of Kauai and the warm and personal treatment by Ellen, Bruce wife and co-owner who drives the land operations. 

Burce's intimate knowledge of the island was very evident in the narration he gave throughout the flight. His tidbits and sense of humor made the commentary very informative and fun. He clearly is an expert pilot and the flight was very safe and smooth. 
He was very patient, especially with our young sons, who asked a lot of questions and he added to their excitement. Sitting in the co-pilot seat in the front was the highlight of the trip for my 10 year old.

We were very touched with the warmth and kindness of Ellen, Bruce's wife and co-owner and clearly the two of them form a great team and run an excellent operation with high regards to customer satisfaction. Their personal touches made us feel at home and like family and it greatly enhanced our experience. They are very courteous and very accomodating and flexible. In deciding the timing of the flights we had questions about the fog which we had seen roll in, in the afternoon, on our drive up the Waimea Canyon the previous day. We took the noon flight and enjoyed a clear sky and Bruce was careful to fly beneath the clouds to allow us to get clear views and get great pictures and video.

The noise-free Bose headphones made the flight very enjoyable (Playing back the video we took told us how noisy it would've been without the headphones. I edited out the noise from my home vidoe when I transferred it to DVD). We were able to take several great pictures and the configuration of the aircraft allowed us to take steady and clear shots. 

We are very glad we went with Wings Over Kauai. Surely this was one of the top highlights of our trip to Kauai and we look forward to visiting the island in future. We highly recommend them and it will be time and money well spent.

review_title: This is the BEST air tour operator on Kauai
review_text: My wife and I took the custom flight on 8/23/08.  We were scheduled for an 1100 flight but the conditions were less the perfect so Captain Bruce suggested we come back later in the afternoon.  We arrived back at 1500 and went on a spectacular flight.  It lasted just over an hour and was the highlight of our seven days in Kauai.  This tour is much better then any of the air tour operators on the island and much more reasonable.

I love the flight and the owners were more than accommodating.  The flight even lasted than they stated. WONDERFUL.  This is a highly recommended agency to use.  They take last min. reservations and as struggling students, we found the price to be GREAT compared to some other companies.

This is the best activity you can do in Kauai.  Going up in the air lends you access to places people cannot set foot onto otherwise.  I am so glad we booked with Wings Over Kauai.  This small company is run by husband and wife, Bruce and Ellen.  Ellen was so incredibly helpful during the booking of the trip and once we got there, she was so friendly with all smiles.  The flight was so unbelievable personal!  It was Bruce the pilot, myself, and my husband.  We each got headphones to hear Bruce's narration and to ask questions.  We learned SO much from Bruce - he was an agriculturalist-turned-pilot so we learned so much about plant life and planes that I felt smarter when the flight was over.  The other helicopter  companies are VERY obnoxious and overly glitzy.  Go with the real deal!

We had a fantastic time with Bruce and Ellen on our tour of Kauai.  We received a warm, friendly greeting upon our arrival, and Bruce's good sense of humor and knowledge of the island made the in-flight experience both fun and educational.  After considering the helicopter option, we are SO glad we chose Wings over Kauai.  We had a personal experience and it was a great value!  Next time we are in Kauai, we will definitely go back.

Based on the excellent reviews in Trip Advisor, we picked this company for our air tour of Kauai - it was fabulous, we were not disspaointed!  The experience was very good from start to finish, both Bruce and Ellen put the emphasis on a personal experince and this comes through at all times, from the pre flight chat, inlcuding gifts for the ladies, to the after flight review.  The Cessna aircraft holds up to 3 passengers plus Bruce, the pilot, so the tour is very intimate.  Bruce does a great job with the inflight narration, his knowledge of the island is evident.  The package comes with a pre-flight photo and the aircraft has posh bose headphones which make the flight extremely comfortable.  My advice would be to avoid the over priced helicopter tours and go for this, a great hour spent of your holiday.

review_title: Start Your Kauai Island Visit with this Tour!
review_text: Bruce and Ellen Coulombe offer a great experience with their aerial tours of Kauai. I booked the flight online for a friend and me. I thought it best to do this early on in our 2wk stay so it would help us understand the layout of the island. Boy, did it ever. You can't even imagine the beauty of the island and there is so much to see. Ellen and Bruce are very warm and friendly and made us feel very special - we weren't just another couple of tourists.  At the start of the flight, before take-off, Bruce assigns you your role as part of the flight crew! Very fun. For those who may be a bit nervous to be in a small plane - don't worry.  You are in very safe and capable hands with Bruce at the controls. We had a fabulous day, clear skies & knock-out views! Next trip to Kauai, I will definitely do this again!!!!

My husband and I were on our honeymoon in Kauai, and this airplane tour was our favorite experience on the island. Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly and knowledgable, and Bruce gives a personalized, informative tour of the island from the plane. He will even open the window and adjust the plane in order to allow you to get the best photographs. The scenery is breathtaking... we had a wonderful experience. The flight was not bumpy or noisy. Bruce has expensive headsets that block out noise and allow you to talk with each other. We highly recommend this experience.

Bruce and Ellen really make you welcome and feel special,once in the aeroplane Bruce puts you at ease if you are abit unsure,he involves you in the take off routine,i was in control of the ventilation system(i held the window open abit)my wife read out the pre-flight check list,after that just a great time was had by all,Bruce tells you all about the plants,trees,canyons and anything else you can think of,plus you get to see parts of the island that can only be seen from the air,the only problem with the flight is it`s over to quick it just fly`s by,once again thanks to Bruce and Ellen for a great trip.

review_title: Skip the Helicopter Ride for Wings Over Kauai!
review_text: Because of the stellar TripAdvisor ratings, my husband and I booked a flightseeing tour with Wings Over Kauai (W.O.K.). This is a great alternative to a helicopter ride. Upon arrivial at W.O.K., Ellen warmly welcomed us and presented me witha kukui nut necklace and a fresh flower. For our flight, we were particularly blessed with a clear and sunny sky. The 1 hour Pali Mist tour led by pilot Bruce was fantastic! It costs $100 per person plus tax. We saw Waimea Canyon, several valleys and waterfalls, the Na Pali coast, Wailua Falls, and many other breathtaking sights. Bruce would turn the plane for us so we could get some awesome pictures! Take the noon flight if available. Since the helicopter tours are at lunch, you don't have to share the air space! Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!

review_title: Best value for an aerial tour of Kauai - bar none
review_text:
We did considerable research on aerial tours of Kauai, and we kept seeing strongly positive buzz about Wings Over Kauai. Their web site was clear and easy to understand, and their prices were absolutely unbeatable. Also, the reliable Cessna aircraft they use is dramatically safer than any helicopter, so we decided to give them a shot. And what a payoff that decision was. It was our best day on Kauai.

Bruce and Ellen were warm and friendly when we arrived, and went to great lengths to make sure we were comfortable. Ellen took pictures of us in front of and inside their clean, late-model Cessna 172.

Bruce helped us strap in and showed us how to use the top-quality Bose noise-cancelling headsets. These headsets allowed us to converse wtih him and ask questions during the flight - unlike some helicopter tours that only let you listen.

Bruce is a nice guy with an agri-science background. Want to know anything about crops in Hawaii? Bruce knows the answer.  As soon as the Cessna's engine fired up, Bruce came alive with a delightful narrative of Kauai, its history, its agriculture, and its stunning scenery. We got a full-hour tour, and it was worth every cent. And was considerably cheaper than a helicopter tour.

I give Wings Over Kauai my highest possible recommentation. The views of Waimea Canyon and the Na Pali coast were amazing, the narration was informative, interactive, and interesting, and we were treated like friends rather than customers. The experience was better than anything else we did on the island.

Words cannot express how awesome our flight over Kauai with Bruce was. It definitely was the highlight of our vacation in Kauai. At half the price of the helicopter tours, our Wings Over Kauai flight was first class from start to finish. Bruce and Ellen are a special couple running a family business with all the right touches from the fragrant gardenia flower, the beaded lei, their friendliness, their genuine concern for your comfort, to Bruce's professionalism in his flying and expertise in telling us all about the island. The authentic Hawaiian music and great sound system on his plane made the tour exceptional. Top of the line, Bose noise-reducing headphones were awesome. We could hear Bruce's wonderful narration of the island tour without the noise of the airplane and, we could converse with him as well. Ellen is so nice and friendly, too. She really gives  a welcomed, homey feeling to the tour. Taking a photo of us and then e-mailing it to us is an extra nice touch. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants the experience of a lifetime. Thanks again Bruce and Ellen!

Wings Over Kauai is not only an amazing value but an experience of a lifetime!  My husband and I both felt that it was the best part of our trip.  A family business, great value, exceptional customer service and amazing views - you can't beat it!  Bruce provided historical insight and melodious Hawaiian music, which made the flight that much more enjoyable.  The privacy of being able to share this memorable experience with my husband and not 8 or 10 additional visitors was great.  Thanks for the amazing flight Bruce and Ellen!  We will see you next time we are in Kauai!!!

I am an Instrument rated Private Pilot (haven't flown since we started having kids) and decided to take my 10 and 12 year old boys on the Na Pali Mist tour last week.  I read many reviews and not only felt excited about the flight, but also very comfortable taking my kids.  They had never been in a light plane and never got nauseous on this flight.

The experience was great.  It started with a preflight discussion about where we were going to go, what we would see, as well as flight safety.  Then we were introduced to the Pilot who provided more in-plane information on safety and the flight.  The condition of the plane was excellent.  Very airworthy aircraft.  

We took off and headed toward the Southeast corner of the island.  He maintained an excellent viewing altitude and knew where to fly the airplane and how to bank it to allow all the passengers to see the many highlights of the island.  His knowledge of the agriculture, history, and geology of the land is amazing.

As we headed up the canyons, the pilot used care to avoid the clouds to maintain good visual contact with the ground and with other aircraft (many helicopters).  He allowed me to put the window in the up position (the wind around the wing keeps it up once it's opened) to take some amazing photographs of the Na Pali coast.

All in all, it was a great flight.  Couldn’t have asked for more. 
I hate to mention it because it I didn't go on it because of the reduced cost, but the flight for the three of us was a quarter of what a helicopter ride would have cost.

The pilot was very safe and knowledgeable.  The aircraft is well maintained and in great condition.  You won't regret it.  Below is a sample of a picture from our flight....

A friend and I booked a flight with Bruce and it was one of the highlights of our two week trip to Kauai.  From the minute we walked up to the counter to the offer upon departing to give directions, we felt temporarily part of the family.  This is an intimate, family run operation and we couldn't have felt more welcome.  We felt totally safe in the aircraft, had a beautiful day and took amazing pictures.  This is definitely the most fabulous, low-cost activity on the island.

review_title: Donot Leave Kauai without taking this tour
review_text:
I was about to confirm my reservation on a helicopter tour when I came across the reviews on tripadvisor about Wings over Kauai. It has a 5 star rating with not a single negative or mediocre review so i though it had to be GREAT! 

We called and booked the same day and it turned out to be the highlight of my trip to Hawaii so much so that i am still thinking about it and want to write my first review ever on Tripadvisor about it. 

I wont go into details about my trip since a lot of travelleres have already written a lot of accurate stuff but I will say that you will definitely miss out on something if you donot take this tour. It is indeed the best $100/person you will ever spend on Hawaii.  Without giving details on the trip, spend that money and experience a flight of a lifetime.

My wife and I, along with our 10-yr. old daughter Alana, took this wonderful tour on June 13th.  The whole family at Wings Over Kauai was great - including Bruce and Ellen's daughter who checked us in.  The personal touch was really great and we recommend this tour to everyone!  Our flight was 70 minutes long and Bruce's commentary was thorough and never boring.  Of course, the tour is also much cheaper than the helicopter offered on the island.  The plane is perfect for taking pictures and the noise-canceling headsets with Hawaiian music in the background is a nice touch.  Most of all, of course, Kauai is breathtaking from the air.  The island had just experienced some heavy rainfall and we must have seen 100 waterfalls that day.  The highlight of the tour is the Napali coast and we flew over Napali for quite some time. review_title: Wonderful Welcome to the Garden Isle
review_text:
I booked Wings Over Kauai after reading several positive reviews and wanting something my entire family, including our infant, could enjoy.  I knew I wanted an aerial tour of Kauai, but was as leery of the helicopter tours as they were of my little one.  Because we were planning on flying with an infant, I wanted to make sure we wouldn't disturb or ruin anyone else's flight, so I was looking for a tour that was smaller, more personal and unique.  With Wings Over Kauai, we got that and more!
  When I called to reserve the tour, I spoke with Ellen who was both knowledgeable and VERY friendly.  She answered all my questions and was more than willing to work to help accommodate our little one.  The plane they fly is a 4-seater, so there wouldn't be anyone else to disturb, and she asked if there was anyplace specific we were looking to fly over so that they could try to work that into the flight plan.
  The day of the tour, we showed up early and both Ellen and Bruce (the pilot) greeted us and even presented a gift to our little 'keiki'.  When it came time to check-in and go over all of the preflight information, Ellen was helpful and made sure to answer all of our questions and concerns.  They even offered us a car seat so that my husband wouldn't have to hold our little one the whole flight, as well as small ear plugs to help with the noise.  They also offer a children's-sized headset, but we figured 10 months was a little young to enjoy or even keep it on.
  From take-off until landing, the flight was amazing!  Bruce was both professional and personable.  He explained all of the piloting jargon and information that was passing over the radio, and he also provided a narrative that gave information and details about what we were currently flying over.  He did his best to allow me ample opportunity to take photos and also informed me of potential photo ops that would be coming up.  Our little one had such a good time that she spent most of the flight laughing, cooing and just enjoying the air from the car seat.  My husband enjoyed himself and had a great view even from the rear seat.
  One warning for those not used to flying in small aircraft:  even on a clear day, it can get a bit bumpy and the nature of the island (mountains and valleys) make for some air pockets.  By the end of the flight, my stomach was definitely feeling a bit rough.  It had nothing to do with the plane or how it was being piloted, but it is something to keep in mind for those who might not have stomachs of steel.  Bruce was very helpful and prepared for any problems - he carried the obligatory air sickness bags but also had ginger candy, water, and a cold cloth that came in VERY handy as we got ready to land.

  Overall, I would HIGHLY recommend Wings Over Kauai.  Bruce and Ellen were very friendly and the ride itself worth EVERY penny.  For both my husband and myself, it was almost half the cost of a helicopter tour, and being able to bring our little one and fly a personal tour made it an even greater value.  Anyone looking for a fun and unique way to tour Kauai should definitely consider flying on Wings Over Kauai!

review_title: To Ride a Helicopter in Kauai or Not
review_text:
Definitely not!  I took a tour with Wings Over Kauai and my experience was fantastic.  I chose Wings Over Kauai because I felt like I was chartering my own private plane.  Wings Over Kauai has a four-seater airplane, so it will only be Captain Bruce and your party (2-3 people).  Wings Over Kauai also has the option to customize your tour to allow you to fly over the sites you want to see.  I wanted to see all the waterfalls on Kauai and Captain Bruce, the friendliest Captain you will ever fly with, flew us around the entire island and took us, as he jokingly told his wife afterwards, "to every [--] waterfall on the island".  If you think that helicopters have a better view than an airplane, think again.  The airplane Wings Over Kauai uses is engulfed with windows and I never noticed the wings my entire flight.  I guaranteed that a flight with Wings Over Kauai will be a highlight of your trip!  

If cost is a concern, it shouldn't be.  You should visit an Activity World booth, one is conveniently located at Coconut Coast Market.  You will need to attend a timeshare presentation.  Timeshare presentations are incredibly lame, but well worth your time.  My tour should have been $260, 70 min. for two people, but it was drastically reduced to $96.

We chose Wings Over Kauai because Bruce came highly recommended on numerous trip web sites – and Bruce has a lot of experience – not just flying in general, but specifically flying over Kauai (that was important to us). There was another plane outfit that had 2 pilots – one with a lot of experience flying over Kauai, the other with only about 2 years – and we could not get a guarantee of getting the one with the more experience. 

We were so happy we went with Wings Over Kauai!!! Bruce was very professional and we couldn’t have felt safer… he’s a very intelligent & contientious pilot, to be sure!! The plane is a 3-passenger Cessna – which gives everyone a window – and creates for a very tailor-made, personal flight experience!

Ellen runs the reservation desk at the Lihue airport commuter terminal. The Coulombes are delightful, warm, and welcoming people.
