Absolutely amazing. We truly felt like the goal was to make us happy every step of the way.  From really attentive customer service as we set things up to a wonderful pilot and flight route.  We didn’t know what to expect but there was nothing we were left wanting in the experience.  They also are very careful to ensure you are back before your boat so don’t worry about booking on your own - they will take care of you.
The front desk staff, pilot, and the fuelman were fantastic! Smooth flight and beautiful scenery. Highly recommended.

Wow! What a great experience. They worked with us because the weather wasn’t good for our morning flight. Rearranged pilots so we could go in the afternoon with Lenny of time to return to ship. The scenery was so unbelievable. We landed on a lake and was able to stand on plane pylons. It was so serene and beautiful. Great company and people. We booked directly with them.

Totally awesome!!! Highly recommend seeing Alaska from another vantage point!!
We did a surprise trip with friends-who had never been to Alaska-they said it was the best trip ever!

This was the highlight of our Alaskan cruise vacation as far as I'm concerned. The entire staff could not have been more pleasant.   Flying over Misty Fjords was simply magical.  The landscape was so unique and IMHO is best appreciated from the air.  We even landed on a small lake and were allowed to stop outside of the plan on the pontoons.  The music just added to the experience.  Thank you all for such a great memory!

Sea Wind Aviation was a fantastic tour operator. They were able to accommodate our party of 5 when another company canceled our trip a week before the scheduled date.
Our pilot Nate was great. He informed us about the plane, history and importance of bush planes in Alaska, and told us about what we were seeing. 
The sights of the Fjords and mountains from our low altitude were breathtaking. He took us right past a beautiful waterfall and hugged the mountains so we felt like we could almost touch them.
Landing in a remote quiet lake and wandering around for a few minutes was fun and amazing to experience. I would say it is definitely a must do activity for a visit to Ketchikan and Sea Wind Aviation is the company to do it with!

This flight was a highlight of our Alaskan adventure in many ways. As a retired pilot I enjoyed the flight in the Otter and envy our Pilot (Russ?) getting to fly around the fjords daily!. 
The scenery is spectacular and I would highly recommend taking the option of a landing on the fjord. Stepping out onto the float in the middle of the calm fjord, in near silence, was just amazing.

We flew with Eric on the DeHavilland Otter. Our group of 5 was joined by 5 others, which was fine with us. The bus was easy to find and the ride was short. Lesley got us checked in right away. Our larger bags were stored safely behind the desk.
The flight was absolutely breathtaking, it is hard to describe in words. The plane was well maintained and we felt very safe. This is a do not miss experience in Ketchikan!

We had an amazing time! The best excursion we’ve ever done. We were in awe the entire time of the natural beauty of Alaska and Ketchikan. Getting so close to the mountains and seeing goats grazing plus the lake landing was beyond words!

SeaWind Aviation was amazing.  They were able to find us a replacement pilot on short notice and he was a terrific pilot.  We landed at a remote lake that was the most beautiful and quietest place I have ever been.  I would highly recommend SeaWind Aviation for any flight.

Absolutely amazing. We truly felt like the goal was to make us happy every step of the way.  From really attentive customer service as we set things up to a wonderful pilot and flight route.  We didn’t know what to expect but there was nothing we were left wanting in the experience.  They also are very careful to ensure you are back before your boat so don’t worry about booking on your own - they will take care of you.
The front desk staff, pilot, and the fuelman were fantastic! Smooth flight and beautiful scenery. Highly recommended.

We were lucky to have a beautiful day with great weather.  The trip was amazing.  The views were unbelievable.  One of the best parts was the water landing.  I had no idea that we would just land in the water and get out and stand on the plane in the middle of the water.  Very cool!  I highly recommend Sea Wind Aviation.  We were on a cruise and this was by far the best excursion we took.

Our experience with SeaWind was amazing!  We took the flight to the Misty Fjords and landed on a lake at very high elevation in the mountains.  We had a beautiful sunny day.  The pilot, Saul (sp?), was great and provided a lot of information on what we were seeing.  The area in Alaska is so remote and beautiful.  It was great to have this opportunity to see it from high up.  I would recommend taking a flight if you can afford it.  Kind of a once in a lifetime opportunity.

We were a family of three so were placed with another couple.  The plane held six total.  Scheduling was easy and they were in contact when we arrived in Ketchikan on our cruise.  It is noisy so we were given headsets and were able to talk through these.  We did not see any bears but one mountain goat made an appearance.  Overall, awesome time.

I was really looking forward to a trip on a float plane / seaplane, this totally exceeded my expectations. Steve the owner is an amazing pilot and all round nice guy. The take-offs and landings were smoother than on a runway which really surprised me, the views were absolutely mind blowing, and touching down in Misty Fjord to be greeted by a bear working his way along the bushes eating berries was made to order, and the along came a seal. I did some amazing trips on this tour, but this is the one I would not miss given a second chance. Thank you Steve and all the staff for memories made.

It was truly a bucket list experience...the pilot was great and so helpful when I was a little fearful of getting out on the float.  The views were magnificent and everyone we dealt with at the office and in the transport to and from the meeting point were very friendly and courteous...highly recommend

review_title: Amazing Experience with Misty Fjords Flight Tour
review_text: Our Misty Fjords Flight Tour was incredible! Our pilot, Sol, was friendly and informative, making the experience even better. We were lucky to have clear skies, which allowed us to enjoy the amazing views fully. The highlight was spotting a mountain goat on one of the cliffs. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to experience the beauty of the Misty Fjords!

The tour was breathtaking. We had to delay our 10 am trip because of low cloud coverage and rain. They were able to accommodate us on a later flight and an alternate path. We are so grateful for the experience and the flexibility of the entire team. We felt safe the whole time and enjoyed the music and history of the area. We would definitely recommend doing this tour!

Riding a seaplane for the first time was interesting.  The sights during the 90 minute flight were okay, not amazing.  Landing during the trip and getting out added a little to the experience, not much.

I would not recommend this tour because of the cost vs. the experience.

The administration and pilot were very good.

Terrific way to see Alaska. My 2 granddaughters, age 15 and 17, said it was their favorite excursion by far. The pilot gave us good insights on what we were seeing. He landed the plane and pulled up close enough to land that we could hop right off -no problem. I got to sit in the co-pilot seat which was awesome. Photos and videos were gorgeous. The take-offs and landings were smoother than on land flights. Don’t miss this chance of a lifetime. Sea Wind makes all the connections and tour easy. This is a local, Alaskan company that is top rated.

Excellent service
Amazing landscapes by the fjords with water stop
I highly recommend this tour of the Misty Fjords with Seawind

review_title: There’s a reason this is 5 star.
review_text:
I just want to echo the majority of these reviews. Communication/coordination was super easy and the trip itself was simply spectacular. We had an excursion cancel the day before in Skagway so we decided at the last minute to splurge on this tour for our last day in Alaska. Turns out this is the one excursion that should have been an absolute lock. Yeah, I was iffy on the price for such a short trip. I was wrong. This flight is what I will talk about for years when I recount my Alaska trip. Anthony was our pilot and he was super informative.  Leslie was the coordinator and I was big time nervous about making it back to the remote Norwegian dock on time.  They listened to my concerns and explained exactly what would happen, and it happened EXACTLY that way. We landed at 5:00 for a last shuttle at 5:30 and it was NO PROBLEM. Made it in plenty of time. (Note: non-Norwegian cruises dock right there nearby so they don’t have to worry about the shuttle back). 

Being greeted back by the golden retriever at the end of the tour is a pure bonus.

This company was Amazing from the time you enter their small building. They had a variety of stuffed animals on display. Extremely friendly and very professional outfit. They will pick you up from the downtown port area. And the experience of getting high up and "Flight seeing" was Bucket list worthy, Spectacular and Amazing. Then the pilot landed on a mountain lake and we got to stand on the pontune of the plane. I Just cannot say enough about the company and the experience. They also have two golden retrievers on property, one of which Loves to swim in the ocean.

review_title: DO IT!!! YOU WILL NEVER SEE THE MISTY FJORDS LIKE THIS ON A CRUISE SHIP!!
review_text:
DO IT!!! You will never see Alaska like this on a cruise ship!!! 

It's worth every penny you spend!!! 

Our pilot was a local native and has a vast mental library of knowledge that he freely shares!

 We took my mobilty and health-impaired moms on this excursion to which the staff were very understanding and accommodating. Leslie picked us up, not even an 8th of a mile from the cruise ship port. So convenient!

High quality plane with a high quality staff and pilot!!!

DO IT!!!!

review_title: Fantastic Flight, Fabulous Scenery, Great Operation.
review_text: Fantastic trip.  Very professional, but friendly too.  Picked us up and dropped us off from the cruise terminal.  Beautiful views that were out of this world.  Got to land on a remote lake and get out to take in the Natural Grandeur. Greeted by the two golden retrievers upon our return.  Highly recommend.

review_title: Thrilling view of the Misty Fjords National Monument.
review_text: A thrilling sight seeing tour. Our pilot was very professional and friendly. The views from the air (not very high) were amazing. We had a drizzly day and it actually made the fjords cool looking. The pickup and drop off were seamless. Right on time. We had to reschedule from an earlier date because of a conflict. They were super responsive of our needs and rescheduled at a time we could go.
My teen daughters and I had a wonderful flight!  We will remember the experience for years to come.  Wonderful people to do business with!

review_title: Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation - SPECTACULAR
review_text: Loved this tour!  We received a 'reminder' text the day before our tour and again the morning of the flight which gave us peace of mind knowing that our tour was on schedule.  Everyone at SeaWind were friendly and engaging.  Our flight captain provided commentary throughout the flight.  A highlight was the tight turn within a  mountain range in order to land on one of the lakes.  The scenery was spectacular.  Photo's don't do it justice.  We were fortunate that the weather cooperated as Juneau receives 12.5 feet of rain annually, but on this day, we had a mix of sun and cloud. The lakes were like glass.  Misty Fjords with SeaWind Aviation was top-notch.
Best part of our family Alaskan cruise.  The views were astounding!  Our pilot, Rick , was very experienced and informative. The staff was great. An amazing adventure.

The scenery and views from the plane were amazing. Max was a great pilot, and handled everything confidently. He did a great job of explaining some of the things we saw. Landing on the lake was incredible! What a great experience!

Lesley was amazing in emailing us details as they changed. We also called on the day of our trip and she kept us informed as to where they would pick us up for our tour. As they were down a plane due to issues they arranged for us to fly with Timber in his Cessna. It was the three of us with him and he had our grandson sit up front with him. He explained all the instruments to our grandson and have us a great tour. We landed on a beautiful lake, got out and walk around before the flight back. As we were flying back I seen a black bear on the ice, Timber turned the plane around so that everyone could see and the bear had moved to the rocks, but everyone else was able to see the bear. It was a very clear sunny day, so no mist but we loved every minute.

review_title: Disappointing Experience and Lack of Professionalism
review_text:
I had booked the Misty Fjords flightseeing tour for 1.5 hours with a landing, along with 8 other friends and family members, nearly 90 days in advance. However, my experience with SeaWind Aviation was a nightmare.

Less than 12 hours before my scheduled departure, I received an email informing me that my flight had been changed from 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM, and instead of the 1.5-hour tour with a landing that I had booked, it was now a 1-hour tour. To make matters worse, my friends were given different flight times, separating our group.

When I tried to contact Lesley, our point of contact, she was unhelpful and suggested canceling for a full refund instead of resolving the issue or providing a reasonable explanation for the changes.

I am extremely disappointed with SeaWind Aviation's lack of professionalism and their failure to honor the tour package I had booked and paid for well in advance. Changing the tour details at the last minute and separating our group without proper communication or justification is unacceptable.

I would not recommend SeaWind Aviation to anyone seeking a reliable and professional flightseeing experience in the Misty Fjords area.

This was a 10 out of 10 experience! Our pilot, Sol, is a native to the area, very experienced, and he had some great stories to tell while we were flying over the Misty Fjords. I can’t thank him enough for being a part of my family’s experience on a seaplane. ❤️
What an absolute AMAZING experience.  We booked this flight outing not with Princess.  We took a little gamble.  It paid off!  This was the high point of our trip, which was great!

The Misty Fjords flight tour was simply amazing! Great views and Max our pilot was great! He Took his time explaining the scenery and making sure we all had a great experience. I would highly recommend this tour! It’s some of the most beautiful scenery I have ever seen.
The flight was beautiful and the weather was a wonder. We landed in a remote area which was stunning to say the least. The pilot was skilled and informative. Best part of our trip

The ease of getting to the site from ship was VERY eas y (short walk).  The pilot and office were friendly and helpful.  The flight was AMAZING and the pilot did a great job telling history, sites and folktales...LOVED IT .... great views of cliffs, Fjords, lakes and forest.
We even landed on a small lake and had time to see the shore line and seclusion.
Best Excurion I have ever been on in my 30 years of cruising.  5+ stars

What an experience! We did 90 minutes with a stopover. Our pilot Sol was absolutely excellent. My favorite moment was passing up between mountains over a gushing waterfall and then over the lake above that flowed down. I also enjoyed circling over a whale, which gave a very different perspective on it and its size than seeing it from the side, and following goats up a hillside. Every moment was magical and unforgettable. I never stopped taking photos and vids because it was all so beautiful and I wanted these beautiful memories that would last longer. The stopover was well worth it, not because it was especially interesting, but because it broke up the experience and made it feel varied and longer.

review_title: Absolute best thing I did on my Alaska  cruise.
review_text:
Incredible !   This tour is a must do.  I’d give it 6 stars if I could.   Stunning up close view of the mountains  fjords and wildlife.   We landed at the base of a waterfall and were able to get out on shore for some great photos and a walk about.  
Highly highly recommend this tour and this company.   They were wonderful.
This was the best view of Alaska and an amazing experience.  So glad we did this. Breathtaking. Easy to book with our large group.
The views were absolutely stunning, and the staff was amazing as well. Definitely the highlight of our week in Ketchikan. Pilot has some fire aux skills as well!

review_title: Fantastic experience on our Misty Fjords flightseeing trip!
review_text:
We had a fantastic experience on our Misty Fjords flightseeing trip! 

Before we even booked our tour Lesley was so great at answering the many questions we had for our group of six. We were gifted a gorgeous sunny day for our flight and had a great trip with Pilot Steve. He was very knowledgeable about the area wildlife and their habitats. We each had a window seat, and my husband was even able to ride in the front with Steve. Landing on the fjord was incredible.

Do not hesitate to book this tour with SeaWind - one of the top highlights of our Alaska trip!

review_title: A Float-plane is great way to see Alaska.  Great experience
review_text:
The flight was high point of the entire cruise.  Absolutely stunning to be flying among a maze of 1000 foot cliffs.  Great landing on a mountain lake where the water was so clear you could see fish 15 feet down. 

The staff was friendly and the pilot very competent.  If you want to really see Alaska, a seaplane is one of the best ways to get a feel for the majesty of the land, and I highly recommend SeaWind

review_title: Fantastic family owned and operated, the best float plane tours in Ketchikan !
review_text: This was a fantastic flight and tour with a very professional pilot, I have flown with Seawind before and have had nothing but an amazing time. This is a local family-owned tour operation, and they will give you the best in personal attention and recommendations for a wonderful tour. As a pilot i highly recommend this wonderful experience with this family-owned adventure! Beautiful mountains and you maybe even will see a whale from below ! Tell them Len sent you !

review_title: Best Sea Plane tour in Ketchikan
review_text: This is a wonderful family owned operation and with  very professional pilots and fully inspected and well maintained aircraft   As a professional pilot myself I would not consider flying with anyone else , Sea Wind Avaition will provide you with a great flight and fun time , I have flown with them before and will continue to give them 5+ stars for a fantastic adventure flight , tell them Len sent you ! They are the best.

review_title: Best experience of our Alaskan cruise!
review_text: This was the highlight of our Alaska cruise! The pictures can't even do it justice. Steven, the pilot, shared lots of great info and took us over the most amazing sights. When we passed over a whale, he circled once so everyone could see it. Same thing when he spotted a black bear eating dandelions! Leanne, the shuttle driver, was sweet as can be. And their dog was so friendly and adorable. If you can only afford one shore excursion during your cruise, do this one!!!

review_title: Amazing views and great customer service
review_text: This was an excellent trip through the fjords, despite the cloudy, rainy day.  It does rain 200 days a year in Ketchikan, so we were not surprised. Lesley worked with us as we tried to sort out an itinerary conflict which she brought to our attention and made sure that we were able to enjoy this excursion and get back to the ship in time.

This was a very lovely relaxing experience 
I have severe motion sickness and somehow did not barf all over everyone 
The views were absolutely breathtaking 
The pilot was knowledgeable and safe and talked just enough to give you info but not distract your zen
The office was clean and new and their two dogs were icing on the cake- such sweet babies! 
I would absolutely recommend this company (over the others) because the others did not inspire confidence.. I kept thinking …
“That guy is taking people in a plane?!”
Ignore the weirdo guy and just book with these guys- there IS a difference

Highlight of our trip.  Everything you read in all the other positive reveiws is accurate.  Book this you will not regret it.   Bucket list flight.  Easy to get to, easy and smooth to get on and get off.  Beautiful!  Friendly staff

Amazing trip! Would definitely recommend and do again. Lovely pilot and perfect landing and cruising. Once he heard we were interested in wildlife it became a Find Waldo adventure in addition to taking in the breathtaking views. Wonderful!
The views were unbelievable. The pilot and staff were extremely professional. One of the best experiences of our lives.

review_title: Alaska flight and two Golden Retrievers.
review_text: This was a great experience.  We were originally scheduled for the Bear Viewing trip but they called us and said it was getting too late for bears - would we like to cancel or switch to Misty Fjords, which is what we opted for. When we first arrived it was raining with low ceilings.  So we waited around for a bit with the owners two goldens.  After the weather cleared we had a terrific flight into the fjords are with a landing at a lake.  Got out and walked the pontoon for a while and then took off for more sightseeing through the fjord area.  Never knew seaplane takeoffs and landings could be so smooth.  Even my wife, who was a little apprehensive felt safe and had a great time. Flying that low over the landscape gave you a wonderful opportunity for sightseeing and pictures.  The owners are a husband and wife team that went the extra mile to make this an unforgettable Alaska experience.  Top that off with two Golden retrievers in the lobby!
Wonderful experience and we loved the approach! Soft drinks and Champagne are offered. The view is breathtaking from the top. Totally worth it.

Viewing the landscape this way is a must. We were so amazed by the beauty and feel so lucky we were able to do. The whole TAT staff and crew were great from check in to check out - props to Liz who was so sweet and helpful and put us right at ease (plus has the best hair in Alaska) and our pilot Cade who was awesome, gave us a smooth and relaxing ride.  Hope to get back someday. Highly recommend TAT.
Our pilot Cade did an awesome job. What amazing experience! It exceeded every expectation and we all highly recommend booking the mountain voyager while in Talkeetna.

All we can say is WOW!!!! We were a family of 6 that did the Mountain Voyager tour on August 22. The company did tell us that our pilot was running about 10-15 minutes late but they still gave us the full time advertised. We were on a small plane that carries 10 people. Everyone gets a window seat. We all put on headphones so we can hear all the info that our pilot, Dan, wanted to relay to us. The flight was smooth, simple, and we felt very safe throughout. What we saw just blew our minds! To see the completely snow covered mountains and the glaciers from where they form and down till they end was just other worldly! And although we didn't actually get to see much of Denali itself, seeing everything else was just a sight we will never, ever forget!

review_title: Great experience for those who can stomach it.
review_text: Cons: Hard to hear the pilot. Crazy expensive.  Pros: Great scenery; good length of trip: fun to land on glacier.  Overall recommend.

Took Mountain Voyager with glacier landing with my wife and 3 girls (14, 13 & 10). It was amazing. Seeing Denali and the other peaks up close gives it a totally different perspective. Glacier landing was definitely worth it, and family thought that was the best part. Pilot talked about everything we were seeing and made plenty of turns so everyone gets equal viewing of everything regardless of what side you were on. Pluto was great. 
Our original flight was cancelled due to weather, but company worked to book us the following day so we didn’t miss the experience. It was awesome. 
We had a clear day, so we were able to see Denali. Because of that, I don’t think it was necessary to do the longer flight.  I may have felt differently if we couldn’t see Denali as clearly as we did.  If you are trying to save money, spend it on the glacier landing rather than the longer flight time.

Absolutely the most amazing thing we did on our Alaska vacation.  I did a lot of research and settled on Talkeetna Air Taxi as the best option.  We were not disappointed!  We got rained out twice, but they have a great cancelation policy, which is good because weather is so unpredictable.   Third time was a charm.   Conditions were excellent, and we had a great flight.  Andy was a great pilot, very skilled and he took us to all the best places.  The glacier landing was a highlight and worth the extra money.  Allow flexibility in you itinerary for a reschedule.  You'll be glad you chose Talkeetna Air Taxo!

review_title: Everything from take off to return was just a mind blowing experience. Especially Glacier landing was an awesome exp
review_text: This was once in a lifetime experience!! Talkeetna Air Taxi exceeded our expectation and I would highly recommend the glacier landing

This was a wonderful tour! Easy to book, well organized.
They were able to accommodate us on an earlier tour when the weather was going to take a turn.
The views were  spectacular and landing on a a glacier was so much fun!
Our pilot Liam was calm, reassuring and knowledgeable.
This was a pricy tour, but the experience was priceless!

review_title: Highlight of a 14 day trip to Alaska - and there were many highlights!
review_text:
We cruised into Alaska, spent 7 more days driving around.  This was our first stop and probably the family highlight because we had never done a flightseeing trip before.

Upon arrival, we were told that the cloud ceiling was pretty low, so our trip would likely be cut short, but we would be refunded for the difference or we could try to reschedule for another day, but there weren't any promises it would get better....our day was the first "good" flying day in a few days.

Being on a bit of a timeline, we opted to go ahead with it and were not disappointed.  our pilot, Ace, was amazing.  He talked to us along the way, gave all kinds of information about the area, pointed out rivers, glaciers, cabins, mountains whose names escape me.  He was genuinely bummed that it wasn't clear enough for a glacier landing, he wanted us to experience that.  Flying around, and probably through communicating with others, he "found a hole in the clouds..." and there we were, looking at the summit of Denali!  Absolutely breathtaking.

Additionally, he pointed out part of a glacier that must have just calved and did an extra circle around.

By day's end, I had a credit back on my card - which was far more than anticipated, and I was glad I had tipped him (what I thought) well.  We didn't start a stop watch on take off, so I really don't know how much time was missed.   The fact that TAT took care of us so well ensures that we will certainly consider them first the next time we are in Talkeetna.

I never felt unsafe in the plane.  Ace's expert flying skills were evident from take off to landing.  Truly, I've felt much harder landings on much bigger planes.  I only wish I had taken the time to ask how he got into flying, if he has favorite routes, learned a bit more about the hiker and skier drop offs - all things he would have told me if I hadn't left the plane with my family in complete awe of the experience.

Seats are tight.  I'm a tall guy (6'7") and was glad for the space right by the door.  It does get a little drafty on board, so if you are cold-sensitive, layer up.

Truly a lifetime highlight - and I can't wait to do it again.

My husband and I took the Mountain Voyager with Glacier landing. Daniel, pilot, was extremely knowledgeable about the area, identifying the various mountains and geography.  We were there on a perfect blue bird day and were able to clearly see Mount Denali. Adding the glacier landing made this an exceptional experience. We had a limited amount of time so we wouldn't have gotten to Denali National Park without the  glacier landing. We got so close to the mountain and were able to check the box on another National Park. Highly recommend!

review_title: Don’t miss this once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
Amazing! I’ve been lucky to have many extraordinary experiences in my travels over the years and this is up there among the best! 

Seeing the Denali Ranges from the air and landing on the glacier is an experience my daughter and I will never forget. 

Don’t miss this once in a lifetime experience. Highly recommended!

review_title: I would highly recommend this tour and this company!
review_text: We were able to get so close to the mountains. It was an amazing experience! Walking on the glacier surreal! The pilot was very entertaining and knowledgeable. The staff were very friendly and accommodating.

This was the trip of a lifetime! Very professional, accommodating, friendly staff. We were blessed with excellent viewing weather. Landing, then walking on Ruth Glacier looking up at Denali was breathtaking. 
Our pilot/guide, Liam from New Zealand was awesome!
Amazing trip, well worth it. Once in a lifetime opportunity to fly above the clouds and see the mountains up close. Would recommend, pictures do not do it justice!
Absolutely amazing flight with close up views of those magnificent mountains. Smooth flight with very good commentary from the pilot

All the staff at Talkeetna Air were super wonderful. Flight was smooth with incredible views. We were blessed with rare clear skies as far as the eye could see. Able to see entire range of mountains. Thank you.

An ABSOLUTE MUST if the weather is good.  Denali and the larger mountain range were simply majestic.  It was a once-in-a-lifetime indulgence that we'll never forget, and the height of our 2-week Alaska adventure.  And, the staff -- Iris, Chase, were accommodating, helpful and experienced.

The company/guide were simply amazing! The views were gorgeous, and they went above and beyond to make it a memorable experience for us! We would highly recommend this company, and it is worth every bit of the money! A special shoutout to our pilot Cade whose thoroughness and narrative helped define our experience. Will definitely be returning in the future.
The staff were so kind and helpful.  Our pilot was amazing.  The views gave us a unique perspective of the glaciers and height.  The experience is unforgettable.
We had a great great time during this tour. Weather was fantastic. Pilot's soundtrack was awesome coupled with Unparalleled views of mountain. Complete ZEN experience. Highly recommended.

Amazing bucket list experience! They picked us up where Princess dropped us off, took us downtown and came back to get us 45 minutes before our ride. Took us back to Princess busses after. Easy to reserve. Clay was an amazing pilot. There were 10 of us on the plane. We took a long scenic flight to the glacier, landed and spent about 15 minutes on the glacier. The trip back was faster, total time about 2 hours.

We booked this same day since the weather had been iffy all week.  Had been in contact with the other popular company but went here bc they were rated #1, and also recommended by our helicopter tour pilot out of Palmer.  Liam was our pilot-super safe, friendly & personable.   He did a great job explaining things and taking us to see the vastness of the Alaska Range.  Denali was visible from Talkeetna part of the day and during our entire flight! What a treat.  Highly recommend this company.  (However, if you’re choosing between helicopter or plane flight tour for your vacation-I personally am in love with helicopters.)

review_title: Amazing views deep in the canyons with the glacier landing.
review_text: This was an awesome flight from our New Zealander pilot Liam.  This dude was a great pilot as well as knowing the land.  Very knowledgeable guy.  He was always pointing out little history of the AK land.  He was very interesting to listen to.  For the flight it was awesome landing in the snow and taking off in a short distance was pretty cool.  They gave us little over shoes for everyone so we didn’t get our feet wet in the wet high mountain snow. I will never for get it as Liam took some epic pics of my wife and I at our landing spot up on the mountain.  Can’t thanks them enough for the awesome flight.
Chris our pilot was great . Fantastic experience mind blowing views of the Denali range and the glacier. Insane landing on the glacier. Just brilliant.

We did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing on June 19.  We chose Talkeetna Air Taxi because Trip Advisor calls them  "#1 of 35 Tours & Activities in Talkeetna".  I called in March and spoke with Amy to discuss our flight options.  Amy was great in taking the time to understand our situation and address our concerns.  I told her my wife was a supplemental oxygen user and asked if there would be any issues. She told me we could not do the summit tour due to the height the plane flew, the need to user flight oxygen, and concerns about my wife's ability to quickly change from her oxygen concentrator to their air.  Amy said we could do either Grand Denali or Mountain Voyager and recommended the glacier landing.  I thanked her for her help and said i would be back to book in a couple weeks after we planned all our excursions for our stay in Talkeetna.  We ultimately decided to fly Monday afternoon.  When I returned to book I learned that many of their planes were reserved for summit landings that day and only the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing would be going out that afternoon.  We booked that and are so happy we did.

Everyone was great from the time we arrived.  The ladies there fitted us in landing suits with boots and helped put the boots on over our shoes.  We flew with Liam.  He gave is a safety briefing before we took off.  The views we had early on were amazing.  He did a soft touch down for the Glacier landing, and we spend about a half hour walking the glacier, watching another plane land.  it started raining whine we were on the glacier.  After we took off  we flew a little more when Liam said because of weather he would have to cut the flight short and we would get refunds for the time we missed.  I calculated that from the time we boarded the plane to touch down we were short 5 minutes, from take off to touch down we were short 10 minutes.  Without our asking they refunded 15 minutes flight time.  They couldn't have been more generous.  

After landing, we asked for recommendations for something to eat.  Not only did they give us a couple recommendations, but they gave us a ride to the one we chose.  Thank you all at TAT.

Only issue - they sell t-shirts that are rolled-up in their office.  When we got home my wife found her ladies medium was too snug and wished she bought a large.
LOVED this company. They were organized and very professional. Our pilot was so interesting and informative.

Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!  Our pilot was Dan and he took his time explaining the geography. We also had plenty of time on the glacier landing for photos and checking it out.  We went above the clouds to see the peaks and it was breathtaking!  We felt safe and the customer service on the ground was also top notch.  I highly recommend doing this...worth every penny!!

Alaska is absolute beauty and there is no better place to see that than with Talkeetna Air Taxi’s flightseeing Denali with glacier landing.  Words don’t describe the majestic beauty. Everyone at Talkeetna Air Taxi was efficient, safety conscious and so helpful. Liam was a wonderful pilot!

 If you are trying to talk yourself out of doing this tour, re-think the decision.  You truly don’t want to miss what Talkeetna Air Taxi
can show you of Denali’s beauty!!

GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE -  This was my second trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi, the first being 15 years ago.  They were incredibly accommodating in trying to make sure the experience was as perfect as the weather would allow.  We had three days of rain in Talkeetna, but the staff kept working with us to re-schedule our Denali Trip. We were finally rewarded with a perfect day. Not many trip providers are willing to keep re-scheduling to make everything is as great as it can be.

review_title: This place is number 1 for a reason!
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal flight. Our pilot was Chris and he was great. The photos we took are beautiful but do no justice to the breathtaking views throughout the entire flight. Friendly, super professional, awesome and top notch in every way.

Because of all the fantastic reviews, we tried 4 times (due to weather) to get our flight in while we were in Alaska.  We were finally able to get off the ground on our last day - and it was def worth it!  TAT communicated the delays and worked diligently to keep rescheduling us.  It was amazing and more than worth it!  Our pilot was great (wish I remembered his name to give him kudos (flew Aug 2 at 11 am)).  The mountains were spectacular!  Highly, highly recommend!!

I was a little concerned in a small plane which are old and had a little gasoline smell in the beginning before takeoff.  But the pilot was wonderful and guided us around Denali mountains and glaciers with amazing confidence and knowledge that I forgot about the smell which was also gone. 

The best part of the trip was landing and taking off from the glacier and then seeing the scenery all around us.  Breathtaking beauty!! 

 Some of the glaciers are receding according to the pilot and I wondered when we will not be able to see these wonders of nature.

This was one of the highlights of my trip to Alaska! We had a beautiful day in September. The glacier landing was definitely a must do and I was definitely in awe. Our pilot and tour guide was amazing. She took care of us and was super knowledgeable about everything about Denali. I would do this tour again!

Did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing.  We went in the afternoon at 1.30. It was questionable if we were going to get to go because of weather.  Luckily it cleared enough to go.  Need to be flexible or understand that the weather can change and your trip will be canceled.  Our plane had our family of 7 and 3 others. The Mountains were amazing and it looked like were were very close but were not. Took about 30 minutes to get to the glacier and landed.  We were there about 15 minutes and then flew back. Tour was about 1 3/4 hour.  We all had headsets and the pilot explained what we ere seeing. This was one of my families  favorite tours.  If I had to pick taking the bus tour of Denali or doing this tour,  I would pick this right away.

a truly awe inspiring once in a lifetime experience flying between massive rocks peaks and glaciers. 
then landing in a stunning 35 acre Amphitheatre with mountains in all directions
worth every penny
If you’re debating, DO IT! One of my most memorable experiences while I was in Alaska. Incredible views.

Of the 18 days we spent in Alaska, this Flightseeing Tour was one of two top exceptional experiences! Safety is number one for these folks, our pilot was experienced, everything was well organized, and we were well taken care of. 

The pilot's narrative enhanced the experience, in that we knew what we were looking at. The views were amazing, seriously some of the most beautiful scenery ever!

The glacier landing was flawless, thrilling, and once in a lifetime!

The plane was comfortable as were the headsets.

We had signed up for the Grand Denali Tour, but at the pilot's discretion, we did not circumvent the mountain due to weather. However, the pilot made sure that the experience was exceptional. He flew the plane in such a way that the passengers on both sides of the plane got to see all of the views.

We got a refund for the difference between the flight we booked and the flight we took. We felt appreciated as customers, and the pilot expressed thanks for all of us (9) flying with them. Do this!

We had hoped to do the Denali glacier landing tour but were unable to due to weather. However, the experience was still magnificent. Our pilot was kind and very knowledgeable. The views of the lower glaciers and fall colors were still spectacular. We will definitely be back to try for the Denali flight sometime in the future (weather permitting of course)

From the very beginning the flight was unbelievable. The sun was shining and the views were beyond spectacular!  A chance of a life time and well worth the price.
Paul made us feel at ease while flying because he was so competent in all aspects of the flight. He was very knowledgeable and informative as well as making us feel comfortable throughout.
We took the Mountain Voyager with glacier landing tour. It was absolutely fabulous. ATA is very organized and employees were very friendly. This tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

Great experience.  Out pilot, Sean, was fantastic.  he worked hard to show use three big peaks as well as glaciers.  We could not do the glacier landing due to the conditions on the ground, something we were warned about prior to boarding the flight.  But that did not stop this from being a memorable trip.  Thank you!

review_title: Would give it 10 stars if I could!
review_text: Our family took this flight with a glacier landing. I wrestled with whether to do the landing or not and decided to go ahead and book it knowing that many times they get cancelled. The day of our flight was cloudy but had no rain. When we arrived they told us that the earlier flight had been cancelled due to visibility, but ours would be able to fly. Since there was a lot of cloud cover in the lower elevations we would not be able to land though. We were given the choice to cancel or reschedule, but it would have been difficult to fit it into our schedule on another day. Besides, the next time might be worse. We decided to go ahead and go and were assured that we would still have good views once we got above the clouds.  We seemed to be flying in complete clouds for a few minutes and I thought it was going to be a bust and then we broke through the clouds and wow! As we flew around up there the clouds seemed to dissipate and the next thing we knew the pilot said it had cleared so much that we were going to be able to land!  It was a very smooth landing on snow and we landed at base camp where the hikers start their journey to climb Denali. It was absolutely amazing to stand there among those majestic mountains. Words cannot even describe it. We had plenty of time to take photos and walk around. You could go pretty far if you wanted and there were cones set up that you were not to go past. Then back on the plane and were heading down the hill and rather than the plane lifting up it was like the ground just falls away from the plane. You feel so close to the huge mountains, but they said we were still 10 miles away at least! The pilot was very experienced, the flight and landing very smooth, and pilot communicated with us through headsets. Facemasks are requred due to covid. It was an amazing experience for our family and in my opinion a must-do in Alaska if you have the funds.

This was definitely a highlight of our trip. There were 10 of us so we had our own plane! It was a beautiful sunny day and the views were spectacular!  The landing on the glacier was fun and our group had a competitive snowball fight. Thank you for the memories.

Fantastic experience. Had signed up for the summit tour w glacier landing but visibility prevented flying over the summit.  So the pilot changed the itinerary to the mountain voyager with glacier landing and the trip was unforgettable. 

I highly recommend taking the flightseeing trip with glacier landing. Breath taking views, knowledgeable and experienced pilots, responsive company.

They are very customer friendly, accommodative and professional. Definitely worth the experience. The view over the Denali will blow you away. This was one of the highlights of our trip. We could not do glacier landing due to bad weather, but they refunded the difference in price without even me asking for it. They also take the safety of flight seriously. We had an experienced IFR pilot. I was picked up and dropped off without any wait time.

My travel mate said this was the most memorable thing she had done on a previous trip to Alaska so of course, we had to book this adventure. Very smooth check-in process, helpful staff, great pilot! The opportunity to see Denali up close was spectacular!! And just flying around the other mountains, formations and above the glaciers was breathtaking! We chose not to do the glacier landing since we were hiking atop Root Glacier in Wrangell-St Elias. If you have the time and money to do this flightseeing adventure, be sure not to miss this!

review_title: A once in a lifetime viewing of Denali including a glacier landing
review_text: Fabulous experience!! With glacier landing. The views were unbelievable! Our pilot was friendly and experienced. Enjoyed learning about the Denali and the surrounding glaciers

We did the Mountain Voyager tour last week, and I am not sure we will ever be able to top this flight.

First off, the weather was absolutely perfect.  Not a cloud in the sky all the way to Denali.  Our pilot, Mike, told us that we were probably at the top 1% of the bell curve for weather this summer.

The flight was so smooth, and Mike pointed out all the sights along the way.  Landing on the glacier was definitely the highlight of the trip for my kids.  We were the only plan in the area that we landed at, and it was awesome being out there with just 10 other people.

For possibly a once in a lifetime experience, definitely consider taking one of these flightseeing tours.
Awesome tour on a spectacular day by Talkeetna Air Taxi. The landing on the glacier was unforgettable.

We went on Mtn  Voyager flight with glacier landing  It was a fantastic experience.  The pilot was great and informative.  Walking on the glacier was great.  I highly recommend this company and this flight.

review_title: Beautiful view of the most beautiful state.
review_text: Our weather wasn't perfect for a glacier landing but our pilot made up for this with a tour of absolutely amazing views.  And what a pilot!  Such a smooth ride.  We would recommend this company for anyone considering a flight from Talkeetna.  Very professional.

The customer service is exceptional! We received a call about and hour and a half before our flight letting us know that weather wasn’t permitting the Grand Denali tour we had booked and options to either fly a shortened one, or postpone. We ended up postponing twice and then our last day in Talkeetna opted for a shorter flight without the landing so that we could at least get up there before leaving. SO worth it! We got an hour 15 of flight time, amazing views, and they refunded us fully for the portion of the trip we didn’t get from our original booking. 

I would recommend not locking yourself into one time slot when booking…give yourself at least a day for flexibility! There was a couple in line behind us banking on the 8:30am flight and had left anchorage at 7am only to be disappointed that their flight was shifted. Alaska weather is always unpredictable…plan ahead to make it worth it!

If you visit Alaska, this is a must do!   Everything was well organized from the check-in process to the flight.   The pilot pointed out all of the features and answered all of our questions with expertise.    Furthermore, the flight was very smooth and we were impressed on how smooth the landing and take off from the glacier was.    Visiting Denali was like being transported to another world.     The glacier landing was well worth it!

review_title: This is the BEST thing I did in Alaska!
review_text:
This was one of the most amazing things my family has ever done (and this is coming from a family that travels extensively and does "adventure" type activities all over the world). From beginning to end - spectacular.  Highly recommend the glacier landing if you can make that work out!

Also want to give a shout out to this company, Talkeetna Air Taxi! We were actually booked on a competitor company (who shall not be named), with the glacier landing option. They told us if it wasn't going for whatever reason, we could rebook as long as we were in the area.   We purposely stayed in town for 2 days knowing that these flights cancel often. Well, the glacier landing wasn't happening during our scheduled time, but when we tried to rebook, the competitor company said they had no availability left. This is not what they had told me on the phone. They told me the would "make every effort" to reschedule my booking.  But they made no effort whatsoever, and instead cancelled my trip (but refunded me, luckily!)

I called Talkeetna Air Taxi immediately to ask if they had any availability to take us up to see the mountain, at any time, over the two days I was in town.  They were extremely nice and accommodating on the phone. They said they would make it happen, and they did! In fact, they really went out of their way to get us on a flight - they ended up booking us on a plane that was going up to pick up some mountaineers hiking near Denali. And that was fine by us, and a very cool experience for us to be a part of!

So THANK YOU to Talkeetna Air Taxi for going above and beyond in making this once-in-a-lifetime experience happen for us!!

Everything about this experience was fantastic!  The booking process was simple,  the check-in smooth and professional and the actual flight itself was beyond incredible!  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and pointed out many things along the way.  The landing on the glacier was a special highlight!! Highly, highly  recommend!  It is a little extra but well worth it!  Our experience was definitely over the top!

My husband and I did this June 21, 2021. Chris was our pilot. He did an awesome job pointing out landmarks and telling us about the area. It was cloudy in Talkeetna but bright and sunny on the mountain. We did a glacier landing...its hard to put into words really, but if you are on the fence about spending the money, just do it! Totally worth every penny!

Absolutely epic in every way for my family (wife + two teen boys). A life highlight weaving throughout the Denali range, seeing Denali, landing at base camp glacier, sitting copilot, and just overall a magical experience. Weather was sketchy down low but once above the cloud layer and around Denali - epic. Would highly recommend!

WOW! We are so glad we signed up for the glacier landing. We actually signed up for the Southside tour and the tour company upgraded us to the Mountainside tour! Beautiful views of Denali and surrounding mountains. Smooth flight and landings.

review_title: Father and Son enjoyed flight and sights!
review_text: We had a fantastic flight on and it also included a glacier landing. The weather that day happened to be spectacular. My son and I had a great time!

We had an amazing time!! I had seen previous reviews that mentioned the steep cost but eventually decided it was a once in a lifetime opportunity. I booked for Father’s Day and oh my gosh, the day was so clear with perfect weather. The flight was amazing and landing on a glacier…when else would you ever have that?! Our pilot was wonderful, made us feel comfortable and safe and his knowledgeable narration made the trip extra enjoyable.

This was the best thing so far on our vacation trip from Fairbanks to anchorage and Seward, mountains where clear we pick a great day to go out, we had a glacier landing, The staff was very informative about the weather it was rainy and cloudy, so we picked the next day at 11 am instead oh boy was that a good choice.

This was a surreal experience! You have to do the Glacier Landing portion as words can't even describe how amazing that felt. Walking on a glacier in the middle of mountains was so calming. The flight is very comfortable too and the views are second to none. Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska

In a nutshell, every aspect of my experience was amazing with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Their office personnel greeted me as soon as I stepped in the door and answered all my questions with a smile. The plane we flew in was well taken care of and the pilot filled us with so much knowledge of the landscape throughout the flight. Denali is so magical seen in the air. Spend the extra money on the glacier landing, and when you land be sure to try the snow...one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten. If I ever return to Alaska, I will definitely fly with Talkeetna Air again!

Oh my gosh this was seriously breath taking. Dress warm! The plane is chilly. The views are incredible. We did the glacier landing - HIGHLY recommend. There is nothing like it. The pilot was friendly and fun!

Imagine our surprise when we checked in to find out we were going to be landing at Denali Base Camp! WOW.  What a special Glacier Landing we had at Kahiltna.  Then, we did a second glacier landing at Pica to perform an expedition pickup.  Our pilot Andy was fabulous, providing a detail explanation of the different peaks and glaciers.  A must for visitors to Alaska.  Our family and friends who visited had the experience of a lifetime.

Amazing experience & glorious views.can’t put into words the beauty beheld. The landing on the glacier was awe-inspiring. Watching the other planes land & take off was unique. We felt like we were suspended in time watching all that God has created through time. The crew was well versed, polite & professional. Safety was never our concern.

review_title: We had the experience of a lifetime!
review_text: We were incredibly lucky. The weather conditions on the mountain were perfect for viewing. We were assigned a flight that was dropping climbers at the 7200 ft base camp. Our pilot Andy was awesome, an experienced pilot who knows and loves the mountain. After we landed on the glacier  and dropped off the climbers with their gear, we continued to get a private personalized tour of all the many features of Denali and her sister mountains, and the glaciers and rock features between them. Andy continually shared his knowledge of everything we were seeing and positioned the plane so we could see it all. An amazing once in a lifetime experience. All the office and ground crew were very friendly and extremely helpful. We give it a 20 star recommendation.
Landing on the glacier was amazing!   Views throughout the flight were spectacular and spending time on the glacier was awe inspiring.

The people in the office were professional, friendly, and helpful. The pilot provided a lot of great insight to what we were seeing and the views were incredible! The glacier landing is worth the extra money. I would do it again in a heartbeat!

I would absolutely recommend this tour and this company to my family and friends. 

Definitely take some anti motion sickness pills! The pilot did a wonderful job of keeping us smooth, but it’s a little plane and you’ll be taking a ton of pictures. Dramamine kept me from being sick.

An absolutely AMAZING experience. You cannot leave Alaska without this flight seeing tour with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Out pilot Andy was fantastic, he went through all the safety steps first to make sure we were all comfortable before taking flight, answered all  our questions and was a great guide while we were in the air. The flight was so smooth and the views were unlike anything I could have imagined. Went through two camera memory cards! Highly recommend the glacier landing! It was 10/10 worth it. Could not recommended this experience more!

This experience was amazing.  By far my favorite thing we did in Alaska!  Everything was great!  I felt very safe with our pilot, and he was kind and professional.  We had a clear day and could see so many mountains and glaciers!  It was so amazing I was almost crying.

We added the glacier landing and it was 1000% worth it!  I wanted to save some money but my husband convinced me to add it on and I am so glad we did!  

Seriously- book this.  You won't regret it!

We did the mountain explorer with glacier landing. It was worth every penny. Our pilot was wonderful- great narration with a focus on safety.  Her flying skills allowed us to be up close to some of the most jaw dropping scenery in the world. Peak fall colors topped it off. 
Pilot, scheduler and ramp agent were all delightful. Talkeetna Air Taxi has the customer experience down pat. Already looking forward to our next trip.

This flightseeing tour is a must-do if you're in the Denali area.  The pilot was an expert flyer circling all the highest peaks and then actually landing on a glacier.  We were allowed to walk around the glacier for a while then back to more peak circling.  The day was perfectly clear and the views of Denali and the surrounding peaks was incredible.  Don't miss this opportunity.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience, a must do experience with Talkeetna Air!
review_text: Talkeetna Air came highly recommneded from a friend and they did not disappoint as the Mountain Air Tour with Glacier Landing is an experience I will never forget. It's a "must do experience" when in Alaska and Talkeetna Air made it exceptional. Andy our pilot, through to Annie and Heidi in the office made it all happen. I could not have thought of a better way to spend my 50th birthday.

My husband and I booked this trip the day before, we were really concerned with weather and being able to see. Booking by phone was very easy and the front desk was very helpful - We booked the 10am Full Tour with Glacier Landing. Our trip was absolutely perfect, incredible views and clear conditions. Landing on a pristine glacier with new snow was an experience we will never forget, even though temps dropped out there to 18deg F - We were glad we were bundled! 

Highly recommend this activity, book with Pilot Paul if you can!

It was a 2-hour drive from Anchorage and all worth it. All of the staff and flight crew were very nice and provided lots of information. They also provided masks if you didn't have one. The views from the plane were Jaw-dropping and the pilot provided tons of info on the landscape. If you're a photographer, you won't be disappointed.

Wow, what an awesome experience! We did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing. We don't typically do things this pricey, and I was worried about regretting the price tag, but I can say it was worth every penny.

Every minute in the air was mesmerizing! Our pilot handled the plain beautifully, he was a great tour guide providing us with mind blowing facts every step of the way, and best of all, the windows and seating provided for better, wider views than I would have thought.

We agonized a bit about paying for the glacier landing. It seemed like a lot of money for a little amount of time, but in the end we decided it was probably our only chance to say we landed on glacier in our lives, and again, it was worth every penny! It felt like we were outside on the glacier for a long time! I did not feel at all rushed back onto the plane.

review_title: Spectacular mountains and glaciers everywhere you look
review_text: Had an unbelievably spectacular flightseeing trip around Denali, Moose's Tooth, and the Ruth Amphitheater!  Pilot Andy was super knowledgeable about the mountains and glaciers, and kept us entertained with nifty chatter about everything there was to see.  Andy's glacier landing was an extra special treat.  If you want to see Denali National Park and the Alaska Range, Talkeetna Air Taxi has the trip for you!
What an amazing experience! I can't recommend this enough. Friendly staff, awesome pilot and just an awe-inspiring landscape. Don't miss it.

review_title: A bucket list item for Alaska
review_text: As an Alaskan, I tell all of my friends and family to do this when visiting the state. I sent my parents with Talkeetna Air Taxi because they are the BEST company to go with. This is an unforgettable experience for anyone and is a must do when coming up to Alaska.
Seeing the Ruth Glacier and the peaks of Denali was a lifetime experience. Our pilot was confidence inspiring and did a great job narrating our flight. I would highly recommend flying with TAT!

My wife and I were fortunate enough to have booked a tour on a beautiful Talkeetna day. The flight and the glacier landing was beyond incredible and our pilot, Leighan, was a fantastic pilot and guide! We will be reliving the memories for the rest of our lives. Thank you for a great tour!

review_title: Wonderful Denali and surrounding area flight seeing experience
review_text: Our family took a  Denali flight seeing tour on July 22nd With Talkeetna Air Service.  LeAnn was our pilot.  She was very personable and professional.  She did an excellent job not only flying but explaining Alaska and what we were seeing.  It felt like it was much more than here is our standard route we fly and some standard information. She provided facts, details, stories not only about Denali but Alaska in general. We would highly recommend Talkeetna Air Service and LeAnn.

We had a fantastic experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi! These tours are extremely weather dependent, so don't schedule this for your last day in the the area, just in case you need to reschedule! We chose the Mountain Voyager tour with a glacier landing, and although we had some clouds, we were able to land on the Don Sheldon Amphitheater section of the Ruth Glacier, next to the Sheldon Chalet. It was so much fun to land on the glacier, and the subsequent take off was very cool! As an aside, we were happy to see that Leighan was our pilot, because we love showing our teenage daughter what women can do! Our daughter sat in the copilot seat on the way out, and although she has Asperger's and has a lot of social anxiety, it did not matter to Leighan in the least. :-) Thank you to TAT for a great morning!

review_title: Best part of my Alaska trip - worth the price tag!
review_text: I know this has a hefty price tag, but I swear it was worth every penny. By far my highlight of my trip to Alaska! Staff was super friendly, the flight was easy and smooth, and the views were unbelievable - in the air and on the glacier. I called around different companies, and TAT was the easiest to talk to. Thank you Andy and TAT!!

Amazing experience! We’re a family of five, the youngest is 8 y/o, we all enjoyed it. Extremely fascinating and felt like we had traveled to another planet in 30 minutes. The peaks and glaciers are breathtaking especially when standing on a glacier. You can hear the sounds of the glaciers as they shift and move, a little unsettling when you are standing on them! Would definitely recommend this excursion if you have the opportunity, a highlight!

I can't put into words how fantastic this was. We were gasping with wonder and delight pretty much the whole time. Pretty sure that if I could have opened the plane's window, I could have reached out & touched Denali. The glacier landing was a special thrill. This tour should be a must on your Alaska to-do list. We live here and it was still breathtaking and spellbinding.

My girlfriend and I had an absolutely fantastic experience with TAT and the Mountain Voyager tour. The weather was perfect and our pilot, Lee Ann, was really great. Yes, it was a splurge but well worth it.

I have always had a fear of small planes and avoided them at all costs. Until now. Just could not pass up chance to land on a glacier. I am so very happy I did it! Did it for my grandson, but really for me. The flight was beyond expectations. First off the pilot was very professional and put me so at ease. It was a slightly cloudy day which made it more interesting. And he worked around the clouds, smoothly, no bumps! The landing on the glacier was soft. Playing on it was so much fun. So many pictures, all beautiful. Back in the air we felt we could reach out and touch the mountains tho we never got closer than a quarter mile. This was the most exciting excursion we did in all of Alaska. It was not cheap but it was priceless in my mind. Do it. And this company was great all around.

review_title: Favorite thing we did in 18 days in Alaska...and I hate flying
review_text: I gathered my nerves to do this and am so glad I did. Add landing on the glacier...it is the best! Incredible experience! Tell them if over 60 and get a discount.

Our pilot took us around the peaks and glaciers of Denali. Visibility was wonderful so capturing outstanding scenes was exhilarating. This was a once in a lifetime experience and the company was excellent!  Highly recommend them.

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience: worth every dollar. you won't regret it!
review_text:
I was told by a native Alaskan  that when visiting Alaska if you do nothing else,  you must  do a flightseeing tour, because it's the only way to begin to  grasp the enormous scale of the place. I can't imagine a better flightseeing experience, or a better company to do it with. Talkeetna Air Taxi  has got to be  the BEST choice I think.
 From the start they were easy  to work with- I  had 6 people in our party, 3 of whom were uncertain, and they were ok with me reserving for 6 and cancelling  some later.
 Also check out their cancellation policies: if you decide on the day of the flight that you aren't comfortable with the weather,  even if they plan to fly they will still refund your deposit. 
Clay was our pilot. Very competent, and confident, and very friendly. The flight was smooth, great takeoffs and landings. 
and DO THE GLACIER LANDING! We had hiked on a glacier in New Zealand, so we thought it would be  a similar experience. WRONG--DO IT. It's the only way you can fully grasp just how huge and awe-inspiring these glaciers are. 

Initially we gulped  a bit at the price, but now we are so glad we did it. 
This was hands-down the best day of my Alaskan vacation.
 I even bought the T-shirt.
Thanks Talkeetna Air Taxi for a once-in-lifetime experience!

A fantastic experience. I was curious if it could possibly live up to the overwhelmingly positive reviews here, but it was indeed really special stuff. I was impressed with how cool and competent our pilot was - he put everyone at ease from the start, and his passion for the area came through loud and clear.

Go for the glacier landing!

Kris Peterson was our pilot.  We were in a DeHaviland Beaver seating 10 or so.  Kris warned that the plane had an identity crisis and thought it really was a helicopter.  Kris's handling of that plane was amazing.  The ride was smooth start to finish. Every now and again he would circle around so everyone on the plane got an amazing view. He even channeled Henry David Thoreau marvelling at the beauty of Alaska.  Best tour I have ever been on!

review_title: Its all about pleasing the customer!
review_text:
I'm so impressed with their service and willingness to accommodate the needs of their clients. This is so rare and a great value.  Read on!

This company was recommended by the pilot with Stellar Aviation in Homer. He said a lot of excellent Pilots have gone over to this company. We also chatted with an air traffic controller who told us that the larger, flashier companies have a higher turnover of Pilots.

They have multiple planes including a four seater and 10 seater. They are flexible on their pricing. They will adjust their pricing based on what you are to see of Denali. This is amazing. They also let you cancel if it looks like the mountain is not going to be visible and you decide you don't want to go. Special boots are provided for the people who go on flights that have a glacier landing. And if you're lucky, you might be added onto one of those flights even though you were paying for just a fly by. Again, amazing! I also learned that even if it's only one person who wants to fly,  they would take you out and would not increase the cost to offset the fact that you're the only person. But honestly, I think they do such a great job it is likely a rare event when there's only one person to go.

The flight was wonderful.  The pilot made sure that everyone  on the plane had equal opportunity to see everything. We appreciated his narration which was more than adequate. It was relaxed and informative. He gave some historic background about the first hikers, the naming of Denali, Etc.

They were so efficient, helpful, and accommodating. It's rare to see a business so willing to work with the needs of the client  and be affordable at the same time. I wouldn't consider going with any other company after this experience.

A side note:  we talked on the phone about the pricing. This is where we learned that based on how much of the mountain we would see, the price would be adjusted. We also learned there was a 10% discount if you book online.

My friends (4 total) and I took the flight because I wanted to see Denali from above.  The staff was so friendly and accommodating.  We postponed our flight one day due to weather and it was no problem.  The day we got to Talkeetna Air Taxi it was raining on the ground but when our pilot Michael got us going we suddenly were in full sunshine.  We had a beautiful and informative tour and our landing on the glacier was perfect.  The time on the Glacier was just enough.  Overall the experience was unforgettable, and was my favorite part of our time in Alaska.  Thank you to all especially Michael.

He was knowledgeable about the routes and conditions.  Super friendly.  Gave us a discount for same day booking and arranged for their shuttle guy to stop by the train depot with us to pick up our luggage that was being held there for us since we would get back after they closed.  Seth picked us up in the shuttle, helped us pick up our luggage at the train station and then offered to drive our luggage to our lodge for us 5 Miles out of town, while we flew.  The ladies at the front desk were super friendly.  And then came our pilot, Matt.  He gave us the ride of our lives.  I grew up in a small plane with my dad and this guy could fly!  Very safe and competent.  We got up close and personal with Denali and the surrounding cliffs.  We only did the 1 hr basic flight and it was amazing.  It helped that we got the one clear day in 10!  But what a ride!!!  So impressed with this company and it’s top service!  Seth drove us back to town.  He had delivered all our luggage as promised and filled the inn keeper in on our plans and schedule.  And he refused our tip!  Said he was just doing his job.  But please don’t let that stop you from trying.  Absolutely go with this company!

review_title: Yes it's expensive, but yes it's worth it.
review_text: Before booking this flight, i googled "is a flightseeing tour of Denali REALLY worth it?" because i had major sticker shock.  It just so happened that the day my friends planned to fly, it was sunny and calm, and i called up to see if they had 1 more spot for me, and they did (literally ,the last seat on the plane!). If you're going to do a flight tour, you MUST do the glacier landing - yes it's more expensive but it's SO worth it.  The views are majestic, and landing and running around on a glacier surrounded by 3 of our nation's highest mountains is SO peaceful and stunning.  We did the Mountain Voyager tour with the glacier landing and it was 100% phenomenal.  One person even gets to sit up in the cockpit - i recommend trying to get up to that spot for amazing views.  I love that the pilot tells you whats going on through individual headsets.  And the whole ride was so smooth - an even better flight than the large commercial airline we flew into alaska on.  So in summary, YES, it is worth it.  If you're only going to go once, pony up for this tour. (And yes, we got to see the summit of Denali which was also AMAZING)

We took the Mountain Voyager Flight with Glacier Landing, a flight of a lifetime!  Weather was not great on the day of our flight, but as advised on Talkeetna Air Taxi website, we booked early in our Talkeetna stay and had plenty of time to wait for clear weather.  After a 5 hour delay, our flight took off!  The snow covered mountain views and glaciers were breathtaking.  Landing on the glacier at Denali climbers base camp was amazing!  There were still a lot of clouds, but they somehow enhanced the moment and created a mystical experience.  Our pilot, Richard, was able to find a break in the clouds to give us a view of Denali peak.  Don't miss out on this flying adventure, and spend the extra money to land on the glacier.  The glacier landing was incredible!  A highlight of our Alaska trip!

Wow - I'm still thinking about this flightseeing tour weeks later. Absolutely incredible and some of the most stunning, majestic scenery you'll ever see. Of course, that's assuming you have a crystal clear, calm day like we did. Our pilot, Clay, was easy going, confident and extremely knowledgable. He provide a great running (flying?) commentary. We had the camera snapping away virtually non-stop.  Landing on the glacier at basecamp was a treat. The whole experience was wonderful!

We felt very lucky to go on the flight. It was smooth and just a little cold for a while at the highest point, but otherwise very worthwhile! If the day is clear, it is a must to do! review_title: The Glacier Walk was the Icing on a Great Cake

Our pilot, Richard, has been flying here for 23 years, but is still passionate about what he does, again with an emphasis on safety. The scenery is spectacular and flying close to the mountains gives you a remarkable experience only surpassed by the glacier walk at 7000 feet. Not just a highlight of our Alaskan vacation but  a highlight of our 50 state quest which reached its successful conclusion here in Alaska.

I am an instrument-rated pilot from Texas.  My first concern is safety.  The TAT planes and equipment and first class, maintain like new, and in excellent condition.  Our pilot, Michael, a skilled commercial-rated pilot, is equally skilled and safe.  He knows how to maneuver the plane for optimum comfort of the passengers, alerting us to what he is doing (turns, ascent, descent) before he executes.  He is an equally good tour guide in the air but his cockpit situation awareness never waivers.  We had a beautiful clear day and the air tour exceeded all expectations.  I don't weep easily but these views of Creation being awe and delight.   The staff on the phone and at check in have a wonderful service culture.   You immediately feel welcome and appreciated. I am rewriting this review, as my first review was softly forced.  The pilot stopped the golf cart near the hangars and asked us to click the links and do the review on the spot…and then he checked our phones to see that the reviews were completed with a thank you screen showing.  While I understand they need reviews as a small business, soft forcing and checking doesn’t feel like it’s the right way to do it.  I’ve been on other plane tours around a couple of the other Hawaiian Islands, so I have reference points for comparison.

Pros:  We did a custom tour, which is supposed to be a combination of two tours, with circumnavigation of Maui and a tour of the surrounding islands.  The views of Molokai and the surrounding area were fantastic.  The pilot, Eric, was skillful and we felt safe.  He was a nice guy and tried his best to be a good guide.

Cons:  (1) I feel like the price of our combined tour was a bit high (around 1250 for two people) especially considering the total time was only about 1.7 hours, which is about the time of just one tour.  I feel like more time could have been spent around west Maui , Molokai/Lanai and Molokini rather than Hanna, which is comparatively not that impressive.  I would not recommend our tour to others, based on my experience and at this price point.  (2)  They could use newer planes.  The current single engine plane (Piper Archer) is very old.  The exterior looks old and the interior is in rough shape.  Again, it was safe, but the plane could at least use a new coat of paint, the seats need to be re-upholstered and the interior needs a good cleaning/vacuuming and wipe down.  Also, the control pod of my headphones was coming apart with interior wires showing, and all the headphones had earmuff covers that were dirty and almost coming off…they could use disposable ear muff covers and mouthpiece covers…these things are very cheaply available on Amazon.  Finally, the pilot’s clothes looked like they were not washed for weeks.  Again, I think the pilot is a nice guy and I have nothing against him, but both my wife and I noticed this and thought it was strange.  Cleanliness is very important…it’s the first things people notice and experience.  These are simple things to fix.  (3) They really need a shared office or at least a hangar where customers can sit down and wait and get checked in etc.  It seems all they have is a parking spot on the tarmac and a golf cart that they use to get customers directly from their cars.  This is ok, but this is just a tip based on what I’ve seen with other tour operators.  

I would recommend this company over a helicopter tour because it is better for a small group.  However, I would like to see some of the things I mentioned to change.  They have been in business for 7 years.  So I feel like some of these things should be addressed for their benefit and that of future customers.  All they have to do is go experience some other airplane tours on other islands (like Kauai for example) to get more tips on how to improve.
