Our son recently graduated from college as an Aerospace Engineer. This flight made all his dreams come true! He ACTUALLY FLEW THE PLANE. The owner/instructor/pilot was so compassionate and accommodating. Do yourself a favor and enjoy MAUI the way it was meant to be seen from above looking down at it’s beauty! Thank you Eric for making us feel at home. Thank you for letting my sons heart soar! Much love the Theisen’s

Great tour of the five islands.  Eric was very knowledge of the area and an excellent pilot.  As a fellow pilot, he allowed me to fly while handling the radios and navigation.  Would happily fly with him again
Eric is personable, professional and very knowledgeable. This tour afforded me a chance for wonderful photos I could never have gotten any other way.

I was a little nervous taking a small plane around the islands, but once we started flying we kept being assured that everything was going smoothly and I definitely felt safe during this flight! Our pilot was awesome and so so sweet! He flew us around and taught us a great deal about the islands and the history of each one. Definitely one of the best activities we booked while in Maui!! We really enjoyed the relaxing flight and got some wonderful photos!!! Highly recommend!!!
Este viaje fue increíble, se los recomiendo! El señor Eric muy amable, una experiencia única. Súper contenta con mi tour.
This safe smooth and very enjoyable flight where the scenery was spectacular and the coastline was lovely. And the pilot made it possible to capture stunning unobstructed photos. Do it.
Trip was amazing Eric was great to deal with lots of great service. Enjoyed the insights flexibility of trip and the care and attention to our experience.

Three of us went up in Eric’s Piper Archer aeroplane and had a once in a lifetime experience seeing Maui from a birds eye view!    Eric was very knowledgable about the Islands and kept us entertained.  It is whale season right now and we were hoping to catch a glimpse.....and we did.  He took great care of us and we had an unforgettable trip.  Thanks Eric!
Fantastic flight which was safe and smooth and a great experience and we were able to see some whales and we’d do it again. Brilliant.

Eric was amazing and had a vast knowledge of the history of the islands. Seeing the island from this point of view was totally spectacular and a once in a lifetime experience. Don’t think🤔...JUST BOOK!!! You will be more than happy with your experience ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Eric was the nest. Flying the plane was an experience in its own. we got to see all of Mauis five islands. We even got to see a bunch of humpback whales playing in the sea. Excellent. Would do again and again and again!!!
This has been the most amazing ride ...I would suggest taking a ride with this feela! the amount of information was given & just the best birthday ever :)

Great flight! Eric was very hospitable, kind and extremely helpful. He was knowledgeable about the area, which enhanced the experience. I am a pilot myself and Eric let me fly for most of the flight (with the exception of during photo opportunities, of course) while he operated the radios, which allowed me appreciate the scenery better. Definitely worth it! Thanks Eric!

Great views of private island flight.  Saw things we would never see from ground.  Windy day but Eric did excellent job minimizing bouncing.  Eric was great guide providing excellent perspective on islands.  Also did some excellent flybys of whales and even breaches.
Unique perspectives (PERFECT Marketing) and service during this private flight with my husband and from start to finish amazing. I’d recommend it.

review_title: Fantastic birds-eye views of Maui and the surrounding islands
review_text: An incredible experience flying over the islands and having this quite different perspective on the beautiful nature which makes up Hawai’i. Eric was our pilot and guide. We had a really great time and we even had the chance to fly over the beach where we had our wedding as well as the hotel we stayed in. If you have the chance, this is highly recommended 👍

Wonderful, fantastic, exhilarating views of the islands. Saw sights you just don’t see from land or boat. Eric is a great pilot and knowledgeable tour guide. I can’t wait to go up again and see more of Maui with him.
Eric was a fantastic pilot and guide. He gave us beautiful views of the islands and made sure we felt at ease.

This was an amazing trip of a lifetime.  So glad we booked this into our dream vacation.  If you have a chance to do this adventure you should.  To see the cliffs up close was breathtaking and the waterfalls were beautiful.
This private flight was outstanding and highly recommended. Very descriptive and informative and recommend it

review_title: Island views on a perfect weather day
review_text: Looking for a flight around Maui and other neighboring islands that are part of Maui County? We were and found Maui Plane Rides a great choice for seeing various landscapes and to have great views of Maui mountains on one of the clearest mornings possible. The pilot was very responsive to a last minute flight request; we had waited for better weather and visibility that happened to be our last day on the island. We were able to see sea cliffs, lush green and more rugged landscapes, ports and other special features that make Maui County special and memorable. A great day to fly with lower winds and visibility to Big Island in the distance. Wonderful photo options from both sides of the plane that we will cherish as memories for years to come! Small plane accommodations for taller and average size tourists, comfortable seating and communications. Smooth take-off and landing with little wind turbulence coming around mountainous areas to be expected. Worth the cost compared to other flights; same cost for up to three people, so both of us got to fly on a beautiful morning flight to start the day! Thanks so much to our pilot for the touring info of each location and great memories of favorite beaches and the blue/aqua waters with mountain backdrops made with photos options!
The most amazing time. A must do. The perspective of the islands from the air is magnificent! Eric is a fantastic guide. Thank you for the memories.
There are few words to describe the experience of floating with your loved one, privately,  on top of the most beautiful Maui you can imagine.
We had the best time seeing the 5 islands on a beautiful day. You can take pics out of the window so every photo is clear. Fantastic trip, would recommend this to anyone!

Phenomenal service with stunning views coupled with an extremely friendly and engaging pilot wrapped in a world class service. Truly an excellent way to see the beauty of Maui and surrounding islands. Would highly recommend.
We had a great trip. My dad and I flew all over Maui. We each got a chance to fly. Great trip and art some scenery. Definitely coming back.

review_title: Jaw-Dropping Views on Maui and the surroundings small islands
review_text: The highlight of our trip to Maui for sure. New views and stunning perspectives of the islands every minute. The pilot gave great orientation and background information. A fantastic way to explore Maui.

Great flight with Eric as our pilot! Thrilled to have a beautiful day to see so many of the islands in a way most people don’t get to see. I’m claustrophobic and can get motion sick- bit Eric was wonderful at ensuring the rose was smooth as could be and turns were soft.

We were able to see so many beautiful areas of Maui- some we want to visit now. 

Learned some great facts about the islands - and had fun while doing it!

Highly recommend the experience and memories you will have!

Had a fantastic time on this private plane tour of Maui County. Particularly loved the pilot’s description of Maui’s history and the view of the tallest sea cliffs in the world! Fun and exciting for anyone with a love of nature or adventure.

Eric had super aloha spirit and did a great job of explaining what we were seeing. Lots of cool highlights and a Molokini flyover! Would strongly recommend Maui Plane Rides for a uniques view of Maui County.

What a lifetime experience, a flight over Maui with all the 5 islands. Eric did a great job showing us the best of all the islands. A highlight of his plane is the camera window where we could take photos without a window in between.
6 stars
We enjoyed a private experience from Maui Plane Rides  it was a smooth and beautiful experience  highly recommend this!
Exactly what we wanted.   It was fun, informative and we got to see everything we wanted and more.  I highly recommend this tour.  Being a private tour made it even better!
Eric was a great pilot and your guide. Great views and information. We did the five island tour and it was the best. Thanks.

Eric is an amazing pilot and we felt very safe and welcoming. He showed us the five islands around Maui and explained us the story behind the islands and what has happened there. Without this tour we would have missed so many astonishing places. Many of them were only accessible by plane. We really liked the tour and it was a great way to see Maui.

What an incredible experience- it was absolutely beautiful and stunning. We were greeted in the parking lot, he took photos of us, offered great history of the islands, insight on things to enjoy in Maui. I would hands down recommend this tour to anyone. 5 stars 100%

review_title: Great Way To See Maui County
review_text: We are frequent visitors to Maui and decided to do an aerial tour of the island on this trip.  After researching the various options, helicopter vs fixed wing, we decided to book with Eric of Maui Plane Rides.  We had a great experience touring the five islands of Maui County.  The views of Maui and Molokai’s North Shores were spectacular with many photo opportunities.  Eric is a very attentive pilot and is willing to personalize your flight itinerary to insure you have the best experience possible.  He is also very knowledgeable about the points of interest along the journey.  This tour was well worth the money, more cost effective that a helicopter tour.  I will definitely book my next air tour with Maui Plane Rides.

review_title: A must to do while in Maui
review_text: An experience of a lifetime. Took some amazing pictures. Eric the pilot/ owner was an excellent host. He was friendly and very courteous to make sure we are comfortable. The aircraft had option to take pictures without having the window in between. This is highly recommended, a must do.
The ride exceeded expectations. Eric was very well informed and gave us up close views to take great pictures.  The ride was very smooth and enjoyable. I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides.   Bob S.

The airplane view of the islands was breathtaking!  Having our private air view was the best tour of Maui county islands.  Pilot Eric was thoughtful and informative and gave us so many photo opportunities.  I loved learning some history while taking in a birds eye view of cliffs, valleys, and even a crater.  Definitely worth it!

We were impressed with this flight.  Pilot Eric was great!  Our flight was at sunset and it was amazing!  It was nice that it was a private flight and everything was just for us.  At our request, we could make several circles around the point to better consider the details, although the pilot himself did this without asking.  It was nice to get the basics of piloting and control the plane - this is an incredible experience!  In general, the organization of the tour was on top.  Thank you for this flight!
Eric has done a fantastic job preparing us for the flight, letting us fly and telling us great stories about the different Islands around Maui. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

Do you like amazing views? Do you like the thrilling sensation of flight? Do you want to control an aircraft with no prior experience? (yes, they let you fly the plane)

If the answer is yes to any of those questions, there is no better company to fly with than MauiPlaneRides. Our pilot, Eric, was exceptionally friendly right from the moment we called about booking a tour. His love and passion for sharing his dream of flight is honest and genuine, and I really appreciated that.

This was definitely an experience that I will never forget.

Also, the worlds tallest sea cliffs of Molokai were unreal and my personal favourite!

A step above a helicopter tour. Eric is an amazing pilot and a fun narrator. He gave us amazing insights about all the 5 islands we saw on the tour. Highly recommended! Thank you for a fantastic experience Eric :)
Great day with the best pilot (Eric) who knows the best places to see and gives you info about everything you can think off. If you get the chance to do thuis trip do it. Worth every penny

Eric was so educated and thorough 
Went over the top with what we were expecting 
Don’t miss out on this experience
Eric was the absolute best pilot.  Informative, kind and very knowledgeable.  Above and beyond our expectations.
I’m a flight student and so it was an awesome experience to see different islands and landmarks only seen by air. HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT.

review_title: Very BEST way to see Beautiful Maui
review_text: This 90 minute flight was hands down our favorite tour of Maui, and gave us the chance to see the breathtaking beauty of the area.  Striking scenery, interesting historical stories from our pilot and smooth sailing.  You dont know Maui county until you've taken this tour.  Thanks Eric for a fabulous morning!
Highly recommended - 5 islands, very informative, beautiful scenery, especially the Molokini crater!

review_title: Best way to see the whole island
review_text:
Wife and I took a full tour of the Maui islands (Maui, Lanai, Moloka'i, Kahoolawe, Molokini) by air.  We've done helicoptor tours before, but this was MUCH more personal and comfortable.  Eric knew all about the history, geography, and personalities of these islands.  His flying skills were excellent.  This whole trip was like a 4K YouTube video, only live.  It is the only way to really see the majesty of the waterfalls, or the vastness of the volcanic flows from centuries ago. 
Unlike the heli tours, this was our personal private tour.  If we wanted to see something again, or get another picture, he turned the plane around and flew it again.   This is a trip we'll take again on our next visit to Maui.

Wow Maui Plane Rides was the highlight of our Hawaiian trip. Eric our pilot went above and beyond our expectations. The plane fit just the 3 of us which was perfect. We recommend the 5 Maui island tour for the experience of a lifetime. Eric was professional, knowledgeable about the island history, nature and culture. Each of us had a window view of our own unlike helicopter tours. Dad even had a chance to fly the plane.  He swooped down for both sides of the plane for the best viewing possible. It was an exhilarating, exceptional experience. Fly with Maui Plane Rides and you will have the time of your life!!! Mahalo Eric! Hang loose!

Eric was an excellent tour guide and flight coach. He pointed out the historical spots on the islands, made sure everyone was comfortable and made extra loops so that we could get the pictures that we wanted. If you're looking for a great Maui experience, make sure to book Maui Plane Rides.

review_title: Highly recommended tour, we had a ball!
review_text:
We had a such a great day at the Grand Canyon! A full day…in the air and a 3 hour tour in the Wildbuck Hummer, 45 mins in the little town before we flew back to Phoenix. Our tour guide in the Hummer was Gerry, he was so friendly and knowledgeable, the only Native Indian Tour guide so was lucky to get him. 
Zac and Brandon, the Pilots were very professional, informative and friendly. 
We ended up on a private tour even though we booked in a group which we thoroughly enjoyed. Highly recommended tour.

review_title: Do this tour!! Cannot recommend enough!
review_text: This was by far one of the best tours I have ever been on. The experience was great from start to finish. Westwind was great to work with and Brandon took excellent care of us in the air. The ground tour through GC Nation Park was a lot of fun and filled with fun facts and knowledge. They take you to lots of spots where you can get lots of great pictures while learning about some of the history and geology. We loved this tour, would do it again in a heartbeat, and will be recommending this tour to anyone that will listen.

review_title: ONLY WAY TO SEE THE GRAND CANYON
review_text: Been to the Grand Canyon 2 other times seen more on this trip that the other 2 combined.  WAY TO GO!! ++++ HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT

Great way to see the Grand Canyon and get there quickly from the Phoenix area. From our communication before the tour with Lindsey to our Flight there and back with pilot Brendon and our tour on the ground with Miss Gigi this was an all around spectacular experience. We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Arizona and would absolutely do again. This was well worth the price paid!

Just such an amazing experience...from Lindsey's warm welcome when we arrived to the pilots navigating the journey! I would highly recommend this tour...it is truly a once in a life time experience what will open your eyes in so many ways! Seeing the Grand Canyon from above, in all its wonder, will delight you and the learnings you will walk away with will leave you in awe! You will not be disappointed!

Our Grand Canyon Signature Tour - South Rim with Hummer Ground Tour was an absolutely amazing experience, flying over the desert from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon, passing over Sedona, Flagstaff, Mt Humphries (which still had snow on it). Once we landed at the Grand Canyon Airport the tour took us on a Hummer trip around the South Rim of the Canyon.  Photos don’t do this vista enough justice.  The rock formations, colours, size and sheer magnificence was simply awe inducing. Our guides,  both the pilot Nico and the Hummer driver Trey were fantastic; so knowledgeable and interesting and always helpful. We had such a fabulous time. Thanks Westwind for making this an amazing highlight.  Your communication, organisation and friendly guides were fantastic.

review_title: Great experience all around and very convenient
review_text: Great experience all around, can't beat it for doing a half-day tour! Airport was very convenient, pilot was awesome, and really fantastic views from the plane and at the canyon.

Absolutely blown away with this experience, everything was perfect form the flight to the hummer tour. We felt safe, and informed about the GC. The time flying in the canyon was amazing if we were the only people there.

The folks at Westwind Air do it right. Top notch service. We were greeted with smiling professional people. Snacks and beverages all ready for us. Our pilot ( Doug) was fantastic. Skilled, thougtful, and informative. Even took pics for us and we had the plane to ourselves.
Once we landed at the South Rim our Hummer and guide were waiting for us. Jerry is a Navajo and knows the area he grew up in extensively.  He was also very patient as we travelled with two young ones. All the stops were awe inspiring and we were fed an excellent, personally made lunch right next to the canyon. 
I would personally recommend this means of seeing the Grand Canyon to be high on one's bucket list. Kudos to the Westwind Air team and thank you for a family memory we will cherish and never forget!
 Eric Riediger

review_title: Best Tour Ever! Don’t Miss It!
review_text:
A fantastic trip with views you will never get to see from the ground. Then when you do land at Grand Canyon Village and take the Humvee part of the tour you will be blown away again by the sheer beauty of the Grand Canyon and some of the lookout points where you stop.
One of the best parts of our trip was our pilot - Carla. She has 30 years experience flying, and a great sense of humor. The tour is pre-narrated which you hear through your headphones in the plane, but Carla cuts in from time to time to add some great tidbits. She also has a great sense of humor! WELL WORTH THE PRICE OF THE TICKET!

review_title: Spectacular Trip with stunning views of the Grand Canyon, as well as several other places along the way!
review_text: This was a phenomenal experience! Well worth the cost of the trip. When we checked in we were met by extremely friendly staff. Carla, our pilot, was absolutely terrific. Very informative and also a very experienced pilot who made us all feel very comfortable. The flight went over Sedona, and Flagstaff and then there it was - the Grand Canyon! Pictures will never do it justice. You have to see it with your own eyes to appreciate the raw beauty. After touring the Grand Canyon from the air we landed at the Grand Canyon airport and went into the Grand Canyon National Park through the East entrance. We were taken to several lookout points on the South Rim, and experienced several more moments of wow from the ground. The tour guide we had on the ground gave us some interesting facts along the way. We highly recommend this trip for anyone not wishing to take a helicopter, or not wishing to drive 4 hours one way, from the Scottsdale area. We reported at 7:30 am, took off at 8, and returned around 2:30 pm. The return flight took a more western route back so there were more places to see. Definitely one of those bucket list items!

This is the third time I have taken this trip and it never ceases to amaze. You cannot appreciate the Grand Canyon from just seeing pictures and flying over and through. It gives a great perspective. I recommend that anyone visiting the Phoenix area spend a day taking this trip, even if they have been to the Canyon before, as I was on a one week rafting trip. 
The views of Sedona are amazing also.

review_title: Only way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: This is a must go trip! The experience was top-notch. You will never experience the views of the Grand Canyon or Sedona without a aerial trip. Carla our captain, experience not only as a pilot, but as a tour guide in the air.  It was lovely to have the headset with a guided tour and acoustic music- not engine noise. The hummer ride with Trey to all the great spots for phots and information made this a whole experience that my husband and I will never forget.

The aerial tour of Sedona, Flagstaff and, of course, the Grand Canyon was fabulous. This was further enhanced by the south rim Hummer tour. This was all followed up with a bonus, delightful  IMAX film about the evolution of the Grand Canyon. Everyone at Westwind was very helpful, friendly and professional. Pedro, our pilot, was a delightful pleasure. Besides the fabulous visual experience, the highlight of the trip for me was the opportunity to sit in the copilot’s seat for the return flight. I felt like a kid again.

review_title: Not just a pretty view after all
review_text: Evidently, the view is amazing, but it's the friendliness and top notch customer service that stands out. Pearl is amazing! The whole team go the extra mile to make sure your experience, not just the view, is unforgettable.

review_title: Plane Hummer Canyon wow wow wow
review_text:
My husband I thoroughly enjoyed our plane ride to the Canyon with the pilot making sure we saw the beautiful canyon from above . Could not stop taking photos. When we arrived at the Canyon we took a prearranged hummer tour of the Canyon from the ground which was excellent! 
What a fantastic experience from beginning to end . Strongly recommend this bundled tour

review_title: Westwind Signature Grand Canyon Tour Exceeds Expectations
review_text:
This was my anniversary gift for my wife and it exceeded every expectation. The staff, pilots and our tour guide on the ground (different company by Westwind coordinates for you) were all outstanding. 

The plane seats 10 (I think). You need to be comfortable in a small plane with minor turbulence. The narration was very informative. 

Make sure you order lunch beforehand. If you book through your hotel (like we did) make sure you tell them to order you lunch. Bring a lot of water. It isn’t a very physical tour but you will want to stay hydrated. If you go in the spring or fall don’t forget that it is noticeably cooler up at the Grand Canyon than it is in Phoenix. Caden our pilot and Gigi our tour guide did an outstanding job!

This was an experience and way more than imagined!  Such an easy day because Westwind Tours took care of everything. Easy flights thanks to Caden and Carla and an amazing experience with the Hummer Tour with Buckwild Tours and Tre Soule.  The right amount of time and expert commentary as we went to amazing overviews of the canyon with guidance of where we were in comparison to other areas of the canyon. The flyover of the canyon was simply spectacular.  We highly recommend this tour and Westwind alongside Buckwild Hummer Tours!!

Was an amazing experience. Everyone we dealt with was beyond nice and helpful. Our pilot, Noah, was wonderful and helped ease our nervous children. The overhead views were spectacular. We are so glad we made this decision instead of driving!!!

This was my second time flying with West Wind and they are fantastic! I couldn’t be happier. Flying over the Grand Canyon with Carson our pilot was an amazing experience and I can’t wait to fly with them again.

This was a great day. The pilot did an awesome job after we hit severe turbulence over the Grand Canyon. The ground tour was great as well and in spite of less than perfect weather, we saw great beauty and had great fun. Even the optional box lunch was very good. I’d highly recommend this tour.

review_title: A grand way to to the Grand Canyon
review_text:
This trip was totally worth it. Everyone at Westwinds was friendly. The narrated flight was informative. The scenery was beautiful. The convenience from Phoenix was awesome. 

The ground portion was chilly given it was super snowy and the Hummer was more suited to warmer weather. They had plenty of blankets. Our guide was friendly and shared his Navajo culture with us.

The arial trip over the Canyon was spectacular. I can't think of a better way to see the Grand Canyon. Especially since it was my first time seeing it. With this overview you can decide what else you want to see.

review_title: Best tour of the whole trip!
review_text: We had an amazing time with Westwinds.  Carla was an amazing pilot and a joy to spend time with in the air.  Seeing the Canyon from the air was a special experience and unforgettable.  The ground tour with Buck Wild and our guide Gerry was also fantastic.  He was knowledgeable and a Navajo tribe member, so he shared many facts about the history and tribe territory of the Grand Canyon park. I would have loved more time there but we only had a day! This trip made the most of the time we had to spend. Seeing Sedona from the air after taking a ground tour was amazing since we could identity so many of the sites we had visited just a few days earlier.

My family of three had an amazing experience with Captain Carla on the Signature Tour! My son and I were very nervous, but Captain Carla was so kind and competent. We departed from Sedona and enjoyed a GORGEOUS flight to the Grand Canyon. It was so nice to avoid the drive time and traffic from Sedona. Upon arrival to the Grand Canyon, we walked out of the airport and right onto our Wild Buck Hummer tour. We were able to avoid the long entry line into the National Park and cruised right into our first stop. We were able to stop at a few gift shops and see several different viewing areas of the Grand Canyon. We then had a lovely picnic lunch with a beautiful view of the Grand Canyon. It was a memorable day! Thank you to Captain Carla and our Wild Buck tour guide for the fantastic day!

This was a last-minute reservation which was a great adventure. A one of a kind type of tour that was worth every single penny. Everyone had a great view from the plane and a great pilot/guide who was very informative. #karla. Everyone at this place is super nice very accommodating and made this probably one of the most amazing tours I’ve ever taken. The teenagers absolutely loved it – partly because of the private plane ride – as well as the entire experience.

review_title: Awe inspiring way to experience The Grand Canyon!
review_text:
We had a once in a lifetime experience on Westwind's Signature Grand Canyon South and Ground Tour. I have a terrible fear of flying but I was desperate to be able to do this tour. If not today, when, was part of my logic. 

My husband and I arrived at Sedona Airport and watched our plane arrive and I was happy to see the size of the plane. The captain came through the gate, introduced herself  and asked if I was her guest! I told her I was and I was scared Sh**less:) Captain Carla was so kind and professional and assured me I would have a wonderful day and would be able to enjoy the flight. I was comforted by her kindness and assurances. 

Upon boarding the plane with 8 wide comfortable seats for guests I knew if I sat and buckled up I would not turn back:) I did it!

The flight to the Grand Canyon was extremely calm and I found the guide information and soothing background music of the headset extremely calming! Captain Carla interupped the voice tour multiple times to point out various additional points of initerest! Captain even checked on how I was doing mid flight which was so kind!

The first view of the Grand Canyon in the distance is awesome! As we flew around the Canyon, the pictures and videos do not do it justice of the awe you feel viewing it from above! I am so very thankful I was able to complete the tour and feel I was able to do it because of Captain Carla. The Carla Touch:)

We were transferred to BuckWild Hummer Tour for the ground portion. I will review them on their page as well. Tom was our driver, the hummer was exceptionally comfortable, we traveled with a total of 12 guests. The rows of seats are stepped so the view from each row was great, not effected at all by persons in front of you! Great set up. Tom our driver was professional, and  extremely knowledgable of all things related to The Grand Canyon park. It was a pleasure to get to know him during our 3 hour tour. He obviously loves his job and shares that feeling with his guests!

Our return flight to Sedona was a not as calm as outgoing  but Captain Carla tried to find some smoother air but it was impossible. Even with the slight occassional bumps the flight was awesome, the views are just indescribable!

Thank you to Lindsey for arranging our reservation with kindness, and professionalism. Thank you to Captain Carla, without her calming, professionalism and expertise I don't know if I could have done it. Thank you to Tom for sharing his knowledge with us and his insights to The  Grand Canyon as well as his wife who arranged all the lunches for our gourp! 

I wish I could give this tour higher than a 5*!

This was one of the most unique experiences I have ever had! The flight from Phoenix to the Canyon was a bit nerve wracking, due to the small aircraft. Since there were only two of us on the tour, it was private which was nice but if you have a fear of flying this would not be for you. Paul, our pilot was awesome and helped us to feel safe based on his experience.  I loved how this tour included both the aerial view and the scenery of the Canyon on the ground. My husband and I were in Arizona for a short time and wanted to make sure to make the most of our trip. This tour really allowed us to see something unique and fit into our travel plans nicely. I would highly recommend this to others if you are looking for a once in a lifetime experience to see the Grand Canyon from above, the views were priceless!

review_title: Grand Canyon Signature Tour from Sedona
review_text: We did the Grand Canyon Signature tour from Sedona.  Our pilot was Max, and he was excellent.  We spent 30 minutes flying over the Grand Canyon, and then had a three hour Jeep tour of the Grand Canyon National Park.  Everyone was professional, interesting and accommodating.  We would recommend this tour through Westwinds.
Best part of this trip was the smooth and peaceful plane ride over the canyon!  Felt safe with our professional pilot Tom!

Our family of four had a great flight over the Grand Canyon. Everyone from Westwind was great - from booking with Denienne to the amazing flight with Paul. We each had our own windows to enjoy the beautiful views. It was a perfect way to see so much of the canyon in our limited time there. Would fly with them again any time.

review_title: Great experience with flight and ground tour - Can highly recommend
review_text:
Great service.  The narrated fly over the Canyon was helpful, our pilot added great information and all went well.  The ground tour by Jeep/Hummer was very good.  Our guide was so helpful not just at stopping at spots to see but then taking us to unique locations within the sites to see the best views and avoid the larger groups.  

Definitely can recommend the combo flight and ground tour.

This tour had it all. Team was very professional. Started at Deer Valley Airport flew to Sedona then to the South Rim took a helicopter to bottom of the canyon boarded a pontoon for a trip down the Colorado River could not have asked for more!!! Max our Pilot took wonderful care of us and delivered us expertly back to Phoenix.

This was one of the best days of my life. I can’t say enough good things about this tour and the staff at Westwind. We would have skipped this tour after my mom broke her arm the day before and the doctor told us she had to keep ice on her arm the entire day. I called and talked to Destiny who told me they could help us still make this day happen by bringing a cooler of ice along in the plane. Then Max, our pilot, helped us strategize how to get her on the plane (which was challenging given her age and injury) and made sure we had a very smooth flight both ways even with all the wind on our return flight. Both Destiny and Max went out of their ways to make sure my mom and I got to the Grand Canyon so she could check that off her bucket list. It was a wonderful experience in every way. I highly recommend having Max as your pilot. He is extremely experienced, safe, kind, and helpful. I will be bringing my sons and my husband back to do this tour in the future. 
Side notes: the lunch was very simple but good. 
Hummer tour was a great way to see the canyon highlights. There was not a lot of time at each spot. It was kind of a quick way to get a once over tour. I’m glad I did it before coming with my kids to hike it.

This was a once in a lifetime, amazing, beautiful experience. 

- the flight out of Scottsdale through the river valleys is beautiful.
- you get to see both north and south side of Grand Canyon. It’s as jaw dropping as everyone says!
- the service, staff is wonderful and super knowledgeable and accommodating.
- one note, (and this isn’t their fault), is the flight can get bumpy in a small plane, especially on the return (it gets windier as the day goes on). Our 2 younger children (6,4) both made use of the air sickness bags.

A few tips/feedback items:
- the hummer tour is really nice and interesting, but really loud. Couldn’t hear almost anything the driver was saying while driving.
- the lunch didn’t accommodate for allergies (the bread is multi grain, not sure what nuts and seeds) also no veggie option.
- overall seemed a bit rushed. Would love to stay in one place and just take it all in for like an hour or so, but most stops were like 15-30
Min.

review_title: DO IT!!  Great experience, well run tour company!
review_text: Excellent!  Well done tour.  Went on the Ultimate Adventure and one of the best experiences ever.  Never felt pressured or rushed and yet, never waited or was bored.  Ran like a well greased machine and the staff was excellent.  You may be asking yourself if its the worth the price (as I did) but have no doubts, it will be well worth every penny!

Very professional 
Boarded our 6-seater Cessna at 8am, wonderful flight over Sedona then off to Grand Canyon...
Peaceful flight over the awesome GC
Landed at GC airport
Jumped into Humvee for ground tour of some of the top view spots, with Stoney our tour guide. He had some great stories of the GC pioneers 
Lunch at the Lodge
Then return flight , arriving back by 2pm
Preston our pilot for the day was great company
Wonderful day
John

Westwind is unquestionably one of the best experiences I have had in travel.  We were scheduled to fly to the Grand Canyon on December 28th.  On Christmas Eve, we saw that weather might be bad that day.  We called the office late on December 24th and they promptly rescheduled us for a private flight on December 26th.

The flight, customer service, and hiking opportunities were world-class.  We have traveled the world and this trip is on our top three bucket list, along with having dinner on the Eiffel Tower (Jules Verne) and hiking to Waipoo Falls on Kauai, Hawaii.

Thank you Westwind!

I hate to write a review in the midst of COVID for a small business, but unfortunately due to our experience I’m writing this in hopes that nobody else has the same experience. We booked a PRIVATE Grand Canyon tour. We spoke with someone over the phone on multiple occasions who explained it would be just us with the possibility of one other person (although they explained that wouldn’t be likely). When it came time for our flight, the pilot + others arrived 20 minutes late, not wearing masks and informed us there would a total of 10 of us on the tour. As you can imagine, we were pretty surprised given that wasn’t what we signed up or paid for. The pilot explained something happened with scheduling and to call Lindsey. We did so and she provided pretty awful customer service. In short she explained yes there were gonna be 10 people and if we didn’t want to go we didn’t have to but either way we weren’t getting a refund or rescheduled. 

Throughout the flight NOBODY including the guests or pilot wore a mask. Nobody suggested or asked for this to be done. This is unlawful in the state of Arizona and county of Sedona. Not only is this against the law, but put customers in great risk. I cannot believe they would allow this and be okay with this. 

I am so disappointed in the service. Highly recommend researching other options prior to booking with this company. I am sure there are other much better companies that would provide honest and safe services.

review_title: Misleading, overpriced and poor customer service
review_text:
My wife and I decided to spend Valentine’s Day in Sedona and booked an air tour of the Grand Canyon. I booked it over the phone with Lindsey whom seems to be the manager. She lead us to believe it would be just us on the plane and when we arrived we were grouped with 7 other passengers, many of which thought they were going alone as well.

When we reached out thinking there was confusion we were told they got booked on her day off. Keep in mind this is in the midst of Covid so flying on a plane with 7 strangers who NONE INCLUDING THE PILOT WERE WEARING MASKS is not ideal.

We were told we did not purchase the cancellation insurance which was never presented when I booked over the phone and we could only get 50% refunded.

So we paid $600+ to fly with a group of strangers who did not comply with any covid protocol.

The overall tour is alright although not nearly close to worth of the cost.

Extremely dissatisfied.

We were so fortunate to take a tour to the Grand Canyon on our recent trip out to Phoenix.  From the initial booking with Lindsey to our wonderful pilot Daniel and tour guide Jeffrey (a Navajo Native American who was able to share his culture with us), everything was perfectly planned and executed. Daniel was a great tour guide in the air, showing us the red rocks of Sedona, Flagstaff, and of course around the Grand Canyon.  Jeffrey took us to several great viewing points along the south rim and was very knowledgeable.  We would definitely recommend to friends and family.

AMAZING!!!  The entire experience, from booking to take off was superlative!  WestWind really knows what they are doing, they know how to take care of people.  Cannot recommend enough.  Take a tour with them!!!!  You will be so very, very glad you did!

Such a great combination of ground and air experiences. Words cannot describe the vastness and awe of being in the air over the canyon. Lindsey and crew make you feel so welcome. We will definitely be back in the future for a new adventure.

Lindsey and Destiny did an amazing job in the planning of our event. They were so helpful, patient and friendly as they worked through our changes and were very accommodating! The pilots were all so friendly on-site and Elijah was very personable making everyone feel comfortable. 
The day was seamless and everyone had a blast on the Hummer Tour and were amazed with the views of the fly over of the Grand Canyon! 
We will definitely use West Wind Aviation for any of our future events as they really provided the WOW factor!!!

review_title: Best way to see and visit Grand Canyon
review_text: Wow! We booked this trip last minute from Phoenix. This was the absolute best way to see Sedona, Flagstaff and many rock formations on the way to the Grand Canyon. Being able to see the perspective of the GC from the air and on land in one day was amazing. To top it off, we ended up being the only ones on the plane and on the Buck Wild Hummer tour. Our pilot and guide were amazing and informative. They even provided lunch sitting at an overlook of the canyon. We were able to accomplish all of that and be back in 6.5 hours instead of 12 hours. We would highly recommend this tour offered by Westwind.

All I can say is WOW. This was truly a once in a lifetime experience. Our pilot, Carla, was so knowledgeable and amazing. I can’t recommend this tour enough and I felt like my money was well spent. We even got to see wild bison! If you only have one day to see the Canyon then this is a great value.
From the first interaction on by phone through saying goodbye, everyone involved in this experience was amazing!  Exceptional customer service and a once in a lifetime trip.

review_title: No better views of the Grand Canyon than this trip.
review_text:
What a totally special and insanely fun way to see the Grand Canyon.

If you are not sure what part of the Canyon you want to see on your trip, and I know a lot of you are think "Do I want to see the North? the West? The South? The river?!?!?" How about seeing almost all over it in like an hour....that's what you get to do in by plane on this tour.

I took the tour, departing with our first class pilot pilot Karla, from Sedona. It was a great view of Sedona and it's geography, the trip up to the Grand Canyon, the Canyon and the return. Totally awesome.

The trip also includes are few hours of driving between photo locations on the south rim. Got to see some of the great views and I really enjoyed our guide Jerry.

I was able to book everything on short notice, which was really fantastic (Thanks Covid!!!!), great communication and a fun time all around.

Organisation parfaite, très sérieuse très efficace. La pilote a offert un survol d une exceptionnelle qualité .
Au sol, la visite réalisée par la compagnie des pink jeeps a été aussi exceptionnelle avec une guide dont les connaissances et compétences ont permis dans un temps limité d’avoir un tour d’une très grande qualité et d un grand intérêt

From the moment we made an enquiring call to the last second we left the premises following the tour, the service was exceptional.  The Canyon overpass was spectacular and if you can, well worth taking the flight for that alone - our pilot (Bill) was friendly and we did not feel in a hurry....  The ground tour was expertly laid on with a very knowledgable guide and at no pint did we feel hurried with a relatively tight schedule.  The ground staff (Lyndsy) back at base was so welcoming and accomodating.  There were snacks and coffee waiting for us when we arrived and on return.  I cannot fault this tour - it made for a once in a lifetime experience.  Thank you.

review_title: One of the best excursions my wife and I have been on!
review_text: From the reception at their airport office, to the flight, jeep tour and guides, and flight back, truly an amazing way to see Grand Canyon. All the staff and pilot were accommodating, friendly and reassuring. Worth every penny! Just do it!
very professional, friendly and knowledgeable staff. the best way to see the canyon without actually hiking into it. Well worth it

review_title: An amazing day!  Both my husband and I loved out tour.
review_text:
We had an amazing day with Westwind Air Services.  We loved Phoenix, found it quiet and peaceful and also clean.
We were collected from our hotel and the day was wonderful from that moment.  We felt we were amongst friends.  Loved the Grand Canyon from the air and the ground.  I will recomment Westwind,  Lyndsay made booking easy and looked after us from the moment we arrived.
The pilot was great and the Pink Jeap Tour was so easy, friendly and informative.
Westwind is the way to fly.
Thanks for everything guys.  Penny and Wayne

Everything about the Grand Canyon Signature Tour was perfect. Lindsay made booking easy and made us comfortable when we arrived. Our pilot Steven was excellent, made us feel comfortable with our first experience on a Cessna, and the air tour was absolutely awe-inspiring. The connection to the Jeep tour was seamless and the ground tour was great. I can’t recommend these guys enough! So easy and so much fun. This tour was worth every penny and I hope to fly with you again! Thanks again for everything! - Brian and Indira

Bra ordning och service, tydlig kommunikation betr. bokning, bra guider. Piloterna gjorde att man kände sig säker under flygturen. Vyerna var fantastiska, Grand Canyon ger inte alls samma upplevelse från marken. Rekommenderas.
All communication with West Winds was clear and timely.  Wyatt and Rob, our pilots were top notch, fun, informative and friendly.  We highly recommend this company!

We took the flight over the Grand Canyon to test out a developing air anti collision app . I was a nervous passenger however, I had nothing to worry about thanks to our pilot Ken. He was very reassuring and ensured that I was comfortable and relaxed throughout the flight.

He was very meticulous with his checks and made the journey very comfortable ( commented by my pilot friend who was traveling with me) 
Thanks Ken for a wonderful and worry free flight. it was amazing.
Would recommend it to anyone

We did the Grand Canyon air tour with the South Rim hummer tour.  It was all incredible!  Our pilot was great, and there was an audio going the whole flight explaining about all of the sights we flew over, like Sedona, Flagstaff, and the different mountains.  And then when we landed our driver took us to some of the best scenic spots on the south rim, ending with a lunch at Grand Canyon Village.  It was an amazing experience that we will never forget!!!

My husband and I took this tour yesterday and it was fantastic!  Gayle was very helpful when we booked and even called the day before to tell us the what the temperature would be at the Grand Canyon.  When we arrived for our flight we were offered water and snacks and our flight left on time.  Justin, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and we felt very confident with him as a pilot. Wonderful ground tour, just wished we could have spent more time in the village.  Overall we highly recommend this tour!

Our group of 6 recently took the trip from Scottsdale to the South Rim of the Grand Canyon.  We were all very happy with the experience.  It was apparent from the start that safety is their #1 priority and they slightly delayed out start to make sure the plane was defrosted (we went during an unusually cool period in Phoenix).  Once off, the pilot did an exceptional job of keeping us informed of what we were doing and what to expect as we got closer to the Grand Canyon.  We did the Buck Wild Hummer Tour and they met us and toured us as expected.  Lunch was great and then we were off to the airport for the return trip.  We were pleasantly surprised when we arrived and found a Happy Anniversary banner on the plane to help one us celebrate our anniversary.
Top notch tour and I give them my highest recommendation!!!

Booked a trip to the Grand Canyon while we were in Scottsdale. Westwind Air was recommended by the hotel. What a great trip, our pilot Justin was incredible (I think he was 18 😂). We got diverted to Grand Canyon Valley airport due to weather at the Canyon, picked up at the new location and driven to the Canyon, was cold and snowy but otherwise a great adventure. The Valley airport was a gem, filled with beautiful antique cars. We got breaks in the weather and seen beautiful views of the Canyon in the snow. Would highly recommend this adventure if visiting the Scottsdale area.

Worth. Every. Penny. 
We were going to drive from Phoenix to Grand Canyon and visit for a day and thought it would be way more fun to go by air and land. Googled this place and they did not disappoint. At $549 per person, 8 of us got into a very comfy tiny plane and flew over Sedona, flagstaff and the Grand Canyon. Spent 30 min over Grand Canyon alone. Landed and took a pink Jeep tour (included in the piece). Our guide was Lucy and she was absolutely awesome. Spent about 2-3 hrs on land with her. She provided us with lunch (sandwich, chips, cookie, apple and water). Flew back to Phoenix in same plane. Cannot remember the pilot, but he just had twins, so congrats and thanks for a terrific day and experience! We will never forget this day!

review_title: Amazing way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: I had a great time on the flight. I was able to ride shotgun both ways since I was a solo traveler. Bryce was very knowledgeable about the area and was super sweet when I got air sick. He was also very attuned to when I became fearful because of turbulence. I would not have had as great of a time if it wasn't for his attentiveness. He deserves major kudos for being so intuitive to his passengers.

Very impressed with Westwind Tours - the lady who booked my flights is warm and friendly and they called the day before (on Thanksgiving) to re-confirm.  The tour ran smoothly and on-time, and our guides were personable and informative.  

Dress warmly!  It was warm in Phoenix and cold at the Canyon. 

Great outfit, outstanding views, a complete experience and highly recommended.

I have been attempting a trip to the Grand Canyon for a number of years. The delay was well worth it given the quality of the day my wife and I had. I cannot say enough good things about the day we had. It was more than I had anticipated!!
Going to do it again for another one of their tours of the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Great Day! Unbelieveable, worth every penny
review_text: My family and I really enjoyed this trip. The flight was flawless . Ben was an excellent pilot and we enjoyed our ride . The views were amazing and your really can't see the canyon from a better angle. You can take a thousand pictures but it wont do justice to the canyon from the air. If you can you must do this trip!

I took my Husband John on the Adventure Tour to the Grand Canyon and it was absolutely AMAZING!  LINDSEY was so GREAT and answered all my questions and she also has a big heart. I was afraid to go on a small aircraft but LINDSEY reassured me that it was safe and most of all FUN!. VAL was GREAT too! VAL made sure that we all had snacks and went POTTY because it was about a 2 hour flight. Thank YOU VAL! Overall this trip was one of a kind.  I highly recommend this trip to EVERYONE!

We had a great time on this tour,  the airplane ride up included a quick fly by Sedona,  great 1/2 hour tour of the Grand Canyon,  then enjoyed the 3 hour Pink Jeep Tour that allowed us to get up close and personal with the Canyon.  A little pricey but well worth it.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon with limited time
review_text: We stayed in Scottsdale for our vacation and took Westwind from the Deer Valley airport only 20 minutes away. Our family of five (kids 13, 10, 3) had never seen the Grand Canyon. Flying up there in 1 hour was such a treat over driving for 3.5 hours. Our two older kids really listened to the narrated history on the headphones the whole way up, and even our three year old looked out the window as we started to fly over the Grand Canyon itself. The view is absolutely stunning, and the flight was very smooth. Once we landed, the Pink Jeep tour guide did a great job telling us the history and getting us to each view point quickly and efficiently. They also added an Imax movie viewing of the Grand Canyon river tour as an added surprise, which all of us enjoyed. On the way back, our pilot Jameson had my 10 year old in the front as co-pilot, and he LOVED hearing all about the airplane and the landscape below the whole way back. The whole day was a great experience.

This was one of the most exhilarating experiences I have had in my life! It is something that you need to experience for yourself - not something someone can tell you about. The whole tour experience was worth every cent, hubby and I flew from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon, our Pilot Mark was great and personable, the Jeep experience up into the Canyon with our tour guide William was awesome - lunch at the top of the canyon was awesome and the staff at Westwind, Lindsey and Gail went above and beyond to ensure this was the best experience we could have had. I would do this again in a heartbeat !!! Thank you again to Lindsey and Gail - you really made this trip "real" for us

review_title: Smooth flying, fantastic view of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Fantastic service - Leslie in the office is an absolute treasure and our pilot was very professional and obliging. Superb views of the canyon - felt very safe & comfortable. Other passengers also very friendly. One very pleased 'aussie'!

review_title: You have to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: great trip--the Grand Canyon is amazing and has to be seen--the view from the plane is excellent. don't be afraid of flying. use time at the Canyon to walk rather than sit in the jeep.

review_title: Flight from Hell over the Grand Canyon...
review_text:
I'm conflicted as to how to review Westwind as we had two different planes for our group of 16 family and friends (ages ranging from 25 - 60) who had completely different experiences on our flight over the Grand Canyon from Page Airport. My flight (which I'll refer to as plane 1), which was supposedly the NON-executive plane, had an awesome pilot named Mark, who communicated with us throughout the flight, pointing out where to look (and there's a lot you won't see/notice if you're not directed) and forewarning us of turbulence. His humor and constant, clear communication made a semi-scary extremely turbulent flight as comfortable as it could possibly be. A few of us threw up from the bumpiness, but we felt very safe in Mark's hands and were all happy with our experience.

Our other plane of 8 people however (plane 2), had an entirely different experience. This plane we were told was the "executive plane" - nicer seats, etc. However, unlike plane 1 which had secure shoulder straps and individual seats for each person, this plane only had waist belts, the last row of the plane was a bench, and their seats were not in a fixed position and so were aggressively sliding back and forth throughout the flight. This constant movement, paired with turbulence, resulted in everyone slamming their heads into the ceiling multiple times (confirmed by every passenger) and 5 of the 8 passengers vomiting throughout the flight (so much vomit that my mom (the guest of honor) had to clean out the plane after they landed while the pilot stood by watching).  One person got so sick they had to go to the hospital afterwards and 3 others were ill for the rest of the day and unable to participate in the activities we had planned. Of the 8 people on plane 2, only TWO people actually saw the Grand Canyon because the others were so sick, or scared that they couldn't look. 

To make matters worse, their captain, unlike ours, did not speak once throughout the entire flight. Not only did this mean they weren't getting told where to look (which you think would be a no-brainer for a tour like this), but it also made everyone incredibly nervous as they continued to hit worse and worse turbulence. Honestly, when I initially heard how terrible a time they had, I thought they were being dramatic, but when I heard THESE details (seats sliding around, heads slamming into the ceiling, and a captain who did not speak the entire 1.5 hour flight) and they were confirmed by every single passenger, I was furious. 

Upon landing, as the majority of our group was throwing up outside the airport, the captains told us that that was the worst conditions they've ever flown through and that they were cancelling the rest of the flights for that day. While I'm of course glad that I (and the lucky others on plane 1 were able to see the Grand Canyon, I'm also a little skeptical of Westwind's judgment to 1) fly us in such bad conditions and 2) fly half of our group on a plane that seems incredibly unsafe and with a pilot who apparently doesn't have basic communication skills.  That's not just "bad conditions," that is bad judgement and completely unacceptable and infuriating when lifes are on the line. And finally, it's really disappointing that a once in a lifetime experience was turned into a harrowing, sickening flight from hell.
Amazing views! We loved it! Very safe. We are locals but loved seeing our home from above!!!!   Beautiful day! San Francisco and all of Marin and the coast.

A fantastic sea plane trip around the San Francisco Bay, with a flyover of the Golden Gate Bridge and the city.
Exceptionally friendly staff and pilot.
Highly recommended.

Great view of Sausalito, San Francisco Bay and the city. You fly along the coast at about 1000’ looking at the sites then you gain a little altitude and go across the city viewing Golden Gate Park and the Presidio. You end up South of the Golden Gate Bridge over the Pacific Ocean. On the way back home you fly directly over the bridge and back to base. On a clear day it is a pretty spectacular 30 minutes.
The beauty of San Francisco could be better appreciated from this tour. Sea plane landing was a memorable one - better than any commercial airplane landing!! Very enthusiastic staff !!

Fun, informative and exciting! Thank you for the experience!
The tour was a great overview of San Francisco and Marin history and offered once in a lifetime views.
Once in a lifetime activity that my entire family will never forget. Awesome experience. My kids had so much fun. The pilot was very knowledgeable & the trip was exciting.

review_title: Welcoming staff, professional communications, fun ride
review_text:
Despite high winds and fog in the city, our group could see all of the sights clearly and had a great ride.  A seaplane is such an exciting experience, even if you've flown in other light craft before.  Each member of the staff we encountered were very friendly and cool, and made us feel very comfortable.  We really felt welcomed.  

The online booking experience was super smooth and user-friendly.  Received reminder emails with all necessary information and even a text the morning of the flight letting us know that traffic would be heavier than normal and to plan accordingly.  

The building was quite nice too, with a comfortable picnic table outside, sofas in a lounge inside, and clean restrooms.  Highly recommend!

review_title: The highlight of any San Francisco visit.
review_text: Ana,  The office manager was extremely efficient and helpful. Fred, the pilot, is an experienced pilot, an excellent narrator, and a great guy.   A flight over San Francisco is the highlight of any visit.

review_title: Safe and Fun, Even With Pandemic and Without the Sun
review_text: The weather was gray and wet but we were able to go up with Fred. We kept to the Bay and flew close to the GG Bridge and over the Bay Bridge. I was bummed that the weather kept us from going over the City, but Fred made the best of it, and we enjoyed our time in the sky. There's no better feeling than flying I can think of, besides my other favorite, being in water. It was my husband's first time in a small plane and he enjoyed the ride and views. Things were not so far away, especially since we were flying low because of the weather. A COVID note: Our temps were taken and the pilot disinfected the plane before we boarded, and all abroad wore masks. I could feel outside air moving through the cabin, too. I felt pretty comfortable and safe. Go flying and keep this awesome business afloat! (Get it?)

A consommer sans modération, la vue sur tout le San Francisco est juste splendide. L’équipe est super sympathique, une navette viens vous récupérer et vous re dépose. 
Le pilote Jérôme parle très bien le français et a beaucoup d’humour. 
Je recommande a 200% de faire ce vol pour tout ceux qui passe par San Francisco.
Bravo.

Extraordinaire expérience que ce survol de 30 minutes de San Francisco et de sa baie.
Un pilote très sympathique qui parle français qui commente, mais pas trop, les vues époustouflantes sur le Golden Gate, la Skyline ou Alcatraz
Reéllement magique!

review_title: Best way to see Golden Gate Bridge and san Francisco
review_text: Seaplane adventure provide a unique was of experiencing main of San Francisco's landmarks through planes. It provides knowledgable pilot and also if you are lucky enough to be only two people on the plane, you will have the whole place to your selves. It was cover Golden Gate bridge, Alcatraz prison as well other landmark such as beaches nearby, stadiums and most of san francisco

review_title: Must do when near San Fran!
review_text: The guide as well as ride was amazing!  Truly worth your time and money!  A must do when near San Fran.  It was one of the best parts of our honeymoon stay!

review_title: Excellent time in the air above the bay!
review_text:
I think this is the best thing I did while visiting San Francisco this week!
Very friendly staff, the pilot was kind enough to accommodate the special requests of the other group of people in the plane and he made sure we could all see and take pictures of all views.
Totally recommend it - it gave me 45 minutes of non-stop smile on my face!!

The customer service and kindness of Meredith was outstanding!  She worked with us on the timing and also the safety of the trip, based on the weather which seems to change by the hour. She truly was outstanding!!!  

Jason was our pilot, and he shared his knowledge and also allowed us the quiet to simply take in the beauty of the mountains. It’s such a different point of view from that vantage point. The take off, flight, and landing were all so smooth. The windows of the plane were crystal clear to allow excellent views and opportunities for pictures. He too was outstanding!  

These folks are a small local company and know how to do it right. Many thanks!

The outfit was really laid-back, which was nice. They accommodated our schedule and shifted us around a couple times. It worked out. The pilot was nice, but not super-informative. Seemed like a new business. This was a wildlife viewing tour, but honestly, it’s really hard to see animals that far away at those speeds. Also, the pilot didn’t seem to know much about the patterns or movement of animals, although he had several trips before us. I would think he would have a better idea of where they are to spot them.
Beautiful views of the Talkeetna mountains and it was clear enough to see the Denali.

We booked the 30 minute ride but decided to go on the longer one once there. Worth. Every. Penny!  You fly so close to the Moose Teeth mountain that you feel like you can touch it. Incredible views of Denali and other peaks. I’ve done lots of things over the years and don’t know how this one could be topped.

review_title: Wonderful customer service despite the disappointing weather
review_text:
Our family booked the 30 minute seaplane adventure as part of our cruisetour.  Due to rainy weather, we were not able to take the tour but I wanted to acknowledge the wonderful customer service provided.  The company reached out the day before to let us know the weather did not look good for our flight but they would keep us informed.  We had booked a morning flight.  They contacted us in the morning to confirm we would have to cancel but offered to postpone to another day.  Unfortunately we were leaving the next day to go to Denali so they offered to wait until afternoon and see if the weather cleared.  We were contacted again at noon time and weather was still not cooperating so they had to cancel.  Our payment was refunded in full with no headaches.  Although we obviously would have preferred to be able to take the seaplane flight, weather is the determining factor on adventures like these.  I was so grateful for the wonderful customer service.  I felt the company cared and really tried to find a way for us to enjoy our excursion.  
For anyone planning an Alaskan adventure, feel comfortable booking with this company knowing they try there best to fulfill their commitment and when they are not able to, you will be refunded quickly and without any hassles.

review_title: If the clouds are to low for Denali, reserve a floatplane ride.

review_title: Right side rewards, left side regrets.
review_text: This sightseeing flight offered some beautiful views, but I found the experience heavily favored passengers on the right side of the aircraft. As a left-side passenger, my view was primarily of the shoreline, and I missed out on many of the central island's key attractions like the mountains, canyons, and waterfalls. Additionally, strategically maneuvering the aircraft to provide brief, alternating views of key landmarks for both sides of the plane could help ensure a more equitable experience for all passengers.

review_title: Great value, awesome pilot and wonderful views
review_text:
I had been looking at this flight since we began planning our trip to Kauai,  but was still on the fence . We did a helicopter tour of the Big Island 20 years ago and kept wondering if it was worth double the price to go on a helicopter here.  On our first day we drove out to Waimea Canyon and there we made our choice.  We saw the plane and a helicopter pass over us and decided the plane looked great.

We booked the flight online 10:30 am (later we heard a pilot share this was the best time but honestly I don't think you could go wrong either time. )

Got to the airport and checked in a little later our pilot Nick came by and welcomed us. Walked out to the plane did a little safety brief, low door watch your head and so on, then loaded the plane for the typical over the water flight, loved the bit of humor with the air sickness bag and taxid out to the runway. 
Nick is a wonderful young pilot, those folks seem to be getting younger every year, or .aybe it's just me. Local guy, no doubt loves what he does and where he lives. Offered a great tour pointing out highlights and the coolest thing was making some left hand turns for those of us on the other side of the plane. Great pilot he banked us over so we could get some great pictures and did it so SMOOTHLY that we hardly noticed.
We took some incredible pictures and a few videos of the entire island. It was really cool having him point out places we had visited and see it from the air.
Wish there was a higher rating we could give. Highly recommend this trip 👌  best value and awesome views, what a combo!
Use my name when you get there they won't remember me just say little round guy big smile, grinned the rest of the day. Book it book it now
.  Can't wait to come back and do it again.

The Air Ventures team is amazing. When we got caught in traffic, they worked with us to get our tour rescheduled when they really didn’t have too… it was our fault that we didn’t give ourselves enough travel time. The tour was great … we will definitely tour with Air Ventures again!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

review_title: Perfect way to see the island
review_text:
This was an amazing aerial tour of the island where we could see just how beautiful Kauai is.  Our pilot and guide, Justin, was kind and personable; he made every effort to make sure we were comfortable and gave us a lot of information about the different places.  The highlight of the tour was definitely N'apali Coast.  Out of all the modes of transportation that allowed a peek at this part of the island, I thought this would be the easiest for my family (kids and elders).  

I was expecting more turbulence, but it was a smooth flight with a few bumps that felt more like rolls.  Even though the flight was smooth, five out of the six of us felt a bit sick- most likely because of the closed space and movement of the plane.  I wasn't expecting to feel nauseous but felt uncomfortable near the end.  My 8 year old son who was sitting next to him as co-pilot, got sick but the pilot was very nice about it.  That said, I would advise you to take some kind of motion sickness medicine beforehand, just in case.

So happy we did this. Marcus was a fantastic pilot. The views were breathtaking. Perfect amount of time to not take up the whole day but to really appreciate the beauty of this island. I couldn't imagine leaving without seeing these views.

That was the best and beautiful thing I’ve ever seen in my life. So many different landscapes 😍😍. Our pilot Marcus was also a real air guide, he knows a lot of things and he tried his best to made this tour unforgettable.
Josh was super friendly. Kept the flight as smooth  as possible in a small plane. Knew his was around the island and knew where the interesting sights were.

😊🔥Amazing way to experience Kauai from the air. Unlike helicopters that could make you dizzy, flying in this small airplane was very smooth and steady, considering we went with a 7 year old and older parents. Our pilot Shaeden was absolutely fantastic! 🙌Knowledgeable and friendly! The views were something we will never forget! We took many photos and videos, it was easy to see everything as the airplane has large windows made especially for sightseeing! Highly recommend 👍
Our pilot, Shaeden, was great. Lots of great information along with beautiful views. The landing and ride was very smooth.
This hour long flight was awesome for our family of four! Great views all around the island of Kauai. They recorded the whole flight on my gopro. We'll worth it!

review_title: My best experience of my Kaua'i vacation (And I did it ALL)
review_text: What a great experience. Out pilot, Shaydin (sp) was great.  Lots of information about the island, and some good stories and lore.  Besides being a excellent pilot and providing not only a smooth flight but also great vantage points for seeing things from both sides of the aircraft. I would highly recommend this.  Even better than the boat charter around Napali.  Best tour I went on.
Piper was our pilot and she was so goooood! Not only experienced but knowledgeable about the island . It made our entire trip so much fun
Wonderful tour of the island and outstanding pilot!  We'd love to do this again.  Pilot is very knowledgeable and showed us a great tour!
Had a great flight with Josh Hak ... funny and informative ... we had great weather and 2 other really nice couples we'd never met before.
Piper was an incredible pilot! She made sure everyone had phenomenal views and shared so many facts about the island. I would definitely recommend doing this on your next trip to Kauai!

Wonderful experience for our family!  Mak was a great pilot, very friendly, and gave us great information about the island during our 1 Hr flight.  This turned out to be one of the many highlights of our trip to Kauai.  Definitely recommend!

Piper was awesome! She knew so much about the island, both its history and cool places to go. We took her advice on a few things afterwards, and everything was awesome. She was amazing and I’d give ten stars if I could! I highly recommend this adventure to anyone, but wish I had taken a Dramamine first! 🤣😍

Our pilot shaedon was really knowledgeable, incredibly easygoing and an all around great tour guide and pilot! He operated the plane beautifully and never once made me worry. The tour itself was extraordinary. The views were absolutely astounding and jaw dropping. It truly is a beautiful place. This tour had headsets so you can hear what everyone onboard was saying. Ultimately it was a perfect way to see the whole island.
Our pilot Piper was great. She knew a lot about the island.  Lots of waterfalls. Good view of a lot of the beaches.  Great overall experience.
Awesome views, great route over incredible scenery, Maka, our pilot, was brilliant. Very knowledgeable and had a great take off and landing, definitely recommend!

This tour exceeded our expectations! The ground crew were so friendly and helpful, the flight was smooth and comfortable, and the views were out-of-this-world! We saw the whole island and the pilot's commentary about what we were looking at was very interesting.

A really beautiful sightseeing flight around the island. Our pilot Marcus gave us a closer look at his home during the flight. We would recommend the sightseeing flight to anyone. We haven't found a better way to see (and photograph) all the sights and the country.
Compliments also to our pilot, who flew the flight so smoothly and provided us with excellent information and experiences

review_title: Awesome scenic plane ride at a reasonable price
review_text: Our pilot Marcus was great! Very knowledgeable and skilled. We felt safe and the views were breathtaking! We got to see the spectacular Napali coast, which can only be seen by plane or boat.
Absolutely amazing experience, with great views and perfect service. Can recommend this to any visitor of the island! Completely worth the money.
Worth every penny. The pilot Marcus was so good and we felt very safe the whole time during the flight.  I highly recommend this.
It was more worthwhile than all the other excursions on this vacation. Cool pilot, awesome experience. Definitely do it!!!
We flew with pilot Piper (named after a plane) she’s had great experience flying and loves to explain everything about the island and keeping us up to date on everything, definitely coming back!

Must do!  There were three retired couples in our group and the plane was the perfect size.  Viewed all the highlights of the island with an excellent pilot who provided an interesting, informative narrative of the the island.  All of us were delighted with the trip.  All of the tour's employees were attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly.  A great experience!

I had the best experience with Air Venture Hawaii! Everyone was so friendly and made me feel so safe and comfortable from start to finish. The views were absolutely stunning, I had been dreaming of seeing Nā Pali from above. So glad that I got such an awesome pilot. Mahalo nui Piper, you’re the best 😊✈️

review_title: A must do when you are on the Island!
review_text: Great views to give you an overall impression of the island without trying to drive/hike everywhere! Our pilot "Piper" was an amazing lady - bubbly,informative, wrote down some turtle spotting tips for us afterward, and yet still professional in all her dealings with other aircraft and air traffic control. We felt a fixed wing plane outing was a better dollar value than the helicopter rides but with similar great views!  Definitely, worth the time and money.
We were able to change our flight day, due to an itinerary change that was unavoidable. Josh the pilot was great he was helpful & informative, he had a good sense of humour & great music.

Justin was our pilot and was an adventure of a lifetime to see the beauty of the island of Kauai and him answering all the questions we had!  Seeing it from above was a photo opt like no other!  Well worth the price and was fun sitting in the co-pilot seat!

review_title: Amazing not to be missed experience!
review_text: We tried going to the Na Pali Coast in our car to see the beautiful views but it was not to be as the whole region was covered with clouds and rain. So to make sure we got to see it we booked a flight with Air Ventures and what a great idea it turned out to be. The plane was a small 6 seater and our pilot was the very young but brilliant, Piper. She did a great job narrating what we were about to see or seeing from the windows. Don't be wary of her age or how young she seems to be. Her flying was faultless and smooth all the way through. If you're looking for an amazing way to explore Kauai then do not hesitate booking with Air Ventures.

review_title: Great flight with a Hawaiian (from Kauai!) native
review_text: We had an actual pilot who is a local -Marcus! Even though he is younger than our kids :) he was awesome and knew the island well! The view from a plane is very different than a helicopter as you get more of the big picture but it was calm and scenic.

We had Captain Shaydon for our tour.  He was very knowledgeable of the island and pointed out a lot of sites. We left the airport and headed clockwise around the island past our resort in Poipu, the the west side, the canyon, Napali Coast, north shore and cut back across the east side back to the airport.

Absolutely fabulous!
Our pilot, Justin was spectacular.
He explained any turbulence we experienced well and we felt safe and comfortable.

The entire tour was incredibly beautiful!

Highly recommended!

We had a fantastic time. Friendly and accommodating employees.  Started with making sure the flight would be perfect so we delayed and rebooked to better weather.   Macha the pilot did a fantastic job explaining the flight process and did a wonderful job as an aviator.  

We saw so many cool things.  He just refused to take us over the
Military base and engage in a dog fight with the aircraft that would have prevented us from going over the base!
Amazing!  Piper was a great pilot and our family of 4 (ages 7 and 8) loved every minute.  When I asked them what their favorite part of vacation was they both agreed that this tour was the best!

The only thing we should’ve done differently is to book this tour at the beginning of our visit to Kauai. Our pilot, Piper, was extremely informative and great tour-guide of the island in addition to being a great pilot. The entire activity was very well organized and necessary details communicated in timely manner. Definitely recommend if you’re visiting Kauai.

Beautiful clear skies over the island to see that magnificent landscapes and costal areas of the island.  Great way to see the many canyons and waterfalls. 
Lucky to see some groups ot Humpback whales out to sea and pilot took us down for a closer look.  Excellent commentary from the pilot describing what we were seeing throughout the trip.
Highly recommend the tour and AirVentures.

Piper was an incredible pilot and showed us everything around the island. She was very informative and made sure both sides of the plane saw everything.
