review_text: Young pilot very professional and qualified.We saw things we were unableto see in the helicopter tour we took. I would recommend this company toanyone wanting a great view of interior and exterior Kauai.

Never been to Kauai and who knows if we’ll be back. This was fantastic.  We flew with JT who flew the plane flawlessly and was nice and informative. Frankly, it was even smoother than most jet aircraft we’ve been on. 

Beautiful views and something we will remember for the rest of our lives.  An absolute must if you come. It only takes an hour.

review_title: Best money you will spend on the island!!!
review_text: This plane tour is literally the best money you will spend on the island. Amazing views mixed in with some knowledge and history. J.T.  Is an amazing pilot that made the entire family feel relaxed and entertained. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone!!

Seeing Kauai from a plane was wonderful. We had seen the na Pali coast by raft the previous day and seeing it from the air was a very different perspective. I personally am less anxious in a plane versus helicopter. And our pilot was very informative and we had a very smooth ride. Also was great to see Waimea canyon from above...a must do!

JT was our pilot on our 60 minute tour of Kauai. It greatly exceeded my already high expectations. Highly recommend to anyone visiting the island. Gives a great overall and history of the island without spending hours and days in your car.

We would like to thank  Capt Makoa for the wonderful memories. You showed us the beautiful island of Kauai up in the air. The sights were amazing. It was all breathtaking. It was great! Smooth take off and smooth landing. I was afraid of heights and you made me feel safe immediately you took off. I didnt feel the plane going up. I just realized when we were already up in the air. You should fly commercial soon. Stay humble and pleasant. Again, thank you to you and the rest of the staff

review_title: Don’t miss this outstanding island highlight
review_text: The Air Venture Kauai Air Tour is simply spectacular.  We took the tour at the end of our stay, and it was breathtaking to see all the sites we visited from the air. You can truly appreciate the beauty of the island during the flight.  Our pilot, JT, was friendly and very knowledgeable about the island.  His enthusiasm expressed how much loved the island and enjoyed his job.  He was a great ambassador for Air Ventures and the island of Kauai.  Very highly recommend this tour.

This was a surprise for my wife, neither of us had ever done anything like this before. She was a little nervous never having flown in a small plane but once in the air the view takes your mind off of everything else. We went around the entire island and were able to see everything. The weather was perfect. The pilot would go into an area so one side of the plane could see and then bank around so the other side could see. He would always ask if everybody got their pictures as he would go again if they had not. It was never an issue. We had already seen much of the island by the time we took this tour but totally different experience from the air.
Everyone loved the experience.  Highly recommended. Pilot and ground crew very welcoming and friendly from the time we arrived for the flight until we were done.

review_title: A must to do and must to see
review_text: Discovering Kauai from the air is a must to do. I think that the plane option is better than helicopter for many reasons. Sure helicopter is more spectacular, because it flyes in the canyon. However views are better with plane : only windows seats, more stable, large and clean windows... Moreover, the pilot flyes over the nicest sites 2 times, so that each side can discovers the best view, especially Waimea Canyon, Wailua falls and napali Coast. It's a wonderful and amazing scenic fly. Pictures and videos are perfect ! And all the Jill's team is kind and very professionnal. Very very good experience in Kauai.

This was our last stop of Hawaii and Kauai is the most amazing of our whole trip.
We seen all the differences Kauai has to offer and was way beond our expectation.
Even put the video i could make on youtube:
(Link not allowed here)
Thanks again for the experience.

JT was an awesome pilot with great information about all the different landmarks. There were places we saw that you could not see by car. Our kids loved the flight as well. It was an experience we’ll never forget. Must do!!
JT was very good at pointing out all the areas of interest and making the trip something we will remember for a lifetime!

Our Air Venture tour was terrific and JT was an excellent guide and pilot.  Even though the weather wasn't optimal JT got us to all the great spots he could and made sure every passenger got a good view out their window.  Highly recommend this tour.

Even though most of our trip consisted of heavy rainfall and cancelled/postponed tours, air ventures was easily the highlight of our trip! Trish was awesome in assisting with the scheduling of our tour (and my proposal)and the pilot was awesome as well. I definitely recommend setting up an air tour with air ventures if you’re visiting Kauai!

Short version: amateur, unprofessional, overpriced, uncomfortable, rude, terrible experience. Spend the extra money and take a he'll ride, or at least use a different plane ride provider! 

Long version: We arrived at 925 for our 10am departure, and after the counter employees spent ten minutes in what seemed like some kind of candid camera routine, they informed us that there was some kind of "system error" leaving us as the only two passengers for the flight, which they "couldn't do." They told us we had to come back at 11. 
 We returned at 11 and waited over an hour before we finally got in the air with a pilot who clearly had very little experience flying or in customer service. After informing us he "wasn't supposed to be here today" and that the pilots don't even get paid, and that one of these tour planes had just crash landed the other day, we proceeded on our unprofessional and abbreviated tour of the island.  After learning we were newlyweds he informed us that he was thinking of getting engaged so he could stop using condoms but that he had been a man whose so his girl wamts him to use them. This was one of the few statements he made that didn't begin with "I'm not supposed to tell you this, but..."
 I know that they cannot be held accountable for inclement weather but we deliberately booked the earliest flight available to get out before the weather turned. About the time the 10am flight landed the storm moved in and we were unable to see much of anything on our flight. 

Had we been on the flight we booked (both airbusses flew at 10am, despite the story that there were only two of us booked) we might have an entirely different review.
Had they just admitted it was their mistake we might have an entirely different review.
Had they just been honest before takeoff that due to weather we would not be able to see the napali coast, we might have an entirely different review. 

But the unprofessional pilot and the unprofessional gate staff and the unprofessional business model of this place left us wishing we had spent the extra money and taken a helicopter ride instead of what now feels like a tourist trap rip-off. Cannot even shrug this off as a "you get what you pay for" experience, as we paid for a 10am professionally piloted all-island tour. And got a short plane ride with a kid who didn't want to be there, and frankly, shouldn't have.

review_title: Bad customer service! Don’t waste your money here!
review_text: This was a very disappointing and frustrating experience to say the least. First, we scheduled a plane tour on Sunday. We were told the scheduling was an error and they didn’t have any pilots on Sunday. We agreed to reschedule on Thursday. We were not told that if you sit on the left hand side of the plane you will not see most of the sights. For more than 50% of the time I was just looking at the ocean. The headphones did not work and we could not hear anything that the pilot was saying. The pilot seemed very disinterested throughout the ride. The ride was bumpy. Clearly, they don’t care about customer satisfaction. I’d recommend choosing any other company or spending a little more and going for the helicopter ride. Don’t waste your money here!

The pilots here just want more flight hours, they are not at all interested to show you the beautiful island. 

They did not tell us that only the right hand side people will see all views. My wife was sitting on the left side and all she saw was the ocean! She missed the Napali coast views and she couldn’t say anything because the pilot couldn’t hear her at all. 

Don’t waste your money with them, the big windows and all are just false advertising. What’s the use if they don’t turn the plane around for half of the people?

We did this Tour on May 21st 2019. Initially, I was looking for helicopter tours but on discovering that they assign seats based on height and weight and that the helicopter has “middle seats” I decided to look into Air ventures. I am glad I did.
First off, there are no middle seats; everyone gets a window. I had booked the morning tour, but due to unforeseen circumstances, the tour had to be moved to the afternoon. They were kind enough to inform me 1 day before the trip. The change was done free of charge. If we could not make it, they were willing to rebook us on a different day that would work out. If we could not attend, I am sure they would have refunded us.
We had 4 people in total who took the same plane ride with us, so we all sat on the same side, but had there been more our pilot Justin T (not Timberlake! ) would have maneuvered the plane so all could get a good look.
The view of the NaPali coast from air was breathtaking. Justin also played some mild background music while he narrated the history of Kauai and pointed out interesting features. For me seeing the NaPali coast and the beautiful reefs from the sky was like the scene from Avatar where the protagonist sees the Floating Mountains of Pandora for the first time. Magnificent. We also saw the Waimea canyon (also known as Grand Canyon of the Pacific). It was lush green and had countless waterfalls. Justin was kind enough to fly the plane around slowly and more than once so we could truly take in the beauty. I was lucky enough to get to sit in the co-pilot’s seat, but all the seats are good. Do make sure you wear all black clothes, else your reflection will show up in the window and ruin your photos. The windows are large enough that you get a good view and squeaky clean too. Side note: Do not put your phone on the windowsill while recording, the vibration though not obvious when flying, will show up on your videos prominently.

Before we began our trip, they also took a photo of all of us and the pilot together and emailed it to us at no extra charge.
For an extra charge of $25, they will attach your GoPro to the exterior of the plane, just below the wing and you can get an uninterrupted video of the whole trip. We did purchase this, and it was completely worth it. You get to relive the experience all over again.

P.S: Ground Staff Jill was super helpful and friendly too. She mentioned must see places and helped us pick out nice restaurants for us to visit. 

TLDR; Awesome experience. An absolute must do. Staff were very courteous, fun and informative.

Amazing views of the island with a safety reassuring pilot.
Located at the end of the airport terminal, with free parking. Quick and easy check in process. Very quick boarding process and takeoff procedure to see the views of the island, narrated by the pilot.
Saw most parts of the island, doing a few 360 turns, to let all passengers view some attractions from all directions and both sides.

For professional or 'prosumers' photographers, be aware that while the windows are large and clean, reflection from them do creep up to the photos. Bring a wide lens. A telephoto lens will be hard to use/not useful. Try to block some reflections e.g. with your hand. For all other amateurs, bringing a good camera phone is sufficient :-) 
Consider enjoying the ride instead of taking too many photos.

The seats on the plane are low but otherwise comfortable. The flight felt safe and not at all scary or bumpy (though weather might impact your ride). I brought with me a water bottle and large camera with no issue. Water was available on board. headsets were available on board, to reduce flight noise and hear the pilot clearly.

This is a single prop plane, with 'just right' speed to enjoy the sights. It does not fly low or close to attractions nor make much changes in elevation while in flight, like helicopters can. IMHO this lets you get a grand view of the attractions, which is what is ride is about. 

Landing was safe and well executed. Getting off the plane was simple and quick.

Traveling with another couple for a 50th Birthday w did this fantastic flight over Kauai during our  Hawaii cruise. 
This flight was in a small but comfortable plane where everyone had a window view. The sights w flew over wee great! you really do get to see the fabulous coat and towns ok all coats plus the fabulous Na Pali coast (wow, what a site that is! ). Flying across the Waimea canyon was awesome, certainly a great easy to see the waterfalls and colours of this great area. 
I can highly recommend Air Ventures, a great organisation that ensures you get to see everything and in reasonable comfort.

This trip was fantastic. We were able to see the entire island by air. The flight on a small plane with windows for everyone to see all the sight was amazing. We would do this tour again. Professional and courteous staff was welcoming and helpful.

From reservations and email follow-ups with Jill, to checkin with Tom & Trish, and flight with TJ, this was a great experience. The views and commentary were perfect. I have worked in the tour company business for 15 years now . It is nice to deal with an outfit that gets what it is all about and provides great guest experiences. Mahalo.
It’s the most amazing view I have ever seen! JT &TOM did a wonderful job! It’s a must do in Kauai, super recomended! Thank you guys for having us!

review_title: This is an experience you should not miss!
review_text:
The entire process of the experience went flawless.  The pilot and staff were very knowlegeable, friendly, professional and especially made you feel welcome.  
The flight took you around the whole island so you felt you had a complete tour of Kauai.
JT (our pilot) was very informative and made the flight very enjoyable.

review_title: Great view of the Garden Isle
review_text: AirVentures island air tour of Kauai was a great way to see the beautiful island - the hour goes by too quickly but you really see the entire island.  The obligatory trip to the "Jurassic Park" falls, Waimea Canyon (which we had visited earlier that day, so it was cool to see where we had been from the air), and of course the Na Pali coast.  JT was an outstanding pilot and great guide.  Seats are a bit cramped as might be expected in a small plane, but you quickly forget about that when you're looking out at the island!  The entire staff was friendly, got me a seat last minute, and provided a seamless experience.  Highly recommended!

That was fantastic experience!!!!!
Unforgettable impression!!!!!
Pilot was experienced and very friendly as well as and the whole team!
Good job guys!!!!!
Thank you!!!!!

We have been on helicopter flights before, so thought a fixed wing plane would be a new adventure.  And sure enough, our Captain, Eric, made sure we had just that. It was a brilliant adventure, amazing views and great commentary. Eric kept us informed all through the flight, and circled around so everyone got the best views possible.
Eric our pilot was great.It was a perfect way to see the island you could not see any of what they showed us. Everyone from front desk to the pilot

review_title: Great pilot, talented beyond his years!
review_text:
Our young pilot was Makoa and he was awesome! He was very good at making sure everyone was having a great time and to share the views as best he could with both sides of the aircraft. He did everything in his power to give us a smooth ride. 

The views were exceptional and we had a nice cool morning. I work on the water around Kauai and would have to say that seeing both angles on our coast and canyon really enhanced my love for this place! Everyone should take a flight!

We left a little early than expected. Mokoa(our captain) did an awesome job giving us the pre flight instructions and getting us up to provide a really nice tour. The flight was very smooth and the views were just brilliant. He had a good eye and also helped us catch a glimpse of whales swimming by the nOrth shore.

We weer looking to do a cruise and everything was sold out. Out of a whim I booked this tour and am so happy we did it.

review_title: Best trip on Kauai (in my opinion)
review_text: This was a sharp outfit. Orgainized, on time, professional, All the safe stuff passed 100% AND our pilot, TJ was super! Narrative and accomodation for both sides of the plane made the flight interesting and just beautiful. You can interract with the pilot, ask questions, and get another view. To see this scenery from above it unbelievable. The Plane allowed window seats for everyone so no blocked views. I would recommend this to everyone.
Nice scenery, very cramped seating, headphones hurt to wear. Very smooth flight but was a little higher up than expected. Helicopters fly much lower.

J.T. was our pilot and was extremely good.  He made the flight even more special by his background music during the flight!  The beauty of the island is magnificent by air and being in a plane, you see a broader view.  
Do not be wary of booking this tour direct rather than through a cruise ship.  The service from the people was awesome.  The arrangements for pick up at Anchor Cove were simple because the ship provided a free shuttle. Our driver, Jill, drove us through the Marriott property on the way to the airport.  When we commented on the beauty, she offered to drop us off on the way back at the Marriott so we could walk through the grounds and enjoy their beach.  Personal service and great tour.  Would highly recommend!
The views were magnificent. It is a great way to see the island and our pilot, Eric, was phenomenal.

I am so grateful for this to her company. We just took an additional tour after 11 years to relive how I propose to my wife. Originally they were so happy and easy to deal with when I initially set up plans 11 years ago. I was even more grateful when after more than a decade the entire crew from the ground to the pilot was absolutely phenomenal and better than I remember. I would highly recommend this tour company for your next adventure.

review_title: If you're headed to Kauai, this is a must-do!
review_text: Yes, the pilots are young, but they are incredibly friendly and great at flying the small planes. The tour features incredible views and opportunities to ask any questions you may have about the land.  Every person on staff is incredibly nice and wants to assist you in any and every way possible- they even offered me a ride to my hotel after without me asking! They're the best! Amazing customer service and it really goes a long way.

You really appreciate Kauai when you are able to see the entire island from the sky.  Only experiencing a small area where you can drive and go to the beach is not enough.  Seeing all the waterfalls that start up high and go down from one to the other is truly beautiful.  We also get to see the Napili Coast and many areas where you would never, never be able to drive too.  It was a stunning experience.  My 11 year old and 8 year old both loved it.  She had a hard time hearing in the headphones but the views were good.  The windows are large.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat because I normally get seasick.  I did not get any motion sickness!!  Ray was a pro pilot!!   He also let me put my hands on the wheel to steer.  That was AMAZING!!!  When is that ever going to happen??  The team here is very professional.  Completely worth it.  ALSO, just wear normal clothes -shorts and t shirt.  The weather is the same in the plane as it is on the ground.
pilot very young, and good narrator, incredible experience good job air ventures staff, all of them.

Aside from the opportunity to soak in some gorgeous and dramatic views of the island, the whole-island tour was an especially enjoyable trip for a pilot. I had originally wanted to fly in their C182, a private 4-seat Cessna, with an instructor, because it is the only way to fly around the island, at the controls, unless you take a checkout flight so you can rent further, solo (more of an option for residents). My wife and I decided this time to take the tour in the AirVan, with J.T. as our pilot and tour guide, along with a few other passengers. 

Even though we pilots are always itching to be at the controls, this was still a fine choice. The airspace is relatively busy with other air tours and traffic, there are several local VFR reference points you don’t know, and the terrain has unique properties which require attention, as well. I was simply able to sit back and enjoy the beauty of Kauai—without getting too antsy to fly, myself! 

Incidentally, with the varying terrain and ocean comes what’s called “uneven heating” which is one of the factors which creates turbulence. There’s only two things one can do to mitigate that: 1) fly early in the morning, or 2) get a pilot who knows how to soften the ride (there are a few ways). J.T. is just such a pilot. 

Highly recommend! (20 year, instrument pilot)

There is NO other way to see the island. Everyone at Airventures was very nice and helpful. Our pilot Eric was amazing! Humorous, knowledgeable and accommodating. Definitely an experience I would give the very highest recommendation.
Alles top organisiert,nette,hilfsbereite Leute und sehr informativ. Eine mega Erfahrung,die man auf Kauai gemacht haben sollte!

Flying with AirVentures over the island of Kauai was probably the coolest thing I have ever done!  As soon as I called and spoke to Jill on the phone, I knew I called the right place!  Instantly felt that personal connection.  We were flying to Kauai just for the day, as we were staying on Oahu.  Jill made sure we had enough time to get from the gate to their location and even made a note to get us to our rental car after our flight.  Jill greeted us upon arrival and did a great job prepping us for our flight.  JT was our pilot and he was amazing!  One of the smoothest flights I've been on.  Soon after take off, he spotted a humpback whale and did a 360 so everyone could see it!!  WOW!  His narration of the trip, coupled with the soundtrack was top notch!  Made for such an amazing experience!  Still in complete awe of things that we saw that morning!  Jill and Ray greeted us when we returned and we enjoyed talking with them.  We really felt like we spent the morning with old friends!  All at AirVentures really went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible.  My company just went through a customer experience program, so I really look out for those extras that make companies stand out now.  I give AirVentures a full 100% A+ rating!

Ray and Jill and the entire staff were wonderful. When the weather didn't look like it would cooperate with our original flight time they did all they could to rebook us on a later flight. When there weren't any spaces available, they added in a private flight for us to ensure we got to see the island in this incredible way. The plane was nearly new and the tour was absolutely wonderful. My husband and I will always remember this experience and are very thankful to have this memory as part of our "babymoon." We definitely recommend Air Ventures!

Pilot Eric Johnson gave us an amazing overhead tour of the beautiful mountains, shoreline, canyons and waterfalls.  He was very attentive to each passenger’s well-being and was a great guide as to what we were seeing.  The pictures we took from the plane are awesome but viewing the island’s beauty bird’s eye view was amazing.  One hour flight, six of us onboard along with pilot.  Highly recommend.  Husband and wife owners.  Everyone was very kind.

Kevin was our pilot and we got to see the Na Pali coast as well as valleys, waterfalls, resorts, places where films were shot, and we even saw whales ( a mom, baby and a third). This plane could not get into the narrow valleys like the helicopters can, but we had a great trip and went right around Kauai! Loved it!

We loved this experience...a good smooth ride...lots of s turns so that both sides could see the sights.
Kevin, our pilot, a veteran pilot flying these Hawaiian airs for over 30 years! Good to know.
Great views of hidden, hard to get to places. Waterfalls, canyons. the tour covers the entire island.
Here’s a hint, they are located between Fed Ex and UPS, on the air cargo park of the Lihue airport.
Only down side, Keven grouses about solar energy. On every other topic, he’s knowledgeable.

We recently flew on the 3 passenger Cessna air tour and had the most amazing time! This was such a special and unique tour for us. The views of the coast/beaches, waterfalls, grottos, etc were breathtakingly beautiful... and easy to see because of the large, clean windows.  Our pilot, Ray, was fantastic - knowledgeable, professional, funny and smooth!  We saw where shows were filmed and learned so much about the island's culture, history, current happenings and more.  The airplane is pristine and the ride was comfortable. My family highly recommends AirVentures Hawaii!  Ray and Jill are wonderful, friendly and feel like family.  (The t-shirts are awesome, too!)

This was the best tour we have ever taken. From the first moment we arrived we were looked after in a friendly and efficient way. However, the majesty of the Kauai scenery just blew us away as we took off and toured the island. The 1 hour flight, with a pilot that made everything interesting was superb. Even down to the soundtrack he played during the flight that fitted the occasion. It was worth every penny and at significantly cheaper than the helicopter tours, I would highly recommend this as the way to see the island and make lasting memories.

Amazing way to cover a lot of amazing territory. Big view windows. Pilot Steve pointed out the sights and made sure both sides of the plane had ample photo opportunities. Waterfalls galore cascading over sky high cliffs, rugged coastal cliffs in green, brown and reds, aqua waves crashing ashore, deep inland valleys and wide grasslands-awe inspiring.

My family and I rented the Cessna 182. The plane was in great shape with G1000 avionics. The air conditioning in the plane was appreciated and made for a comfortable flight. As a certified pilot I was able to fly most of the flight. Our instructor Eric was great helping with local procedures. Eric was very knowledgeable about the island and local attractions. The views were beautiful. We were able to see the entire island as well as some whales which helicopter tours just can’t.

review_title: The only way to see the island
review_text: JT thanks for a great trip around the island. Enjoyed the beautiful view of the beaches  and waterfalls

Eric was an excellent pilot and commentator.  He learned our names and personally interacted with each of us during the flight. We had two children on our flight with whom he did a great job. I highly recommend flying with Eric.

Very smooth flight. Saw lots of Hawaii scenery and well known landmarks. Pilot was very knowledgeable and friend/y.  Napali coast was breathtaking! Best way to see the Island of Kauai. You can rent a Go-Pro and film your trip.

review_title: Incredible views with Ray - best money we’ve ever spent on a tour
review_text:
Had booked with another company but was cancelled last minute. While we were waiting Jill engaged us a couple of times in general conversation - she is a real sweetheart! Knowing we were in a bit of a predicament, she tracked down her pilot who happens to be her husband to take us up for our tour. Ray was awesome and the tour was even better - I don’t think you can possibly say you saw the island if you don’t see it from the air. We’ve done 4 hikes and while the scenery has been spectacular, what we saw from the air was priceless. 

We had contemplated a helicopter tour but so glad we went with Air Ventures - a small family company that really cares about your experience. The price is very reasonable for the experience and we will be sure to include this on our next visit with our sons.

Awesome Airvan tour.  The owners, Ray and Jill were a delight to work with.  Our original morning tour with another operator was cancelled yesterday and we hastily booked for an afternoon tour for today with Air Ventures.  Early this morning, I called to  see if we could change our tour time and Jill was very accommodating.  Despite being very busy due to a cruise ship coming into port, she called me back when a couple seats opened up on an earlier flight.  She even picked us up near our hotel along with another family from the cruise ship.  Ray piloted our tour and was delightful for the entire trip.  He has spent a career flying airplanes, and he obviously loves flying every chance he gets! He made sure everyone was comfortable....even a reluctant father who didn’t like to fly, but went along with the family.  He explained everything and told us a lot of first hand information about the coastline and waterfalls we were seeing.....he has hiked most of the trails we were flying over.   When we returned, Jill was kind enough to drop us off to pickup our rental car.  Truly a pleasure working with small business owners that enjoy what they are doing and understand good customer service.  Thanks to Ray and Jill for a great Kaua’i memory!

review_title: Kaui from the third dimension, simply beautiful!
review_text: Had a wonderful trip with the company owner in the Cessna 182. Of course the ride was a bit bumpy at times, but guess what...its even worse in a helicopter ...and muchmore expensive. Being pilots ourselves we could see the airplane was in good condition and thorougly enjoyed the views from above. Definitely wotth every cent!

As a budding pilot, my wife and I took the ride of a lifetime on Snoopy the Waco biplane piloted by Harry.  It was the best time EVER!  Great ride!  Enjoyed talking with the owner,  Ray and his wife about their adventures.  It will be a do over!

We had a fantastic experience. Eric was our pilot, and he was engaging, informative and considerate. He was thoughtful in asking questions of the little girl on our tour and engaged the future pilot with us as well! He was able to answer our questions, had a great sense of humour and appeared truly genuine in his passion for flying. The flight itself was fantastic. Our Napali boat trip had been cancelled due to weather; while this had been our second choice, we were really glad it worked out this way. We were able to see way more of the island than we'd thought possible and enjoyed every minute of it. Would definitely highly recommend!

We took the Kaui Island tour, better value and longer than helicopter tour. Had a brilliant time, JT was our pilot, he was a good guy, his flying was great and he told us lots of interesting info as we flew. The island is amazing from the air and the route JT flew gave us great views. 
Would definately recommend the tour.
Suggest their upfront info should contain more details on where they are at the airport site, to make it easier for people who haven’t been to the airport before. When we landed from Honolulu their location wasn’t clear from the confirmation info, we had to ask someone who worked in the passenger terminal then walk about 5 minutes from there, not a big problem but could have been made easier.

review_title: Great company and a great plane ride.
review_text:
My wife and I took the Kauai Island Air Tour. We were on a Norwegian Cruise Line cruise and had a free morning, before leaving the island at 2:00.We made arrangements to be picked up at the Anchor Cove shopping center. Ray picked us up and gave us a ride to the airport. We talked on the way and I asked Ray about the company. I found out that Ray is the owner, but his wife Jill is the boss. Ray retired after 30 years with United Airlines. This was after spending eight years in the service. We met Jill at the airport and checked in. Jill was 
pleasant to talk with too. We felt very comfortable with our pilot, Harry. The views of the island are breathtaking and you get to see the highlights of the island. We were lucky that we we able to see whales off the Napali coast. Ray took us back to the ship and we were back in plenty of time before the ship disembarked. I would do this flight again on my next trip to Hawaii. A great family owned company that gives you a great tour.

review_title: Airplane flight tour of Kauai Island.
review_text: This trip was absolutely terrific. We usually take a helicopter tour around the island so this was the first trip in an airplane. Ray (the pilot) was absolutely terrific. Great since of humor and a lot of knowledge about the island. This was definitely a different perspective of seeing the island from the helicopter. It was totally different. Actually slower and more informative. I will definitely do this trip again the next time I return.
JT was our pilot.  He was great.  Had a great time, so glad we went with this flight rather than helicopter!,
Great tour of the entire island! Loved seeing all of the sites! JT was a great pilot! Definitely make this a "to do" item!!
Great tour of the entire island! Gorgeous sights. Our pilot/guide JT was super. Relaxed atmosphere. Seats on the right have the best view. Directions on how to get there weren’t great.

We recently took an Air Ventures tour circling the island of Kauai...what an incredible experience!!! The plane has oversized windows and holds just 6 passengers, so it seemed like a private tour. One fortunate passenger (Laura below) was even able to sit in the co-pilot seat for the entire flight!

Our pilot T.J. was wonderful (and funny) and interactive, describing what we were seeing along the way. He even spotted some whales and circled them twice to make sure we had an incredible view. In addition, two of our fellow passengers had arrived by passenger ship, so T.J. made sure to fly over the ship on our return to the airport...it was very, very cool!

In addition to T.J., everyone we came into contact with from Air Ventures was great...starting with the young lady who took our reservation over the phone, kept us updated on the status of the flight, and greeted us when we arrived.  What is very special about Air Ventures is that it is a family owned and run local business.  We know this because we were assisted by Jill, a co-owner, who couldn't have been more kind and helpful.  After our flight she even returned us to our hotel (Kauai Marriott Resort) instead of us getting a taxi or Uber.

This was our final adventure before heading back to the mainland and it was the perfect way to conclude our trip.

Thank you Air Ventures!!!

Laura Overcash
Hank Kirschenmann
Alexandria, VA

review_title: One Hour Air Tour of Kauai
review_text: A fantastic flyover of the island.  A beautiful land with mountains, waterfalls, plantations, golf courses and the Napali Coast.  JT, the pilot was excellent and provided insight to the island.  He took a jog to view two whales swimming along a boat.  4 visitors on the plane without any viewing issues.  The couple that joined us took a helicopter ride earlier their trip at Hilo.  He was stuck in the middle back and was not pleased with the outcome.  Thus, the subsequent plane trip at Kauai.  He was very pleased with our tour.

Nice aerial tour of the island in a GA8 Airvan. At 6' 1 1/2" the cabin was a little cramped for me but tolerable for the one hour flight. Our flight was smooth although there were the inevitable bumps due to updraft over the mountain areas. We picked a nice day with minimal clouds and were able to see clearly all of the sights including a couple of whales. The pilot was informative and accommodating, explaining the history as well as relevant facts along the way.

Experiência para toda a vida! A ilha vista de cima é incrível! E a Air Ventures faz de tudo para que seja segura e tranquila. O piloto foi muito simpático, educado e preocupado em nos explicar tudo o que acontecia com a aeronave e com o que víamos no chão. Foi tudo muito fácil: reservar, pagar e desfrutar! Um passeio imperdível! Vale a pena!

Our pilot JT was great, the flight was smooth, take off and landing were a breeze. We saw amazing views of Waimea Canyon, Napali coast and even the crater in the middle of Kauai. The scenery is awesome from the air. It seemed to me JT flew the plane slow enough that we were not rushed and he circled around so that both sides could see the sights. Unfortunately, my seat was right behind the pilot. Even through their website claims the interior of the plane is spacious, the pilot's seat was so far back it was not possible to sit in the seat and have room for my legs, so I was forced to sit sideways which meant I could not see out my window and had to look out the window across from me. That view was also partially blocked by the wing and the support for the wing. It was also very warm in the plane.

The price was reasonable, far less than a helicopter tour, which was very much appreciated. 

It was difficult to hear the narration through the headphones. For that reason and the fact that I could not look out my window due to no leg room, I am giving 4 stars. Otherwise it would be 5.

JT was our pilot and we had a GREAT flight - amazing views and Sooo smooth ! A few of us were a little nervous of motion sickness but we had None of that !! We Saw whales - beautiful waterfalls- amazing coastline and terrain that was spectacular. Wonderful landing - the whole ride was worth every penny — thanks JT !

TJ took us up.  It was my first time in a small plane and was in the co-pilot seat.  Could see everything.  Just a bit bumpy now and then, never an issue.  We saw all the major and some minor sights on the island.  It was thrilling.  Over too soon, TJ brought us back safely.  Hope he achieves his dream of commercial flying.

JT is an awesome pilot!  My husband and I learned so much about the island; JT gave an amazing tour!  The views are spectacular and it really is the only way to see how beautiful the whole island is.  This was the highlight of our trip!  So glad we booked with Air Ventures!

The staff was extremely friendly and courteous.  At check-in, you're informed of what's happening before the flights start.  Then your pilot will come personally to meet everyone that's on the flight!  They take a group photo by your plane that they will send to you via email.  Once they review the safety instructions your then ready for "Take off"!!!  

Our pilot JT was awesome he shared some history and highlights about the island.  No matter where you were sitting he made sure everyone got to see it!  Kauai is a gorgeous place and this tour provided snapshots of places you might not be able to get to see!

review_title: Great pilot, bad judgement on the part of the owner
review_text: We took this air tour around Kauai in late September. The weather in Kauai is often very unstable, and it was particularly so while we were there. It was pouring rain across the entire island the morning of the day we took our air tour, but when I called Air Ventures to make a reservation for two days later, there was a break in the weather. The owner (at least I believe he was the owner) told me that the conditions were great if I wanted to go that day, and that he could book me for that afternoon, so I did. When we arrived, we were told that all flights had been canceled that day because of bad weather but they were still hoping to get out that afternoon. We took off on schedule, and it was a beautiful tour, but Waimea canyon was completely socked in and we couldn't see it at all, and there were lots of clouds to contend with along the entire flight. I felt that we had been misled about the conditions that day, and if I had known that the weather would be so unstable I wouldn't have booked the trip. Also, if I did it again I'd go in a helicopter. We saw helicopters touring the canyon and the coast later during our stay and they could get much closer to the sights and provide better views. Still, the pilot was great and overall it was a good experience. But I was terribly disappointed at not seeing the canyon.

Wow, this was amazing and so worth it!  My wife and I purchased this tour with a booking for a Tuesday morning trip.  Upon arrival at the airport and going through the preliminaries, it was obvious that it was not a good day to go flying to sight see the island from the air.  We agreed instead to try for the next day which was a much better day!

The staff were welcoming, friendly, professional and considerate!  We realize all businesses need to make a profit, but the experience was more important to them.  We appreciated that a lot.  

We had the pleasure of flying with Desi, a very knowledgeable, friendly pilot and guide.  She is one reason we are giving the rating as shown.  We honestly did feel that all the staff would be great as we were connecting with four of them at the check in counter.  

Our pilot made it great fun, was full of information and knowledge that was worthwhile to take in.  

I have to admit, I have never been in a seven seater airplane before but now that I have done it, i will go again.  We all felt very safe.  I am a bigger and taller person and this was not a concern at all.

Loved it!

Not only was the staff friendly and knowledgeable, they were FUN!   Recommend this trip for a great way to see the entire island ‘bird style’ JT was great at smoothly flying around the island.  Recommend this trip as a good introduction to Kauai

review_title: Breathtaking tour of the entire island
review_text: We booked this tour to see the island from a 'different perspective', JT was our pilot, it was a fabulous way to see all parts of the island from the air. With the Napali Coast Wilderness Area closed right now, it was a wonderful way to see the amazing cliffs, waterfalls and valleys. We were blown away by the beauty of Kauai.

We took the private tour. It is fabulous! The pilot, Ray, and his wife treated us royally. The views from the air were just great. No way we could have seen Kauii any other way.

These folks are the best.

Suzanne and Jim

review_title: See more of the island, Its many waterfalls and valleys.
review_text: Very comfortable flight. See a lot more than you can from an auto in less time than a hike. Also very informative as the pilot is also the tour guide.

review_title: Great alternative to the helicopter tours
review_text: We did this partially for cost, we had our 2 year old son with us and per FAA regs he was considered an adult so we picked this option.  We were not disappointed.  JT was an excellent pilot. Our son loved the ride and JT was very knowledgeable and informative about what we were seeing as he went around the island.  I loved the entire view of the area we got as you cant get this on the ground and some parts were restricted historical sites.  Everyone had their own window view and he circled it for those both on the right hand side and left hand side. The only thing I wish is that we got a little closer but i understand something is lost between being in a helicopter versus a plane.

review_title: A great way to see Kauai!
review_text:
I've done a variety of helicopter and plane tours on the various islands and I love flying with Airventures. The staff and pilots are friendly and I've always had a great time. It's a great value for people who choose not to go the route of the helicopter (they are fun but they can get more pricey). It's also good if you're afraid of the idea of a helicopter or not having doors ;-) 

We saw so many cool things and the waterfalls were just FLOWING when we were up there. I thought the flight might be cancelled but it wasn't and it was clear and safe and we had a blast!

The ground team and our pilot did a fantastic job of entertaining us during our trip. The pilot was conscientious to make sure both sides of the plane got great views of everything. I would highly recommend this tour.

So I'm not a fan of small airplanes, and had some trepidation about doing this.  But Eric, our pilot, was terrific.  Never took us into bumpy air, and kept up a dialog laced with humor and sightseeing facts.  It was easy making (email) arrangements and appointments, all the staff were friendly, they picked us up near our cruise ship, and returned us when the tour was over.  I was really happy I did this.  Also, I know helicopters are popular, and each to his own, but this fixed wing airplane was way smoother than bouncing around in a helicopter.  I felt safe, and enjoyed the entire flight, in no small part because of Eric.

The air tour was great.  Our pilot J. T. did a great job.  We’d done a helicopter tour years ago, but this was better, as the tour was longer, and went around entire island, instead of just the touristy hotspots.  And this Australian AirVan goes nice and slow, so you get lots of time to see the sights.  Thanks J. T. and Jill!

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: Eric was a great pilot and we had a great experience. Do this at the beginning of your stay so you can see all the fabulous places you want to visit. It was a really nice perspective of the entire island. Less expensive than a helicopter and you get a longer rider.

This was a truly amazing experience. We opted for a smaller plane so it was just my husband and me. We prefer this over a helicopter. Our pilot Kevin was awesome—lots of information and photo opportunities. It felt like a family friend was taking us out in his plane. All the staff were so helpful. They took our picture with the plane and emailed it to us for free, no extra charge. Without hesitation we absolutely recommend this!!!!

It was a fabulous view of this most beautiful island.  We had the good fortune of seeing the Na Pali Coast both by air and by boat. It's hard to say which one was most impressive.  Our pilot was JT, if I recall, was fairly new to the island but had done his research and was a good tour guide.  I did have difficulty at times understanding him, could have been my headphones.  Wonderful way to see the entire island.  Very affordable.

review_title: Same sights, half the price of a helicopter
review_text: I have taken several helicopter tours but now they are very expensive.  This fixed wing flight gave a great tour of the island to include the Napali coast, Grand Canyon of the Pacific, many waterfalls for a lot less money.  Our pilot "JT" gave us a great narration and did a great job of flying in some cross winds, and that is a compliment coming from a 37 year retired Air Force pilot.

Customer service was excellent, picked up by Jill, delightful lady. Taken to the airfield & boarded the plane, 6 people plus the friendly pilot. We had an hour or so of fabulous scenery, especially the Waimea Canyon & coastline. Lots of interesting info by the pilot. I superb experience, our highlight of the holiday.

I called on a day when it had rained all morning and more rain was forecast throughout the day across the island. The person I spoke to, presumably the owner, said that the conditions were great that day, so I booked for that afternoon. When we arrived, the woman at the desk said that their flights from the morning had been rescheduled to the afternoon because of bad viewing conditions/low cloud cover. So, at the same time I was told that conditions were excellent, they were rescheduling flights! We had a great pilot and some wonderful views of the island, but there was a lot of cloud cover so the views were restricted, and we couldn't see into Waimea Canyon at all, which was a huge disappointment. Also, while it is a bit cheaper to fly in the fixed wing aircraft than in a helicopter, I noticed over the course of our stay that helicopters can fly at lower altitudes and can achieve closer viewing positions. If I did it again, I'd go in a helicopter.

We booked a private airplane tour on Kauai to see all the great sights this Island has to offer. We were not disappointed!! It was a great way to experience the island and we got to see things, that are not possible to see from the ground. Absolutely loved it and would definitely recommend. Booking and check-in were super easy and friendly and our pilot Kevin was really knowledgeable and fun to fly with! Can only recommend

review_title: A fabulous experience on a fabulous island
review_text: I’ve travelled to about 60 nations and have seen some great places (Swiss Alps, New Zealand, Norwegian fjords, Scottish Highlands, Yellowstone/Tetons, etc.), but nothing more beautiful than Kauai—and seeing it from the air is a MUST. Great people to help you here, like pilots JT and Ray. Six stars out of five!
Kevin was our pilot and we had a an amazing flight over Kauai. We've been coming here for years and we still learned more about this wonderful island. We would highly recommend AirVentures Hawaii!
We had Eric as our pilot. What an experience from start to finish. Customer service is incredible. Views are spectacular. The best sightseeing tour we have done

Amazing experience for half the price of a helicopter. This was every bit of 60 minutes and so beautiful and informative. Do this early in your trip and see a lot of places you may want to go on the ground. I can’t remember our pilots name but he was the older gentleman with a great moustache :) He was great!

Totally worth the price. We went over the island for over an hour, and as promised got to see many Rainbows. Kevin was an amazing Pilot and gave us many interesting facts about the island. We covered almost the entire island and looked at the places that we were not able to drive to. 
The staff was overly friendly, especially Kaycee!

We booked an all day tour of Kauai and one of the things we did was board an airplane for a 1 hour ride over/around the island of Kauai with Air Ventures.  The pilot, Harry, did an excellent take off and landing and kept us in a smooth ride the entire time.  He made sure that both sides of the plane could see the sites to see from the air.  We were very fortunate to have a clear day.  He pointed out the various sites so we would have a good perspective of where on the island we were viewing - hotels, farms, waterfalls and their names, beaches and their names.  We believe this is the only way to really understand what Kauai is all about compared to the other islands.  The check-in staff are efficient and friendly.  Again, we think this is MUST DO!

Thank you Kevin for such a wonderful flight around Kauai. We saw everything from the Na Pali Coast, Wailea canyon, beaches, waterfalls, volcanic remains. Such a great way to see the island. We have travelled on the island for 10 days and the trip put everything in perspective and allowed us to see the many bits you cannot get too.
Thank you to Jill and Kaycee with the booking.

We'd come to the end of our cruise and trip and were initially hesitant as to whether we could justify the cost.

The answer, ABSOLUTELY!

The pilot was amazing, so much fun and she was delightful. Tailored what we saw to what we asked for, the weather and anything else she thought would interest us!

Wow, what an incredible way to see Kauai...from Waiemea Canyon to the NaPali coastline, gorgeous beaches and so many waterfalls!  Jill and Ray, the owners, are so welcoming and friendly!  And our pilot, JT was awesome!  He has only been on Kauai for a few months, yet he was really knowledgeable about Kauai, which was impressive! Definitely recommend booking a flight tour with Air Ventures!!!

We were fortunate enough to have one of the owners Ray pilot our plane to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The company was professional and the planes looked to be in good shape ( to the unexperienced eye). 
Ray was an excellent pilot and guide. The views were breathtaking and a MUST when visiting Kauai. My favourite views were of the Na'apili coast and the Waimea Canyon. He was able to shows us multiple waterfalls inaccessible by land. 
It is my pleasure to recommend Ray and his team

Our photography flight with Air Ventures—the most eco-friendly air tour company in Kauai—was one of the highlights of our Hawaiian adventure. Owner Jill Briley and her outgoing staff ensured that everything was air-tight prior to takeoff. With over 8,000 hours of flight time and a sparkling personality, Captain Eric ensured that we were safe and entertained from takeoff to landing.

Soaring over Kauai was a truly amazing experience. We covered a lot of ground from the air—the entire Garden Island—in just over an hour with the Big Kahuna tour.

The most epic highlights on an island of breathtaking coastlines were Waita Reservoir (the largest on Kauai), Captain Cook’s Landing, the inspiring Waimea Canyon, the surreal Napali Coastline, Lumahai Beach (where “South Pacific” was filmed), Hanalei Valley, countless beautiful cascading waterfalls and the Kilauea Lighthouse. It is so beautiful that over 60 movies have been filmed here, including Blue Hawaii, King Kong, Jurassic Park, Soul Surfer, The Descendants and Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides.

You must do this when you are in Kauai!! Great company! Everyone was so welcoming! Our pilot was so knowledgeable and so funny!  I love that we each had our own window and the windows were super clear, even when it was rainy out.  The aerial view of the island was just spectacular.  I took lots of pictures and videos but those don't even do justice!  You have got to see it.  You will not regret it!  I will definitely fly with them again!

È stato facile trovare il punto esatto della partenza (in fondo all’aeroporto di Lihue), c’è anche un parcheggio gratuito per i clienti. Il pilota, molto simpatico, ci ha guidato sopra varie cascate, il canyon e la Naphili Coast.. un vero paradiso raggiungibile ora solo per mare o per via aerea in quanto la strada è stata chiusa all’altezza di Hanalei. Il giro è durato circa un’ora.
Ho notato che gli elicotteri costano di più perché scendono nel canion e si avvicinano  alle cascate. 
Comunque il volo sull’isola va assolutamente fatto! Il mare è spesso molto increspato e la barca, per quanto affascinante, può non essere la scelta migliore visto che i costi sono quasi uguali.

review_title: Book your trip with Air Ventures & do it now!!!
review_text: We’ve just returned from our trip with Air Ventures and wowwwwwww what a trip! TJ was our pilot; lovely chap, young, full of enthusiasm, competence and just loving life doing what he is doing. We felt very safe in his hands, and would jump aboard again any time. The views are breath taking, it is such a beautiful place. The plane seats 9, but Air Ventures did not cram the plane full. There was only 4 including my wife and I on our flight, and the flight before us only 6. Book your trip with these guys and you’ll be in for a pleasant experience from start to finish, I would recommend this to all!!!

review_title: So much to see that can only be seen from the air! Great adventure
review_text: There is so much to see in Kauai that can only be seen from the air. This tour lasted about 70 minutes and it was well worth it. The scenery you get to see from the plane is breathtaking. The windows of the plane are large and you get a good view from both sides of the plane, although most of what there is to see is on the left side because of the route the plane takes. The staff was very welcoming and our pilot J.T. provided very informative commentary throughout the tour. I had limited time during my trip to the island so I'm glad I got to see a great deal in a short time because of this tour.

review_title: Only way to see the whole island
review_text: We flew with Air Ventures Hawaii as part of the Best of Kauai tour.  The plane is compact and was flown by our very competent young pilot, JT.  The views were spectacular despite the day not looking so good from our North Coast resort.  The trade winds were quite strong but JT managed to keep us in remarkably smooth air.  We had our photo taken with the pilot before take-off and were to first of three planes on the tour.  An awesome experience and thoroughly recommended.

I had never been in a small craft before, so I was scared and relictant even as I buckled in while still on the tarmac. Even after the smooth take-off, and cruise past landmarks, I still expected the plane to buck and pitch and to cause me to use the air-sickness bag. However, none of the former or latter happened. Our pilot, Eric, with his 30 years of flying expertise, flew that plane rock steady. His calm demeanor, seemingly effortless flying, and his abundant knowledge of the island distracted my mind from my unfounded fears of a plane-crash death.
As for the sights, we were able to see most of the must-see places all over the island. The views were so good in fact, that we didn’t even feel the need to see them up close anymore. Why go to the (Fantasy Island) waterfalls by car just to see it from the freeway, when we’ve already seen it from the best angle available? The same went for spouting horn and other attractions. We even saw sea turtles from our vantage point in the air.
But what goes up must come down. Again, Captain Eric did not disappoint. The landing was so smooth I didn’t even feel the moment when the wheels actually touched the ground.
All in all a great flight. I highly recommend it!!

review_title: Amazing way to see the island
review_text: We were visiting Kauai from an NCL cruise ship and chose this as a way to see the beautiful views of the island - and we were so impressed!  Jill picked us up from near the cruise port and was very friendly, giving us a history of how she and her husband built up the company.   Once we got up in the air, our pilot JT was awesome, he gave us a great tour of the island.  The plane was not very bumpy at all, and it gave us a great way to see the entire island in an hour.  Would definitely recommend this tour for everyone!

review_title: I'm a big chicken, but I did it!
review_text:
Wow! Breathtaking views of this gorgeous island paradise. Jill and staff were absolutely amazing and accommodating.  I do not like to fly and have a bit of claustrophobia, but really wanted to see whole island. I was encouraged and even babied a little and had the most incredible experience that I have recommended this to several others already. 
Trip was smooth despite rain storms, pilot was engaging and entertaining. The sites and trivia caused me to wear a huge smile the whole trip.
JT was our pilot.  He was informative and lots of fun.  He had smooth take-offs and landings.  He also took us where the winds wouldn't affect the ride.  Smooth ride, great fun.  I'd do it again.

We had an incredible time on this tour! Our pilot Eric was fun and very knowledgeable. We felt safe at any time, we didn't get sick or anything. The views were incredible, the beauty of Kaua'i is breathtaking. There is only one Na Pali coast!

This was a great way to see the entire island. We were on the island for 8 days, but that is not enough time to see everything. Going on this flight allowed us to see things we wouldn't have been able to otherwise. The staff was SUPER serviceable! After the flight we had 25 minutes to eat lunch before heading to another excursion, so we packed a lunch and ate out of the back of our car. A staff member saw us there and came out with cold water bottles for everyone (7 of us). They also went out of their way to help us with other things, too. They included a picture of us that was emailed to us later that day.

We were lucky enough to have Harry Dalsey as our pilot and some nice weather during our flight.  The perspective this adventure gave us is once in a life time, unless of course you go back for more.  Harry was very informative about both the various geological features and travel destinations of the island, and gave the whole flight a signature fun and relaxed Aloha vibe.

I highly recommend this tour -- it provides a spectacular view of the entire island (including Hanalei Bay, Waimea Canyon, and the Napali Coast, among many others) which really lets you appreciate how beautiful Kauai is. Our pilot, J.T., was excellent, as he provided the group with a very smooth ride and entertaining/helpful commentary while also being sure to point out notable features in the landscape for photos. Definitely a trip worth doing if you have the opportunity!

Thanks J.T.!

- Daniel and Nicole

P.S.: It will probably be fairly warm inside the plane, so show up to the tour hydrated and not on an empty stomach to avoid motion sickness!
Ray, Jill and Kaycee made our journey wonderful.  Highly recommended. Have a light breakfast before the morning flight and enjoy your times. Years of experience piloting clearly shows!

The island air tour was a fantastic addition to our family vacation! The best way to see Kauai is definitely from the air as most of the beautiful North Shore, the backdrop of many Hollywood movies with the picturesque cathedral mountains, is only accessible by air or water; but is best viewed by air. If you want the best perspective to take in the breathtaking paradise that Kauai has to offer, then I highly recommend this air tour as helicopter rides do not travel to the Napali Coast. The air tour is also a great way to pick out waterfalls and other natural beauties that can be hiked to further into your stay on the island. Also, our pilot/guide JT provided a smooth flight along with lots of valuable information about the island and what we were currently flying over.

review_title: Interesting way to see the whole island
review_text: Very informative tour. We enjoyed our pilot J. T. he was friendly and funny. We were able to see the Na Pali coast and the Waimea Canyon. I highly recommend it.

We looked at helicopter tours of the island and they were very pricey and short.  This tour was much longer and much less expensive.  You also have the comfort of a plane which is not going to be going up and down as rapidly as a helicopter.
Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and had cold compress towels for us because it's a longer plane ride and there isn't a lot of air conditioning.  
We went all over the island and we all had microphones and headsets and could all communicate with the pilot.
This is a very safe and enjoyable ride and you won't regret it.

My husband and I wanted to do something awesome on our last day in Kauai. The (super nice!) lady at the counter was able to accommodate us last minute on a private tour with captain Eric. This was one of the most amazing experiences we had on the island !! Captain Eric was a great guide and pointed out all the sights, and he even let my husband take the wheel for a while :D

If you’re hesitant about whether to take this tour or not, DO IT!!! You will never forget it.

We had a party of 6.  Air Venture was so accommodating and friendly from the 1st time I spoke with them.  Kevin set us at ease when asking how long he'd been flying.  I got to ride shot gun and so glad I did.  The flight was amazing, the views breath taking, and Kevin was very knowledgeable.  I actually got to fly the plane!  Something I will probably never experience again.  Thanks for an amazing flight.

review_title: Awesome tour, with a great guide!
review_text: Desi was an awesome tour guide! She was so informational and fun to talk with! She was a very good pilot and was an amazing representative of AirVenture Hawaii. We saw the island in a whole new light and loved every second of it!

We did this halfway through our vacation and it was great. Husband keeps commenting about seeing some of the sights we'd already been to but from a different angle, just incredible. Eric, the pilot, was quite entertaining.

I have done the helicopter ride around the island of Kauai, and today I took Air Ventures around the island of Kauai.  Air Ventures flies a small fixed wing aircraft called a G-8 Airvan which seats 6 people.  Hands down—I loved this experience so much more than being in the helicopter. It was roomier and way more comfortable. We each got our own headset, so we could easily hear our pilot, Harry, talk about the beautiful island of Kauai. We each had a big window to look out of.  The scenery is absolutely breathtaking!!  The only way to really see the grandeur of Waimea Canyon, all of the magnificent waterfalls, and the NaPali Coast is from the air.  It’s stunning!!  Book this right now!! You will not regret it! It’s the best adventure I have done on the island!!!
p.s. Any age can do this. I took my 91 year old mother, and she loved it!!!

Excellent tour guide/pilot. I believe his name was Kevin, guy with the mustache.

The flight was excellent. We go to see the majority of the key point of the island.
It was much more affordable then a helicopter and I believe it gave you a more stable view to take pictures and videos!

From take off, to landing everything was smooth.
It did get a little hot at one point, but they provide cool towels if you get to hot, so I'd recommend just wearing shorts and t-shirt. No long sleeves or jackets are needed.

The weather was great, so we got to see just about everything we wanted to, with clear skies!

The only tiny issue we encounter was understanding where to park and where we'd have to go to board the plane. We've never flown a private plane before, so we figured i'd be similar to a comercial plane, where we'd have to park in a large lot and go through TSA screening etc.... Maybe these instructions are provided if you book directly, we booked through hawaii discounts. Rest assured, its quick and painless process, you literally go to their address, you park right at the parking lot outside of their offices, you walk into their offices, which is right on tarmac, check in and they'll walk you on to the plane.

It was an excellent flight, affordable, and I'd definitely recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Beautiful flight.  Great to get a feel for the whole island.  No comparisiont to driving.
review_text: The flight was awsome!!  Desi was a lot of fun and shared good information about the island.  Views were great all around.  Highly recommend this tour.

Eric was our pilot who showed us an excellent time!  His wealth of knowledge of Kauai, showing us the remote areas, beaches all around the island, pointing out several famous waterfalls, volcano and canyons were more than we imagined our flight could have been.  We had a terrific time!  Thank you, Eric 😁🤙🏼

Great service. We originally booked for a day which turned out to be rainy and poor visibility and Jill, at the desk, suggested we re-book to a better day which we did. Eric, our pilot was a great guide and interpreter of the island views and history. His humorous stories and manner made us all feel at ease and comfortable. Highly recommended!

We had Desi as our pilot and she and the entire staff here were wonderful! The views were spectacular! So much fun! Highly recommend. Do take a motion sickness pill before this flight though if you tend to get motion sick!
Desi is both an excellent pilot and a great tour guide. Look for the circular rainbow when you get around clouds. The views of Waimea canyon and the Na Pali coast are amazing. Thanks!
We loved our flight and even though Eric encountered bad weather he kept it very entertaining and fun.

This was part of another tour that had eight people on it, including our two traveling companions.  We were separated from our companions and put on two different planes. We were introduced to our pilots. I don't remember either's name. But I have included a picture of our pilot. The other pilot was a young woman with long curly hair. Both were excellent. We were asked our seating preferences. And all got the seat that each wanted. Each person had a window. I was in the back seat and had one on each side. We circled sites so that both sides could see them. A bonus was seeing so many whales. A fantastic tour.

When I asked the activities agent “how can I see most of the island in a short amount of time” he quickly suggested: “take a plane ride, it’ll be unforgettable.” He was absolutely right. The view was breathtaking! Seeing the Na Pali coastline, Waimea Canyon, and the 800 foot waterfalls left us in awe. I would highly recommend this wonderful company. The owner herself picked us up from the meeting point and drove us to the airport where we were to board the plane. The pilot and all the staff members were friendly, informative, and made sure we had an amazing adventure to remember. Thank you Airventures!

Company was referred to us by another, who could not accommodate plus size. These folks picked up up at Anchor Cove Mall (free shuttle from cruise ship), fast ride to airport. 
Eric was our pilot, and he did not disappoint. He was very in tune with the three of us with him in the cabin that day. He saw my friend have a very momentary stomach blip- checked in wit him. Saw me wiping eyes, checked in with me. I was just teary from the awe-inspiring views. Extremely responsive. Directed each of our attention to views we'd have, but also maneuvered expertly so that we all got the views! Reacted quickly to changing conditions, taking advantage of opportunities to go after sights that unexpectedly came up. Some of the most superlative beauty I have ever beheld. Anyone who says you "can't see anything" from a small plane... is trying to sell you a helicopter trip, lol. 
I'd be back up in a heartbeat. 
Then our driver back responded to unexpected traffic backups by taking the scenic route- and it really was! Nobody on it, either- he knew his back roads. Also liked that they worked as a team- our second driver was also a pilot.

We had an amazing tour on Valentines day. Staff at Airventures are very nice and accommodating. Weather was perfect and we got good views of Napali coast and Waimea Canyon. Our pilot Harry was very knowledgeable. Flight was pretty stable. Special thanks to Jill for giving us a ride to the car rental pickup.

I had a great aerial tour of Kauai with Eric and the team at Air Ventures Hawaii.  Due to schedule, weather, and other factors, the only chance I had to see the NaPali Coast was with Eric in the AirVan.  Being a fixed wing pilot I wanted a tour by plane rather than helicopter.  The AirVan gives every passenger a window seat.  On top of that, the price made this an excellent value.  Perfect weather on Kauai is rare, and though we had an excellent day to fly, there was still weather that could have been a factor in seeing all of the island.  Eric skillfully guided us to all of the points I wanted to see, and did it safely.  Even if I had my own plane on the island, I would still fly with Air Ventures.  Their skill and knowledge of the island alone was worth the investment.

Our pilot, Kevin, was friendly and very knowledgeable about the island. He made sure we were having fun and getting great pictures too. I would recommend the private tour to anyone. We both sat on the right side of the plane so we had great views for the whole ride. The larger planes and helicopters can't offer that. Our concierge Kki at Banyan Harbor got us a good price on this too.

My wife and I along with another couple originally booked a helicopter tour but my wife stumbled onto AirVentures' website and wow what a substitution! Needless to say the view from above was out of this world but I do need to comment on our pilot. I believe she said her name was Dezi but it may have been Dexie. Not sure but for a 24 year old, what a career. She played a major role in making this a fabulous adventure. Her personality, skills, & knowledge were off the charts. Not only would I recommend AirVentures to anyone, I would highly advise that they request her if at all possible. Thanks to her and everyone else at AirVentures for making this the highpoint of our Hawaii cruise/vacation. - Dan & Linda Kollatz

Excellent staff, excellent pilot, our flight was after days of rain and there were many, many waterfalls.  The pilot was excellent, showed us many sights and areas.  Gave advice for ground tours on our own. Highly recommend this tour.

Really a great tour.  The flight was longer than the helicopter tours and we got to see everything from a window seat.  I've been on helicopter tours which I think are better if you actually land somewhere, otherwise the plane is just as good and much less expensive.  Our pilot, Desi, was a real trip, super enthusiastic and a lot of fun to be with.  Our flight was the afternoon after a heavy rain day so there were an unbelievable number of waterfalls.

I have been coming to Kauai for the last six years, but this is the first air tour and it was awesome.  I highly recommend it for the most comprehensive and complete tour of the island.  Desi was an awesome pilot and guide and thoroughly an asset to the tour.  It is a tremendous review of this beautiful island.

Eric, our pilot, provided a magnificent tour of Kauai, despite some cloud cover.  He expertly and safely found openings, was considerate of providing the view from both sides of the plane and knew the best sights.  We had spectacular views of the coastline, the canyon and even saw three whales!  Have you ever seen the full circle of a rainbow?  Now we have!  Eric was friendly, professional and gave us some beautiful photo opportunities.  Highly recommend.

What great people. Eric was attentive, personable and went out of his way to make sure everyone had a great time.  I would recommend this tour to anyone. 
Eric took extra time to make sure we could see the whales off the Napali coast and did a fantastic job of narrating the whole tour.

We had Eric as our pilot and lucked out to be the only two on the plane with him earlier this morning.  We were able to see whales jumping in the ocean as well as the most amazing views! Eric was very fun and informative we learned so much while we were in the air with him!  I can’t rave enough about how amazing it was to be up there! I would do it over and over again if I could!  If you can ask for Eric to be your pilot I’d highly recommend him! Safe flight with so much info and a fun environment! My fiancé and I can’t stop talking about it!

review_title: The highlight of our Kauai experience
review_text: Our family of 4 flew with Eric around Kauai in a six seater plane.  Every passenger had a great view, Eric was personable and knowledgeable and made an effort to detour when he spotted a breaching whale which was super.  The scenery, of course, was magnificent.  The service and the experience was excellent. Our only thought was we should have done it on the first day to get a better perspective and to help us make decisions about what to do on Kauai!

What an amazing experience! The team at Airventures are all so lovely and helpful. They were professional and friendly each step of the way and I couldn't fault them if I tried. Our pilot Eric was fantastic. He pointed out all the important landmarks and made sure everyone could see each place from both sides of the plane. He made sure we all got a good view of some whales while we were at it! 
The island itself is stunning and the best way to see all of it's unique cliff faced beauty is definitely by air. I would recommend this to everyone.

Our pilot Desi was amazing.  Her personality really shows how much she loves her job and loves to show the beautiful island of Kauai.  I highly recommend this tour.  Seeing nature’s beauty from the air is truly amazing.

review_title: Views of the island were amazing
review_text: We took an airplane tour around the island of Kauai with this company and they were very good. The pilot was funny and gave us a mini history lesson and knew the answers to all of our questions.Most amazing was the view of the canyon and the view of the Napali coastline. It may seem expensive but it really is a good value considering it is an hour long flight and you have amazing views you would never be able to see from the ground.

Would highly recommend!! This tour was amazing!! Our pilot Desi was absolutely wonderful!  Her bubbly personality was contagious!! She was very knowledgeable and about the island!  If you have a fear of small planes she will definitely put your mind at ease!! We loved her, she was so full of energy and a great pilot!! Great tour!!

Had the opportunity to see Kauii by plane, with Desi as our pilot. She was awesome, and we were lucky that visibility was excellent the day we flew. We were off the Pride of America for the day and thoroughly enjoyed this excursion with our knowledgeable pilot, which we booked through Discount Hawaii. fantastic views of the canyons and coastlines.

This was a great experience! We got to tour the island with Desi. She was so fun and knowledgable about the island! The entire staff was so friendly and helpful. We saw amazing views of the island and had a blast! We would definitely do another tour with Air Ventures Hawaii!

Our family of three booked a flight to see Kauai by air, and we were not disappointed! This is definitely a great way to see the island in all of her amazing beauty. Do not miss this opportunity! Also, the staff at Air Ventures were super friendly and accommodating. They picked us up, and dropped us off afterwards with recommendations of other things to check out in the area (thanks Jill). Harry was a very skilled pilot and knowledgeable about the island. He answered all of our questions, and even made sure we got the best views possible (of the island and the many rainbows). It was a little rainy the day we went (typical for this time of year), so we ran into a little turbulence, but he looked for the smoothest path possible. After we landed, the ground crew could tell that I was a little nauseous from some of the turbulence, and they quickly brought me some ginger ale, gave tips on other options for motion sickness,  and made sure I was okay before taking us back. Very kind and helpful. Outstanding service and an amazing experience, We would do this again in a heart beat!

We were lucky enough to find out about this at the port and it was so worth it.  Kevin, our pilot, was wonderful and could answer any question we had.  We had done a helicopter tour over the volcano on Hawaii, but this was even better.  A full hour, over the entire island of Kauai.  We got to see all the sights we had read about and others we didn't even know about, and there is no bad seat in the plane and they dropped us back off at the cruise ship afterwards.  Thanks Jill, Kevin and Rich for a wonderful experience.

We (me and my wife) booked the excursion in air-van initially with Air Ventures team. On reaching the terminal Jill gave us a free upgrade to Cessna (private tour). Woohoo!!
The tour guide Desiree was a certified pilot and very knowledgeable. She took us over the entire island and made few circles around the must see places (Blow hole, Napali coast etc).
