Personally I liked the way she showed us the island, starting from the southern part and then going over the Waimea Canyon and then Napali coast and then finally over the weeping walls and other tons of waterfalls.

Overall the Air Ventures team is awesome and I would highly recommend anyone who wants to see Kauai from the top. Pretty impressed by Jill and Desi!!

We booked a private aeroplane tour for two around Kauai. It was the best. Friendly staff, great pilot, a brilliant experience for a reasonable price. This is by far the best way to see the island and I can't recommend this company enough.

review_title: Great pilot, friendly ground crew, amazing service!
review_text:
We had originally booked the Vintage Bi-Plane tour and were really excited for it, but were contacted by AirVentures shortly before our trip to let us know that there had been an incident on the tarmac (not AirVentures fault) and their bi-plane had been unfortunately damaged. Given their commitment to safety, they were cancelling all bi-plane tours until they could arrange for a new plane. All changes to our plans were handled very professionally and AirVentures did everything in their power to make sure our tour was fantastic and fit into our plans given the rescheduling! 

I actually got to ride in the co-pilot's seat (which was amazing!) and we enjoyed one of the best tours of our entire trip. It had rained heavily for two or three days straight so it seemed that every waterfall on the island was running heavily, which was a real treat to see. The pilot was friendly and offered very interesting commentary throughout the flight. Takeoff and landing were both smooth and we would do the tour again in a heartbeat - so beautiful!

They go above and beyond!  The entire team at Air Ventures provided outstanding customer service to my family.  It was our last day few hours on the island before our flight and we were on a tight schedule.  My wife, daughter and I took the tour as my parents waited at the Air Ventures location.  The airplane was clean, comfortable and they provided cold water and towels for added comfort.  Our pilot, Eric, is awesome at what he does.  He’s a great pilot and gave an exceptional tour which shows how knowledgeable he is of the island.  Upon our return, we were so impressed with the tour that we convinced my parents to the take the next tour which was going to leave in a few minutes.  As I mentioned earlier, we were on a tight schedule.  We had a lot to do before making it back to our terminal with enough time left to check-in, etc.   The staff at Air Ventures understood our situation so while my parents were up in the air taking their tour, one of the gentleman on their staff offered to drive me to the rental hub to return our rental vehicle.  For no charge at all, he helped move our luggage from my rental to their company van, shuttled me to the rental hub, shuttled me back to Air Ventures and finally, took all of us to our terminal with ample time to check-in, etc.  My parents were delighted to know that they were also able to take the tour without all of us cutting it too close. I highly recommend Air Ventures for their excellent tour and superb customer service.

review_title: Great experience - the perfect way to discover Kauai!
review_text:
We discovered the Air Ventures Tour and liked the idea to fly over the island in a small plane instead of a helicopter: you see more though the large windows and the plane uses much less gasoline.
It turned out to be the right decision: Desi is a great pilot, she knows the island by heart and explained every bay and mountain we passed. 
On top we got a lot of great tips on where to snorkel, hike etc. Thanks for pointing out the Puka dogs - they were really delicious!
A great Mahalo to Desi, Jill and the whole team!

Our island air tour was just awesome.  Desi was our pilot and did an excellent job of showing us the island ( locations, beaches, waterfalls, Na Pali coastline) and also narrating about them as well.  My husband was able to get some wonderful pictures of the sites without being in a rush, since there is more time when on a plane.  The ability to see everything was excellent.  The price was very reasonable for a 60-70 minute tour.   We will do this tour again on our next visit to Kauai.

The view was spectacular and the pilot knowledgeable of the island.  It's a must-do activity to truly see the wonders of the island.  Highly recommended but word of caution, if motion sickness is an issue for you, do not do this unless you have taken dimenhydrinate (Gravol) early enough for it to be active in your system.  Absolutely no fault of the pilot but just the nature of the activity makes this kind of tour unsuitable for people sensitive to motion sickness.

Our tour guide, Eric, was very helpful and informative of history and other fun facts about Kauai.  The views were spectacular, and we got to hover directly over a few waterfalls!  Excellent way to see the entire island!

My husband and I had an excellent and memorable tour of Kauai by air. Our pilot, Eric, was fun and informative. He made the entire trip great. I highly recommend this activity while visiting the island.

This is definitely a tour you must take. Our pilot Dennis was extremely knowledgeable about the island of Kauai and explains everything you see from small beaches, former locations of sugar cane fields to formation of the island by volcanoes and history of natives. 
We saw the entire island especially areas that were inaccessible and could only be viewed by air. 
This is definitely the highlight of our trip. Thank you Air Ventures

My husband and I took our 1 year-old daughter to Kauai. We booked the Best of Kauai land and boat tour at first thinking our daughter wouldn't be able to fly. When we changed our mind just an hour before flight time, Steve (of Northshore Limousine who led our tour) called and made arrangement. Not only we got our own private plane, we got Ray, the owner of Air Adventures, to be our captain. He was very knowledgeable about Kauai and was very considerate of our comfort during flight especially our little one. There was also wet cool towels for our use during flight to remain cool even though we didn't need them. And we used headsets to communicate with captain as well as for him to explain the scenery to us. Our girl fell asleep throughout the entire flight. There was a little turbulence here and there whenever we approached the mountains but felt the same compared to the turbulence in a big passenger plane. Ray always warned us about upcoming turbulence and got our input in fly direction such as when we wanted to see the Na'Pali coast from a different view. Overall, our experience was very enjoyable. I can't say enough about the scenery. The best way to see Kauai is by small plane like this. By land alone you can only see 10% of the island. I'm so glad we could do it.

We had a wonderful experience on our biplane tour with Air Ventures Hawaii! We flew into Kauai for a one day visit and this was an excellent way to experience the entire island! The views were amazing and Kevin was a great guide. This was definitely the biggest highlight of our 2 week Hawaiian vacation. We highly recommend it for everyone!

The Air Ventures tour was recommend by our friend. We were picked up from the ABC store and brought to the airport for the ride of a lifetime.  Our pilot Kevin  seated the 6 passengers.  We all had window seats and one person was chosen to sit in the 
co-pilots seat. He made turns so that both sides of the plane could take pictures.  The "Grand Canyon of the Pacific" was awesome to see from the air.He circled the entire island.  We saw tons of waterfalls, gorgeous beaches which you can not see on land.  We flew for an hour.  This was an experience that we will remember for a forever.  After the plane ride, they drove us to the harbor boat ride to the Fern Grotto.  Price was about a 1/3 less than the helicopter rides.
Don't miss this one!!!
June 2016  L&B new York
Absolutely beautiful aerial tour around the entire island of Kauai. The pilot was an excellent tour guide too. Loved seeing the rugged coastline and mountain valleys from the air.

We took the two-person plane ride that takes you on an hour tour of Kauai.   Brian was our pilot.  The plane is 60 years old and looks a little rough, but he assured us the engine gets replaced every 2,000 flying hours and it ran just fine.  Brian did a wonderful job of narrating the tour of Kauai, pointing out interesting spots, vegetation, and historical facts.  We really did see the entire island and got a sense of the amazing geographical areas that make up the different parts of the island.  While it is true that an airplane doesn't go as low and up close as a helicopter, we paid about half of what a helicopter ride would cost, stayed in the air almost twice as long, and definitely saw all the same points of interests.  I have no regrets that we chose Air Ventures over a helicopter.  We'd do it again in a heartbeat!

We were very surprised on how reasonably priced this air tour is set. The pilot was great with info and flying skills. The personal services before and after the flight was ideal. A great way to see the remote parts of the island and an overview of the entire island.

We took a private 60-minute tour around the Island this past week and it was truly the highlight of our entire trip. I booked with Air Ventures because we could do a private tour and it was a bit less expensive than other companies. We left a little bit after 830am when our flight was, but spent over 60 minutes in the air which I was really pleased with (I've heard other companies will shorten your air time). We went out with Eric who was a fantastic tour guide, pointing out all the sights along our trip, and was also very conscious to check on me frequently since I told him I do get motion sickness. I enjoyed the solo tour because Eric could talk to us about what we were interested in and I could also shift around in the plane to see all the sites and take pictures. All-in-all it was a fantastic experience and I'd highly recommend it to anyone traveling to the island.

This was something we wanted to do the entire trip and searched long and hard for the right one. After doing our research, we decided on Air Ventures and we were not disappointed!! Our pilot Eric was very knowledgable about the island and the tour was well over an hour. Compared to other tours prices, this one was comparable but a firm believer in you pay for what you get and we got a great guide and amazing views of the island! Highly recommend

Really happy we took this tour. Our pilot Brian had several years experience, was very knowledgeable and made sure to turn the plane so passengers on both sides of aircraft had opportunity to see and take photos.  Some of my best photos of the island were from this tour.  He did a great job of pointing out landmarks, providing history and answering questions.  He even flew me over the now dilapidated Coco Palms where I had stayed as a young girl.  It was a nice touch and greatly appreciated.  I've done helicopter tours before, but actually enjoyed this more.  Felt safer and they fly low enough that the view are absolutely fantastic.  I felt the trip was a great value and the entire Air Ventures team we dealt with were professional and accommodating.  This is a tour I would recommend.

review_title: Air Ventures Kauai-- Red baron byplane flight
review_text: This was the best fun we have ever had. My husband and I were in Hawaii for our 50th anniversary, and this was the most memorable experience we could have wished for. We were on the Pride of America our last day in Kauai. Rich Lopaka picked us up in the little village shopping area in Lihui. He was so funny and very informative as he drove us to the airport . The wonderful true Hawaiian culture was his main topic and he was very interesting. At the airport we were checked in by a lovely young woman to await our flight.  Captain Harry came in introduced himself and took us outside for intro to the Red Baron. So beautiful. My husband had been a little nervous , but we were both put at ease by everyone at Air Ventures. We boarded in the front seat, and put on our ear phones for communication. Captain Harry readied the plane and we were off. The flight was smooth and Harry just gave us such a wonderful tour of the entire Island . Movie sights, water falls, rivers villages, we spotted a whale and he flew down to get a better view. The waimea canyon and Nepali coast was breathtaking. He explained all the areas and a great deal of history. Even spoke of the reefs and outlying islands. He made sure to place us in good picture and video position . I cannot stress enough  that this was the most we have ever gotten for our money on any trip or excursion we have been on. It was so worth it. Landing was so smooth we didn't feel it..  We were returned to the village again by Rich.  Again this as wonderful and we hope that anyone who reads this and are going to be in Hawaii will have the same experience.  Ron and Karen

review_title: Wow what a GREAT way to see the Island
review_text: We have been coming to Kauai for over 20 years. We have looked at every place we could get to on the island. I should say we thought we had seen the Island. Wow what a difference it makes to be up in the air. The plane was clean , with lots of room , the pilot was a wealth of knowledge, In one quick tour we saw the entire Island. Beautiful, Spectacular and WOW

This was my second trip to Kauai. My wife and I wanted to make sure that we saw as much of the island as we could. Air Ventures was booked as a combination ground/air tour. The air portion took us over the entire island and gave us some interesting facts and history. The staff was wonderful and our pilot/guide did an excellent job.

review_title: AMAZING! Steady flight, great pilot, and very clear views that were incredible!
review_text:
My husband thought this was the best part of the trip. They place you according to weight in the plane, which I thought was weird at first but just fine after a while. Plane only holds 7 people so it was very close and everyone had a window seat with amazing views. The rainbows from above are incredible! Ive never experienced anything in my life like this and it was so worth the money.

My husband sat copilot seat and I sat behind the pilot. There is AC and everyone wears headphones that the pilots talks to you through and you can ask questions through. The flight was extremely steady and we never had any scary moments, just smooth flying. 70 minutes long and you go over the entire island. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and we learned so much about so many things on the island. He was funny too, it was the best.

We took our phones and our professional camera with us and it was steady enough to get smooth video and clear pictures, we took tons and it was so amazing. He flies back and forth to make sure both sides of the plane get the same view on most parts of the island, which I really appreciated.

I recommend you do this at the start of your trip! We did this on the last day and we realized how many cool places we never explored after taking the air tour, had we only known before. Either way, take this tour, you will not be sorry and everyone you know at home will be so jealous!

I decided to go on this trip with my husband for his 60th birthday with Air Ventures.  I chose this type of aircraft over a helicopter because I felt more secure in it.  The trip was fantastic and our pilot Harry was great.  The weather was wonderful.  We got to tour the entire island from the sky.  We had toured the island by car prior to this flight.  I'm glad we did the flight after visiting ourselves because it gave us perspective of what we saw on the island by ourselves.  This tour showed us things you would never see by car.  The island is truly beautiful and has such a diverse topography.

review_title: Really, you and the family should do this!!!
review_text: My family and I took the Air Ventures tour over Kauai!! We were debating on going on this tour, or a helicopter tour.. I must say that we made the right choice!! =-) The staff was fun and very friendly and put us at ease in an instant. The pilot was awesome at showing us the sites that you just plain cant see from the ground. The way that the pilot conveyed his knowledge of the history and the landmarks of the island was fantastic!! =-) The 4 of us were genuinely impressed with the entire experience and loved the fact that we all had window seats, and we all had a chance to see the sights from our own seats. No need to lean across anyone for pictures, the flight plan made it so that we all had no problem enjoying the sites. I especially enjoyed the fact that I was chosen to be the co-pilot for our flight!! =-) Definitely the thing to do in Kauai, and the fact that it is priced about half as much as a helicopter tour dosn't hurt!! =-)  Thanks Air Ventures!!

My four friends and I decided to take an aerial tour of Lihue. What an amazing time. Very comfortable 6-seater aircraft with plenty of windows to take unobstructed pictures of the island. Over the hour we were in the air, we were able to circle the entire island, plus head inward to see a lot of the landscape that just isn't reachable by car, etc.  Even better, the pilot actually gave us an interesting commentary about the aspects of the island we were viewing... You could tell he wasn't reading from some prepared script like a lot of these tour companies. 

For the airline geeks :-) - We took the tour that left around 11:30am. As a result we were able to see a United plane land from LAX. By the time we got back, AA had their 757 parked at the gate. 

Overall definately worth the time and money. A couple folks I was traveling with said this was much better than the helicopter tours they have taken in the past.

Though I must say I was not thrilled about the prospect of flying in a small plane (we did the bi-plane) it was an excellent way to see the entire island.  We took the one hour tour. The views were spectacular. The pilot was very informative and personable. We saw sites that were truly amazing; ones we could never have seen from the ground (and we did a lot of hiking!). review_title: An Air tour of Kauai is a MUST
review_text: An air tour of kauai is something you cannot miss. Much of the island is inaccesible by car but you get to see the entire island in this flight in a short time. It will give you a great idea of where you want to go on the island for the rest of your trip. Most helicopter tours have weight limits so we were going to go without an air tour until I found out that the planes were much more flexible and we got to see kauai from the air afterall. review_title: Great way to see all of Kauai
review_text:
AirVentures was a great way to see the entire island.  We have been to Kauai once before, but this shows you so many sites that you cannot get to by ground.  It also is a great way to put the whole island in perspective.  We did our air tour as part of a "Best of Kauai" tour which was a great combination.  We started with the air tour, so we got to see all the way around the island.  Then we had a van tour.  By seeing the air tour first, it helped us decide what else we wanted to see.  We decided we needed to see more of the Waimea Canyon.  
Paul was great at giving each side of the plane a pass of all the best sites.  Smooth take off; smooth landing, great flight.

Flew on 1/22/13. I was apprensive with low clouds on the north side of the island. We took off and immediatly saw whale pods just off the coast. We turned and flew over Lihue then right between a saddleback ridge and over the ocean again. Beautiful coast line views and Harry pointed out the special beaches, coffee plantations and many waterfalls. All the while we were connected to Harry and could here air traffic from the other tours. Harry (our pilot) spotted another pod of whales and circled so that all could see. Then up the Waimea Canyon and out over the Na Pali Coast, from a 3000 foot canyon to 4000 foot shear cliffs. With clouds and rain from the rainforest and some turns by Harry all aboard were offered views of multiple rainbows.
Then along the North coast over beautiful Hanalei Bay, past the Kilauea Light House and then south back toward Lihue. Before we landed we saw more waterfalls, cattle ranches, and former sugarcane plantations. Smooth landing and a great time.  After 31 years of marrage I did not realize until finished that my wife had never been in a small plane. Although a bit shaky after landing she enjoyed the entire flight.

We did our Air Ventures tour of Kauai on December 17 with Harry as our Pilot. He was very professional and did a great job of making sure that we saw all of the beautiful sights of Kauai. My favorite place to see, of course, was the Napoli Coast. I was very glad we got a great look at it by air, as our Sunset Dinner Cruise down the Napoli Coast had to be rerouted to the Southern Coast due to the intense waves. I would definitely recommend this air tour to everyone that wants to see the sights of the entire Island in an hour. I would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Great air tour of the island!
review_text:
Since most of Kauai is only accessible by air or boat, an air tour is essential to see the whole island. I decided to do a small plane instead of a helicopter tour. It was less expensive and the departure times fit my schedule. I'm so glad I chose Air Ventures. They were courteous and the pilot was friendly and informed. The tour covered the entire island. It was fun seeing prominent spots like Twin Falls, from the air. The tour lasted about an hour.

If you are doing an air tour, I highly recommend Air Ventures.

I think this was the highlight of our week trip to Hawaii.  Kauai has such beautiful natural features that can only be appreciated from air.  And you get to see them all in a sixty-five minute trip small group flight rather than hours of travel on a crammed tour bus filled with screaming children.  You see the beautiful luxury resorts, the black volcanic shores, the white waves crashing through Sprouting Horn, the white sandy beaches, the entire length of the grand canyon, the high altitude water falls, and the amazing remote North Shore which is only accessible by plane or boat.  It is truly an experience of a lifetime.  

The free van picked us up and returned us directly to our cruise ship.

review_title: Best of Kauai Combo Excursion - Air portion
review_text:
Very glad I booked this combo excursion. It was a toss-up between this plane tour or doing a separate helicopter tour. I'm glad I did the plane. Tour was 1 hour long and we flew all around the island and saw it's entire coastline, flew over Waimea canyon. Pilot pointed out a number of celebrity homes. Got to see waterfalls that aren't on the map and can only be seen from the air.

All in all well worth the money.

I've been wanting to go on a helicopter tour my whole life and found a 2-for-1 coupon in my hotel's pamphlet for Air Ventures. I booked a Sunday morning tour for two and asked what kind of helicopter we'd be flying. "It's actually an airplane, an AirVan," said the friendly voice.

I considered canceling - doesn't everyone see Hawaii from a helicopter? Isn't that the "it" thing to do?

We kept our time slot and showed up early. There were seven of us scheduled to fly together, everyone amiable and sharing their travel stories. The flight lasted almost an hour - and we saw EVERYTHING. Also, when I asked the pilot to show us something specifically, he nodded and made sure to include it along our route, even doubling back a few miles to point out the open-air cave along the Na Pali Coast.

When we returned, we spoke to a man from our hotel who paid twice as much to go on a helicopter ride for half the time and saw a third of what we saw (and if I haven't mentioned it, we saw the entire island). His wife was none too pleased at being left behind, and he said the helicopter ride was incredibly bumpy - hard to photograph. My photographs came out spectacular.

I got an incredibly great price on this, and I think Air Ventures would lose money if everyone found the coupon I did. But if you're on a budget and enjoy star treatment, do your research ahead of time and expect to be rewarded.

My wife and I went to Kauai, HI for our honeymoon and came across Air Ventures while on the island. We went on the Big Kahuna Air Tour which is a 70 plane tour of the entire island. We were in awe the entire flight! Our pilot Harry was awesome. He showed us the entire island as well as some key spots we wanted to see (ie, Ben Stillers vacation home, the beach where Jurassic Park was filmed and many more). The flight was extremely smooth and provided absolutely stunning views! If there is one activity on Kauai that you cannot afford to miss out on - its this one! It's a must!

review_title: Misleading waste of time and money. Will be contacting priceline
review_text: I flew on "Air Ventures Hawaii" today and really "got took" as they say. First from booking on Priceline, what was stated there and on the trip info simply was not what I got. To ad insult to injury I was placed on the left side of the plane behind the pilot and missed most of the sites. A family with a tot all of maybe 4 or 5 got the cherry seats on the right side. A girl about 8 inches shorter than me got to spread out in front with the pilot. A 4 or 5 year old (again amazed by this) gets the big window on the right in the middle. Her Mother getting the last good window on the right. There I am 6'2" 210 pounds, crammed in this tiny plane behind the pilot with a great view of the wing and white bar holding it on. One of the girls on the right side was kind enough to snap a few pictures for me and also thought it was foolish how they arranged us. The rest of the trip consisted of me sticking my arm over to where the tot was and trying to get pics and then finally shutting my camera off and giving up. The waterfall was the only thing the pilot circled back for, for me to see. I missed the entire Napali Coast which was the main thing I wanted to see. Oh there is Julia Roberts house and there is Pierce Brosnan's place. (The tot does not know who they are.) I will never know with my view of the ocean, wing, and white bar holding the wing on. This was absolute crap. Do yourself a favor and wait until you are here and book a helicopter tour. I have been sick at my stomach all day from this tiny plane and also just feel very ripped off. I cannot believe the pilot gave a tot a cherry seat and stuck me where he did either. A short girl getting to spread out in front. I had a 20 dollar tip ready but I left tipping nothing. I guess I will go blow 15 on a beer at the St. Regis where I am staying. Did not like the reference that it was foolish to spend 15 on a beer. What was foolish was this plane ride. I think I should get refunded as I have booked a copter tour tomorrow and have to drive all the way back to that side of the island to get a decent tour. The place I went to book another tour right after this said I would get a seat I wanted. They said they did not think that was right giving two of three people in a group, especially a little kid the good seats. They thought I probably only paid 60-70 though. Oh boy, I paid much more and got to watch a family make great memories while I sat in the worst seat on the plane. Not as advertised. Avoid at all costs! What a waste of a day and now I have to drive out of my way again for a decent tour. If you can't tell I am writing this while I am still mad. Just terrible. As if all this is not bad enough if you are on the right side, the plane still flies very very high. Not up close and personal at all like it was made out to be.

The directions sent with the confirmation were accurate and made finding the Air Ventures at the Lihue airport easy. The day before someone called to re-confirm the trip.  The pilot greeted all the passengers (6) by name and we had the picture taken before boarding the small plane.  We all put our headphones on. The plane ride was totally smooth.  The plane glided over the entire island without any bumps or jerking.  The pilot was describing all the locations below and when he wasn't talking, a relaxing Hawaiian music was being played.  The landing was very smooth.  Overall, the  the tour was immensely enjoyable and relaxing and I was able to take some good pictures.  I can honestly recommend Air Ventures!  Combine it with Lauau or the NaPali Cost dinner cruise to get the best deal.

review_title: Amazing way to see all of Kauai!
review_text:
We decided to celebrate my son's birthday and see the entire island by taking a flight with Air Ventures Hawaii.  We were very impressed by their presentation, given at our resort and decided to book with them.   

We were very impressed with, not only their professionalism, but also with the wealth of information they provided during the tour. Captain Harry gave a wonderful tour that gave a lot of insight into both the history of the island, as well as places we might want to tour by car. It was presented in a most enjoyable and humourous manner. 

I would suggest bringing your camera and a spare battery. One member of our party had his camera die after only a few shots. Fortunately, there were others able to take up the slack - but still a disappointment for him.  

In 1998, I had taken a helicopter tour of the island. While it was exciting to ride in a helicopter, I found that I had better views and a more far ranging tour of the island with the fixed wing. 

I can't wait for the opportunity to come back to Kauai. I would certainly take this tour again - it is breath taking.

We took a wonderful  Air Ventures tour of the island of Kauai.  We circled the entire island.  The pilot was excellent, as was the plane's performance. The pilot shared his knowledge of the geography, and pointed out waterfalls and other attractions as we circled the island.  The views were incredible, with the highlights being the Waimea Canyon and the AWESOME Cathedrals at Na Pali.  Bring a camera!!! We had some one person in our group who was 83 so we opted for the Air Ventures based on other positive reviews that it wouldn't be as bumpy as a helicopter.  I would recommend Air Ventures. review_title: Best Way to View the Entire Island
review_text:
We did this on our third day and really were glad that we did. We did the 1-hour tour and got the free DVD for booking online. (By the way, the DVD is worth it if you book online and get it for free, but not for the $20 or whatever you had to pay for it, it's only like 20 min. long and doesn't have that great of quality, but was a nice gift for us since it was free!) This was something my husband was adamant about doing and since I get really motion sick, I wasn't originally too keen on it. In fact, he originally started wanting to do a doors-off helicopter ride and I was excited to find Air Ventures had such great reviews so that I could suggest this as an alternative to the helicopter, which went over well and I think he's very happy that we did it this way. 

You really get to see the entire island from above and get some of the history from your guide. Our guide/pilot wasn't as talkative as we would have liked, but really no one on the plane was asking questions or talking to him either, so I think it's understandable that it turned out that way. And most of the sights speak for themselves. You get to see the coffee fields, all of the fabulous/famous beaches of the island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, where Jurassic Park/Raiders of the Lost Ark was filmed, etc etc etc --- it is really all encompassing and I would recommend it. 

The people that run it and were the pilots were SUPER nice as well, which really makes for an awesome trip, especially because I was a little nervous about flying in such a small plane. 

As for the motion sickness, I did ok for a half hour and then was feeling really ill for the second half, but I never actually got sick and imagine it's MUCH better than a helicopter ride would have been. And they were very sweet about it as well, offering watering and where I could sit to cool off, so that was much appreciated. 

I think this is a must do for those on Kauai, it's so cool to see all of the places from above and then spend the rest of the week exploring from the ground or water, very cool!

review_title: Kauai, Hawaii Perfect Air Venture Tour
review_text: We just returned from a vacation week on the island of Kauai, Hawaii.  Our week was jam packed with activities such as kayaking, hiking, swimming, beach combing, etc.  But beyond a shadow of a doubt, the Air Venture Airvan plane tour of the entire island was the highlight of our adventures.  It was not only reasonably priced but was filled with the most spectacular views of this island, including the Waimea Canyon, lush tropical forests, coffee plantations, and the many, many beautiful beaches.  Paul (?), the pilot/guide, was very informative and courteous during the entire tour taking the time to point out whales splashing along one beach.  He advised us to turn off the camera flash to increase photographic quality.  Each of our party had their own window for observation and photos.  No details were omitted as the windows were freshly cleaned before each flight.

In November, my girlfriend and I visited Kauai for the first time.  We wanted to get a good "overview" of the Island and chose Air Ventures instead of helicopter tour.  I think we made the right choice!  The tour was inclusive of the entire island.  The pilot was very informative and pleasant.  We had a great flight around the island.  I would recommend this trip to anyone visiting Kauai.

JS Flinn
Moreno Valley, CA

Yesterday my wife, a friend, and I went on a flight over Kauai riding in a fixed wing aircraft flown by an experienced pilot from Air Ventures.  We debated flying in a helicopter instead of the fixed wing aircraft, because a helicopter can hover over a scenic location, but opted for the lower cost aircraft.  We had heard that the Air Van aircraft, which seats 7 passengers and flies at about 115 - 120 mph offers plenty of time to take pictures of waterfalls and other scenic spots.  Each passenger is seated next to an optically clear plastic window and is provided an opportunity to photograph locations of interest.  I was using my new digital SLR and got some great photos.  The flight takes an hour and the plane travels (at least our flight did) in a clockwise direction around the island, primarily along the coast line and over the Waimea Canyon (the Grand Canyon of the Pacific), traveling over the Hanalei Valley when returning to Lihue.  My wife and I had toured much of the island by vehicle on a trip to Kauai with two other friends just last January, but seeing the canyon and some of the waterfalls that we had seen from the road-side access was not nearly as exciting as the view from the aircraft.  We particularly enjoyed flying over the Napali coast (western shoreline) and seeing all of the waterfalls.  Our flight was on a relatively clear day after several days of intermittent heavy rainfall, so the waterfalls were spectacular and abundant.  The pilot was very good about pointing out the sites and telling us historical anecdotes about various scenic locations.  The noise-canceling headphones and microphones provided each passenger enabled us to hear him clearly and ask questions.  He was an excellent pilot, considerate about minimizing turbulence by flying above it or moving away from the cliffs, and very knowledgeable about Kauai.  In short, I would strongly recommend taking the Air Ventures aircraft flight as providing one of the best ways to see all of the major sites of interest on the entire island.  We all enjoyed the flight and felt it provided more than any other recreational experience during this vacation.

The tour is very affordable compared to the traditional helicopter tours and you are even in the air for more time. We would recommend this tour to anyone who would like to view the entire island by air at a very affordable rate compared to other air tour companies.

Air Ventures was great to work with; knowledgeable about the island; and provided a great value for money spent.

Take a tour with Air Ventures. It will be worth your time and money to see Kuaui from the air.

review_title: See Kauai from the air with Air Ventures
review_text:
Flying with Air Ventures is not just a cheaper alternative to taking the more expensive helicopter tours!

You get a full hour tour with a great guide and pilot (Joel) to tour all of the major sights of the island and see things you cannot see from the ground.

The plane is specially designed for low speed flying and much quieter than the helicopters.  You get a headset and microphone to enable two way communication with the pilot.

You will see the harbor, the entire western coast (NaPali), Kalalau Valley, Hanalei Bay, Princeville, numerous waterfalls, the Powerline Trail, Mt. Waialeale, coffee plantations, Wailua Falls, and many other sights.

This was our fourth trip to Kauai but our first time to see the island from the air and it is well worth the money spent.  Don't book with any other airplane or helicopter tour.  Then report your experiences back to this website!

This person should be the designated picture taker as there is a convenient open section of the window that allows unobstructed picture taking.  Don't get too caught up in the picture taking or else you will miss some lovely spots.  You will definitely get low enough to enjoy beautiful waterfalls and landscape.  Don't pass this opportunity up.

review_text: It was a beautiful clear day and we were able to see so many things! Views of downtown Seattle and the sky line, Puget Sound, San Juan Islands. review_text: Flight was so scenic, a great first leg of our trip to the San Juans!  Checkin was easy-peasy, pilot was great.  And compared to driving and ferry, the flight saves so much time.  Highly recommended.

Fantastic experience and great customer service. We had a tour scheduled for 2:30pm but due to high expected winds in the afternoon Redtail reached out asking if we would be able to due the tour earlier as it may have to be cancelled due to weather. We did not want to miss this tour so appreciated the proactive reaching out. We did the Canyonlands flight and it was fantastic. A completely different perspective and got to see things we would otherwise not be a lie to see. Our pilot was great and very knowledgeable.

About 14 years ago I was in the area and could enjoy just a glimpse of Canyonlands, things you could only see from the road. But I imagined that there will be much more and the only way to grasp that was by airplane. Back then I planned to make it happen, should I be in the area again. Due to the pandemic it took a bit longer... 
Feed forward to the present, and today was the day! I originally planned to take the combo flight of both parks, but it seemed that the minimum number of participants dit not materialize, so I had to fall back on the Canyonlands alone. No regret, we were four passengers and I could take the place beside the pilot and was very impressed by the various landscapes, canyons, arches under the plane. The pilot was very well informed about the various stone types told us a lot of things, including where there were film sets of famous movies.

We had the most amazing experience, from start to finish, with Redtail Air Adventures! I had originally scheduled a helicopter tour for the morning of my birthday, however due to the flight schedule, they called to let me know that the helicopter needed routine maintenance & wouldn’t be available that day. I was so disappointed, but they quickly arranged for my husband and I to do a complimentary airplane tour instead. I was blown away by their generosity and kindness. We had spent the past 2 days hiking Canyonlands and Arches NP, and to see it then from the air was amazing. Views were unparalleled and our pilot was awesome! If we’re ever back in Moab, we will definitely be doing another tour. Book with Redtail, you won’t be disappointed. Thanks to the entire team at Redtail for kicking off my special day in the most amazing way!
Just wow! The tour was above expectations. Great information given by the pilot during the flight. Thank you for the great experience!
Cool experience. Professionally run and the pilot shared interesting info along the way. Good experience.

From takeoff to landing...Pilot John is amazing. professional, knowledgeable, takes the time to make sure you see the sights he is pointing out...very close views of canyons..
Very kind and patient, always smiling and jokes here and there..
Loved loved loved the adventure..
If you are a grown up 4 yr old, he is the perfect pilot..
thanks for the fun and adventure..planted a seed to get a my pilots license..thanks
and agree planes are boring!!
Peace
Melinda/Andy
California/Idaho crew

We had an incredible time on this flight. The pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and shared all kinds of great historical tidbits with us as we flew over the incredible desert landscape. As residents of the area, we learned a ton, and we brought my parents as a Christmas gift, and they learned a ton too. Would do this again for sure!

review_title: Redtail flight over Canyonlands National Park
review_text: We had a great experience  with our Redtail flight over Canyonlands. Our pilot, Ethan was friendly and very informative.  Gave us a nice smooth flight with awesome views of the park and maze area. We took several excursions as we visited  the 5 National Parks in Southern Utah, but our Redtail airplane  excursion was by far our favorite! From booking it with Jenny (who was so very helpful) to out flight ... everything was handled well! We took the 1 hour flight over Canyonlands, and experienced the vastness and beauty of the Park in a way that we couldn't have taken in from the ground. I would highly recommend Redtail and this experience!!

The views were just stunning.  They never get old for me.  Everyone at RedTail was very helpful.  Our pilot, Tracy Michoud, was also great.  His knowledge of geography and geology was impressive.  It was nice that he was able to keep talking the whole way while our jaws were on the floor.

From the folks at the front desk to the pilot everyone was both very helpful and very cheery! We thoroughly enjoyed the entire experience and learned a good amount about the structures.  Also saw some arches that are only accessible by plane or several days of hiking!  Most highly recommended!
Breathtaking views of the Canyonlands. Once in a lifetime experience, I highly recommend this! Our tour guide Chris was awesome and very knowledgeable of the terrain.

The flight above so familiar places of Canyonlands was a dream! Still in awe from the overwhelming beauty of endless canyons, rivers, arches and mountains in the background. Special thank you to our pilot Tracy who was fun and knowledgeable on history and geology of the area. 
I could take this tour every day and I don’t think it would ever get old.

Don’t forget to take photos! You’ll be in awe with the scenery. The best bit of my Moab outdoor adventure for sure! Flying over inaccessible parts of Canyonlands NP. Connor did an amazing job of narrating the surrounding area. The entire Redtail team is awesome.

My husband took me for an airplane tour of the canyon lands for my birthday and it was amazing! Our pilot, Conner was very nice and informative. He pointed out all the things to see in time for us to look and made sure we saw it all. We’re from East Tennessee and this was one of my favorite things we done the whole trip out. Next time we will bring our 7 year old! Very calm and smooth ride. Turbulence wasn’t bad at all! Definitely a great unforgettable experience!

What a wonderful experience!  My husband Steve and I were in Moab with a few extra hours in the afternoon before starting our train trip though the  Rockies.   While an afternoon time slot was not advertised on Redtail website, Amanda and Heather coordinated a flight time for us.  They also recommended Moab taxi to transport us to the air field from our hotel.  Connor our pilot was excellent pointing out amazing sights from the air as well as being attentive to safety procedures.   The staff at Redtail made our wonderful trip even more extraordinary than anticipated.  Thank you Amanda, Heather and Connor!!

Ethan flew us over Labyrinth Canyon, the Confluence, the Maze, the Needles, up the Colorado, and over the upper Castle Valley/Mill Creek drainages. He was super informative and flew us very smoothly. One of the coolest experiences in moab.

Fabulous would be a one-word description. As a resident of this area I have explored much of the wonders that exist here and am always amazed, but nothing I have done compared to the amazement and astonishment of seeing the wondrous Colorado Plateau and Canyonlands terrain from the air. 
I highly recommend Redtail Air Adventures to anyone who wants to fully explore this marvelously unique part of our planet. You will never regret this adventure. 
Ray Cannefax.

We had the greatest time on this flight by Red Tail Aviation.  Craig, our pilot, was very personable and informative.  We learned more from him in an hour about the Canyonlands than we ever did in school!  The scenery (which we would never see on our own) was spectacular.  The plane ride was very smooth and every passenger had their own window seat!  On a scale of 1 to 10, this is an 11!!!!  I highly recommend.  If I ever make it out to Utah again, I will be a repeat customer!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

review_title: Great way to see Moab’s terrain
review_text: Recommended by a friend and it did not disappoint! Amazing to see the beautiful landscape from the sky. Connor was an excellent pilot and the flight was smooth and enjoyable. Would highly recommend!

review_title: OUTSTANDING experience, plane tour over Canyonlands - you dont want to miss this experience
review_text: Red Tail Aviation = this one hour plane ride thru Canyonlands NP was OUTSTANDING and well worth the money!!! We really enjoyed the tour.  The pilot was excellent, very professional and friendly, he gave a good safety talk, he was very well informed, he shared alot of interesting facts and history during the flight.  This was one of the best experiences we had during our vacation to Utah.  We would do it again, and book thru Red Tail aviation.  Thanks for an excellent airplane tour.
We are so happy that we booked this tour while in Moab. We have never done a scenic flight and are so thankful that we found Redtail. Highly recommend, it was unforgettable!
This was such a special and wonderful experience! We cannot wait to book another tour with Redtail. Cannot recommend enough!

This is definitely the way to see the Canyonlands especially since it is so vast.   There were 4 of us & we only had a short amount of time before we needed to drive north.    Connor was our pilot.  He did an excellent job in providing info on the type of plane we would fly in and in pointing out the different areas including the Island in the Sky, the Maze, the Needles, the Green river,  various arches, etc.   Just a great experience!   We highly recommend!

Great experience! Our pilot, Craig, was friendly, knowledgeable, and put us all at ease. He was great with my kids, ages 2, 5, and 7, which means the world to any parent. We all learned a great deal about the fascinating history and geology of the area. This is definitely the best way to see Canyonlands. We were able to see The Maze, which we never would have been able to do otherwise given its remoteness and inaccessibility. It was incredible! Highly recommend!

WOW!! What an incredible experience, I’ve been to Moab once before, Jeeping and dirt bike riding and this is an absolute MUST DO! Our pilot Tracy was fantastic, very thorough safety chat before the flight. He gave us seating options as well which was great. He was very informative and gave us plenty of back story about all the sights that we flew over. The hikes and trails are great but seeing it from the air really takes the cake. Definitely recommend!
Way cool to get a totally different perspective on the parks! A must do when in Moab! Tracy was a very knowledgeable pilot / guide.

I feel sorry for people who don’t see the Moab area from the air.  It is amazing how different the canyons look from above.  Our Redtail Air Adventures pilot (Dan) did an exceptional job of telling us what we were seeing and gave us an amazing tour.  My grandson and I really enjoyed the flight.

Great trip with Redtail Adventures and great way to see both Arches and Canyonlands, which we had seen from the ground earlier in the week.   Provided a really cool perspective of what we had seen  and allowed us to see parts of the parks and a number of arches we had not or could not have seen from the ground (especially in Canyonlands).  Our pilot Tracy was fantastic - professional, friendly, and highly informative throughout the whole flight - showing us the many sites, explaining the geology, and sharing the history of the parks and the region.

A friend and I took the Canyonlands and Arches tour and it was so worth it! We got amazing views and fabulous information about the area - both current and historical. The scenery was breathtaking. Also, ask for Craig to be your pilot - he was engaging, funny and super chill.

review_title: Hour plus aerial tour of Canyonlands & Arches
review_text:
This was money well spent.  Never would have experienced all of Canyonlands 3 areas.  Beautiful scenery and our pilot, Dan, was a great tour guide.  Definitely recommend!

Jim Simpson

The Kodak Quest was quiet and comfortable. Josh, the pilot, was professional and interesting with a sense of humor. The aerial views of the 4 Canyonland areas helped us choose our hikes for the rest of our trip. We were so glad we chose this trip.

On 5th September, a sunny, blue sky morning, we took this flight as an optional trip on our Riviera holiday. Everything about it was excellent. Derek, our pilot in the 4-seater plane was helpful, friendly, professional and very informative with his running commentary. Our headsets were 2-way, so we were able to ask questions as we were flying over the amazing labyrinth of red, white & pink canyons spread out below us. Stunning scenery from start to finish and a most memorable experience. Can recommend.

We went on this flight as an optional Riviera trip. It was amazing and I would recommend it to everyone. We were on a small 4 seater aircraft. Our pilot was James who was very sympathetic towards nervous passengers and explained everything. We were in touch with each other during the whole trip. He was very friendly and informative about Canyonlands and the views were unsurpassable. A truly unforgettable experience.

Wow, where do I begin. Last week for Valentine’s Day I surprised my girlfriend with Miami Seaplane Island Adventure Tour to Islamorada and what an incredible experience! Tony, is a true gentleman and went above and beyond to help make this trip something my girlfriend will never forget (and myself). We’ve done a lot of cool stuff all over the world but this was one of the absolute coolest adventures we’ve been on. Starting off by seeing our neighborhood up close from an aerial view, then seeing the crystal blue waters on our way through the keys, to landing right up to the restaurant we had lunch at. Lunch was excellent, plenty of options and fresh seafood with live music! Tony’s flying was smooth and controlled, we felt safe and calm the entire time. We explored the island for a couple of hours before we got back on the plane to head home to Miami. Seeing our skyline again around sunset was also very special for us. Tony is sharp and I feel like I’ve made a new friend. I’m excited to plan another adventure very soon.
The most memorable experience of my life. And I’ve saw a lot! The perspective you get from the air is remarkable. We saw Sharks, Dolphins, Sea Turtles… incredible.

We can’t say enough about Miami Seaplane.  It was wonderful from start to finish. We felt safe and more than that our pilot Tony and boat captain Yanni were both delightful. They were incredibly sweet with our young children as well. We would definitely do this again and it was a memorable adventure !!

review_text:
My husband and I did the Key West excursion with pilot Adrian at the helm.  It was fantastic!  Adrian was incredibly knowledgeable about the history and ecosystem of the Keys and an excellent pilot, too.  He seemed to have a deep connection to the area and it made the trip especially memorable.  We want to return and fly to another destination soon.  We will recommend this to all our friends far and wide.  Many thanks.

Christine and John Gordon

WOW. Simply amazing. Our pilot’s enthusiasm was like a kid at Christmas. His knowledge of the history and current issues of the Keys was unlimited. We did the trip to Islamorado and wanted to do it again as soon as it ended. We were in expert hands with the local pilot with over 25 years of experience. His narrative was mesmerizing and gave us a whole new appreciation for the beauty of the area and how important it is to preserve it. Thanks for a day we will never forget!

review_title: Great Waterplane Flight to the Florida Keys
review_text: Great flight over the Florida Keys with stopover and lunch on 'Loreley' Island. The trip starts and ends in Miami, a short motorboat ride through Miami Harbour to and from the seaplane is included. Overall a great experience and highly recommended!

I LOVED Miami Seaplanes! They took us down from miami all the way to key west, with a bit of snorkeling thrown in. They were super professional, sweet, fun, and it was gorgeous! It's the only reasonable way to get down to the keys; I wouldn't travel any other way! From the sky you could see sharks, dolphins, rays and more, and it was an experience I'll never forget!

If you think this looks fun at all you should definitely book it!! It was an absolute blast!! You can see everything from miles. Tony is a well experienced pilot who got his license in the 1970s. He was a joy to talk to while we were flying to the lunch. My wife loved it as well. Thanks for the memories for our 20 year anniversary!

review_title: Birthday surprise flight for a friend.
review_text: Our wives put this awesome day- trip adventure together and I feel compelled to write an inspirational review of our experience. DO IT, Book the flight!!! The owner Tony and his Son Adriel, are incredibly talented, SAFE, and  passionate about flying and bringing this experience to you. They were consummate professional Pilots. Water flying is something everyone should experience. Four of us booked 2 planes, Cessna 172’s on floats. The father son team flew us to key west where we lunched at louie’s backyard, and then walked duval st. Before  returning to Miami at sunset. What a day! What an adventure! What a great experience and memory we have forever... like I said.... Do it!! Joe from Jupiter Florida told ya so.. say hello to Tony and Adriel for me.👍👍
Wonderful trip with a top pilot. He explained everything in detail and we had a fantastic experience. Top.
Great experience, pilot was very Knowledgeable acting as a tour guide as well as pilot. Will use again when in Miami as probably the best way to see the islands.

Amazing trip to Key West with Miami Seaplane Tours.  The flight was fabulous and we saw lots of marine life on the way including sea turtles, sharks, manta ray, stingrays and whales.  Key West was busy but still felt relaxed and friendly.  Tony, our pilot, was so knowledgeable and informative that the whole day was a complete success.  Tony even circled so we could see some manatees which made our day!  I know the price is on the expensive side (especially for just a couple) but so worth it.  Don’t hesitate to book - you will have a once in a lifetime experience!

review_title: Don’t skip because of the price!!
review_text: This is one of the most fun things that my husband and I have ever done. Our pilot Tony was wonderful. He pointed out everything to us, had lots of history to share, answered all of our questions. Our lunch was good, but you are not “paying”for the lunch. Yes it is included, but it is just a normal restaurant in the Keys. The snapper was wonderful. Take this trip, it was super fun!

Great adventure, magnificent views, super-friendly crew :-) I highly recommend it. Maybe the only, slight disadvantage is limited time in Key West... We arrived at 12:45 and had to leave at 4:30. Worth every penny!

review_title: Sea plane visit to Key West
review_text: This was a great experience,our pilot Adriele was fantastic, friendly and provided excellent commentary for our trip. The dining experience could be improved but that wasn't the key to the trip.  Would highly recommend this trip, yes it is costly but you wouldn't see what we have seen by driving and or a boat charter.

Stunning !!! Best way to experience Denali !!! The staffs were so friendly and accommodating. We had a wonderful pilot. He was funny, friendly and very knowledgeable. At that height, if you don't have confidence on the pilot - you lose it..LOL. The landing experience was out of the world and we were given sufficient time to experience the vastness of it. If you can afford it and have time, please don't miss it. They have a wonderful team and tours.

We were recommended of the place on the day of the tour, and decided to give it a shot. We get clear sky which gives us extremely beautiful view!! So stunning that it even looks fake or those from magazines. I do carry a professional camera and I was able to get some really amazing pictures. I had some motion sickness but I managed to pull through without feeling too ill afterward. The pilot was really experienced and I felt safe for the whole time. He also gives us some brief introductions of what we are seeing. Overall, incredible experience and amazing for how much we could see in an hour. It is pricey, but honestly given how small the plane is (and we even get our private tour for how empty the winter season is), that is totally understandable. Would definitely recommended!

This is my second time to be here. I did not fly this time but have in the past.  Two of our group flew and was awestruck by the beauty of Denali.  It was a great experience for them.  I was amazed by its beauty when I flew. The pilot was Dorothy . She was very personable and informative.  Definitely a do again.  Two of us stayed in the office building and Mandi was very friendly and nice. We enjoyed the fire and refreshments while we waited

Amazing trip, facilities 1st class, super organized and professional. Very nice facility. This is not a fly by night company (pun intended).  Merchandise at facility reasonable priced. I can’t say enough positive things about operations and excursion,

Very customer friendly.  Support staff when checking in very helpful.  Pilot did a great job answering any and all questions.  Would definitely fly with with them again and wholeheartedly recommend them.

It was the best decision to take up this tour with them . Very experienced crew and very thorough planning for the flight keeping weather in mind and everyone’s safety . The pilot made sure we get the best views and pictures .

The flight over the Alaskan range was amazing!  We had booked the glacier landing experience, but weather did not permit it.  We knew that and appreciated the attention to safety.  It was still a great experience!  Excellent pilot, great planes, and the onboard narrative was good.  Would book it again, no question!
The only way to truly see Denali. Best overall glacier viewing and photo ops. Weather can be a factor but flight was amazing and pilot very knowledgeable.

Must do!!! Jack was our pilot and he was amazing! We flew up and over the top of Denali! We were amazed by the mountain and scenery. Jack also did an amazing job landing on a glacier in Denali. Definitely book your flight with K2Aviation! You will NOT regret it!

The most amazing thing I have ever done 
The pilot was very informative 
Everything was amazing the whole flight take off to a flawless landing
Absolutely beautiful views. Was originally to do a glacier landing but weather was not permitting. Our pilot, Josh, was awesome…. And looked a bit like Tom Cruise:)

We had an amazing Denali experience with Matt as our wonderful pilot!  Staff at the facility were very helpful and friendly making sure we knew what to do prior to boarding aircraft.  Once we were assembled, Matt discussed safety measures and worked to make sure all 5 guests were comfortable.  It’s a small plane and took a couple of folks a bit of maneuvering to get in and out of the plane.  We flew for a little over an hour and were dazzled by the views and Matt’s excellent communication and skills.    We opted not to take the glacier landing tour and didn’t regret our decision as Matt went out of his way to point out interesting facts.  Highly recommend!

It was a once in a life time awesome surreal experience. Flying through the fog and clouds over glaciers!
 Only regret is that due to inclement weather we could not experience the glacier landing.
We did the tour on 19 August 2024 at 6 pm. Our pilot ( forgot the name) was very knowledgeable and answered all the questions we asked. She described the locati9ns she was flying over in detail.
This is a must to do activity in Denali National Park.

review_title: A wow trip to the glaciers.
review_text: We booked this flight as soon as we arrived in Talkeetna as our excursions on the ship were cancelled.  What a wonderful surprise.  Riley was our pilot and we landed on the glacier and took photos for at least 20 minutes.  The flight and landing were amazing and surreal ! If you get a chance to go you should do it!

review_title: Land on the glacier- amazing Petspective
review_text: We were lucky to have a clear and sunny day. That said the trip was amazing from the fantastic views coming and going to landing on the glacier and even throwing a few snowballs. Amazing the scale huge mountains are and how little you are on them.  Our guide was interesting and fun and I would recommend it to anyone.
Fantastic way to get true perspective of Denali !  Our pilot David was superb,  and a wealth of information. Highly recommend !

review_title: Gentle flight, lots of glacier information.
review_text: It was beautiful, couldn't see Denali but tried. The pilot was very knowledgeable about glaciers. Some of it was so technical I couldn't follow along but it was really neat. I get motion sickness and I did not feel unwell on the flight.  It was about 1.5 hours from wheels up to wheels down.

We were fortunate to have fantastic weather and the views were stunning.  The landing on the glacier was a one in a lifetime experience and I highly recommend the experience.  Our pilot Doug was very knowledgeable and  our flight was incredibly smooth.
Very experienced pilot who also shared information with us. Gorgeous views and great experience landing on the glacier!

Wow! There aren’t words for the views you get of Denali on this flight We were blessed to have a perfectly clear day so we had unbelievable views. Well worth your time and money.  Pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and concerned with the safety of the plane. We actually had to wait about 30 minutes to leave while he had maintenance checking a part on the plane. I appreciate all safety precautions . Definitely recommend!

What a fantastic ride with Riley. 
I am afraid of heights, get motion sickness and claustrophobic.
So why do it? My granddaughter said I need to face my fears.
I am SO glad I did.
The flight was smooth and absolutely breathtaking!
We were the 1st group of the day to be able to see the peak of Denali.
I am so pleased I did this!

review_title: Breathtaking spectacular overview of the Denali mountain range from Talkeetna
review_text: The K2 aviation experience was amazing. The flight was smooth, flying close to all the beautiful mountain scenery on an absolutely clear day. Our pilot was so informative, friendly and full of information about the area, the mountain climbing and the glacier landings as well as the scenery. We could have imagined a better experience and highly recommended to everyone.

The experience was amazing. It was a beautiful day so we got some great shots. The only thing that disappointed me was since it was called Denali experience that we would spend a few minutes near Denali but we didn’t. The pilot mentioned just a couple of times that “there’s Denali”.  I was sitting in the back of the plane so with the cloud cover, by the time the plane turned around, I wasn’t sure which one was Denali so I didn’t get any photos.

One of the top experiences we had while in Alaska. Wow, to see this amazing mountain and the glaciers from the air is breath taking. You just cannot experience the scale the beauty same way from the ground. Would highly recommend over any land tour. Our K2 pilot did a great job. It was a little cloudy the day we flew, but he was able to get us up to a clear area and it was beautiful. Flew so that we all had great views and pointed out the major and interesting features. We did not do a glacier landing, but if you're really interested in that they offer those flights. I'm happy we choose just the flightseeing; feel we had more time in the air and were able to see more of this amazing area.

review_title: Best add-on to a trip ever!!
review_text: This was an add on to a Viking cruise and it was the highlight of our pre cruise Denali excursion. We ended up being the only two on this flight. We had Mac in a 6 seater Cessna 185. Plenty of room👍😉. It was an hour and a half total flight and we spent about half of it circling Mt Denali on a very beautiful day. It couldn’t have been more perfect.
We didn’t get to go. It was canceled.   The did call. Offered options but being out of town we had time restrictions.  They are giving a full refund

This experience was phenomenal! The flight was very smooth in our Otter with wonderful pilot Sean. We had amazing views of Denali and the surrounding mountains - brought tears to my eyes! And the glacier landing is something we will never forget. The boys had a snowball fight on a glacier in the mountains of Denali! This is an unmissable experience. We can’t stop talking about it!

This was a great tour to see the mountains and land on a glacier. I was surprised that it was only about 10-15 degrees cooler than on the ground. It was a warm day so, it was about 60 degrees on the glacier. Some in our group were wearing shorts. We didn’t get to see Denali on the flight, it was fogged in. But many don’t see it. We saw it, other times. Would recommend!

Amazing unforgettable experience. Glacial landing is incredible and pilot is super capable and reliable. Would do this a million times. 
K2 has a long line checking in but were very helpful and rescheduled my flight for weather reasons a couple times. It does have a relatively small parking lot for RV so be mindful for parking there

review_title: Amazing pilot, flight, and glacier landing!
review_text: Wow! This is probably the coolest thing I’ve ever done. We had an amazing view of Denali itself and the other two big peaks, and flew in and around so many gorgeous mountain views. But the most amazing part was getting to land the plane on a glacier and get out and walk around. SO AMAZING! I cannot say enough good things about our pilot, Doug. He was so calm and professional, and so knowledgeable about all of the various peaks and glaciers we flew over. Felt incredibly safe on his aircraft. And the aircraft itself was incredibly smooth in the air. Cannot recommend this company and this trip highly enough!

This was by far our most amazing activity in Alaska for our family. Our pilot was very friendly and experienced and narrated our whole trip. We landed on a glacier and he took family pictures for us. This is an expensive activity but is so worth every dime we paid. Our check in was very easy and all flowed well.

This was a once-in-a-lifetime experience and was so amazing. It was a great way to see Alaska and the glaciers of Denali from the air. We took the flight that included the glacier landing and I could not recommend this trip any higher. It was an awesome experience. My husband and I took my parents who are in their 70s and our two children ages 11 and 8. The kids loved throwing snowballs made of glacier snow and ice! Our pilot, Doug, was great. He was super informative, funny, and super professional. If you're thinking of doing a flight, just do it. It is worth every penny!

This is a must do if you find yourself in Talkeetna.  K2 is a wonderful company and our pilot Shawn (not sure of spelling) was the best tour guide you could hope for.  You can’t really describe the views and experience, you just have to see it.

I was a bit terrified of flying in a little plane, and so close to mountains, but our pilot, Tully, was wonderful and the ride was smooth and spectacular.  We also got lucky as the weather was pretty perfect.

review_title: Fantastic finish to an amazing day in Talkeetna
review_text: K2 Aviation is the best.  Our family of 7 decided to spend a day in Talkeetna doing a number of other tours but partially because we wanted to do our flightseeing with K2 Aviation based on all of the fantastic reviews they have received.  They do not disappoint.  Our tour was amazing and the glacier landing is spectacular and I highly recommend it.  Our pilot was wonderful giving us all kinds of information and willing taking pictures of our group during the glacier landing.  I highly recommend taking a tour with K2 Aviation.  The sights and view are breathtaking and absolutely amazing.

review_title: This is an adventure not to miss.
review_text: Incredible views!!  Upgrade to glacier landing was well worth it.  Pilot was very skilled and knew all the mountains. Highly recommend this trip.

The entire experience was and will be unforgettable 
Josh was outstanding in his knowledge. Friendly and respectful 
Wonderful time

What an amazing experience!! We were referred to this company by friends and we weren't disappointed. They were very professional and friendly. We had the opportunity to fly around Denali and see all three peaks. We then landed on the glacier for a surreal experience--exhilarating! Doug, our pilot, kept us very informed and helped us feel completely safe. If in doubt, just do it! No regrets!

review_title: If you splurge on one thing do this!
review_text: We were so blessed with beautiful weather for this amazing experience! What a great way to end our Alaska 2 week adventure in Talkeetna. We did the glacier landing which was great. Our Pilot Chad was super! We did the 6:30 pm tour which was the last of the day and great light at that time and the last of the day so no rush for the pilot to get back! So, if you are hesitating on the time to choose, it can be good any time! I thought maybe the weather would be worse later in the day, but wasn’t necessarily the case. Tip- you can walk there from town. Everyone gets a window seat by the way!

I had an amazing birthday.  I got to land on a Glacier.. that's wild!! My pilot Riley was amazing and friendly; super helpful and even flew my over the property at MPL, where I work. I'd also add that he very attractive. So having a sexy guide on my bday has habds down been the best thus far.!! THANKS RILEY!!!
Pilot Dave was exceptional in his flight skills, knowledge of the area and overall experience! The scenery and glacier landing was phenomenal!

Can’t rave enough about this organization.
From start to finish, top notch crew.
To Greg who was our pick up/drop off guide - Thank you
Our Pilot Doug - you are an amazing pilot/tour guide. 
So worth every penny for this experience.
You guys ROCK!

K2 Aviation Pilot Chad Smith and his De Havilland DHC-2 Turbo Beaver delivered us an incredible aerial tour within one of Alaska's gems: Denali National Park. Our glacier landing was a once in a lifetime level experience. Incredible, awesome, wicked crazy good... insert your exceptional adjective here. This tour was absolutely and unquestionably worth its cost. We were very blessed to be able to take it and have Mr. Smith as our pilot. Thank you again for the unforgettable and safe flight and landing(s). The very best to you and K2 Aviation.

By far the best experience!!! Jack is a great pilot and we really enjoyed his flight. The glacier landing was fascinating, and the views were breathtaking. If you are wondering if this tour is worth the money, it absolutely is!!  They also provide sunglasses and glacier boots that fit over your shoes.

Our flight around Denali, including glacier landing, with K2 Aviation was amazing, and we would highly recommend them for anyone looking for a Denali flight tour.

Our pilot, Doug, was fantastic as he explained what we were seeing during the entire flight. He emphasized our safety throughout the experience.

An amazing experience flying through the mountains, getting to see the glaciers up close. The plane just had 6 passengers and the pilot who was very informative. The flight was very smooth-lasted just over an hour. Able to walk into Talkeetna afterwards and explore.

What a once-in-a-lifetime experience!  Dave, our pilot, was very friendly and knowledgeable and did a great job flying the plane and landing on a glacier. The views from the plane were phenomenal and the glacier landing was so cool!! We even got to see a little of Denali peeking through the clouds!  I would highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Put this on your bucket list
review_text: This was the once-in-a-lifetime trip for my wife and son to see Mt. McKinley/Denali and we had an AWESOME time.  The pilot, Pat A., had over 17,000 flight hours and made sure we were well aware of what to expect and what maneuvers were ahead.  He was also well-read in the geology of Denali Park and the glacial formations.  The weather was clear and calm (one day out of 366) and we were able to get close to the mountain face.  To top it off, K2 gave me a NICE military discount.  Thanks for an unforgettable experience!

What an awesome adventure! This was one of the best experiences that we have ever had! The views of Denali were spectacular! The pilot, Dorothy did a great job flying and narrating! This is a MUST DO adventure in Alaska!
Breathtaking views that you wouldn't get to see any other way.   K2 aviation staff are very friendly and professional and very safety minded.

review_title: Just amazing. There flights and service are outstanding.
review_text:
These guys were amazing.
From the customer service to the actual tour, these guys just had it going on.
As the 1st day in Talkeetna was overcast and snowing, we rebooked our flight to our last day in Talkeetna. The team were very helpful in this.
As we had finished a dog mushing tour on our second day, the weather was superb and you could see the 3 mountains from town.
Luckily for us, we walked to airport and asked if we could get on the flight from our rebooked ticket the next day and they managed to get us on the flight that day. The team at the airport base were super helpful in this.
The flight was amazing. We were lucky enough to see all three mountains in the one flight and the scenery was spectacular. Its hard to put into words. The only issue we had was another companies plane was on the glacier runway and we couldn't land. Our pilot Jack tried to wait a few minutes and took a quick lap around the area to come back and see if we could get down but it wasn't safe so we couldn't land and then we flew back to base. When talking to the team at the airport, we said we had an amazing experience and a shame we missed the landing. You don't have to pay for that part as well if you didn't get it. As we were buying some merchandise from the shop, the staff came back to us and asked us if we wanted to jump on the next flight, for free, and only pay for the landing if we got it. We jumped at the chance. We got the same pilot Jack again for our next flight. He was excellent and explained and answers for questions when asked over the radio. Luckily, we got a glacier landing on this flight. 
It was an amazing experience and well worth the money. Luckily for us we got two flights for the price of the one.
I cant thank the team at K2 aviation for the help they gave us. There customer service was amazing, just like the service they provide.
I would thoroughly recommend K2 aviation for a Denali flight experience. Its a must do when in Talkeetna
I highly recommend seeing Denali and it was also awesome to see it so up close! I highly recommend this experience and K2 Aviation knows what they are doing.
Oh wow!!! Take this tour! Everything was perfect. Our pilot, Jack, was so personable and knowledgeable. The views are magnificent and unforgettable. Thanks for a perfect bucket-list experience!

Amazing experience, one of the best of our 40-day Alaskan vacation. Just spend the money and enjoy an unforgettable experience. We landed on the Ruth glacier and ran around like kids for 10 minutes in the new fallen snow (we're in our 60's). Our pilot named Dorothy was excellent at flying her plane, and being a tour expert...she made us feel extremely safe. The clouds obscured our hoped-for view of Denali, but the views we saw of the landscape were spectacular. While a little costly, it was very much worth it.
Our trip was in May 2022. We had a blast. The pilot was knowledgeable and fun. My husband hates flying, especially small planes, but he'd do it again. We plan to book with K2 again.

review_title: Worth the price! Bucket list trip
review_text: There are no words for how stunning this flight tour was. Our party of three were the only ones on the plane with the pilot. He had been flying for 30-40 years and his father was a pilot, and we felt very safe. Flying over the glaciers was a beautiful experience. There were hundreds of little lakes in one area of the glaciers that were bright blue against the white snow. Due to the weather, we could not get too close to Mt. Denali, but we did not miss out.

If you do only one thing in AK, put this at the top of the list. QA once in a lifetime "bucket list" item for sure. The landing on Ruth's Glacier was fantastic. The de Havilland  Otter was awesome! Our pilot David, was top notch! I can't say enough good things about K-2!

review_title: This is a must do! Put it on the list!
review_text:
We had such an amazing time on our flight. We were worried we would regret not doing the glacier landing but we were able to enjoy all of the views and take tons of photos.  We were super fortunate that we had an amazing weather day but we also could not have asked for a better pilot and tour. 
Thank you for a great morning! This is a definite must when in Alaska!

It was the first trip to Alaska for my husband and me. We elected the option to fly over the three glaciers in order to get a close up look of the glaciers and surrounding mountains.  Patrick wash an excellent guide who made sure to make turns so that all passengers saw the views from all angles regardless of where you were seated.  He also provided several opportunities for close ups.  Highly recommend
