The flight and glacier were landing were amazing. We lucked out with the weather and the views were incredible. Don't miss it if you're going to Alaska!

We booked a small plane for just my wife and me. Our pilot, Will, couldn't have been more helpful, professional, or cooperative. It was a clear day, except around Denali, but it didn't matter because the sights were stunning. Will even dropped down so we could see a couple of Brown Bears. This was definitely a highlight of our time in Alaska. Talkeetna is a great spot to stay for Denali views, and the town itself is cute.

Here is the deal, I can write pages about everything you will see, and how majestic and spectacular the views are from the plane, the peaks and valleys, wonderful pilot and magical glacier landing and all the unforgettable moments, or, you can just take this tour and experience it yourself. It is absolutely worth every penny, one of the best purchases of my life no doubt. I will never forget this ride.

review_title: Worth every penny spent to do this!
review_text:
Seeing the peaks of the Alaska Range from the air is so much better than the ground! It gives you a much better perspective of how extensive the mountains and glaciers are.

Our pilot gave us very thorough safety instructions about the plane before boarding and explained where to find things that would be needed in case of an emergency. Then during the flight continued to tell us what he was doing so we would not be surprised by the planes actions. He also was pointing out things we could see on each side, whether it was plants, animals, rivers , glaciers or mountains. Everything has a name and he gave explanations on how the mountains were formed . Not only does the pilot do so much more to fly, than we do to drive, but has to have extensive geography, geology and history knowledge

review_title: What an amazing bucket list experience
review_text:
The team at K2 have only your safety and enjoyment in mind. We we’re cancelled from the previous day due to snowfall in the Denali park. We were offered the next available which was 830 the next day. 
There was a 50/50 chance of being able to land on the glacier. The pilot Dorothy was amazing and narrated our flight around the mountains and glaciers. 
The time had then come to land on the glacier. It was the most spectacular experience. The awe of standing on top of a mountain range with high peaks all around you was out of this world. Mt McKinley even peaked through the clouds while we were there. The snow was so deep up to our knees. The pilots did a great job landing and taking off, they are very skilled. I would recommend this company. Kept us informed every step of the way. 
Thank you K2 aviation

I understand why they couldn’t do the grand or flyer tours due to safety/weather concerns, but it’s still disappointing that we were unable to see rest of Denali.  The flight was still stunning, and the glacier landing a cool experience that I m glad we did.  Felt it was best to take the tour we could since we had weather cancellations before than gamble on trying to hold off for the one we wanted and risk not getting to go at all.
Took the first flight out at 8. Pilot (Riley?) was skilled and very accommodating. It’s cold up there, so layer. The bowl we landed in was stunning!

review_title: Amazing Experience, definitely worth it and a must do
review_text: Amazing experience. Very professional and coordinated. Flightseeing was amazing, we were able to see the peak of Denali. Felt safe the entire trip. Glacier landing was a great experience. Pilot was knowledgeable and was happy to answer all questions. Would highly recommend.

K2 Aviation was great. Appreciated transportation from our hotel. Had an excellent flight despite very overcast weather. Excellent explanation of what we were flying over and even got to see moose from the air. Husband got to sit next to the pilot which he really enjoyed.
Once in a lifetime experience I'll never forget! Staff was great, the views were even better. Highly recommend to anyone
Very informative. Pilot made sure all guests young and senior were properly accommodated. Nice historical perspective

We had booked the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour with the Glacier landing but because of bad weather we were offered a 1 hour flight to see the Tokositna Glacier and Ruth Glacier. Even with the cloudy weather the views of the glaciers were amazing. We had to re-book our tour a couple of times as there was bad weather of few days continuously but the people at K2 Aviation were extremely patient and helpful throughout. We will definitely be back to do the Denali Experience flight.

We took the Denali flyer with glacier landing tour and it was incredible!  We couldn't fly around Denali specifically (the weather changes by the minute) but we still flew around the mountains and over glaciers.  Landing on and walking around a glacier was beyond description!!  One of the highlights of our 2.5 week trip to Alaska.

Take a spectacular weather day, a seasoned pilot and state-of-the-art aircraft, and enjoy an incredible day flying around one of the most beautiful mountain ranges in the world.  Denali lived up to its reputation in every way.  Conditions permitted a landing on Ruth Glacier for a stroll in the nine-foot snowpack with all angles for photo opportunities.  K2 Aviation is tops all around.  Our knowledgeable pilot, Sean, gave us a smooth ride, detailed narration and even offered his services as photographer.  It was an adventure to treasure forever.

We did the flight with a glacier landing! It was awesome!!! This ended up being our favorite activity of our trip! The views of the mountains are wonderful from the air and landing on the glacier was great. We were able to get out of plane on the glacier , walk around and take pictures! Our pilot was great! Everyone at K2 were helpful and kind.  I would definitely recommend this while you are visiting Alaska!!!

Super smooth and very enjoyable!
Great pilot. Pilot was very informative as to all the landscape, rivers, mountains, towns. Etc

Book your flight well ahead and cross your fingers for good weather! The K2 staff was very upfront with us regarding the weather and offered to allow us to cancel or reschedule.  Denali viewing is historically fickle with all of the cloud cover.  The average viewing is 30% of visitors but, with this summer's extra rain and clouds, it's been more like 20%.  But go for it! We were part of that 20% and our pilot Josh flew us in patterns surrounding Denali that gave us multiple spectacular, breathtaking views. This was one of the best things we did during our two weeks in Alaska and we'd definitely do it again!

INCREDIBLE!!! We had booked the summit tour originally but it couldn't go because of clouds. They moved us (with our approval) to a Denali Flyer tour departing at the same time. It was probably one of the most amazing experiences of my life!! Truly breathtaking. Worth every single penny.

The entire tour was a great experience!  We had beautiful weather and fantastic views of Denali and surrounding mountains and glaciers. Our pilot Josh did a  great job narrating the wonderful sights and pointing out features of interest.  I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the beautiful sights of Alaska.  Thank you K2 Aviation for a phenomenal experience.

Beautifully efficient and satisfying organisation. 
Please be informed that the reliability of experiencing the glacier landing is not particularly strong; there is plenty of reliance on the weather at bay. 

Our pilot was advanced in his profession, and ensured that we were well informed of the history of the local environment. 
The views and atmosphere were remarkable- an excellent experience i would strongly recommend.

Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the history of the plane we were in as well as the great Alaskan frontier.  The pilot stayed engaged with us throughout the flight and passengers were able to talk amongst ourselves to share our experiences. The glacier Landing was breathtaking. We could not experience the glacier and majesty of Denali in any better way.

Nice lunch spot.   Hot dogs are very good and creative.   We had the Kraut Dog and Southern Dog, and both were excellent.    The eating area is congested and very basic, but the quality of the hot dogs makes it worth it.   The staff was very friendly and food was prepared quickly.

WE were blessed with open skies. I had no idea of the vastness of the area. We got very close to mountains, I thought I would be able to reach out and touch them. Great explanation of the glaciers and mountains by our pilot.  Landed on the Glacier. Epic experience.

Glacier landing tour was spectacular. Due to the weather, a landing was not an option. At the last minute, near the landing site, headquarters gave us the go ahead to land. Never seen anything like it.

What an incredible experience!  After 3 overcast days in Talkeetna we were not sure we were ever going to see Denali, but K2 fixed that!  On our final morning in Talkeetna it was, again, overcast with no mountain views. Once our flightsee emerged from the clouds it was a stunning visual display of the park and the mountain peak!  Our pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and gave us lots of great information about what we were seeing.  There is truly no better way to experience this amazing, vast park that via plane.  This was a highlight of our Alaska trip.  Highly recommended!!!

review_title: Great way to see Denali and surroundings
review_text: Excellent experience! (K2 Grand Tour, without glacier landing) The views were totally amazing + our pilot was skilled, knowledgeable, and provided just the right amount of narration/explanation during the flight. We were very lucky with particularly clear weather, but the terrain, and the altitudes at which you see it, are very varied, so I'd guess that it will be remarkable even in less-than-perfect conditions . The pilots have discretion about the exact route they fly, so they can take best advantage of whatever is happening on the day you fly. We recommend leaving an empty day the day after your scheduled flight, if that's possible, so that in the rare event that no flights can go out on your day, you can stay over and try again the next day. In any case, the train trip to Talkeetna is very pleasant and scenic, and the town itself is...cute. A highlight of our Alaska trip (tied with the Kenai fjords boat tour).

The trip was fantastic! Lots of beautiful views and pictures. This was one of my best and unforgettable experiences. We also have seen bear and a cub right on the glacier which was super rare but absolutely stunning. The color of the glacier was blue! Thank you K2 aviation for the amazing experience.

review_title: Favorite thing we did in Alaska
review_text: I went back and forth about doing this tour, both due to the cost and because I'm a slightly nervous flyer. Our original date was cancelled due to weather. I almost ended up taking the refund, but am so glad I rescheduled instead. This ended up being the favorite thing my family did in Alaska. We did the glacier landing, which was absolutely amazing. It also allowed us to actually see Denali, which we weren't able to do in Denali National Park (due to clouds). Our pilot has been flying since he was 6 (!) and I felt more comfortable as his passenger than on any commercial flight I have taken. (He's also a pretty good photographer. He offered to take pictures of our family on the glacier and I'm so glad to have some of all four of us). He let our 9 year old son sit in the co-pilot's seat, which I am sure my son will talk about nonstop for years. If booking this, I recommend building some flexibility into your schedule, in case of cancellations. We stayed in Talkeetna for two nights, so were able to easily move things around once our original flight was cancelled.

Had an awesome experience, can’t say enough about our pilot Jack who took care of us , explained all we were seeing and was able to safely land us on the glacier before the weather changed.  Highly recommend K2 for a Denali experience!
My husband and I did the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing tour.  It was definitely the highlight of our interior Alaska trip!  Our pilot was fantastic and the views were drop dead gorgeous!
We had an awesome time!  Full view of Denali!  Riley, our pilot did an amazing job.  We had a perfect landing on Ruth Glacier.  Thank you, K2 Aviation!  Highly recommend the trip with the landing.

We were not able to do a landing due to weather but had a fantastic trip to see several glaciers and the summit for just a short while. 
It was an amazing tour with a terrific pilot.
It was the highlight of our trip. Totally worth every penny spent. Everything was amazing. Views were spectacular the pilot was great
This is a "you gotta do it" tour if you are visiting Talkeetna.  Phil was our pilot and he was so chill and made us feel very comfortable. The entire trip was very smooth.

review_title: If you are on the fence, do it!
review_text: This was 100% worth every penny! Wow What a beautiful trip. Our pilot was informed, a great educator, and super helpful, too!

Totally worth the money. We are locals and did the trip with a glacier landing. Great customer service all around. Pilot did a great job pointing things out and giving local history. If you can do the glacier landing we highly recommend it.

review_title: Beautiful Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text: Such a beautiful and breath taking experience!  The flight was incredible and the Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier was such a thrilling event!

review_title: Denali can only be experienced up close…
review_text: I was skeptical about spending the money for the additional glacier landing, but the sites are just jaw dropping. There is no other way to fully understand the glaciers and magnificence of Denali.

The entire flight was spectacular! Stunning views in every direction. Our pilot, Todd, made us feel safe and he was excellent narrating about the sites we were seeing. We were provided headsets so we could communicate and ask questions. We were not sure what to expect and booked the 1 hour flight, but next time we will definitely do a longer flight or land on the glacier! Highly recommend K2 Aviation!

I have traveled much of the world, and the experience of flying past Denali and the other peaks, then landing on the glacier is one of the top five I have had in my life.  The "laid back" approach of the pilot inspired confidence and allowed us to truly enjoy every moment of the trip.  I would highly recommend this to anyone.  As a side note, it was a bit anticlimactic visiting the national park on the ground after the experience in the air!

review_title: Outstanding, up close views of Mt Denali
review_text: Amazing grand tour around Mt Denali and some of the surrounding area! Our pilot, Joe, was very professional from start to finish!! My wife and I highly recommend this company and tour.  They were in communication with us several times to confirm that our first reservation time could not fly due to weather and were sucessful getting us a second time that worked.  Be persistent if your first time doesn't work out do to weather.

I’m not sure I have the right words to describe how amazing this trip was! K2 has been in business for a long time and was highly recommended by my brother who has climbed Mt. Denali. Upon walking in we were greeted by friendly staff who helped check us in. The facilities were nice and clean. Next we met our amazing pilot Dave. We went over safety. You can tell how hard K2 works to take good care of their planes. There are not that many Otters so it’s a special treat to fly in one! We lucked out with near perfect weather conditions and seeing Mt. Denali so up close is exhilarating. I got to sit up front with Dave and he made our experience extra special by pointing out things about my brothers climb. We landed on a glacier which that alone was exhilarating. I have the most incredible pictures and video of Mt. Denali and the mountain range!!! Thanks K2 and Dave for helping us make amazing memories and celebrate our Honeymoon in Alaska!

K2 did a great job.  Very big operation but runs like a well-oiled machine.  We left on time, had a great trip, and saw amazing views.  I had to email them several times in advance and they always responded quickly and clearly.  The only thing I wanted was a bit more commentary as we flew but otherwise a perfect flight.  I highly recommend !!!

review_title: It's not expensive, for the value and the total cost of being here.
review_text:
Awesome in every way.  Courteous, competent, friendly, safety conscious and very informative pre, during and post trip.

Everything worked flawlessly.

They communicated clearly, factually.  Refunded when weather made part of the flight path unsafe.

This was the ABSOLUTE highlight of our trip to Alaska. Worth every penny! We had a perfect day (it was 80 degrees in Talkeetna. 65 degrees on the glacier) and the perfect pilot. Couldn't have had a better time. Once in a lifetime experience. You only live once. What are you waiting for?
Great experience. We got a pretty clear day and were able to land on the glacier. The views are phenomenal.
Dorothy, our pilot was amazing and did an amazing job flying us over the mountain. The visibility was good and we had a great view of moose tooth.

This was an absolute breathtaking experience. We were so fortunate to have a clear blue sky day. Saw Denali in all its glory. Our pilot was very kind and knowledgeable.  Once in a lifetime adventure.  Do not hesitate to take this tour. It was one of our highlights of our Alaskan trip

review_title: Spectacular views and very professional and knowledgeable pilot!
review_text: We were blessed with a break in the weather and blue skies. Unfortunately the haze in the high elevation did not allow for us to see Denali but otherwise the views were breathtaking!  Our pilot, Will, was exceptional. We felt safe and and he gave us so much information about what we were seeing!  We absolutely would recommend this excursion!

Landing on the glacier was probably the high point of the tour.  Being up in the air and looking down makes a person realize how small we all are in the vast expanse of the wilderness.  A very nice tour!

It was an absolutely spectacular experience!! The glacier landing was epic.Being on the glacier, surrounded by majestic mountains was so intensely profound. K2 Aviation is excellent. Booking the flight was easy and straightforward;I was even able to be picked up from my hotel and brought to the airport. Our pilot was very professional and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

review_title: No better way to recognize Denali summit expect climbing - PERFECT!
review_text: Weather forecast wasn´t so good, but finaly - excelent weather for such a amazing experince. So nice - to start from lowland and slowly fly closer and higher to Denali summit across great glaciers, around Denali´s daughter and wife....  Pilot, perfect boy in gumboots -)  ... was still exlpaining everything, joking and driving so calm, made some circles to both sides of plane can enjoy that monumental views - PERFECT! However very windy, almost silent landing with so smal plane.... and finaly pilot made nice pictures of group with plane after landing.
Fantastic flight - views of the glaciers were absolutely breathtaking. Our pilot was very informative and the flight was really smooth. Highly recommend

review_title: Flying to and around Denali and landing on a glacier
review_text: This trip was once in a lifetime! We had incredible views of Denali - the whole range, and landed on a glacier. Beautiful! Our pilot Jack was really great and shared a lot of info about what we were seeing. Just amazing trip!
Hands down the best experience in our two weeks in Alaska!  If you do nothing else, make sure you land on a glacier!  The views were amazing. This will be an experience that we will never forget!

review_title: Your experience will live rent free in your mind for a life time!
review_text: Holy COW!!  An experience that will leave you in constant wonder!  Other worldly, and awe inspiring. Landing on the glacier was truly incredible!  The views are something you’ll never forget!  Our Pilot, Chad, was perfection!!  I 1,000 percent recommend this experience!

review_title: Amazing Aerial View of the Glaciers
review_text: Although our longer tour had to be cancelled due to a low cloud ceiling, we still had an incredible flight.  We flew over several glaciers near Denali.  Our pilot was outstanding by giving us lots of information as we soared over the glaciers.  Highly recommend this experience!

Second year taking ng the flight around Denali and landing on the glacier.  This is a once in a life time experience.  If you can do it then go.  Great pilot.  Company helpful and friendly.  Will do this again

review_title: An experience we will never forget!
review_text: This experience far exceeded my expectations. We had an amazing pilot, Sean, who took us all over to see the Mountains and explain the areas we were seeing. The trip was smooth and we were able to spend about 30 minutes on the glacier with a perfect view of Denali. I highly recommend this activity for anyone.
AWESOME flight seeing trip around Denali! Our pilot was so knowledgeable and gave us us a smooth flight with fantastic views of the mountains and glaciers.

This was a special opportunity to see Denali up close and take in how massive it truly is and how small we are in the whole scheme of things. We were blessed with a beautiful blue sky day with lots of visibility. The Glacier landing is short but worth the extra money. Just to stand there and take in the scale and beauty of the glacier is amazing. Our pilot, Jeff Berstrand was excellent and narrated  what we were seeing and the history of the area. Highly recommend this excursion as a “must do” when in Alaska. 2 hour easy drive from Anchorage. The ladies at checkin were very friendly and helpful too.

review_title: See Denali from the air if you're short on time!
review_text: We have a summer home in Alaska in the Mat-Su valley, and making the drive to Denali is a long trip. This Denali flight seeing tour out of Talkeetna is a good way to see Denali without making the long drive! I would highly recommend this. It was about 2 hours long, beautiful, breathtaking views, good commentary. A must do if you're in Talkeetna!

We had Dorothy for our pilot and it was amazing!!!  I am a student pilot and she let me sit next to her.  I was able to make an ice/snow ball that sparkled in the sunlight.  We had a great weather day for it as well.  I am more motivated now than I ever was to continue to get my license.  Thanks for the experience!!!

All very well-organised and good to be picked up from our accommodation... and dropped back after which we weren't expecting. Staff all very friendly and helpful. Amazing sights and landing on the glacier was brilliant. A highlight of our holiday.

This tour was the highlight of our 9 day trip to Alaska. Our group ranged in age from 7 years old to 72 years of age and it fit all of us perfectly.  Our pilot, Dave, was exceptional.  He shared so much information with us and was very kind and friendly . Don't miss this awesome experience!

review_title: K2 Glacier Tour - Best of the Best!!!
review_text: We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Our pilot Phil was outstanding. The view from the glacier was absolutely breathtaking. This was hands down the highlight of our vacation. Highly recommend.

Fabulous trip! I did the Denali Grand flight and our pilot, Joe, was great. He is also a photographer so was able to put us in position to get some great shots. He was very knowledgeable about the area and pointed out so many things to us. This was the best part of my trip to Talkeetna. Many thumbs up! 
👍👍👍

review_title: Best excursion we did in Alaska!
review_text: This was one of the best things we did in Alaska on our two week vacation! We did the Denali Flyer with Glacier Landing. Although our original flight was cancelled due to weather we were able to reschedule. It was incredible! The views from the air were stunning and the flight was so smooth. Landing on the glacier was like landing on the moon! It was other-worldly. We loved every minute of this! Would definitely do it again!

review_title: Last minute booking.. greatest decision ever!
review_text: My mother and I decided to take this tour day if very last minute with weather being so perfect. We called around noon for a 4 o’clock tour. We were booked and ready to fly! It was the most amazing and beautiful experience. Would highly recommend! Once in a lifetime experience for sure! Joe was our tour guid and pilot. He took us so low towards the glacier for breath taking views!
The pilot was very knowledgeable. It was an excellent experience that I would highly recommend. The scenery was amazing!

This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska. The tour was so impressive and the glacier landing was awesome. The pilot was really nice and knowledgeable. And all the staff at K2 was super friendly. I highly recommend this experience.

This was by far our most enjoyable event in Alaska.  The flight was incredible.  The views were amazing.  The pilot was outstanding.  Landing on the glacier was something I will never forget.  I sat where a copilot would sit.  I believe I had the best views.  Raise your hand if they ask if you would like to sit next to the pilot!

The Denali grand tour with glacier landing was truly spectacular! Granted, we had a rare completely clear day, but even with partial clouds, it would be beautiful almost beyond description. Going though mountain passes and landing on the Ruth glacier were wonderful experiences.
Incredible! Pilot was great and let my daughter sit right seat. Felt like safety is their top priority. Such a great experience
Just one word…awesome.  Great pilot. Great staff.  Felt safe and in great hands so enjoying the magnificence was ez.

The tour was amazing! We had a clear day and the views from the plane were stunning. Definitely recommend the glacier landing. Such a cool experience landing on a glacier. Riley was our pilot. He was great and felt safe the whole time. Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Thrilling!  I want to do it again!
review_text: This flight was easily one of the most thrilling experiences of my life!  Dorothy was our pilot, and she did a great job of explaining and narrating all we were seeing. And the flight was much smoother than I expected it to be.  I did not realize ahead of time how close we were going to land to Denali. We were extremely fortunate to have a very clear day, and the sights took my breath away!  I highly recommend this tour!  It seems a bit expensive at first but you will long long remember this experience, so it is well worth the money.

review_title: Top experience in Denali/ Talkeetna area
review_text:
Our pilot was Pat. He did a great job of orienting us to landscape and geologic features that we would see. He also carefully coved safety features.  
Of course, the scenery was amazing

review_title: A great, clear day for flying and siteseeing.
review_text: Walking on a Glacier, and taking many pictures. Pilot and plane were excellent at flying around the sky high mountains with great ease.
Excellent pilot and a nice operation. The flight was beautifully tailored to our photographer's needs and all around, it was a wonderful experience.

We did the flight seeing with a glacier landing. It was so worth the money. I can’t say enough good things about the whole experience. They got you checked in quickly and there wasn’t really a lot of standing around. The views while flying were second to none. The glacier landing was unreal. Our pilot Dorothy was amazing. Smooth flight and landing as well as being very knowledgeable about everything we were looking at. I cannot recommend this tour enough. I will say we had a pretty good weather day.

This was amazing!  It felt like our wing tips were just a breath away from the mountain and yet, no fear!  Our pilot was great!  The landing on the glacier was so smooth!  A bucket list trip for sure. Flying between and around all the mountains was a view like no other!

My husband and I booked this experience as part of our honeymoon. I can't adequately describe this experience because words like amazing or breathtaking don't do it justice. If you decide to try a flightseeing tour, be sure to choose the one with the glacier landing.  It is important to note that if conditions aren't right, your pilot will not land and you will be refunded the difference. We were lucky enough to land, and it was indescribable! I had a good chuckle after sharing the pics we took, because photos will never capture the reality of the moment. Our pilot, I believe his name was Ryan, was knowledgeable about the area and took great pride in his plane. It was about an hour and a half all told, with 15-20 minutes on the glacier.  Well worth every penny.
This tour has to be one of the most beautiful things I’ve ever seen! Our pilot was super welcoming, passionate, and knowledgeable about the area. The flight was smooth as well.

This tour was AMAZING! We caught a clear day so the views were phenomenal. There were 3 people in our group so we went up in one of the smaller planes and it was so cool. Our pilot was great and I felt like he had the perfect balance of sharing info on the mountains and also just letting us sit and take in the sights. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone.

My wife and I did this today and had the most magical experience. My wife was very nervous, but our pilot, Jack, who also sevred as Stewardess, photgrapher, tour guide, and all the rest was unbelievable. He went above and beyond, and on top of it all he was funny and had a great personality. Would highly recommend this!

review_title: Best trip you can do for  yourself!!
review_text: Our pilot Dorothy was fantastic.  This is a life changing experience. I lived in Alaska for 50 years and have hunted and fished all over.  This trip is still the most Awe Inspiring thing i have ever done!!  Well done!!!!!  And Thanks again Dorothy!!

review_title: Best adventure we had in Alaska!
review_text: Amazing! Life-changing! We had to reschedule due to bad weather, but the staff was incredibly helpful and responsive as we navigated around the weather and our travel schedule. They are fabulous! And the flight with Jack was everything we could have possibly asked for and more! The weather broke and we were able to see Denali in her full glory and Jack made sure every seat on the plane had the opportunity to see her fully and take photos. Landing on the glacier was breathtaking and smooth as silk. (Glad we had those waterproof boots that were provided!) The whole experience from start to finish was above and beyond any expectations we had. And to top it off, Jack was willing after our flight to show us the path we took on the topo map in the office.  Loved it all! Don’t miss this experience!

The views were amazing!! Our pilot, Josh, was super nice, and pointed out things of interest, and did his very best to give us bang for our buck!!  We were able to catch a peak at the top of Denali, thru a break in the clouds.  The glaciers, and mountains are so majestic, it is hard to have our pictures translate it.  Excellent experience.  Highly recommend!!

This was one of lifetime plane trip realy memorable. I simply envy pilots they get to do this and get paid for it. Just seeing the wonderful mountain range up close is breathtaking and to walk upon one of glaciers is simply cherry on top.

review_title: Great Flight around Denali Mountain, AK
review_text: This was the greatest trip through the Denali Mountain that felt like you could touch it! I would recommend to take this flying trip from Talkeetna!

Tom, our pilot, did an excellent job navigating so riders on both sides of the plane could see everything.  He answered every question and shared nuggets of the area that he learned through experience.  I have Vertigo and took a Dramamine beforehand and didn’t feel a thing.  Super fun adventure and all 4 of us loved it!

Wow!  Wow!  Wow!  This absolutely made my trip to Alaska complete.  The views and experience were humbly breathtaking.  

Jack, the pilot, was professional and easy going.  The plane setup was excellent.  Mt. Denali and the surrounding area from the air was SPECTACULAR!  Landing on a glacier was the cherry on top!

Don't hesitate.  If you're here, do it!
Experience you can’t miss if you are here at Alaska. Great pilot and breathtaking views of Mt Denali and other peaks. Glacier landing and experience the fresh snow are to be remembered for long time

This was well worth the money spent. Our pilot Patrick was so informative. The sites were Ah-mazing!!!  We only did the hour flight. Most people were doing the glacier walk. But the flight was perfect for me. A little advice. Take videos instead of pictures. The videos my husband took actually seemed to show the mountains better than my photos.

This was a once in a lifetime experience. We flew in their single Otter single engine plane up close to Denali. Unfortunately the top of the mountain was covered in clouds. We did have an excellent view of the Ruth Glacier on the flight. We had a very competent and informative pilot - Dorothy. We left on time and returned an hour later. K2 picked us up at our hotel and drove us back after the flight. Based on my experience I strongly recommend K2 and their flight/sightseeing servjce.

review_title: Don't hesitate, do this.  this is not a rehearsal, no do overs in life.
review_text: Don't miss this trip.  It's one of best flights we've ever been on.  Being up there among the peaks and glaciers with a birds eye view is outstanding.  The people who run this operation are great.  I decided you get better pictures from the second seat rather than the front.  Also, note, a similar trip is much more expensive near Denali, they have to fly twice as far.

review_title: Incredible flight tour with glacier landing!
review_text: K2 Aviation Flight tour “Denali Experience with Glacier Landing” first flew around Denali which was magnificent…then the glacier landing was over the top!!!   We were Blessed with having clear day and was able to see incredibly beautiful Denali in all her glory!!!  We landed at the top of the glacier at Base Camp, which is where they take those folks who are climbing the mountain!  It was definitely one of the major highlights of our trip to Alaska!!!  Sunny and no wind, so was not very cold while on the glacier, which surprised us!  The pilot was very skilled and knowledgeable, as well as, personable.  I highly recommend this trip!  You will not be disappointed!

Excellent customer service. We booked a Denali flight-seeing trip with a glacier landing. When we arrived, K2 provided us with a weather update & stated that due to fog, the glacier landing was cancelled for the day. Because we had specifically booked this tour, they allowed us to cancel with no penalty. So technically - we didn't take any tour but we really appreciated being able to cancel.
Jack was our amazing pilot and we enjoyed riding the Otter to a successful glacier landing. He was professional and helpful and made the trip special. Whatever you do, make this trip a reality.

My husband Paul, took this trip today. He LOVED it! He has had this on his bucket list forever and it was everything that he had hoped for and more! The pilot was Jack and he was amazing! I highly recommend this company!

The check in experience was easy.  The pilot was very professional and knowledgeable.  He narrated the trip constantly.  We lucked out and had an amazingly clear day for our tour and the views were spectacular.  Lifetime memories.
Our pilot was so knowledgeable.  I was nervous about being in a small plane, but take off and landing were smooth.  The views were amazing.

Unbelievable, once in a lifetime experience!! K2 was an excellent company to fly with. They were safe, professional, and friendly from the moment we booked. Weather can often change plans…we originally booked the summit tour but weather on the mountain had a different idea. K2 communicated with us the whole time and still made sure we got the best experience possible. Highly recommend paying extra for the glacier landing. It’s so amazing! Jack is a great pilot.

We were originally scheduled for the glacier landing but with the bad weather in the area they cancelled the glacier landing but we went on the hour flightseeing tour.  It was beautiful.  I am glad we did not cancel the entire adventure.  It was so nice seeing things from a different view.  Thank you to all for keeping us up to date on the weather, giving us the final say whether we wanted to cancel the entire tour are just part, I am so happy we chose to go through with just the flight.  
Thanks again,
Diane Cox

Our pilot, Josh, was very friendly, informative and cute! He took us for a flight over Denali and the weather was sunny and clear.  We all really enjoyed this flight and would highly recommend this company. Thanks Josh!

review_title: No Denali due to weather; Knik was great
review_text:
We had such a great experience with K2 Aviation. We had initially signed up for the Denali glacier landing tour, but it was cancelled due to bad weather. The staff recommended the Knik Glacier trip, which had availability for later that same afternoon. We were bummed about missing the Denali flight, but figured we'd still do the flight that was available, and we are so glad we did!

The 1 hour and 45-minute flight was very enjoyable.  Phil was an amazing pilot and guide. We even got to do a landing near the glacier, which was a very pleasant surprise! Highly recommend booking with K2 Aviation.

We arrived 45 minutes early and at this time we were told the flight we paid and signed for was unable to go cause of weather, however, we could go on a shorter flight or would refund money. We were in Alaska a limited time, so we choose the short flight they offered. This flight was not worth the trip. Really didn't see much. Family was disappointed. And Pilot spoke most time with a family from Alaska about careers. I will say the flight was safe and smooth.

We had an incredible experience  with K-2 Aviation!   Our pilot, Phil, made us feel extremely safe and was a superior pilot!  The views of the mountains were spectacular and the landing on Ruth Glacier was totally amazing!   This was the best part of our trip to Alaska (group of 5) for all us.  It is definitely worth the price.   I would do it all over again!!!

This was the bucket list item we didn’t even know we had. Amazing flight and glacier landing. Our pilot offered great narration.  Loved that it was the small plane and just my husband, son and I with the pilot.  We had a beautiful, clear and sunny day. The views were breathtaking and the time on the glacier was definitely a special time we will never forget. The K2 operation is very well organized and you could be confident in the experience of their pilots and crew. If you can only do one excursion in Alaska, we would recommend you make it this one.

review_title: Up close and personal with a glacier
review_text: Phil was our pilot and he was fabulous. He was very knowledgeable about Denali and flying in general. He let us know what we were seeing during the flight. We were able to see Denali and he circled around so we could see the mountain from both sides of the plane. We landed on the glacier which was an awesome experience. Phil had lots of information about the glaciers and the weather patterns. It was a fabulous flight.

The flight was great and seeing the glaciers from the sky was beautiful.  My husband loved the experience in the small 1965 plane and my teens took tons of photos!  Our pilot was great and very informative.  The only drawback for us was the weather didn’t cooperate, so no peak sighting or glacier landing, but no one can control Mother Nature.
Joe was an amazing host and pilot! He took us to see some of the most amazing sites of the mountains! Thank you Joe. This experience was worth every Penny we spent!!

This was an amazing experience. We were unable to do the glacier landing flight due to weather but the staff is so friendly and accommodating we got on this one and don't feel like we missed a thing. Flying through those mountains was breathtaking. Our pilot was so nice and informative. Truly a trip to make time for. A+

review_title: The best way to see Denali!
review_text: Well worth the cost! We didn’t walk on the glacier, but the trip through the mountains was truly awe inspiring! Pilot was great, smooth flight! Our pilot taught the owner how to fly! 40 years of experience. Loved every minute and got some great pics. The best way to see Denali and the Alaskan range.

review_title: Thank you for the experience K2
review_text: Our trip was spectacular!   Worth every dime we paid.   Our pilot Will was so informed and put one of our nervous travelers at ease.  K2 runs their business like a well oiled machine.  So much of what we have done and seen here in Alaska, seems like things have been MacGyvered or not top quality,  but not the case for K2. Their facilities were spotless and each employee we were in contact with was on top of their game.

My husband and I had a great time on our flight seeing tour! The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable and did a wonderful job of pointing out various points of interest. Unfortunately the weather wasn't super cooperative (very cloudy/foggy) so we weren't able to do a glacier landing or go to the North side of the mountain, but we did get a glimpse of Denali peeking through the clouds, which was very cool. The pilot made sure that passengers on both sides of the plane had a chance to view the mountain. It was a beautiful tour and we're so glad we decided to do it.

Fantastic experience. Due to poor weather conditions on our originally scheduled day, we were able to reschedule for the following day when the weather was more optimal. Our pilot, Tom, was experienced and knowledgeable.

The views were amazing!  We took so many photos! Our pilot, Riley, was fantastic!  He kept trying to get a glacier landing for us and he did.  It was short but so worth it.  The group appreciated Riley's dedication to providing an enjoyable experience for all!  Would recommend K2 Aviation to anyone.

review_title: Weather dependent so keep expectations in check
review_text: Good trip to see Denali area but only average viewing due to the cloudy and rainy weather. Common opinion is that only 30% of people that visit the area actually get to see Denali. Glacier landing was canceled due to weather. They do adjust charges to reflect what you actually do since weather is such a factor. The route only covers part of Denali and flies up and around the Ruth Glacier. Pilot commentary was pretty average and nothing insightful.

We checked in over an hour early for a complete Denali Summit flight with landing on glacier. Weather disallowed this flight but rather than tell us we returned to this news and were offered the Denali experience.. I wished I’d passed for $600+…
Amazing! Pilot was a young guy, did a great job. Took us by top of Mt Denali. Very safe. Walking on glacier was awesome. Best thing we have done in Alaska!
Awesome!!! Don't debate whether or not to sign up....just do it!! Even with the clouds we saw so much and landed on the glacier. An experience of a lifetime!

This trip was the highlight of my Alaska vacation!!  The pilot was was first class (take off and landing on the glacier was seamless).  The scenery of the mountains and glaciers was exquisite.  I am so glad the weather cleared up and allowed us to make this trip.

Amazing trip! Our pilot Tully was great, and made sure we were comfortable and had great views the entire time. 10/10 would go again, was the coolest thing I’ve ever done. I went with 2 friends and we ended up with our private plane which was awesome.

My family of 6 went and it was amazing! Highlight of our 
Alaskan trip! Our pilot, Chad, was wonderful. We felt safe and very comfortable the entire time. Easy process checking in, getting gear we needed and getting loaded. Awesome!!

review_title: Eh, maybe book here, maybe don’t
review_text: Save yourself a drive and book a flight out of the Denali area itself where the weather has been much more fair. After telling me our flight was cancelled they wanted me to try to rebook a third time. We drove an hour from our hotel to K2 and received no phone call about a cancellation. The sun came out as we drove out of the parking lot… I’m sure it’s a great flight if you’re actually able to go.

Excellent experience! We did not do the glacier landing, and it was just our group and our pilot in the plane. Our pilot had a lot of interesting information about the area, and we were able to ask questions. The views were amazing, I definitely recommend this tour! They are very accommodating and their shuttle drivers picked us up and dropped us off in "downtown" Talkeetna instead of our hotel so we had time before and after our flight to shop and eat.

Highlight of are 10 day Alaska trip.  Phil was the pilot and exceptional.  A once and a lifetime experience.  As my wife has said many times, "Don't just see but make sure to see and DO".  
Thanks K2!

Worth every penny. We debated spending the money for our family of 5 for this excursion. My local friend highly recommended it and so glad we did it. Amazing views and actually watched an avalanche happen while we were flying about. Pilot Tom suggested the times to video as we traveled between peaks. Great video remembrance. Seeing and hearing about the glaciers was pretty cool. Can’t say enough about the excursion!

If you visit Talkeetna this trip is a must. The flight and glacier landing were breathtaking. Our pilot was an excellent guide as well as a very accomplished flyer. He gave stacks of interesting info throughout the flight.

This experience was unreal. And it was 100% worth the money. We had been hearing about doing some sort of helicopter or flight of some around the mountain when we saw the weather was going to be as good as it is we booked it! We were really hoping to get the land on a  glacier experience but it was sold out. You arrive a little before and check it and they weight you and then the pilots map it out. You then wait for your name to be called and head out with your pilot. The view we had were stunning and unlike anything I have ever seen. Tom our pilot was great at pointing things out and making sure both sides of the plane got the same views. The trip was around 1 hour and maybe 20 mins. And they provided headsets so you could all talk. I cannot recommend this enough and also recommend watching the weather if possible to find the best time to make sure the weather is in your favor. We only had tshirts on but the pilot could turn the heat or the air on

Excellent experience flying to and landing on the glacier overlooking Mt. Denali. Despite of weather challenges, the company worked w all of us to ensure a re-arranged schedule for a superb afternoon.

Excellent customer service & stupendous pilot!! Spectacular views! Can’t recommend enough! Had hoped for tour with Mt Denali & glacier landing, but wind & clouds precluded that. Can’t control Mother Nature!
The views were amazing.  We took a lot of photos.  Didn't get to land on the glacier because the weather was not suitable, but it was still a good experience.

In a word, WOW! I highly recommend K2 Aviation for a glacier flight seeing tour. Be sure to book a glacier landing, very much worth the extra. Everyone was super friendly, they have the process perfected from making reservations over the phone, to check in, to safety briefing, to the flight. I had Jack as my pilot and he was a lot of fun. You can tell he loves his job and takes pride in doing it well. My landings (both the glacier and the runway) were smoother than most big jet landings. I’m so glad I had the nudge to go on this adventure because it was worth every single penny!! I recommend everyone do this, whether you live in Alaska or are visiting.

We highly recommend K2 Aviation.   They were very flexible on times/dates for us to see Denali and nearby mountains.   On our original time/date it was raining so the trip was moved a couple of days.     They still couldn't do the circle Denali that we'd booked on that final day, but gave us an amazing slightly shorter tour and refunded the difference.    K2 is wonderful, and this is a must do experience in the recommended town of Talkeetna.
K2 gave us a great experience!  Beautiful views of the mountains and Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot Tom gave us a smooth flight and tons of information about the glacier.
The flight was smooth and the scenery was beautiful.  Landing on the glacier was exciting the pilot gave great history and local insights
Fun experience of a lifetime. I appreciate that they were very focused on safety (weather) and made a slight adjustment to our tour. Still saw amazing views!  Highly recommended!

This is an expensive activity, but it is worth the splurge! What a great way to see the Alaskan range and the awesome Denali! Our pilot, Ian, was fantastic, making sure everyone was comfortable, could be heard, and explaining a lot about the glaciers, the mountains and passes and of course the Great One! We had planned to do the longest summit tour, but the weather was good enough , As I guess they need ideal conditions as we had fairly clear weather. K2 quickly refunded the difference in cost between the two different tours.
Josh was a great pilot! Never a worry flying alongside 5000' high cliffs. Or heading up a glacier valley. This was the number one highlight of our week in Alaska.

What an amazing adventure!  Joe, our pilot, was great!  We were able to see the mountains, glaciers and rivers so clearly!  Joe made us feel very relaxed and calm.  The trip was fantastic!  We were so glad we decided to add this to our vacation package!
Flight was amazing. Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the mountain and the glaciers. I felt safe at all times and would do it again. Especially the landing on the glacier was amazing.

It's worth every penny!!!! What a truly amazing experience. I was fortunate enough to sit in the co-pilot seat and had some of the best views ever on a flight I will never forget. We were also fortunate enough to get to see the peaks of Denali. The whole operation from booking to landing is excellent. These guys even helped us out with a slow puncture on a tyre on our rental and inflated it for us. Amazing experience and should be one for everyones bucket list.

Amazing experience! We had perfect weather the day of our flight. Our pilot, Jack was awesome! I’ve never had a smoother landing than we he planted us on Ruth’s glacier. Top notch pilot! Highly recommend and would love to come again with my kids.

review_title: Best from the air! Go K2!
review_text: Even tho the ceiling was 12000 ft the glacier landing was spectacular and the sun shining on the lower peaks were stunning!  Our pilot had great narratives and pointed out many interesting places!  Very smooth!

Having 37 years as an Airline Pilot, I've seen plenty, but landing on a glacier was one of the most memorable moments I've ever had.
Our pilot Jack was a true professional and I knew.my wife and I were in good hands. You could tell that Jack absolutely loved what he was doing and his narratives were first class and informative.  Add to that a fleet of beautifully maintained aircraft and K2 becomes hard to beat.  The views, experience and memories are worth every dollar.

review_title: Wonderful tour, totally worth the price
review_text: This Tour was amazing.  Joe our pilot was excellent.  I had a private tour with just my mother and I and the pilot.  He was a great guide and a wonderful pilot I took lots of pictures and I can't wait to go back and do this tour again.  I hope I get Joe again.

Was even better than I could have imagined.  Our pilot Dave was excellent and provided a lot of information.  He made sure it was safe to do the glacier landing which we did.  Appreciate that K2 seemed to be ultra safety conscience.  The views were specatacular.  If you are going to pay for one excusion while you are in Alaska, I would recommend one of the K2 tours.  We did lots of cool stuff while we were in Alaska and I'd say this by far was the best.  Thanks K2!
Awesome experience! The tour was extremely good and enjoyable. The Landing was an add on to the tour and getting this as part of the tour was the best thing we opted for

This is a definite must see! You just can't compare to seeing these majestic mountains from up in a plane! We landed in the glacier and had some time up there. It is expensive but worth the cost! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job!
We had an amazing experience on this trip! Our pilot, Phil, was top notch and full of interesting information. Landing on a glacier runway is a one of a kind experience! Highly recommend!
This was amazing! You can’t beat the scenery from above! The pilot answers questions and gives insight on different mountains and landscape. This is a must on your trip.

The flight was awesome, great pilot, professional customer service. It was the best experience I had in Talkeetna, the views were truly amazing. We were able to land on the glacier at base camp, so cool! We saw the mountain climbers and their camps. Denali was in full view and clear. Would highly recommend this company.

review_title: K2 Flight and Glacier Landing - Do it!!!
review_text: The highlight of our 2 week cruise/land tour.  Views are breathtakingly beautiful.  Captain Dave was a great tour guide pointing out all of the sights.  The glacier landing was fantastic.  Worth every penny.

review_title: Do not miss this if you’re in Talkeetna
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip. We almost skipped the glacier stop, and that would’ve been a big mistake. The flight was fun but the glacier stop was amazing. Our pilot Josh was the best. And by luck. we had the plane to just the two of us and the pilot. I do not skip this. if you are in Talkeetna. Worth every penny.
Onder leiding van piloot Tom een onvergetelijke en adembenemende tocht met prachtig zicht op de Denali, gletschers, ijswatervallen. Zeer aan te bevelen

Shaun was our pilot, and he was very  kind and friendly. The plane ride was smooth and not
scary at all. It was the most fabulous thing ever! It brought tears to my eyes it was so beautiful! Landing on a glacier was the highlight! I’m so glad we were able to experience it. K2 Aviation was professional and made us feel comfortable. Excellent service and breathtaking experience!

A must do!  We had hoped to be able to do the glacier landing but the weather didn't allow for it.  Pilot is fantastic.  Felt completely safe.  Views of Denali were breathtaking!  Recommend a thousand times over!
Step outside your comfort zone and spend the money and do this. Highlight of our trip. K2 was professional and First Class

Views were amazing. We didn’t opt for glacier landing but our pilot, Joe, took us very close to the mountains and floor and showed us all the lovely formations. He gave us great information. We took a lot of pictures.  We really enjoyed it a lot!

The entire trip from the airport to the glacier and back to the airport was amazing. Standing on a glacier at the top of the world was a priceless experience.Chad, our pilot, gave us a running commentary along the way and answered every question.

review_title: Unforgettable and MUST-DO flightseeing and Glacier Landing!
review_text:
We took this tour last week while visiting Alaska, and included the Glacier Landing in our Denali Flightseeing Tour. Please trust me when I say you NEED to do the Glacier Landing!!! It is SO worth the extra money for the experience.

Booking Experience: Super easy and wonderful customer service. Unfortunately the weather was not cooperative and we had to rebook several times due to this. The ladies in the office were great to deal with and more than willing to refund if we couldn't get an alternate date (thankfully it worked for us another day!!). The day we were planned to go up, the weather started changing in the afternoon, and they got us up in the air about an hour early so that we could still do the Glacier Landing.

Pilot: Our Pilot for our flight was Jack and he was GREAT! Super friendly, funny and knowledgeable he made our experience a fun one. My son is 14 and wants to be a pilot someday. He got to sit in the Co-Pilot seat, so as you can imagine he was in his glory!! Jack did a great job of sharing history about Alaska, the mountains and the glaciers.

Glacier Landing: Again, you NEED to do this!! The landing and then taking back off were smooth. When you step out of the plane the complete SILENCE and STILLNESS are mind blowing! You feel like you're the only person in the world at that moment. It was a truly beautiful and mind-blowing experience. My son dropped down and did a snow angel in that perfectly undisturbed snow lol. 

Flight: The flight was smooth and we were able to get SO many amazing pictures while in flight.

This is an adventure we will cherish and remember always. Thank you K2!!

I had an amazing experience and the glacier landing was unforgettable! Planes are comfortable and their are amazing views the whole time. The flight was smooth and beautiful and we flew over the mountains and among the glaciers to our landing on Ruth Glacier. Our pilot explained everything that was happening and what we were looking at and did an incredible job flying the plane.

One of the best tours I have ever been on!  The pilot was Chad - very knowledgeable of the area, glaciers and just all around very pleasant personality.  The weather did allow for us to land on the glacier and was one of the 5% clear days allowing us to see all the way to the top of Denali!!  Awesome day!
Probably one of the best experiences of my life even our pilot said we were in the 5% perfect weather perfect conditions landed on 2 feet of snow. It was absolutely beautiful.
Awe inspiring, seeing the majesty of all that is beautiful in the world. Our pilot was interesting and highly competent too!

We had an amazing flight - I took my teenage son on a trip where he got to his 50th state! It was the perfect cap to all of our adventures. Everyone at the company was professional and nice. They picked us up, explained all that was going on, and took us on an incredible flight. A once in a lifetime experience.

This company is top notch. I called a few times with questions and they were always polite and helpful. The trip itself was spectacular. The pilot was so knowledgeable and flew the plane like an absolute pro. The landing was one of the best I have ever experienced. They give headsets so you can ask questions and everyone had a window seat on the plane we flew in.
The plane was the perfect size for our group. The pilot and co-pilot were very friendly and familiar with the aircraft and area. The flight was very smooth and the views were fantastic.

This was an absolutely FABULOUS experience! Our pilot, Will, did an informative and helpful pre-flight review of our flight and route.  He did a great job of pointing out major landmarks as well as the geology of the area. Having flown K2 25 years ago as part of a climbing expedition I appreciated then and again on this trip with their focus on safety and experience. Seeing the Ruth Gorge / Glacier as well as Denali up close is a once in a lifetime experience and well worth the cost. I would give them a 10 in terms of delivering a truly memorable experience.

Had the best time flying with K2! The weather was just right we got to land on a glacier and hang out for about 30 mins. Flew around Denali and saw so many cool views. Started out green and lush then went into snowy mountains. It was incredible. Worth it!! The staff was great and our pilot as well.
Cool trip.  Unfortunately it had snowed earlier that morning so we couldn’t land on the glacier.  But it still was fun.  And our daughter ran into mayor Denali!!

K2 Aviation provided an educational tour with beautiful views of Denali. They accommodated a date change for our scheduled tour due to low visibility - incredible customer service. The front desk crew was extremely friendly and offered hot cocoa. The entire experience from the drive to/from Talkeetna to the flight and views were outstanding. Highly Recommended!

review_title: see All of Denali National Park this way if you can
review_text:
I understand less than 5% of visitors get the day we had. Booked after seeing a clear day in the forcast and it was a perfect. Calm winds, amazing sun on a winter day in November. We were able to circle Denali, curve around all the main glaciers, even fly through 747 pass. The Sheldon resort gave us perspective to the immense mountains around us.
If possible, see Denali this way! We saw the entire park, experienced all the stunning beauty, dangerous peaks and saw the vast fields and rivers that make this National Park so striking.
Chad was calm, careful and an extremely good pilot.
All around great experience.  Knowledgeable pilot.  Beautiful day!  Everyone was very polite and organized.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you again for the wonderful flight experience with K2 Aviation on August 19 2022, around Denali. Soaring above the clouds with Leon was powerful and impressive at the same time. At the same time, a big thank you to the nice employee who made this magnificent flight possible for me despite the lack of capacity.
with all my heart Angelika Schauder
Germany

Mid September day with really lousy weather.  We had to cancel our Denali flightsee with K2.  They were great to work with, rescheduled easily for the following day.  Next  morning, still really cloudy, no flightsee to Denali, no glacier landing – passed on the opportunity for a flight through the lowlands and valleys.  They refunded our deposit immediately, no questions.  
Only posting to comment on how easy they were to work with.

review_title: Canceled flight with VERY little notice
review_text: They canceled our flight 20 minutes before our check in time after driving over two hours. It would have been nice to get more of a heads up so we didn’t waste our time.

Absolutely the best way to experience Denali!   You can see all sides of the mountain and glaciers.  We were unable to land due to recent snowfall but they were great about creditong back a portion. Our pilot was professional and confident - exactly what you want in a small plane pilot.   I had never been on a smaller prop plane like this. It seats 11 and everyone gets a window seat.  Windows are bubble shaped so you can really see all around.   The ride was smoother than I expected.  Commuter flights bounce you more than this one did.  It's an unforgettable experience. Alaska is enormous and trying to drive everyone doesn't give you a chance to experience enough.  This flight was the perfect way to see Denali!

Alex our pilot shared so much information and answered all of our questions.  The scenery was unbelievable! We felt as if we were making a documentary for an imax theater. It was the highlight of our family’s Alaska trip.

This was supposed to be the "cherry on top" for our family Alaska trip, since our daughter is a mountain girl and pilot. Due to weather, we weren't able to fly as high as planned, and fresh snow prevented landing/walking on glacier. (Sad!) 
Regardless, it was INCREDIBLE!!!! THE FOOTHILLS ALONE WERE MAGNIFICENT!! 
Pilot let our pilot girl be "co-pilot" (no controls, of course!) 
Great experience! Courteous, helpful staff. Half refund since couldn't do what booked. Great communication from 6 months out til trip.

review_title: Incredible Views, Great Pilot and Guide.
review_text: Our K2 Denali Flight was best experience during our 20 day trip into Alaska and we did it all. Our pilot, Leon, was great.  He spent time going over all the safety issues and then took us up on an incredible flight around Denali.  Leon was very knowledgable and explained all about the many peaks of Denali along with the mountains nearby.  He showed us where the major climbing routes were and explained why the worked the best.  The staff at K2 were all great. Great flight, great day, great pictures and videos.  I would probably do it again.  The cost was well worth the trip. Dale M.

Amazing! This trip surpassed our expectations!!
Well narrated and flown.Views we never would have seen by any other method. Thanks so much!!

From start to finish was the best part of the trip. All the people I dealt with at K2 were friendly and professional. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about our plane and the area we flew over. If there was a down side it was that we didn't land on a glacier. But that was no fault of K2, it was weather related. K2 happily refunded that portion of the price. There was no fighting or hassle - it was in my bank within 2days.

I highly recommend flying with K2

review_title: flight was canceled but customer service was outstanding
review_text: Unfortunately, our flight was canceled due to weather.  we appreciate their commitment to safety.  and the staff was so professional.  they gave us options of rebooking or canceling but we had to cancel due to our plans to travel home the next day.  they were friendly and easy to work with and gave us tips on things to do in the area with our new found free time.
Absolutely wonderful tour with great pilot and ground staff!!! We have and will tell anyone heading to AK to take the tour with K2 - they will be thrilled!!
Chad our pilot was awesome.  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska, the views of the mountains, landing on the glacier and then taking off again were stunning.

This was in the top two of our vacation experiences during our two-week stint in Alaska.
The glacier landing was awesome.  And the aerial views were amazing.

review_title: Don’t be fooled by a cheaper price
review_text: I was really looking forward to this experience while in Alaska. k2 called us about an hour before our schedule led departure to let us know we cannot go to Denali due to the weather. It was a beautiful day with seemingly perfect weather. Upon further inquiry we were told this happens very frequently and they have different regulations than other companies. I called other companies in Denali and were told they were all running. I had initially booked k2 because of the reviews and lower rates. Spend more money and avoid cancelations. It really put a damper on my day.
The entire trip was excellent. Unfortunately weather precluded me taking the Grand Denali tour and glacier landing which should have made things exceptional.

review_title: Experience of a lifetime to see Denali
review_text: This was an experience of a lifetime. We toured Denali and landed on a glacier. It was amazing!! The pilot explained all we were seeing from the air and then landed the plane on a glacier. We were able to walk out on the glacier! I felt safe and enjoyed every minute! Do yourself a favor and book this while in Talkeetna.

review_title: Beautiful & Majestic Mountains - Nice Folks - Way Over Priced & Impersonal Experience
review_text:
Of all the things we planned across our 6 week Alaskan tour, this was the one I was MOST excited about and willing to splurge on.  Unfortunately for over $1500 for 3 folks to experience the Denali Grand Tour, we were surprised to arrive with a large mass of people and be shuffled onto a plane whereby we were told not to talk and we couldn’t sit together. Of course the mountains and glaciers are beautiful and the plane is super cool. And I understand that despite the gorgeous weather the pilot made the safe decision not to land on a “sticky” glacier (and they refunded us for this portion).  We just expected a more personalized, engaging experience. Everyone was perfectly kind, and of course safe. And we learned a lot.  It was just a disappointing experience compared to the absolute love and joy of Alaska that we’ve experienced in other locations.  

This was a wonderful trip, just not worth the money spent.

This was one of the best things I have ever done!   Words cannot describe the beauty and magnificence of flying around the mountain in such an up close and personal way.    WOW.    Make sure you include this in your trip to Alaska!

What a perfect way to see the glaciers of Denali with a wonderful glacier landing.  It could not been more perfect.  Sunshine and could see Mt Denali in all its glory.  Not every day I can play in the snow in August as I live in South Carolina.  The beauty will give you a lump in your throat.  I am a travel agent and this is a must for all my clients.  It turned out to be the best tour while in Talkeetna.  I will be looking at the picutres and videos for many years to come. Take my advise and bite the bullet and GO!!

I highly recommend a flight tour with K2! Check in was a breeze, they have boots if needed, water refill, bathrooms, and a place to store excess items. We were told we had a 50/50 chance of getting to land on a glacier dependent on weather and clouds as we got closer....so I was keeping my expectations low...but we got lucky and Chad made it happen! Chad filled us in on various points and entertained our random questions. Again, highly recommend an outing with K2!

This tour was such a highlight to our Alaska trip. Beautiful and breathtaking views of Denali that you won’t likely see or experience any other way, and we felt very safe with our pilot Chad who was very professional. Thank you!

We really enjoyed the flight tour led by our pilot Mitchell. Originally we had booked the tour with the glacier landing but due to weather had to reschedule. Luckily we went the same day on a shortened 1 hr. tour. It was still amazing and he shared some interesting facts along the way. We felt very safe with him as our guide. Highly recommend!

review_title: This experience was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure.
review_text: The entire trip was spectacular, but the glacier landing was the best. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.  He made it fun.
The whole tour was awesome.  Words cannot express my feelings as I looked at the glaciers; their beauty and size.
Phil was an excellent pilot & guide. Excellent customer service from everyone involved - had to reschedule the flight due to weather conditions with no hassle. Once in a lifetime experience!

Fly a large Otter airplane with skis even, over and around the Ruth Glacier. The weather was to windy to land on the glacier that day.  That meant about an hour trip instead of 2 hours.  We were able to get a 50% refund before we left for the tour.  Our pilot was very informed about the topography of that glacial system.  Very good customer service and a good value for the buck

5

I highly recommend this tour. Despite difficult weather conditions they were able to give us an amazing and safe flight.  Our pilot, Leon was great, we couldn’t have asked for more and would definitely do this again if we return to Alaska.

This was an astonishingly great thing to do. Felt very safe.  Can’t rate this high enough.
Enjoyed the pilot and the whole experience. Ranks #1 as far our Alaska adventures.
Absolutely beautiful views it was raining when we took off but by the time we got over the mountains it was sunny.  our pilot Chad was excellent. Worth every penny

What a great experience, highly recommended. The K2 team worked around the rough weather and gave us fair options on how to proceed. We chose a shorter flight than originally booked yet it did not disappoint!

review_title: Flight of a lifetime! Nothing else comes close.
review_text: This is the BEST way to see Denali, bar none! A trip you will cherish for the rest of your life. Very Professional and worth every penny. You will not regret it, I guarantee it!

review_title: Breathtaking even on a cloudy day
review_text: We could not have asked for better treatment from email updates, pickup and drop off for hotel, and to let hang out in their lounge prior to our train departure. Moreover, since the weather was not optimal, they offered to let us cancel for a full refund. Our pilot, Mitchell, was exceptionally safety conscious with a touchdown that wouldn’t wake a baby. Highly recommend!!!

We originally booked the Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing but the weather was not cooperating. We rescheduled for a few days later on our way back through the area. Unfortunately, weather came in and it was too dangerous to fly beyond some of the glaciers. We never saw Denali the whole trip but that was just bad luck with the weather. August is the rainy season.  K2 was very accommodating and made it possible for us to enjoy the Experience flight which our party of four loved. The glaciers are amazing!  We got fantastic photos and my husband got to be the co-pilot. All of the staff at K2 were so nice and easy to talk to. The pilot, Lou, was experienced and very knowledgeable. He shared a lot of information during the flight.  The front desk issued a refund very quickly and they even shipped my sunglasses to me which I had left in the back pocket of the seat in front of me (for the price of postage.  If we are ever in the area again, we will fly with K2. P.S. we flew with K2 8 years ago and had the glacier landing and saw Denali!
I was so nervous going into the flight,  but it was 100 times better than I thought it would be.  Mitch was an awesome pilot and knowledgeable about the area.

Our entire experience was fabulous!  From Austin, our shuttle driver who took great care of us and our backpacks to and from their site (and had us laughing with his jokes), to our pilot Riley (also entertaining with his dry humor filled preflight briefing) to the folks at the desk, K2’s staff was professional and very courteous.  We did the glacier landing and we were awestruck by the peace and beauty up on the glacier.  Riley is a great pilot and we had a smooth and beautiful flight as we wove our way through the peaks. He also was great at answering questions and narrating the trip.  This was an experience we will remember!!  Thanks K2!

We had an awesome beautiful sunny day. We really saw how majestic Denali is. You get a chance to feel really small as you are close to the mountain. I was not happy with the type of pictures I was able to capture as they put us on the one and only low wing plane. The wing was in 90 percent of my pics. Maybe my expectations were too high since I have been in small planes before, but the wing in my pics really disappointed me, hence my lower rating. Currently my favorite Denali pic was taken in Talkeetna  on the Susitna River. On the same day as my flight.

Fabulous flightseeing trip.  Dorothy was an excellent pilot.  She was skillful, safe and knowledgable of the geography and history of the area.  Also, we got to ride in a classic, well-maintained, DeHavilland Beaver, which was a blast.  
My wife and I had a great experience that I would highly recommend.  
Thanks K2 Aviation! Two thumbs up!
Fantastic, up-close, incredible views of Denali Mountain, surrounding mountains and glaciers! So enjoyable and absolutely breath-taking! Our pilot, Joe, was informative and very capable.

This was an incredible adventure. I would do this again anytime I am in Alaska. My daughter and I spent a week hiking in Alaska. Going on the K2  Grand Tour of Denali with glacier landing was a great way to finish the week. We had booked to do this two days earlier, but could not because of the rain. They were great and rescheduled us for two days later. They run a very efficient and professional service. From the front office to Lou, our pilot everyone was great. My daughter loved this and we will both always remember our whole week in the mountains of Alaska, but flying over the and landing on a glacier was a nice addition to the whole week.

This was an absolutely amazing experience. This company is very professional and well run. I would highly recommend this to anyone in the area. We did many different things during our week touring Alaska, and this definitely topped the list for us. Well worth the money spent.
Super knowledgeable and funny guide made us feel safe and at ease for the entire trip. Amazing views and fabulous experience all round.
It was fabulous! An absolutely great time and the scenery is stunning from start to finish.the pilot was very knowledgeable and made us feel safe the whole ride.

review_title: Go for it! It's worth every penny
review_text: We were fortunate to get to see Denali (the mountain itself) two days in a row. Their planes hadn't been able to even fly for two weeks due to low visibility. We were one of the fortunately 25-30% who actually got to see the top of Denali at 20,000 feet. There has been 3 feet the snow at the top the day before, so K2 had to cancel our glacier landing due to safety concerns. However, our pilot was able to get within a mile of the top of Denali which he hadn't been able to do all season!  He was great - very knowledgeable, checked how everyone was doing, gave us a little extra time because our glacier landing was canceled.

review_title: The only way to see Denali
review_text: This was the highlight of my vacation. The entire experience was terrific! Dorothy, our pilot was excellent, from the information she shared, the route she took and complete flight process. I was extremely lucky to be her "co-pilot" and had to best seat in the plane. It's truly an amazing way to see Denali!

Do not pass up this amazing experience! I was nervous about flying in a small plane but am so glad I went. The pilots are very experienced and fly all the time. Denali Park is so vast that you cannot begin to see it all. Flying made it possible to get a better glimpse at the millions of acres. We even got a view of the Tall One - Denali! Lots of glaciers and mountains.  Our pilot Phil was very knowledgeable about the area and answered all our questions.

review_title: K2 Aviation Denali air tour, highly recommended!
review_text:
This aerial tour of Denali was simply spectacular. I highly recommend it.
Service was phenomenal, from the driver that picked us up from hotel and was so personal along the way, to the pilot whom was a rock star!
We connected personally with all the staff. Their service was top rated. Safety was upmost important as well!  This flight was a highlight of our Alaska trip! The pilot was so knowledgeable about Denali, the glacier, the geology etc. The driver was a retired geological engineer living his dream in Denali! We connected so well with everyone!
Thank you so much K2 Aviation💕

This is the most spectacular thing we've ever done.   Our pilot, Chris was very informative and made sure both sides of the plane got to see the sights.  Words cannot describe the views and pictures do not do them justice.  Landing on the glacier at Denali base camp was just the best.   DO THIS!!!!
Our family of six, three generations, Had a wonderful time flying with pilot Chris. We landed on kahiltna glacier on the most beautiful clear day. Perfect point on our 10 day vacation
It was a fabulous experience. Dorothy was our pilot & she was great! A smooth, safe flying experience with lots of information. The views are extraordinary and we loved it!!  We’ll worth the money.
