Our pilot Chris was excellent and very experienced.  The day was great, sunny and awesome views of Denali. The glacier landing was pretty cool and the kids got to make snowballs.

What an amazing trip!
Our pilot.. can't remember his name but he was from Pennsylvania studying aerospace engineering was a great great guy!  Give that young man a raise.  K2 did an amazing job checking us in and getting us to Denali.  

Landing on the glacier was just truly amazing.  Really puts things in perspective about nature and all it's glory.

Truly remember this forever.

Signed
From Texas
Expected a little up and down. Take a few pics of the peak. Flying the gorge was amazing and beyond what I expected from the experience. Highly recommend!

review_title: This is a great company and a must-do experience!
review_text: My adult daughters and I took this trip, the experience was perfect from beginning to end. Connor, the pilot, knew so much about the plane itself and the area. The shuttle guides were wonderful, and the actual views were unbelievable! They were able to get over the clouds for the first time in 2 weeks, we saw the Denali peak in all its majesty. Absolutely breathtaking! Highly recommend the trip if you’re in Talkeetna.

We flew with Garrett and a bunch of other guests on one of their beautiful dehaviland otters.  Every one who we interacted with was super friendly and courteous.  Garrett is a true professional and a great tour guide.  Our day was the first time in 2 weeks the weather had allowed them to fly so when we added on the glacier there was 2 feet of fresh snow.  I would definitely recommend K2 and Garrett.

The entire experience was amazing!!! Highly recommend! They are a very professional company from start to finish. We also paid extra for the glacier landing, and it was definitely worth it! Thanks K2 for such an awesome trip!
Great side by side couple hours in Denali mountains!! Bumpy but lot of fun! Scenery amazing and guides knowledge were super!!!

review_title: Mountain Range Tour and Glacier Landing.
review_text: A great safe flying tour of the mountain ranges and surrounding landscape.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was absolutely amazing!  The captain was a great pilot and very knowledgeable of the area.
This was a fabulous trip! Mitchell was a great pilot and guide, very knowledgeable about the area around Denali. We would definitely recommend this trip, and hope to do it again in the future.

review_title: Once the rain cleared, blue skies, sunshine and stunning views.
review_text: K2 Aviation was so accommodating and worked with us due to weather delays. Our flight with Chris was amazing and the majesty of the Alaska Range, breathtaking. Highly recommend flying with K2.

review_title: Flight Around Denali is a MUST!
review_text:
K2 was amazing! Their wonderful reviews led me to them. Their competitive rates/discounts were a big factor as well. 

Our flight was canceled the morning of due to wildfire smoke but they worked with us , keeping us in the loop, and were able to get us booked for later the same day!

Absolutely stunning views!

We had the best experience with pilot Billy. Polite, detailed, and knowledgeable about his craft and the environment. Lucky to be a 30%er following rainy days. Thanks also to the young man who checked us in upon arrival. Articulate and friendly.

review_title: Just do the flight with K2, you won’t regret!!
review_text: Our Denali Experience Flight with K2 was one of our favorite things in Alaska, you can’t miss it! The flight is absoluteky amazing, views are stunning and we felt very safe. Plane was great and our pilot was also experienced and knowledgeable. I am usually a little scared of flying and felt great, highly recommend!!

We were told at check in we would likely not see the mountain but could cancel and receive a refund.  Weather related.  We said heck no.  We came a long way to take this flight and will just see what we see.  Half way between Talkeetna and the mountain the pilot got word from the flight that left before us that the weather had cleared!  Amazing to see Denali close up. Take the flight and ask for Billy for your pilot.  He was great!

This was a once in a lifetime experience!  If you are considering doing this, I highly recommend you do it, you won't regret it!  Lou was an excellent pilot and explained a lot about what we were seeing. Landing on the glacier and seeing Denali are something we will NEVER forget.

Once and a lifetime experience! My entire family enjoyed so much! This by far has been our favorite excursion of our trip. We didn't get to go to the North side because of the smoke from the wildfires unfortunately, but it was still an awesome experience. Landing on the glacier was so smooth, and seeing the gorgeous views from the plane will be etched in our memory forever. Worth every penny!

review_title: Beautiful Scenic Flight to truly appreciate Mount Denali and the Alaskan Range
review_text: Phenomenal flight experience in a small Cessna 185. There were 4 of us and the pilot. The morning had perfect view of Denali. It was incredible how small the planes that had landed on Denali appeared from the sky. Due to a fire north of Denali, there has been a lot of smoke in the area, but it had cleared for the few days I was around Talkeetna! Would highly recommend on a clear day to go up!
It was excellent experience. Our pilot Louie was just beyond the excellent. He was very knowledgeable guy and give us lots of great info about the Denali mountain 🏔. I am highly recommend.

We had a great flight with Billy.  He was very informative and pointed out all the different glaciers and told us stories about them and how they got their names.  Felt very safe in the plane.  Clear day, so we were lucky to be able to land on the glacier!  Love it!!

review_title: Flightseeing over Denali with landing on glacier - fantastic life experience
review_text: Our flightseeing trip to Denali was amazing! Pilot (a young New Zealand fellow) was great - very competent and informative. Plane seemed very airworthy and safe, and company followed good safety procedures. Pilot gave great commentary while flying through mountains and valleys around Denali, and we landed on a snow-covered glacier.  We were fortunate that weather was exceptionally clear with beautiful blue skies (a rare occurrence at Denali).  One drop-dead gorgeous view after another. Undoubtedly, this was the highlight of our 20-day Alaska trip!!
This was definitely one of those chance of a lifetime experiences. Awe-inspiring views, fantastic piloting, and very informational. You will not be disappointed choosing K2 Aviation.
This was a fabulous experience!  You need to do this if the weather permits.  Leon was a great pilot, made us feel very comfortable

Let me begin by saying this is something I do almost every time I visit Alaska (at least yearly). The flightseeing over Denali is absolutely breathtaking! The views cannot be described and do them justice. On top of that, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating.  I can't wait to go again!

We recently returned from a 13 day land & cruise tour of Alaska. We took this tour as part of the land portion of our trip. It was the highlight of the entire trip!! Not only was the weather gorgeous and Denali was in full view, we were very pleased with the plane, pilot, and professionalism of K Aviation. We were awed & sometimes speechless with the views. The landing on the glacier was fantastic! Will also mention that this excursion was booked through & recommended by Princess Cruises. They also place confidence in the quality of K Aviation.

Excellent tour of Denali . Seeing the snow enveloped peaks which resembled scoops of vanilla ice cream melted over the jagged mountain  ridges was awe inspiring and spectacular. Due to flat sunlight which reduced visibility, we were not able to land on a glacier but that did not diminish our delight in the opportunity to see Denali within six miles. Lovely experience in the hands of very trustworthy staff. Highly recommend this tour!

My family and I booked the Mt. Denali flight with the glacier landing as part of our bucket list Alaska Adventure Vacation and it did not disappoint. The planes are well maintained and the pilots extremely knowledgeable of the area and conditions. Our pilots got us amazing views of the summit of Mt. Denali as well as stunning views of many glaciers in the surrounding area. The climax of this trip was landing on the

This was a once in a lifetime experience that I'm glad we did not miss. We were a little worried at first that the weather wouldnt allow for us to land on the glacier, but the pilots went ahead and flew and determined while they were up there if we were okay. We lucked out because we landed. I have never experienced anything like this. You are very close to the mountain and glaciers. The view is absolutely stunning. Definitely worth the extra cost to land!

review_title: breathtaking experience of Denali mountains and glacier
review_text:
excellent flight through the denali mountain ranges and glacier landing. It's not cheap but worth doing it. The views of the mountains and glaciers are just breathtaking. 
One of the highlights so far of my Alaska trip.

review_title: Do the Glacier Landing, it’s the best part of the tour!
review_text:
Great experience with K2! This was a once in a lifetime experience for my daughter and I; it was everything we expected and more. The line was long when we arrived but they were fully staffed to meet demand and we were checked in quickly. After checking in we were on the flight within 10 minutes. The pilot was very knowledgeable and easy going. We got some great pictures from the flight and glacier landing. 

If you are going to take the tour, I highly recommend the Glacier Landing. It’s more expensive but it really was the highlight of our flight (with the exception of seeing Mt. Denali of course).

Every seat is good in the plane so no need to rush on it to get the best seat. Also we sat in the last two rows since we were the last onboard and we enjoyed have a lot of leg room compared to the other seats.

Some advice for first time flyers specifically re: Glacier Landings:

1. Bring a jacket even if it’s 80 degrees in Talkeetna since the weather changes so much in the mountains. Wear layers if you only have a thin coat.  I had a t-shirt and windbreaker but I wish I had something warmer since it was chilly on the glacier during our late evening flight.

2. Wear the boot covers they give  you at K2. They keep your shoes dry during the glacier landing!! I was surprised how many folks on our flight did not wear them. 

3. Make sure you take lots of photos! Bring an extra camera if you have it. The views are stunning!

I would definitely fly with K2 aviation again!

We took our Denali flight seeing tour on July 1.   Lou was a fabulous pilot and very experienced climber.  We had amazing views of the mountains, glaciers and park areas.  He did such a great job pointing out the sights and turning the plane so both sides could see important views.  The booking process was easy and checking was a breeze.
Landing on a glacier with K2 on a brilliantly clear and sunny day with Riley as  our pilot was a great experience. I highly recommend it!

review_title: A Glory to God majestic experience!
review_text: K2Aviation Denali flightsee and glacier landing was the highlight of our trip!  Pilot Connor was professional, knowledgeable and gave us an experience of a lifetime!  We saw Denali in it's full glory!  Landing on a glacier was over the top!  Thank you, Connor and K2Aviation!

review_title: Nothing better than making a snow angel on a glacier
review_text: Such a cool experience! Flying over the mountains, rivers and lakes! Our pilot, Conner was awesome! (And looked like Goose 😆) Caught glimpses of Denali from the air and, best of all, landed and played on Pika glacier. Snow angels, snowball fights and family pictures all in June! Loved it!

My favorite excursion so far in Alaska! Pilot Lou flew a smooth flight and landing on the glacier. I learned so much about how the glaciers, mountains and waterways were formed. He's educated about the geology of the area and shared his knowledge with us, encouraging questions, and made sure both sides of the plane could view what he was describing.
Stepping onto a glacier was unreal! Stunning views, trip of a lifetime! And K2 Aviation even sent a shuttle to pick us up from our campground.
Very cool sweatshirts and tshirts in their gift shop too.

review_title: Breathtaking views, the best way to see Denali!
review_text: Absolutely breathtaking experience, this is the best way to see Denali National Park, Mt Denali, and the glaciers! This is probably the best tour we’ve done throughout our Alaska trip. K2 aviation is the best operator to go with, super professional and they make the experience very enjoyable, our pilot Chris was exceptional with his knowledge of the Denali National Park and he went above and beyond to make the experience special for everyone onboard! Definitely recommend this tour, we’ll be back soon with friends and family.

This is a must do when you visit Alaska! Our pilot Joe was awesome! He is very knowledgeable and you can tell he loves bringing this experience to the visitors. We did the glacier landing and it was so worth it. I highly recommend K2!

This is the highlight of my trip to Alaska and far exceeded my expectations- a fulfillment of a lifelong dream.  Chad is an amazing guide and pilot.  Very knowledgeable of the area,  a top notch pilot and great person.  The views were breath-taking!  I have already recommended this trip to two others that I met and suggested that they ask for Chad.  Many thanks Chad for an experience I will never forget!

We were a larger group (25 total including 18 teenagers).  We loved our experience with K2.  It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Worth the money.  K2 pilots (we were divided between 3 planes) were excellent. K2 office staff allowed us to add 2 add’l members to our group with little notice.  They were booked but were able to adjust things on their end to accommodate us.  We were so grateful to K2 for working with us at every step.  We were fortunate to have beautiful weather, but I believe the experience would have been awesome regardless.  Thank you, K2.  We would absolutely book with them again.
There aren't enough words to praise the beauty of this part of the world! Add to that a compassionate & knowledgeable pilot. Truly a bucket list experience!
Fantastic glacier landing flight with Billy. Great personality, informative and fun, felt safe the entire flight. This is the highlight of our trip , so far.

review_title: Doesn't get much better than this trip
review_text: I have read a lot about Denali mountaineering exploits, plus I love flying so this trip with K2 was a long-awaited highlight of our trip from the UK to Alaska.  I knew from TV programmes that it would be good but it certainly exceeded our every expectation.  We were lucky enough to have excellent weather and to get onto an earlier morning flight thanks to a very kind, helpful lady on reception who realised how important this trip was to us personally! The views as we flew in were extraordinary and the visibility so good we seemed to be in touching distance from so many majestic, snow-clad mountains, glaciers and rivers. Riley, our pilot, was great fun and very informative and we were very surprised just how stable and  comfortable the trusty Otter was amongst the huge mountains. My only regret was that I didn't make better us of my map of Denali to orientate myself better but I was so busy soaking in the views and experience.  This trip wasn't cheap but certainly worth every cent and the trip out to Alaska.  It doesn't get much better!
Family  trip to land on glacier and travel to Mt Denali/ McKinley was amazing. Once in a life time adventure.!  Family members 15 to 48  year old loved it!

When asked what was my favorite part of this experience I would have to say, "The whole experience.".  From making reservations, too checking in, to the flight, to landing on Ruth Glacier all was wonderful.  Staff were all professional.  There is flexibility if you need to reschedule.  K2 Aviation wants to guarantee you a  excellent experience, and they did exceeding all of my expectations.  If you are visiting Talkeetna Alaska this is a must.

review_title: K2 is on top of the World experience
review_text:
Customer service was first rate.  The whole experience was perfect.  I will do this again!
Great views of the mountains and MckInley.  Glaciers were awesome!  Landing on the glacier was smooth and beautiful.  I am so glad we were given the option and chose yes,  Our pilot was an excellent guide.

Pilot Matthew was great, & the trip was fantastic. The "Big  3" were glorious,  but Matthew made the rest of the flight even better.  More than just a thrill ride. God's majesties were underscored during this  trip.

review_title: An amazing flight to see one of the tallest mountains in the world!
review_text: I am really surprised by the comments about no narration during the flight?!? I wonder if his headset wasn't working because out pilot was telling us about the area the entire flight. Landing on a glacier is such a great experience. We were very lucky in that the skies parted and we got a nice sunny experience. I don't think we could have asked for better, other than spending even more time on the glacier than we did (and we got some bonus time being the last flight of the day). We lucked out and booked same day (in the morning) so if you suddenly find you have some time, you might check them out.

Landing on and take-off from as well as walking on the glacier were the most wonderful experiences during this excursion.  Lou was our pilot and a great guide.  He  allowed me to ride in co-pilot's seat and made my experience even more memorable.  All guests get a window seat.  Wings being over the windows did not block the beautiful views of mountains and glaciers.

The check-in center is beautiful and spacious with good seating inside and outside the building.  The staff is extremely helpful and courteous.  The restrooms are also very clean.

One tip to future guests:  If weather is expected to be bad, please call to find out whether glacier landing would be possible.  If not, they are very accommodating about changing your day, refunding, and adjusting the price.

We enjoyed the beautiful views of the glaciers. Was disappointed that our pilot didn't give us any narration or information about the history and geography of the land and we were unable to ask or communicate with him as mics were not active. He was a good pilot and friendly on the ground. His tour guiding skills had no interaction with the people after takeoff.

There are two reasons why we cannot rate this 5 stars.  First, one person in our party had a headset with a nonworking mic so they could not ask any questions during the flight.  Second, we thought the flight would be limited to six people (according to the website description).  There were 10 people  in our plane not counting the pilot.  Not sure why there was a difference.  The views on the right side were better than the left, but the views for all were incredible. Takeoff and landing were very smooth.   It's worth the trip, but be sure to check your mic and ask how many people will be in the plane before going.

review_title: K2's flights to and in Denali National Park
review_text: Of all the flights I've taken in Alaska this was both the most exciting and smoothest ride of all.  My pilot (Phil) was also well versed when talking about Denali.  He could maneuver the plane as if it was a part of him.  Such smooth turns when flying up along the glaciers in Denali.  I'll remember this for a lifetime.

The shuttle picked us up on time at our hotel, and then explained to us how to walk downtown after our trip and where to pick up our hotel shuttle back.  Check in was easy for the flight, even weighing everyone (discreetly) for safety.  The pilot gave us a great safety demonstration and told us able all his experience.  The landing after the flight was smooth and flawless.  Unfortunately, I don't remember the pilot's name but he made everyone feel comfortable.  We had a group of 9, 6 adults and 3 kids.  Getting see Denali up close, with the other mountains and glaciers was just WOW!

review_title: Book a flight, you won't regret it! Amazing experience and staff!
review_text: Everyone at K2 was great! Our original booking date had bad weather, so we were offered a refund or a rescheduled flight. We ended up rescheduling twice after speaking with people at K2 trying to get the best chance for a good flying day. When we arrived, we were told it was a 50/50 chance to see Denali, so we knew there was a chance that we may not see the mountain or be able to land on the glacier. They offered us three chance to take another flight, or even a refund since conditions weren't the best. We took the chance and ended up being very lucky to have great views of the summit on Denali, and land on the glacier. Our pilot was very knowledgeable of the area and history, which made the flight more interesting. I had my 4 year old son with me, and everyone at K2 was great with him. Patiently answering questions and making sure he was okay before and during the flight. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. This was the experience a lifetime. If you're thinking about it, or just in the area, book a flight with K2. You won't regret it.

In all our research for Alaska, what stood out the most was the encouragement to see Alaska from as many perspectives as we could - land, sea, air. When we figured out that flightseeing out of Talkeetna would not only work great for our schedule, but allow us to experience the Alaska Range and Mount Denali, it wasn't a hard choice to go with K2 Aviation. The reviews were overwhelmingly positive, and we really appreciated the transparency on their website for the different routes available. From booking, to arrival, and check-in, the staff was very kind and helpful. I tend to be a bit of a nervous flyer ever since experiencing a super bumpy ride many years ago in a small 2 seater plane, but Lauren in the office was so encouraging and genuine in putting my mind at ease. We had booked the Denali Grand Tour, but due to weather conditions up there, we weren't going to be able to fly that route. Instead, we were offered the Denali Flyer and a refund for the price difference. For anyone wondering if a certain time of day is best, there really isn't, and all the staff confirmed this. Whatever time works best for you, is the best time to go! We were there for a 6:30 PM and it was an absolutely beautiful, sunny and clear day - and yet we still had changes because the cloud and/or wind conditions are always going to be completely different higher up and around the mountains. We had an absolutely fantastic time, and I felt great throughout the flight! I do recommend being on Dramamine or Bonine if you're prone to motion sickness and/or have some anxiety with flying - take one dose the night before to metabolize in your system, and one prior to your activity. Being prepared is key! Our pilot Mitch was very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable about anything and everything we saw from the air. The views were breathtaking, and we learned so much! It was an almost out of this world experience to feel like you're floating above and among the mountains. We were prepared to do a glacier landing, but some last minute cloud cover interfered. It was still an awesome experience though, and one we won't soon forget!

Landing on Ruth Glacier was superb!  It was so picturesque and smooth.  The scenic views are so magnificent and awe-inspiring.  Garrett piloted us safely allowing scenic photographic opportunities and a personal experience of walking on the glacier.  His narrative was not only informative but passionate.

great flight thru Denali, we saw the glaciers and the rest of the range up close.  the views were spectacular.  Our pilot Wilbur was great.  provided great narration throughout the flight.  Highly recommend, this is a must do.

This is amazing. Landing on a glacier on Denali was surreal. The flight in was fine although weather conditions and fire smoke made the views so so.  But once we got close to the mountain and once we landed it was so clear and vivid and stunning. Don’t miss it.  Definitely opt for the glacier landing

We loved this experience! Joe, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and did a great job. We loved flying over the glaciers and really getting a bird's eye view of them. Awesome experience that we would do again!
This flight is an excellent way to see Denali and the whole mountain range. Our pilot,  Will, was the best!

We went on 11am flight. The views were awesome. We saw so many glaciers, tents of hikers for Denali. We landed on Ruth Glacier. The only thing we didn't do was circle all around Denali due to weather on other side. My suggestion take as early flight as you can. The weather seems to change as day goes on. Another suggestion, ask to sit up front. I was co-pilot best experience I've ever had.

This was an amazing experience!  From the moment we took off, we were in awe of the beauty of the Alaska Mountains and the pilot was very informative about the entire area and geology of the glaciers and the mountains.  The highlight of the trip was the glacier landing and getting out on the glacier and experiencing this unique geological feature from the ground.  This trip was truly the high point of our Alaskan experience and we would recommend it to anyone!  The company was very communicative and worked diligently to accommodate us when the weather caused our first trip to be canceled.

What a great time
Beautiful sights great pilot
Landed on the glacier and he made sure we all had a lot of pictures
Excellent

Seamless experience throughout, especially given the variable weather.  We were able to delay our experience and still do part of it.  The views were breathtaking and landing on a glacier was memorable.  Our children ages-18, 14 and 12 loved every moment.  Pilot was engaging and encouraged us to ask questions as we were up in the air.  Highly recommend!!!

review_title: Amazing Experience, Accommodating Staff! Don't Miss out!
review_text: We had an amazing experience with K2 on our Denali Flyer Tour with Glacier Landing!!  I was hesitant to book because I am claustrophobic and my son is 6'7" tall.  I was worried about both of our comfort on the flight. I called in to book and spoke with the K2 staff and they told me they would put us on one of their "bigger" planes.  We ended up on a 10-seater (incl. pilot) and we were all comfortable!  I so appreciated the fact that they heard my concerns and didn't minimize them but found a perfect solution.  The flight itself was spectacular and the glacier landing was the highlight!  We had perfect weather and the views of Denali were amazing!  Highly recommend this activity and this company!  Was the highlight of our Alaskan adventure!

An experience not to be missed! Our very experienced and capable pilot Lou gave us an amazing flight over the Alaska Range and onto the Ruth Glacier - absolutely breath-taking! The highlight of our three-week tour!

review_title: A Once in a Lifetime Experience
review_text: Lou was an excellent pilot and took us on an amazing flight.  The highlight was landing on the glacier.  When we first took off there was an issue with the back tire.  Lou landed the plane and the lady at the office gave us several options as to what we would like to do.  We decided to wait and within 20 minutes our plane was ready again and it was back to amazing scenery.  All I can say is do this if you get the chance.  K2 Avaition is a good company.  They seemed really focused on safety and on making sure everyone enjoyed their experience.

Just another glowing review for this experience.  Yes it’s expensive but it’s such a unique experience that you’ll talk about for the rest of your life.  The glacier landing is a must.  Don’t even hesitate.  Our pilot was Connor and he was excellent.  All staff were excellent and a top notch outfit.

We had an amazing experience on the Denali Flightseeing Tour with our family of 10.  Just us 10 and Wilbur the seasoned and fantastic pilot. I had done this trip 20 years ago and was excited to show my family what I believe is the best tourist experience in Alaska or anywhere. It didn't disappoint. Plan to take a day or two in your trip to make this flight.   Weather is unique in Denali and it is best with cooperative weather conditions.

review_title: An Experience You Will Never Forget
review_text: Our pilot Wilbur did a wonderful job, you can tell he loves what he does and sharing his knowledge and experience of the Denali area and glaciers. The landing was something I will remember for the rest of my life. The weather was perfect and it was actually warmer on the glacier than I expected. Great photo opportunity so be sure to bring your camera or phone.  There are not enough adjectives to describe the experience - fantastic, wonderful, awesome! Be sure to add the landing to your flight.

Vielen Dank an das K2-Team! Der Flug war perfekt organisiert, vom Check-In bis Verlassen des Vorfeldes!

Dorothea war ein tolle Pilotin, die uns sicher über die wunderschöne Landschaft bis zum Denali geflogen hat. Auch wenn wir den Gipfel aufgrund der Wolken nicht erreicht haben, war es ein wahnsinnig tolles Erlebnis.

Vielen Dank nochmal, der Ausflug ist wirklich zu empfehlen! Auch ein besonderer Dank an Dorothea!

review_title: High point of any Alaskan vacation
review_text: The glacier landing flight is so far among the highlights of our Alaska vacation. Well, maybe, except for seeing the moose with her calves. 😀. Being on top of the glacier looked almost like being on another planet. The flight over was beyond words. And the time spent on the glacier was fantastic. Chad was a great pilot.

Beautiful views. The pilot gets so close to the mountains you feel like you could reach out and touch them. The glacier landing provides phenomenal views. Be aware... Flight is bumpy. Maybe consider some motion sickness meds and/or some vomit baggies.

AMAZING!!!  Definitely worth the money - and you MUST include glacier landing!!  Was the smoothest take offs, landings and flight of our entire vacation.  It's surreal to be so close to this magnificence!

The option to land was up in the air due to weather, but we were so happy to be the first flights all week to land on the Glacier. It was like being in the magazines you see, and the feeling was magical. I appreciate the professionalism, safety and knowledge of this well organized company! Well worth the money and trip. JUST DO IT!
Worth every dollar, only note is that I wish y’all had an ATM (unless I missed it) so I could pull cash to tip pilot. Other than that I loved it so much.

review_title: Highly Recommend!  Was a family favorite experience!
review_text: We had a wonderful trip to Alaska and this adventure was one of our family's favorites.  We had a clear day so we felt very fortunate to be able to see Denali from various areas and especially while flying around it.  We had Connor as our pilot who was very knowledgeable, experienced and made us feel very safe throughout the entire experience.  Our flight was very smooth throughout and he made our trip very enjoyable.  Definitely recommend adding the glacier landing as it was unbelievably special to be in such a unique and remote area.

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing
review_text: This tour was amazing.  Absolutely Spectacular! Like nothing we have ever experienced.  We were fortunate to be able to do the entire fly over of Denali along with the glacier stop.  Don’t skip the glacier landing!  K2 was extremely professional, informative and made the trip very easy to book.  Our pilot Lou had been flying for 40 years and was a wealth of knowledge about Denali, the mountains, the glaciers and more.  He was very safe and made us feel comfortable and at ease the entire time.  We would highly recommend them for a flightseeing tour out of Talkeetna.

Just do it! Stunning views. We included the glacier landing and will never forget it. We flew with Wilbur, who was super thorough, calm and experienced. Loved every second, but the glacier experience Beats all! Wear the glacier boots!

We were so lucky to have a beautiful day for a flight tour....no clouds around Denali.
The airstrip is within a short walk from the train "station".  The office looked fairly new and everyone was very friendly and helpful, happy for us for the good weather.  We checked in (don't sweat the weigh-in) and after a short wait, our pilot came to collect us.  We were again fortunate in two ways:  we were the only 2 on the tour and Leon was our pilot.  Leon was a climbing guide for 12 years before transitioning to the air and he was incredible.  So much information and experience to share!  This is a very professional group and the tour was well worth the cost.  An unforgettable experience!!

Unbelievable lifetime experience! Our whole family had great time and we took a lot of photos at the top of the mountain.  
We do not see huge amounts of ice, but it is top of the mountain covered with snow.  Maybe there are ice under the snow.  We did see ice on the flights.

Flying among the magnificent peaks in Denali was the best part of our Alaska trip. It felt like you could reach out and touch the mountains. And landing on the glacier and walking on it was such a rush! 

Our pilot (who trains other pilots) did an excellent job. The flight was smooth and his commentary was informative and interesting.

We were lucky to be in Alaska during an unusual hot, dry time when Denali was visible every day. I also feel lucky to have chosen K2 for this experience. From the wonderful Ernie, to the bus driver, to the pilot everyone did their best to ensure I had a safe & enjoyable time. I rate them AWESOME!
My favorite part was seeing the immensity of the landscape.  The pilot was great at explaining what we were seeing and covering a lot of territory.  Everyone was so nice.

review_title: Grand Flight Seeing tour from Talkeetna was amazing
review_text: We had taken the Grand Flight Seeing tour from Talkeetna. It was a magnificent experience. Our pilot was very good and professional. He gave us a very good tour of the Denali mountains, the glaciers and all other surrounding mountains. The weather was perfect and views were amazing. Definitely worth the price and an activity not to miss in Alaska !
Highlight of our trip!  I would highly recommend it if you can. Everyone was great!  Our pilot Riley was professional and personable!

review_title: The best decision we made was to use K2 Aviation. Very organized incredibly friendly .
review_text: I think the best part of our flight was our pilot Leon! So incredibly knowledgeable and entertaining. I truly had the best time. When we landed on the glacier he never rushed us we got to spend some time taking some incredible photos. I would highly highly highly recommend this organization for sightseeing and if you can request Leon you'll be golden! The whole experience was incredible!

Amazing!! Nothing like seeing the mountains that close and personal! Our pilot, Riley, was very entertaining and informative. It was such a great experience to land on the Ruth Glacier. A dream!! Definitely reccomend.

review_title: Add this to the Bucket List!
review_text: If you want to see Denali up close and personal this is a must do. Well worth the money we had awesome weather and visibility was close to perfect. Bucket List for sure.

This was a fantastic experience and K2 is absolutely top notch.  Landing on a glacier was so smooth and the beauty of glacier is overwhelming and breathtaking.  Air is so crisp and sky so clear that Denali was totally visible.  My photographs are. Fantastic thanks to K2.  I would do this tour again and again if I could.

The K2 Denali experience was fantastic! Our pilot, Dorothy, was experienced, professional, and knowledgeable. While in the air, the views were unbelievable! Then, we also had a glacier landing, which was even more spectacular! Do not miss the opportunity to go on the K2 flyer!

review_title: Wow!!! Do I have to say more?
review_text: Wow!!!! Is that enough?  This was the best small plane trip I’ve ever been on.  Our pilot, Leon, was fantastic, the landing on the glacier was in unbelievable experience, flying around Denali exceeded expectations!  I can’t say enough about this… just an amazing, memorable experience.
Best day in Alaska thanks to Pilot Chad Smith of K2 Aviation! The glacier landing was flawless and the views were spectacular.
What an absolute breathtaking experience. Puts viewing the great Mt Denali in a completely different perspective. Awesome experience. The pilot was completely professional and informative.

Amazing Views of the surrounding area!! Found out at hotel pick up  we wouldn't be able to land on the glacier due to extreme fog.  Disappointed but understand they can't control the weather! Dorothy was our pilot and she was great! Made it a fun experience explaining fun facts of the area and for small plane, Very smooth take off and landing! :) Would highly recommend this company as we looked at another flightseeing company out of Denali, to attempt a Glacier landing, and it was considerably More $$ for the exact same experience!

Billy was our pilot and did a wonderful job explaining what we were passing. The flight was smooth and, most importantly, felt very safe. 

We landed on Rose Glacier and he took our photos. Billy was very friendly and courteous. 

This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for many of us and our flight was taken on a perfect cloudless hour and day. 

The entire experience went smoothly from checkin to landing back at the airport.

review_title: Majestic bring you to tears experience!!
review_text: The view was majestic, literally brought me to tears, never could even imagine the beauty of Denali without this once in a lifetime flight experience, this is a must do!!!!

review_title: Simply a MUST DO Alaska activity....
review_text: Outstanding experience!  Our pilot (Wilber) was so professional and informative.  If you're in Alaska don't miss out on this once-in-a-lifetime experience!

Flight of a lifetime.  Views were absolutely spectacular.  Seeing Denali from close up and from up high were so much more impressive than from the lodge.  The flight is a must to truly see the mountains.  Pilot was wonderful and so knowledgeable.  Plane was comfortable and smooth.  Glacier landing was a thrill.  Flight seeing is a must do if you come to Denali.
Being able to fly close to and land on Denali.  Chris was great with his knowledge and taking photos for everyone.  The day was beautiful, the flight perfect.

Incredible!! Unlike anything we've done or seen! I was nervous for the small plane and had zero complaints or motion sickness throughout. This company knows what they're doing - the building, welcome staff, gear, planes, pilots - all professional, clean, and organized. We thought this was well worth the cost! Outside of just the amazing views our pilot provided TONS of interesting facts about Alaska, flying, the wildlife, the mountains, etc; took our pictures on the glacier landing; and even walked us through the flying techniques and process (I think this helped to calm anyone's nervous). I was on the fence in booking and now would HIGHLY recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska.
The weather was perfect, and the views were outstanding. The pilot was great ! She was well informed and funny.

Wow! The flight we took landed on a glacier and the weather couldn’t have been better. We were able to see every mountain range including those who were hiking Mt Denali. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight was smooth. Highly recommend taking this tour when visiting.
Seeing the North side of Denali on a perfectly clear day and then walking on the Ruth Glacier. Our pilot was the best!
Fantastic experience!! The pilot was amazing getting us up close and personal with the mountains.  The glacier landing topped it off wonderfully.. Such amazing views it doesn't even seem real.

This was amazing!   At first I did not plan on going and was sending a family member.  

I am a larger person and just assumed this was not something I could do.      When checking in my family member the person asked if I was going and then asked me why not.  When I explained why - he was amazing.   Made me feel comfortable and assured me I was perfectly able to go. 

Despite. It planning on it - I joined my family member on a most amazing adventure!

Absolutely amazing sights.  I felt safe.  The staff was amazing.   This is a bucket list item - even if you don’t know it yet!!!
This is a fantastic experience and highly recommended for anyone!  Hard to describe and pictures just don't do it justice.  It's not that expensive, if the mountain is clear just go!!

review_title: Put this on your bucket list!
review_text:
All of the pictures, videos, and words can not  describe this magnificent trip. If you are going to be in Talkeetna take this flight!!
We arrived on the train the day before our scheduled flight. It was a clear day and you could see the whole mountain. Our cabin host suggested that we ask if K2 could take us up a day earlier...they did!!

To my surprise, My wife decided last minute that she would fly Denali and do a Glacier landing. This was the most memorable adventure that we did in our Alaska vacation. These guys are highly recommended and the office staff was all great also. When they found out it was her birthday, they gave her a nice complementary gift upon our return. I can't recommend them enough!

This tour was one of the best experiences I could have done in Alaska! It was amazing to fly above the glaciers and see them from the plane-truly an Alaskan experience. The pilots were both polite and professional, the planes were safe and well-equipped with headsets and gear, and the entire process was enjoyable. Even when the weather prevented a glacier landing, the pilots gave us a great flight over and around the glaciers that this area is so famous for. Truly magical.

review_title: Awesome Denali Flight with Glacier Landing
review_text: Loved the trip and we managed to do a Glacier Landing and walk around. It is only from the air do you get a true appreciation of the scale and beauty of the various Mountain Ranges.

There is not one favorite part......the trip was a memory I will think of for the rest of my life.  The pilot was a wealth of knowledge, the views looking at the mountains and various glaciers was just outstanding.  If the weather cooperates, don't think twice, do it.  The glacier landing.....what can I say, other than you have to do it if you have the opportunity.

K2 staff and pilot professional, facilities clean and all were accommodating.  Had to get a red K2 hat when leaving......with the plane we rode in on the top front.

My wife and I took the Denali Flyer tour as part of our 25th Anniversary trip to Alaska.  It was amazing!  We had perfect weather and the views of Denali were spectacular...officially part of the 30% club.  Our pilot, whose name I unfortunately don't remember, gave us a perfect flight and provided information on everything from the peaks and glaciers we flew past to the history of Denali...he made the experience even more enjoyable.  If we ever return to Alaska, we will definitely be taking another flight with K2 and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a wonderful experience.

Best part was the flight and the staff, the views were amazing! The glacier landing was also amazing, a first for myself and the view on the glacier was top notch! Chad the pilot was terrific, very professional, accommodating, and knowledgeable! A must do on your state visit!

Absolutely magnificent!! This is a must do and K2 is the way to go. Safe, knowledgeable, and friendly...K2 made this experience the best. Landing on the glacier,, seeing the peaks, and flying through the Great Gorge were the best parts.
Amazing experience! The view from the plane is gorgeous. I recommend doing it, it’s worth it! Thank you
Fun, exciting and fact-filled. Excellent pilot. Great time on the glacier. They provided boots for the glacier.

Super friendly, and knowledgeable about the area. One of the more life changing experiences, to fly through such an amazing magical place. Even as a life long Alaskan, I am STILL in awe over the beauty  of the glaciers, mountains, and terrane.  I highly recommend K-2

Family of 8 travel to Alaska in August 2021.  K2 was able to accommodate us all on the same flight.
Weather was perfect, clear and sunny.  We had the most amazing experience. 
As the pilot took us around, giving us information and making sure we all had a perfect view every time!  We came to see Denali and we were so lucky to see it very clearly and different viewpoints, only thing that made it even more fantastic was that  we were the lucky few to see all 3 peaks!!  Thank you for a memorable experience.

Probably the best experience we had in Alaska. The crew at the office was super friendly, and the pilot provided a lot of informations. He was passionated about the flight, and about what he was seeing with us.
An incredible view (the weather was all clear, lucky us), a fabulous experience for people who know they will never get the chance to hike on those mountains. We had the feeling to touch them, such a great tour!!

My family of 5 ranging in ages of 18 to 73 embarked on this amazing flight in March 2022.  I admit I was a bit nervous as flying can bring anxiety sometimes but Billy - our pilot was GREAT!  He informed us about the flying experience before we headed outside to the plane.  Once outside by the plane, we had additional instructions and it made us all feel quite secure.  We were given headphones so Billy could talk to us, ask us questions, and let us know what we were seeing as we flew overhead.  
We were blessed with a cloudless and BEAUTIFUL day.  Seeing Denali up close was breathtaking.  The time went by so quickly and we are grateful we had the opportunity to experience these mountains upclose and see the glaciers from above.  
we highly recommend this tour.

We were fortunate to have perfect weather for our flight around Denali. Our pilot/guide, Dorothy was terrific. She was knowledgeable about the mountains and did a great job of pointing out the peaks surrounding Denali. We were also able to get great views of glaciers. It truly was a breathtaking experience. Highly recommend!

This something everyone should do when coming to Alaska. You won’t find a better view of the Denali mountain range. I had initially booked k2 for the wrong dates they quickly and efficiently resolved my mistake and were able to reschedule me for the correct date. All in all I would definitely fly with them again

I am born and raised in Alaska and I have done this tour at least four times now. When we have friends and family visit, this is always our most recommended activity. The views are breathtaking. The pilots are always so kind, informative, and skilled. The staff are so helpful in booking trips, assisting with weather forecasts, and getting us ready for our flight. Thank you, KT Aviation, for such a wonderful service for visitors and residents!

A clear day gave us the most amazing views of Denali and glaciers that I could imagine!   Landing on and exploring the glacier was one of the highlights of our Alaskan adventure.  Please book this trip if you can, you will not regret it!!

First time I've taken a flightseeing tour it was amazing!  When I got to K2 they made the process super easy, and it included the glacier landing. We got on our snow boots (make sure you do this) and got into the De Havilland Otter.  If you have a choice sit on the right side because the view are slightly better. We landed on the glacier and the snow was powdery soft and two feet thick. This is where the snow boots help to keep your pants from getting wet. The quiet and beauty were breathtaking.  Chris the pilot did an great job  providing narration and safely guiding the plane up and back. The folks in the office were very helpful and answered all our questions. If you have a chance, you have to make time for this!

The whole experience was fabulous from the convenience of short notice booking to the easy check in and ultimately with the flight and our pilot! The facility is welcoming and the staff is efficient and friendly. Any apprehension I felt was alleviated by Joe’s calm and professional nature. He was friendly, informative and patient as he flew us over the beautiful terrain of Alaska into the mountain region. Landing and getting to walk around on the glacier was thrilling in many ways. This was an unforgettable experience overall. I highly recommend this company and cannot wait to return again some day.

A totally AWESOME experience. One of the most beautiful flights and landing on a glacier was a trilling experience that everyone should have on their bucket list.
Captain Stan was polite, courteous, experienced and extremely professional.
He did an outstanding job explaining and informing passengers of the history and facts surrounding Denali. He was also funny and entertaining and a great tour guide.
I would highly recommend this experience to anyone and everyone, well worth the cost (which was my only hesitation) but now realize it as money well spent and a memory of a life time!!

This tour was incredible!! Everything about the operation was smooth and easy!! The pilot was very skilled, helpful, and knowledgeable! And the sights were out of this world!! It will be hard to top this experience!!

AMAZING
We actually loved our first trip so much we booked a 2nd trip on our way back through Talkeetna.
1st trip we just did a flightseeing tour around Denali - it was a little cloudy so didn't see the peak of Denali but the rest of the views were spectacular and the Pilot Chris was amazing and now my dad's new friend!
2nd trip we actually did a glacier landing and were able to land in fresh snow - it was absolutely beautiful and a great flight again.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!

WOW! Spectacular day with a great flight. Smooth flight with great narration by the pilot telling us the Denali story. Glacier landing is a must if the weather allows it- be sure to wear the boots they provide because the fluffy snow on the glacier was above "normal" hiking boot level. Efficient check in process. Great facilities. With 4 days notice they allowed us to delay 1 day for a better weather forecast which turned out to be a great change. Not a cheap flight, but worth every penny.

Denali is on the short-list of everybody's travel plans in Alaska. We decided to take this plane tour with glacier landing and although it was pricey, it was well worth it. You get to fly to the tallest mountain in North America and land on a glacier. Not many chances to experience something like that. The flight takes a total of 1.5-2 hours and is narrated by the pilot. You fly from Talkeetna into the mountain range. We had clear views of Denali as we approached the glacier. After we landed, we were able to get off the plane and walk around for 15 minutes in this truly magical place on top of a glacier. The flight to and from Denali was mostly smooth and our pilot did a great job avoiding the clouds and turbulence. This is an experience we will cherish forever. Thanks K2!!

An unbelievable experience! Fortunately, it was a sunny day with clear, blue skies making for a perfect excursion into Denali and glacier landing. Our pilot, Stan, was fantastic! Highly recommend for a spectacular time!

We got very lucky with the weather and got put on a longer flight that lasted for about two hours. The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. It was such a great way to see Denali and the view was worth every minute and every penny. I highly recommend doing the glacier landing as it was an incredible experience. They also provide sunglasses and waterproof boots if you don't have your own.
It was amazing, the best experience in my life, awesome views from Denali Mountain, the pilot was great, he landed in a glacier, it was just amazing, I 100% recommended

I can't say enough good things about K2. We booked the flightseeing glacier landing tour but the weather was iffy, so we didn't land, which was fine. I had a little anxiety about the flight, having never been in such a small aircraft, but it was clear from the outset that this place is professional and I had no cause for concern. There were about 9 people on the plane. The pilot inspired complete confidence, and we flew over glaciers, between mountain peaks, were treated to informative commentary, were able to ask questions, and my traveling companion even got to ride in the cockpit. It was amazing.  Reasonably priced. Do not miss the opportunity.

Flying near Denali on a sunny day with excellent pilot was a highlight of our Alaska tour.  The awesome ( in the true sense of the word) scenery took our breathbaway...the size of the mountain and surround crags and valleys, the long Ruth Glacier, Great Gorge and Amphitheater spectacular.
Chad was our pilot and made for an incredible experience! Seeing these beautiful mountains from this perspective was once in a lifetime experience. Stop reading reviews and just book already!

This was definitely the highlight of our trip.  From booking to landing K2 was awesome.
Our pilot Chad was a phenomenal pilot and narrator.  Our flight was incredible and something we will never forget.  And of course Denali was beaming in the sunlight!!! 
If you think you would want to try this stop thinking and book with K2 they are amazing friendly, helpful, group of people.  And thank you Ernie for your help as well with the shirt!

We did the shortest tour (not sure if I labeled correctly on review) and it was epic! We saw tons of nature and plenty of awesome landscapes with Denali. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly! Would recommend to anyone as a day trip on the way to or back from Denali!

What an awesome flight! Very professional company. Our pilot Joe was great, sharing a lot of information about the area.  Landing on the glacier and flying through and around the mountains was an incredible experience.
Landing on the glacier at the base camp of the Denali climbers. The pilot/narrator was very thorough and showed great piloting skills. Wow!
We had a great time! It was the most memorable thing we did on our entire trip! Garrett was an excellent pilot and guide. We would highly recommend K2 Aviation!

Professional operation from the front desk clerks to our incredibly experienced pilot. I’ve been an Alaskan resident for 45 years and this is at the top of my list. I will be sure to send all of my guests straight to K2.
All of it... and landing on the glacier was a once in a life time experience.  We had plenty of time on the glacier to take all in. Going around Denali was magic.

It was such a well run operation. The admin staff were terrific in helping us to select the right experience for us. The pilot was so professional and was a wealth of info on what we were seeing. The walk on the glacier was breath taking. Recommend this experience. Worth every penny!

K2 is THE flight service to take when in the area of Denali. All personnel are courteous and helpful is booking or rearranging your flight if the local weather does not accommodate your original flight. They all, want to make your flight an exceptional and extraordinary experience, and they succeed.

Landing on the glacier was amazing!! We had beautiful clear weather and very little turbulence. There had also been fresh snow the day before.  This of course were ideal conditions but our pilot was great and very informative too!

review_title: Glacier Landing Perfect! We enjoyed the flight seeing with our pilot, Garret, on the De Havilland K2 Red airplane!!
review_text: A very special trip to Pica Glacier on a cool September sunny day. We flew ar 10:30am, and returned to airport 2 hours later, Threw snowballs on the glacier and even builf a snow man. Worth every penny.

By far the best day of our 11 days in Alaska!  Landing on the glacier and seeing the mountains up close is something we will never forget!  Our kids were able to take turns in the cockpit on the way out and back, and the pilot made our trip extremely memorable.  The flight was smooth and the headsets make it easy to talk.  Can't recommend this trip enough!  You won't be sorry you fly with them.

review_title: Highlight of my trip to Alaska
review_text: This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska. The flight was incredible and something I'll never forget. The staff was super helpful and our pilot was wonderful! They were accommodating and everything ran smoothly. Would highly recommend this to anyone who is up in Talkeetna!

We originally signed up for the Denali Summit tour with the glacier landing. However, when we arrived they said the weather and visibility was too poor to go to higher elevations. Instead, they asked if we wanted to switch to the Denali Experience or reschedule. We went ahead and chose the Denali Experience for that day. Our pilot was very knowledgable about the area we were flying over. He gave clear instructions about the safety of the tour (both airplane related and COVID). He mentioned how we had a unique experience that showed us more of the lower mountains that you don't normally see. He did a great job accommodating the changes and still provided a wonderful tour.

This experience was amazing for our entire family, which includes three young boys (8, 5, 3). They were very accommodating of the kids. They had car seats installed for them and ready to go in the plane, and they had their own kids' ear protection. Landing on the glacier was SO COOL! These memories will last a lifetime. Thank you K2!

I have thousands of flight hours, in both small General Aviation airplanes and in military aircraft, and have had some pretty amazing experiences, BUT….   nothing I have ever experienced in an aircraft has been more amazing and more enjoyable than this one hour flight!   I know you’re weighing the cost, but trust me - just do it!    You will never regret the money you have spent on this experience!

review_title: Top Activity to do in Talkeetna
review_text: Great flight around Denali and glacier landing.  The pilot very informative and highly recommend doing the trip when in Talkeetna.

review_title: An experience even long time Alaskans value
review_text: We have lived in Alaska since 1982 and travelled extensively in remote areas of the state.  We typically stay away from touristy places like Talkeetna in the summer but decided to take a cousin from Texas on a flight seeing trip with K2.  It was an A-1 experience from booking to post flight.  The staff at K2's office are easy going and helpful, the pilot (Chad) is one of the best we've ever flown in a single engine plane with and they collectively work their tails off to deliver a fantastic experience. There's not a bad seat in the plane to watch beautiful mountain scenes unfold below and around you.  Definitely pick a tour that includes a glacier landing!

Yes you might hesitate to take a moment or more when considering the cost since it can be around the same as a domestic flight in the "lower 49" but PLEASE don't let that get in the way of you having one of the MOST incredible experiences during your visit to Alaska. The flights and proximity to the glaciers is unspeakably beautiful and worth every cent. We were unable to make a glacier landing that day because of weather but we were not disappointed as it was a spectacular experience. Joe was our pilot and incredibly professional and pleasant to talk with. Don't worry about the $$$ it is truly worth the cost.

What a great sight seeing flight!  We had booked a 3 pm all around Denali, they picked us up at our hotel and drove us to K2 Aviation.  The check in process was quick and easy and after a 10 minute wait our names were called for the flight.  Our pilot (forgot her name) was very informative with the safety measures and soon we were in the air.  Wow, what an up close experience flying around the mountains on a perfectly clear day!  Our pilot was very informative (with out talkin too much), she flew both ways so that each side of the plane had a chance to get clear pictures.  This was just a fantastic experience it was the highlight of our trip!!!
You, guys made my day! Great customer service! This is an experience of a lifetime! Above Denali, we also landed on the glacier. Was awesome to sunbathe on the snow for a bit. Thank you ❤️
K2 is so professional from their check in  ground crew to their flight staff! We experienced an awesome glacier landing. Thanks, Stan for making this trip unforgettable!

Experienced pilots and very  informed about the local geography. The trip was worth it because of the information that the pilot was able to share during the flight. 
Would highly recommend this tour for every one visiting Alaska.

One of the highlights of our trip to Alaska--the weather was perfect, views were phenomenal, and the experience of landing on a glacier was breathtaking. The K2 Aviation staff was friendly and professional, and made the whole operation run seamlessly. Our pilot was very experienced and put us all at ease, and went out of his way to help us enjoy our trip.
They were absolutely great. They were very informative. Pointed out a lot of scenery. I will be back.

review_title: Book it now you crazy fool!!
review_text: HOLY BALLS! WORTH EVERY CENT!! This was one of the most amazing things I’ve ever done. You have to add the glacier landing too. The whole thing was breathtaking. Chris was the best pilot! He shared lots of knowledge on the area as we flew. Do not pass up this opportunity. BOOK IT!!!

The flight to Denali and through the canyons around the other mountains was spectacular.  We had such a soft landing on the glacier.  We had tremendous sunny and blue skies which is uncommon for August and there had been snow two days earlier so it was a trip to be remembered forever.  The gods lined up and this was the best tour that we took during our 2 week trip to Alaska's interior. Our pilot, Chris was incredibly skilled and knowledgeable   I would highly recommend it and if you are coming in August please have time in your itinerary to do a reschedule if the weather does not cooperate for you.
Great experience. Wonderful weather and awesome views of Denali and the surrounding area. Pilot Maury was fantastic, with great commentary and a smooth flight.

Our trip to Alaska wouldn’t be the same if we hadn’t had the experience of flying over Denali National park and landing on a glacier at the foot of Mt. Denali.
Everything was top notch during registration and preflight, and Chip, our pilot, was a font of information.  He made sure we all enjoyed the trip, including a woman who couldn’t bend her knee.

I did the flight seeing tour with Glacier Landing on our first full day in Alaska  It was also the highlight of our Alaska vacation.  This was a bucket list item that was well worth the price.  I waited till three days prior to arriving in Alaska to book the trip based on the weather forecast.  If you're visiting Alaska this is definitely a must.  The views and scenery were amazing.  The entire staff at K2 Aviation definitely made this a memorable experience.

They weren't able to do the glacier landing due to weather which was a huge bummer but the flight itself was amazing and our captain really did a great job explaining things and narrating for us.  This is clearly a well run business. Pictures came out amazing.

I wish we could remember our pilots name she was awesome.  She was very knowledgeable about the history of the area. This was our first trip to Alaska and the little town of Talkeetna is great. The Piper Plane tour around and through Denali was just amazing. We had a very clear, bright day. Everyone told us it was a very unusual day for the season.  If you head this way this trip is a must.

review_title: K2 Aviation makes the experience seamless.
review_text:
It was an amazing experience overall. Smooth flight, incredible views and vistas. Our pilot Joe was fantastic, so professional and calming. Would go back in a heartbeat and highly recommend. 

We actually had to cancel a glacier landing due to weather, so we just did a shorter flight. But honestly, we were able to spend more time in the air over the mountains seeing the glaciers, which ended up being a blessing. I cannot imagine that a glacier landing would have added much to the trip. It was perfect exactly like it was.

Great service and highly professional staff. Unfortunately our initial flight to Denali Glacier got cancelled due to adverse weather conditions, but K2 team tried during all day to rebook us on another flight, in the hope that the weather conditions improved. Since that did not happened they proposed us an alternative tour to the Knick Glacier, which we accepted and that turned out amazing. Airplanes look in a perfect shape, pilots are highly professional and we felt totally safe. Highly recommended!
Weather made landing on glacier be cancelled.  However, flight and pilot were great, and just as we got near, the clouds cleared, and we saw Mount Denali.  Got amazing photos.  Thank you.

review_title: Great sight seeing flight at K2 Aviation
review_text: Our pilot Morrie was a highly experienced professional and gave us a thorough safety and aircraft familiarization briefing, provided a very interesting and appropriate narration of the incredible terrain we were seeing, and made every effort to ensure we had great photo opportunities.   We were on a very tight schedule  to leave Talkeetna and at the conclusion of the tour  the helpful front desk people at K2 immediately whisked us back to our hotel to meet our bus.   You really don't want to miss this sight seeing experience!!

On two other trips to Alaska I have booked with K2 and had the flights cancelled due to weather.  Please note that this was no problem for me.  They are not going to fly if it is unsafe or they cannot provide you the experience you are paying for.  The money was promptly refunded.

On this trip we arrived in Talkeetna without a tour reservation.  As we drove in, I heard the planes taking off from the local airport.  I immediately rounded up the family and headed over to see if we could get on a flight.  It was no problem and 45 minutes later we were boarding a late afternoon tour.

I believe we were on the Denali Flyer.  My sense is the routes are a generalization of length and the areas they will try to show you.  I felt like the pilot adjusted the flight based on where things were clear and we could get the best views/experience for the time we had in the air.  It is unsafe and pointless to follow a route that is cloud-covered.  It was a great tour and I thought the pilot did an excellent job of allowing both sides of the plane to see the different sites.  He was informative about the area and things we were seeing.  This was the first activity we did in Alaska and set a great tone for the rest of the trip.  The family absolutely loved it.  We did not have the choice of a glacier landing due to the uncertain weather, so I cannot comment on whether that is a worthwhile addition.  I can say that, although expensive, you are not getting the most out of your Alaska trip without some flight seeing.  There is just too much of Alaska that is inaccessible from the ground.  You need to get into the air to truly get the full experience.  Highly recommend K2...take any trip you can afford.  If you have the option, I would take a cheaper trip and save money for a second trip of another kind...there is so much to see in this state.

There is not enough positive we can say about this tour!  Our pilot was awesome, the experience was unbelievable, and K2 was an incredible operation to work with.  The best thing my family has done period!  Our pilot, Chris, was incredible and engaging the whole way through and you can still see his excitement at flying this area.  We were able to do the glacier landing which I encourage everyone to do.  Standing on the glacier surrounded by those peaks is awe inspiring and takes your breath away.  This is the tour you have to do no matter what!  Thank you K2 and Chris for an experience and photos our family will never forget!!

We did the Denali Grand flightseeing tour and had a wonderful time! We saw some really cool things - mountains, glaciers, rivers, lakes. Our pilot Dorothy was really amazing and made the flight smooth and a lot of fun! We unfortunately couldn’t see the summit of Denali because of weather but that didn’t take away a lot from the experience.

We were lucky that the sky was clear and the Denali mountain peaks were spectacular already viewing from the Susitna riverfront in Talkeetna. But flying over the Denali mountain and landing on the glacier made it a lifetime experience! To experience the true grandness of Denali, this is a must do! The aircraft from K2-aviator is top notch, our pilot was very informative and executed an excellent tour and a safe flight. Absolutely the highlight of our Alaska trip.

review_title: Unforgettable once in a lifetime experience!!
review_text: This was an unforgettable once in a lifetime adventure! We loved everything about this awesome flight seeing tour! Landing on Mt Denali was simply amazing I highly recommend this adventure! Garret our pilot was very informative also!
This is a epic trip of memories and views. Well worth the money as you will learn a lot about Alaska and Denali as well. The glacier landing was amazing ! So glad we did this trip !

Denali Flyer with a glacier landing was a great experience. Our pilot, Chris, was great. Would recommend to anyone. It goes from one amazing view to another. 

I wish we could have gone further and seen the volcanos; it wasn’t offered as an option but something we would have paid extra for.

What an incredible experience, my favorite thing to do in Alaska, but what brought this to a completely different level, was our pilot Wilbert, Not only did we feel safe, his passion for the history and the terrain of all of our sites made this an incredible experience, if he didn’t say one word to us we would’ve been blown away, but there was not one moment where he was not explaining a peek, a river, a glacier, and that’s what brought this to a completely different level, outstanding Wilbert thank you…

There are not many words that can actually describe this experience. It's one of those things that makes traveling so far, all worth it! Firstly, I have to say that our original tour (with glacier landing) had to be modified due to weather. Being in Denali for a few days prior, my family and I were already setting our expectations because it had been very rainy and cloudy. The staff picked us up and let us know that we would not be able to land, as we already figured. They were so so accommodating though and you could tell they really wanted to do as much as they could to still get you flying, in the safest way possible. We opted for a 1 hour flight over Denali National Park. It was AMAZING!! Denali itself was covered in clouds that afternoon, so we can't include ourselves in the exclusive 30% club - but we did see the most beautiful views of Ruth Glacier and surrounding mountains. Our pilot was great as well and spent the whole flight pointing things out and was very knowledgeable and open to any of our questions. Overall, this is a must-do while you're in AK!!!

review_title: Bad Business Practice - No Warning for Canceled Flight
review_text: Due to weather we were not able to do the flight we had booked, including landing on a glacier. I understand that the weather cannot be controlled. I do not understand however the thought process behind not informing us via email or call to let us know our options. We are in Alaska for 10 days with plans down to the minute each day. Had we known we wouldn’t be flying we wouldn’t have even stopped in Talkeetna. They want you to come to the office to check in anyways so they can try and sell you a different flight. Seems unethical. Let us know ahead of time so we can make our own decisions. It’s not like they just decided not to fly when we got there.
Pilot was wonderful and explained everything we saw. Went above and beyond to make it a memorable experience.

Great trip. Saw the four peaks of Denali!  Pilot was friendly and the plane was in great shape!  Only complaint is that our headsets didn’t work and we couldn’t hear the pilot’s narrative.  Suggest you do a headset check before you take off

review_title: Amazing capstone to a summer Alaksan vacation
review_text: My wife and I were vacationing in Talkeetna at the beginning of Aug '21 and lucked upon several days of clear whether that gave spectacular views of Denali.  So we jumped at the chance of flying around Denali with K2 on our last morning in town.  It was phenomenal!  The K2 staff resolved a last-minute scheduling glitch (thanks again!) and got us on a flight at the appointed time.  Our pilot (Stan) was great both in terms of flying skill and sharing interesting information during the flight.  We got to fly among the soaring peaks, sheer cliffs, and beautiful glaciers.  Stan landed us on a glacier near the backcountry hut; this gave unparalleled views of Denali and other peaks, and a size/distance perspective that was awesome.  K2 really gave us the opportunity to take advantage of the good weather and end our trip with the highlight of the entire vacation.
We had a lovely time flying with Dorothy. Though our original route into Denali was cancelled, going over the Talkeetna mountains was amazing, and the ride was completely smooth.

The staff is pleasant and professional.  Our pilot Stan was great with a ton of information about Denali and the surrounding area!  Weren’t sure if we would get to do the glacier landing but the clouds parted and Stan made it happen!  What an amazing flight!  Treat yourself to this activity and you won’t regret it!

The experience was amazing the views Of the mountains was spectacular the landing on the glacier was flawless and a once in a lifetime experience. I would  highly recommend  this to anyone  and everyone

review_title: Absolutely Stunning Highlight of our Alaska Experience!
review_text:
This was, without a doubt, the highlight of our Alaska experience. We were fortunate enough to fly on a perfect blue sky day, and the flight was just absolutely stunning. The entire flight was spent in awe of Denali and it's grandeur. It was worth every penny. 

More importantly, our pilot Dorothy did an excellent job talking to my very, very flight-averse Mom, explaining where best to sit to reduce nausea, going over the safety requirements thoroughly, and generally her best to reassure her about everything. So major shout out, and a big thank you to Dorothy!

review_title: This incredible tour literally  and figuratively tops them all!
review_text:
When planning out my trip to Alaska. I decided to add a flight tour to my trip. I had heard a lot about flight tours being a very Alaskan experience and OMG the rumor are true. It's was honestly a very surreal and humbling experience.  

Our pilot Joe gently ushered our plane in and around some magnificent stream systems, lakes, foothills, mountains, and glaciers. He navigated all this while giving us all sorts of interesting geologic, historic, and ecologic details. He also basically landed us on the near tippy top of North America. 

I would absolutely recommend K2 to anyone who's considering this option while in Alaska. I promise you will not be disappointed!!

Had a wonderful with a very experience pilot and guide. He gave a great historical and biological narration. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.  Flew in a 1956 dehaviland Beaver.  Great fun with great photo ops.
K2 was absolutely amazing! My girlfriend and I really enjoyed our fly over experience! Pilot was professional and nice
What amazing up close views of the mountains!  Flying between the snow capped peaks with lots of glaciers.  Learned more about the glacier activity.  The K2 staff was pleasant & helpful.

The windows in the plane allowed for excellent viewing and the pilot adjusted the flight to get the best view from each side of the plane based on cloud conditions. One of the highlights of our vacation. First class operation.

review_title: I’d give it a “6” if I could!
review_text: First AK stop for a couple washed up AF Fighter guys and their boys….wow, it was incredible!  A bluebird day exposed Denali in all her glory, and landing on Ruth Glacier is an experience none of us will ever forget.  The Otter is a great way to fly and Joe was the perfect tour guide and pilot.  Driving through the valleys below the peaks was just incredible…staff was professional and even got some other recommendations from the Owner, Suzanne!  I was worried about the cost, but this experience and memory is priceless!!

The pilots were incredible! So experienced, so friendly and knowledgeable! We absolutely LOVED our experience flying with them. We took a tour and loved it so much, we booked a second tour the next day!

Wow....what an amazing experience.  We had a perfect day to go flying around Denali...the sun was out and so was the mountain.  You could see for miles and miles.  Our pilot (Chris) expertly navigated around the mountains and glaciers.  I almost felt like I could touch the cliffs and the mountain.  He did a great job of narrating the tour and telling us interesting anecdotes about the mountain.  K2 was totally professional.  They picked me up (and even called me to say they were running 5 minutes late).  When I realized that something fell out of the back of my pocket they were very accommodating about letting me go back to the plane and get it.  The plane felt safe and Chris was a total professional while flying.  Definitely worth the money and the experience.  And it is a great way to truly experience the majesty of Denali.  Kudos to K2

One of our top experiences in Alaska! Staff at K2 were efficient and helpful and there was a spot to lock up our backpacks since we could not take them in the plane. They even have sunglasses you can borrow and snow boots that fit over your shoes. Our pilot was great (Joe?). The ride was smooth, he took great care to make sure we could see things from both sides of the plane, talked to us about what we were seeing, and then managed a remarkable landing on the Ruth glacier. How often in your life to do you get to land on a glacier? Truly remarkable and breath taking. Bring your camera and/or little binoculars. Well worth the price.

A must for anyone who stops into Talkenna. A total WOW factor of 10 from all 9 passengers on the plane. Everyone has their own window seat to adventure. Our pilot was very informative on the surrounding topography and answered any questions we had. A totally awesome experience walking on the glacier.  Sunny and 73 degrees the day we landed on Ruth Glacier.  Entire flight staff from Check in, Pilot and Ground Crew is very Professional.  Thanx K2 Aviation for a once in a lifetime adventure!!!

review_title: A must do when in Talkeetna
review_text:
