We hemmed and hawed about doing a flight seeing experience.  I was the most nervous in the bunch.  Agreed at the last minute to do a Denali fly around with a glacier landing.  

Arrived at K2 for our reservation only to find out that the experience would be a bit different due to the weather in Denali area.  There would be a Denali approach, a Ruth Glacier fly over but no landing.  We were given the choice of getting a full refund or a partial refund if we agreed to the new experience option.  

Decided to go for it because we'd likely never get another opportunity during our AK stay.  We are very glad we did.  Saw Denali's peak as we peeked above the clouds.  Then spent some time over the enormous, breathtaking glacier.  Never seen anything quite like it.  I also enjoyed seeing the ground as we traveled back to the airport.  It was amazing to see the trails we had been on from a different perspective.  

The staff went above and beyond with us as I am hearing impaired.  They realized I wouldn't be able to understand the pilot, especially with him and everyone else masked, so they gave me a several page print out with information of everything I would see on the flight.  It wasn't anything we asked for either so I was very much appreciative of that.  

The pilot was excellent and clear as he gave his flight instructions to his passengers.  And the flight itself gave me nothing to fear.  I was very comfortable from start to finish.  

Highly recommend!

This is a great company.  The entire staff was friendly and helpful from our shuttle driver to the check-in staff and our pilot. The flight was fabulous! Beautiful sites and our pilot told us a lot about the area we saw! The flight was smooth and comfortable.  K2 takes care of everything!

I can't say enough positive things about this amazing experience. It was worth every penny and then some. Will(bur?) was an excellent pilot and a downright excellent human. He was extremely knowledgable, capable, fun, kind and cool. Check-in was easy and enjoyable (the office staff killed it). The 1956 Beaver was a beautiful and meticulously maintained aircraft. I can't imagine enjoying a flight as much as we did with K2 again in my life! Mount Denali and The Alaska Range ranks among the most beautiful and unique terrain in the world, and to be able to fly right next these majestic chunks of rock and ice was nothing less than spiritual ecstasy. A huge thumbs up and thanks to K2 Aviation!

My daughter and I had a great experience with our flight with Chad. He made sure that we are very comfortable during the flight, views that we saw from the plane were amazing and exceeded our expectations on every level.  We were hoping for a landing on glacier, but due to the weather conditions it was not possible. Despite this our flight was very memorable and we would definitely recommend K2 Aviation.

They said, "You'll see some of the best views of your life today." They WAY undersold it. Completely spectacular. A clear day and calm skies helped for sure, but our pilot, Chris, was a pro. We literally couldn't have asked for anything more. Great service, clean, properly maintained plane, super nice staff...really A++ all the way around.

review_title: Great on the glacier family trip
review_text: Fun family trip that got our young family on the glacier and closer than we otherwise would have come to that part of Denali. Took the Park Connection bus 3+ hrs one way from Denali lodge across from Grizzly Bear lodge to Talkeetna and worked well!

What a unique and exciting experience for our entire family! The flight was amazing and we learned so much from our pilot. We were lucky enough to have great weather, so we could actually see Denali. The landing on Ruth Glacier was breathtaking. Our entire family loved the experience - including our teenagers!

This was the most amazing experience we have ever had. Leaving the earth in a beautiful, classic bush plane from the 1950’s. Our pilot, Maury, was clearly in love with the plane and his job. He could not have done a better job of safety orientation, or educating us about what we were getting ready to experience. He was also very good about preparing us for the possibility of turbulence, although we had almost none. There are no words to describe this flight - it was surreal. With headphones, it was amazingly quiet. We saw no other planes while in the sky. Maury did a great job of narration, but also gave us quiet time to just experience this remarkable adventure. We strongly recommend this magical trip to you.

This was a spectacular flight and glacier landing. We booked the day before for June 2 because the weather looked good. The skies were blue which made contrast with snow all the more scenic. We had done the same tour about 10 years ago and so happy to be able to do it again. The on ground facilities were much better and passengers did wear masks for Covid. Each of us had a window seat. The flight was smooth. Even my spouse who gets nervous on commercial flight landings was confident. Highly recommend this activity.
Maury and his wife made our experience at K2 sensational.  From our last minute purchase of tickets to the incredible flight, K2 does a sensational job.   Don't hesitate, just do it.

This experience was my favorite part of my Alaskan adventure. K2 aviation is excellent at their jobs. We were informed early that due to weather conditions and it not being safe, we would not land on the glacier that day.  The woman in charge was very calm, friendly, and confident about that announcement and even brought out Charlie the dog to interact with us. Pro-tip for delivering bad news in the future! Obviously, these folks are professionals and safety is the top priority.

We were checked in, weighed, signed our waivers quickly, and in a relatively short time frame were met by the pilot who thoroughly briefed us for our flight.  Joe was our pilot and he took us on a breathtaking tour of many of the glaciers that surround Denali.  Because the weather was moving in, he carefully directed us towards the open sky and showed us some of the most beautiful places I've ever seen.  He had a thorough knowledge of the area and answers my zillion questions about flying and the aircraft.  He also made it a point to check in on the passenger's comfort while we flew - everything from temperature to turbulence. 

I would absolutely recommend this group to anyone, and can't wait to get back to Alaska to fly with them again!

Every part of the activity was well planned and was an excellent experience. The plane ride took us over all the major spots around Denali National Park and we enjoyed stunning views of Mt. Denali and surrounding areas. The plane was in excellent condition and the pilot was professional and informative. Would definitely go again with K2!

Our group was lucky to have perfect weather for the tour which made it possible to do the whole tour and land on the glacier. The staff was very nice and made the experience more enjoyable.  Definitely recommend as this was our group’s favorite part of our week long Alaska trip.

We did a LOT during our weeklong trip to Alaska, and this was, without a doubt, our favorite. Our group was still on a budget, and after much debate, decided to add on the glacier landing. It was WORTH IT. (Seriously - babysit a few times, get a job on the side for a few weeks, whatever you have to do for the $100 upgrade.) We were very lucky to have a clear day, but we were at peace knowing we could cancel if needed due to weather.

This was a fantastic experience for our family! Such great views of the range from the air that will remain with us for a long time. Because of the weather we were not able to do the glacier landing but despite that it was breathtaking. The staff is professional and very friendly. Highly recommended.

What a unique and awe inspiring experience. K2 met all our expectations. The pilot's expertise was obvious and the planes had amazing views from every seat. While the weather wasn't as cooperative as we hoped, the pilot was able to navigate safely to give us amazing views of the glaciers, peaks and educated us on everything we were seeing. The glacier landing was incredible. Great landing and a once in a lifetime experience. This is a tour not to be missed!

Our trip was awesome! Very organized check in and our pilot was fantastic. We also had a rare sunny day and got to see so much. 

What set this place above all was their customer service weeks after our trip. I lost my sunglasses on the plane and thought they were a lost cause. However, 2 weeks after my vacation, they called me to tell me they found them! I can’t believe they still even had my name and phone number with all the people and lost items they deal with! Very impressed with this company, will definitely use in the future! Thank you K2!

Incredible Denali Experience with Glacier Landing - we did it on July 1st - 7:30 pm flight.
Everyone from checkin crew and our fearless pilot (Derek or Erik?) made sure we had an awesome experience.
The landing was smooth and amazing experience. Pilot also let me sit on the copilot seat which was pretty cool.
Super happy and higly recommend K2 aviation

Dorothy was the best pilot we could have had!  She did a fantastic job.  It was my 19th heart transplant anniversary and she went out of her way to make our trip special for me!  I totally recommend the tour to anyone who comes to the area.  The view is just spectacular!

review_title: Please don’t miss doing this flight
review_text:
AMAZING !! BEYOND ALL EXPECTATIONS 
The views you will see from the aircraft can’t be described 
The service of the staff is unreal 
Our pilot JOE was so smooth so knowledgable felt so safe with him, I would request him if you decide to do this flight .

If in Kalkeetna  don’t miss this

review_title: Arguably the best thing to do in Alaska.
review_text: We did the flyer tour with the glacier landing. The trip is amazing and it was really cool landing in a massive glacier and being able to wear just a t shirt. We were lucky to do this on a day with 0 clouds in the sky too! We had to rebook because they weren't going out, and a call ahead would have been nice. Our pilot always seemed like he was in a rush, but everything about the trip was breathtaking. Just make sure if you book a glacier landing you call the day of to make sure they're going.

review_title: The highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text:
All I can say is...DO THIS! It was, hands down, the highlight of our trip to Alaska. The views were fantastic and our pilot, Will, was absolutely great. He clearly wanted to give us an unforgettable experience. We were very impressed with all the safety precautions taken by K2, not only within the plane itself, but also with their concern for the weather and what we would be able to see.  We were scheduled to fly around Denali on the Grand Denali Tour, but the winds on the north side of the mountain were too high to allow this so they rebooked us on the Denali Flyer tour and refunded the excess payment. We were the only two passengers with Will and we had gorgeous views. Yes, it is expensive, but so worth it. 

We had also done the flight out of Kantishna (which was also wonderful) after the six hour bus ride into Denali , but the flight out of Talkeetna was more spectacular because you fly directly toward Denali from a distance, seeing it come closer and closer.
Best day in Alaska so far!! Whole experience was special from meeting the owners dog Charlie to our pilot Stan!! Highly recommend!!
Awesome experience. Great view of Denali the surrounding mountains and the glaciers. Excellent value for money. Highly recommend.

Breathtaking experience. The pilot was amazing & experience, he navigated the flight without any bumps.
Enjoyed it very much. Highly recommend it.
Flying around the mountains & glaciers was amazing! Landing & taking off on a glacier up near Denali was awesome! It was a smooth, informative, comfortable ride & we had a great pilot!

Fabulous experience and worth every penny!!!  We couldn't do our glacial walk, but trust the right decision was made and still over the moon by our experience.   Thanks for an epic fly over one of the most beautiful mountain ranges.  Denali was in full view.

K2 is a top notch company.  They take safety seriously.  Masks were required for all passengers and crew.   I really appreciated this as I have 2 children who are too young to be vaccinated.  Our pilot was excellent (I wish I could remember his name!).  The weather on the day of our trip was not great, but our pilot managed to weave in and out of the clouds to find excellent  views. We even saw the peak of Denali! 

This trip is very weather dependent,  so try to leave some flexibility in your schedule in case you cannot go exactly on schedule.

This was one of the highlights of our trip. We had an amazing experience flying with K2. Our pilot, Will, made sure we were comfortable with the plane, safety procedures, and flight plans before boarding. We had amazing tour and were fortunate to be the only plane on the glacier towards the end of the day. We had questioned splurging for the glacier landing, but it was well worth it. The views are stunning!

review_title: Don't miss this tour with K-2!
review_text: K-2 is the way to go!  Very professional from the very start to end.  Our pilot in the Otter was knowledgeable with the geology and knew every canyon and glacier by name AND could multitask as a pilot, tour guide and flight attendant all at once!  At the very end of the flight Denali peak came out of the clouds and he made one more turn so that we could all see it- amazing!  Our tour had to be downgraded from the Grand Tour because of the weather on the back side of the mountain but it did not disappoint.  Don't miss this tour!
Experienced pilot. Breathtaking views. We landed on a glacier! Pilot was very knowledgeable and personable.

We did the Denali Flyer with glacier landing. The staff were very friendly and professional. Unfortunately, we had to reschedule our flight 3 times due to rainy weather, but glad we were able to fly towards the end of our trip. It was such an amazing experience flying around Denali.  The glacier landing is a must! It was absolutely beautiful. The sheer magnitude of those mountain ranges were unbelievable. We got to fly so close to them. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced. We had an incredible experience and would HIGHLY recommend this experience to everyone!!!

Pilot was great!  He was very personable and gave us lots of information without interrupting our viewing/photographing of the topography.  Every site up to Denali and all surrounding areas was amazing.  I highly recommend this experience.

review_title: I made reservations,  I arrived in Talkeetna, I was picked up at my guest house. I arrived at airport. I flew.
review_text: Joe, the pilot, was not just knowledgable and interesting, he put us all at ease with clear safety instructions,  very obvious attention to his task, and some needed comedic relief.. It was one of the most spectacular things I've ever done..and I've done a lot.
The plane was super smooth barely any turbulence. Our pilot was very informative about the topography. The scenery amazing! Landing on the glacier was super smooth
Awesome!!! Wilbur our pilot was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. We saw Mt McKinley clearly. Top of our bucket list.

This trip was excellent.  Stan, our pilot, was extremely knowlegeable of the topography and past history.  We weren't able to fly completely around Denali due to high winds, but the aerial views flying around the south side were spectacular.  The landing and takeoff on the glacier was particularly memorable as were the views of the Denali area.  Definitely worth doing,  a memorable experience.

Did the flyer with the glacier landing and it was worth every penny! I was admittedly scared for my life for a brief second but that’s because I’m a scaredy cat. The plane and pilot were top notch and I’ll tell everyone to do K2 at least once in their life.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: A highlight of our trip to Alaska! Seeing Denali and landing on a glacier. The pilot was informative.

This was the highlight of my trip to Alaska, and my parents (who are in their 80s) felt the same way.  I'm sorry I don't remember our pilot's name.  He was topnotch.  Beyond that, flying through the mountains, softly landing on the glacier, being surrounded by mile-high granite walls and ice, seeing all of the high peaks--it was extraordinary.

Amazing flight over Denali that included an epic glacier landing. Well organized. Knowledgeable staff. 
We had an amazing time!!

review_title: K2 Aviation will take you to a place where your senses will be dazzled.
review_text:
K2 Aviation will take you to a place where your senses will be dazzled. 
Denali is Awesome, like Alaska; entirely beyond the scale of ordinary urban life. 
The ONLY way to see even part of Denali, is a flight-seeing air tour of this massive mountain, Denali.  An absolute must for those who seek an Alaskan adventure. 

K2 Aviation will take you there_  Up close in the air, Denali is amazing, breathtaking, exciting and yet still remote, completely humbling; visited briefly, but remembered always.

This flight was the high point of our 15 day Alaska trip, the experience is much more than these few words can say_  Our Pilot Chad made it a wonderful uplifting flight.

Do not be timid! K2 Aviation's pilots and equipment (planes); [especially their turbine powered de Havilland Otters] are tried & true, experienced and capable. 
Their pilot's local knowledge and skill making the flight a joy for everyone; it's a once in a lifetime experience.

OUTSTANDING!  Great pilots and excellent customer service.  A trip of lifetime! Highly recommend!!!!  The pilot was super on answering questions about what we were looking at and great at trying to provide us the most spectacular tour.
Great staff and our pilot, Stan, was very informative, friendly and safe.  The views cannot be adequately described in words or pictures- you have to see this for yourself.

This is a must do.  From the time they picked us up at our lodge to the time they returned us the people at K2 were wonderful at making us feel safe and welcome.  The pilot was very informative and knowledgeable, answering all our questions and not only was he able to show us Mount Denali but also other points of interest.  Again thank each and everyone at K2 Aviation for making our experience of viewing Denali so memorable.
Great staff and neat experience. I took my family off five and they were great with the kids. I enjoyed landing on the glacier and having a snowball fight with the kids

I had a flightseeing tour with glacier landing with K2 Aviation and it was AMAZING. That was the highlight of my Alaska trip. Seeing the mountains so close as if you could touch them and landing on the glacier was once in a lifetime experience—and the K2 Aviation delivers.

Patrick, our tour pilot, was very good. He was calm taking away any of my fear of flying in a small plane. It’s obvious that he is an experienced pilot, told us what to expect on the flight, will tell us in advance if he will make some turns and the time to
land. He also shared his knowledge about the area and Alaska mountain ranges. Thank you, Patrick, for a safe, smooth and once in a lifetime amazing tour.

The staff of K2 were courteous. I had my original scheduled tour cancelled due to weather, given a choice to be fully refunded or move to another day which I did and it turned out to be gloriously sunny the next day when the elusive Denali showing its glory.

The plane is clean and safety is well practiced. Their color red planes look so beautiful against the snow covered mountains and glacier on the pictures. Also, if you don’t have snow boots—they will provide any sizes that you can put over your footwear. Their facilities are clean too. I think their restrooms were the cleanest among all the public restrooms I used during my trip in Alaska.

The money I spent with this tour is all worth it. It’s a tour of a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.
Love the trip. Our pilot was great and very informative. We saw the top of the Mountain because it was a clear day. This is a must do for Denali Park.

review_title: Glacier Landing and Denali Up Close
review_text: Many thanks to the Talkeetna team and Patrick our Super Pilot!  Great staff, equipment and an awesome once in a lifetime experience.  No promises made and yet the clouds parted above Denali just in time.  The glacier landing was stunning, a highlight of my life and for my wife and daughter as well!  Thanks much K2!

Wonderful team to manage this lifetime opportunity!  We had booked the trip to go around Denali, but the weather was bad on the other side so they refunded the difference. The pilot, Patrick, was great and gave us our glacier landing first because of impending weather. Really great trip and company. I highly recommend!

review_title: Office lied to us consistently multiple times
review_text:
Office intentionally lied to us multiple times.

There were three levels of yours running - blue , yellow , green. We were booked for the highest tier - green on our way up to Denali. Due to bad weather we had to reschedule on our way back, cancelling our itinerary to see Anchorage instead. We called every 2-3 hours for 2 days to confirm that green tour is running. Every time they said, yes it is running. We tried to reschedule it to another convenient time - they said the green tour is full for all other slots. When we reached at our scheduled time, we were told green tour had not been running for few days, we can downgrade to yellow or get refund. 

Now that we had lost the opportunity to see Anchorage as originally planned, we did the yellow tour. But it was deceitful on their part to not tell us in the 6-8 calls we made that the tour we are booked for has not been running. I understand weather condition can change - the green tour may not be running in morning but might run at our scheduled time. But when we explicitly asked if green tour was running - they should have told us honestly. Instead they were telling us it is 'fully booked'. 

Had they honestly told us that green one was not running since morning, we would have not skipped seeing Anchorage for the 'possibility' of green tour . It was because of their false confirmation that green one is running, we changed our itinerary.
Patrick was an excellent pilot and provided us with a wonderful mountain experience and narrative and of course the glacier landing was the highlight of the experience. We are so glad we did this !!!
Awesome views. Smooth landing on Ruth Glacier.Pilot very knowledgeable. Blue sky day. Made great photos. We absolutely loved it.
Views were magnificent.  Standing on the glacier was so amazing its hard to describe.  Our pilot Jeff was really cool and had good knowledge of the area.
Such a great experience! Pilot and staff were informative and helpful at every turn. A must do for anyone in Alaska.
Unforgettable experience. Felt safe the entire time, top notch operation and service. It's not cheap, but it's worth it and will create memories you will never forget.

Ok so i read the bad reviews. I don't understand them.

I arrived in Talkeetna and everything was closed. Sitting in Denial Brew house i needed something to do because everything was closed.  I called K2 and the lady was awesome. I thought about it and called back 5 minutes later to book the trip.  It left in 30 minutes. Stan our pilot introduced himself after an EASY check in with the front desk. I asked Stan if i could copilot and he said the seat was mine. 

Within minutes we were airborne.  10x smoother then and flight ive ever been on. Landing on Denali was crazy smooth. His knowledge was so amazing. 

The only thing that honestly made me upset was that the other 6 people on the flight didn't tip the pilot. That was terrible to witness. 

You can search my name on YouTube and watch our flight.

We had an Amazing trip with Joe flying over Alaska’s magnificent mountains! Our family really enjoyed the beauty and all of Joe’s helpful information and his expertise. The staff is super friendly and very helpful with little ones. This is a MUST experience for the entire family! 
Thank you K2! ❤️
Hearing the pilot Chris point out various aspects of the mountains as well as the base camp. So cool!!

We had a great flight! They were so kind in helping us when there was a weather hold on flights at our reservation time. They got us up later in the day. The pilot would point out features and answer questions during the flight. Was a highlight of our entire Alaska trip.
This was truly a once in a lifetime experience!  Stan was a great pilot and tour guide. Spending a little extra to land on the glacier was well worth the money.

Absolutely a MUST-DO - we stayed at the Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge. K2 was right on time with the pick up and dropped us off immediately after (no waiting). We were very fortunate for gorgeous weather. 70 outside and excellent visibility. The air in the plane in the mountains was cold but the pilot did his best to keep the heat turned on. 

The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable. Gives heads up when bumps are coming which is great for those with anxiety flying. There was a slight hiccup and K2 said they couldn’t fly the route I booked due to winds that day but they happily refunded the difference in cost. 

Me and my husband lovedddd this adventure. What a way to see Denali

review_title: If you don’t do this tour then you didn’t really visit Alaska!
review_text:
If you are coming to Alaska you must do this!  Our trip was the third weekend in May and the weather was gorgeous.  The trip is once in a lifetime.  Glaciers, mountains, rivers, and amazing views of Denali and Denali National Park.  You feel like you are on a different planet.  The glacier landing is a must.  A truly unique experience.  Our pilot Jeff was super approachable and a great guide, knowledgeable in the history of the park, the mountains, and glaciers.  He made the trip even more enjoyable with his narration. 

K2 Aviation is a super professional operation.  Not one complaint. We originally booked the grand tour but because of weather they booked suit a different tour on the morning of and refunded the money automatically, no fuss.  When I come back to Alaska I’ll be visiting K2 once again.

My group was so happy we booked this tour, especially the glacier landing - worth the money! Jeff was a great pilot who made all of us feel safe and comfortable. I loved hearing him tell about what we were seeing throughout the journey.

review_title: Cancelled tour. No courtesy call from company ahead to inform
review_text: Didn’t inform me about tour cancellation until I drove 2.5 hrs from Anchorage to reach there.Still awaiting refund

This is easily the best thing we did in Alaska while I was there. I actually proposed to my now-fiancee at Denali basecamp through K2, and they were so helpful and supportive!

You MUST do the glacier landing, and we'd highly recommend the entire experience over anything else you have to do in Alaska.

review_title: Great trip - do the glacier landing!
review_text:
Sign up and do this now. I know it’s a little pricey. Just do it. You will not regret it and it will likely be the high point of your trip to Alaska. My family of four had so much fun. Stan, our pilot, was wonderful and provided a very smooth flight. Nice landing on the glacier!  The whole organization was first class, kind and polite. We felt very safe!
Book this and enjoy it!
JC

We had a wonderful time with Chad, our pilot. He was curteous and very informative throughout the flight.  We were told that we were in a rare group of the 5% to see all three large mountain tops of Mt Hunter, Denali and Foraker!  We loved the experience   as a unique celebration for our 40th anniversary.  The entire staff was curteous and very helpful.  If/when we return we would most likely take another flight with K2 Aviation. Thanks, Chad, you were the best!  Randy and Kathie Schwarz

Plane was well maintained. 
Had a very memorable flight. 
Service was great. Staff worked through having to have an O2 generator. Very accommodating. 
No issues.

Our pilot (Chad) was very informative and friendly, learned a lot on the flight and we were very excited to see all three peaks! Flight was very smooth and the pilot took the time to talk about the airplane specifications with us after we landed.

We loved flightseeing with K2!  We booked the grand tour to do a glacier landing and we were bummed that the weather wasn't good enough to land on the glacier.... however, the flight around Denali without the landing was still AMAZING!  Our pilot was an awesome guide too!  I HIGHLY recommend K2!
Great morning ride. Safe flight and very professional. Amazing way to see the Alaskan Range and Denali. Highly highly recommend.

The trip was on a classic Dehaviland Otter retrofitted with a turbo-prop engine.I hadn't booked a landing as part of the package, but other on the same excursion had, so I was able to land on the glacier too. This ended up being my favorite part of the trip. Standing on the glacier, there was a beautiful sense of quiet, and the views of the surrounding mountains were superb.  It was easy to get great photos. This is not to say the rest of the trip wasn't great as well. On the way up and back, the frozen ponds, lakes tundra and rivers were striking and otherworldy. From the vantage point of the airplane, we were able to see the flow of the glacier and the slight signs of melting water brought by spring. The pilot was an excellent and genial guide. Definitely worth the money.

The trip was phenomenal! Everyone should experience it at least once. We originally booked glacier landing along with the fly tour, but the weather didn’t permit landing do we did the fly tour of the Denali. We had to postpone a few flight times due to weather. K2 was great in providing us with updates on fly conditions and let us chose our flight time. They were great to work with. 
For future reference give yourself a couple days, for weather is predictable, to schedule the best flight for you.

review_title: It was a highlight of our trip
review_text: My son and I did the Denali Flyer tour on April 13. It was such a treat and what a day to fly. It was a highlight of our trip. Thank you so very much. Mary Ott

From the office check-in,  to the end of trip landing, the whole experience was a 15 on a 1 - 10 scale.  Walking on the Ruth Glacier was surreal.

Bruce and Kathryn Jordan, Palmer, AK

Awesome flight experience! Added the glacier landing which was spectacular! The weather was perfect- 55 degrees and sunny! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we got some fantastic pictures. Best way to see Denali National Park for sure.
The Denali glacier landing was once in a lifetime opportunity!  We were in complete awe!  Highly recommend!

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience
review_text: It was absolutely incredible and the folks at K2 were so good about working around the weather. We were in the area for three days and pushed the trip from the first day to the second because of visibility, pushed from the second to the third for the same reason. On the third day the sun came out and there wasn’t a cloud in the sky. It was beautiful. The staff were responsive, attentive and genuinely care about making sure their guests have a great time.

The staff was amazing trying to accommodate walk ins (Thank you) our pilot was awesome! We had a great group. Our pilot was very knowledgeable, experienced and made the entire experience exceptional..... He helped take pictures for our memories. We WOULD RECOMMEND this company to any one!!
Thank you to a GREAT team!!!
Great plane, even better pilot! Chris was knowledgeable and a ton of fun!  We had never flown in a small plane. Smooth take-off and even better landing. I highly recommend!

We did a winter tour and it was so beautiful. If you are in Alaska take a chance on seeing it from above! You take off from Talkeetna so it is a short trip to see Denali close up. They accommodated our two year old in his car seat so family friendly. 10/10 would recommend.

Incredible. This is the best part of our trip. From start to finish, the flying experience was fabulous, the views from the place were break taking. Spending time on the  glacier and views from the glaciers were experience of life time. The service was excellent. Thank you K2 team.

We had an excellent flight with pilot Chris. The entire K2 staff is great. They want all their guest to have a memorable experience but their main concern is for everyone's safety...especially if you are landing on the glacier. Landing on the snow left us gob-smacked. The sheer size of the mountains is overwhelming. Chris did an excellent job sharing facts about the landscape, mountains, history and the state of Alaska. Highly recommend K2! The office pup, Tulli, will welcome you with love and snuggles.
We enjoyed the beautiful scenery and landing on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and informative.

review_title: Seeing what you could only see on National Geographic.
review_text:
Sitting in the co-pilots seat. Landing on Ruth's Glacier.
Pilots great meandering flight path to see everything.

review_title: Excellent exp would def do again!
review_text: Highly recommend. Pilot was very educated! The plane ride was extremely smooth. A definite must do! :)

K2 aviations online booking and screening process made it extremely easy to book/showup and get right on with the tour. 

Pilot Chris was extremely knowledgable about the Alaska Range/Denali and everything in between. Sights like this can only be experienced from the Air!

One of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had! We flew right up and around the mountains and it was surreal. I would definitely recommend this company. The pilot was extremely helpful and knowledgeable and encouraged us to ask lots of questions about the area, the wildlife, etc. He also told us to let him know if the wing was in the way of our photos so that he could adjust to give the best angles for photos of the region. It was an amazing experience all around!

Our Pilot Chris, was excellent.  He was a great guide, very knowledgeable, as well as a fine pilot.  Our flight was very comfortable and the views tremendous. Being Alaska residents for many I've done two other flight seeing trips near Denali, and K2 was my favorite.

review_title: The Proposal Flight that was breathtaking!
review_text:
My favorite part of the tour was flying in and out of the gorges.  We were so close to the sheer cliffs and you can see the solid rock.  
Also, being able to view Mt. Foraker and Mt. Hunter was impressive. 
The view was spectacular and the weather was sunny and little wind.
The pilot described where we were and where we were going.  There is so many things about this venture that made it a memory forever.  The spectacular view, the sunny weather, experienced pilot, and gracious employees. 
I did propose to my future wife during the flight and with the Denali backdrop, it was fantastic.  
Post Script:  She said yes!

review_title: Don’t miss this experience! Life changing!
review_text: This was absolutely a dream come true!  I could not have asked for a more amazing experience in my life! I literally cried with joy and awe at the beauty I took in from the back of that shiny, beautiful red Beaver!  I can’t thank our pilot Ryan Kerby enough for his knowledge and in depth tour of the beautiful Alaskan Range. Highly highly recommend to all!
Had an incredible time. Chris, our pilot, was a great dude with a chill demeanor. I felt safe the whole time.

I went on this tour for my birthday and couldn’t be happier I did. I am a larger person and they accommodated me with ease. The flight was smooth and Denali was out in all of its glory. 100% recommend this to anyone visiting Alaska!

As one might imagine, flightseeing in  Denali National Park is always breathtaking but what made our experience unique with K2 Aviation was their responsiveness.  It was a cold, clear, sunny morning on November 1.  We knew it was last minute but we took a chance anyway and called K2 to see if they could take our party of 3 out that same afternoon.  Sarah was most pleasant, helpful and accommodating on the phone. When we arrived in Talkeetna, we discovered a new, clean and welcoming facility.  Our pilot, Chad, was friendly, safe and very informative.  We were safely back on the ground within 5 hours of making our initial call.  This is a very safe and efficient operation offering spectacular flightseeing tours of Denali.

What an amazing tour. I would 100% recommend this to anyone visiting the area. I was bummed that we weren't able to do our original tour that we booked (due to weather) but quickly realized that it didn't matter. Spend the money and experience K2.

We booked this flight on a last minute suggestion from our bed and breakfast host and we were so happy we did. They were able to get us in same day and at a time that worked for our schedule. Our pilot/tour guide Chad was very knowledgeable about the Talkeetna region and the immense Denali mountain area. We learned so much about the glaciers and mountains, and the formation of the region. Thank you K2, this was the cherry on top of a great 2 week Alaskan vacation.
This is an essential experience if you're visiting Denali. There's no better way to take in the mountains than these flight tours.

review_title: Grand Denali tour was simply mind blowing
review_text: Best experience that i will remember for a long time. Although, it is Corona time, the whole experience from booking to check out was great. We made the reservation over the phone and werent sure whether we were going to make it in Alaska due to Covid, but there were no worries because they would not charge until the day of the flight. Checking was very easy. Once we signed we headed outside where we were provided with covers for our boots and the meet and greet by the pilot. It was 5 of us flying that day. The weather was beautiful and the pilot said we had a 60 to 80 % chance of landing on the Glacier. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable and kept us engaged the whole flight. He knew the area well and told us some amazing stuff about Alaska and Denali. You also had a chance to sit upfront with the pilot and we decided who will with consensus. The views were amazing, the aircraft was excellent, well kept and comfortable. We could not have asked for a better experience. The take off and landing both on the glacier and on ground were smooth. It is so worth the money and i would recommend to anyone who would like to have a life time memory and experience something as amazing as flying near Denali and landing on the glacier.

review_title: The best part of going to Alaska!
review_text: We had the most incredible time and flight overseeing Deanli. It truly is the best way to see all the mountains! The photos came out incredible and I believe this was worth every penny. Definitely recommend splurging on the glacier landing. It was the best part of the trip to be able to land on the glacier and see it from a different perspective. Would definitely recommend!

Our tour guide, Bryan (?) was incredible!
He made it a point to give us equal views of the mountain no matter what seat we were in :)
The flight was extrememly smooth, no turbulence! 
It was adventurous to wear the headset, like a real pilot and felt secure to have on board the survival gear...incase :) 
The pilot was also an excellent photographer who took exceptional photos of us outside the plane!
Don't forget to dress warm, especially in the fall time ;)
By the way, they offer warm shoes, incase you forgot yours!

review_title: A view well worth the price
review_text:
I’ve climbed glaciers and traveled around to see many more but despite plenty of time around some incredible mountains, the flight was absolutely worth it and k2 totally rocked it. 

We called up literally at the last minute and they were able to accommodate (no doubt thanks to it being off season and covid) our small group. Despite the rushed arrival, everything went smooth — obviously they know their stuff as evidenced by the climbers who use them for hauling in to the range. 

Easy process, nice building with all the key essentials, great pilot and oh what a view. Of course, no one controls the weather but with their pattern, we had a mix of close up and far off views which helped get in through the ever moving clouds the mountains create.

The red planes are awesome for photos too, added perks.
This was a great experience. Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable about Denali and the glaciers. We paid the extra $100 for the glacier landing. WORTH IT. Flight was smooth and lots of fun.
Incredible! Worth every penny! No other way to get so up close and personal with Denali unless you plan on climbing it yourself.

review_title: Glacier landing denali national park, base camp
review_text: Best trip EVER. Pilot was outstanding, photographs were amazing, and the pilots commentary was super interesting. We went to some glaciers on helicopters, but nothing came close to the 3 hours we spent flying around denali. Highlight of my entire 6 month stay all over alaska

Chris was incredible pilot with a cast of knowledge! Most terrifying yet best experience of my life!!!
 We will come next year to stay local and ski.
On of the what things I’ve done! The people are sweetest and our pilot, Chris was amazing!! Highly recommend K2A!

This trip was jaw dropping to my son and myself 
We’re very excited and grateful for this opportunity and experience 
I certainly recommend everyone to go 
It’ll be best ever experience of your life

review_title: Flying over Denali with Kahiltna Glacier Landing
review_text: I highly recommend this flightseeing tour. Its the yellow tour offered on the K2 aviation tour brochure. The whole process from speaking to a person at the office, booking the tour, doing the tour and after tour service were all done professionally. Cris our pilot was very good at explaining everything we had to know prior to departure, explaining the sites we were seeing and most of all how to operate his aircraft. A once in a lifetime experience was landing on the Kahiltna glacier. Will do it again with Cris.

We had an amazing time flying the Denali Grand Tour mid-Sept. We lucked out with an amazingly clear morning, and a small 3 person group. The tour was one of the highlights of our time in Alaska. It gives you amazing perspective on the Denali Range, and our pilot had lots of information to share about the mountains, glaciers, climbing expeditions, and history. We were showered with eye candy and lots of info throughout the journey. 

Our initial attempt at flying around Denali was cancelled due to weather, but we made the drive from Anchorage to Talkeetna on the early morning of the day we were flying home because we heard from fellow travelers it was well worth it. It did not disappoint.

Gorgeous sunny day with views for miles. Pilot was incredibly knowledgeable about the local area and made the once in a lifetime experience that much better. Glacier landing was a huge highlight. Being surrounded by such impressive peaks is not something we’ll forget any time soon.

This was a fantastic experience!  To see the sheer beauty and majesty of Mt. Denali and Denali National Park from the air is unbelievable. Words and pictures don't do it justice. It was soooo much fun!  We had a great time!
We got very lucky and had a beautiful day. The prior day's flights were wiped out by a snowstorm on the mountain (while we enjoyed perfect weather on a lake below). Turns out K2 has a generous rescheduling policy. We had scheduled for the "good day" yet Erica called me directly to ask if we could shuffle a bit to help out with guests from the prior day. She gave me a few options and left the decision to alter our plans or not up to me. She and I talked and joked for a while then, in the end, we shifted our reservation by an hour. It was great to meet her in person in Talkeetna. She was super friendly and thanked us again and again for being flexible.
Before boarding the plane, our pilot, Chris, did a great job of putting everyone at ease with a few jokes while explaining how the flight would go and telling us about the plane's safety features. During the flight, he pointed out landmarks, gave us info on the area, and told stories about the mountains. He was very fun and personable and fielded questions from passengers during the flight.
We couldn't be happier with the service from K2. They made the entire experience very, very memorable.

It was an incredible experience, just indescriptible. All the personel was very profesional and kind. The pilot awesome, very attentive and friendly.

The experience worth all the effort.

The only thing I would add is more time after landing to enjoy the landscape.

review_title: Fabulous, once in a lifetime, experience.
review_text: This was the BEST experience!  The flight was smooth, the pilot was great, the scenery was fabulous and we landed on the glacier, where without COVID, the base camp for climbers would be.  It was the most beautiful day on top of it all, cloudless and the sun was shining.  There is not one thing I can talk about because it was all so wonderful.

We left out from Talkeetna on a sunny day and the experience was life changing! Denali was as beautiful as can be and the glacier landing was beyond words. All the pictures we took were beautiful but seeing the views in person is indescribable! I would encourage everyone to take this flight and enjoy the beauty of Gods country!
Fantastic adventure. Erika in the office made all our communications enjoyable. Stan made the flight interesting and exciting. So glad that we booked with K-2.

It is hard to pick to pick a favorite part of the tour as the whole experience was beyond words.
We would definitely pick the glacier landing as a must.  We could not have had a more perfect day as there was not a cloud anywhere.  Our pilot (Chris) was an encyclopedia of information  about the history of the area and the mountain.  As long time residents of Alaska  I don’t know how we could have had a better experience and would definitely recommend it to everyone and it should be on everyone’s bucket list.

review_title: Views like a James Bond movie
review_text: This is a very well run and professional company.  Our pilot provided a good explanation of what we were seeing and turned the plane around so passengers on both sides could get a good view of all of the sights.  The magnificent views were like flying through a James Bond movie.
We were fortunate to have good weather.  I'm sceptical of all tourist excursions, but this tour was amazing.

Incredible flight over Denali and surrounding mountains. A must-do in Alaska! Our pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and shared his passion and wisdom of the area throughout the flight. The staff was welcoming and walked us through the safety of the plane and the flight. Our flight was cut a bit short due to weather but was incredible none-the-less and we received a partial refund before we even left. Fantastic service and an experience we will never forget!

This was an amazing trip for my wife and I.  The Glacier landing was beyond exciting.  Pilot was excellent, trip was A+++, views were exquisite, weather was perfect, etc..... No question a trip we will never forget!

I surprised my mother with a flightseeing tour over Denali, and it was awesome!  We went on a beautiful, clear morning, and were able to cruise around so many mountain peaks and into infinity.  Stan, the pilot, was very kind and interesting, too!  I could not recommend this enough!  They offer a discount for Alaskan residents, too, which was really great!  Thank you so much, K2!

review_title: A great adventure worth every penny
review_text:
K2 aviation is a great company
Our pilot/tour guide did an amazing job providing history, not only of Denali, but Alaska as well.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier was very exciting. The Turbo Otter is a well maintained, purposes built aircraft made for this type of flying. Our great adventure was worth every penny.

The entire flight was awesome!  They received snow the night before on the Glacier so we were not able to land on the glacier.  The views were amazing.
Chad our Pilot did a GREAT JOB!  Explained what we were looking at.

This adventure was the absolute highlight of our trip to Alaska. Although it is an expensive flight tour, it is worth every penny you will spend. We were fortunate enough to have a fairly calm and clear day, and the views of Denali and the mountains were outstanding. We were able to land on the glacier, and the views from the glacier were magnificent, and an experience I will never forget. If he is available, ask for Captain Stan. He was an incredible host who shared very interesting narration throughout the trip.

Wear warm winter clothes and comfortable boots or shoes, and K2 will provide special boots for walking on the glacier. The company is also really great about screening for COVID-19, and our negative test results were required in order to take the flight tour. Masks were also required when in the K2 buildings and throughout the flight.
Everything was excellent! Great weather,  breathtaking views! Denali Park looks amazing from the sky! Definitely worth the money!
Very friendly pilot. Smooth ride and landing. Absolutely beautiful views. Well worth the price! We had the best time. This is the best way to see Denali.
Chris was a great pilot, it was really a memorable experience. It is as cool and as impressive as we had hoped. Much cooler than the bus tour.
An AK MUST! I always take visiting friends and family and it never disappoints!! Thank you for all that you do for your guests and you community.
Landing at base camp glacier by Mt. Hunter was outrageous and a once in a lifetime experience.   The pilot, Stan, was super experienced and a great host.  It was a glorious day.
Thus experience will forever be one of the highlights of my life! You can't even begin to understand Denali until you see it up close and personal!!! This is a definite MUST DO when you visit AK!
Captain Stan is super nice. The glacier is wonderful none to say the amazing experience of landing on the glacier!!!!!

The front desk recommended the Denali Flyer your with a glacier landing. We were not disappointed! Take-off and landings were so smooth we could not feel them. We felt safe and entertained the entire time!

Very cool experience and one not to be missed!  If you're going to be near Denali take the trip!  Pilots and staff are super professional!  we have awesome pictures and memories of Denali and would go again

What an incredible experience - it is hard to put into words how it feels to be flying among the mountains of the park - we had incredible weather and saw Denali, mountains, glaciers, lakes, rivers, rainbows....the list goes on. 

Chad was a great pilot. He worked hard throughout the trip to take us to some really special places, constantly checking in about changes in weather so he could take us cooler and cooler places. The time went by so fast after looking at one amazing view after the next. His excitement about flying and being on the trip was contagious! We felt very confident and safe in his plane as well - he was a very attentive and skilled pilot. 

We also felt very safe and comfortable with the covid precautions K2 took all the way from the office building to the plane. 

We will definitely be back and I will send all my friends and family from in and out of state K2’s way!

My wife and I took a morning Denali Grand Air Tour with K2 Aviation and had a wonderful time. The weather was absolutely perfect; no clouds and very little wind. 
Our pilot Stan was very knowledgeable about the history of Denali, glaciology, geology, and the names of all the peaks and glaciers. He positioned the plane so all on board could get ample photographs of all the beautiful scenery. We were completely satisfied with our air tour and would definitely recommend this activity as a once in a lifetime experience. 

The Enrights

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip to Alaska
review_text: Wow! This was an incredible experience. Our pilot was professional, informative, trustworthy, and fun. He provided interesting information along the route and checked in regularly. This was a highlight of our time in Alaska. The mountain peaks are brilliant and the glacier landing was definitely worth the extra money. I strongly recommend this adventure.
The whole trip was excellent. pilot narrated features throughout the flight, captured awesome pictures!

It was great to see the mountain close up! At first I was worried that it wouldn’t be worth it but it totally was. We were lucky to have a clear day but even if it didn’t work out I wasn’t concerned because the staff was so upfront that they weren’t going to charge you for the trip if you didn’t get the experience you signed up for. Super nice people. Perfect stop if you are going to/from Denali!

We are 'local' (Anchorage) and had scheduled a trip on Saturday. Friday's trip to Talkeetna was beautiful....Denali visible from our home all the way to Talkeetna. Sarah worked with us to change our reservation from Saturday to Friday. Chris was our pilot and it was an overall awesome experience. Their goal is to have you enjoy the trip...not take your money. What a refreshing change and what an amazing experience!!  Very "Covid Aware"! Most grateful! -Rick & Natalie
Chris was a great pilot, all the staff was friendly and the experience was fantastic. It was definitely worth it!

We had an amazing Denali Flyer Tour with the glacier landing. From our initial contact with Ernie we were impressed. Our pilot Stan was outstanding and highly informative. The following morning we had a little car trouble and Chad jumped right in to help us out. 

A flight tour around Denali is a must for any visitor to Alaska and K2 is the company to trust for an outstanding time.
It was awesome! Our pilot was very informative and intelligent, and did great flying the plane. We never felt uncomfortable! We had a great time and would love to go again in the future.

review_title: The GREAT ONE... Was Definitely GREAT!
review_text: HAPPILY checked off an item on my Bucket List!  I have been blessed to get to fly to many areas in Alaska in small airplanes and to enjoy the float plane we have in Seward.  BUT, to get to fly near to Denali and do a glacier landing was outstanding!  Definitely, in my top 5 best Alaskan and International flights!  I’ve known for years that when time permits in the summer and the weather looked good.... it would be a go for me!  All good things came together (except for the COVID-19 giving all Alaskan’s time to explore our state .... ) made it work for us to do my dream flight.  Would be tough to be more PERFECT!

review_title: Amazing trip! So worth the price!
review_text: Knowledgeable and friendly pilot who described all we were seeing. Smooth flight and easy landing. Just an amazing once in a lifetime experience to get so close to the mountain!

review_title: Words cannot describe how awesome this is!
review_text:
I've been to Talkeetna a number of times. It's always been overcast or rainy, and I've loved it anyway, even when I haven't been fortunate to see Denali. This time was incredible, and K2 aviation, and our pilot Chris, put our trip over the top. Literally. 

We'd been hesitant to do a Denali flight as it's so expensive. And the weather is so variable, we were afraid to commit. But after reading a number of reviews, it seemed worth doing if the weather seemed promising. We booked for one day, it turned out to be really hazy because of fires in Siberia (!) and K2 was great about allowing us to switch days.  Chris our pilot was phenomenal from the second we met him. Incredibly knowledgeable, personable and professional. The weather was clear, and we saw Denali and other mountains, SO close up. We did a glacier landing, and at one point our family and Chris were the only ones on the ice field. It was like being in a dream.

This is an expensive trip. It is dependent on weather and other factors, and we know we were very lucky. But K2 is so professional, and with pilots like Chris, really maximize the potential that this will be an unforgettable experience. If you are able to be flexible with the timing that helps, because the weather changes so much. 

Also, just have to say that we were nervous given Covid. But again, K2 was extremely professional, had exceptional hygiene practices both in and out of the aircraft, and  I would not Covid concerns stop you from doing this trip.

review_title: Beautiful day icing on cake of terrific flight
review_text: We did the glacier landing tour and some of the Denali Range. We had an exceptional day to fly and the landscape was breathtaking. We did a bus tour the previous day and it was wonderful to see the mountains from a different perspective. I had some trepidation’s about this flight but our pilot Chris was terrific and I am so glad I went. The plane held 10 people and we felt the sight lines were very good for all. Even sitting with the strut by my seat I was able to get some great pictures. Well worth doing and I highly recommend this company. Very professional in all aspects.

Absolutely one of the top highlights of my recent trip to Alaska. We had signed up for the glacier landing and at check in were told that it was going to be too foggy to land. While we were disappointed and were given the option to reschedule, we didn’t have the schedule flexibility so we agreed to fly without the landing, which we were still very excited about.  Once up in the air, our terrific pilot, Chris, had been eying the potential glacier landing field and decided that the conditions were much better than earlier and fog had cleared enough for a safe landing under the premise that we would need to be ready to leave should he sense the conditions changing once on the ground. Standing on the glacier in complete silence listening to rocks falling, glacial water rushing, was one of the most surreal experiences ever. Would 100% recommend this trip and the landing is absolutely worth it.  Honorable mention to the way that the bright red plane pops on the white snow in all of our amazing pictures. Thanks, Chris and K2 aviation for the unforgettable experience! 

Also, for anyone traveling in the current pandemic climate, K2’s COVID procedures felt very safe and clean and I feel they are doing a great job putting safety first.

Chad, a fellow Minnesotan, was a fantastic pilot!  He made us feel safe, gave great details about the mountains and surrounding landscape, and we had so much fun!  We might have been quiet guests, but we were just taking it all in!  We even saw a rare avalanche!!  Couldn't have asked for a better trip!  Thank you!!

review_title: One of the highlights of my 2-week trip
review_text: I was able to squeeze in a quick tour at the end of a two-week trip after my flight home was delayed a day, and I'm glad that it worked out - this tour was one of the highlights of my trip. Flying over and around the mountains was an almost surreal experience, even after having spent 8 days backpacking through the wilderness just north of the same mountains. My pilot and guide Chris was knowledgeable, accommodating, skilled, and very friendly - his steady piloting and narration throughout the trip added to an already amazing trip. I can't recommend this highly enough - I'll remember my flight for the rest of my life and am already looking forward to a future opportunity to re-live it.

Our flight with K2 Aviation was a wonderful experience! Our pilot was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. They were covid conscious. They called and gave us the option to shift our flight time based on the weather to give us the best views possible. They also gave us extra time in our flight to see Denali base camp. Definitely a great time!
Landing on the glacier was a first, even as a pilot myself. I sat in the ‘jump seat’. Stan was a superb pilot/guide. Stan knew they ridges and names.  I would recommend this adventure to anyone.

review_title: There is no better way to see the mountains.
review_text:
I had a great experience with K2 from the first phone call to the last purchase in the gift shop (and a great geocache out front). I called to make a same-day reservation due to slower than anticipated COVID test results and they were helpful, accommodating, and made a very wise suggestion as to when I should depart Denali National Park to be on time for my flight. 

Check-in was very efficient and I took the time between check-in and departure to go find the geocache out front. 

The flight was amazing! Our pilot was a fount of information on the area and had good stories. It is truly amazing to see the mountains from the air while having the peaks still above you instead of seeing them from thousands of feet above as you normally might see them in flight. They were truly breathtaking. 
Landing on the glacier was an unforgettable experience even though Denali was hiding in a cloud. Unfortunately, and as great as K2 is, they have not yet figured out how to control the weather. Despite Denali hiding from us, the trip was great and absolutely worth it. If you ever find yourself in the area you absolutely should take advantage of one of K2's tours.

So worthwhile!!  We upgraded from the flight only to landing on the glacier and it was a surreal experience.   The flight to the Alaska Range was informative thanks to Chris's (pilot) commentary.  The mountains are majestic and flying along the paths of glaciers was breathtaking.  The weather was such that we didn't need a coat to walk on the glacier which was completely unexpected.  We flew way closer to mountains then I would've thought possible.  We would sign up again the next time we're in Talkeetna!!

A group of 6 family members took the 45-minute Denali Flyer tour in early August.  It was one of the most fabulously mind-blowing way to see Denali and the glaciers.  We cruised around the mountains and various glaciers and ended by flying low in the valley over the main glacier! This was the highlight for all 6 of us over the course of our 8-day Alaska adventure.  It's the best way to take in the scope of Denali park!

review_title: The red planes look amazing in photos!
review_text:
There are a few things that set this trip apart for us;
1.) Our pilot, Chris, gave us one of the smoothest flights I have ever been on (sorry Delta).  I wasn't necessarily expecting a bumpy ride but I also never expected it to be so flawless.  The take-off and landing were almost effortless.  I also appreciated the narration by Chris.
2.) You guys, the red plane looks absolutely stunning in every photo we took.  It's only August and I might as well start making the Holiday cards.  If you are torn between two companies, choose the one with the red planes as the color will simply pop in every picture you have.  And if you are really thinking ahead, throw some Santa hats into your luggage and stage the perfect Christmas photo right there in Alaska.
3.)  Do the glacier landing.  I struggled to bite the bullet on this with our family of 5 but after a week in Alaska and lots of spendy excursions, this is the one I truly don't regret. Worth every single dollar.  We did the most basic flight but added the glacier landing and it was everything we could've dreamed.

Enjoy this amazing part of the world.

Capitalized on a brief window of good weather on August 1st. We flew for about an hour and got to see the Great Gorge and the peak of Denali (from below). Absolutely MUST DO when visiting the Denali area. Our pilot and the ground staff were great.
What an incredable thing to do!  A must do if you are there. The views are amazing.  I just can't say enough about the knowledge of our pilot and the views.
Most scenic flight I have ever done. Flying with the plane in the mountain range was incredible. And the glacier landing was just unique. Pilot was also very knowledgeable.

review_title: Once in a life time experience
review_text: Pilot was fabulous with all of his knowledge of the mountains and surrounding area. Very professional!

Everyone at K2 was amazing! I had to shuffle a few things around (more than once, I might add) and they worked with me to make sure I was able to get up in the air when I would be there. 

Once up in the Stan, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and friendly and made sure we all got to see the good stuff!

K2 does a great job working with you and making sure you have the best possible experience. While they cannot control the weather do a good job staying in communication and helping to adjust when necessary. Cannot recommend the glacier landing enough as it was incredible.

This flyover was the highlight of our trip!  We had never been on a plane of that size before and we felt completely comfortable riding with Chris.  Five year old Frances felt so comfortable on the plane that she fell asleep towards the end of the trip.  🤗

Everyone at K2 was great to work with. They took the time to help us pick the best option for our flight, and they were very professional at check-in which showed that our safety came first. Due to covid, we wore our masks from the moment we walked in the door until the time we left. Our pilot told us all about the plane before we boarded: where the life vests were, where the radio was, where emergency supplies were stored... you know, in the event we didn't make it back as expected. On the flight out, he told us what we were seeing, and although we didn't get to land on the glacier due to weather, we still immensely enjoyed our time. Part of our payment was immediately refunded once we landed due to the cancellation of the glacier landing. We left elated and with LOTS of great pictures! Advice, you'll see more of Denali if you sit on the right side of the plane. Go- it's beautiful and unforgettable! Highly recommend!

While we didn’t get to fly because of weather, the staff was extremely accommodating and were very willing to work with us to reschedule or refund our flight. After seeing their outstanding customer service, it’s clear why K2 Aviation is as successful as they are. While we missed the chance to fly this trip, we looking forward to coming back one day to fly with K2 Aviation!

AMAZING! Booked our tour for a brief break in our drive from Denali to Seward, hoping to see the mountain. We were told upon arrival that they would be willing to book us in a later date or give us a refund because of how cloudy it was, but since we were in a schedule we decided to just go for it and see what we could see. Our pilot was SUPER knowledgeable, we didn't expect a fully narrated flight! He also found an opening in the weather to get us a view of the three big mountains and got a beautiful flight up kahiltna glacier. He made sure we were comfortable the entire trip. Also had very good covid mitigation, masks required and plane disinfected between trips. 12/10 would recommend! I'm a local Alaskan and this was one of my favorite tourist things I've done

review_title: K2 Aviation is a top notch professional flight seeing outfit.
review_text: This flightseeing tour is worth every penny. The pilot was a complete professional. K2 went the extra mile to ensure of our safety by mandating COVID testing within 14 days of flying. The entire experience from phone call to booked reservation to actual flight was incredibly efficient and professional. I highly K2 Aviation for your Denali flight experience.

Great trip with seasoned pilot, Chris. The scenery was breathtaking and I highly recommend spending the extra money on the glacier landing. Well worth the cost. This was such an epic trip we plan to do it again since we are locals!
This was the highlight of my trip. Fabulous scenery. Pilot was excellent and gave a great commentary, I felt totally safe the entire time. I plan on doing this again next year when I return.
Highlight of my experience... poor, flight canceled, poor explanation and a poor alternative suggested. No prior phone call and missing out on other items

Absolutely one of the most incredible experience of our Alaskan vacation.   My family spent two weeks In Alaska & this was the highlight of our trip.    I highly recommend the glacier landing.   Minutes after our plane landed, we were able to experience an avalanche off in the distance.     

Absolutely the best way to experience Denali

The views were amazing! Pilot was excellent. A once in a lifetime experience landing on glacier. It felt very safe and in good hands. 

Two complaints: 
1.) we stepped off our bus after a 3 hour bus ride from Anchorage - we were two hours early for our trip - they rushed onto the 5 o’clock plane so fast I had to request they slow down so we could use the restroom and reorient - that felt... not good 
2.) we were scheduled for a longer tour around the mountain at sunset - it was canceled for “weather reasons“ - I’m no pilot, but the weather was amazing - my take: it was canceled and we were shuffled onto this other plane because they didn’t want to lose money sending another pilot up just for me and my son - so, that felt... not good as well

Still, once in a lifetime experience- worth the trip and money! Highly encourage the experience
Professional, clean, exceptional views and kind service. The whole package. The landing on the glacier was smoother than most commercial flights.

This is one of the top 3 tourist activities I have ever done.  The entire flight and landing was so memorable.  The pilot was engaging.  The sites were incredible.  Landing on a glacier next to Denali was unforgettable.  Even Ernie, who was our driver from our hotel, was amazing.  This is a MUST DO while in Talkeetna;  spare no expense, it is worth every penny.

review_title: Glacier Landing was a once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: K2 has a very professional and engaging staff from the minute you enter the building to the minute you leave the airplane doing everything they can to make your trip enjoyable and memorable.

If you are in the Talkeenta area, you need to do this! We had an amazing - like best thing we've done in our life, experience. Flying into the mountains and being able to land on the glacier and see the beauty of everything was breathtaking! Everyone we worked with was also very nice, helpful, and knowledgeable!

review_title: Celebrating a Birthday at the Top of the World
review_text: Weather couldn't have been more perfect.  But until you've experienced it for yourself, there are no words!!

Very personable, friendly + knowledgeable pilot made us feel comfortable and no anxiety as we flew up the mountain foothills and glaciers to see Mt Denali. Wife + I have lived in Alaska over 30 years and she had never been up to see Denali, so we took advantage of no tourists here during Covid-19 summer and took the 1-hour tour! WOW, was a perfectly clear flying weather, even got to see a small snow/ice avalanche!  So incredible. This flight tour should be high priority on every Alaskans’ “to-do” list!!
Ryan was a superior pilot.  Great experience!  A must-do AK experience.  Staff helpful, kind.  Would recommend for sure!
Exceptional tour, with our pilot Doug being the absolute best! We had another tour the next day with a different company and that really made us appreciate Doug even more.

July 2020 - had a perfect flight - with a clear view of Denali - and an awesome glacier landing (highly recommend)! We originally had a morning flight scheduled and it was completely foggy - so K2 nicely moved us to an afternoon flight. By the afternoon, the fog had cleared and it was a sunny day. Do the glacier landing - it is worth it!!!

Absolutely amazing experience!  Truly a once in a lifetime opportunity!  Our flight time had to be re-scheduled due to weather and K2 was proactive and professional in making the change.  We flew up to and around the Denali peak, landed in a glacier field at the base of the mountain and got to explore the ice field.  The flight back was fantastic as we came off the snow and back into the green forested fields.
Amazing experience!  The glacier landing is worth every penny!  Add it to your trip, you won't regret it!

Not enough stars to rate our experience!! Went to Alaska on a limited budget so was very leery about what I spent my money on. Came back with an experience we will never forget!! Don't hesitate to think about it, just do it!!!

it was an amazing experience. Staff was really nice and welcoming. Pilot was really experienced, he warned us before every bumps, it was really smooth. On the other side, the tour was breathtakingly amazing. I don't think I can compare what I saw with anything I have seen before. I highly suggest everyone to take this tour. again thanks to everyone who works there.
Plus; there was a receptionist lady gave me a poster with the painting of Denali. That was really nice of her.

I have used K2 aviation about 16 years back when I visited Alaska and so I decided to use them again! the weather was perfect so we got to see the Mt Denali and also the surrounding mountains in the area.  We also were able to land on the glacier due to good weather conditions.  Our pilot Chris was an excellent pilot and landed the airplane with great ease on the glacier.  Chris also explained in great detail the history and other information as we flew along Denali national park.  It is worth every penny!

review_title: Spellbinding experience words don't do justice
review_text: From the moment we took off to the moment we landed back at the airport we were all spellbound!  The ride was amazing and I would highly recommend it.  We landed on Ruth Glacier and it was a smooth and comfortable take off and landing.  The view from the sky is spectacular.  From the ground Denali is beautiful but from the air you get a better understanding of the size, scope and vastness of the mountain.  We definitely thought this was the highlight of our 10 day visit to Alaska.

What a great experience! I believe our pilot's name was Chris. We felt completely safe with him.  He made sure that we had all the details we needed for a good flight and all the landings (both on the glacier and the tarmac) we smooth.

This is an excellent operation and the employees did a great job making sure all COVID protocols were followed.

5 Starts well earned!
Our Pilot was so professional and made the whole experience fun! Even got shuttled to and from the train station. One of the best things I could’ve done while in Alaska. Thank you so much K2!
The entire experience was amazing!! The pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight took us through amazing terrain.
This experience was by far the highlight of my trip to Alaska! I got to ride co-polit which was awesome and the guide was very knowledgeable. The family that was along for the ride was nice as well!

review_title: Should be the only way to see Denali
review_text:
My coworkers highly recommended this company, so we booked for March. Unfortunately we got into a car accident right before the flight and couldn’t make it. They were so helpful and kind, gave us a full refund. 

We vowed to take the trip this year because people kept recommending it! And how happy we are that we did!!! I was awestruck the entire flight! (Even during the Glaciar Landing, which is a MUST!)

Worth every penny!

Must do!!! One of my most rememberable experiences while I was in Alaska. The staff was extremely flexible and understanding  due to rainy weather. We flew with Chris, who was very friendly and knowledgeable. The views were breathtaking!! Even though we were initially told we wouldn’t be able to take part in the glacier landing, the weather cleared up just in time and Chris was able to land the plane safely. I would definitely recommend this company and if I’ve ever back in Alaska I’ll be taking another flight myself!

Our experience was awesome! 

They waterproof shoes that slipped over our own boots for the glacier landing. Our experience was during Covid-19 and the whole staff took extra precautions to ensure our safety and the cleanliness of their airport and planes along with other equipment we came into contact with. 

There was some questionable weather in the amphitheater (where they land the plane on the glacier) but our pilot said we would fly in and see how it was when we got there. Luckily, it cleared up and we were able to land. The landing was flawless - which I imagine is not an easy feat on snow and skis. Our pilot took photos of us, taught us so much about glaciers and the surrounding mountains, and was pretty funny as well. He turned the plane a lot to make sure everyone on both sides could see the same things. I have never seen anything more beautiful in my life and I am so happy we sprung for the glacier landing. He also gave us some local tips for places to eat and things to see. I even got to sit copilot on the way back - which was super cool. 

On the way back, the landing into Talkeetna airport was just as perfect as the one on the glacier. I was shocked at how smooth both landings were. I would do this again in a heartbeat - it was worth every penny.

Except me and friend think the time length of glacier landing is too short. We even didn't have the time to walk a little further to take some more photos using this costing chance. Other than that the flight is quite good.

review_title: Tour of Denali with glacier landing
review_text: Fly towards Denali and landing on the glacier. Excellent trip, weather was perfect, Chris the pilot was a professional at all times and had detail knowledge of being a tour guide and still have the professional skills to maintain discipline needed as a professional pilot to get around the unforgiving terrain of Denali. The flight was supper safe, o couldn’t even tell when we landed on the glacier, it was that smooth.

Flying over Denali Park is an incredible experience and K2 runs a first class operation making it happen. Weather can always be a factor in changing your flight path or cancelling altogether and K2 keeps you posted on all changes that arise. It's apparent that safety is their top priority. Really enjoyed the experience - highly recommend K2 for flightseeing!
The flight tour was amazing I would highly recommend it for all ages.  It was very easy to get signed up and they really have a top notch facility and planes.

We went up on a whim.  We drove up from Wasilla to explore Talkeetna sans tourists.  Now I love Talkeetna, and don’t favor what happened to our economy during C19 but this is a silver lining folks.  

The K2 facility is  beautiful.  All the mountains were out.   Our pilot, Chris experienced and knowledgeable. And with no other planes to check in with we had a private tour with all the history.  A week later and I’m still 2 miles high and enjoying my money’s worth.  Plus a great pick of all the wonderful gear with all sizing available. 

Not a plane in the sky!   No one mountaineers on the mountain.  No ski marks.   It’s a unique chance and there was a walk-in possibilities.  None of that edgy vibe that you sometimes get when the place is packed and walk-in availability.
