This Alaska fun hog doesn’t write about everything but I sure have to give them the best rating and if there was 100 stars  I’d give them 100 stars. 

Might just go back for another fix IF this one wears off.

Stunning !!! Best way to experience Denali !!! The staffs were so friendly and accommodating. We had a wonderful pilot. He was funny, friendly and very knowledgeable. At that height, if you don't have confidence on the pilot - you lose it..LOL. The landing experience was out of the world and we were given sufficient time to experience the vastness of it. If you can afford it and have time, please don't miss it. They have a wonderful team and tours.
what an amazing adventure Chris was informative, could not have asked for more.   Will definitely spread the word

review_title: 5/5 An experience you could won’t soon forget.
review_text: Great Safe professional experience. Definitely recommending to friends and family. The K2 staff was very accommodating and helpful.

We decided to go on a flightseeing tour, last minute.  K2 Aviation was able to accommodate us.  We went up, and our pilot pointed out fun stuff as we headed toward Denali.  He took us over Hunter Mountain and flew around so we could look for the two hikers ascending the mountain.  We had spectacular views and our pilot told us everything.  It was an incredible experience and well worth the money.  I felt safe and had a great time!!!!  I strongly recommend K2 Aviation!!

Wow, this was a great experience.  You really don't grasp the size of this mountain until you get up there in it, an awesome perspective that you can't get from the ground.  Our guide was Dallas, he was very personable, informative, and made us feel completely safe during the entire flight.  This flight was easily worth the price, I would do it again and Highly Recommend.
Excellent flight and very informative. Booked this as a surprise for my girlfriend and was super easy. Everyone was great. The pilot was very informative and helpful. I’d recommend this to anyone.
Our tour guide was informative and would double up on particularly great views. I would highly recommend.

As part of our overall Alaska experience, our vacation group (2 couples) did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour.  We loved every minute of it!  Our pilot, Ryan, was very personable, knowledgeable and fun during the trip.  He offered lots of information during the flight and explained what mountains/glaciers we were seeing.  I would recommend this tour to anyone interested.  Well worth the money!!

We decided to go with K2 and drive ourselves to Talkeetna from Anchorage--it saved us money and in the end they were great! We enjoyed the amazing views. Our pilot talked and informed us all along the way in local history, geology facts, etc. Would recommend to anyone. I even tend to get a little sick on small planes and I did okay. Pilot was kind to me and made gentle turns :).

We picked a great day.  100 plus mile visibility.  Couldn’t get all the places we hoped to go due to strong winds off the mountain but our pilot Doug was amazing.  His flying skills and knowledge were excellent.  Well worth the cost.  Only negative is it will depend on which plane you go up on if you are a larger person.   The small planes it could be a tight squeeze (I’m 6’4 and just fit in the Piper 6 - keep that in mind if you are tall to ask about aircraft).  That’s a nit picking negative because overall was truly one of the next sightseeing trips of my life!   Thanks K2!!

The views of the mountains, glaciers, rivers, and valleys was incredible. This was so much better than just seeing Denali from the ground.  The birds eye view was amazing. I highly recommend a tour with K2 Aviation for your Alaska trip.

review_title: Experience the very best of Alaska
review_text: Jst got off the plane and I could not wait to review K2. We had a wonderful experience today flying over Denali. The flight felt very safe and warm. I did not even have to wear my gloves. Doug, our pilot was very friendly and an amazing guide. During the flight, I noticed some ice caves and Doug was kind enough to help us get a closer look at the caves. We also saw so many mooses. Special thanks to Ernie at the desk, she was very helpful and gave us a lot of information about things to do around Talkeetna and Anchorage. Wonderful experience!! 10/10

This was the high of our trip! The views were stunning and the pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. Absolutely loved this experience and would highly recommend to anyone! I am even afraid of heights but you forget it all when viewing the mountains.

review_title: Had a great flight tour around Denali
review_text: My wife and I booked a K2 flight and it was a wonderful experience.  We'd picked a day when the weather was supposed to be reasonable clear and when the day came, there were clear blue skies.  Even though Denali was spectacular when we observed from a distance, it was wwwaaaayyyy more impressive up close.  Our pilot was very clear about how the flight would proceed and had a great sense of humor.  He kept a running commentary during the entire flight with interesting information about the National Park, climbing within the park, historical exploration, geology and other topics.

This was an amazing trip. Our pilot was excellent and the views we got were incredible. 
Would highly recommend this to anyone who is interested.
Amazing smooth, fun experience. Had great close up views and a great pilot Billy. This is a definite to do when visiting Denali

Incredible flight around Denali!  Our pilot, Ryan was great. He flew in a way that allowed both sides of the plane to see everything.  The views are out of this world!!  Ryan shared lots of information - the names of all the features, the routes made by climbers, history of the area, glacier geology.... Although a couple of us felt initially nervous about the flight in a small plane, once in the air, all fears melted away.

We flew with K2 Aviation for my birthday, and it was a wonderful experience. We unfortunately were not able to do the glacier landing due to poor weather conditions, but it was still a memorable trip. Our pilot was wonderful, and we got to fly in a 1958 de Havilland Beaver, which was really cool. I sat up front in the co-pilot seat, which was pretty cool. I highly recommend K2!

If you are looking for an experience you will never forget, go on a tour with K2! We were lucky to have a beautiful day with spectacular fall colors and mostly clear skies. Our pilot was friendly and knowledgable. He provided narration about Denali National Park as we flew and was open to questions. He also made sure to maneuver the plane so both sides had the best views possible! It was surreal seeing Denali, especially from such an unique vantage point. The tour would have been worth it for this, but to top it off, we also landed on a glacier! Our pilot made the landing look easy and we got to exit the plane and walk around a little. It was serene and magical. We will forever be grateful for the memories we made on this trip. Thank you K2!!

Staff were very attentive and accommodating when weather conditions for my scheduled flight weren't optimal, but we were cleared for a flight later in the afternoon. Be flexible with your time as Denali weather is unpredictable and know that safety comes first with flights over mountains. Views were SPECTACULAR!!! Unlike anything I've ever seen before. Pilots demonstrated excellent flying techniques and were knowledgeable with the topography below.

Experience the mountain in a brand new way with K2Aviation. Beginning with the informative pilot you take flight and explore everything from Denali, Hunter, and Forker. Let time stand still as you land on the glacier and look around at this gorgeous mountain! Take it from these newlyweds - we wouldn’t have wanted to miss it. 
Until next time!

Our pilot, Mark, was excellent.  He was very personable, and gave us lots of information about what we were seeing.  The views of Denali and its glaciers were amazing.  I would absolutely do this again!  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.
It was amazing! The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable and the view were incredible. Highly recommended.

review_title: Uno de mis mejores tours en avioneta
review_text:
La organización estupenda, se olvidaron de venirnos a buscar pero finalmente llegaron e hicimos el check-in con tiempo más que suficiente. Muy profesionales y amables, sin duda, avionetas pequeñas y el piloto genial. 
Lamentablemente y por razones que no vienen  al caso, no pudimos aterrizar en el glaciar como teníamos previsto pero el tour fue tan fantástico  que casi ni nos supo mal. Los glaciares y montañas estaban tan cerca que casi se podían tocar, fue una hora y media de vuelo tan repleta de paisajes y emociones que no se podía aprovechas más. No dejéis de hacerlo, además Talkeetna es el sitio ideal, como el objetivo principal es ver de cerca el monte Denali, nuestra primera idea fue hacer el vuelo desde Denali pero nos aconsejaron Talkeetna e hicimos caso, menos mal, por lo que pudimos observar la opción Denali es mucho peor por zona y recorrido. Animo a todo el mundo a hacer el tour, no es el primero ni el segundo que hago en avioneta sobre montañas y este fue soberbio

review_title: Awesome way to see Denali up close!
review_text: We had to adjust the tour a bit due to forest fire smoke - but was clear above 6000' and seemed we could have touched the mountains!  Glacier landing was not allowed due to low snowfall earlier in the year.  It still was a glorious view of the glaciers and mountains on such a clear day above the smoke. Pilot's explanation  of what we were seeing made the trip even more enjoyable.  Thanks for the great flight and experience!

My wife and I booked the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing for August 29.
  
K2 arranged pick-up and drop off service for us at the Talkeetna Lodge.  The transfers were completed smoothly.   We were informed that since Alaska experienced one of the warmest summers on records the snow on Denali was too soft to conduct the glacier landing.   I had been following the latest Tripadvisor reviews and anticipated this situation, disappointing, but totally understandable.  Since the tour was prepaid our credit card was reimbursed in a timely manner.

The plane has a capacity of 10 or 11 passengers and we had seven clients on this trip.   You are provided with headphones which permit the pilot to narrate information during the flight.   The headphones also contained a microphone which allows you to ask questions during the experience.

Each customers has a window seat which provides excellent views and an opportunity for unobstructed photography.  Frequently the pilot would maneuver the plane so the passengers on the right side would have a view of a glacier/mountain/point of interest and then adjust the route so the passengers on the left side would have a similar view.

Due to the Swan Lake fire the visibility directly after take-off was less than ideal.   The pilot indicated this would clear up as we gained altitude and approached the mountain range.   He was 100% correct as visibility was excellent as we approached Denali.

The day before we were fortunate to observe  Denali as we exited the park.   K2 provided an entirely different visual experience.  The excursion is definitely on the expensive side, but since this was likely our one and only trip to Alaska it was totally worth it.  

The Denali Experience is the basic of the three tours that K2 offers, for us the length of time in the air was satisfactory.

K2 did an outstanding job for us. We are now in the 10% club who have actually seen the summit thanks to K2. Safety was a top priority and the pilot did a great job narrating and ensuring everyone got a good view. We saw Denali, Hunter and the Ruth glacier. 

Not to be missed.

Les vues étaient magnifiques ! Nous sommes partis de Talkeetna, et le temps étant un peu nuageux et venteux, nous n'avons pas fait le tour en entier. Mais le vol a quand même duré 1h. Le personnel est vraiment très aimable, et a été très arrangeant lorsque nous avons annulé la participation d'une personne (sur 4 inscriptions) au dernier moment (la personne étant malade). 
L'Alaska est vraiment impressionnant vu d'en haut !

I spent 10 days in Alaska with a friend,and our flightseeing tour was a definite highlight! Our pilot was very personable, knowledgeable, and safety conscious. We were supposed to do the slightly longer tour, but due to clouds it was shortened to the one hour flight. It was breathtaking. My friend asked if she could sit in the co-pilot seat and enjoyed it so much (She said it was "not for the faint-of-heart" lol) I've included a picture she took that has the propeller showing as we approached Denali. The glaciers were incredible to view and we were lucky to have blue skies at Denali's summit. It was Sept 5th and the fall colors were beautiful. We were still awestruck for several hours after the flight. I wish I could remember our pilot's name (I think Daniel?) because he was great.  Thanks K2!

review_title: Most amazing views in my life!
review_text:
We were only in Talkeetna for one day and knew that Denali weather has a mind of its own. But to our delight the rain cleared and the day was perfectly clear, resulting in one of the most spectacular things we have ever seen or done!

We originally booked the glacier landing but the glacier was not in a safe condition for landing so we changed to the Summit tour. Last minute the Summit tour was cancelled due to high winds, so we sort-of reluctantly rebooked to the Denali Grand Tour since it would be the best option we could get. The Grand Tour was utterly spectacular. I was lucky enough to ride copilot, our pilot was fantastic and answered all of my nerdy airplane questions, and for 90 minutes we got to see the staggering views of Denali and the surrounding rivers, glaciers, and sister mountains up close and personal with INSANE visibility. We climbed to a total of 12.3kft and could see each peak in an incredibly personal and in-your-face manner as we weaved in-and-out through the peaks and valleys. 

90 minutes came and went so fast. Yes this can seem expensive to most, but damnit, do it! You will not regret it for a minute and you’ll have unreal photos to reflect on for the rest of your life. 

We are still in awe. Thank for the mesmerizing experience, K2! Just keep flying!

Our flight could have been a disappointment: clouds kept us from seeing Denali up close and the lack of fresh snow prevented the glacier landing. Despite all that, it was still an astonishing and beautiful experience. The flight was smooth and the relatively slow speed meant you could really take in the view...and what a view. This landscape is part of what makes Alaska such a remarkable place and there is just no other way to get this perspective. One of the highlights of our trip.

The pilot was very confidente, nice and informative before, during and after the flight. 
The airplane offered a slow and smooth ride, and had a "private" window for every passenger.  The views are just fantastic.  My wife and I spent 2 weeks in Alaska, and this was 1 of the 4 top programmes we have done in the 49th State.

We ended up in Talkeetna on a clear day so we booked our flight as soon as we arrived to take advantage of the weather. The plane was awesome and so was the flightseeing. It was so much fun that I would do it again. If the cost seems high, please know that it's 100% worth it.

I had a blast flying around Denali and looking at the mountains and glaciers up close. It was stunning.  The K2 facilities and the plane were clean and well kept.  The staff was pleasant and professional.

Excellent customer service, I love Ericka, she attended me in spanish, my languaje, and  made me feel comfortable,   The plane works perfect and the pilot was incredible skilled, I don't know his name but he drives the two engine plane. Me and my friend, we felt totally safe and enjoyed the whole trip
A most do in Talkeetna. Worth every dollar that was spent. Pilot was very knowledgeable and very friendly

We had the best pilot,Steve, and he was so knowledgeable about the area. The views were amazing! They were so accommodating with my husbands limited mobility (he has a fractured ankle). The weather was not good the day we planned so we moved it to another day and they were so helpful and willing to change.

Booked this with my father who was up in Alaska visiting me. We originally booked the Grand Denali with glacier landing, and was told we'd be on a Turbine Otter-- which made sense, given they're the majority of K2 and every other Talkeetna tour operator's fleet, as they make excellent flight seeing planes due to their high wings and single engine. The booking was pricey, especially when an entire 185 could have been chartered for the same money (and we'd have had seats to spare), but being able to land on the glacier was worth it, we thought.

When we arrived we learned the glacier landing was scrubbed due to the warm weather. Not much to be done about that-- we were disappointed but in no way upset about K2 for it. And besides, the weather was as clear and sunny as I have ever seen Denali, and smoke from the local wildfires had shifted out of the area, setting up K2 with the opportunity to give an absolutely amazing trip.

Instead, they blew it. We were ushered not to an Otter but a Piper Navajo, whose twin engines and low wings make it utterly horrible for a flight seeing plane-- probably why neither Talkeetna Air Taxi nor Sheldon Air Service across the taxiway from K2 have anything like it in their fleet. It is, however, a bit cheaper to operate than an Otterof which there were about 4 on the ramp at K2 when we departed. The picture attached shows the view out my window. I spent the entire flight with them obstructing the views and making pictures more difficult.

I won't be bringing any other visitors back to K2. Taking a scenic around Denali is certainly an experience, but K2 absolutely blew it. I'll be taking future visitors elsewhere.

Fabulous! Our pilot, Dan was excellent in narrating the 1+ hour flight around Denali and the surrounding areas. Excellent views from both sides of the plane. 
Even though we had partly cloudy skies, he took advantage to vary the elevations and slight turning of the plane for the best views. We could not do the Glacier landing as the weather did not cooperate for a safe landing and takeoff but other than that, the experience should be on everyone's bucket list.

Cannot begin to put in words this experience."the high one" showed her peak which is a rarity this time of the year. K2 is top notch, down to earth, go the extra mile to give us a once in a lifetime experience. We thought this was expensive, but Billy, our pilot got us so close to the mountain, yet completely safe. Thank you K2 for this service.

We made a last minute decision to fly. We were rewarded with an outstanding part of our visit to Denali area. We were blessed with incredible views of Denali and the surrounding peaks. Our pilot Jeff was awesome and the staff at their headquarters friendly and professional. Once in a lifetime experience worth the investment. Highly recommend.
Our pilot Doug was amazing. Although he has flown this tour for years, he was excited as we were.  The whole process from reservation ,to check in , our flight and after was top notch

We flew with Dan in the Otter, the last flight of 
the day. His greeting to us was polite & he was an apparent plane guy from the get go. The safety briefing was easy to understand & t ime was given for questions. The take off was smooth & we leveled off & took off for the beautiful Alaska scenery which didnt disappoint. His narration was just enough & knowledgeable. The incessant other pilot chatter was a distraction & interruption. Plenty of perfect pic opportunities were made & the flight was smooth despite clouds & some wind. We landed perfectly with great pics and and an awesome time to sury repeat. He even asked if we were co le, checked our headsets, helped an elderly passenger in. The only pitfall or complaint would be price or some other snooty staff. Thanks K2 & Dan!!!!

review_title: Professional Operation & a Smooth, Beautiful Ride
review_text: Our pilot, Dan, took us for an excellent ride in the Denali mountain area.  One of the highlights of our cruise-tour.  Booked directly.

review_title: This tour was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!
review_text:
We decided at the last moment to splurge and take this tour. After all, how often does one go to Denali? The weather was spectacular (we were told by many locals that it was unusual to have a clear day).  Our pilot, Stan, was excellent & entertaining.  But Denali was breathtaking. Even now, nearly a month after our trip, words can't describe how incredible it all was.  Check out my photos.

If you're on the fence about whether or not to spend to money to do this, I say do it. It's the opportunity of a lifetime!

Chris our pilot was excellent! We had an incredibly clear day and that was HUGE! The booking, check in, and flight was easy and well organized! Easy to find and lovely new facility. 

We did book this while staying in Denali, I didn't realize it was a bit of a hike back down to Talkeenta (about 2.5 hours) but WELL worth the drive!

review_title: Sights amazing, K2 not so much
review_text: The experience was 5 stars but K2 was not the reason. Paid for flyer with landing. flight time was 70mintues not 100. Pilot was not engaging. Very quiet flight.  Answered some questions. Obversely in a hurry to go home as he was in parking lot before we took off boots. But it was a safe trip.

It's a pity that they cannot provide glacier landing due to the dry condition, but the trip is still gorgeous with wonderful views!! The sky looks smoky due to wild fire, it's very clear when flying on top of it. You can see clearly the peak of Mt. Denali, and various glaciers surrounding it. You will find keep taking pictures/videos the whole trip. Definitely recommended! 

The question is never about whether the trip worth the money; it's about whether the weather allows you to flight so that you can learn the true meaning of Denali Beauty.

We were lucky enough to fly with the amazing pilot Chad. This was one of the most amazing excursions I have ever had. It was a beautiful sunny day with clear skies. The flight was very smooth. Chad pointed out all the highlights. If you want to see “it all”, join Chad on a once in a lifetime flight.

Absolutely stunning. The pilot was very experienced and made everyone on board feel safe. My 6 year old boy loved being able to talk to the pilot through the headset. This is a must do if you plan on visiting the 49th state.

review_title: Our flight over Denali was Awesome!
review_text: Our K2 Denali Summit tour was an amazing experience not likely to be forgotten anytime soon. Our pilot was very helpful with the technical aspects of our flight such as safety and the operations of the aircraft, and he was also knowledgeable about Denali and its history and features. His narration was informative and he encouraged us to ask questions if we had any. We spent a good hour at and around the range and visited many of the most prominent features. I would highly recommend a K2 flight to the summit as there is no other way most of us will ever see Denali up close.

It was a great flying experience, with view of mountains, valleys, glaciers all over. The journey is scenic right away.I loved looking down at the color changing trees and deep blue lakes at the beginning and end and then just being swept away by the magic of the great mountain giants that is Denali and the surrounding peaks. Majestic scenery, stunning upclose views of a dramatic mountainous terrain, peaks rising from the clouds, with the sun playing different shades on everything, it was just beautiful. Something everyone should experience. I'm very grateful to K2 for the incredible 1 hour journey. Thank you!

review_title: This was a pretty awesome trip!
review_text: We did the Grand Tour.  It was so awesome!  We got pretty close to Denali, above the clouds, like it was in our face!  Got some pretty awesome pictures.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable. I believe his name was Rick.  He was very good!

We booked this tour at the last minute and are so glad we did.   It was one of the coolest things we've done. Even though it was overcast the pilot was able to climb up and we got a beautiful view of Denali above the clouds.  It's hard to find the words to describe the enormity of the glaciers.   So glad we got to experience this! We definitely would recommend this tour.

review_title: Don’t miss out on beautiful views!!!
review_text: Very awesome company!! Would recommend to anyone! Really exciting way to see Alaska! Very cool view of Denali! Everyone wears headphones to hear and talk to the pilot which is a nice touch. He answers questions and tells some interesting facts! Very fun! Worth every penny.

Despite the wildfire smoke and limited visibility, this was still absolutely breathtaking. Our pilot was excellent - soft spoken, knowledgeable, I couldn't have felt like I was in safer hands. Everything was just perfect.

We went on a Denali Flyer tour and Stan was our pilot.  Our aircraft was a deHavilland Otter, and our flight was breath-taking and well narrated bu Stan.  The lessons on Denali and the geographic events that formed it were amazing.  Not a single negative thing to say about this outstanding trip!

I need to reschedule the flight for 3 times because of Glacier Landing. When I asked a front desk person, when was the last glacier landing, she did not able to answer me which is quite awkward whereas K2 Aviation giving advertisement always with Glacier landing. So I need to choose only Denali Grand tour without Glacier landing which is fine cause they can not land on hard ice or weather contsraints. However, as a Company they should have keep the statistics or records when was the last glacier landing or the ideal time of Glacier landing chances so customer can plan accordingly.

The grand tour was good but it would be nicer if the pilot would narrate the navigation during fly as it was depicted on their website pages how would be the navigation and what mountains and peaks would be covered as well as an handly print out of this navigation so customer can enjoy the total journey fully instead of just seeing white glaciers from the top.

We took the Denali Experience flightseeing tour from Talkeetna.  It was a safe and beautiful flight. Originally we had booked the Grand Tour, but weather conditions prevented the two hour flight. K2 Aviation was very good in keeping us informed of weather, our options to select another tour, reschedule and/or cancel.  All the staff was welcoming and friendly. The pilot was knowledgeable and did a good job of pointing out highlights of scenery and answering questions.  Great tour. We definitely recommend.

My flying was cancelled twice due to no fly days because of high winds. Finally good weather & great time. Pilot Billy very friendly & provided narration for entire trip. Unable to have glacier landing but csr service very prompt on crediting my credit card. They also keep you up to date on flying status & weather via email. Well worth the wait. Did have bit of headache afterwards due to vibration & noise but would do it 
again (& again)

From the moment we signed up for our flight tour, K2 clearly communicated with us about payment, the flight, etc.  The flight itself was tremendous: I got the feeling that they had really thought through the best flight path for the tour.  And, we landed on a glacier!  I liked that we were able to spend some time on the glacier itself.  Our pilot was excellent!  Overall, a great company and experience.

review_title: Once In A Life Time Trip
review_text: Highly recomend the flightseeing tour with glazier landing. Was one of most exciting things I have ever done

What an awesome experience! Our plane had 9 passengers. You can ask the pilot to ride shot gun to have a front row seat. We opted for the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing. They provided snow boots that you put over your shoes and shades in case you forget. Pilot is experienced in doing the glacier landing. You spend around 15 minutes on the glacier. View is just breathtaking. We were the only ones on the glacier. Flight was smooth but it smelled of diesel fuel. Highly recommended. Price is expensive but if you have extra cash the experience is worth it.

The K2 Denali Flightseeing tour is an absolute MUST for anyone visiting Alaska! The pilots are incredibly personable and knowledgeable of the area. The staff is incredibly professional and considerate. Our flight had to be cut short because of weather rolling in but before we had even landed, we were already refunded for the unused flight time. Landing on a glacier is a truly remarkable experience we won’t soon forget! Thank you K2 Aviation for an awesome trip!

Senza dubbio è un esperienza da fare. Accettazione e front office eccellente. costi abbastanza alti. Tour sempre legati al tempo che varia con molta facilità. Alla fine nonostante ci abbia provato un paio di volte non è semplice trovare le condizioni giuste per atterrare sui ghiacciai. L'aereo è sicur.o ma si balla. Sconsigliato per chi soffre di "mal d'aereo"

This tour was a once in a lifetime experience! We were able to see the most beautiful views of Denali. All the employees were friendly, courteous, and extremely knowledgeable about the park. It was absolutely incredible!

review_title: A once in a lifetime experience.  WOW
review_text: This was a once in a lifetime experience.  The higlight of our trip to Alaska.  Staff was courtious and well informed.   Helped us thru the process step by step.  Felt very safe throughout the flight, pilot was friendly answering questions and interacting with the attendees.

We thought we were going to be disappointed because the weather stopped us from seeing Denali mountain and we couldn't land on the glacier.
We were wrong, it was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! 
Everything looked so different from the air and the pilot was so knowledgeable and went out of his way to make sure it was so special.

While the glaciers do not disappoint the reason most people want to take the tours is to see Denali. 
Since the weather OFTEN prevents you from seeing the mountain but allows you to fly below the clouds to see the glaciers this is the most common tour.  
Are the views amazing?  Yes!   Is it worth the cost to not see Denali?   Debatable.

We gave it a shot and picked a day with 20% rain, turned out fine with cloud surrounding Mckinley but got to see the summit. TIp 1. Don't pick flight with the twin engine, if you are unlucky to sit on the wing that will ruin the view. Looks like there is only one such plane at K2. Tip 2. Request seat with the pilot, the bonus panoramic front view is awesome but picure will show the prop. There is seat pocket on the door to keep cell or extra lens, bino. 

My family w 3 teenagers were absolutely thrilled. It's the highlight of our Alaskan trip. If you can affort the extra 100 bucks for glacier landing do it. Even if just flying through the park and see the rugged terrain up cloase is quite an experience. Our flight path was different from advertised, I guess was due to cloud. We landed on Kahiltna Glacier and didn't fly to Ruth or Tokositna Glaciers.

This was hands down one of the most humbling experiences I’ve had of my many adventures.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier at Base Camp on the south west slopes of Denali makes you feel very small in the grand scheme of things.  Patrick, our pilot, was stellar.  What an awe inspiring scenery.  It was a blessing to experience it.  We originally intended to do the summit flight with glacier landing, however due to storms the attempt was too dangerous.  K2 happily quickly and happily offered to get us on the Grand Tour with the glacier landing with the promise of better views flying amongst the towering walls as opposed to above them.  They were beyond correct.  I would highly recommend this experience!!  Well done K2 Aviation, well done.

Class A operation from start to finish.  Beautiful new office facility with a video of what we were going to experience.  Great pilot Will was very informative and[professional. Overall a must do attraction in Alaska.  One you will never forget!

We really enjoyed this start to finish along with our 2 and 3 year old kids. K2 were very accomodating, allowing us to easily switch dates to accomodate the logistics of travelling with toddlers as well as have the peace of mind of a full refund even with late cancellation. Also the discounts for travelling with 2 year olds were significantly larger than at the other places we checked. It was great to be able to do a few swings around the glacier before landing and thus get good time to take in the details of Denali's south face. Chris was our pilot and excellent guide.
Wonderful flight. Heavy smoke meant no view of Denali from the ground or in the park. But a couple of thousand feet up and the view was perfect! Totally clear day. Great pilot and experience!

The K2 Aviation team went above and beyond tommake sure we were able to have the full experience, even though we booked a little last minute. The flightseeing tour was awesome and they made sure we made it back to our hotel shuttle on time! Great outfit and we endorse them 100%.

Get up close and personal with Denali with the Grand Tour to view one of the most dramatic sights in America. You get a totally different perspective and experience seeing the mountain in detail from the air. Our pilot was fantastic. Just do it, you will not regret taking this tour.

review_title: Our pilot was great! Very personable and knowledgeable with out having to fill every second with talking.
review_text: The operation was professional from start to finish! Check in, pre-flight, boarding, the tour and de-planing.  The plane and all facilities were clean and well maintained.  And, of course, nothing can match the majesty of Denali. Highly recommend!
Fantastic experience!  The fly-in/hiking was the best experience that we had during our Alaska vacation.
Bucket List activity that was amazing. K2 / Rust’s is a well oiled machine. Very informative and friendly pilot. Breathtaking scenery.

K2 are an excellent, professional and friendly company. If you have the opportunity to take one of their tours I would highly recommend it. As a pilot I appreciate the skill and experience it takes to fly members of the public around one of the world's great mountains and to land on a glacier with delicate precision. Stan (sorry buddy but I guess you'll get some stick from the rest of the gang), was ultra-professional while also being informative and entertaining. The whole process, from booking through pick-up and check in was easy and it made for a perfect day that will stick in our memories forever.

The plane and pilot were first rate. We only saw the tip of Denali because of clouds (disappointing because k-2 reports said otherwise that morning). The trip was expensive for the results. The glaciers were impressive.

We weren't able to do the tour we wanted to do due to clouds and wind at the summit, but K2 did everything they could to get us on another tour.  We weren't disappointed!  Pilot was awesome and the views were, of course, breathtaking.  Definitely something not to be missed.

Exceeded my sky-high expectations (no pun intended). Very professional, provided updates about weather and conditions before the trip. Pilot was very informed and safety-oriented. Route was perfect and allowed both sides of the plane to see everything (sometimes flying in 'S' patterns to allow that). Everyone had a window seat. Glacier landing was smooth, as was the whole flight. Highly recommended.

review_title: AMAZING!!!!!!  A must do to truly experience Alaska!
review_text: You can’t experience Alaska without doing this.  It was the highlight of our trip.  Words can not describe the incredible views that will be imprinted in my mind forever.  Our pilot was awesome!!!!  Bring your camera!  You’re  sure to take hundreds of unbelievable photos!!!!!!

Decided to spend the money on a flight tour of Denali. For a family of 5, it’s quite expensive...but...
worth every penny.  My God, the scenery from above cannot be out matched. Sooooo beautiful!! Captain Wilbur ensured a safe and smooth flight, pointing out all the highlights along the way . My kids ( 16,14 & 12 ) were a little nervous at start, but after the first 10 minutes got used to the small plane and couldn’t stop taking pictures. Thanks captain Will and K2 for an amazing, unforgettable experience!

This was our second visit to K2 Aviation as we had guests with us that needed to have this amazing experience. This Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing was even better than our first trip (8 years ago)!  We had a perfect day for flying and Chris our pilot was excellent.  Chris gave us information about our flight that left us with very few questions.  He took the time to make sure both sides of the plane enjoyed the magnificent views of Denali.  He also was very accomodating and patient of a guest that had limited mobility as she entered and exited the plane (even at the glacier).
Stan was an amazing pilot and an even better tour guide!  I would definitely recommend this experience to everyone!!  Thank you K2!

So incredible. We did the Denali summit tour and landed on the glacier.Our family of 4 went and it exceeded everyone's expectations which is hard to with us, ranging from 16-48 yrs old. We had clear views and beautiful weather. The staff at K2 were great to work with from the very beginning and we loved out pilot. Highly recommend!!
A beautiful tour. Our pilot Jeff was perfect for this excursion. Very knowledgeable about the area and terrain. Breathtaking views.

review_title: Great time and even better pilot
review_text: Although the weather curtailed our flight the sites were still incredible and the pilot was the absolute best. First class service!

K2 is a top-notch organization.  The weather was bad on our originally scheduled tour date but they allowed us to move our flight to a different date of our choosing.  The weather was much better on that date so we were able to do the glacier landing.  They were very flexible and accommodating.  Thanks K2 for a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

It was easier and better than expected!! 6 of us flew evening of July 30 and luckily we had clear views of all mountain peaks!  Super smooth ride, incredible close up views! So glad we went! Great experience.

It has been a amazing experience. Landing on the glacier and view this unique surroundings was special. The K2 flight company offered a great service with a reasonable price.
Recommended.

This was a spectacular experience!  We were scheduled for the Grand Tour with glacier landing but had to step back to the Flyer tour (still with glacier landing) due to weather.  It was not the least bit disappointing.  We still flew up to the mountain Denali and got a close look at it.  Our pilot Stan was so knowledgeable and inspired much confidence (I was nervous taking this flight) because of his years and years of experience.  He knew so much about the area!  I would do this again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Best Flightseeing Tour and Company I’ve Ever Seen
review_text: Absolutely amazing experience all around. I was hesitant at first because it was my first time on a small plane, but the pilot was so personable and really perfected the experience. Stunning views that you can’t get anywhere else in Alaska and I also learned so much about the area. Definitely a must for anyone traveling that wants an experience of a lifetime.
Phenomenal.  What a great flight with Daniel in an Otter, made even better with the glacier landing.  If you are in Alaska - DO IT!

Originally signed up for the Summit Tour with Glacier landing but due to clouds, couldn't be done. But thankfully, the Denali Experience could happen. Something was better than nothing. We were able to see the top of Denali which pictures don't do this justice. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and had a blast flying around in a tiny plane. All the staff of K2 is very friendly. Definitely recommend for sure!

We came for a flight seeing tour of Denali but due to weather weren’t able to fly that day. I wish I had known to check my email on the morning of the trip, it would have saved me a long drive as they had sent a message telling us of the less than desirable weather. It was overcast and so we wouldn’t have been able to see Denali. We were rescheduled for the next day but the same occurred and they offered a flight seeing excursion around the Talkeetna valley area (sheep mountain). Although it was a bummer that we didn’t get the full Denali viewing tour (not their fault) the Talkeetna valley tour was fun. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. He took his time explaining the safety features and helped quell some other people’s fears of flying. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. It’s a little awkward getting into the planes but there were was an older lady on our trip with a bad knee that the pilots and rampers were only too willing to help out. I would fly with this company again.

Matt was a great pilot and seemed to know the Otter we were flying in. The weather could have been better but I could still see how massive Denali was close up. It was a great experience and I'd definitely do it again. The hosting center at Tolkeetna airport is spacious, new, comfortable with plenty of bathrooms.

review_title: Mountains at epic scale and glacier landings. This one has it all.
review_text:
It's hard to imagine there are better views of Denali and the Alaska Range available unless you plan to climb the beast. The glacier landing was a really nice touch and added an element of scale to this remote range. The vastness of the valley we landed in was hard to capture in a picture, the only way to get it is to be there. 

Our pilot was top notch - my dad is a pilot and sat in the front seat on the return flight. He was impressed. 

Can't recommend this enough.

Our family took this tour last week (my husband, kids aged 15, 11, and 11, and me). It was fantastic. The views of the mountains were terrific. Landing on the glacier was a lifetime highlight. The amphitheater where we landed is so beautiful. We were initially scheduled to go on a Saturday. The weather wasn't cooperating, and we would have had to do a different tour. They let us reschedule to the following Tuesday when we would be driving back through Talkeetna on our way back from Denali. It worked out great. Chris, our pilot, was a wealth of information and handled the plane extremely well. We would definitely do this again, and the kids loved it too.

review_title: Wow!  That is what you'll be saying when your flying right up next to the mountain.
review_text: This is a once in a lifetime experience.  My wife and I were in awe and it was worth every penny.  Our pilot was great and made the flight very smooth.  Loved it!!!

review_title: Breathtaking views of the Last Frontier
review_text: This flightseeing trip with K2 was the highlight of our land trip/cruise to Alaska.  Our pilot Chad made us feel completely safe and at ease in the plane, as if he was driving us around Denali in a limo!  We were blessed with a beautiful day as he flew us within a few miles of The Great One.  We were thrilled to have seen The Last Frontier in all its amazing beauty and awesome splendor.  This is a MUST DO excursion when you visit Alaska!
There's really no comparison. You can't see Mt Denali like this any other way. It's sure to be one of the most beautiful and unique experiences you've ever had.

Outstanding!  Even though we could not fly all the way around Denali due to weather, the glacier landing and viewing was breathtaking.  Must do.  They discounted our package as the weather restricted the flight path.  Landed near Sheldon homestead.  Entire K-2 team was great.

review_title: High above everything else, the mountains reign.
review_text: We had a wonderful flight with great visibility and our pilot guide was not only knowledgeable but fun and entertaining. The views were great and the landing on the glaciar was truly spectacular. The weather was so warm that we didn’t even need extra layers!
Really amazing experience, very nice professional people and great and experienced pilot. Stan we loved you :) Strongly recommended

This trip was incredible. The glacier landing was definitely worth it. We had a wonderful pilot who provided interesting information and was very safe and knowledgeable. It was so worth it to take this flight tour!

review_title: Astounding beauty, One of a kind experience
review_text: I literally cried a little - it was so awesome and breathtaking! Landing on the glacier (though I have been on many) was thrilling and stunningly beautiful - don't miss it. Stan was a knowledgeable, interesting guide and a great pilot. If you feel nervous - you are in safe hands. Also there is a lot of working around the weather - so be patient. The tour group really is trying to get you the best view and keep you safe. This is one of the best tours I have ever taken!

Wonderful! We had originally signed up for the glacier experience, but the weather wasn't cooperating. The staff was willing to let us switch and let any members of our party back out with a full refund....that never happens! We did the flight seeing tour instead and it was amazing. Our pilot, Wilbur, is now my favorite person in Talkeetna. He was calming and informative and fabulous!
We very much enjoyed the trip to the glacier. An experienced and knowledgeable pilot.We would highly recommend the excursion.

Just yesterday my wife and I enjoyed the spectacular beauty of Denali from the air with K2!  The pilot was excellent, explaining as we flew along and answering questions; the plane, an OTTER was perfect, the office folks were wonderful.  On a business trip 25 years ago I took this flight and have been looking for the occasion for my wife to share the experience with me - the occasion was our 50th anniversary vacation and she was appropriately delighted with the experience.
I could go on and on -- just do it!  You will forever be glad you did!

We had a family (10) vacation and decided on K2 to take us on a glacier landing.  WOW what a trip.  Randy the pilot was super informative.  Glacier landing was so easy.  My grandkids loved it as well as the grown kids.  We capped off a 10 day vacation with this tour.  It was a great ending to a wonderful vacation.

Altogether - great flight - captain - booking - plane 

Exceeded expectations - 
Well explained - quiet confident competent pilot - 
Yes ! In a safety critical environment to have friendly high professionalism!!

review_title: Landing on a glacier is awesome!
review_text: We had a fantastic experience! Chris is an excellent pilot and guide. He shared personal experiences with us and is a wealth of knowledge.  We got a beautiful view of the area. Landing on a glacier is incredible! We laid on it and even threw a couple of ice balls at each other.  We highly recommend

review_title: Amazing experience, glacier landing totally worth it
review_text: An overall great experience, amazing views, very capable and experienced pilot. Landing on a glacier was truly incredible. Keep in mind that what you see will always depend on the weather patterns which are constantly changing. Highly recommend. A few in my group felt a little queasy so may want to take Dramamine or the patch if you are prone to motion sickness.

I had seen these flight advertised before and was tempted to book a flight but wasn’t totally sure. My husband and I did end up booking a flight and it was the best decision ever. The weather was perfect in fact so great that our pilot gave us extra 15 minutes because he himself enjoyed it so much and the weTher isn’t always so nice. The landing on the glacier was smooth and standing there on the ice was a wonderful experience I will never forget. The flight was expensive but worth every single penny.

There really aren't words to describe just how amazing the scenery and views on this experience were. We packed a ton of activities into two weeks in Alaska, and this is right at the very top of our favorites. 

We were scheduled for the Grand Tour, but when we arrived were told that while the weather where we were was great, it wasn't ideal on one side of the mountain, so we were downgraded to the Denali Flyer Tour (and given a refund for the price difference). The glacier landing portion of the trip would be a game-time decision made by the pilot. 

Flying over the mountains and glaciers was just unbelievable. The pilot was knowledgable with great commentary, and we felt very safe on the plane the entire time. Landing on the Ruth Glacier and being able to walk around for about 30 minutes was otherworldly. The clouds had been clearing all morning and we ended up with what the pilot said was one of the clearest days in weeks. We ended up with a perfect view of Denali! 

Excursions like this are expensive, but provide such a different point of view than you'll get from the ground or the water... I can't recommend it enough. It's truly a once in a lifetime experience, one I'll never forget. Thanks K2!
This was one of the highlights of our trip k2 were awesome what an amazing thing to do was land on the glacier  thanks again mark and debora andrews

We did the "Denali Experience" without the glacier landing.
Seeing Mt Denali was on my Mom's bucket list but at the time we visited the national park the visibility was poor.  We called a couple of flight tour companies to see if we could get closer.  We quickly dismissed the idea once we got prices from a couple of companies in Denali!  We had to drive to Anchorage so I decided to see if there were any options on the way and found K2.  Their price was half as much, they had an aircraft that could accommodate our large party of 8 adults, and I made the reservation just the day before!  All the staff we dealt with over the phone and in person were great.  The pilot was fantastic and did an amazing job getting us a view of Mt Denali and knew everything about the glacial and geological history of the area. 
 Totally worth the drive to Talkeetna, especially if you're headed to Anchorage anyway.  I wouldn't hesitate to use K2 again.
We were not able to fly due to weather and they were gracious to book us the next day and we had a wonderful time. Beautiful sights and fun to land in the glacier!
Within 30 minutes of asking "Have You Got a Flight Available?" we were wheels up. Caught a peak of the Denali summit through the skill and passion of pilot Doug.
K2 was great. Terrific plane, pilot and trip. This flight with the glacier landing was the highlight of our 10 days in Alaska.
Was by far the best excursion of our land& sea CruiseTour! I highly recommend it. Our flight was smooth and the views were incredible.

We had a great experience on this summit tour. The pilot made our tour a little longer than was scheduled which was really nice. My husband had just summited Denali which made it even more special.  Definitely recommend.

Flight was cancelled due to wildfire smoke and ultimately for safety reasons. I’m leaving this review as a testament that K2 Aviation only flies when it’s safe and will cancel flights for safety reasons.  Although disappointed about having trip canceled, it’s better to be safe than sorry.

review_title: Wonderful experience of the Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2
review_text:
That is a Wonderful experience of the Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2. It's amazing feeling to view the Denaly and the Glaciers from sky. The pilot tried his best to make sure everyone in the plane could see the viewpoints. During landing the glacier, the pilot helped to take picture for all of us. 

If you travel to Alaska, don't miss the activity -- Denali Experience With Glacier Landing via K2.

We had a wonderful family flightseeing trip with K2. Much to our and our kids' disappointment, our morning flight was initially cancelled because of smoke from forest fires. But K2 managed to squeeze us in on a flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a few hours later, and it was the highlight of our trip for my teen and tween daughters! Our pilot patiently answered my nine-year-old's questions on the flight and took terrific pictures of us on the glacier. Great trip and great staff!

review_title: Sunny day - got to see all the mountains!
review_text: It was a perfect day to see the Denali mountain, and also the 2 smaller ones next to it (the "momma" and "baby"). Our pilot was Chad Smith. He said only 5% of people get to see all 3mountains at the same time, so it was our lucky day!  I was concerned about flying on such a small plane, but the ride was smooth, and I was so busy getting pictures of everything that I completely forgot I was on a small plane.  I would definitely recomment this tour for everyone!
The tour is well organized and professional. It brought me really close to Denali which is impossible to do by land.

The flight was enjoyable but not earth shattering like promoted! Pilot Patrick was doing a job not actively enthusiastically participating so I’d rate that part as average. Without the glacier landing the flight would be Ho Hum! The bushfire smog affected visibility and it was obvious that we were unlucky flying in today’s conditions. Last point at approx A$500 for the experience I think time again I’d prefer a trip in winter when conditions were better for sight seeing

The Denali Grand flight tour was incredible.  To be able to see this amazing mountain up close at 12000 feet was such an inspiring experience.  Our pilot Will was very informative.  My husband took wonderful photos that are just not obtainable any other way!

Was struggling with how to take in Denali on a short trip, and this is definitely the way to do it.  Saw so much of the Alaska range, up close and personal, and a knowledgeable and friendly guide.  Glacier landing a definite - do it!  It so crazy to set down in the middle of the snowfield with mountains all around you.  Flying out of the snowfield, you're flying through a glacial valley, with rock cliffs to either side.  It really is a must-do.  BTW, I'm jumpy on small planes, but I was enjoying myself so much I completely forgot about it.

This flight was a dream come true.  You get close enough to the summit that you can see the trails the climbers have made in their camps and to the summit!!!  Photo opportunities abound as the pilot turned the plane in every possible direction zigzagging all around the summit while flying at 22000 feet!!!  Words and pictures simply cannot describe this amazing experience. Highly recommended.

We missed this tour on our previous trip and were so glad to take it this time.  Beautiful views of the mountains and glaciers!  Our pilot did a great job with narration and keeping us informed of distances and other planes.  We even got a look at Denali which we missed the previous day in the park.  This was the highlight of our trip!!!

Incredible, as I thought it must be, to be that close to something so huge when stll 50 miles away on the ground. Chris was my excellent pilot, adding facts and figures, history and smiles throughout our 90 minutes in the air. DO NOT MISS this experience should the weather cooperate with your travel plans!

It was definitely an unforgettable experience flying over the glaciers. We booked for the grand tour but was changed to the flyer tour due to weather condition that day. Except that, everything went very well. The staffs were very friendly and the pilot was, too, and also very professional. We learned more about the glaciers through pilot's narratives as we flew over the mountains. The view was astonishing. Then we came back safely. Liked it a lot. I do want to point out, however, that after we left and searched online we found that there was an accident which killed 5 people last year. Please do plan with all the risks that come with the tour.

review_title: Breathtaking experience you just have to do!
review_text: K2 was our favorite experience of our entire week in Alaska! Though we couldn’t land on the glacier due to poor weather conditions, the flight experience was breathtaking! The staff and pilot were all exceptional and skilled. No matter where you sat on the plane you couldn’t get a bad picture because the pilot took you to a little slice of heaven! It was an unforgettable experience and I highly recommend it! It is a must in AK!

This was a fabulous excursion!  The pilot made sure everyone on the plane could see the sights as he was pointing things out.  Such a beautiful view of Denali and the glaciers!  Highly worth it!!  It was the highlight of our Alaska trip.

We’re from Anchorage and spent the 4th of July camping in Talkeetna. We woke up and meandered into K2, not expecting to go flying that day. They made us an offer we couldn’t refuse and that afternoon all 6 of us were up in the air flying around Denali!
Our kids 7,5,3 and 9months did great. Car seats were provided for the youngest two. The pilot was so attentive about every detail and explained the process and safety to us. He was so welcoming to our children! 
Seeing this mountain up close after having lived near it for over 10 years was breathtaking. The different amphitheaters with hanging glaciers were simply amazing. The range of mountains - the Alaskan Range - just keeps going on and on and on!! 
It was an epic flight. If you’re hesitant about flying, like I initially was, K2 will take care of you with their experience and expertise.
I’d do it again in a heartbeat as long as I could land on the mountain and hike around for the afternoon or even stay at the Sheldon cabin.
Don’t hesitate. Just fly!
Great trip guide was knowledgeable and fun.  Turned the place many ways so each side could see.  Had a great time

Wilbur, in simple terms, was fabulous! He was very personable and was a great guide. His attention to detail in explaining the surroundings of the landscape was educational. Very courteous and professional throughout the flight. As far as being a pilot, Wilbur was very competent, detailed and professional. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation and Wilbur!
Incredible experience, a must if you come al the way to Alaska. We had a great day and it is highly recommend.

Taking this flightseeing trip was one of the most spectacular things we did on a fantastic trip to Alaska! We took the tour out of Talkeetna. Everyone we met associated with K2 was friendly, enthusiastic and helpful. Our pilot, Billy, was awesome- provided a wonderful narration during the flight & made the smoothest landing I have ever experienced. 
I highly recommend K2 and thought it was a great value for an incredible experience.

We were booked on the Denali Grand Tour.  When we showed up they said it was snowing on the other side of the mountain so the tour was cancelled.  They did offer to refund our money, change our time or put us on the Denali Flyer.  We had been looking forward to this for so long and wouldn't have been able to do it another time so we did the Denali Flyer.  It was cloudy and we didn't even get close to Denali.   In hindsight, I would advise you not to book ahead.  Then plan to stay in Talkeena 2-3 days and when the weather is good, just walk up and take a flight.  We wrongly assumed that when they cancelled the Denali Grand Tour because of weather that since they offered the Denali Flyer, the weather for it would have been better.  I'm sure the Denali would have been a nice flight in better weather.

We did the Summit Tour w/o a glacier landing. It was incredible and has been the highlight of our trip so far..We planned a 2 week trip to AK and this was the first bucket list item we did. It will be the most recommended tour we tell people about.. Now having seen Denali from the national park, highway and a lodge deck, the view from the top can’t be compared to anything else. It’s a must do and K2 is the greatest! Safe & professional & worth every penny!

It was leterally one of the coolest things i have ever done in my 59 years. I debated about spending the money and I am so happy that i decided to do it. It was well worth the money and I would do it again in a heartbeat. Chad was the pilot on the Piper Navajo for my trip. He gave good narration of the flight and executed one of the smoothest landings I have ever been on.

review_title: the only way to experience Denali, Foraker, and Hunter
review_text:
Everyone in our party thought this was the highlight of our trip to Talkeetna. Our guide, Patrick, was very knowledgeable and willing to answer any question we asked. 
We got lucky that there was no rain but weren’t able to do the glacier landing due to the clouds.  Even without that, this experience was breathtaking.

Our tour with K2 exceeded our high expectations. It was an amazingly clear day and it felt like we could touch the mountains. When we landed on the glacier we had it ourselves and enjoyed the cooler temperatures and ice. Our guide Patrick was professional, knowledgeable and fun. I highly recommend this experience!

The trip with K2 Aviation was a wonderful experience for my family.  We opted to take the tour with the Glacier landing and enjoyed the trip very much.

It was a very clear day and we thoroughly enjoyed the trip back and forth.  The pilot was giving us good commentary all the way and provided us with some extra time on the glacier.  

Booking the tickets was also very easy and they honored the Toursaver coupon that we had.  We also had a national parks pass and they took that into consideration as well.

I would caution folks who are sensitive to the smell of gasoline as you are exposed to it throughout the duration of the trip.

All in all it was a wonderful once in a lifetime experience and I would like to thank K2 for making it memorable.

The flightseeing experience is great and was the highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska. The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and gave us lots of information as we were flying. Arranging the trip was a challenge, however. Our summit flight was cancelled due to last minute routine maintenance to our plane. Then it was rescheduled due to a last minute change to the maintenance date. Then it was downgraded to the Flyer Tour due to weather conditions. Overall, though, we had a good flight.

What a fantastic tour. We were signed up for the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier landing. Due to the wildfires near Fairbanks, the north side of the mountain was smokey. It was a beautiful clear day we flew very close to peaks and the glaciers. The pilot and the staff was very professional and informative. Landing on the glacier was impressive and we were able to appreciate the grandeur of the mountains. There even is a Chalet on the glacier that you can stay at for $2,300 a person a night. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

My wife and I were very pleased with the air tour of the big mountain!  Unfortunately, smoke and clouds had moved in so we could not get as close as we would have liked but still a great experience.  Very impressed with the knowledge of our pilot.  I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Awesome flying get and Glacier landing
review_text: I booked this months in advance and they did a great job holding our reservation. K2 is quite a large operation in Talkeetna, but the staff treats you well. Our pilot, Chris, was very personable. He came from a family of Alaskan pilots. My wife got to sit in the copilot seat. If they ask who wants to sit there, raise your hand quickly. Flying between peaks was awesome. Landing in the snow in July, wow. It’s pricy...but probably our best experience in our first two weeks in Alaska. And tip your pilot! Don’t be like the majority of passengers on our flight and just shake his hand.

We loved the flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range with a landing on Ruth Glacier. It was an awesome experience!

We made our reservation through Alaska Tour and Travel, just because of some other stuff we were bundling, but you can go straight to the K2 site. They have a nice facility at the airport (soon to be even bigger and nicer with a new facility). Check-in was very organized, and you can enjoy some free coffee while looking at their gift items. They provide overboots for the glacier, so you can just wear your street shoes no problem. We were called by name, introduced to our pilot, and walked to the plane for a quick safety briefing. After takeoff, it is a short flight to get up to the mountains. Our pilot provided interesting information on the area over our headsets. Then you are in the mountains...

We were lucky to have a clear day, and it was specatcular! We flew up the Great Gorge, surrounded by peaks, then by Denali and the other large mountains in the range. Both sides of the airplane get the views. The glacier landing was very cool, and we spent 20 minutes walking around the plane in the huge Sheldon Ampitheater. It is just an incredlble place! The flight back included more awesome views as we zig-zagged down through the peaks (I was sitting up front with the pilot for this part). It was hard to believe we did all this in just 1 1/2 hours.

I highly recommend a flightseeing tour of the Alaska Range and the glacier landing.

We went on the flyer with glacier landing on Jul 1 - our 1pm flight was one of the firsts to be able to land on the glacier as the cloud cover cleared in time. We got the flyer deal with the TourAlaska coupon booklet so worked out reasonable (still expensive :)) The plane is a 10 seater cessna - a bit loud so they give you noise cancelling headphones. The views are incredible as the plane goes very close the mountains and the glaciers. The immensity of the glaciers cannot be fathomed until you go this close to them. The landing itself was awesome and it was unreal that we were sitting on a mile of ice on the Ruth Glacier. Overall about an hour and half for the trip - the glacier views and landing were increible. The flight was a bit bumpy on the return but nothing too bad. My kid was complaining of a headache from the flight (probably altitude) but otherwise enjoyed it. Dont forget to take the complementary goggles on the way in - the glacier is too blinding without extra pair of sunglasses (you will go snow blind if you dont use them). Highly recommend this tour!

review_title: A RARE NATIONAL PARK  FOR FLYING FAIRLY CLOSE TO THE MOUNTAIN PEAKS WITH POSSIBILITY OF LANDING ON THE GLACIER
review_text: Talkeetna is the only commercial airport in Denali National Park from where commercial flights are available for viewing Denali mountain range fairly closely. Weather permitting, the fights also land on the Glaciers for 45 mins. grand view and walking on the glacier. At least 2 days are recommended to explore the park with glacier flight & Jet boat.
These people not only delivered an unforgettable experience but they were also considerate, competent, and knowledgeable -- a thoroughly safe set of hands. Our pilot Chris was exemplary

We took this excursion out of Talkeetna on a beautiful, bright afternoon at 7 pm, days before the summer solctice.  Billy was our pilot and took us to our plane, along with five other passengers.  Before we knew it, we were smoothly lifting up into the blue sky where the sweeping views were astounding.  As we approached the mountains, the sights grew more and more  dramatic!  We landed within a snowy canyon within the mountains, it was mesmerizing!  We were able to disembark into the snowy quiet and enjoy the magical sights around us, Denali towing up into it's own cloud!  We got to fly over base camp, up towards the peaks, and even saw a rainbow as we returned! What an amazing experience, we'll never forget!!

My husband and I had the pleasure of taking a flight around Denali with Chad from K2Aviation. It was a wonderful experience. Chad was very competent and made us feel very comfortable with his skills and ability We were lucky enough to be the only two passengers in the plane. Chad was a very knowledgeable guide of the area and we learned a great deal during our flight. Safety was a priority throughout our flight. One of the most exhilarating experiences of my life!

review_title: Best thing we did in Alaska
review_text: We spent 10 days in Alaska and this was everyone's favorite activity. The staff was professional, competent and knowledgeable.  The flight was just amazing and the glacier landing is a MUST!

review_title: Incredible views of mountains (Denali) and glaciers
review_text:
My family really wanted to go on a flight-seeing tour and land on a glacier, so we started searching for them while in Anchorage. We found several great options, but ended up going with K2 Aviation since their availability best matched our schedule. We chose the Denali Flyer Tour because we wanted to see multiple sides of Denali but didn't think the Grand Denali was quite worth the added cost.

We arrived really early since the drive from Denali to Talkeetna took less time than we anticipated. We hung out in the parking lot and on the picnic benches in front of K2. They provide water, tea, etc.There was also WiFi for guests but it didn't work for me.

We checked in 30-45 minutes before our flight. Each person weights themselves with everything they're taking onto the plane. You can also borrow sunglasses at this time if you need. They have a great selection with all sorts of styles and sizes. We also got our overboots at this time.

About 10 minutes before our flight, the pilot called us over and gave us a safety briefing. Then, we got on the plane. He took volunteers for co-pilot and everyone else sat wherever they wanted. Every seat has a headset and a window. The headset is a bit uncomfortable since it really closes in on your ears and head.

The flight itself was incredible! We flew over the park and soared through the mountains. Our pilot pointed out all the major landmarks from the summits to glaciers. He didn't provide much information besides that, which was fine with me. He did a good job of showing Denali to both sides of the plane so everyone was able to get photos. 

Near the end of the flight, we landed on Ruth Glacier. It was more like a field of snow than glacier ice, which was a little disappointing, but still a beautiful place. We had about 15 minutes on the glacier and then we got back on the plane and headed back.

Oh! One thing to note, it was rather hot when we were in Denali (highs of 75-80). It was also warm on the glacier and basically everyone wore short sleeves and jeans or shorts. No gloves, beanies, jackets, etc. were necessary.

Overall, I would recommend the flight to folks considering it. I wouldn't say it was the highlight of my trip, but it was definitely up there!

We had a wonderful experience flying around Denali and landing on the glacier. I highly recommend it. OUr pilot was very experienced, careful and assured. Ifelt confident in him throughout. But it was exciting! We were lucky to have a clear day.

I live in Alaska and had family visiting from Virginia.  I have done this trip once before and that was incredible and now I am so glad to have done it again!  It's a jaw-dropping, awe-inspiring trip and one that you shouldn't overlook!  The views are simply incredible, beautiful, wild and amazing.  Our pilot was great- very informative and interesting.  It was 87 degrees on the ground when we left and everyone was feeling it, but getting up in the cool air cheered everyone up.  The tour is one I would do again and again!

My brother was visiting and we decided to do a flyover of Denali. The weather was great and the views were spectacular. Chad did a great job of pointing out the geology and features and giving both sides of the plane a good view. It was a beautiful trip for me and my brother.

We initially requested either the Summit Tour or Grand Denali Tour, but unfortunately the weather didn't allow us to be able to do that.  Knowing that our time in Alaska was limited and we didn't know whether the weather would cooperate we decided to take the Denali Flyer Tour that day instead.  It did not disappoint!  We were blown away at the vastness and grandeur of Denali, and we took many pics/videos during our trip.  It's definitely not one that we will ever forget.

This is a must-do!  The experience was awesome and the views were breath-taking.
We originally scheduled the Grand Tour but were unable to take that flight because of the decreased visibility due to the smoke from the wildfires on the Kenai Peninsula. We also did not opt for the glacier landing.  
Our pilot, Doug, was great.  He pointed out some things, like Boiling Springs, along the way and he was very friendly.
We would easily do this again. Well worth the price!

Pilot was fabulous, kudos to Kevin. Our photos were spectacular with this once in a lifetime experience. The weather was perfect for viewing all of the awesome sights. Definitely the highlight of our Alaskan journey.

I traveled to Alaska for a marathon & brought my 82 year young Mom with me to show her the beauty of Alaska. Seeing Denali is a must see because of its sheer size & beauty. Traveling with Mom is a challenge because she is wheelchair bound but this posed no problem with K2 Aviation. They allowed me to park as close as possible to help getting Mom out of the car & provided tremendous help in getting her into the plane. Actually, they placed Mom into the plane just like it was an everyday experience. I believe that it would have been impossible for Mom to see to see Denali without K2 going above & beyond in their assistance. Thanks so much to K2 for making this possible!

Our flight over the mountains with the glacier landing was the highlight of a great two weeks in Alaska. It was a last-minute decision to go. I called K2 first thing in the morning and they could not have been more helpful, giving us a choice of trips going on the same day, picking us up from our hotel, and lending us snow shoes to wear over our normal footwear. Stan the pilot was thoroughly professional, giving us a comprehensive safety briefing and then taking us on the trip of a lifetime with expert commentary. We got to inspect the Alaska Range at close quarters, helped by excellent weather and smooth flying conditions, and then the ultimate bucket-list experience ... landing on the Ruth glacier. We had about 15min on the ice, then returned to Talkeetna. This is an expensive trip, but we thought it was worth every penny.

It was an awesome experience, a once-in-a-lifetime event. Kevin, the pilot, was wonderful. He explained everything and took pictures of us. The weather was perfect, which enhanced our experience. I would definitely recommend the glacier landing tour. It is worth the extra hundred dollars.

Our family of 4 did this trip and it was absiluetly spectacular.  The pilot was great and shared a lot of info with us.  The glacier landing is a must.  Really cool.  Highly recoomend and worth the price!

Our pilot Doug went above and beyond to make our flight so wonderful. He was very knowledgeable and even made sure we joined the 30% club. Will definitely recommend you to all. Thank you for a wonderful experience.
Informative,exciting. Wonderful clear flying day with excellent views of glaciers and areas surrounding Talkeetna😁
Garrett our pilot did a great job explaining Denali and the how the glaciers worked. Very friendly at checkin and check.  A big highlight on out trip.

The entire experience was beyond our wildest expectations.  Stan, the pilot, and the K2 office staff were very kind and helpful.  The flight scenery is hard to convey with words...Spectacular, awesome, breath taking, larger than life are the first words that come to mind and I could go on forever. Landing on a glacier, high up on Denali itself was an unforgettable and immeasurable experience.  I assure you my review does not even come close to capturing the grandeur of the experience!

We absolutely loved our flight around Denali! The pilot was excellent and shared lots of information with us. We felt very safe and secure during the flight. We loved seeing the glaciers and had a great view of Mount Denali! The day that our flight occurred, the sun was shining and the view was crystal clear. We even had the opportunity to see, and take pictures of, a moose on the runway. I would strongly recommend this attraction to anyone visiting Alaska.  It was one the of best activities we did while visiting Alaska!
We had an absolutely amazing flight. our pilot was terrific and very knowledgeable of the area. i highly recommend K2 Aviation. the flight was worth the price.

Our pilot, Chris, was an excellent guide. Knowledgeable about the mountains, AK history and flight. By far the smoothest take off, flight and landing ever. If you are nervous about the small plane fligtseeing, this is the place for you. Could not be easier. Also upgrade to the glacier landing, it’s worth it,

review_title: Was Great Experience, but there was a BIG safety concern
review_text:
We had booked "Denali Flyer Tour with Glacier Landing". Glacier landing was the best. And "Denali Flyer" was good enough in terms of the length and the time of the tour. I wouldn't opt for for the other 3 tours. This is good enough.

Our tour was scheduled to start at 3:00 pm. We were a family of 6. We did a checkin at 2:30 pm. Be there 30 mins prior to boarding. There is a restroom at the office, clean. If you forget to get your sun glasses, no worries, the staff there are helpful and you can borrow sun glasses, and return them after the flight. You get to borrow the boots kind that you wear on top of your shoes. So keep in mind, you don't need to bring your boots. Just the regular shoes that you are wearing for your entire trip is good enough. You pick your size from their storage box, wear them, meet the pilot when called around 15 mins prior to flying. The pilot walks you to the 10 seater plane and you get seated.

You wear your headset. 
FEEDBACK: 
1. MY HEADSET WAS NOT CONNECTED TO THE SOCKET. AFTER FEW MINTS I HAD TO FIGURE OUT
2. THE WORST PART WAS: I WAS SITTING NEXT TO THE ENTRY DOOR AND THE FLIGHT STARTS MOVING, AND I'M SHOCKED THE DOOR IS NOT CLOSED. I REMOVED MY SEAT BELT AND RAN TO THE PILOT AND TAPPED ON HIS SHOULDER AND TOLD HIM THE DOOR IS NOT CLOSED. HE STOPPED THE PLANE AND CAME AND CLOSED/LOCKED THE DOOR.

That was terrible terrible mistake of the pilot not having a checklist. Had I taken a minute or more to inform the pilot, maybe we all wouldn't have been in the plane to even tell. I as a passenger don't know how to close and lock that plane door, and for sure I don't want to do it myself and feel safe.

Then we go over the mountain, which was beautiful to see the snow tip from areal view. Then we land on a 4000 ft glacier surrounded by snow mountains. It was "nature at it's best".. just gorgeous. Absolute beauty. Amazing. We get to spend more than 20 mins and then fly back. The pilot was a good narrator. We land back. Return our sun glasses, boots, and back to our car.

Oh, Talkeetna was cute little town, we had Ice Cream and coffee. Should try it. It was great. And there are lot of Thai Restaurants if that's a point to keep in mind
