This was an amazing experience. Billy was our pilot and that was the smoothest takeoff and landing I have ever experienced. The views are the best you will ever see!

review_title: Weather affected our trip but still awesome!
review_text: We had originally booked the Denali Grand tour with glacier landing. Unfortunately, this was the only day of our trip it rained. We received an email early morning explaining our trip details might be affected by weather. Upon arrival at scheduled time, they could only do the most basic Denali Experience flight. We were promptly refunded the difference. A much shorter flight but still awesome. Our pilot cruised around, looking for a break in the clouds to get us above them for more of a few. He was very knowledgeable and a lot of fun. Overall it was a great experience! Keep in mind, this company can't control the weather and if they cancel certain flights, it's for everyone's safety. Don't blame them for bad weather!

Our flight seeing tour was fabulous! Because of some weather over the usual landing spots, our pilot opted to land at Denali Base Camp instead. The scenery was incredible, and it was an experience we will never forget. We had our kids with us (youngest age 9) and our parents (age 70), and the flight was perfect for all.

Exceptional sights, very appealing experience
One of the best during our trip in Alaska.
You will be amazed , and to do it K2 is the company

We had a wonderful experience with K2 and our pilot, Justin.  It was a little pricey, but we figured being on a once-in-a-lifetime trip like we were, we should go all out. 

We did!  And I am so glad.  Being eye-to-eye with the summit of The Great One was incredible!

Thank you K2 and Justin!!!
Took a flight seeing tour. We were able to see the peak of Denali and landed on Ruth Glacier! An experience we will never forget. Would highly recommend!

review_title: Incredible trip on a beautiful Alaskan day!
review_text:
I got this trip for a birthday present for a friend.  I had cancelled 2x's because of the weather, it was no problem with K2, they just rescheduled for when I wanted to go.  The morning of the flight I called at 8am to check on weather.  Even though it was overcast where i live 30 miles to the SW of Talkeetna, they assured me the weather on Denali was picture perfect, and it WAS!
Our pilot, Will was very knowledgeable of Denali, the mountains surrounding it, the glaciers and rocks.  He made the trip educational and interesting.  Great host and representative of K2.
I have flown to Denali before, and have flown with K2 on a private trip in the early 2000's.  I have been in the area for 20 years now and have never heard anything bad about K2.
If I ever decide to go again, it will be with K2 and will request pilot Will.
THANK YOU K2

The reservation desk in town was very helpful.  The checkin was smooth and efficient.  Most importantly the pilot, Doug, was experienced and extremely knowledgeable of all the nine glaciers and numerous mountains.  He positioned the plane often so everyone had a clear view of Denali, Foraker, and Hunter as well as other fantastic sights.
Kevin was awesome and we had a great trip around the mountains and a very cool glacier landing.  Helped that the weather was perfect.   Highly recommend K2

We originally planned the Summit tour although weather didn ´t allow us to. K2 aviation team offered to us shorter experience flight with was available. We are glad we decided to listen to them and accept shorter flight too. It was amazing, views were breathtaking and at the end we saw also the top of Denali and many rainbows around our plane. I would recommend this flight to everyone, it was worth every penny and our pilot Doug was perfect, talked during whole flight about all mountains we ha seen and many stories too. He made the tour special for us.
The flight was awesome, and the glacier landing is a must do!!!  Perhaps one of the best experiences of my life.  Our pilot Chip, was great, very informative, and friendly.  Thank you K2 Aviation.

review_title: Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing on K2 Aviation Plane
review_text: On the morning of May 25, 2019 we were blessed with beautiful weather. We had perfectly clear blue skys except for a few clouds at around 10000 feet.  We were able to see the peak of the "Great One" (Denali) from all sides!  The airplane, a DeHaviland Otter on skies, was perfectly suited for the mission!  Our pilot was excellent both as a pilot and a guide.  Being a pilot myself I could appreciate his communications skills as well as piloting skills. We were able to land on the glacier and that was exciting! We were picked up for the flight at our hotel by a K2aviation shuttle and were also returned by the shuttle. The shuttle drivers were young ladies whom we enjoyed talking with and the vans seemed to be new and were perfectly clean.  The three people in our party, aged 22, 77 and 79, thouroughly enjoyed the whole experience and felt perfectly safe at all times.

Although we booked for the Grand tour and glacier landing, the weather didn't cooperate.  K2 clearly advised at the time of the reservation that this was a possibility so we were not surprised when advised of the change.  They did offer another flight option (refunding the difference) which allowed us to see the mountain, glaciers and surrounding area.  It was a great experience and we will return

review_title: Fantastic experience! A “must do” in Talkeetna!
review_text: The Denali grand tour will not disappoint! We opted in for the glacier landing and are so glad we did. The weather cooperated, the pilot and office staff were phenomenal. Special thanks to Larry and Arwin. They made our trip extra special by being so helpful, informative and kind. Captain Mark maneuvered that plane like nobody’s business. Took us up close and personal to multiple walls and faces, while providing explanations of everything we saw. He then played photographer on the glacier so we all got pictures next to the plane. Thank you all for making our trip to Talkeetna so special!
We had a great time. Even though the weather prevented us from landing on a glacier.  We would definitely do it again.

What a wonderful treat to see all Denali and the other two mountains and see base campers as well as land on the glacier on skis - super safe no nausea and they had boots to walk on glacier - operation is run so professionally - they are building a beautiful new building to move into because businesses and planes have grown  - so glad I splurged and saw something rare and soul fulfilling .

I've gone on flight seeing tours with K2 before and this again was a great time!
We did the Denali Flyer tour in June 2019 and had an amazing time.   Our pilot pointed out all the various glaciers and peaks and was really informative.   I highly recommend K2 if you want a wonderful flight seeing tour.
Our pilot was wonderful. He helped everyone feel comfortable about the experience. I learned so much about Alaska on this trip.  The glacier landing was incredible.

review_title: Great trip and top notch company.  Highly recommended
review_text:
My two young daughters and I had an amazing experience on this flight with Glacier landing.  Checked out numerous glaciers, base camp, Denali, and Don Shelton Amphitheater.
 
Smooth landing and flight. Great planes, experienced pilots, and very safe operation at K2. 

Trip of a lifetime and highly recommend!!

review_title: Excellent Customer Service, but still weather dependent
review_text: We had a good trip.  The pilot was terrific, providing explanations along the way.  And we were able to land on the glacier - very neat.  But the cloud cover was low, making it very difficult to see Denali.

We did the K2 Flightseeing Tour and landing on a glacier. It was so incredible and highly recommend this tour. We purchased the Alaskan Tour book and got $62.50 off each person (up to 4 people).  Worth every penny.

A great tour of Danali including a glacier landing.
Pilot described every phase of the trip and provide detail that enhanced the flight. We were blessed with wonderful weather. I would highly recommend K-2

First glacier landing since my Navy assignment in Antarctica. Nice for the memory bank. 
My mate was beyond excited. 
Fairly expensive, but well worth it.
Don’t miss the opportunity if you have it.
Nothing compares with landing on a glacier in the middle of a mountain range. You’ll probably never get another shot at!!

review_title: Beautiful, Comfortable, Fun, We Would Do It Again!
review_text: My wife and I did this air tour and thoroughly enjoyed it.  In addition to the pilot, Randy, there were three others on the flight.  We flew in a very well maintained 1958 deHavilland Beaver which alone is worth the trip, but we also saw the beauty of Dinali and the glaciers from the air.  As described, each person has a headset so that they can hear the description offered by the pilot and so that they can ask questions.  K2 picked us up at our hotel at the designated time and returned us after the flight.  We had a fairly good day weather-wise and were able to take a lot of beautiful pictures; the flight itself was very relaxing with little to zero turbulence (this is weather dependent I suppose), and the pilot/guide was very informative.  We would certainly do this again in the future and recommend it to others.

The K2 Glacier landing tour was awesome flying to Denali. Even though we had an overcast day, the sun frequently peeked out between the clouds and presented us with great photos. It averages only 10 degrees cooler on the mountaintop than the town of Talkeetna. (On June 4, it was 50 up there around 1pm.) A light sweater was plenty. The sun is bright so wear sunglasses and a hat. They provide boots that cover your shoes. I have bad knees and took a hiking stick for stability in the snow. It is fairly level and just like walking in snow but you are on a Glacier! Very cool!

review_title: One of the highlights of our trip!
review_text: We booked the grand tour with the glacier landing, one of the highlights of our trip! From the initial check in, the entire experience was a once in lifetime trip. The pilot  was very knowledgeable, professional and a lot of fun. We had perfect weather which was a real bonus. Highly recommend K2,

We had a wonderful pilot (Billy) that was professional, knowledgeable of the history, geography, and very personable. He gave us the safety briefing and kept us informed of where we were flying and allowed us to ask pretty much any question during the flight and on the glacier.

This experience was totally insane, once in a lifetime.  The K2 staff was so friendly and enthusiastic, and we don't have enough good things to say about our pilot, Doug.  He was enthusiastic, incredibly knowledgeable about the terrain and history of the area, and very attentive in regards to flight safety, potential motion sickness (which never reared its head), and making sure we had a great tour.  The views were out of this world, and we hoped the tour would never end.  Definitely a must!

Kimberly set us up for our 50th anniversary flight and it was something very special.  We chose a clear day when the mountain stood tall and clear and beautiful.  We took the 8:30 flight and Mark was our pilot.  He made sure both sides of the plane had an opportunity to take the pictures of one of the most spectacular sights you will ever see. Mark's narration of the sights we were seeing and his piloting skills were outstanding. We are so happy that we chose K2 aviation for our once in a lifetime experience.  Thank you Kimberly and Mark!

We took this tour as an excursion on a Princess Off the Beaten Track land/sea tour, and it was beyond belief.  Our pilot, Chris, took us right between the summit of Denali and Mt. Hunter and on to the the gorge of Ruth Glacier, where we landed.  We lucked out with gorgeous weather and were able to clearly see the entire Alaskan range...Chris provided fantastic info about what we were seeing and pointed out all the amazing sites, including base camps of hikers attempting to summit Denali.  Everyone at K2 was wonderful! This was a trip we will always cherish!

Our flight was postponed due to iffy weather but better to be safe than sorry and as it turned out the following morning was GORGEOUS for flying.  

Our pilot had four decades of experience and handled the plane so perfectly that there was zero turbulence and we could simply sit back and enjoy the experience.

I actually didn't sit back because I had the seat beside the pilot, but also, I felt like a little girl flying over a magical land of glittery diamonds because the sun was reflecting off the snow on Dinali (and all around the mountain)…it literally took my breath away because I held my breath the whole time, not from nerves, but from sheer bewilderment at the beauty ahead and below me.

We landed on Ruth Glacier and had time to take photos, and just BE in all that natural beauty.

Flying back to base, we flew over more of the glacier and saw the turquoise ice through the snow, soooooo beautiful.

Sadly, we're damaging the environment so badly, that they say within 50 years what I saw could be gone....so if you have the opportunity to experience this, DO IT!  It was worth every penny and one of the best experiences of my life. 

P.S.  I'm a senior travel consultant with 30 years in the business, and have (been blessed to have) had MANY amazing experiences during my travels, so when I say that the flight-seeing to Denali was a highlight, believe it.

I took SO many photos and videos, these are just a few of them.

Originally signed up for the Summit tour but unfortunately we did not get to do that one since they did not get the minimum amount of passengers. However, we did do the Denali Grand Tour which did not disappoint. I would recommend taking a plane ride to see Mount McKinley, you will get the most amazing views ever.

Best experience of my trip. Daniel was our pilot. He was just as excited as the rest of us. Before we took off, the whole staff was informing us that the clouds were coming in and we might not get to land on the glacier. On the flight up Daniel was telling us what we were seeing and saying he was still hopeful for a landing. Turns out the clouds weren't as bad as they thought and we got to land. He helped us take pictures, pointed out mountains and shared tales. Overall K2 is the only flight company I would trust flying with. Everyone we met seemed to love their job and it makes you feel relaxed seeing that.
Very friendly staff, great pilot!  Excellent views and experience! Pilot explained everything we were seeing and the locations around, pointed out various sights along the way.

Although we signed up for the Denali Grand Tour, due to weather problems, we had to take the 1 hour tour instead. It was still a fantastic tour; all the staff and pilot were excellent. I would recommend this company to anyone who wants a first class experience.

Completely dependant on pilot and weather, but Kevin (pilot) was awesome and shared a lot of information with us. The weather prevented us from landing on their "normal" glacier spot, so we got to land at the base camp glacier that is usually restricted. We saw the climbers and their camps a few hundred yards away, and while we were there, a couple of groups left on their trek to the next campsite. When we took off again, we could see the groups that left base camp while we were there. Saw a few climbers at other camps on other glaciers during our flight. Can't describe how fulfilling this experience was and give it the highest recommendation.

We were amazed and awed by the sights and sounds once we landed on the ice.  The flight to and from the glacier was also very exciting.  Even after almost 10,000 hours aloft myself as both a military and civilian pilot, I couldn’t wait to make this flight.  My wife was equally excited.  Our pilot Mark was very professional and knowledgeable both about the aviation aspect as well as the mountaineering experiences he shared with us.  Outstanding experience.

My teenage son and I enjoyed a spectacular tour around the glaciers in Denali. Weather prevented us from seeing higher elevations but our pilot did a great job showing us what he could and adjusted the flight to see other features in the area. As a pilot myself, I found him to be professional, personable and well trained. Aircraft also seem well maintained. Definitely worth seeing that terrain from above.

We booked the Summit Flight with Glacier Landing, but it was cancelled due to bad weather. We were kept informed at all times which we appreciated, and they phoned to inform of the cancellation. The following day we were able to get a base flight in, again due to weather, there was no going too high and no Glacier Landing. We enjoyed the 1hr flight with a very knowledgable pilot who provided lots of information and commentary. It was worth it to see the mountains and glaciers and puts into perspective the immense size of Denali. We would definitely reccomend K2 for flight-seeing, they are very good and safety aware. Had a great time and would do it again.

Excellent flight around the Denali National Park including a Glacier landing and  30 to 45 minutes in the snow in May 2019.

If you are taking the flight, you will NOT want to miss the Glacier Landing experience.

Very SAFE team..

We loved our flight with K2 pilot Wil. He was experienced and sensitive while providing interesting details about what we were seeing. The entire K2 staff was helfpul from the beginning, quick to respond to email and safety oriented. We nearly didn't get to fly because of the weather on the mountain but it cleared up by late afternoon and we enjoyed the trip of a lifetime! I highly recommend K2.

Our  Dehaviland Otter aircraft was First class! Our pilot Chris , was a consummate professional.One of the best things we have ever done!Landing on the glacier with a cobalt blue sky and Denali in all its glory!Unforgettable👍

Yes a little pricey but worth it. It is Alaska everything is pricey.
Beautiful day to land on the glacier. So peaceful and overwhelming. It just proves how small we are in this beautiful planet.
Our pilot was knowledgeable with a great personality. I never felt uncomfortable.  He explained the different areas we flew over and what it meant in Alaska.
Highly recommend

review_title: Amazing, incredible way to see Denali
review_text: Earlier clouds in front of Denali had cleared by the time we took off from Talkeetna at 7 pm on K2’s last “Denali Flyer” of the day. Pilot Daniel was both an excellent pilot and knowledgeable commentator as we flew the face of the mountain. He made sure passengers on both sides of the plane were able to get good views and didn’t skimp on time of trouble. The weather was perfect for flying and especially for the unforgettable glacier landing. An amazing, incredible, never-to-be-forgotten way to see “The High One.”

We went on the grand tour with glacier landing and things couldn’t have gone better. From the gorgeous, clear weather, to the special landing at base camp, to the knowledgeable pilot - everything was too special to put into words. It was a once in a lifetime adventure and I feel blessed to have experienced it!!!

Awesome once in a lifetime experience ! We upgraded to the glacier landing and it was totally worth it! Breath taking views of the mountains! Pilot was great and flight was smooth. This is a must do in Talkeetna M

We flew around the grand mountain and then the best was landing on the glacier.
The pilot was so infomative . He made it very exciting. Looking out of the plane you could see the hikers going to the top! Start to finish was a wonderful time!

Our flightseeing tour included walking on a glacier. I'm so happy we chose to add that because it was amazing! Daniel was a very knowledgeable and fun pilot. All of the people K2 Aviation are very professional, nice, helpful and organized. If I get the opportunity to visit Alaska and see Denali again, I will definitely fly with K2 Aviation.

Our pilot, Chris, gave us a thrilling 1.5 hour flight over Denali National Park. As we flew through steep canyons over sparkling glaciers, Chris beguiled us with interesting statistics and fascinating stories. We saw climbers below, snow caped mountains beside, and blue skies with puffy white clouds above us. Even Mt. Denali peeked out at us from time to time. We highly recommend this trip of a lifetime.

Our tour included the glacier landing and it was incredible! Our pilot was business like and professional when it came to safety instructions, yet fun and personable in relating with our group. It has been the highlight of our vacation so far!

Words are not enough to describe the views. All the care of the staff and pilot. Besides a good flight on taking off and landing. Amazing experience. And one of the best decisions we have done on the trip while choosing where to take the flight. Very reliable. Besides the weather today was also very favorable

review_title: Great Flight on a great day
review_text: The fight was a wonderful  experience and our pilot Mark was great. He made a extra turn so  we could see a avalanche in progress which just added to the flight. The office staff and ground crew also did a great job. The flight was the best start we could have asked for on a six day Alaska vacation.

We flew with Will from K2 Aviation, and it was an awesome experience! Even though we weren’t able to safely land on the glacier, we still got to see a lot of amazing landscapes, including Mt. Denali! 
I would highly recommend this to everyone!

Wow.  Where do I begin.  I had been up to Talkeetna on no fewer than three occasions before the opportunity was taken on trip #4 to hire a flight around the Alaska Range mountains (which includes Denali / Mt McKinley).  April 24 was a glorious day, and we had been anticipating a great adventure flying among the peaks and landing on a glacier.  The meticulously clean DeHaviland DHC-3 Otter was our bird and Chris was our pilot.  My husband and I were two of only three passengers on the plane, and the mountain peaks, the craggy cliffs we saw  and the glacier we landed on (Pika Glacier) -- Everything Was So Incredible!!   What was super special was that Chris would explain everything he knew about what we were seeing (and he knows a LOT!).  All of it was so interesting -- we both want to return for another flight in the spring or summer when the snow in the lower elevations has melted and the green has "returned" -- and we will ask for Chris to take us on yet another flight.  He's a great guy who is meticulous with everything (EVERYthing) he does, and we want more of his stories!!  Thanks, K2, for the amazing experience (I still think you should have a "Frequent Flyer" card... 6 flights and the 7th is free... or something like that.  I'd be game!).

review_title: Amazing Experience and Great Pilots and Staff!
review_text: We were debating on whether or not to do it due to the price, but ended up feeling like we'd regret it if we did not.  It was an unforgettable experience and so worthwhile! There were two pilots with us (one was learning the terrain) and the other had 40 yrs. Of experience along with teaching, and it definitely showed! He was very knowledgable and conscientuous about the flight and terrain, was more than willing to answer any and all questions, and I felt like he went above and beyond as far as customer service is concerned.  They were also willing to do a later flight which other companies said no to, which is impressive as well.  We were able to see multiple glaciers, a glimpse of the peak of Denali (as weather permitted), and felt like it was an amazing experience that we will definitely recommend!

Denali is so massive that it makes its own weather systems, so it's hard to predict whether or not you'll be able to make a glacier landing. But I recommend K2Aviation and their tours to *everyone* visiting Alaska, even if you can't get a glacier landing that day. It's enough be able to approach these majestic mountains - Denali, Hunter, and Foraker - and get a close look with K2's terrific pilots - and Sarah and the other office folks are terrific - but if you're lucky enough to take one of the longer tours and to make a glacier landing in the Sheldon Amphitheater, I promise that you will never forget it. It truly is a bucket-list adventure.
Our pilot was very well informed and provided a nice commentary. We had a stunning day with beautiful views of Denali and the surrounding area.

This was one of the funnest things I’ve done. Went on a whim. Ended up getting on an earlier flight. We were the last one to land on the glacier as weather closed in. I always felt safe. We flew weeks BEFORE they had a fatal crash but I felt so good about my experience I’d do it again, with them, no problem. Plan to go again this summer.

The experience was the most amazing time we have had traveling.very organized in what they do. The pilot was very personable . The flight was on a perfect day . We were told it was one of the few times that year that the mountain was (uncovered) .we flew between two mountain peaks wondered at the views of the Glaciers and then landed going up hill on the glacier itself .. getting out I made a snowball of the powder and threw it at my wife (she wasn’t amused) but it was still fun .. taking off you could hear the skis squeaking. Over all it was the highlight off our Alaskan adventures.

Excellent customer service from the time we booked our flights a day in advance to the time we checked out.

Our Pilot Chris took the time to ask all of our names and our expectations, then proceeded to tell us a bit about his pilot experience.  

The flight tour was majestic.  We had blue bird skies.  Strong winds at the Kahiltna Cut prevented us from circling around the mountain however Chris took the time talk about all the different peaks, faces and glaciers we travelled around which was a real treat. 

I would recommend K2 to anyone.  

Great Job Team K2!

The pilote was really nice and great, gave us many facts about the history of Denali.
The plane is spacious and great as well.
The views on the mountains are breath taking.
My friend and I had a blast and definitely recommend it!

This was one of my top five life experiences. Everything about it was fantastic, starting with the details of the airplane itself, the flight, the information provided while viewing the scenery, through the landing. You just can't believe the enormity of the mountain and the glaciers around it until you are up there with the peaks beside you, seemingly so close you could reach out the window and touch the granite, and you find out that granite is over a mile away. If you can do only one thing while you visit Alaska, do this. I am so glad I did.I will never forget it.

An absolutely incredible experience. K2 facilitated a spur of the moment trip on an Alaskan ski touring vacation. We booked our 1030 AM flight with a glacier landing and they called to let us know a later time would offer better chances for the glacier landing. We highly recommend our pilot Chip. He inspired confidence and was essentially narrated a natural history lesson during the flight, as well as a history of the aircraft as an introduction. Excellent experience.

Awesome experience!!!  This is the only way to see the true magnificence of the mountains and glaciers without being a professional climber or with all the hard work of actually hiking up the trails.  You see the mountains and glaciers from a perspective few get the chance to.  From the moment I arrived the Staff at K2 were wonderful, letting me know weather updates and options.  They even pulled up the live camera feeds on the mountain and glaciers to let me know exactly what I could and could not see.  No bait and switch here, they were up front about everything.  My pilot Chip was amazing, narrating the entire trip with aviation actions he was taking and then local and historic information about the area and what we were seeing.   Even gave me a flight map of exactly what we flew over and saw.  So much to see and learn, you will not be disappointed!!  Already booked a flight for my return trip this summer.  VETERANS- Don't forget to ask for the Military Discount!

I'd like to start with the fact that each and every member of the staff was professional, nice and very knowledgeable.  They were unsure of the ability to do this tour as advertised due to weather conditions in the area, but instead of changing the route or even cancelling they decided to go up and see how things looked and it turned out that we were able to not only get to the mountains we went a little further to make the experience even more amazing.  i would highly recommend checking them out! i am definitely planning to head back in the future and will try another experience.

We researched tour companies prior to and chose K2 from all the recommendations.  So happy that we did.   It was beyond anything I ever experience.   I felt like my whole Alaskan vacation was like "Living in a Postcard", with our glacier flight and landing one of the top things that I enjoyed the most from all of our time in your great state.   Our pilot was wonderful and knowledgeable and a joy to spend the day with.  The whole process of getting schedule to finishing off the experience was so easy with no stress what so ever.   We registered in town at one of your store locations,  so easy and convenient.  Perfect directions and recommendations on how to dress and what to expect.   
Make sure you have plenty of battery for your camera as I took over 300 pictures from take off to landing.   
Dress warm, double socks as the glacier is cold, but not a lot of wind; (I went in Fall), warm jacket, hats and gloves for sure
I saw beautiful views, had great weather and memories to last a lifetime.  
Thank you K2 for the experience of a lifetime.

review_title: The experience of a lifetime !  Ken J
review_text: The K2 team handled us perfectly from our first call to the end of our Flightseeing tour. They also managed the weather in a way that gave us complete confidence. Our pilot was an incredible communicator explaining everything we were going to do route and maneuver wise from takeoff to flying to landing. His decision making put us at ease and allowed us to focus on the awesome spectacle of flying among some of the most special parts of the Alaska Range to include MT. Hunter, Foraker and McKinley. Seeing the Sheldon Chalet was  also a special moment. I and my group will all be back for another adventure and it will be the first thing we recommend to our friends and guests. I have lived in Alaska for almost 50 years and I am still compelled to say, thank you very much K2 for the experience of a life time.

review_title: Absolute must if you are visiting Alaska
review_text: My girlfriend came up for a week in February to visit Alaska, and this was the highlight of our trip for sure. The whole experience was about an hour and a half, and the views were unbelievable. The flight itself was very smooth, and our pilot Ryan was a great guide. We'd highly recommend going with K2 to schedule your flight!

My husband and I lucked out to have a crystal clear day for flying.  Ryan took us up and gave us an incredible tour.  He was so knowledgeable about the mountain range, glaciers, surrounding area, and Alaska fun facts in general.  The weather cooperated and we were able to fly all the way around Denali and even see the north side.  It was a breathtaking, mind-blowing experience.  We highly recommend them - very professional and easy to communicate with.  They were honest about what we may or may not see, depending on weather.  Overall, fabulous company and experience.  Many thanks.

review_title: This is the best activity we did in Alaska!
review_text: Wow! How fun! We did the Denali Flight Tour and Dallas was our pilot. Dallas was so cool and so informative. Both my husband and I were so worried about the flight - is it going to be super bumpy?? Are we going to get air sick?? Will the take off and landing be scary?? No, no and no. Dallas made sure that we were not scared and comfortable. If it would get bumpy at all, he just would get to a comfortable speed/altitude. The girl at the office was really nice too and even gave us two vintage posters! We loved the experience and we definitely agreed that this was the best thing that we did on our winter Alaska trip. The views from the flight are surreal! We hope to do it again another time and are now even considering taking some flight lessons!
Original plan was flight around Denali but weather was foggy so did glacier fly by toward Valdez. Glaciers everywhere! Our pilot got us in very close, almost two hours of siteseeing, very worthwhile!

We were blessed with perfect weather to fly and land in the shadow of Denali. The flight was wonderful, I got to sit in the co-pilot seat on the ride to the glacier landing. We were the only plane on the glacier at that time. The weather was calm and quiet, this was September 11, we had a group minute or two of silence, very moving experience,
My boyfriend and I had an amazing trip with K2's chief pilot! Incredible views, lots of information- worth every penny!

The trip was amazing! Our pilot, Chris Wilson, was super nice. The view was amazing! Everything was super clear and it looked like we were in a movie. We did not even notice we were off the ground at take off. I would do this 1 million times and still not get tired of it. The trip was spectacular!

Ian McGrath from Belford New Jersey

We had an exceptional grand tour.  The weather was spectacular, light wind, and low angle sun light resulted in magnificent views, shadows and resulting photographs.  We even witnessed a large avalanche cascading down a steep frozen rock surface.  
Chris, our Pilot, was well versed on the geology, and glacial descriptions.  He was very calm giving us warning when turbulence may occur.  During the flight he kept us informed about where we were relative to each peak, valley and glacier.    He showed us the various climber base camps and pointed out the favored ascent routes.  Truly a trip of a lifetime.
This one-hour tour was amazing! Everyone at K2 was really nice. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone coming to Talkeetna!

review_title: Landing on the glacier was the best
review_text: The staff at K2 was very friendly and helpful.  Our pilot Ryan gave a knowledgeable and informative narrative during the flight.  Landing on the glacier was by far the highlight of the trip.

We were in Talkeetna in late September, 2018, and hadn't booked anything to do in advance, considering chances of unpredictable weather and visibility. When it turned out to be an amazingly clear and gorgeous Saturday, we started thinking it would be a great chance to do flightseeing. Our Airbnb host highly recommended K2. We called and they happened to have 2 seats available on an afternoon trip. Jeremiah and the office crew are very helpful!

Our pilot, Dallas, is their head of maintenance, and he made us very comfortable with the operation and safety before and during the flight. He was great with answering our questions and providing a lot of information about the area geography - mountains, glaciers, valley, and rivers, as well as our geeky plane questions. 

Highly recommended!

I was meant to do the Denali Flyer with glacier landing, but was the only one booked so I was upgraded to the Grand Tour. Unfortunately, the weather prevented us completing this, so I ended up getting what I paid for! It really was a once in a lifetime experience and, if you get a clear day, take the opportunity. I would suggest though that the Denali Experience (the cheapest flight) would be sufficient, but do the glacier landing!

Was an experience of a lifetime.  Had an up close view of Mount Denali and landed on a glacier.  The view from the plane was awesome and the pilot was very knowledgeable of the area.  Would highly recommend it as a must do.

Breathtaking, amazing experience.  Our pilot, Rosemarie, was fantastic.  Very knowledgable and friendly.  How can you miss seeing Denali?  K2 has great customer service, very accommodating.  This is what I talk about the most from our Alaska trip!!

Wow! What an amazing experience this was. My two friends and I decided to book this flight tour (based on reviews here) during our after-season trip to Alaska. We assumed it would be cool, but it exceeded our expectations. Our pilot, Ryan, was knowledgable and friendly, and the plane was a cool Vietnam era craft (called an Otter, I think). 

The weather for our tour was out of this world--totally clear sky and no clouds to be seen. They told us it was the best flying day they had seen in months! Getting to see Denali and the other peaks up close was breathtaking, and Ryan told us a lot of history and answered all of our questions expertly. 

Denali was obviously the main attraction, but there were a lot of other beautiful peaks in the range, as well as some glaciers. It was fun to loop through the peaks and see so much. 

I'm sure the tour would still have been great even if the weather wasn't so good, so I highly recommend this tour. Definitely book in advance. Also, volunteer for the copilot seat if they ask!

review_title: What an amazing experience- and top rate customer service!
review_text: All I can say is, WOW!!! What an absolutely amazing experience. We were blessed with clear weather and gorgeous views right from takeoff. Our pilot, Billy, was so knowledgeable and personable, that he allayed any fears we might have had (we don't fly much and these are no jetliners!). The flight was smooth, and did I mention the views were spectacular? On top of the wondrousness of the trip, we experienced excellent customer service. Our reservation had been made through a travel agency, and they mistakenly booked the wrong type of flightseeing tour. We didn't realize it until we were being escorted to the plane by the pilot, and realized that it had no skis. We had been looking forward to the glacier landing, but clearly, the travel agency had their wires crossed. Not a problem, though! The pilot of that plane took us back into the office, where, after looking at their schedules for a couple of minutes, the staff rectified the situation and put us on the tour we had been hoping for. They didn't even charge us! I believe the other couple who went with us also got a free upgrade, to make it a full flight. I truly expected to have to pay the upgrade then and there, but no. They just fixed it all for us, and off we went! Thanks to the A+ customer service, we had the full experience of flying around Denali AND getting to land on the glacier, where there were more magnificent views awaiting us. I can't say enough good things about this company and this tour. It was definitely one of the big highlights of our trip to Alaska- truly unforgettable!!!

review_title: Booked the Summit Tour With Glacier Landing, But Winds Changed Things
review_text: We booked the Summit Tour with Glacier Landing.  It was a clear day so we were excited, but when we arrived, we were told the winds were too high so we would be taking the Grand Tour with Glacier Landing.  When we got into the air, Chris (pilot) received info from other pilots that the  winds were increasing, so we ended up taking the Denail Flyer with Glacier Landing.  You can read other reviews to see details on everyone's wonderful experiences; I will add that, even though we were disappointed we couldn't circle and climb the summit, I would highly recommend you take whatever tour you can get--even our tour was breathtaking!

Denali was cloudless on Monday September 10,2018.  Perfect to experience what Denali is all about. Went to K2 Aviation and from beginning to end had the friendliest, kindest help in choosing what experience would be best for us.  the biggest plane was a must and we were shown each plane. Ground crew and the pilot were excellent helpful understanding people.
Flying next to Denali gives one a completely different perspective of what the mountain is all about.The grandios width of its base, with glaciers, moraines, in gullys and crevases and canyon walls.  And how the rivers form, the difference of terrain.  It is all unimaginable from afar.  A very worthwhile and fantastic experience.  Worth every $

We took the K-2 Aviation Denali Grand Tour based on recommendations from two of our friends.  Both of the friends said it was the highlight of their trip to Alaska.  We did the flight on a clear, sunny day in September, and it was absolutely fantastic.  In fact, I took so many pictures and can’t bring myself to delete any of them.  Our pilot, Kevin, was very, very knowledgeable.  He knew when to talk and when to let us enjoy the beauty and grandeur of the flight.  I would highly recommend paying the extra money to land on the glacier!  It was especially a highlight for these Floridians that never see snow!

I hate when people hype things up, but this was easily one of the coolest things I've ever done!Full Disclosure: It's expensive, and highly weather dependent. We weren't able to fly due to weather the first day, came back the next day, and it was beautiful, so keep a couple days free in case!Even so, I think it was totally worth it. Our pilot Chris P. was knowledgeable, friendly and really tailored the experience to our preferences as much as he could. I could go on and on, so just trust me, you can make more money, but how often can you fly around the tallest mountain in North America and land on a glacier?! Do it, enough said.

We had always wanted to do the Ruth Glacier landing so we booked the Denali Grand Tour with the landing on the glacier. We had a great day of clear sky weather to do this and it was a great experience. K2 staff were very communicative both via email with alerts and in person when we got there. They explained very clearly the possibility of cancellation due to inclement weather (not a problem for us) and all safety information was thoroughly explained as well. Our pilot and the desk staff were friendly and knowledgeable. Overall wonderful experience! Definitely worth doing!!

Denali is awesome if all you get to do is see it from the road.  Having the chance to fly among the peaks and land on a glacier is a not-to-be-missed experience.  The weather was crystal clear the day we were there, but we were told that was rare and that only about 30% of visitors actually get to see the top of Denali.  It is usually shrouded in clouds.  It's an expensive venture but worth every cent.

review_title: Sunny, clear day to see Denali in all her splendor!
review_text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our flightseeing tour with the glacier landing.  The weather could not have been better, blue skies and sunny.  We could see Mt Denali from Talkeetna upon take off.  Randy, our pilot, is a delight person and very knowledgable about the area and flying this DeHavilland plane.  I strongly recommend doing this tour to anyone that wants to see the landscape from a bird's-eye view and be so close to the peak of Denali, you feel like you can reach out and touch it!  AMAZING experience!  Thanks K2 and Randy!

This flight was great and our pilot Chip was very experienced and knowledgeable.   The   weather cooperated and were able to land on the glacier.  Highly recommend K2 and this very safe flight experience.

We were supposed to do the tour around the summit, but it was too windy above 12,000 feet so instead we did the one where it was a bit lower, but we did a glacier landing.  It was a great experience - so beautiful flying around the glaciers and out pilot, Daniel, was great. So knowledgeable!  Something to put on your bucket list for sure!

The pilot's narration was fabulous along with the majestic views of Denali and many other   glaciers along the mountain tops.  The highlight of the flight was the landing at the amphitheater of Ruth Mountain and glacier.  We we're able to walk on the snow and capture many pictures.  Weather was perfect, thankfully!

What a fabulous trip....friendly staff, perfect weather, first rate pilot (Chip) with stories and facts of relevance and historical interest.  What a fine way to spend an afternoon!  We'll be back another time, and will definitely recommend this flight both to visitors and locals. By all means, take some pictures!

Beautiful blue sky day to take the Denali Grand Tour flight! Our pilot was so skillful and calm, she put all of us at ease, even while flying so close to the mountaintops! This is the experience of a lifetime and so worth the money! If you ever get the chance, just do it!

Will was a fantastic guide and made our trip exceptional! All of K2 were very friendly and professional. Had a picture perfect day and one of the most amazing experiences of our lives! Would recommend and will do it again when we get the chance!

This was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. We did the grand tour plus landed on the glacier. The views were stunning! Our pilot Daniel was so informative and full of information. The people that worked there were helpful and nice.

review_title: Stunning bird's eye view of the and the mountains
review_text:
Our final stop before driving back to Anchorage from Fairbanks was the Denali Flight tour with Glacier Landing with K2 Aviation. We had checked off everything on our Alaska trip except the flight + glacier landing and we are so glad that we flew with K2 aviation. The overall experience was just brilliant and one to savor for years to come. 

The winds were rough near Mt Denali, so with some potential turbulence our Denali Grand tour was not possible but we were able to do the Denali Flyer. Our captain Mike with decades of experience was very nice to give us all the information about the Ruth glaciers and others. We got a good glimpse of Mt Denali from about 5 miles. The weather was so good when we landed on the glacier, we didnt even use our jackets. The view of all the other mountains was excellent and the glaciers especially was unreal. The formation, the journey and the final integration into the rivers of these glaciers was so exciting to see and fathom. 

I would recommend everyone to try this out with K2 aviation and rest assured you wont be disappointed. The staff is very friendly and flexible at K2 and please do get your Alaska Tour saver coupon book for a flat 20% discount !

Next time it'll be the Grand tour / summit tour !

I am not a big fan of flying. My fear of heights and motion sickness are the biggest factors. My wife and I were doing a Princess Cruise and she really wanted to see Denali up close and personal. We went out to the airport at Talkeetna and looked at the various different operations offering a flightseeing of Mt. Denali. K2 Aviation seemed to have the best aircraft and most professional facility. We opted for the air tour which included a landing on a glacier near the mountain itself. 

We were issued boots and then greeted by our pilot, Stan. Our aircraft was a vintage de Havilland Otter that had been upgraded with modern avionics and a turbine engine. It appeared to be a very well maintained aircraft. After a short safety briefing, we were  in the air, heading for the mountain. 

There really is no better way to see Denali up close. Weather plays a big factor in determining how close you can get to the mountain and what you can see, but we got lucky with our trip. The views were truly amazing and I managed to get numerous pictures as our pilot wound his way around the numerous mountain peaks. .  

Landing on the glacier was fun and the view of the mountain from that location was the best. One minute the peak was covered with clouds and then it was out in the clear.  

Soon we were all loaded up and heading off the glacier. After a little more canyon flightseeing, we were on our way back to the airport. 

We saw many interesting and wonderful sights on our 12 day Alaska cruise. Without a doubt, the K2 experience was the highlight of the entire trip.

review_title: Time of my life!, With a Glacier Landing.
review_text: My husband and I did the Grand Tour with glacier landing and it was spectacular!  I am so sorry that I did not get the tall guy at the counters name, but he was wonderful in helping us move up our timetable before a storm came in, so that we were able to see the mountain and do our landing.  Everyone there was great, and our pilot Kevin did an amazing job, letting us know when to expect a little bump and what we were looking at on the mountains.  I would go again with K2 in a heartbeat.

The staff at K2 were very friendly and accommodating.
The tour left on time and we had a picture perfect day for our flight with K2.
The scenery was spectacular, our pilot Rosemary was very skilled and informative, she threaded her way through mountain peaks while pointing out glaciers and peaks all by name. 
With over 20,000 flight hours of my own, this is a flight I will never forget........absolutely awesome.

review_title: Denali flyer tour with glacier landing.
review_text: Amazing, once in a life time view. We were lucky to get a sunny bright day and the sights of the mountain range from the plane are amazing, but the tour de force is the glacier landing and time spent on the glacier (this even after we had hiked on another glacier the day before).

This is the ultimate Alaska experience! You wont experience the majestic mountains until you've landed on a glacier surrounded by these tall peaks. From the very first contact with K2, everything went very smoothly. The flight to Denali was breathtaking and our pilot was very informative the entire trip out, explaining what we were seeing. And the landing on the glacier is a lifetime experience! I highly recommend this tour!

review_title: Thanking God for our good luck
review_text: My daughter, her husband and I were scheduled to fly with K2 to see Denali.  The reservations were for the day AFTER their plane crashed.  Although my husband and I were wanting our daughter to get a REAL good view/taste of Alaska.  Again, we said prayers after learning about the crash.  Condolences to the family of those who died.  Such a sad event.....

review_title: An amazing aircraft Glacier landing on the top of the mountain
review_text: It was an amazing experience to fly by a small airplane from Talkeetna to the Denali Park’s mountains top where we landed over the Glacier on the top of the mountains and walk over the beautiful snow in the middle of the summer watching this breath taking blue ice lakes

I was impressed by the company's willingness to issue refunds due to inclement weather, they went above and beyond to provide various options including a full refund. We got lucky and were able to view the peak of Denali, our pilot Chris was a great pilot, well informed and a good storyteller. While we didn't get to land on the glacier or see the foothills it was still a magical experience.

Initially we rejected the idea of a flightseeing tour due to the price.  At the last minute, we decided to book a tour and are so glad we did.  The weather completely cooperated and it was a once in lifetime experience.  The flight to the glacier had incredible views. Then we landed on the glacier and walked around.  Words fail to adequate describe it - just wow!  We are so glad we did this.  It was truly one of the most memorable things we have ever done.  The entire K-2 staff was wonderful.  Special thanks to our pilot Kevin.  His combination of knowledge and jokes made the adventure even more fun.

Absolutely a must do.  I would highly recommend including the glacier landing. What impressed us the most was there customer service. My son was very nervous about flying in a small plane.  He actually backed out right before we boarded so my wife stayed behind with him.  K2 gave us a refund, no questions asked.  They went the extra mile and offered to let my son come back the next day and tour the inside of the planes.  A worker took him out and let him sit in the cock pit of several planes to help ease his nerves if he wanted to attempt to fly again.  

I own my own small business.  I truly appreciate that K2 was honest, caring and truly wanted us to have a great experience.
Great valley tour. Accommodated weather limitations. Worked with passengers. Safe informative beautiful flight.

We did the Denali Flyer Trip. This was an experience I will treasure for the rest of my life. Our pilot Chris was great. He showed us beautiful scenery and was a master with landing and take-off. We landed on Ruth Glacier and got to play for a few minutes. The weather was perfect and we saw God's amazing creation. It was so awesome it made me cry. While we were up there, my husband and I exchanged renewal vows. We felt like we were in heaven.

Simply exhilarating and blessed to be able to go on this flight and saw Denali up close along with the glacier landing on July 31st at 1.00 ... awesome.

K2 offered the best price (USD 310) that I had found when I was doing a search on the best flightseeing available options from Talkeetna. On top of that, this company has made it a point to make a refund on the portion paid for glacier landing if we are unable to do so due to poor weather condition, that's real good business etiquette in which rarely to be found nowadays.

Went on this flight with a great pilot and I believe that would make a difference too.

Denali was not an option the day we went because of bad weather so they offered us another tour.  We had a wonderful pilot and got to see a lot.  I was in the co-pilot seat which was amazing!  My girlfriend was in the back and was a bit disappointed that she was unable to see a lot of things that were being shown on the opposite side of the plane.  She was really underwhelmed when she got off the plane.  All in all though we felt it was cool to be able to see Alaska from that high though, despite not being able for her to see that much.

The day of our tour, we found out later, was the same day the plane crashed.  They left only a few hours after us.  I have no idea what the factors were that led to that, because there is not much information online still. I have to say that memory will live with us forever.  We are still in total shock that a few hours later the same tour we were on was never coming back.  Our hearts are heavy for everyone involved.  What an awful day.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the mountains
review_text:
We had booked a trip with K2 for Sunday but when we arrived in Talkeetna on Saturday with blue skies, we stopped in to see if we could hop on a flight that day to take advantage of the weather. The K2 team encouraged us to do so we were on a plane within the next two hours (after a lunch in town). 

The trip was an amazing way to get close to the mountains. We included the glacier landing--super fun in a small plane! Our pilot was knowledgeable about the geology and history, as we as friendly.

Highly recommended. For a once-in-a-lifetime trip it was worth the cost!

This was on the top of our bucket list. While we were hoping to land on the glacier, the weather didn't let us. HOWEVER,,,,,,, we had a awsome time. We checked in several times and the staff was there for us. They knew how much we wanted this trip. We started by contacting them a couple of months prio with questions. They took the time to answer all of them. Then when we arrived, they were once again very helpful. The planes and equipment are 1st rate. We took off and we each had a headset. The interatction between all of us and the pilot was fun. The flight was like nothing we'd ever dreamed of. The views of the mountain made us just sit in owe.  Bottom line is that K2 was professional, they took our safety into account with everything. They provided a memory that we cherish. They treated us to a trip of a lifetime. Thank you for making our vacation.

review_title: Excellent investment if weather is good!
review_text: Seeing Denali up close and personal in a plane is an experience I'll never forget. Rose Marie, our pilot, made sure the 3 of us saw both peaks of the huge mountain, climbing routes, glaciers, and pointed out other peaks in the Alaska Range. She knew elevations, she explained how tundra grows on top of glaciers and pointed out an ice fall from a calving glacier. It was well worth the cost. I was lucky because it was a sunny, clear day.

We were scheduled to land on a glacier but the weather was too cloudy and it was not felt to be safe to land however we had a great pilot, Mark, who flew us around the mountain and showed us many great vistas! Wonderful tour.

review_title: Spectacular Denali flight-seeing. Don't miss the opportunity!
review_text:
Seeing Denali from the ground is awesone - seeing it from the air is inspiring, truly hard to find the right words.
K2 is a well oiled machine and works a process that leaves nothing out.  From the moment you make your reservation, to the time you get off the plane returning from your trip - everything is explained in detail, and handled expertly.  These guys are pros!
Seeing the "great one" up close with a panoramic view at 15,000 feet, looking down at the terrain and different glaciers provides a view of how this terrain was formed for eons, AND JUST MAKES YOU SIT IN AWE.
Kudos K2 - truly a highlight of our trip!

This was an amazing experience as we left Talkeetna and flew over Denali.  As we  climbed high, we were in awe as the scenery all along the way kept getting better over U shaped valleys and snow covered pinnacles.  The views from the snow covered top were incredible and as we got off and walked around, it was just undesirable, An absolute MUST DO!

review_title: Need at least 10 Stars to rate this tour
review_text: You simply MUST take this tour.  After incredible week in AK hiking, fishing, and soaking up breathtaking scenery our first day flying with K-2 was my favorite.  Staff was professional.  Really appreciated morning email alert to potential weather...(earlier in the day glacier landings were not possible) but weather cleared and we were able to land.  They also gave heads up alerting us to longer travel time due to some road construction in area.  Tour:  From the minute you lift off you are in for a treat.....and by the time you reach the peaks you will be spellbound.   Such an up close intimate look at the ridges, the glaciers and peaks.   Humbling to realize not many people ever get this opportunity unless you are part of hiking expedition being flown into base camp.

review_title: The flight was beautiful and Chris did an excellent job.
review_text: We were in Alaska for ten days and this flight was the best part of the trip. The scenery was awesome and the pilot was very informative. Thank you and we will be back.

WOW! An experience of a lifetime. We were booked for the Denali Grand Tour however with limited visibility and weather moving into the area, we were offered the opportunity to do the Flyer Tour.  From the start to the end, I felt comfortable and confident I was flying with an experienced pilot and safety was their main concern. The flight and glacier landing was amazing!!! No words or photo can capture the beauty and grandeur of the area.

K2 Aviation is a super friendly and well-run organization. Views were amazing. So glad my teenage kids got to really see a glacier for what it is. We'd talked about them so much on the rest of our trip but it was all talk until this tour made it real. Breathtakingly real.

K2 picked us up in a shuttle bus from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge promptly 45 minutes before scheduled takeoff. Belongings you don't want to carry in the tight cabin of the plane are stored in locking bins at the office, one per aircraft. Some of my party are a little squeamish about small planes, but were put at ease by the pilot's safety talk and by the overall clean and competent feel of the place. Our plane had a 1 pilot and 6 passenger capacity, and there were bigger and smaller ones around the airfield. After the 90 minute narrated flight we walked about 5 minutes to downtown Talkeetna for lunch and shopping.

As others have said, weather is likely to mess with your plans. We couldn't do the glacier landing, but it was abundantly clear why. The clouds started at 4000 feet that day and the landing site is at 5000 feet. The front desk staff were super quick and friendly about adjusting the price to match what we actually got to do. Couldn't ask for more.

Highly recommended!

What an awesome experience with an awesome pilot that knew his stuff and answered questions throughout.  I never felt nervous or uneasy about the flight.  Landing and takeoff were smooth.  Can't wait to do it again!!!

Our pilot, Chris, was terrific as were the people at the counter. Landing on the glacier and seeing Denali were the best part of the Alaskan experience. I felt safe and enjoyed that Chris was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Everything is well run and I would say that this is a must for any trip to Alaska.

K2 was really accommodating. Weather was not flyable on our original date and K2 rebooked us for another date without any problems. Unfortunately on that date we could not do the tour we originally booked (Summit) as there were not enough people, but they tried to still accommodate us and have booked us on Denali Flyer instead, which was amazing. The pilot Adam was great and very skilled and knowledgable, flew us through some amazing spaces and taught us a lot. Totally enjoyed the whole experience, well worth every penny.

review_title: Grand view of the Denali and neighboring peeks
review_text: Beautiful flight right close to the mountains with views you just don't get from anywhere else in the park. The glacier landing was fun and provided both a unique experience and also a chance to appreciate up close how big and glorious everything is. Having fantastic weather was surely a contributing factor.
On a clear day, there is absolutely no better way to experience the size and scope of  Denali and the surrounding mountain range. It was spectacular!

This was by far the most amazing experience of our Alaskan vacation. To land and walk on a glacier while looking up at Mt. Denali was beyond our expectations. We had a very friendly, knowledgeable pilot who guided us through the flight and answered our questions. If you can only do one thing while in Alaska, take the Denali Experience with Glacier Landing you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Highlight of our vacation to Alaska.
review_text: Great fun and amazing views.  Pilot was very experienced and knowledgeable..If you want a view of the great expanse of the area, this is for you.  Earphones blocked the noise, and the flight was exhilarating but not scary.

The weather was too cloudy on our original date, so we ended up moving our trip multiple times and changing the tour that we had selected based on what K2 could accommodate.  We were SO appreciative of their flexibility, and the Grand Tour was amazing!  Rose Marie was a fantastic pilot, the views were incredible, and the experience of flying in this little plane was way different than anything we had experienced.  A highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska!

review_title: Did the Grand Tour and Glacier Landing with Chris (Pilot) AWESOME Expierence
review_text: Blessed with a Beautiful Weather day and super flight plan to round the Denali mountains and slip into the pathway for Ruth Glacier Landing. Recommend for anyone that can make it.. a Bucket List item not to miss. Thank YOU!! Agree with my wife.. rating 1-10 this is a 10!

I am not a fan of small planes & was a little apprehensive about taking this trip which was an add on tour  to Danali after a cruise. We flew from Anchorage to Talkeeta and my nerves settled down with our competent pilot Kevin giving a wonderful commentary and pointing out interesting places of interest. When we reached the mountains I felt so close we could have touched them but my nerves gave way to awe at the magnificent scenery we were witnessing.  Definitely one to tick off the bucket list !!

Every seat was a great seat.  Pilot was knowledgeable and provided interesting  information.  We felt very safe and the views were beautiful.  This is great for any age.

This is a very professional organization.  We made a request to change our trip as some bad weather was coming in.  They were very accommodating.  We had elected to do a glacier landing. They provided clean boots for our use.  Unfortunately, the weather came in earlier than expected.  They came and found us to immediately inform us that a glacier landing wouldn't be able to be performed.  We were offered our choice of either a full refund, a partial refund for not being able to do the glacier landing, or opportunity to reschedule to another day.  This company really empowers their staff to provide excellent customer service!

Our pilot gave a really great tour and explanation as we flew. I really learned the most from him. The smaller mountains were beautiful as well and really varied in the flight back.  Well worth the money.

review_title: One of the highlights of our Alaskan trip
review_text: If you only do one thing in Alaska....make sure it is this one. What an experience. Super organisation and fab pilot who was very knowledgeable about Mount Denali and its surroundings. We were very lucky to fly on a crystal clear sunny day when Mount Denali was visible from the bottom  right up to the top!

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska vacation!
review_text: It took a lot of back and forth for everyone to build up the courage to take this flight.  It was fantastic!  We all felt it was the best thing we did on the vacation.  The flight to the mountains and the landing on the glacier were amazing.  Our pilot, Billy, really made this fun.  He immediately put us at ease and was engaging with plenty of commentary along the way.  Definitely recommend it.

What a great experience to fly around the mountain, between the peaks, land on the glacier, etc..   It was amazing.  We were lucky to have perfect weather.  The flight was so smooth and the take off and landing were just as smooth.  It was fantastic and I recommend this trip to everyone.  Don't miss out, take the trip.  Originally two out of my group booked this trip, then one more the night before once he saw more information on it.  Then at check in I could tell my husband was getting more and more interested and we added him on at the last minute.  The office people were fantastic at accommodating all of our last minute plans.  No one had any regret after we landed.  It was a fantastic trip and I highly recommend using K2 Aviation.  They were fantastic.

This was our 2nd time flying with K2 Aviation.  Same flight both times.  Mike the pilot from 2008 is still there.  We flew with Chris the chief pilot this time.  Both pilots were fantastic, extremely informative and very professional.  There is no way to describe the feeling of landing on a glacier.  The word "awesome" doesn't come close.  This is definitely one for the ole bucket list!!  The only suggestion I could make would be to add more chairs in the shade while you wait for your turn to go.

This was an amazing tour! Although we had signed up for the Denali Flyer trip the weather decided to move in and they switched us to the Denali Experience tour, with a refund of the cost difference. Once we got into the Alaska Range, the clouds had cleared up a bit since their previous flights so we had some unbelievable views of the range and the glaciers below. Our pilot, Daniel, gave us great narrative info throughout the flight and kept us safe and comfortable even with the clouds and changing weather. If you're considering a flight tour- it's definitely worth splurging on and K2 gives an awesome experience!

We had booked the longer tour but weather didn't permit it. The company was perfect in how they handled it. They were constantly updating us and at pickup we had the option of getting a refund, trying the next day (space available) or getting a refund between what we paid and experiencing what was available. We understood that the weather could have prevented ANY flight the next day so opted to go as scheduled. Patrick was our pilot and he was perfect. We were able to land on the glacier and, because I was on crutches and in an aircast, he lifted me off the plane so I could also experience standing on a glacier. We fly a lot and I honestly think his landings -on the glacier & back at the airport- were the the smoothest I've experienced in 50 years. Another plus was the great driver who picked us up from and returned us to our RV park. Synopsis: Great company, great pilot & shuttle driver, wonderful flight!

Great pilot and great tour.  Unfortunately weather was not cooperative and could only go 7,400 ft up rather than 20,000.  Saw a lot of ice and mountains.  K2 very accommodating for the required change.  Would highly recommend to anyone

This was an amazing tour! We originally signed up for the Denali Flyer trip but due to weather they decided to only run the Denali Experience tour. We were lucky that the clouds had cleared up a bit since their previous flights so we had some beautiful views of the Alaskan Range. Our pilot, Daniel, gave us great narrative info throughout the flight and kept us safe and comfortable even with the clouds and changing weather. If you're considering a flight tour- it's definitely worth splurging on and K2 gives an awesome experience!

Two major things you need to have a great flight seeing experience a good pilot and fantastic weather, we were fortunate to have both. 

The plane ride out to see Denali was smooth and the pilot was great making sure everyone was able to see the awesome sights in front and below us. The clouds cleared from the great mountain just as we got close which I guess makes us part of the 30% crowd that saw the mountain. 

He then took us through some valleys and we saw glaciers and some of the wonderful jewel like reflections of deep blue peaking through the snow. We did hit a bit of turbulence in one of the passes and the pilot handled it beautifully.

It was an awe inspiring experience and I'm so glad to call Alaska home.

We really enjoyed our flight and glacier landing. We lucked out and had beautiful weather so we had awesome views of Denali. Our pilot was excellent. He explained highlights during the flight but didn’t talk so much as to be intrusive. I would highly recommend during this tour, it was a wonderful experience.

review_title: K2 Flight around Denali and Glacier landing
review_text: ABSOLUTELY JAW DROPPING!  Highlight of our trip to Alaska!  The flight was delayed due to morning fog, but definitely worth the wait!  Highly recommend this excursion!

Outstanding experience. The staff was friendly and the Pilot, Dan, was top notch. We benefited from a perfect day on the glacier and the competent, friendly, efficient team at K2 made our special day just Perfect!

From start to finish my mom and I were treated to an amazing experience thanks to K2 Aviation. We were greeted and checked in by the wonderful and friendly Dominick, who made sure we had everything we needed for our flight. We flew with Patrick as our pilot and he gave us amazing views of Denali and the glaciers all while answering all of our questions. Viewing Denali and the mountains from the plane and even landing on a glacier was truly an unforgettable and once in a lifetime experience. The glacier landing was the highlight as you're able to truly be surrounded by spectacular views of all the mountains in all their glory. Its definitely something worth doing for a truly unique view of Denali National Park. Cannot recommend enough!

We signed up on the "spur of the moment"
Called in the morning hoping to get on a flight and we were airborne by 1.
At $300/per it wasn't "cheap" but boy was it worth it.
Truly the only way to really "See" Denali park.
Our Pilot was Professional, Knowledgeable, Friendly and engaging.
We did not do the glacier landing but will try for that next time we get to AK.
If you have a chance, JUST DO IT....

review_title: 2 Hour Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: It was a fabulous time, one of the highlights of our vacation in Alaska. Everyone should do a tour like this when they come to Alaska, the absolute splendor of these mountains is just breathtaking.
Chris was our pilot and he was phenomenal!  Loved everything about this tour, including the glacier landing.  Would highly recommend!

Start off with Dillon. The young shuttle driver who was totally engaging and who checked us in.

Then Chris, our expert pilot who took off and landed with hardly a bump! He was amazingly awesome! Gave all the appropriate safety warnings. Told us of POI as we flew along. Spent more than enough time on the glacier.

My wife was hesitant when we booked, but thoroughly loved the experience in the end👍👍👍

We appreciated the professional and thorough booking process; everything went smoothly for check-in too- very welcoming. The ride was great- worth doing the glacier landing. Our guide Daniel put us at ease and was informative. Thanks K2!

I am recently retired, and a trip to Alaska was one of my 'bucket list' destinations.  This flightseeing tour over Denali was the crown jewel of the trip.  Truly amazing, and a lifetime memorable experience.  The clouds came and went, but, overall the weather cooperated the day we visited.  I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Denali, even timid flyers, as the flight was as smooth as any commerical flight.

review_title: Denali Experience + Glacier Landing = Fabulous Adventure!
review_text: We did the Denali Experience tour + glacier landing.  Truly a bucket list experience!!  We highly recommend K2 and this trip.  Well worth the money.  And Craig was a great pilot, shared lots of info during flight, and happy to take group photos for us.  This is a must-do adventure!!

We were a little nervous flying in a plane that lands on a glacier but this was incredible and well worth it. We landed on Pika Glacier in front of Foraker Mountain. 

The sights were amazing and a thrill we won’t forget. Spent around 30 minutes on the glacier and another 90 minutes touring the skies. 

FANTASTIC!!!

review_title: This was the best experience of our whole trip!
review_text:
We really enjoyed this experience.  Flying around Denali and landing on a glacier was so surreal.  The Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing will cost you $942 for two people, including all taxes and fees, but will definitely be worth it. 
The only reason that I did not give it 5 stars is because our pilot, Patrick, was a real jerk.  He did a great job of flying, but I would definitely request another pilot if I knew better.  
K2 Aviation did a great job.

Words can't describe the experience of a flight seeing trip and glacier landing with K2 Aviation!  The views are something that can only be experienced from the air.  The time spent walking around on the glacier was awe-inspiring.  When you get off the plane, you can't help but be struck by the absolute quiet.  We were lucky enough to hear an avalanche happening somewhere in the mountains while we were on the glacier.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and the entire experience from start to finish was unforgettable.  Terminal is very convenient to everything in Talkeetna.  We wondered if the trip would be worth the money....the answer is a resounding ABSOLUTELY!!

review_title: Prepare to change plans and is AMAZING
review_text: It was the most expensive experience in Alaska and we had left half a day for the selected tour. After Memorial day they called the day of not enough people gathered for our tour so all our so they could only offer the Grand Tour. It only takes 4 people and the pilot to fill the small plane, choice of seats was arbitrary and of course the one next to the pilot is the best. I am writing this to warn you of this practice of switching times and tours without any prior notice and also the weather, the 30% rule. If there are clouds they admitted is good but not the same. If you can leave as many days open as possible, the mornings seemed clearer and supposedly more snow early season and sometimes less clouds, It was breathtaking and worth the expense. Did not do glacier landing. Just prepare to change plans if needed. The grand tour is the typical one for a reason.

This is mine and my husband's last summer in Alaska and the 15th was our anniversary. the glacier landing ended up being cancelled due to cloud cover but the one hour flight was AMAZING. our pilot was VERY knowledgeable, take off and landing were both smooth, and I couldn't believe how beautiful the mountains are all the way up there. thank you to the friendly staff and pilot.

I can't say enough about this amazing flight seeing experience. The staff at K2 were wonderful, they did their best to manage expectations regarding the weather and possibility of a glacier landing and were very helpful in making sure all passengers were ready to go and comfortable (even let some of us borrow sunglasses!). Our pilot was very safety-minded and knowledgeable. This flight is so much more than seeing Denali, it's about being amidst the huge, wild, jagged mountains that surround it. Puffy clouds only made it all the more dramatic. Our glacier landing was such fun, and although we couldn't spend too much time on the glacier itself due to flight traffic, it was still such an adventure. You don't want to miss out on this experience, so plan some flexibility in your schedule in case your scheduled flight is delayed for weather.

review_title: Great Views but couldnt do Glacier Landing
review_text: Booked a glacier landing trip but when we reached the weather was bad . Good customer care , even when the weather was not allowing they gave options to change the booking to another day or refund or fly without landing. We changed to another day but the weather didnt allow us next time as well , so we had to choose not to land on glacier. So missed the landing , but they refunded the difference in cost and we did get to see denali from above :)

K2 Aviation is very friendly, but has no control over the weather.  If you can be flexible, book this for the first day of your trip and keep your options open to reschedule for the best weather.  We visited in mid-June.  There had been several days of rain just before, so they were not offering the glacier landing we had booked.  It was also cloudy, so they were not flying to Denali itself (the Denali Grand Tour).  They offered a complete refund, the chance to reschedule (warning that they had many flights to rebook), or the option to keep our reservation time and do the shorter, less expensive Denali Experience.  We had reservations at our next destination so we could not reschedule for a different day.  

Our pilot Daniel made us feel very safe and gave us some great views of several glaciers and smaller peaks.  It was a great experience, but we did not get to see The Big One on this flight.

review_title: The best, the very, very best experience with a glacier landing also!
review_text:
Mike who was our pilot, was a quiet guy, very knowledgeable and obviously a real professional. He shared all the important stuff along the way, pointed out all the must sees and a few more. He manoeuvres the plane to ensure that every gets the chance to see the same thing and in doing so it makes the trip a bit of fun with some of the turns!
