He made us feel really welcome and when we landed on the glacier it was such an awesome time for these two Aussies.

Thanks Mike and K2 for giving my wife an absolutely beautiful lifetime experience as this mountain and the flight with the glacier landing, was the reason behind our decision to go to Alaska, stay at Talkeetna and then someone ensured that Denali was totally cloud free on our trip. We could've reached out and touched the mountain it was so clear!

K2 booking online from Australia was easy and the staff we're fantastic when we arrived to check in for the flight.

My wife is now the proud owner of a K2 Denali zip jacket and when she wears it she relives her time of our flight around Denali!

We had a 9am reservation for the Grand Tour but were informed about postponment due to weather. K2 kept in touch via email about each change in plans.  We really wanted to see Denali so decided not to take other flightseeing destinations which were offered instead.  Finally, 24 hours later,  Denali was visible and we found out the tour was on BUT no glacier landing and a one hour instead of a two hour.  We were a little doubtful but so excited to be flying around Denali that we decided this was the best alternative.  We were definitely not disappointed!  The views were crystal clear and just incredible, Mike was a wonderful pilot and commentator..  The substitution turned out to be just a reason to try again another time.  Fabulous job K2!  What wonderful memories (and photographs) we have!

Flying with K2 was the highlight of our trip.  We did the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing, and it was worth every dollar.  Our original flight date had poor weather, so we rescheduled for two days later when we'd be back in Talkeetna.  When the weather was poor on our original date, K2 explained our options clearly and helped us reschedule.  The flight was incredible.  Once above the clouds, we had unobstructed views of Mt. Denali and surrounding peaks.  Our pilot did a wonderful job of pointing out prominent peaks, glaciers, and climbing routes within the Alaska Range.  It was all breathtaking and an amazing experience.

It’s hard to say enough about our flight.  We had the glacier landing and it was well worth the extra cost.  Got lots of great pictures from our landing spot just south of the Denali summit.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and I had absolutely no worries for our safety throughout the flight which made for a stress-free experience.  The total cost was a bit pricey, but the Alaska Tour Saver discount of $85 per person was a big help.  Also, our flight appeared to last a lot longer than originally advertised.  We seemed to spend way more time on the glacier than half an hour.  Also, Chris appeared to circle the summit more than once while waiting for an opportunity to land in the established landing zone with the other aircraft.  All and all, a great experience and well worth the money we paid; and that’s coming from someone that really knows how to stretch a dollar for value.  Don’t hesitate, “Just Do It”!!!

review_title: A Fantastic Aviation Experience with K2!
review_text: My son and I booked the K2 Denali Grand Tour with Glacier Landing and we were not disappointed with the experience! The weather was perfect and so was the flight. Our excellent and experienced pilot made sure both passenger sides of the plane saw everything and everyone has a window seat. This is the very best way to grasp the immenseness and beauty of Denali and combined with the landing on Ruth Glacier, it was an awesome experience we will never forget!

My husband and I enjoyed this as a part of celebration for our anniversary. The entire experience was wonderful with exception of having to wait over an hour for our take off time. When checking in, we were told they would be loading with in the next few minutes, an hour later, we were off?? Not sure, what happened, there was no explanation. That was a let down! We were scheduled for the 3:00 flight and departed a little after 4:00.

review_title: The Best Of Denali!  K2 Aviation!
review_text: If you want first hand joy from the seat of an airplane, K2 is your mandatory stop.  Our pilot, Chris, gave us such a special tour and went beyond the call of duty looking for critters.  It's no wonder Trip Advisor five star reviews steered us in the right direction, just like Capt. Chris did!  Bravo K2, we'll spread the good word!

The vast beauty of Denali park area is like no other.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and experienced pilot.  The view was beyond words.  Seeing the back side of Denali was the greatest as a break in the clouds allowed us to look up to the top.  Would do it again and again  Cathedral Mountain was incredible.  I could have flown all day.

review_title: Seeing the mountains and glaciers up close was awe inspiring!
review_text: Denali makes its own weather. We had a total of 8 reservations over 3 days before it was finally the kind of weather that they could fly the Denali Grand Tour. We were able to wait it out, but if you are in Talkeetna for just a few hours, you may not be able to count on doing this tour. K2 is wonderful to work with and cheerfully rebooks your tour or gives a full refund if you can't rebook. They have loaner sunglasses if you forget yours, and everyone had a pair of loaner glacier boots to keep feet dry on the glacier. It was shirtsleeve weather the day we were on the glacier although we did bring along a sweatshirt just in case. My ears hurt intensely when we made a descent of about 7,000 feet for the glacier landing. Be aware of this if your ears readily respond to altitude changes. I had gum along and chewed it like mad, but the pain was real for several minutes. My only disappointment was that they do NOT record your actual flight for you to purchase a copy of. We were not informed of this until I went to purchase one after we landed, but they do offer a generic flight recording to purchase. Truly a once in a lifetime experience.

Can't say enough about the whole experience. Booking was easy, check in was fast and the flight was something we will never forget. The staff and Patrick who took us up flying was hands down something we will come back to do again,

Our pilot, Rosemarie, provided a wonderful flight and narration.   She was consistently focused on meeting our needs, answering questions with insightful responses, and proactively providing information about the geology, glacial activity, and history.  The scenery was completely awe-inspiring and captivating.  We're very glad that we did this!
Other-worldly up on the glacier around Denali. Fantastic views from the plane and neat to land on the glacier. Have done this twice now. Still love it.

We were treated well when we arrived and were told that the original tour planned would not be available due to weather moving in. Constantly monitoring the conditions made me feel safe. 
Wonderful views, good photos, narration was informative.  We loved the glacier landing. Just being in among the mountains was spectacular and realizing how large the mountains are. This excursion was worth every penny!
No words can describe this!!! The enormity of this mountain range is incredible. I cried from the shear beauty of the view. It’s absolutely worth every single penny.

review_title: Superb flight by very experienced pilot
review_text: My wife and I did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour on May 29, 2018. There were some clouds to contend with but K2 will not fly if it is not safe. So they delayed our flight about 30 minutes. I was very pleased to see that we were going in a turbine powered Otter aircraft; much safer than a piston as I just retired after 45 years of flying military and corporate. Chip our pilot gave us a good safety briefing before we got airborne. My wife sat in the copilot's seat as I wanted to just take photos. Chip gave us a nonstop tour and history of the area; it was like being in a college classroom as he really knows what he is talking about. Overall this was the highlight of the Alaska land tour that we did with Princess Cruises. If you want to see Mt Denali up close and personal and the surrounding area, don't miss this flight. K2 is an impressive company; check out their article on landing on glaciers in AOPA magazine, June or July 2018 issue if I remember correctly. This tour should not be missed....(skip the river rafting, boring; use that money to fly!!!). You won't be sorry you did. Don't forget your camera either.

review_title: Pretty terrific, even without glacier landing
review_text:
Our sighseeing tour with glacier landing was bumped for several days in an attempt to get cooperative weather. Unfortunately, the landing was not to be. Depite the disappointment, K2 provided a great flightseeing experience. The pilot was very knowledgable (although did not "teach" very much unless prompted by questions).  We would go again, and would definitely use K2 because of their obvious commitment to safety first. 

If you want to do the glacier landing, plan it for your first day in the area, so that you can re-schedule (if possible) to minimize weather impact.

We drove to Talkeetna and booked a flight around Denali the same day and were treated to cloudless views of Denali and the surrounding area during our 90 minute flight. Our plane was a small 6-seater and I'm pretty sure we got a longer your than we booked, so that was a bonus. Unbelievable views and not a dull moment the whole trip.

review_title: If you're offered a refund because it's foggy take it!
review_text: If you're offered a refund because it's foggy take it. We could hardly see anything. The pilot was great and the flying experience was fine but worthless if you can't see anything but white

This was by far the highlight of our sightseeing as the weather was great-sunny and warm. We arrived at K2 about an hour before our flight and got our booties to wear over our shoes-wear Tennis shoes. The flight left on time and we had a get pilot (Kevin) very knowledgeable and he gave us a lot of interesting views on Denali park and the background of who and how it became a national park-Perfect day and awesome weather to visit this beautiful park- The best part is landing on the glacier and actually getting out on it -- so much fun and definitely a must do activity

I put off doing a flight experience of Denali because I thought seeing the mountain from a bus excursion was good enough. Boy was I wrong. Being up close to the mountain with K2 and Brad, seeing the glaciers, and flying among the jagged peaks was awesome.  But the best part was landing on the glacier at the foot of Denali.  Looking at the awe inspiring beauty from there on the mountain was truly an unforgettable experience.  You You gotta just do it!

The Denali Flyer Tour at K2 was rated one of our top activities in our 2 week Alaska adventure.  Once we left the airport in Talkeetna, our pilot was advised some weather was moving in so he modified his flight so we could land on the glacier.  Even though the time was cut short on the glacier, it was AWESOME!!!  To see this part of God's creation, watch other planes land and take off from the glacier was an amazing sight. After taking off from the glacier he tried to climb above the cloud cover to get a glimpse of Mt. Denali but couldn't get a view. You just can't put into words the views you can see from the glacier landing and from the flight around the mountains, it's just an experience you have to see for yourself.

Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate for us to take our scheduled flight and glacier landing.  We rescheduled and tried the next day, but still weren't able to go.  So we ended up flying towards Palmer and seeing the Knik glacier instead.  Since this didn't include the glacier landing, our cost was less than the original tour we booked. Everyone at the front desk was very polite and easy to work with for the rescheduling and check in process. Mike was our pilot, and he did a great job of turning the plane so that everyone on both sides could see well.  My daughter got to ride in the front with him as his "co-pilot", and she was thrilled!  There were four of us, myself, my husband, and our two kids (age 9 and 11).  We all four enjoyed the flight.  It is definitely worth doing even if you don't get to actually see Denali!

We loved our flight with K2 Aviation.   I was quite nervous at first but our Pilot Mark soon put all nerves to rest.    The company are so well organised and safety details explained.  Have no hesitation in recommending this company to see the most beautiful scenery in Denali.

We had a group of 6 who chose to fly on a not certain of seeing top of Denali day.  It turned out to be much more than just seeing the top of Denali!  The pilot, Kevin, was super and obviously in love with his job, flying and that area in particular.  He pointed out so much more than just the mountain!  We saw glaciers up close and rivers and valleys and got a good feel for the geology of the area as well as finding a "hole in the clouds" allowing us to see the top of Denali!  Great hour plus trip for all from age 7 to 76!

Words and pictures do not come close to describing the experience of flying up to view Denali.  We were very happy with our pilot, Billy.  He was funny and very knowledgable about the area and kept us entertained the whole flight.  Oh, and the landing was the smoothest I've ever experienced...

review_title: Once in a lifetime magnificent view
review_text: K2 offers reasonable price for their services. The staff are friendly and courteous. We booked the Denali Grand Tour with landing, but due to weather downgraded to the Denali Flyer Tour without landing. They also offered a different time/day or full refund as alternative options. Our pilot was easy going, knowledgeable, experienced, and you can tell she has a passion for nature. The glacier and mountain view were magnificent and unforgettable. I have lived in Alaska for several years, and I think flight tour is the best way to appreciate the vastness and power of the land. It's worth every penny. You will not regret this experience.

We were supposed to take the grand tour with glacier landing but due to weather conditions on the mountain we took the short blue tour. Our pilot was great. He told us great details about the city of Talkeetna, the three rivers area, the preserve and National Park. We flew over one of the many glaciers, the moose tooth and house mountain. We got to be part of the 30% of visitors to Denali that got to see the summit.  It was beautiful, almost beyond description. It was one of the best flying tours I have taken. It was an almost surreal experience.  I would recommend K2 Aviation and would definitely come back again for my glacier landing.

This tour was recommended by a friend and did not disappoint. Our guide and pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and most accommodating, it was an overall great experience- especially since it was a clear evening and one could actually see Denali.

Great flight, very cool to see the mountains and glaciers from this perspective.   Pilot (forgot his name, sorry) did a great job of narrating and explaining what we were seeing.   

Our only disappointment was that we were not able to do the glacier landing, as we had booked, due to poor weather conditions for several days.   But the staff at K2 was easy to deal with in re-booking us until the weather cooperated and refunded the difference for not doing the glacier landing.

We were scheduled for the Summit Tour but the weather didn't permit it.  K2 gave us the Grand Tour AND added the glacier landing at no extra charge for 6 people for the inconvenience!  The tour was superior, our guide was great - so glad we did this.  Very much worth the money.

Until you've experienced this with K2 Aviation you cannot comprehend what seeing and almost touching Denali is all about. K2 treats you as if you are royalty. I highly recommend you do this with K2 and if you're lucky enough to have Daniel as your pilot...BIG BONUS!

Felt secure with Will as our pilot and K2 as the company. I had never flown in a 6 seater prior to this experience. It was an incredible flight.  Made my three week visit to Alaska the greatest experience of my traveling life.  Thank you, Will. Thank you K2.
It was a once in a lifetime experience I took my 10 yr old daughter. She was blown away by it.we had a snow ball fight. She has never played in snow being a Florida child

review_title: Best experience we've had in Alaska!
review_text: We come up every year just to hang out and relax.  Decided this year to take this flight.  We should have done it years ago.  Scheduling the flight was easy, the staff was professional and friendly, the facilities are top notch, Dan (our pilot), explained all things about the aircraft and the trip and did a great job telling us about the area over which we were flying.  All-in-all this was just awesome.  Of course it helped that we had an awesome look at Denali (thanks to the weather).  If you can only do one thing while you're here I'd highly recommend K2!!
The weather was great on the day of the tour. The view was breath taking. Unforgettable experience !
We found the staff very professional and communicative.  The weather did not allow a landing but they kept us in the loop at all times.

Our planned trip of the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing was canceled due to cloud cover but we were able to go on a shorter flight on the southern side of the range and still got to land on the glacier. Awesome experience to see the mountains so close, walk on a glacier and have Mike, our pilot, give us such great info about the terrain! The southern peak of Denali was above the clouds so we got to see her up close and the beautiful blue waters in the glaciers that we flew over. If you have the means and opportunity to do this, K2 is the way to go. Great staff, safe stable planes and excellent itineraries.

We had a great Flightseeing tour on Wednesday, June 20.  Although there were low clouds, we were able to see many glaciers, lakes, and mountains from the air.  We were not disappointed by the clouds and actually were very impressed with the safety first attitude of our pilot.  He was extremely knowledgeable about the mountains we were flying around and made sure we were all able to see the sights he was pointing out.  K2 picked us up from the Talkeetna Lodge and also took us to the train station when finished with our tour.  We all very much enjoyed the experience.

This experience is not to be missed! We were taken through the Alaska Mt range, over glaciers, close to Mt Denali. A wonderful 1 1/2 hr flight. Our pilot was very confident and gentle. We felt safe and were in total awe of the snow capped mountains, clouds, glaciers, etc. Shout out to our enthusiastic pilot, Will!

we booked this as part of our Princess land/sea tour (land portion). It was our first excursion and I was nervous about the small plane but it was wonderful. Our pilot gave a really great tour/explanation as we flew. I really learned the most from him than I did on any later excursions. We were lucky to have amazing clear views of Denali as we circled the summit. I also really enjoyed the flight back--the smaller mountains were beautiful as well and really varied.

Amazing flight tour.
Amazing scenery, saw Denali...
Landing on Ruth glacier to be experienced. outstanding beauty.
Great commentary

review_title: Any day is special when you are flying over Denali
review_text: Yes it was cloud and rainy. This however was our grandsons first trip in a small airplane. And we whispered that to K2. They made this trip so special for him. And therefore for us too. Our thanks to the young lady who placed the three of us on a small plane like we had ridden two times previously with two other grandchildern. And our biggest shout out to Will, our pilot, who let him feel like a copilot in the front  seat of the plane. A great trip, worth every dollar.

Was hoping for a Glacier landing, but wasn’t to be. I completely understand safety first at all times. Our pilot Randy was incredibly knowledgeable of the area and pointed out many things. Being a plane fanatic, I just loved being on board, and captured many great shots and videos on my iPad. Beautiful flight, and I highly recommend K2 Aviation for any experience in the air.

We had an amazing time on the tour. Our pilot was great! She had vast knowledge of Denali and the surroundings. She was a excellent pilot and tour guide! If we ever make it back we will defiantly be taking the flight again!

We had a group of 30 in town for a corporate event. K2 Aviation was easy to work with and we had no issues getting our group split up into several small planes. Our group was in Alaska for 6 days and this excursion was the highlight of the trip! Despite the small planes, the take off and landing are very smooth, you have headsets, so that you can talk with other passengers, the pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable about the area. 
I highly recommend this tour!
This trip was the highlight of our time in Alaska and so worth the money! We spent the litte bit extra on the glacier landing and are so glad we did.

review_title: On a clear day, there's nothing better than a K-2 tour
review_text: We (three adults and one child) thoroughly enjoyed flightseeing the Alaska range with an experience pilot who gave us a commentary about Formaker, Hunter, and Denali.  The views were incredible, and all made for a major highlight of our week's stay in Alaska.

review_title: Best way to see Denali and surrounding area.
review_text: We really enjoyed our flight with K2. Our pilot, Rosemary, was very professional and engaging. She had great knowledge of the geography and history of the area. The flight was smoother than I expected, and the views were spectacular.

review_title: Denali on a perfectly clear day
review_text:
We had an awesome experience.  Thank you to our pilot for giving us such a great view of the mountain range, the glaciers and an incredibly smooth landing and takeoff on the glacier.  One of our top 3 highlights of the trip.
K2-Aviation was fantastic from the moment they picked us up at the hotel, during prep time, flight and the return to the hotel.
Flying Denali is a much an everyone's agenda when visiting Alaska and K2 is the one to do it.  Thanks,

review_title: A unique experience. You will be in good hands.
review_text:
The flight, and specially the landing on the glacier were amazing. 
K2 Aviation gave us a perfect service and the let us change our reservation to catch better weather. 
Fully recomended.

The experience was beyond my expectations.  K2 is a very well run organization with quality & entertaining pilots.  The weather was perfect for the 2.5 hour flight and landing on Ruth glacier where we could see Sheldon Chalet and Denali Mtn.  
The views were breathtaking and I learned so much from the pilot.  This is a must do excursion in Alaska!

review_title: did the flight @ 4:30 pm ,took advantage of a fairly clear day
review_text: Pilot had a lot of additional info to relate about the climbers, camps & glaciers. gave us a great perspective of the true size of Denali & glaciers

Words can not say enough about the wonderful experience with K2. From the time we booked, through arrival and check in process the experience was great. We met our pilot, who was not only experienced and knowledgeable but gracious and friendly. We booked the flight hoping it to be a highlight of our family trip and it met and exceeded our expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend K2 and would definitely repeat the experience if we are lucky enough to return to the area.

The view is glorious and the landing on the glacier is something we truly were amazed by  it. 
The pilot was very friendly and was able to tell you about the mountains with all their names.
Our first fight was cancelled but they were able to work us in an available one.
Everyone going that way should take one of these flights.

So glad i decided to do this tour at the last minute ! It was A-MA-ZING !!! The pilot was awesome ! Friendly staff :)  Highly recommend when in Talkeetna. 
Bucketlist checked :)

Everything about this trip was amazing especially the glacier landing. Highly recommend this. Such a professional company we have been using for over 10 years! Love all the helpful staff and pilots.
Must do the glacier landing

Viewing Denali this way is just remarkable, no way to explain what you see except to say you just need to experience it, with the glacier landing. You will never forget it. I'm now rating the tour experience with K2.  The office staff were friendly, and made sure all questions were answered before boarding. They were fully booked in the morning, if you go try an afternoon tour if you are able, most of the clouds will be burned away and your views will be incredible. The pilot and guide was patient with all of the questions and a fully loaded plane. His knowledge of landmarks and Denali were excellent, and he gave what I felt was a little extra in the way of making sure we were comfortable and safe. I would recommend them to anyone.

K2 Aviation provided an amazing flight seeing trip to view Denali with a glacier landing.  The staff and pilot were friendly and knowledgeable.  Don't pass up an opportunity to fly with K2 and check this off your bucket list!

Our family decided to do the K2 Flight seeing tour with glacier landing at the very last minute.  We had not planned on doing this on our trip to Talkeetna but so glad we did.  We had ideal weather and hardly a cloud in the sky. Our pilot Steve was fabulous.  Good sense of humor, did a fabulous job as narrating our trip. We are so glad we had this opportunity and would definitely recommend it.

We decided to do this at the last minute through our cruise tour and we are so glad that we did!  Pick up and registration was quick and efficient. We were boarding our plane before the boys even finished their game of cornhole!  Our pilot, Craig, was fabulous. He was really knowledgeable about the geography and history of the area and passed on so much interesting information. We expected to simply fly over the mountains and glaciers but to our surprise and amazement, we flew much closer to the landscape. The views will forever be imprinted in our memories. We walked away feeling like we were able to view this mountain range is a special way. We are so glad we chose to do this!!

review_title: Terrible views from K2 s Cherokee 6
review_text: While most of K2 sightseeing aircraft are high wing airplanes, which are excellent for sight seeing we were placed in a low wing Cherokee 6 airplane which was absolutely horrible for viewing and enjoying the mountains. I seriously considered asking for a refund, and would never sight see in this type airplane again.

We arrived at McKinley resort and were greeted by an amazing sight of Denali with clear blue skies. So we took advantage of the opportunity to book a Denali flight experience with glacier landing. K2 was very accommodating and got us on an earlier flight than we booked. Dave, the pilot, was an excellent host and guide. Very informative commentary. The flight was amazing with panoramic views and close ups of the mountains and glaciers. We landed on a glacier and spent maybe 20 minutes taking in the incredible view. If you are lucky enough to have a clear day, then this is a MUST do!

review_title: Fantastic flight through the Alaska Range With Landing on a Glacier
review_text:
This was a spectacular flight! We had a sunny day and Denali was out in all it's glory.
Our pilot Stan started off with all the safety features and then after we were securely in our seats with head sets on he took off and narrated our flight with many interesting details about the area. It almost felt as if we could reach out and touch the mountains. Simply awesome and I couldn't stop taking pictures and videos. We had a smooth landing on the glacier and got to frolic around in the snow for awhile before heading back. I highly recommend this trip! K2 Avaition was efficient, friendly and I felt like I was in good hands with their very experienced pilot. The office is at the edge of downtown Talkeetna so you can walk to town and browse around or eat and drink before or after this trip. Also at their office is complimentary coffee and some nice hats and T-shirt souvenirs to choose from.

Wow!  This flightseeing experience was simply amazing!  The rugged beauty of Denali and the Alaskan Range is quite striking when you are flying so close to it.  Our pilot, Mike, was extremely competent and knowledgeable.  Although I had not previously flown in a small plane, I was not at all nervous with him in the cockpit.  Landing on the glacier and spending some time experiencing the grandeur was incredible.

If you're looking for a truly unique, one of a kind experience. Then look no further then K2. From the beautiful drive to downtown Talkeetna staring down Denali, to getting geared up for the Glacier landing, their planes are nicely restored, our pilot was experienced and knowledgeable. From start to finish the experience was totally worth the cost.
Loved every minute of this tour.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable ... we were lucky to see Denali "out".  Absolutely breathtaking sights.  Highly recommend this tour!

When we got to Talkeetna and it was a clear day, we upgraded out flight to the Grand Tour with a glacier landing. What an experience. To see the mountain up close and personal, and then land and get out and walk around. Just awesome and worth the cost...

K2 provided an amazing experience flying in Denali. Our pilot and guide, Daniel, was phenomenal! We flew around the many peaks of the Alaska range in comfort as Daniel pointed out many interesting features. The glacier landing tour is easily the highlight of any Alaska vacation and I am very happy that I chose to go with K2!

We were initially scheduled for the longer flight with a glacier landing. Weather did not cooperate. When we arrived the staff was very apologetic and switched us to shorter flight. Equipment was in good shape. The pilot was very informative and views were terrific.

review_title: DO THIS BEFORE YOU LEAVE ALASKA
review_text: Have done this 4 times and the glacier landing and scenery are always spectacular! Pilots are safe and knowledgeable, planes are in top shape.  K2 A must do for your trip.

Having admired Denali from below for many years, it felt like time for a closer visit.  I'm so glad we did!  Got to see all the peaks, climbers on the move, Mountain House #1 and #2,  and amazing vistas. The pilot's narrative was very helpful - nice to know that those "little wrinkles" were hundreds of feet deep!  Thanks to K2 for making this experience so amazing.  Afterwards, we visited the Ranger station and the Talkeetna Cemetery memorial to climbers who didn't make it.  I recommend those as a follow up reminder of the force of this great mountain.

We couldn't do the glacier landing due to the weather, so our pilot, Chris, decided showed us the spots that were well visible. Chris also told us a lot about the area and was it was an extremely smooth flight for such a small plane (10 people including pilot). All in all, a great experience even though not as planned and everything went very smooth and easy with K2, all very professional and super friendly.
We really enjoyed the experience, it was well worth the time and money.  Great experienced pilot :)  I enjoyed seeing Denali from a different view.  Thank you k2

If you come to Alaska for vacation or even if you live here don't miss a flightseeing tour of Denali. It gives you an entirely different perspective on how unique and amazingly huge Denali really is. K2 Aviation in Talkeetna provides an unbelievable experience.  If you aren't bothered by flying try this incredible trip, you won't be disappointed.

You have to do this tour. It is truly phenomenal. Being up in the plane gives you a completely different view than being in the towns surrounded by mountains. I could not stop snapping pictures during this flight! Landing on the glacier also gave us spectacular views of Denali and mountains surrounding you. Everywhere you turned, your mouth would drop. Our pilot (whose name I forgot (sorry!) but he said he could be identified as the guy with all the tattoos) pointed out different peaks and views to look at throughout the flight. I expected a bumpy ride, but it was super smooth. The landing was smoother than a commercial flight! We had initially signed up for the Summit Tour with Glacier Landing, but when we arrived at the hangar they said the winds were causing unsafe travel conditions so we had to do the tour that was down one notch - the Grand Tour with Glacier Landing. They even refunded me the cost difference, as they said they would never charge for a tour they couldn't offer. I was pleased with the way they handled it, but I'm sure they have that happen a lot. I'm glad to hear they always put safety first and do not try to fly in unsafe conditions just to get more money.  We were concerned the tour wouldn't be as good since we had to "downgrade", but this one was absolutely beautiful and we don't think we missed out on too much because we were still able to see so much. I cannot recommend this tour to you enough - seriously, worth every single penny you pay!!! Just make sure you have a lot of memory on your camera for this!

When we arrived at K2 we were disappointed to learn that because of low cloud and changeable weather conditions we would not be able to land on the glacier. We were given a range of options and decided to go on the Denali Flyer.
 It was the best decision we have made as the flight under pilot Randy was the smoothest ever and his expert skills enabled us to see all the major glaciers while flying above and below cloud and what seemed right next to sheer cliff faces. We even caught views of the mighty Mount Denali.

review_title: Great, eventhough the tour was shorter than planned
review_text:
because the weather wasn't complying, I did get the chance do to the whole tour I had signed up for. K2 told me to come back a bit later to see if the weather improved enough to be able to fly. When I came back the weather was slightly better but not enough to do the originally chosen tour. K2 offered a choice between a refund or taking another tour and refunding me the difference. I chose to fly and didn't regret it.

Pilot was good and funny.
The views eventhough the weather was not perfect were still absolutely spectacular.
Really worth it.

we enjoyed this flight so much! great experience and awesome people ! 
definetely worth the money!
we landed on a glacier and it was beautiful. Always felt safe during our flight

Worth every penny! We chose the “Denali flyer with glacier landing”. On our flight day, there wasn’t enough visibility to do the whole trip or the glacier landing, so they refunded us to the basic package, and we got a shorter flight. Our flight was amazing!! Truly a once in a lifetime experience. I was nervous beforehand but our pilot was so skilled, the take off and landing were so smooth. The was also a great tour guide and told us lots of interesting things. 

We were on a land tour with Princess, but we booked the flight directly with k2, which was much cheaper than booking through Princess.

We weren’t able to land or see Denali like we planned, because the weather wasn’t cooperating, but the tour we took was amazing!  Our pilot, Randy, was very informed on the glaciers, the topography, the climbers and the history.  The ride was smooth and the views stunning.  We saw a couple base camps, many of the climbers were in town waiting to get out...like the tours, problems to safely land.  The K2 staff was great to deal with, gave us the option of full refund if we didn’t want to go, or of course a reduced rate for trip we were able to take.  I’m glad we did!  Their office and airport is walking distance from Talkteeba town, where we stayed, but I also noticed K2 vans brining their customers back and forth too.
Our pilot was competent and professional.He gave a running commentary throughout. We felt safe at all times.I would definitely recommend K-2 sightseeing flights.

Wow...hard to explain such a mind blowing experience. I am not a person with a lack of things to say, but this trip left me speechless.  The feeling of being so close to these majestic mountains that were so far away from our hotel is amazing.  Your mouth will hurt from smiling so much. Our pilot EO, was so fun and knowledgeable too. He answered all of our questions and even pointed out base camp so we could get a feel for how high we truly were.  WELL worth it....I can't wait to do it again!
Amazing views, great pilot, helpful staff! I highly recommend this company if you want an unforgettable experience :)
What a wonderful experience!  Everyone at K2 Aviation was friendly, helpful, and professional.  The views were amazing and we enjoyed every minute!

review_title: Highlight of our week in Alaska
review_text: At first, a flightseeing trip seemed like a pricey add-on to our Alaska trip, but my son and I were so glad that we decided to go. Our pilot, Chris, was knowledgeable about the geology and history of the mountains in a conversational sort of way, without sounding  like he had memorized a script. Even though the weather didn't allow us to see Denali, it was a spectacular trip that was the highlight of our week in Alaska.

review_title: Epic - The Highlight of our Alaska Trip
review_text:
Words hardly do justice to the surreal experience delivered by the K2 team. Our family of four absolutely rank our K2 Denali air tour to be our absolute best Alaska experience. 

We arrived in the mid afternoon and within 30 minutes, we were in the air. Our pilot was so friendly and professional - I had zero concerns about our safety. The tour itself was just so amazing! The views just can't be duplicated. I still can't wait to tell someone new about the experience.

I think if you're traveling all the way to Alaska (1,800 miles for us), why wouldn't you spend just a little more money to take a K2 scenic flight that you'll talk about forever? I am thrilled that my teenage kids get to reflect back on the incredible experience for the rest of their lives. Thanks, K2!!

Readying to be picked up by the K-2 shuttle at our hotel (Grand Talkeetna Lodge) we were browsing the gift shop when several people mumbled and looked out the rear window to see Denali in all its great splendor. The mountain had been sort of "socked in" for a few days but was now gleaming in the early sunlight of a new day. So with anticipation we boarded the shuttle for the short ride to the K-2 facility, checked in and were assigned to a twin Cessna along with another couple and a family of four with two youngsters. Full cabin but what a great ride! The pilot was most knowledgeable, friendly and put everyone immediately at ease as he "ran up" the engines to check temps and pressures then off we went. The scenery is unimaginable and hard to fully describe in words to convey the full range of the vistas the eye is presented with. Slowly gaining altitude we were soon among the peaks and found ourselves amidst the summit faces of Denali itself. Alas, the experience lasted not long enough as we began our slow descent back down to Talkeetna. As we departed I shook the pilot's hand telling him while I know he had no control over the weather conditions, we were very appreciative of what he was able to show us (and tipped him handsomely for the effort). K-2 is a "cant' miss" deal.

This was a great experience from start to finish, starting with quick responses to initial enquiries, preflight contacts and information, safety briefing and the engagement of an experienced pilot with us all constantly explaining the scenic area and easing any concerns we may have had as we flew over the most daunting and majestic mountains and glaciers. 
The planes were very clean and well maintained, very powerful and ideal for the type of work expected of them to fly in mountain terrain.  Windows were very clean enabling surprisingly good photography.
The history of the area was well explained as we flew. Although we did not manage a glacial landing due to cloud conditions, the whole experience was exceptional.It would be one of the best experiences we had in our 3 weeks in Alaska. April, often seen as not a good time to be in Alaska due to the melting snow, actually was really good as the day light hours are long, the landscape is still well covered in snow, the lakes and rivers are largely still iced over, but thawing and there were no mosquitos yet to worry about!
Great experience and very much recommend.

K2 handled our last minute request perfectly. Chris was a great pilot and guide and went out of his way to show us a few extra things we wanted to see. On a windy day, our flight was very pleasant. The views, were, of course breathtaking! Thank you K2 for a view of adventures to come!

Take flight from a small air strip in Talkeetna, AK and soon you'll be looking down at ice fields and glaciers as far as you can see. Cliffs rising thousands of feet in front of you.  Then Denali, the highest mountain on the north American continent looms in front of your small four seater aircraft. The pilot makes a quick turn, dives down, and within a breath or two you're gliding on the snow covered surface of a glacier a mile wide. The plane slows, stops and you step out. Twenty minutes to fill your mind with memories that will last a lifetime before an exciting flight back to Talkeetna. You will never forget this excursion.

My second time flying with K2 and just as mind-blowing as the first time.  Everyone we dealt with was super nice and very helpful.  Pilots patiently answered all my dumb questions and all their suggestions for activities in town were spot on.  Would certainly recommend K2 and look forward to flying with them again!

Very professional. The whole experience end to end was beyond excellent. We were actually running 10 mins late and they called us to make sure we were on our way for the flight. I was so impressed and thankful for them to accommodate us. Our pilot was a seasoned one and gave us very good detail and narrative on the whole tour. Highly recommend them!!

A picture perfect day for our flightseeing in February. Up close and personal with the mountain range courtesy of K2. The photos don't do justice to the majestic sight of these rock formations against the blue sky and the glaciers making their way down the slopes. Great narrative by our pilot answering all of our questions. And even tho the temps outside were in the teens, we were plenty warm and cozy for the duration of the flight.

We had a terrific ride with David and he took us to places that were amazing and beautiful, giving us opportunities to take nice photos and explanations of what we were seeing alongside with historical perspectives.  Even though we were flying in the winter, there were accommodations to try to make it as warm as possible in the plane.  It was a nice long sightseeing adventure that didn't feel rushed.

*Fun
*Friendly pilot and office staff
*Great views of the mountain ranges and surrounding areas
*informative and educational trip

My son is stationed at JBER and I came to visit for Christmas. He surprised me with this flight tour and I was absolutely amazed at the experience. From the moment we arrived and chatted with Suzanne about what to expect to the actual flight with Dallas as our flight guide, the experience is out of this world spectacular. I cannot say enough positive things about K2 Aviation. If you're looking to take a tour by plane this is the place to do it, a must do!!!!
Wow wow wow wow.  This is a North American bucket list item for sure.  Watched the weather all week and got a million dollar view.  So glad we did this!

Did a tour in the winter. The crew prioritized safety and enjoyment by altering the tour as needed for wind/turbulence. They informed us as soon as we arrived of the conditions so we'd be prepared. Our pilot, Dallas, was clearly an expert at what he does, meticulous, and has a very enjoyable demeanor, explaining interesting things about the area during the flight. 100% satisfied.

review_title: A must do if you're anywhere close to Talkeetna!
review_text:
We stopped here on our way from Anchorage to Denali...You have to go a bit out of your way to get to Talkeetna, but if you wish to do a flightseeing tour of the Mountain, this is the place

K2 Aviation is the way to go...We had pre-booked (a must) the Summit Tour with a glacier landing, but due to weather conditions were not able to fly to the top of the summit

But, the alternative was amazing...The flight from Talkeetna to the glacier was perfect...Our very knowledgeable pilot provided great information during his commentary...Photo opportunities abounded

The glacier landing is a must add-on (don't worry about the price...this is a once in a lifetime trip)...the scenery is unreal and words won't do it justice...Heck, the photos hardly capture the moment and feeling of wonder

Must do!  Must do!  Must do!

Wir haben im Juli diese Flightseeing Tour unternommen und konnten auf Grund des nebligen Wetters leider nicht soweit in das vorgesehene Gebiet fliegen wie beabsichtigt. Wir hätten uns auch für einen anderen Tag entscheiden können oder K2 hätte uns das Geld zurückgegeben. Wenn man natürlich schon einmal "in der Gegend" ist unternimmt man die Tour natürlich und muss eben damit leben, dass sie bei "schönerem" Wetter bestimmt spektakulärer ausgefallen wäre...
Der Pilot und alle Angestellten waren sehr nett !!

I will start with safety is very important to this company.  We origionally had a tour with a glacier landing booked, but the weather was not cooperative.  We had to reschedule for a different day.  When we did go on our tour, it was amazing.  Great pilot, very nice planes, wonderful views.  The flight was very smooth, no issue with motion sickness, as my husband can be prone to it.  The pilot was very informative, and explained what we were seeing.  If you truly would like to experience Denali, book a flight tour with this company.  Our time on this tour was definitely one of the highlights while on our trip in Alaska!

review_title: Best Thing We Did in Alaska!!!
review_text: Stunning views, interesting and enjoyable pilot.  We also cruised the coast while there - but this was the highlight of our trip!!!

review_title: Stunning Views, Wonderful pilot, Smooth Flight
review_text:
I could not recommend taking a K2 flying tour more. It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and one of the most unforgettable experiences I've ever had. 

K2 watched the weather carefully and made sure we went up at a time when the viewing would be good. We really appreciated their diligence about the weather to ensure a good viewing experience. Given the potentially flexible nature of the flight time, I would recommend planning only activities that can be rescheduled on the same day as your flight tour. We just did a local hike that day, so it was easy to flop our schedules to accommodate the flight time change. We also ended up on a better tour without paying extra since our rescheduled time was to go with others who had booked a longer tour.

The plane itself was comfortable and offered great views from every seat. Our pilot made the experience extra special by sharing information about everything we were seeing as well as happily answering any questions we had. He was also diligent about making sure everyone on both sides of the plane got to enjoy views of the best sights.

The one complaint I would have is that we were confused about being picked up for our flight. When we signed up, the form asked for a pick-up location and gave us a pickup time, but we were actually expected to get there ourselves. Getting there wasn't an issue, but the confusion about what we were supposed to do was frustrating. They also didn't call us when they knew our flight would be rescheduled. They were just going to wait for us to check in at the location to tell us. Luckily, our lodging owner called over there for some other customers and found out that they wouldn't be flying until the afternoon and let us know. We then called and we able to reschedule and clarify the pickup situation. This was frustrating at the time, but the experience was so wonderful, I am not docking them any rating points. I would just suggest that you call before you head there to check on the weather and pickup situation.

We had such a great time on our Grand Canyon plane ride! Our pilot was super professional and made sure we felt safe and comfortable, going over all the safety rules before takeoff.

The views were absolutely incredible—seeing the Grand Canyon from above is something I’ll never forget. My son loved every second of it, and we took tons of photos. I did feel a little nauseous at times, but that’s just part of the experience, nothing to do with the pilot.

Overall, it was an awesome adventure, and I’d give it five stars without hesitation. If you’re thinking about doing this, go for it—you won’t regret it!

review_text:

By plane, better than by helicopter, you can enjoy an uncompromising view of the soil below, the meanders of the Colorado River, the plateaus overlooking it, the animals walking in the numerous gorges and woods. Absolutely not to be missed this experience!

review_title: NOT TO BE MISSED, PANORAMA IS WORTH THE EXPENSE
review_text:
Absolutely to book in advance because you can't do without it.
We booked it a few days before and called to confirm the reservation.
In June 2023 we spent 164 euros each for the flight + 14 euros each for fuel surcharge, it's a lot but the excursion is worth it all.
Having arrived at the airport half an hour early, there was a terrible wind blowing and we were asked if we still wanted to fly as there would have been strong turbulence and if we preferred to cancel they would refund the cost of the tickets.
We asked if we would fly safely, in which case we would have preferred to fly now we were there and we couldn't postpone it as it was an itinerant trip.
It shook so much that you risked crashing your camera into the window, every now and then several driving alarms began to sound and several warning lights came on.
The flight lasts about 40 minutes and was quite challenging and towards the end we had become quiet and a tried...
But I guarantee it was worth it, if I could go back I would do it again without a doubt and I highly recommend it.
From above you have the perception of the earth's crust and the crack that passes through it, it is a completely different image from the one you get when seeing the grand canyon from the various panoramic points on the edge.
I don't want to diminish the beauty of the grand canyon from the views, but in my opinion the flight completes the experience, absolutely worth the money spent.
The plane is honestly dated and the headphone supports and the regulators for the audio guide are now falling to pieces, a little more maintenance could be done on the internal instruments, but I realize that it will always be in flight and the time available is not much, but given the expense one would expect better maintained instruments.
Our flight had 8 seats and we all sat at the window.

review_text:
We had originally thought about doing a helicopter trip of the Canyon, but several people who'd visited suggested the airplane tour was better. We decided to go for it and weren't disappointed.

We managed to book for 11am the following day which suited our schedule perfectly and arrived at their smart reception area at 10:20 as requested.

We were met by the pilot at 10:45 who showed us out to the waiting Cessna Grand Caravan. This is a perfect airplane for this type of trip since it is high-wing and affords an excellent view. Each of the comfortable seats was equipped with good-quality headsets so one could listen to the commentary throughout. The airplane was not too noisy, and it was still possible to hold a conversation with someone on the opposite side of the airplane (after removing the headset of course).

We were soon in the air and flying over the rim of the canyon. It takes a circular clockwise route and covers around 100 miles of the north and south sides of the canyon with excellent views including the Colorado river.

We returned for a very smooth landing around 40 minutes later.

Overall, this was an excellent experience at a reasonable price with plenty of opportunities to take great photos and videos. I would highly recommend it.

One minor gripe - we were asked to pay a $15 per person fuel surcharge at reception and I consider it would be better to incorporate this into the published price.

review_title: This is the way to tour the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Trip Reserved: Grand Canyon Deluxe with Hummer
Our Group: 2 families (4 adults, 2 teenage boys)

On a recent trip to Las Vegas, we wanted the views of the South Rim without the 9 hour round trip drive from Vegas.  After some searching I found this tour. It's not inexpensive, so we considered it for a while before booking.

I had been to the grand canyon twice. My husband and son never had. My husband's initial take was to simply do the 2.5 hour drive from Vegas to the West Rim, proclaiming "rocks are rocks." 

In the end, knowing that the south rim is much more spectacular, we ended up booking this trip. It's a full day, that started with pick up at our hotel, and transfer to the Boulder City airport west of LV. From there we boarded an 8 passenger plane  for a flight over the Hoover Dam, and part of the Grand Canyon before landing at the Grand Canyon Airport. The flight was narrated. Not by the pilot... there were headphones available and a pre-recorded narration in a few languages. It wasn't fantastic, but I appreciated that there was some narration to what we were seeing, and I did learn from it.

Once we landed, we transferred to open-air hummers for a several hour tour through several different vantage points in Grand Canyon National Park. Our tour guide was fantastic. His love of the GC is evident and comes through in his delivery.  We had a boxed lunch (turkey sandwich, apple, chips, cookie, water). He had some fun suggestions for photos. He was very willing to play the role of photographer and take photos. And he was so knowledgeable and just had so much enjoyment about sharing "his Grand Canyon with us"

We returned via the same plane and were dropped off back at our hotel.

I don't know what could possibly make this anything other than a 5-star experience. If you have the means to take this tour, it is a wonderful way to experience one of the Natural Wonders of the World.

PS. Two teens on the trip. Pretty sure the only time they used their phones for the entire day was to take photos!  You know that an experience that can accomplish that is a special one!

review_text:
This was not a bad experience - but it was a little pricey for what you get.

The hotel pick up was fine. The driver was late. I called - repeatedly. Nobody answered. I was worried that we had somehow miscommunicated. Fortunately he was just running late. But it's a little disheartening to discover that there is nobody there if a problem develops. 

They pick you up super early and drive you to the little airport. We sat there waiting for about 90 minutes before we boarded the plane. That's a lot of wasted time. 

The flight was fine. They have twin engine Otters (those are the ones in the pictures) and single engine Cessnas. The Otters hold about 20 and the Cessnas hold about 10 so which plane you get on depends on how many passengers are flying. I suspect that some of the flight delays might be related to consolidating trips to fill the planes.

The flight itself was fine. It felt safe enough and fun if you haven't been on a small plane before. But you wear a headset and listen to an audio recording that sounds like it was made in the 1960s. Ours started late so it wasn't synced with what we were flying over. Then it glitched and started playing the safety briefing again. Then the pilot caught on and restarted the audio - from the start - so we were now way out of sync. Then he tried to zoom forward and it was a little better. But you get the idea - it's pretty canned.

The views of the grand canyon are good. You are much lower than any commercial flight so you see the ground much better but don't get a high level perspective. It's a big loop out and back trip. Most of the people on our flight were dozing off. 

Bottom line, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't something I would do again.

review_title: THIS is the way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: I’ve done the helicopter tour many years ago it was great but short for the $$$. We decided to take the plane tour since it was longer and less $$. WOW it as great only 9 passengers! I had the left view my husband had the right view. Great videos and pics from each side. Doesn’t get better than this!

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Fabulous way to see the Grand Canyon!  The staff and crew were friendly and knowledgeable.  The plane comes equipped with narrated tour available in several languages. Loved every minute!

review_title: Amazing views of the South Rim
review_text:
This tour is worth every cent.  We were picked up promptly from our hotel, then taken to the airfield.  Checked in and boarded our small plane to fly out to the South Rim of the Grand Canyon.  The weather was 45 degrees, so very hot, but they got flying quickly.  Flew over the hoover dam and Lake Mead before arriving at the Canyon.

Then we were put into an open air hummer for a 2 hour tour.  This was great, stopped at lots of lookouts, the guide took lots of photos.  Given a delicious, fresh lunch to enjoy overlooking the south rim of the canyon.

After lunch we were taken to a heliport for a helicopter ride out to and over the canyon - breathtaking.  Then flown back to Las Vegas in the light plane.

Only downside was upon checkin, they advised us that the price of fuel had increased so it would therefore be an extra $33pp - would have been nice to have been told beforehand, rather than right there on the spot - we couldn't back out, not that we would have, but given the price of this tour, I think some correspondence would have been nice.

review_title: NOT TO BE MISSED, PANORAMA IS WORTH THE EXPENSE
review_text:
Absolutely to book in advance because you can't do without it.
We booked it a few days before and called to confirm the reservation.
In June 2023 we spent 164 euros each for the flight + 14 euros each for fuel surcharge, it's a lot but the excursion is worth it all.
Having arrived at the airport half an hour early, there was a terrible wind blowing and we were asked if we still wanted to fly as there would have been strong turbulence and if we preferred to cancel they would refund the cost of the tickets.
We asked if we would fly safely, in which case we would have preferred to fly now we were there and we couldn't postpone it as it was an itinerant trip.
It shook so much that you risked crashing your camera into the window, every now and then several driving alarms began to sound and several warning lights came on.
The flight lasts about 40 minutes and was quite challenging and towards the end we had become quiet and a tried...
But I guarantee it was worth it, if I could go back I would do it again without a doubt and I highly recommend it.
From above you have the perception of the earth's crust and the crack that passes through it, it is a completely different image from the one you get when seeing the grand canyon from the various panoramic points on the edge.
I don't want to diminish the beauty of the grand canyon from the views, but in my opinion the flight completes the experience, absolutely worth the money spent.
The plane is honestly dated and the headphone supports and the regulators for the audio guide are now falling to pieces, a little more maintenance could be done on the internal instruments, but I realize that it will always be in flight and the time available is not much, but given the expense one would expect better maintained instruments.
Our flight had 8 seats and we all sat at the window.
My daughter and I had a great time.  The views are incredible and the pilot is very knowledgeable.  I only wish it lasted longer

review_title: Incredible views/large windows/great information - worth every penny
review_text: Well worth the price. We flew in a 19 passenger Otter fixed wing aircraft out over the east rim/Grand Canyon. Amazing views and great visibility. We each has our own window and these windows are LARGE - you have an amazing view. The flight was 45 - 50 minutes from takeoff to landing. Great information as we flew - and was in several languages. The other passengers were French. We all enjoyed this flight. It was a  toss up with fixed wing or helicopter and I am very glad we selected the airplane. You saw EVERYTHING and had time to take incredible photos. Again, worth every penny!! Do it!!

Amazing. Very choppy with turbulence but worth every penny to see that awe inspiring view from above. 
A memory for me to cherish as both my grown up sons with me
The flight was awesome and we got to see so much of the canyon!  They did a beautiful job showing us around!

The flight through the Grand Canyon was incredible!
The Hummer tour was awesome.  Our guide, Alice was very knowledgeable, attentive and fun.  Thank you for an unforgettable trip

review_title: Best view of the Grand Canyon
review_text: We have taken many helicopter/airplane/hot air balloon rides and this 45 minute flight was by far the most incredible experience we've had. The team at GCA was experienced, happy and fun. We took the 9AM flight and sat in the last row of the "Twin Otter". Windows are big and words just don't do the loop justice. If you visit the National Park do yourself a favor and get on a flight. It will be the highlight of your visit. The many vistas you can see from the edge of the canyon do not compare to what you see from the plane. AMAZING! Worth every penny.
Tolles Erlebnis. Crew super nett. Der Blick von oben auf den Canyon lässt erst die Dimensionen erkennen.

Survol de 35-40 minutes à bord d’un petit avion (8 passagers à bord). Pilote super agréable. Commentaires en casque audio (un canal par l langue), il y a du français. Survol de différents spots : plateaux, canyons. Prix intéressant.

Booked direct, over two months in advance. With only a couple hours to go before our flight they tell us it's cancelled, since not enough people signed up for the time slot. They offered times later in the day but we had so little warning that we were unable to make the last minute schedule change. It took over a week to get a refund with zero communication on their end during the delay. 

We spoke to some Grand Canyon park employees and they said they frequently heard complaints about Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines being flaky and dropping reservations with little warning. Buyer beware.

Horrible experience when the third party booking company doesn't communicate with the actual servicing company. And the policies of the booking company don't apply with the servicing company. I had a hard time getting a hold of anyone after my booking was canceled due to inclimate weather but they were not understanding when I followed original booking cancelation policy. After finally communicating with a supervisor I was told I would get a refund but then weeks later I was told no. Horrible customer service.

review_title: Spectacular experience - takes your breath away!
review_text: Our flight over the Grand Canyon was spectacular and is one of my top travel experiences ever!  Our scheduled flight had to be canceled because of weather, but luckily there was room the next morning and the weather cooperated. It was absolutely worth delaying our arrival at our next stop to do the flight. If you are trying to decide, stop thinking about it and do it!  You will not regret it!

review_text: We had a fantastic flight with Jack as the pilot. Incredible views of the  Grand Canyon and the surrounding National Park.  The seating in our aircraft was brilliant as everyone was sitting next to a window.  I don't know what the regulations are but it would have been nice to get a little lower.
Professional and attentive airline crew.  Hummer tour was outstanding!!  The tour guide Alice was so knowledgeable and she made the trip exceptional.  Highly recommend this tour.
Captain Jack was the best. This tour was SMS big!!! Smooth take off and landing.  Amazingy experience.

review_title: Great way to take in the Grand Canyon.
review_text: Great way to see the entire canyon. If you are staying at or near the south rim it’s a short trip to the airport. Excellent value. Our pilot had many years of experience and lots of interesting facts to share

It’s a must visit experience. It’s off season in winters but less crowded peaceful and serene. I assume summers are the best but then if you enjoy lot of company it’s the season to go. Antelope, south rim , morning sunrise at yavapai are a must. There are various points that you can cover from one entrance to another.  We went through Salt Lake City / utah route from Vegas and that is very scenic and beautiful.

review_title: One of the 7 wonders of the world and one of the best Bucket list items to do.
review_text:
Everything was wonderful! Everyone has their own window, but I do recommend the left side if you can get it. There are only 8 seats, so everybody will have a great view; it’s a great little plane for seeing the canyon. You will not be disappointed.
Kevin was our pilot and he would share bits of history along the route. He is very kind and even took extra time after the flight to answer our questions about his experience and the Grand Canyon. 
The weather was perfect, blue sky and sunshine, and we could see for miles. November is a great time to visit GC with smaller crowds, plenty of space, and shorter lines.  I highly recommend!

We had originally thought about doing a helicopter trip of the Canyon, but several people who'd visited suggested the airplane tour was better. We decided to go for it and weren't disappointed.

We managed to book for 11am the following day which suited our schedule perfectly and arrived at their smart reception area at 10:20 as requested.

We were met by the pilot at 10:45 who showed us out to the waiting Cessna Grand Caravan. This is a perfect airplane for this type of trip since it is high-wing and affords an excellent view. Each of the comfortable seats was equipped with good-quality headsets so one could listen to the commentary throughout. The airplane was not too noisy, and it was still possible to hold a conversation with someone on the opposite side of the airplane (after removing the headset of course).

We were soon in the air and flying over the rim of the canyon. It takes a circular clockwise route and covers around 100 miles of the north and south sides of the canyon with excellent views including the Colorado river.

We returned for a very smooth landing around 40 minutes later.

Overall, this was an excellent experience at a reasonable price with plenty of opportunities to take great photos and videos. I would highly recommend it.

One minor gripe - we were asked to pay a $15 per person fuel surcharge at reception and I consider it would be better to incorporate this into the published price.

review_text: Tolle Aussicht und Überblick über die riesigen Ausmaße des Grand Canyon. Endlich auch den Colorado River auf dem Grund des Canyons entdeckt. Ganz andere Perspektive als vom South Rim

review_title: Smiled to myself the whole flight.
review_text: "Craig the pilot was very helpful with any questions. Seasoned pilot. The whole operation is totally professional. The flight was totally awesome. A must see over the grand canyon.

review_title: Wonderful flight right into the Grand Canyon
review_text: This small Cessna airplane gave every passenger a great view and super commentary of the Grand Canyon.  We could each take all the pictures we chose to take and the pilot was very accommodating.  We didn't take the Hummer Tour, but the flight right into the Canyon was amazing.

This flight will leave you speechless. It provides incomparable, incredible views of the Grand Canyon.
The flight itself was smooth (despite the thunderstorm!) and a really nice infotainment through your headset to provide history and information the Grand Canyon itself.
Pilot and First Officer were both extremely talkative to everyone, allowing photos of the plane etc.
Would do this again in a heartbeat. Amazing.

Each seat had excellent views of the Grand Canyon. Taking the whole scene in by air is maybe the best way to understand the size and majesty of the canyon. The crew was professional, aircraft was top notch (nothing rickety here) and the cost was reasonable compared to other air tours we have done in different parts of the country. Highly recommend this flight experience!
Wonderful experience, beautiful views. Definitely the way to see the Canyon and all the beautiful scenery. Took my daughter who had never seen the canyon and it was a great flight.

review_title: Fascinating flight with nice extra info on the canyon
review_text: To fly above the Canyon gives you so much better view on the size of the canyon. The info during the flight about the creation and changes of the canyon are interesting to know andf make the trip worth while. We did not do the drive, only the flight.

review_title: We really enjoyed the air tour
review_text: We really enjoyed the air tour of the Grand Canyon National Park. After a full day of viewing the wonder from the rim it was super cool to experience it from the air.

I did the rim to sky tour. Best part of my visit by far! Everyone was so nice and paying for the window seat was so worth it!! I came to the Canyon to hike but sprained my ankle right beforehand. It was the prefect way to see the canyon and couldn’t imagine my trip without it! I would do it again even if I was able to hike!
Amazing views! Craig was a great pilot, super nice and friendly. There are headsets with music and information about the Canyon that play as you fly.

Our family had a wonderful time flying on a Grand Canyon tour.  The people were very friendly and professional.  The sights were amazing and the tour gave you a great feeling of just how majestic and awesome the Grand Canyon truly is as a whole.

review_text: Enjoyed seeing better view of the Colorado River. Seeing the Rapids was cool. The pilot and copilot were pleasant people. The greeter was nice and helpful.

review_title: At a loss for words- best way to see a lot of the Grand Canyon in a short time!
review_text: The experience was amazing.  The vantage point offered by this tour can not be had from the rim edge.  Seeing the Colorado river, the snow on the north rim, along with breathtaking views the entire way, would make me highly, highly recommend this tour.   The crew was helpful, and experienced.  The crew even took photos for us in front of the plane at the end.  The only thing I can say that could have been better was the narration through the headphones was a bit scratchy.  Take this tour if you are even thinking about it!  The airplane windows were extra large and everyone had a window seat.

review_title: Great way to experience the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Loved our tour! Captain Jack was great and very personable with our teenagers. Our oldest son got to ride up front with him. Loved that everyone had a good sized window seat. The narration provided was excellent. So awesome seeing the Grand Canyon for the first time by air to get an understanding of its size. Our hummer tour was wonderful also. Definitely recommend this combo.

review_title: This is the way to tour the Grand Canyon
review_text:
Trip Reserved: Grand Canyon Deluxe with Hummer
Our Group: 2 families (4 adults, 2 teenage boys)

On a recent trip to Las Vegas, we wanted the views of the South Rim without the 9 hour round trip drive from Vegas.  After some searching I found this tour. It's not inexpensive, so we considered it for a while before booking.

I had been to the grand canyon twice. My husband and son never had. My husband's initial take was to simply do the 2.5 hour drive from Vegas to the West Rim, proclaiming "rocks are rocks." 

In the end, knowing that the south rim is much more spectacular, we ended up booking this trip. It's a full day, that started with pick up at our hotel, and transfer to the Boulder City airport west of LV. From there we boarded an 8 passenger plane  for a flight over the Hoover Dam, and part of the Grand Canyon before landing at the Grand Canyon Airport. The flight was narrated. Not by the pilot... there were headphones available and a pre-recorded narration in a few languages. It wasn't fantastic, but I appreciated that there was some narration to what we were seeing, and I did learn from it.

Once we landed, we transferred to open-air hummers for a several hour tour through several different vantage points in Grand Canyon National Park. Our tour guide was fantastic. His love of the GC is evident and comes through in his delivery.  We had a boxed lunch (turkey sandwich, apple, chips, cookie, water). He had some fun suggestions for photos. He was very willing to play the role of photographer and take photos. And he was so knowledgeable and just had so much enjoyment about sharing "his Grand Canyon with us"

We returned via the same plane and were dropped off back at our hotel.

I don't know what could possibly make this anything other than a 5-star experience. If you have the means to take this tour, it is a wonderful way to experience one of the Natural Wonders of the World.

PS. Two teens on the trip. Pretty sure the only time they used their phones for the entire day was to take photos!  You know that an experience that can accomplish that is a special one!

review_title: Breathtaking views and experience I’ll never forget.
review_text:
I am physically disabled and wanted to experience the Grand Canyon while vacationing in AZ. I highly recommend taking this tour. The tour was breathtaking and we got to see the Canyon closer then I expected. 

From check-in with Howard to pics and the actual flight, everything went smoothly. Howard is very friendly and funny and the repot between him and the pilot had all of us laughing.

I will never forget this experience.
This is a great way to see the Grand Canyon! Was on time, smooth ride. Airport is very convenient to Tusayan town.

This was not a bad experience - but it was a little pricey for what you get.

The hotel pick up was fine. The driver was late. I called - repeatedly. Nobody answered. I was worried that we had somehow miscommunicated. Fortunately he was just running late. But it's a little disheartening to discover that there is nobody there if a problem develops. 

They pick you up super early and drive you to the little airport. We sat there waiting for about 90 minutes before we boarded the plane. That's a lot of wasted time. 

The flight was fine. They have twin engine Otters (those are the ones in the pictures) and single engine Cessnas. The Otters hold about 20 and the Cessnas hold about 10 so which plane you get on depends on how many passengers are flying. I suspect that some of the flight delays might be related to consolidating trips to fill the planes.

The flight itself was fine. It felt safe enough and fun if you haven't been on a small plane before. But you wear a headset and listen to an audio recording that sounds like it was made in the 1960s. Ours started late so it wasn't synced with what we were flying over. Then it glitched and started playing the safety briefing again. Then the pilot caught on and restarted the audio - from the start - so we were now way out of sync. Then he tried to zoom forward and it was a little better. But you get the idea - it's pretty canned.

The views of the grand canyon are good. You are much lower than any commercial flight so you see the ground much better but don't get a high level perspective. It's a big loop out and back trip. Most of the people on our flight were dozing off. 

Bottom line, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't something I would do again.

Flying over the Grand Canyon offered great views because you not only saw it from overhead, but also viewed different areas of the canyon. The plane held around 8-10 people and all seats were on a window. One side of the plane had a better view than the other based on the direction of the flight. We went counter-clockwise on the tour, so the left side was always looking at the canyon. It is a small plane, so the ride was very choppy.
We had a terrific experience flying this airline over the grand canyon.  It felt very safe and we got terrific views you couldn't get from th he ground!

Wow! Is what comes to mind when thinking about the experience we had with Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane. Despite a very windy day, our pilot decided it was safe enough to take us up and informed us that our flight would be rocky, but still safe. Safe was all I needed to hear. 

The 45 minute flight was a tour of the entire South Rim and included an on-flight informative guide (via headphones) that turned out to be very insightful.

 Finding parking at the Grand Canyon airport was fairly easy and so was our check in. I would highly recommend bringing your own camera to take pictures of what will probably be the best vantage point into the canyon. I would also try my best to board the plane first. Although everyone will get a window seat, (on a smaller plane; 8-10 people) there are a few seats that have a wing blocking your shot, thus preventing you from capturing the perfect picture. If you are simply there to take in the sights, any seat will be fine. 

If you are prone to motion sickness, I would recommend bringing gum, or taking something for it before your flight departs. Keep in mind that if it is too windy and deemed unsafe your flight may be cancelled (check the weather). However, if there are high winds and it's safe to go, it will feel like a 45 minute roller-coaster ride. 

I am very pleased with this experience and would definitely do it again. The ticket price is well worth it and I am very thankful that our pilot turned out to be happy and experienced and landed us safely.
